+"""Read-only live identity probe for the Reel #2 ``social,`` caption."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+from xml.etree import ElementTree
+
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4_REEL2_SOCIAL_TARGET_READONLY_PREFLIGHT_V1"
+MODE = "step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight"
+PROJECT_NAME = "New Project 1"
+TIMELINE_NAME = "DcJRJtUKScu_offline_timeline_v1"
+TIMELINE_UID = "4ad2a3c3-031c-464d-96aa-76a045608ad6"
+ITEM_NAME = "VC Caption 0045 - social,"
+TRACK = 2
+START = 365
+END = 376
+TEXT = "social,"
+CANONICAL_WINDOW = [359, 383]
+LOCAL_ANIMATION_RANGE = [0, 23]
+ZERO_MUTATIONS = {
+    "saves": 0, "creates": 0, "deletes": 0, "title_writes": 0,
+    "modifier_writes": 0, "keyframe_writes": 0, "imports": 0,
+    "relinks": 0, "replaces": 0, "timeline_selections": 0,
+}
+
+
+def _load_base() -> Any:
+    path = Path(__file__).with_name("video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application.py")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vc_social_target_phase6", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"cannot_load:{path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+BASE = _load_base()
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_command(command: Mapping[str, Any], run_id: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    required_false = (
+        "mutation_permitted", "save_project", "create_permitted",
+        "delete_permitted", "title_write_permitted", "modifier_write_permitted",
+        "keyframe_write_permitted", "import_permitted", "relink_permitted",
+        "replace_permitted", "timeline_selection_permitted",
+    )
+    if (
+        command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID
+        or command.get("mode") != MODE
+        or command.get("run_id") != run_id
+        or payload.get("read_only") is not True
+        or any(payload.get(key) is not False for key in required_false)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("read_only_command_authority")
+    expected = {
+        "expected_project": PROJECT_NAME,
+        "target_timeline_name": TIMELINE_NAME,
+        "expected_timeline_uid": TIMELINE_UID,
+        "expected_item_name": ITEM_NAME,
+        "expected_track": TRACK,
+        "expected_start": START,
+        "expected_end": END,
+        "expected_text": TEXT,
+        "canonical_window": CANONICAL_WINDOW,
+        "local_animation_range": LOCAL_ANIMATION_RANGE,
+    }
+    if any(payload.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+        raise ValueError("target_authority")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _repository_file(root: Path, value: Any) -> Path:
+    path = Path(str(value or ""))
+    path = path.resolve() if path.is_absolute() else (root / path).resolve()
+    path.relative_to(root)
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"authority_missing:{path}")
+    return path
+
+
+def verify_authority(root: Path, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    report_path = _repository_file(root, payload.get("accepted_report_path"))
+    export_path = _repository_file(root, payload.get("exported_fcpxml_path"))
+    if _sha256(report_path) != payload.get("accepted_report_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError("accepted_report_hash")
+    if _sha256(export_path) != payload.get("exported_fcpxml_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError("exported_fcpxml_hash")
+    accepted = json.loads(report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if any((
+        accepted.get("ok") is not True,
+        accepted.get("classification") != "VIDEO_CLONER_V1_LIVE_ACCEPTED",
+        accepted.get("project_name") != PROJECT_NAME,
+        accepted.get("target_timeline_name") != TIMELINE_NAME,
+        accepted.get("target_unique_id") != TIMELINE_UID,
+        accepted.get("ownership_classification") != "NEWLY_CREATED",
+        (accepted.get("applied_operation_counts") or {}).get("textplus_titles") != 92,
+    )):
+        raise ValueError("accepted_report_contract")
+    titles = []
+    for title in ElementTree.parse(export_path).getroot().iter("title"):
+        name = str(title.get("name") or "")
+        text = "".join(title.itertext()).strip()
+        if name == ITEM_NAME:
+            titles.append({
+                "name": name,
+                "lane": int(title.get("lane") or 0),
+                "start": _frames(title.get("offset")),
+                "duration": _frames(title.get("duration")),
+                "text": text,
+            })
+    if titles != [{"name": ITEM_NAME, "lane": 1, "start": START, "duration": END - START, "text": TEXT}]:
+        raise ValueError("exported_title_contract")
+    return {
+        "accepted_report": str(report_path),
+        "exported_fcpxml": str(export_path),
+        "timeline_ownership": "NEWLY_CREATED",
+        "historical_caption_count": 92,
+        "title": titles[0],
+    }
+
+
+def _frames(value: Any) -> int:
+    raw = str(value or "").removesuffix("s")
+    numerator, denominator = raw.split("/", 1)
+    return round(float(numerator) / float(denominator) * 24)
+
+
+def _timeline_identity(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        "name": str(BASE._safe(timeline, "GetName", default="") or ""),
+        "unique_id": str(BASE._safe(timeline, "GetUniqueId", default="") or ""),
+    }
+
+
+def _modifier_state(tool: Any, input_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    input_object = BASE._safe(tool, "FindInput", input_name, default=None)
+    output = BASE._safe(input_object, "GetConnectedOutput", default=None) if input_object is not None else None
+    modifier = BASE._safe(output, "GetTool", default=None) if output is not None else None
+    attrs = BASE._safe(modifier, "GetAttrs", default={}) if modifier is not None else {}
+    keyframes = BASE._safe(modifier, "GetKeyFrames", default={}) if modifier is not None else {}
+    return {
+        "connected": output is not None,
+        "modifier_type": str((attrs or {}).get("TOOLS_RegID") or "") or None,
+        "keyframes": json.loads(json.dumps(keyframes or {}, default=str)),
+    }
+
+
+def _fusion_state(item: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    count = int(BASE._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0)
+    nodes = []
+    textplus = []
+    for index in range(1, count + 1):
+        comp = BASE._safe(item, "GetFusionCompByIndex", index, default=None)
+        tools = BASE._safe(comp, "GetToolList", False, default={}) if comp is not None else {}
+        for tool in (tools.values() if isinstance(tools, Mapping) else []):
+            attrs = BASE._safe(tool, "GetAttrs", default={}) or {}
+            row = {
+                "name": str(attrs.get("TOOLS_Name") or ""),
+                "reg_id": str(attrs.get("TOOLS_RegID") or attrs.get("TOOLST_RegID") or ""),
+            }
+            nodes.append(row)
+            if row["reg_id"] == "TextPlus":
+                textplus.append({**row, "styled_text": str(BASE._safe(tool, "GetInput", "StyledText", 0, default="") or ""),
+                                 "modifiers": {name: _modifier_state(tool, name) for name in ("Center", "Size")}})
+    return {"fusion_composition_count": count, "fusion_nodes": nodes, "textplus_nodes": textplus,
+            "textplus_node_count": len(textplus)}
+
+
+def inspect(resolve: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    manager = BASE._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager", default=None)
+    project = BASE._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject", default=None)
+    project_name = str(BASE._safe(project, "GetName", default="") or "")
+    if project is None or project_name != PROJECT_NAME:
+        raise ValueError(f"project_identity:{project_name}")
+    timelines = BASE._timelines(project)
+    name_matches = [timeline for timeline in timelines if _timeline_identity(timeline)["name"] == TIMELINE_NAME]
+    if len(name_matches) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"timeline_name_occurrence:{len(name_matches)}")
+    timeline = name_matches[0]
+    identity = _timeline_identity(timeline)
+    if identity["unique_id"] != TIMELINE_UID:
+        raise ValueError(f"timeline_uid:{identity['unique_id']}")
+
+    structural = []
+    for track in range(1, int(BASE._safe(timeline, "GetTrackCount", "video", default=0) or 0) + 1):
+        for item in list(BASE._safe(timeline, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", track, default=[]) or []):
+            start = int(BASE._safe(item, "GetStart", default=-1))
+            end = int(BASE._safe(item, "GetEnd", default=-1))
+            if track == TRACK and start == START and end == END:
+                structural.append((track, item))
+    if len(structural) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"structural_target_occurrence:{len(structural)}")
+    track, item = structural[0]
+    uid = str(BASE._safe(item, "GetUniqueId", default="") or "")
+    if not uid:
+        raise ValueError("timeline_item_uid")
+    item_name = str(BASE._safe(item, "GetName", default="") or "")
+    if item_name not in {"Text", "Basic Title", ITEM_NAME}:
+        raise ValueError(f"item_identity:{item_name}")
+    styled_text = BASE._title_text(item)
+    if styled_text != TEXT:
+        raise ValueError(f"styled_text:{styled_text}")
+    duration = int(BASE._safe(item, "GetDuration", default=end - start))
+    if duration != END - START:
+        raise ValueError(f"duration:{duration}")
+    properties = BASE._safe(item, "GetProperty", default={}) or {}
+    fusion = _fusion_state(item)
+    target = {
+        "timeline_item_uid": uid,
+        "item_name": item_name,
+        "item_type": str(properties.get("Type") or properties.get("Clip Type") or "") or None,
+        "track": track, "start": start, "end": end, "duration": duration,
+        "styled_text": styled_text, **fusion,
+    }
+    if fusion["fusion_composition_count"] == 0 and fusion["textplus_node_count"] == 0:
+        classification = "TEXTPLUS_RECONSTRUCTION_REQUIRED"
+    elif fusion["fusion_composition_count"] >= 1 and fusion["textplus_node_count"] == 1:
+        classification = "TEXTPLUS_TARGET_EXISTS"
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("fusion_textplus_structure")
+    return {
+        "project": project_name,
+        "timeline": identity,
+        "classification": classification,
+        "target_unique": True,
+        "target": target,
+        "compatibility": {
+            "persisted_window": [START, END],
+            "canonical_visual_window": CANONICAL_WINDOW,
+            "required_local_animation_range": LOCAL_ANIMATION_RANGE,
+            "can_host_unchanged": duration > LOCAL_ANIMATION_RANGE[1] and start == CANONICAL_WINDOW[0] and end == CANONICAL_WINDOW[1],
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _queue_preflight(root: Path, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    queue = root / ".agent" / "commands"
+    pending = list((queue / "pending").glob("*.json"))
+    running = list((queue / "running").glob("*.json"))
+    if pending or len(running) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"queue_state:{len(pending)}:{len(running)}")
+    command = json.loads(running[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if command.get("run_id") != run_id or command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID:
+        raise ValueError("queue_identity")
+    return {"pending": 0, "running": 1, "command": running[0].name}
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or command.get("run_id") or "")
+    report = {
+        "ok": False, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "mode": MODE,
+        "classification": "READONLY_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED", "read_only": True,
+        "mutation_counts": dict(ZERO_MUTATIONS), "failures": [],
+    }
+    try:
+        payload = validate_command(command, run_id)
+        root = Path(str(payload.get("repository_root") or "")).resolve()
+        if not (root / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
+            raise ValueError("repository_identity")
+        report["queue_preflight"] = _queue_preflight(root, run_id)
+        report["authority"] = verify_authority(root, payload)
+        before = [BASE.timeline_snapshot(timeline) for timeline in BASE._timelines(BASE._safe(BASE._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager"), "GetCurrentProject"))]
+        result = inspect(resolve)
+        after = [BASE.timeline_snapshot(timeline) for timeline in BASE._timelines(BASE._safe(BASE._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager"), "GetCurrentProject"))]
+        if before != after:
+            raise ValueError("resolve_state_changed")
+        report.update(result)
+        report["protected_state_unchanged"] = True
+        report["reel1_unchanged"] = True
+        report["reel2_unchanged"] = True
+        report["ok"] = True
+    except Exception as exc:
+        report["failures"] = [f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"]
+    return report
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4_sub001_style_probe.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4_sub001_style_probe.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..dc6beb1538d570f58535f3e8c2034a696ac9abfd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4_sub001_style_probe.py
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step4_fresh_reel2_textplus as fresh
+from scripts.davinci.resolve_apply_video_cloner_metadata import set_caption_textplus_style_inputs
+from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_textplus import prepare_textplus_authority
+
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4_SUB001_STYLE_PROBE_V1"
+
+
+def _first_mismatch(style_result: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    for name in ("Font", "Style", "Size", "Center", "Enabled1", "Red1", "Green1", "Blue1", "Alpha1", "Enabled2", "Enabled3", "Enabled4", "Enabled5", "Enabled6", "Enabled7", "Enabled8", "StyledText"):
+        row = (style_result.get("inputs") or {}).get(name) or {}
+        if not row.get("verified"):
+            return {"field": name, "api_input": name, "expected": ((row.get("write") or {}).get("value")), "actual": ((row.get("readback") or {}).get("value")), "detail": row}
+    shading = style_result.get("shading_probe") or {}
+    for section in ("outline", "shadow"):
+        for row in (shading.get(section) or {}).get("attempts") or []:
+            if row.get("required", True) and not row.get("ok"):
+                return {"field": section, "api_input": row.get("resolved_input_id") or row.get("candidates"), "expected": row.get("value"), "actual": ((row.get("readback") or {}).get("value")), "detail": row}
+    return None
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": context.get("run_id"), "save_count": 0, "failures": []}
+    project = target = current_before = None
+    created = False
+    try:
+        command = context.get("command") or {}
+        payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != "probe" or command.get("run_id") != context.get("run_id"):
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        paths = {name: Path(str(payload[name])).resolve() for name in ("fcpxml", "generic", "style", "lifecycle", "proxy")}
+        for name, path in paths.items():
+            if not path.is_file() or fresh._sha256(path) != payload[f"{name}_sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"artifact_identity:{name}")
+
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or str(carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") or "") != payload["expected_project"]:
+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        pool = carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool")
+        current_before = carrier._safe(project, "GetCurrentTimeline")
+        protected_before = carrier._timeline_inventory(project)
+        if any(row["name"] == payload["timeline_name"] for row in protected_before):
+            raise ValueError("probe_target_exists")
+
+        authority = prepare_textplus_authority(fresh._read(paths["generic"]), fresh._read(paths["style"]), fresh._read(paths["lifecycle"]))
+        cue = authority["cues"][0]
+        if cue["id"] != "visual_token_sub_001":
+            raise ValueError("probe_token_identity")
+        raw_style = authority["cue_styles"].get(int(cue["index"])) or authority["style"]
+        runtime_style = fresh._style(raw_style)
+
+        carrier._safe(pool, "ImportTimelineFromFile", str(paths["fcpxml"]))
+        matches = [row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if str(carrier._safe(row, "GetName", default="") or "") == payload["timeline_name"]]
+        if len(matches) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("import_target_identity")
+        target = matches[0]
+        created = True
+        fresh._baseline(target)
+        if not carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", target, default=False):
+            raise ValueError("probe_target_activation")
+        if not carrier._safe(target, "AddTrack", "video", default=False):
+            raise ValueError("probe_track_creation")
+
+        v1 = list(carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", 1, default=[]) or [])
+        source = carrier._safe(v1[0], "GetMediaPoolItem") if v1 else None
+        props = carrier._safe(source, "GetClipProperty", default={}) if source is not None else {}
+        source_path = next((props.get(key) for key in ("File Path", "FilePath", "Path") if isinstance(props, Mapping) and props.get(key)), None)
+        if source is None or not fresh._same_path(source_path, paths["proxy"]):
+            raise ValueError("probe_carrier_identity")
+
+        provision = carrier.apply_carrier_textplus_v2(project, target, [{"caption_id": cue["id"], "text": cue["text"], "timeline_start": cue["start_frame"], "duration": cue["duration_frames"], "lane": cue["lane"]}], source, {
+            "ownership": carrier.CARRIER_OWNERSHIP,
+            "preexisting": True,
+            "deletion_permitted": False,
+            "unique_id": carrier._unique_id(source),
+            "source_start": 0,
+        })
+        if not provision.get("ok") or provision.get("created_count") != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"probe_provision:{provision.get('failures')}")
+        item_id = provision["rows"][0]["item_unique_id"]
+        item = next((item for item in carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", 2, default=[]) or [] if carrier._unique_id(item) == item_id), None)
+        if item is None:
+            raise ValueError("probe_item_reacquisition")
+        comp, tool = fresh._textplus(item)
+        args = argparse.Namespace(
+            caption_apply_outline=runtime_style["stroke_width"] > 0,
+            caption_apply_shadow=runtime_style["shadow_enabled"],
+            caption_shading_probe_only=False,
+            caption_outline_element=2,
+            caption_shadow_element=3,
+            caption_outline_width_scale=1.0,
+            caption_outline_thickness=None,
+            caption_shadow_opacity=None,
+            caption_shadow_offset_x=0.003,
+            caption_shadow_offset_y=0.003,
+            caption_shadow_softness=None,
+        )
+        style_result = set_caption_textplus_style_inputs(tool, cue, runtime_style, int(cue["index"]), args=args, comp=comp)
+        mismatch = _first_mismatch(style_result)
+
+        if not carrier._safe(pool, "DeleteTimelines", [target], default=False):
+            raise ValueError("probe_rollback")
+        created = False
+        if current_before is not None:
+            carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", current_before, default=False)
+        protected_after = carrier._timeline_inventory(project)
+        if protected_before != protected_after:
+            raise ValueError("protected_timeline_delta")
+
+        result.update({
+            "ok": True,
+            "classification": "STYLE_FIELD_DIVERGENCE_PROVEN" if mismatch else "STYLE_PROBE_PASSED",
+            "token": {"id": cue["id"], "text": cue["text"], "window": [cue["start_frame"], cue["end_frame"]]},
+            "expected_authority": raw_style,
+            "runtime_style_payload": runtime_style,
+            "alignment": {"authority": ((raw_style.get("placement") or {}).get("horizontal_align")), "enforced_by_current_writer": False},
+            "style_readback": style_result,
+            "first_mismatch": mismatch,
+            "rollback_deleted_disposable": True,
+            "protected_timeline_delta": 0,
+        })
+    except Exception as exc:
+        result["failures"] = [f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"]
+        if created and project is not None and target is not None:
+            result["rollback_deleted_disposable"] = bool(carrier._safe(carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool"), "DeleteTimelines", [target], default=False))
+            if current_before is not None:
+                carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", current_before, default=False)
+    return result
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..456b4d86c2f7aa16506d3cefb30277fafca1aab9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py
@@ -0,0 +1,439 @@
+"""Bounded disposable live proof for the STEP 4B Text+ animation adapter."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+import traceback
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4C_ANIMATION_LIVE_PROBE_V1"
+MODE = "step4c_animation_live_probe"
+PROJECT_NAME = "New Project 1"
+REEL1 = "DZsqH7auhjt_textplus_visual_first_full_rollout_polish_v4_confirmed74_repair_metrics_v1_occlusion_complete_v4_flash_transition_v4"
+REEL2 = "DcJRJtUKScu_standalone_timeline"
+SOURCE_TIMELINE = REEL1
+PROBE_PREFIX = "VC_STEP4C_ANIMATION_PROBE_"
+TARGET_TRACK = 3
+TARGET_FRAMES = (100, 250, 400)
+EXISTING_TARGET_FRAMES = (250, 400, 550)
+ITEM_NAMES = ("VC_STEP4C_CENTER", "VC_STEP4C_SIZE", "VC_STEP4C_STATIC")
+STATIC_PROOF_NAME = "VC_STEP4C_STATIC_PROOF"
+STATIC_PROOF_FRAME = 100
+TITLE_DURATION = 12
+
+CENTER_PAYLOAD = {
+    "authority": "visual_observed",
+    "source_evidence_id": "step4c_disposable_center",
+    "source_type": "slide",
+    "property": "Center",
+    "keyframes": [
+        {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": [-0.0106, 0.0565]},
+        {"frame": 2, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": [0.0, 0.0]},
+    ],
+}
+SIZE_PAYLOAD = {
+    "authority": "visual_observed",
+    "source_evidence_id": "step4c_disposable_size",
+    "source_type": "scale",
+    "property": "Size",
+    "keyframes": [
+        {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.30217657},
+        {"frame": 7, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 1.0},
+    ],
+}
+
+
+def repository_root() -> Path:
+    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+
+
+def _load(name: str, path: Path) -> Any:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"cannot_load:{path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def load_dependencies(root: Path) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any, Any]:
+    previous = os.environ.get("VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN")
+    os.environ["VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN"] = "1"
+    try:
+        animation = _load("vc_step4c_animation", root / "resolve_workspace/resolve_apply_caption_animation_step_3C.py")
+    finally:
+        if previous is None:
+            os.environ.pop("VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN", None)
+        else:
+            os.environ["VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN"] = previous
+    return (
+        _load("vc_step4c_native", root / "resolve_workspace/modules/step_3D_native_textplus_title_probe.py"),
+        animation,
+        _load("vc_step4c_snapshot", root / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_phase4b_timeline_application.py"),
+        _load("vc_step4c_carrier", root / "scripts/davinci/resolve_apply_video_cloner_metadata.py"),
+    )
+
+
+def _find_unique(native: Any, project: Any, name: str) -> Any:
+    matches = []
+    for index in range(1, native.timeline_count(project) + 1):
+        timeline = native.safe_value(project, "GetTimelineByIndex", index, default=None)
+        if timeline is not None and native.timeline_name(timeline) == name:
+            matches.append(timeline)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def queue_preflight(root: Path, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    queue = root / ".agent/commands"
+    pending = sorted((queue / "pending").glob("*.json"))
+    running = sorted((queue / "running").glob("*.json"))
+    if pending or len(running) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"queue_state:pending={len(pending)}:running={len(running)}")
+    command = json.loads(running[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if command.get("run_id") != run_id or command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID:
+        raise RuntimeError("queue_identity")
+    return {"pending_count": 0, "running_count": 1, "running_command": running[0].name}
+
+
+def _modifier(animation: Any, native: Any, tool: Any, input_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    output = animation.connected_output(animation.find_input(tool, input_name))
+    if output is None:
+        return {"connected": False, "type": None, "keyframes": {}, "keyframe_count": 0}
+    modifier = native.safe_value(output, "GetTool", default=None)
+    attrs = native.safe_value(modifier, "GetAttrs", default={}) if modifier is not None else {}
+    output_attrs = native.safe_value(output, "GetAttrs", default={}) or {}
+    modifier_type = str((attrs or {}).get("TOOLS_RegID") or (attrs or {}).get("TOOLS_Name") or output_attrs.get("OUTS_Name") or "")
+    keyframes = native.safe_value(modifier, "GetKeyFrames", default=None) if modifier is not None else None
+    if keyframes is None:
+        keyframes = native.safe_value(output, "GetKeyFrames", default={}) or {}
+    safe_keys = native.json_safe(keyframes)
+    count = len(safe_keys) if isinstance(safe_keys, (dict, list)) else 0
+    return {"connected": True, "type": modifier_type, "keyframes": safe_keys, "keyframe_count": count}
+
+
+def _tool_state(animation: Any, native: Any, tool: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {name: _modifier(animation, native, tool, name) for name in ("Center", "Size")}
+
+
+def _temporal_readback(animation: Any, tool: Any, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    name = str(payload["property"])
+    return [
+        {
+            "frame": row["frame"],
+            "expected": row["value"],
+            "actual": animation.normalize_value(name, animation.read_input(tool, name, row["frame"])),
+            "matched": animation.values_match(name, animation.read_input(tool, name, row["frame"]), row["value"]),
+        }
+        for row in payload["keyframes"]
+    ]
+
+
+def protected_snapshot(native: Any, animation: Any, snapshots: Any, timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    base = snapshots.timeline_snapshot(timeline)
+    topology = []
+    for track, item in native.all_video_items(timeline):
+        tools = native.get_text_tools(native.get_comp(item))
+        for index, tool in enumerate(tools):
+            topology.append({
+                "item_unique_id": native.item_unique_id(item),
+                "item_name": native.item_name(item),
+                "track": track,
+                "tool_index": index,
+                "inputs": _tool_state(animation, native, tool),
+            })
+    topology.sort(key=lambda row: (row["track"], row["item_name"], row["item_unique_id"], row["tool_index"]))
+    result = {"timeline": base, "animation_topology": topology}
+    result["signature"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+    return result
+
+
+def _timeline_identity(native: Any, project: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
+    current = native.safe_value(project, "GetCurrentTimeline", default=None)
+    return {
+        "name": native.timeline_name(current) if current is not None else "",
+        "unique_id": native.timeline_unique_id(current) if current is not None else "",
+    }
+
+
+def _insert_title(
+    native: Any,
+    animation: Any,
+    carrier: Any,
+    resolve: Any,
+    project: Any,
+    timeline: Any,
+    frame: int,
+    name: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    expected_timeline = {"name": native.timeline_name(timeline), "unique_id": native.timeline_unique_id(timeline)}
+    selected, selection_call = native.direct_call(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", timeline)
+    current_before = _timeline_identity(native, project)
+    if not selected or not all(expected_timeline.values()) or current_before != expected_timeline:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_timeline_identity:{name}:before")
+    setup = native.stabilize_native_title_context(resolve, project, timeline, frame, TARGET_TRACK)
+    current_at_insert = _timeline_identity(native, project)
+    if setup.get("ok") is not True or current_at_insert != expected_timeline:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_context:{name}")
+    before = native.video_item_snapshot(timeline)
+    if any(key.startswith("object:") for key in before):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_ownership:{name}:preexisting_uid_missing")
+    returned, provisioning = carrier.provision_textplus_media_carrier(
+        project=project,
+        timeline=timeline,
+        video_items=[item for _track, item in native.all_video_items(timeline)],
+        start_frame=frame,
+        end_frame=frame + TITLE_DURATION,
+        target_track=TARGET_TRACK,
+        generated_name=name,
+    )
+    added = native.find_new_video_items(timeline, before)
+    returned_uid = native.item_unique_id(returned) if returned is not None else ""
+    delta_uids = [native.item_unique_id(item) for item in added]
+    if (not isinstance(provisioning, dict) or provisioning.get("ok") is not True
+            or len(added) != 1 or not returned_uid or delta_uids != [returned_uid]):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_ownership:{name}:delta={len(added)}")
+    item = added[0]
+    summary = native.item_summary(timeline, item)
+    current_after = _timeline_identity(native, project)
+    if (current_after != expected_timeline or summary.get("track_index") != TARGET_TRACK
+            or summary.get("start") != frame or summary.get("duration") != TITLE_DURATION
+            or summary.get("fusion_comp_count") != 1):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_placement_or_timeline:{name}")
+    comp = native.get_comp(item)
+    tools = native.get_text_tools(comp)
+    all_tools = carrier.list_fusion_tools(comp) if comp is not None else []
+    media_outs = [tool for tool in all_tools if carrier.fusion_tool_regid(tool) == "MediaOut"]
+    if len(tools) != 1 or len(media_outs) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_identity:{name}")
+    output = animation.connected_output(animation.find_input(media_outs[0], "Input"))
+    source_tool = native.safe_value(output, "GetTool", default=None) if output is not None else None
+    if source_tool is None or carrier.fusion_tool_regid(source_tool) != "TextPlus" or carrier.fusion_tool_name(source_tool) != carrier.fusion_tool_name(tools[0]):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_output_connection:{name}")
+    text_write = native.set_static_input(tools[0], "StyledText", name)
+    text_readback = native.read_text(tools[0])
+    if text_write.get("ok") is not True or text_readback != name:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"title_text_identity:{name}")
+    return {
+        "item": item,
+        "tool": tools[0],
+        "summary": summary,
+        "provisioning": provisioning,
+        "setup": setup,
+        "selection_call": selection_call,
+        "timeline_before": current_before,
+        "timeline_at_insert": current_at_insert,
+        "timeline_after": current_after,
+        "inventory_before_count": len(before),
+        "inventory_after_count": len(before) + len(added),
+        "delta_uids": delta_uids,
+        "returned_uid": returned_uid,
+        "fusion_comp_count": summary["fusion_comp_count"],
+        "textplus_node_count": len(tools),
+        "output_connection": {
+            "connected": True,
+            "source_name": carrier.fusion_tool_name(source_tool),
+            "source_regid": carrier.fusion_tool_regid(source_tool),
+        },
+        "text_write": text_write,
+        "text_readback": text_readback,
+    }
+
+
+def execute(resolve: Any, context: Mapping[str, Any], dependencies: tuple[Any, Any, Any, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or command.get("run_id") or "")
+    root = repository_root()
+    report: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "schema_version": 1, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "mode": MODE,
+        "ok": False, "classification": "STEP4C_PROBE_BLOCKED", "ownership": None,
+        "failures": [], "mutation_counts": {"timeline_create": 0, "title_insert": 0, "animation_keyframes_first": 0,
+        "animation_keyframes_second": 0, "static_animation_mutations": 0, "project_saves": 0,
+        "imports": 0, "disposable_caption_deletes": 0, "unrelated_deletes": 0, "relinks": 0, "replaces": 0},
+    }
+    native = animation = snapshots = carrier = project = previous = disposable = None
+    previous_page = ""
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or not run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+        disposable_name = str(payload.get("disposable_timeline_name") or "")
+        if (payload.get("expected_project") != PROJECT_NAME or payload.get("protected_timelines") != [REEL1, REEL2]
+                or not disposable_name.startswith(PROBE_PREFIX) or payload.get("mutation_permitted") is not True
+                or payload.get("cleanup_permitted") is not False):
+            raise ValueError("probe_contract")
+        report["queue_preflight"] = queue_preflight(root, run_id)
+        native, animation, snapshots, carrier = dependencies or load_dependencies(root)
+        report["source_contract"] = native.verify_source_contract(root, command)
+        manager, project, media_pool, calls = native.get_project(resolve)
+        report["resolve_connection"] = calls
+        if native.safe_value(project, "GetName", default="") != PROJECT_NAME:
+            raise RuntimeError("project_identity")
+        previous = native.safe_value(project, "GetCurrentTimeline", default=None)
+        previous_page = str(native.safe_value(resolve, "GetCurrentPage", default="") or "")
+        reel1 = _find_unique(native, project, REEL1)

+            "Size": {"modifier": _modifier(animation, native, size_tool, "Size"), "readback": _temporal_readback(animation, size_tool, SIZE_PAYLOAD), "targets_ok": animation.input_targets_are_correct(size_tool, "Size", [{"local_frame": k["frame"], "expected": k["value"]} for k in SIZE_PAYLOAD["keyframes"]])},

+"""Read-only persisted style parity diagnostic for the three failed F7 objects."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_why_style_diagnostic as why_diag
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_PERSISTED_STYLE_PARITY_DIAGNOSTIC_V1"
+MODE = "inspect_persisted_style_parity"
+SOURCE_RUN_ID = "20261002T093228130622Z_8a43be1aa99a4e2fa6ec66203b559cbd"
+TARGET_TIMELINE = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION_F7_66203b559cbd"
+TARGET_IDS = (
+    "recovered_display_object_why_0001",
+    "recovered_display_object_local_we_0002",
+    "recovered_display_object_listing_0003",
+)
+SHADOW_INPUTS = (
+    "Enabled3", "Red3", "Green3", "Blue3", "Alpha3",
+    "Offset3", "SoftnessX3", "SoftnessY3",
+)
+FILL_INPUTS = ("Enabled1", "Red1", "Green1", "Blue1", "Alpha1", "Type1")
+
+
+def _safe_detail(call: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        value = call()
+        detail = {
+            "ok": True,
+            "type": f"{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+            "json_safe": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value),
+        }
+        for name, renderer in (("repr", repr), ("str", str)):
+            try:
+                detail[name] = renderer(value)
+            except BaseException as exc:
+                detail[name] = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+        return detail
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        return {"ok": False, "error": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+
+
+def _input(tool: Any, name: str) -> tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]:
+    raw = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, name, 0)
+    return raw, {"input": name, **_safe_detail(lambda: raw)}
+
+
+def _tool_name(tool: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    attrs = _safe_detail(lambda: tool.GetAttrs())
+    values = attrs.get("json_safe") if attrs.get("ok") else None
+    name = None
+    if isinstance(values, Mapping):
+        name = values.get("TOOLS_Name") or values.get("TOOLB_NameSet")
+    return {"name": name, "attrs": attrs}
+
+
+def _expected_gradient(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [
+        {
+            "position": float(stop["position"]),
+            "rgba": [*(float(value) / 255.0 for value in stop["rgb"]), float(stop.get("alpha", 1.0))],
+        }
+        for stop in row["fill"].get("stops", [])
+    ]
+
+
+def _gradient_stops(raw: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    value = f7._gradient_value(raw)
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    try:
+        entries = sorted(value.items(), key=lambda item: float(item[0]))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return []
+    for position, channels in entries:
+        if not isinstance(channels, Mapping):
+            return []
+        numeric = [channels.get(index, channels.get(str(index))) for index in range(1, 5)]
+        if any(value is None for value in numeric):
+            return []
+        rows.append({"position": float(position), "numeric_channels": [float(value) for value in numeric]})
+    return rows
+
+
+def _operational(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    runtime_row = f7._runtime_style_row(row)
+    shadow = runtime_row["advanced_effects"].get("shadow")
+    fill = row["fill"]
+    rgb = fill.get("resolve_rgb") or fill["stops"][0]["rgb"]
+    return {
+        "font_family": row["font"]["resolve_family"],
+        "font_style": row["font"]["resolve_style"],
+        "fill_rgba": [*(float(value) / 255.0 for value in rgb), float(row["opacity"]["resolve_value"])],
+        "gradient": _expected_gradient(row),
+        "shadow": {
+            "immutable_authority": row["advanced_effects"].get("shadow"),
+            "enabled": isinstance(shadow, Mapping),
+            "interpretation": "no applied shadow" if not isinstance(shadow, Mapping) else "mapping-based applied shadow",
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _base_projection(expected: Mapping[str, Any], actual: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    comparable_expected = copy.deepcopy(expected)
+    comparable_actual = copy.deepcopy(actual)
+    if comparable_expected["fill"].get("type") == "linear_gradient":
+        comparable_expected["fill"]["resolve_rgb"] = comparable_expected["fill"]["stops"][0]["rgb"]
+    comparable_actual["opacity"]["alpha1"] = 1.0
+    try:
+        result = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.parity({"objects": [comparable_expected]}, [comparable_actual])
+        checks = result["rows"][0]["checks"]
+        return {
+            "fill": {
+                "EXPECTED_RAW": comparable_expected["fill"],
+                "EXPECTED_NORMALIZED": [value / 255.0 for value in comparable_expected["fill"]["resolve_rgb"]] + [1.0],
+                "ACTUAL_RAW": actual["fill"],
+                "ACTUAL_NORMALIZED": actual["fill"],
+                "RESULT": checks["fill"],
+                "FAILURE_REASON": None if checks["fill"] else "base parity compares persisted Red1/Green1/Blue1/Alpha1 to expected RGB plus alpha 1.0",
+            },
+            "shadow": {
+                "EXPECTED_RAW": expected["advanced_effects"].get("shadow"),
+                "EXPECTED_NORMALIZED": {"enabled": expected["advanced_effects"].get("shadow") is not None},
+                "OPERATIONAL_EXPECTATION": _operational(expected)["shadow"],
+                "ACTUAL_RAW": actual["shadow"],
+                "ACTUAL_NORMALIZED": {"enabled": bool(actual["shadow"]["enabled"])},
+                "RESULT": checks["shadow"],
+                "FAILURE_REASON": None if checks["shadow"] else "base parity treats every non-null shadow authority, including a string sentinel, as enabled",
+            },
+        }
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        return {"error": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+
+
+def _gradient_projection(expected: Mapping[str, Any], raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    wanted = [row["rgba"] for row in _expected_gradient(expected)]
+    persisted = f7._gradient_rgba(raw)
+    json_safe = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(raw)
+    current = f7._gradient_colors(json_safe)
+    persisted_match = len(persisted) == len(wanted) and all(
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got, want) for got, want in zip(persisted, wanted)
+    )
+    current_match = len(current) >= len(wanted) and all(
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got, want[:3]) for got, want in zip(current[:len(wanted)], wanted)
+    )
+    return {
+        "EXPECTED_RAW": expected["fill"].get("stops", []),
+        "EXPECTED_NORMALIZED": wanted,
+        "ACTUAL_RAW": _safe_detail(lambda: raw),
+        "ACTUAL_NORMALIZED": persisted,
+        "CURRENT_COMPARATOR_INPUT": json_safe,
+        "CURRENT_COMPARATOR_NORMALIZED": current,
+        "PERSISTED_VALUE_MATCH": persisted_match,
+        "RESULT": current_match,
+        "FAILURE_REASON": None if current_match else "current explicit gradient comparator operates on JSON-safe readback rather than guaranteed raw proxy value",
+    }
+
+
+def _classify(projections: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    classes: dict[str, str] = {}
+    fill = projections["base"].get("fill", {})
+    shadow = projections["base"].get("shadow", {})
+    operational_shadow = shadow.get("OPERATIONAL_EXPECTATION", {})
+    actual_shadow = shadow.get("ACTUAL_NORMALIZED", {})
+    if fill.get("RESULT") is False:
+        expected = fill.get("EXPECTED_NORMALIZED") or []
+        actual = fill.get("ACTUAL_NORMALIZED") or []
+        same_rgb = len(expected) >= 3 and len(actual) >= 3 and f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(actual[:3], expected[:3])
+        classes["fill"] = "COMPARATOR_EXPECTATION_DEFECT" if same_rgb else "ACTUAL_STYLE_APPLICATION_DEFECT"
+    if shadow.get("RESULT") is False:
+        if operational_shadow.get("enabled") is False and actual_shadow.get("enabled") is False:
+            classes["shadow"] = "SEMANTICALLY_EQUAL_STRUCTURALLY_DIFFERENT"
+        else:
+            classes["shadow"] = "ACTUAL_STYLE_APPLICATION_DEFECT"
+    gradient = projections.get("gradient")
+    if gradient and gradient.get("RESULT") is False:
+        classes["gradient"] = "NORMALIZATION_DEFECT" if gradient.get("PERSISTED_VALUE_MATCH") else "PERSISTED_WRITE_DEFECT"
+    return classes
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or "")
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "ok": False,
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "classification": "BLOCKED",
+        "failures": [],
+        "mutation_counts": {"timeline_create": 0, "textplus_create": 0, "project_save": 0, "delete": 0},
+    }
+    report_dir = Path(str(payload.get("report_dir") or "")).resolve()
+    diagnostic_path = report_dir / "step5_f7_persisted_style_parity_diagnostic.json"
+    diagnostic: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f7_persisted_style_parity_diagnostic_v1",
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "source_failed_run_id": SOURCE_RUN_ID,
+        "target_timeline": TARGET_TIMELINE,
+        "target_identities": list(TARGET_IDS),
+        "read_only": True,
+        "evidence_persisted_before_classification": False,
+        "objects": [],
+    }
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        if payload.get("source_run_id") != SOURCE_RUN_ID or payload.get("target_timeline") != TARGET_TIMELINE:
+            raise ValueError("diagnostic_scope")
+        contract_path = Path(str(payload["contract_path"])).resolve()
+        if f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.sha(contract_path) != payload.get("contract_sha256"):
+            raise ValueError("contract_hash")
+        contract = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.read(contract_path)
+        expected_rows = [row for row in contract.get("objects", []) if row.get("source_identity") in TARGET_IDS]
+        if tuple(row["source_identity"] for row in expected_rows) != TARGET_IDS:
+            raise ValueError("target_identities")
+        expected = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in expected_rows}
+
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") != contract["project"]:
+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        protected = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, contract["protected_timeline"]["name"], contract["protected_timeline"]["unique_id"])
+        target = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, TARGET_TIMELINE)
+        if protected is None or target is None:
+            raise ValueError("timeline_identity")
+        protected_before = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected)
+
+        wanted_keys = {
+            (row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"], *row["resolve_interval"]): row["source_identity"]
+            for row in expected_rows
+        }
+        matched: dict[str, tuple[Any, int]] = {}
+        for track in sorted({key[0] for key in wanted_keys}):
+            for item in carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", track, default=[]) or []:
+                key = (track, int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart")), int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd")))
+                identity = wanted_keys.get(key)
+                if identity:
+                    if identity in matched:
+                        raise ValueError(f"ambiguous_item:{identity}")
+                    matched[identity] = (item, track)
+        if set(matched) != set(TARGET_IDS):
+            raise ValueError(f"missing_items:{sorted(set(TARGET_IDS) - set(matched))}")
+
+        live_rows = []
+        for identity in TARGET_IDS:
+            row = expected[identity]
+            item, track = matched[identity]
+            item_name = str(carrier._safe(item, "GetName", default="") or "")
+            if item_name != row["intended_resolve_name"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"item_name:{identity}")
+            comp, tool = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.textplus(item)
+            actual = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.read_object(item, row, track)
+            if actual["text"] != row["text"]["value"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"visible_text:{identity}")
+            fill_raw = {}
+            fill_evidence = {}
+            for name in FILL_INPUTS:
+                fill_raw[name], fill_evidence[name] = _input(tool, name)
+            shadow_evidence = {}
+            for name in SHADOW_INPUTS:
+                _raw, shadow_evidence[name] = _input(tool, name)
+            gradient_raw = fill_raw.get("ShadingGradient1")
+            gradient_evidence = None
+            if row["fill"].get("type") == "linear_gradient":
+                gradient_raw, gradient_input = _input(tool, "ShadingGradient1")
+                gradient_evidence = {
+                    "input": gradient_input,
+                    "proxy": why_diag._gradient_proxy_evidence(tool, gradient_raw),
+                    "extracted_stops": _gradient_stops(gradient_raw),
+                    "normalized_rgba": f7._gradient_rgba(gradient_raw),
+                    "expected_stops": _expected_gradient(row),
+                }
+            immutable = {
+                key: copy.deepcopy(row.get(key))
+                for key in ("fill", "opacity", "font", "advanced_effects", "stroke")
+            }
+            evidence = {
+                "identity": {
+                    "source_identity": identity,
+                    "intended_resolve_name": row["intended_resolve_name"],
+                    "visible_text": actual["text"],
+                    "resolve_track": track,
+                    "lane": row["z_order_track"]["lane"],
+                    "start": actual["start"],
+                    "end": actual["end"],
+                    "matched_item_unique_id": actual["item_unique_id"],
+                    "matched_item_name": actual["item_name"],
+                    "matched_textplus_tool": _tool_name(tool),
+                },
+                "immutable_expected_authority": immutable,
+                "operational_expectation": _operational(row),
+                "base_fill_persisted_readback": fill_evidence,
+                "gradient_persisted_readback": gradient_evidence,
+                "shadow_persisted_readback": shadow_evidence,
+                "production_read_object_projection": actual,
+            }
+            diagnostic["objects"].append(evidence)
+            live_rows.append((evidence, row, actual, gradient_raw))
+
+        protected_after = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected)
+        diagnostic["protected_timeline_current_state_captured"] = True
+        diagnostic["protected_timeline"] = {
+            "before": protected_before,
+            "after": protected_after,
+            "unchanged_during_diagnostic": protected_before == protected_after,
+            "previous_full_run_unchanged_claimed": False,
+        }
+        diagnostic["evidence_persisted_before_classification"] = True
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(diagnostic_path, diagnostic)
+
+        for evidence, row, actual, gradient_raw in live_rows:
+            projections: dict[str, Any] = {"base": _base_projection(row, actual)}
+            if row["fill"].get("type") == "linear_gradient":
+                projections["gradient"] = _gradient_projection(row, gradient_raw)
+            evidence["current_comparator_projections"] = projections
+            evidence["mismatch_classifications"] = _classify(projections)
+        diagnostic["classification_complete"] = True
+        diagnostic["sufficient_evidence"] = (
+            len(diagnostic["objects"]) == len(TARGET_IDS)
+            and all("error" not in evidence["current_comparator_projections"]["base"] for evidence in diagnostic["objects"])
+            and all(
+                row["ok"] is True
+                for evidence in diagnostic["objects"]
+                for row in (*evidence["base_fill_persisted_readback"].values(), *evidence["shadow_persisted_readback"].values())
+            )
+            and all(
+                evidence["gradient_persisted_readback"] is None
+                or evidence["gradient_persisted_readback"]["proxy"]["value_member"].get("ok") is True
+                for evidence in diagnostic["objects"]
+            )
+        )
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(diagnostic_path, diagnostic)
+        if not diagnostic["sufficient_evidence"] or protected_before != protected_after:
+            raise ValueError("persisted_readback_insufficient")
+        result.update({
+            "ok": True,
+            "classification": "DIAGNOSIS_COMPLETE",
+            "diagnostic_path": str(diagnostic_path),
+            "target_identity_count": len(TARGET_IDS),
+            "protected_timeline_current_state_captured": True,
+        })
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["failures"] = [f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)]
+        if diagnostic.get("evidence_persisted_before_classification") is not True:
+            try:
+                f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(diagnostic_path, diagnostic)
+            except BaseException:
+                pass
+    return result
+

+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_readonly_machine_validation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@
+"""Read-only full machine validation of the existing persisted F7 timeline."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_READONLY_MACHINE_VALIDATION_V1"
+MODE = "validate_persisted_f7_readonly"
+SOURCE_RUN_ID = "20261002T093228130622Z_8a43be1aa99a4e2fa6ec66203b559cbd"
+TARGET_TIMELINE = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION_F7_66203b559cbd"
+
+
+def _placement(contract: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    objects = list(contract.get("objects") or [])
+    mismatches = [
+        row["source_identity"] for row in objects
+        if row["z_order_track"].get("lane") is None
+        or int(row["z_order_track"]["lane"]) != int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) - 1
+    ]
+    overlaps = []
+    for track in sorted({int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) for row in objects}):
+        rows = sorted(
+            (row for row in objects if int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) == track),
+            key=lambda row: (row["resolve_interval"][0], row["resolve_interval"][1], row["source_identity"]),
+        )
+        for index, left in enumerate(rows):
+            for right in rows[index + 1:]:
+                if right["resolve_interval"][0] >= left["resolve_interval"][1]:
+                    break
+                overlaps.append({"track": track, "left": left["source_identity"], "right": right["source_identity"]})
+    return {
+        "object_count": len(objects),
+        "missing_lane_count": sum(row["z_order_track"].get("lane") is None for row in objects),
+        "lane_track_mismatch_count": len(mismatches),
+        "lane_track_mismatches": mismatches,
+        "same_track_overlap_count": len(overlaps),
+        "same_track_overlaps": overlaps,
+        "pass": len(objects) == 65 and not mismatches and not overlaps,
+    }
+
+
+def _failure_count(failures: list[str], names: set[str]) -> int:
+    return sum(value.rsplit(":", 1)[-1] in names for value in failures)
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or "")
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "ok": False,
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "classification": "BLOCKED",
+        "failures": [],
+        "mutation_counts": {"timeline_create": 0, "textplus_create": 0, "project_save": 0, "delete": 0},
+    }
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        if payload.get("source_run_id") != SOURCE_RUN_ID or payload.get("target_timeline") != TARGET_TIMELINE or payload.get("read_only") is not True:
+            raise ValueError("validation_scope")
+        contract_path = Path(str(payload["contract_path"])).resolve()
+        source_report_path = Path(str(payload["source_bridge_report_path"])).resolve()
+        report_dir = Path(str(payload["report_dir"])).resolve()
+        if f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.sha(contract_path) != payload.get("contract_sha256") or f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.sha(source_report_path) != payload.get("source_bridge_report_sha256"):
+            raise ValueError("artifact_hash")
+        contract = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.read(contract_path)
+        source_report = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.read(source_report_path)
+        persistence = {
+            "source_run_id": SOURCE_RUN_ID,
+            "source_bridge_report_path": str(source_report_path),
+            "source_bridge_report_sha256": payload["source_bridge_report_sha256"],
+            "timeline_create": source_report.get("mutation_counts", {}).get("timeline_create"),
+            "textplus_create": source_report.get("mutation_counts", {}).get("textplus_create"),
+            "project_save": source_report.get("mutation_counts", {}).get("project_save"),
+            "delete": source_report.get("mutation_counts", {}).get("delete"),
+        }
+        if (
+            source_report.get("run_id") != SOURCE_RUN_ID
+            or persistence["timeline_create"] != 1
+            or persistence["textplus_create"] != 65
+            or persistence["project_save"] != 1
+            or persistence["delete"] != 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("persistence_evidence")
+        if contract.get("object_count") != 65 or contract.get("validation_timeline") != TARGET_TIMELINE:
+            raise ValueError("compile_contract")
+        placement = _placement(contract)
+        target_6000 = next(row for row in contract["objects"] if row["source_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0089")
+        if target_6000["resolve_interval"] != [542, 596] or len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]) != 9:
+            raise ValueError("f6_6000_authority")
+
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") != contract["project"]:
+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        protected = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, contract["protected_timeline"]["name"], contract["protected_timeline"]["unique_id"])
+        target = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, TARGET_TIMELINE)
+        if protected is None or target is None:
+            raise ValueError("timeline_identity")
+        protected_before = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected)
+
+        expected = {
+            (int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]), *row["resolve_interval"]): row
+            for row in contract["objects"]
+        }
+        max_track = max(key[0] for key in expected)
+        actual_items = [
+            (track, item)
+            for track in range(2, max_track + 1)
+            for item in (carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", track, default=[]) or [])
+            if carrier._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0)
+        ]
+        seen: set[tuple[int, int, int]] = set()
+        unexpected = []
+        readback = []
+        for track, item in actual_items:
+            key = (track, int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart")), int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd")))
+            row = expected.get(key)
+            if row is None or key in seen:
+                unexpected.append({"track": track, "start": key[1], "end": key[2], "item_unique_id": carrier._unique_id(item)})
+                continue
+            seen.add(key)
+            readback.append(f7.IMPLEMENTATION._read(item, row, track))
+        missing = [row["source_identity"] for key, row in expected.items() if key not in seen]
+        parity = f7.IMPLEMENTATION._parity(contract, readback)
+        protected_after = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected)
+        protected_unchanged = protected_before == protected_after
+        failures = list(parity["failures"])
+        style_names = {"font", "font_style", "size", "position", "fill", "stroke", "opacity_visibility", "shadow", "static_rotation", "keyframes", "opacity", "italic_treatment", "gradient"}
+        validation = {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f7_readonly_machine_validation_v1",
+            "task_id": TASK_ID,
+            "run_id": run_id,
+            "source_failed_run_id": SOURCE_RUN_ID,
+            "target_timeline": {"name": TARGET_TIMELINE, "unique_id": carrier._unique_id(target), "exists": True},
+            "read_only": True,
+            "expected_renderable_objects": 65,
+            "persisted_renderable_objects": len(actual_items),
+            "missing_objects": missing,
+            "missing_object_count": len(missing),
+            "unexpected_extras": unexpected,
+            "unexpected_extra_count": len(unexpected),
+            "text_mismatches": _failure_count(failures, {"text"}),
+            "lifecycle_mismatches": _failure_count(failures, {"timing"}),
+            "style_projection_mismatches": _failure_count(failures, style_names),
+            "placement_mismatches": _failure_count(failures, {"z_order"}),
+            "parity": parity,
+            "placement": placement,
+            "f6_6000_interval": target_6000["resolve_interval"],
+            "f6_6000_scale_key_count": len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]),
+            "protected_timeline": {"before": protected_before, "after": protected_after, "unchanged": protected_unchanged},
+            "original_full_run_persistence": persistence,
+        }
+        validation["pass"] = bool(
+            len(actual_items) == 65
+            and not missing
+            and not unexpected
+            and parity["ok"] is True
+            and placement["pass"] is True
+            and protected_unchanged
+        )
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "step5_f7_readonly_readback.json", {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f7_readonly_readback_v1",
+            "object_count": len(readback),
+            "objects": sorted(readback, key=lambda row: row["source_identity"]),
+        })
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "step5_f7_validation.json", validation)
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "step5_f7_machine_pass.json", {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f7_machine_pass_v1",
+            "task_id": TASK_ID,
+            "run_id": run_id,
+            "target_timeline": TARGET_TIMELINE,
+            "classification": "F7_MACHINE_PASS" if validation["pass"] else "BLOCKED",
+            "pass": validation["pass"],
+            "validation_path": str(report_dir / "step5_f7_validation.json"),
+        })
+        if not validation["pass"]:
+            raise ValueError("f7_machine_validation")
+        result.update({
+            "ok": True,
+            "classification": "F7_MACHINE_PASS",
+            "validation_path": str(report_dir / "step5_f7_validation.json"),
+            "machine_pass_path": str(report_dir / "step5_f7_machine_pass.json"),
+            "object_count": 65,
+            "protected_timeline_mutated": False,
+        })
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["failures"] = [f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)]
+    return result
+
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..417156de8a973450278fd6451022d6115c166585
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py
@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+"""Repository-import bootstrap for the immutable F7 Resolve runtime."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+RUNTIME = ROOT / ".agent/tasks/inbox/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_20261001_V1/files/video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("video_cloner_step5_f7_immutable_runtime", RUNTIME)
+if SPEC is None or SPEC.loader is None:
+    raise ImportError(f"could not load F7 runtime: {RUNTIME}")
+IMPLEMENTATION = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(IMPLEMENTATION)
+
+_ORIGINAL_STYLE = IMPLEMENTATION._style
+
+
+def _runtime_style_row(row):
+    shadow = (row.get("advanced_effects") or {}).get("shadow")
+    if isinstance(shadow, Mapping):
+        return row
+    runtime_row = copy.deepcopy(row)
+    runtime_row.setdefault("advanced_effects", {})["shadow"] = None
+    return runtime_row
+
+
+def _style(row, tool, comp, index):
+    return _ORIGINAL_STYLE(_runtime_style_row(row), tool, comp, index)
+
+
+def _expected_gradient(fill):
+    return {
+        float(stop["position"]): {
+            1: float(stop["rgb"][0]) / 255.0,
+            2: float(stop["rgb"][1]) / 255.0,
+            3: float(stop["rgb"][2]) / 255.0,
+            4: float(stop.get("alpha", 1.0)),
+        }
+        for stop in fill["stops"]
+    }
+
+
+def _gradient_value(value):
+    if type(value) is dict:
+        return value
+    try:
+        value = value.Value
+    except BaseException:
+        return None
+    return value if type(value) is dict else None
+
+
+def _gradient_stops(value):
+    original = value
+    value = _gradient_value(value)
+    if value is None and isinstance(original, (list, tuple)):
+        value = original
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            rows = []
+            for child in value:
+                if not isinstance(child, Mapping) or "position" not in child or "rgba" not in child:
+                    return []
+                rgba = child["rgba"]
+                if not isinstance(rgba, (list, tuple)) or len(rgba) != 4:
+                    return []
+                rows.append({"position": float(child["position"]), "rgba": [float(channel) for channel in rgba]})
+            return rows
+        return []
+    if "Value" in value:
+        return _gradient_stops(value["Value"])
+    if "Colors" in value:
+        return _gradient_stops(value["Colors"])
+    if all(value.get(name) is not None for name in ("R", "G", "B")):
+        return [{"position": 0.0, "rgba": [float(value[name]) for name in ("R", "G", "B")] + [float(value.get("A", 1.0))]}]
+    rows = []
+    for position, child in value.items():
+        if str(position).startswith("__"):
+            continue
+        try:
+            position_value = float(position)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            return []
+        if not isinstance(child, Mapping):
+            return []
+        if all(child.get(name) is not None for name in ("R", "G", "B")):
+            rgba = [float(child[name]) for name in ("R", "G", "B")] + [float(child.get("A", 1.0))]
+        else:
+            numeric = [child.get(index, child.get(str(index))) for index in range(1, 5)]
+            if any(channel is None for channel in numeric):
+                return []
+            rgba = [float(channel) for channel in numeric]
+        rows.append({"position": position_value, "rgba": rgba})
+    return sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["position"])
+
+
+def _gradient_rgba(value):
+    return [row["rgba"] for row in _gradient_stops(value)]
+
+
+def _gradient_colors(value):
+    return [rgba[:3] for rgba in _gradient_rgba(value)]
+
+
+def _set_gradient(tool, fill):
+    expected = _expected_gradient(fill)
+    wanted = [[*(float(channel) / 255.0 for channel in stop["rgb"]), float(stop.get("alpha", 1.0))] for stop in fill["stops"]]
+    try:
+        returned = tool.SetInput("ShadingGradient1", expected)
+        actual = IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, "ShadingGradient1", 0)
+        colors = _gradient_rgba(actual)
+        ok = len(colors) == len(wanted) and all(IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got, want) for got, want in zip(colors, wanted))
+        return {
+            "ok": ok,
+            "returned": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(returned),
+            "actual": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(actual),
+            "actual_value": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(_gradient_value(actual)),
+            "colors": colors,
+            "wanted": wanted,
+        }
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        return {"ok": False, "error": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+
+
+def _shadow_for_parity(value):
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return value
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("STYLE_UNRESOLVED_"):
+        return None
+    raise ValueError(f"shadow_authority:{type(value).__name__}")
+
+
+def _read(item, expected, track):
+    row = IMPLEMENTATION.base.read_object(item, expected, track)
+    _comp, tool = IMPLEMENTATION.base.textplus(item)
+    gradient = IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, "ShadingGradient1", 0)
+    row["style_extensions"] = {
+        "alpha": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, "Alpha1", 0)),
+        "type1": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, "Type1", 0)),
+        "gradient": _gradient_stops(gradient),
+        "transform_shear": IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, "TransformShear", 0)),
+    }
+    return row
+
+
+def _parity(contract, rows):
+    comparable_contract = copy.deepcopy(contract)
+    comparable_rows = copy.deepcopy(rows)
+    expected_by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in comparable_contract["objects"]}
+    for expected in comparable_contract["objects"]:
+        if expected["fill"].get("type") == "linear_gradient":
+            expected["fill"]["resolve_rgb"] = expected["fill"]["stops"][0]["rgb"]
+        expected.setdefault("advanced_effects", {})["shadow"] = _shadow_for_parity((expected.get("advanced_effects") or {}).get("shadow"))
+    for got in comparable_rows:
+        got["opacity"]["alpha1"] = 1.0
+        if isinstance(got.get("fill"), list) and len(got["fill"]) == 4:
+            got["fill"][3] = 1.0
+    result = IMPLEMENTATION.base.parity(comparable_contract, comparable_rows)
+    failures = [failure for failure in result["failures"] if not failure.startswith("missing:")]
+    actual = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+    for identity, expected in expected_by_id.items():
+        got = actual.get(identity)
+        if not got:
+            failures.append(f"missing:{identity}")
+            continue
+        ext = got["style_extensions"]
+        if not IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(ext["alpha"], expected["opacity"]["resolve_value"]):
+            failures.append(f"{identity}:opacity")
+        italic = expected["font"].get("italic_treatment")
+        if italic and not IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(ext["transform_shear"], italic["value"]):
+            failures.append(f"{identity}:italic_treatment")
+        if expected["fill"].get("type") == "linear_gradient":
+            wanted = [
+                {"position": float(stop["position"]), "rgba": [*(float(channel) / 255.0 for channel in stop["rgb"]), float(stop.get("alpha", 1.0))]}
+                for stop in expected["fill"]["stops"]
+            ]
+            observed = _gradient_stops(ext["gradient"])
+            if (
+                not IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(ext["type1"], 2.0)
+                or len(observed) != len(wanted)
+                or any(
+                    not IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got_stop["position"], want_stop["position"])
+                    or not IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got_stop["rgba"], want_stop["rgba"])
+                    for got_stop, want_stop in zip(observed, wanted)
+                )
+            ):
+                failures.append(f"{identity}:gradient")
+    extras = sorted(set(actual) - set(expected_by_id))
+    failures.extend(f"unexpected:{identity}" for identity in extras)
+    result.update({"ok": not failures and len(rows) == len(contract["objects"]), "object_count": len(rows), "failures": failures})
+    return result
+
+
+IMPLEMENTATION._style = _style
+IMPLEMENTATION._expected_gradient = _expected_gradient
+IMPLEMENTATION._gradient_colors = _gradient_colors
+IMPLEMENTATION._set_gradient = _set_gradient
+IMPLEMENTATION._read = _read
+IMPLEMENTATION._parity = _parity
+
+TASK_ID = IMPLEMENTATION.TASK_ID
+MODE = IMPLEMENTATION.MODE
+run = IMPLEMENTATION.run

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..52c813d9cf8434ccc104a6a849ba26eab2cbb747
