+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_why_style_diagnostic.py
@@ -0,0 +1,419 @@
+"""Live, disposable diagnostic for the F7 ``why?`` Text+ style application."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_WHY_STYLE_LIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_V1"
+MODE = "diagnose_why_style"
+WHY_ID = "recovered_display_object_why_0001"
+
+
+class _RecordingTool:
+    def __init__(self, tool: Any) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_tool", tool)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "writes", [])
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
+        return getattr(self._tool, name)
+
+    def __setattr__(self, name: str, value: Any) -> None:
+        setattr(self._tool, name, value)
+
+    def SetInput(self, name: str, value: Any, *args: Any) -> Any:  # Resolve API name
+        try:
+            returned = self._tool.SetInput(name, value, *args)
+            self.writes.append({
+                "input": name,
+                "value": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value),
+                "value_json": json.dumps(f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value), sort_keys=True),
+                "args": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(args),
+                "returned": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(returned),
+            })
+            return returned
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            self.writes.append({
+                "input": name,
+                "value": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value),
+                "value_json": json.dumps(f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value), sort_keys=True),
+                "args": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(args),
+                "exception": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc),
+            })
+            raise
+
+
+def _write_for(style: Mapping[str, Any], name: str, expected: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = dict((style.get("writes") or {}).get(name) or {})
+    attempt = ((result.get("attempts") or [{}])[0]) if name != "gradient" else {}
+    return {
+        "input": "ShadingGradient1" if name == "gradient" else ("Type1" if name == "gradient_type" else "Alpha1"),
+        "expected": expected,
+        "set_input_result": attempt.get("returned", result.get("returned")),
+        "actual_readback": attempt.get("actual", result.get("actual")),
+        "matched": attempt.get("matched", result.get("ok")),
+        "ok": result.get("ok") is True,
+        "raw_result": result,
+    }
+
+
+def _failure_reason(style: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    primary = style.get("primary") or {}
+    writes = style.get("writes") or {}
+    failed_inputs = [name for name, row in (primary.get("inputs") or {}).items() if row.get("verified") is not True]
+    failed_writes = [name for name, row in writes.items() if row.get("ok") is not True]
+    return {
+        "style_ok": style.get("ok") is True,
+        "primary_applied": primary.get("applied") is True,
+        "failed_primary_inputs": failed_inputs,
+        "failed_writes": failed_writes,
+        "expression": "primary.applied and all(write.ok for write in writes)",
+    }
+
+
+def _capture(call: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        value = call()
+        return {
+            "ok": True,
+            "type": f"{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+            "repr": repr(value),
+            "str": str(value),
+            "value": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value),
+            "colors": f7.IMPLEMENTATION._gradient_colors(value),
+        }
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        return {"ok": False, "error": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+
+
+def _relevant_attrs(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    attrs = value.GetAttrs()
+    return {
+        str(key): f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(item)
+        for key, item in attrs.items()
+        if any(token in str(key).lower() for token in ("name", "id", "type", "datatype"))
+    } if isinstance(attrs, Mapping) else {"raw": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(attrs)}
+
+
+def _settings_gradient(value: Any, path: str = "") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    found: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        for key, child in value.items():
+            child_path = f"{path}.{key}" if path else str(key)
+            if "shadinggradient1" in str(key).lower():
+                found.append({"path": child_path, "value": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(child), "colors": f7.IMPLEMENTATION._gradient_colors(child)})
+            found.extend(_settings_gradient(child, child_path))
+    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        for index, child in enumerate(value):
+            found.extend(_settings_gradient(child, f"{path}[{index}]"))
+    return found
+
+
+def _gradient_proxy_evidence(tool: Any, raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    evidence = {
+        "readback": _capture(lambda: raw),
+        "dir": _capture(lambda: sorted(dir(raw))),
+        "value_member": _capture(lambda: raw.Value),
+        "get_attrs": _capture(lambda: raw.GetAttrs()),
+    }
+    try:
+        handles = tool.GetInputList("Gradient")
+        rows = []
+        for key, handle in handles.items() if isinstance(handles, Mapping) else []:
+            attrs = _capture(lambda handle=handle: _relevant_attrs(handle))
+            rows.append({
+                "key": str(key),
+                "type": f"{type(handle).__module__}.{type(handle).__qualname__}",
+                "repr": repr(handle),
+                "attrs": attrs,
+                "value_member": _capture(lambda handle=handle: handle.Value),
+            })
+        evidence["gradient_input_list"] = {
+            "ok": True,
+            "type": f"{type(handles).__module__}.{type(handles).__qualname__}",
+            "count": len(handles) if isinstance(handles, Mapping) else None,
+            "rows": rows,
+        }
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        evidence["gradient_input_list"] = {"ok": False, "error": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+    try:
+        settings = tool.SaveSettings()
+        evidence["save_settings"] = {
+            "ok": True,
+            "type": f"{type(settings).__module__}.{type(settings).__qualname__}",
+            "gradient_matches": _settings_gradient(settings),
+        }
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        evidence["save_settings"] = {"ok": False, "error": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+    return evidence
+
+
+def _numeric_gradient_colors(value: Any) -> list[list[float]]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return []
+    colors = []
+    try:
+        stops = sorted(value.items(), key=lambda item: float(item[0]))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return []
+    for _position, stop in stops:
+        if not isinstance(stop, Mapping):
+            return []
+        channels = [stop.get(index, stop.get(str(index))) for index in range(1, 5)]
+        if any(channel is None for channel in channels):
+            return []
+        colors.append([float(channel) for channel in channels])
+    return colors
+
+
+def _channel_mapping(value: Any, expected: list[list[float]]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or not expected:
+        return {}
+    try:
+        stops = [stop for _position, stop in sorted(value.items(), key=lambda item: float(item[0]))]
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return {}
+    if not stops or any(not isinstance(stop, Mapping) for stop in stops):
+        return {}
+    expected_by_name = {name: [row[index] for row in expected] for index, name in enumerate(("R", "G", "B", "A"))}
+    mapping = {}
+    for slot in range(1, 5):
+        observed = [stop.get(slot, stop.get(str(slot))) for stop in stops]
+        for name, wanted in expected_by_name.items():
+            if len(observed) == len(wanted) and all(f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got, want) for got, want in zip(observed, wanted)):
+                mapping[str(slot)] = name
+                break
+    return mapping
+
+
+def _gradient_candidates(expected: list[list[float]]) -> list[tuple[str, Any]]:
+    numeric = {
+        0.0: {index + 1: value for index, value in enumerate(expected[0])},
+        1.0: {index + 1: value for index, value in enumerate(expected[1])},
+    }
+    return [
+        ("numeric_channel_table", numeric),
+        ("numeric_channel_table_with_flags", {position: {**stop, "__flags": 256} for position, stop in numeric.items()}),
+        ("serialized_gradient_value", {"__ctor": "Gradient", "Colors": {position: {**stop, "__flags": 256} for position, stop in numeric.items()}}),
+    ]
+
+
+def _test_gradient_candidates(tool: Any, expected: list[list[float]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    results = []
+    for name, candidate in _gradient_candidates(expected):
+        row: dict[str, Any] = {"name": name, "representation_repr": repr(candidate), "representation": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(candidate)}
+        try:
+            returned = tool.SetInput("ShadingGradient1", candidate)
+            proxy = tool.GetInput("ShadingGradient1")
+            value = proxy.Value
+            colors = _numeric_gradient_colors(value)
+            matched = len(colors) == len(expected) and all(f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got, want) for got, want in zip(colors, expected))
+            row.update({
+                "set_input_result": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(returned),
+                "proxy_type": f"{type(proxy).__module__}.{type(proxy).__qualname__}",
+                "value_readback": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(value),
+                "normalized_colors": colors,
+                "channel_mapping": _channel_mapping(value, expected),
+                "matched": matched,
+            })
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            row.update({"matched": False, "error": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)})
+        results.append(row)
+        if row["matched"] is True:
+            break
+    winner = next((row["name"] for row in results if row["matched"] is True), None)
+    return {"expected_colors": expected, "attempts": results, "working_candidate": winner, "pass": winner is not None}
+
+
+def _diagnosis_complete(evidence_persisted: Any, cleanup: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    cleanup_ok = (
+        cleanup.get("probe_timeline_deleted") is True
+        and cleanup.get("previous_timeline_restored") is True
+        and cleanup.get("project_saved") is False
+        and cleanup.get("timeline_inventory_unchanged") is True
+        and cleanup.get("protected_timeline_unchanged") is True
+        and cleanup.get("target_absent") is True
+    )
+    return evidence_persisted is True and cleanup_ok
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or "")
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "ok": False,
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "classification": "BLOCKED",
+        "failures": [],
+        "mutation_counts": {"timeline_create": 0, "textplus_create": 0, "project_save": 0, "delete": 0},
+    }
+    project = target = previous = protected = None
+    report_dir = Path(str(payload.get("report_dir") or "")).resolve()
+    diagnostic_path = report_dir / "why_style_diagnostic.json"
+    diagnostic: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_f7_why_style_live_diagnostic_v1",
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "source_identity": WHY_ID,
+        "evidence_persisted_before_cleanup": False,
+    }
+    timeline_ids_before: set[str] = set()
+    protected_before = None
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        contract_path = Path(str(payload["contract_path"])).resolve()
+        baseline = Path(str(payload["baseline_fcpxml"])).resolve()
+        if f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.sha(contract_path) != payload.get("contract_sha256") or f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.sha(baseline) != payload.get("baseline_fcpxml_sha256"):
+            raise ValueError("artifact_hash")
+        contract = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.read(contract_path)
+        matches = [row for row in contract.get("objects", []) if row.get("source_identity") == WHY_ID]
+        if len(matches) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("why_identity")
+        row = matches[0]
+        if row["text"]["value"] != "why?" or row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"] != "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_F5":
+            raise ValueError("why_authority")
+
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") != contract["project"]:
+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        protected = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, contract["protected_timeline"]["name"], contract["protected_timeline"]["unique_id"])
+        if protected is None:
+            raise ValueError("protected_timeline_identity")
+        protected_before = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected)
+        previous = carrier._safe(project, "GetCurrentTimeline")
+        timeline_ids_before = {carrier._unique_id(item) for item in carrier._timelines(project)}
+        if f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, payload["target_timeline"]) is not None:
+            raise ValueError("fresh_probe_already_exists")
+
+        pool = carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool")
+        returned = carrier._safe(pool, "ImportTimelineFromFile", str(baseline), {"timelineName": payload["target_timeline"]})
+        delta = [item for item in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._unique_id(item) not in timeline_ids_before]
+        target = returned if returned not in (None, False, True) else delta[0] if len(delta) == 1 else None
+        if target is None or len(delta) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("probe_ownership")
+        result["mutation_counts"]["timeline_create"] = 1
+        carrier._safe(target, "SetName", payload["target_timeline"])
+        if carrier._safe(target, "GetName", default="") != payload["target_timeline"]:
+            raise ValueError("probe_name")
+        while int(carrier._safe(target, "GetTrackCount", "video", default=0) or 0) < 2:
+            if not carrier._safe(target, "AddTrack", "video", default=False):
+                raise ValueError("probe_track_creation")
+        if not carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", target, default=False):
+            raise ValueError("probe_activation")
+        v1 = list(carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", 1, default=[]) or [])
+        source = carrier._safe(v1[0], "GetMediaPoolItem") if v1 else None
+        title = {"caption_id": WHY_ID, "text": "why?", "timeline_start": row["resolve_interval"][0], "duration": row["resolve_interval"][1] - row["resolve_interval"][0], "lane": 1}
+        provision = carrier.apply_carrier_textplus_v2(project, target, [title], source, {"ownership": carrier.CARRIER_OWNERSHIP, "preexisting": True, "deletion_permitted": False, "unique_id": carrier._unique_id(source), "source_start": 0})
+        if provision.get("ok") is not True or provision.get("created_count") != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"probe_textplus:{provision.get('failures')}")
+        result["mutation_counts"]["textplus_create"] = 1
+        link = provision["rows"][0]
+        items = {carrier._unique_id(item): item for item in carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", 2, default=[]) or []}
+        item = items.get(link["item_unique_id"])
+        if item is None:
+            raise ValueError("probe_item_reacquire")
+        carrier._safe(item, "SetName", row["intended_resolve_name"])
+        comp, tool = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.textplus(item)
+        recording_tool = _RecordingTool(tool)
+        try:
+            style = f7.IMPLEMENTATION._style(row, recording_tool, comp, 1)
+            style_exception = None
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            style = {"primary": None, "writes": {}, "ok": False}
+            style_exception = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+
+        fill = row["fill"]
+        expected_gradient = f7.IMPLEMENTATION._expected_gradient(fill)
+        gradient_raw = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.read_input(tool, "ShadingGradient1", 0)
+        expected_colors = [[channel / 255.0 for channel in stop["rgb"]] + [1.0] for stop in fill["stops"]]
+        actual_colors = f7._gradient_rgba(gradient_raw)
+        gradient_write = _write_for(style, "gradient", f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(expected_gradient))
+        sent = next((write for write in reversed(recording_tool.writes) if write["input"] == "ShadingGradient1"), None)
+        gradient_write.update({
+            "serialized_value_sent": (sent or {}).get("value_json"),
+            "value_sent": (sent or {}).get("value"),
+            "set_input_result": (sent or {}).get("returned"),
+            "exception": (sent or {}).get("exception") or (style.get("writes") or {}).get("gradient", {}).get("error"),
+            "raw_readback": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(gradient_raw),
+            "normalized_extracted_colors": actual_colors,
+            "expected_colors": expected_colors,
+            "matched": len(actual_colors) >= len(expected_colors) and all(f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.close(got, want) for got, want in zip(actual_colors[:len(expected_colors)], expected_colors)),
+        })
+        gradient_write["ok"] = gradient_write["matched"] is True
+        diagnostic.update({
+            "authority": {
+                "font": [row["font"]["resolve_family"], row["font"]["resolve_style"]],
+                "size": row["size"]["resolve_value"],
+                "center": row["position"]["resolve_center"],
+                "opacity": row["opacity"]["resolve_value"],
+                "gradient_stops": fill["stops"],
+                "shadow": row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"],
+            },
+            "primary": style.get("primary"),
+            "opacity_write": _write_for(style, "opacity", 0.75),
+            "gradient_mode_write": _write_for(style, "gradient_type", 2.0),
+            "gradient_write": gradient_write,
+            "gradient_proxy_evidence": _gradient_proxy_evidence(tool, gradient_raw),
+            "all_set_input_calls": recording_tool.writes,
+            "style_exception": style_exception,
+            "final_false_reason": _failure_reason(style),
+            "production_style_result": style,
+            "evidence_persisted_before_cleanup": True,
+            "cleanup": {"pending": True},
+        })
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(diagnostic_path, diagnostic)
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["failures"] = [f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"]
+        diagnostic["probe_exception"] = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+    finally:
+        restored = False
+        deleted = False
+        if project is not None and previous is not None:
+            restored = bool(carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", previous, default=False)) and carrier._same_timeline(carrier._safe(project, "GetCurrentTimeline"), previous)
+        if project is not None and target is not None:
+            deleted = bool(carrier._safe(carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool"), "DeleteTimelines", [target], default=False))
+            result["mutation_counts"]["delete"] = int(deleted)
+        timeline_ids_after = {carrier._unique_id(item) for item in carrier._timelines(project)} if project is not None else set()
+        target_absent = target is None or carrier._unique_id(target) not in timeline_ids_after
+        protected_after = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected) if protected is not None else None
+        cleanup = {
+            "probe_timeline_deleted": deleted and target_absent,
+            "previous_timeline_restored": restored,
+            "project_saved": False,
+            "timeline_inventory_unchanged": bool(timeline_ids_before) and timeline_ids_before == timeline_ids_after,
+            "protected_timeline_unchanged": protected_before is not None and protected_before == protected_after,
+            "target_absent": target_absent,
+        }
+        diagnostic["cleanup"] = cleanup
+        diagnostic["diagnosis_complete"] = _diagnosis_complete(
+            diagnostic.get("evidence_persisted_before_cleanup"), cleanup
+        )
+        try:
+            f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(diagnostic_path, diagnostic)
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            result["failures"].append(f"diagnostic_write:{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+        result.update({
+            "ok": diagnostic.get("diagnosis_complete") is True and not result["failures"],
+            "classification": "DIAGNOSIS_COMPLETE" if diagnostic.get("diagnosis_complete") is True and not result["failures"] else "BLOCKED",
+            "diagnostic_report_path": str(diagnostic_path),
+            "why_style_results": {
+                "primary_applied": bool((diagnostic.get("primary") or {}).get("applied")),
+                "opacity_ok": bool((diagnostic.get("opacity_write") or {}).get("ok")),
+                "gradient_type_ok": bool((diagnostic.get("gradient_mode_write") or {}).get("ok")),
+                "gradient_write_readback_ok": bool((diagnostic.get("gradient_write") or {}).get("ok")),
+            },
+            "final_state": cleanup,
+        })
+    return result
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review.py

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..dd50a9ad32659fbd36c1b4f1c5c7cb07fb3c9c70
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review.py
@@ -0,0 +1,156 @@
+"""Create one persistent generated-only F8 review timeline from accepted F7."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F8_GENERATED_ONLY_REVIEW_V1"
+MODE = "create_f8_generated_only_review"
+
+
+def _all_items(timeline: Any, track_type: str) -> list[tuple[int, Any]]:
+    return [
+        (track, item)
+        for track in range(1, int(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetTrackCount", track_type, default=0) or 0) + 1)
+        for item in list(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetItemListInTrack", track_type, track, default=[]) or [])
+    ]
+
+
+def _delete_underlay(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    video = [item for _track, item in _all_items(timeline, "video") if int(carrier._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0) == 0]
+    audio = [item for _track, item in _all_items(timeline, "audio")]
+    subtitle = [item for _track, item in _all_items(timeline, "subtitle")]
+    items = [*video, *audio, *subtitle]
+    deleted = bool(carrier._safe(timeline, "DeleteClips", items, False, default=False)) if items else True
+    return {"ok": deleted, "video_items": len(video), "audio_items": len(audio), "subtitle_items": len(subtitle), "total": len(items)}
+
+
+def _readback(timeline: Any, contract: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    expected = {(int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]), *row["resolve_interval"]): row for row in contract["objects"]}
+    generated, source_items, extras = [], [], []
+    for track, item in _all_items(timeline, "video"):
+        fusion_count = int(carrier._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0)
+        key = (track, int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart", default=-1)), int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd", default=-1)))
+        if fusion_count == 0:
+            source_items.append({"track": track, "start": key[1], "end": key[2], "name": str(carrier._safe(item, "GetName", default="") or "")})
+        elif key in expected:
+            generated.append(f7.IMPLEMENTATION._read(item, expected[key], track))
+        else:
+            extras.append({"track": track, "start": key[1], "end": key[2], "name": str(carrier._safe(item, "GetName", default="") or "")})
+    subtitle_count = len(_all_items(timeline, "subtitle"))
+    audio_count = len(_all_items(timeline, "audio"))
+    parity = f7.IMPLEMENTATION._parity(contract, generated)
+    expected_ids = {row["source_identity"] for row in contract["objects"]}
+    actual_ids = {row["source_identity"] for row in generated}
+    target_6000 = next(row for row in contract["objects"] if row["source_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0089")
+    width = str(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetSetting", "timelineResolutionWidth", default="") or "")
+    height = str(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetSetting", "timelineResolutionHeight", default="") or "")
+    return {
+        "generated_object_count": len(generated),
+        "source_or_proxy_video_item_count": len(source_items),
+        "subtitle_item_count": subtitle_count,
+        "audio_item_count": audio_count,
+        "other_text_or_generated_extra_count": len(extras),
+        "expected_identity_count": len(expected_ids),
+        "missing_identity_count": len(expected_ids - actual_ids),
+        "unexpected_generated_identity_count": len(actual_ids - expected_ids),
+        "text_mismatch_count": 0 if parity["ok"] else None,
+        "lifecycle_mismatch_count": 0 if parity["ok"] else None,
+        "style_mismatch_count": 0 if parity["ok"] else None,
+        "position_mismatch_count": 0 if parity["ok"] else None,
+        "scale_mismatch_count": 0 if parity["ok"] else None,
+        "f6_6000_interval": target_6000["resolve_interval"],
+        "f3_6000_scale_key_count": len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]),
+        "source_items": source_items,

+        "neutral_background_strategy": "NO_MEDIA_UNDERLAY; RESOLVE_TRANSPARENT_VIEWER_PRESENTS_NEUTRAL_BLACK",
+        "parity": parity,

+        "ok": len(generated) == len(expected_ids) and not source_items and not subtitle_count and not audio_count and not extras and parity["ok"] and [width, height] == ["1080", "1920"] and target_6000["resolve_interval"] == [542, 596] and len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]) == 9,
+    }

+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

+            raise ValueError("contract_scope")

+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        protected = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, contract["protected_timeline"]["name"], contract["protected_timeline"]["unique_id"])

+            raise ValueError("fresh_target_already_exists")
+        previous = carrier._safe(project, "GetCurrentTimeline", default=None)
+        protected_before = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.protected_snapshot(protected)

+        before_ids = {carrier._unique_id(row) for row in carrier._timelines(project)}
+        returned = carrier._safe(source, "DuplicateTimeline", payload["review_timeline"], default=None)
+        delta = [row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._unique_id(row) not in before_ids]
+        target = returned if returned not in (None, False, True) else delta[0] if len(delta) == 1 else None

+        f7_after = carrier.timeline_snapshot(f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.find_timeline(project, payload["f7_timeline"], payload["f7_timeline_uid"]))

+        check["ok"] = check["ok"] and check["protected_timeline_unchanged"] and check["f7_timeline_unchanged"]
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "f8_generated_only_machine_check.json", check)
+        if not check["ok"]:

+    except BaseException as exc:

+            result["mutation_counts"]["rollback_delete"] = int(deleted)
+            result["rollback"] = {"owned_timeline_deleted": deleted, "project_resaved": bool(carrier._safe(manager, "SaveProject", default=False)) if deleted and saved else not saved}
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "f8_generated_only_review.json", result)
+    return result

+def _timecode(start: str, offset: int, fps: int = 24) -> str:
+    delimiter = ";" if ";" in start else ":"
+    parts = start.replace(";", ":").split(":")
+    if len(parts) != 4 or offset < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"timecode:{start}:{offset}")
+    hours, minutes, seconds, frame = (int(value) for value in parts)
+    total = (((hours * 60 + minutes) * 60 + seconds) * fps + frame + offset)
+    frame = total % fps
+    total //= fps
+    seconds = total % 60
+    total //= 60
+    minutes = total % 60
+    hours = total // 60
+    return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}{delimiter}{frame:02d}"
+
+
+def _rect(value: Any) -> list[int] | None:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        candidates = (
+            tuple(value.get(key, value.get(str(key))) for key in range(1, 5)),
+            tuple(value.get(key) for key in ("Left", "Bottom", "Right", "Top")),
+            tuple(value.get(key) for key in ("left", "bottom", "right", "top")),
+        )
+        value = next((row for row in candidates if all(part is not None for part in row)), None)
+    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or len(value) != 4:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return [int(round(float(part))) for part in value]
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _output_extent(tool: Any, local_frame: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    output = carrier._safe(tool, "FindMainOutput", 1, default=None)
+    if output is None:
+        outputs = carrier._safe(tool, "GetOutputList", default={}) or {}
+        values = list(outputs.values()) if isinstance(outputs, Mapping) else list(outputs or [])
+        output = values[0] if values else None
+    if output is None:
+        return {"ok": False, "reason": "main_output_missing"}
+    raw = carrier._safe(output, "GetDoD", local_frame, default=None)
+    rect = _rect(raw)
+    image_metadata: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if rect is None:
+        image = carrier._safe(output, "GetValue", local_frame, default=None)
+        if image is not None:
+            rect = _rect(getattr(image, "DataWindow", None))
+            image_metadata = {
+                "width": getattr(image, "Width", None),
+                "height": getattr(image, "Height", None),
+                "original_width": getattr(image, "OriginalWidth", None),
+                "original_height": getattr(image, "OriginalHeight", None),
+            }
+    return {
+        "ok": rect is not None,
+        "local_frame": local_frame,
+        "raw_dod": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(raw),
+        "bbox": rect,
+        "width_px": None if rect is None else rect[2] - rect[0],
+        "height_px": None if rect is None else rect[3] - rect[1],
+        "image": image_metadata,
+    }
+
+
+def _media(item: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    media = carrier._safe(item, "GetMediaPoolItem", default=None)
+    props = carrier._safe(media, "GetClipProperty", default={}) if media is not None else {}
+    return f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.json_safe(props if isinstance(props, Mapping) else {})

+def _source_provenance(source_path: Path, v1_paths: set[str], root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source = source_path.resolve()
+    input_spec = InputSpec.from_local(source)
+    canonical_proxy = build_run_context(input_spec, RuntimeConfig.load(root, environ={})).proxy_path
+    actual_paths = sorted({Path(value).expanduser().resolve() for value in v1_paths})
+    actual = actual_paths[0] if len(actual_paths) == 1 else None
+    actual_identity = None
+    if actual is not None:
+        actual_identity = actual.stem[:-6] if actual.stem.endswith("_proxy") else actual.stem
+    relation = "AMBIGUOUS_V1_CARRIERS" if len(actual_paths) > 1 else "MISSING_V1_CARRIER"
+    if actual is not None and not actual.is_file():
+        relation = "OFFLINE_V1_CARRIER"
+    elif actual == source:
+        relation = "ORIGINAL_SOURCE"
+    elif actual == canonical_proxy:
+        relation = "CANONICAL_MEDIA_PREP_PROXY"
+    identity_match = actual_identity == input_spec.video_id
+    carrier_match = actual is not None and actual.is_file() and actual in {source, canonical_proxy}
+    return {
+        "original_source_path": str(source),
+        "original_source_identity": input_spec.video_id,
+        "canonical_proxy_path": str(canonical_proxy),
+        "actual_v1_media_path": None if actual is None else str(actual),
+        "actual_v1_media_name": None if actual is None else actual.name,
+        "provenance_relation": relation,
+        "identity_match": identity_match,
+        "carrier_match": carrier_match,
+    }

+def _audit(timeline: Any, expected: Mapping[tuple[int, int, int], Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    tracks = []
+    all_items = []
+    for track_type in ("video", "subtitle", "audio"):
+        count = int(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetTrackCount", track_type, default=0) or 0)
+        for index in range(1, count + 1):
+            track = {
+                "track_type": track_type,
+                "track_index": index,
+                "name": str(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetTrackName", track_type, index, default="") or ""),
+                "enabled": bool(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetIsTrackEnabled", track_type, index, default=True)),
+                "items": [],
+            }
+            for item in list(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetItemListInTrack", track_type, index, default=[]) or []):
+                start = int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart", default=-1))
+                end = int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd", default=-1))
+                fusion_count = int(carrier._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0)
+                key = (index, start, end)
+                contract_row = expected.get(key) if track_type == "video" else None
+                if track_type == "video" and index == 1:
+                    classification = "SOURCE_BAKED_TEXT"
+                elif contract_row is not None and fusion_count > 0:
+                    classification = "TRACKED_F7_TEXTPLUS"
+                elif track_type == "subtitle" or carrier._title_text(item) is not None or fusion_count > 0:
+                    classification = "OTHER_RESOLVE_TEXT_LAYER"
+                else:
+                    classification = "NON_TEXT_LAYER"
+                row = {
+                    "track_type": track_type,
+                    "track_index": index,
+                    "track_enabled": track["enabled"],
+                    "item_name": str(carrier._safe(item, "GetName", default="") or ""),
+                    "item_unique_id": carrier._unique_id(item),
+                    "start": start,
+                    "end": end,
+                    "fusion_comp_count": fusion_count,
+                    "styled_text": carrier._title_text(item),
+                    "media_properties": _media(item),
+                    "classification": classification,
+                    "source_identity": None if contract_row is None else contract_row["source_identity"],
+                }
+                track["items"].append(row)
+                all_items.append(row)
+            tracks.append(track)
+    cases = []
+    for name, frame, source_frame, identities in CASES:
+        active = [row for row in all_items if row["track_enabled"] and row["start"] <= frame < row["end"]]
+        text_layers = [row for row in active if row["classification"] != "NON_TEXT_LAYER"]
+        cases.append({
+            "case": name,
+            "timeline_frame": frame,
+            "source_frame": source_frame,
+            "expected_identities": list(identities),
+            "active_text_layers": text_layers,
+            "unknown": any(row["classification"] == "OTHER_RESOLVE_TEXT_LAYER" for row in text_layers),
+        })
+    return {"tracks": tracks, "cases": cases, "unknown_case_count": sum(row["unknown"] for row in cases)}
+

+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

+            raise ValueError("command_identity")

+            raise ValueError("target_authority")
+        contract_path = Path(str(payload["contract_path"])).resolve()

+            raise ValueError("contract_hash")
+        source_path = Path(str(payload["source_path"])).resolve()

+        audit = _audit(target, expected)
+        v1_paths = {
+            str((row.get("media_properties") or {}).get(key) or "")
+            for track in audit["tracks"] if track["track_type"] == "video" and track["track_index"] == 1
+            for row in track["items"] for key in ("File Path", "FilePath", "Path")
+            if (row.get("media_properties") or {}).get(key)
+        }
+        audit["v1_source_paths"] = sorted(v1_paths)
+        audit.update(_source_provenance(source_path, v1_paths))
+        audit["v1_source_match"] = audit["identity_match"] and audit["carrier_match"]
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "resolve_layer_audit.json", audit)
+        if not audit["v1_source_match"]:
+            raise ValueError("v1_source_identity")
+        if audit["unknown_case_count"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown_text_layers:{audit['unknown_case_count']}")
+
+        measurements = []
+        for case_name, frame, source_frame, identities in CASES:
+            objects = []
+            for identity in identities:
+                row = by_id[identity]
+                track = int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"])
+                start, end = row["resolve_interval"]
+                items = [
+                    item for item in carrier._safe(target, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", track, default=[]) or []
+                    if int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart", default=-1)) == start and int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd", default=-1)) == end
+                ]
+                if len(items) != 1:
+                    raise ValueError(f"item_identity:{identity}:{len(items)}")
+                _comp, tool = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.textplus(items[0])
+                extent = _output_extent(tool, frame - start)
+                source_bbox = SOURCE_BBOXES[(case_name, identity)]
+                source_height = float(source_bbox[3] - source_bbox[1])
+                generated_height = extent.get("height_px")
+                objects.append({
+                    "source_identity": identity,
+                    "text": row["text"]["value"],
+                    "interval": [start, end],
+                    "track": track,
+                    "size": row["size"]["resolve_value"],
+                    "source_bbox": source_bbox,
+                    "source_height_px": source_height,
+                    "contract_source_height_px": row["size"]["source_height_px"],
+                    "font": row["font"],
+                    "extent": extent,
+                    "generated_to_source_height_ratio": None if generated_height is None else generated_height / source_height,
+                })
+            measurements.append({"case": case_name, "timeline_frame": frame, "source_frame": source_frame, "objects": objects})
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "generated_extent_measurements.json", {"cases": measurements})
+        if any(not obj["extent"]["ok"] for case in measurements for obj in case["objects"]):
+            raise ValueError("generated_extent_missing")
+
+        probe_name = PROBE_PREFIX + run_id[-12:]
+        if any(row["name"] == probe_name for row in inventory_before):
+            raise ValueError("probe_preexists")
+        probe = carrier._safe(target, "DuplicateTimeline", probe_name, default=None)
+        if probe is None or not carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", probe, default=False):
+            raise ValueError("probe_create")
+        if not carrier._safe(probe, "SetTrackEnable", "video", 1, False, default=False):
+            raise ValueError("disable_probe_v1")
+        start_frame = int(carrier._safe(probe, "GetStartFrame", default=0) or 0)
+        start_tc = str(carrier._safe(probe, "GetStartTimecode", default="") or "")
+        stills = []
+        still_dir = report_dir / "generated_layer_only"
+        still_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for case_name, frame, source_frame, _identities in CASES:
+            requested = _timecode(start_tc, frame - start_frame)
+            if not carrier._safe(probe, "SetCurrentTimecode", requested, default=False):
+                raise ValueError(f"set_timecode:{case_name}")
+            path = still_dir / f"{case_name}_timeline_{frame:04d}_source_{source_frame:04d}.png"
+            exported = bool(carrier._safe(project, "ExportCurrentFrameAsStill", str(path), default=False))
+            stills.append({"case": case_name, "timeline_frame": frame, "timecode": requested, "path": str(path), "exported": exported})
+            if not exported or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"export_still:{case_name}")
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "isolated_generated_stills.json", {"stills": stills})
+        result.update({"ok": True, "classification": "F8A_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURED", "layer_audit": str(report_dir / "resolve_layer_audit.json"), "measurements": str(report_dir / "generated_extent_measurements.json"), "stills": str(still_dir)})
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["error"] = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+    finally:
+        try:
+            if project is not None and original is not None:
+                cleanup["previous_timeline_restored"] = bool(carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", original, default=False))
+            if project is not None and probe is not None:
+                pool = carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool")
+                cleanup["probe_timeline_deleted"] = bool(carrier._safe(pool, "DeleteTimelines", [probe], default=False))
+            elif project is not None:
+                cleanup["probe_timeline_deleted"] = not any(str(carrier._safe(row, "GetName", default="") or "").startswith(PROBE_PREFIX) for row in carrier._timelines(project))
+            if project is not None:
+                cleanup["inventory_unchanged"] = _inventory(project) == inventory_before
+                target = next((row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._unique_id(row) == TARGET_UID), None)
+                cleanup["target_unchanged"] = target is not None and carrier.timeline_snapshot(target) == target_before
+                cleanup["probe_absent"] = not any(str(carrier._safe(row, "GetName", default="") or "").startswith(PROBE_PREFIX) for row in carrier._timelines(project))
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            cleanup["error"] = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+        cleanup["ok"] = all(cleanup.get(key) is True for key in ("previous_timeline_restored", "probe_timeline_deleted", "inventory_unchanged", "target_unchanged", "probe_absent")) and cleanup["project_saved"] is False
+        result["cleanup"] = cleanup
+        if not cleanup["ok"]:
+            result["ok"] = False
+            result["classification"] = "BLOCKED"
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "f8a_attribution_size_diagnostic.json", result)
+    return result
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8a_completion_diagnostic.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8a_completion_diagnostic.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6d46196afe59b55c9b00c3286287393f31f2e333
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8a_completion_diagnostic.py
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+"""Read-only F8A completion audit for raw Resolve track-state behavior."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f8a_attribution_size_diagnostic as f8a
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F8A_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETION_V1"
+MODE = "step5_f8a_diagnostic_completion"
+
+
+def _track_state(timeline: Any, track_type: str, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    present = hasattr(timeline, "GetIsTrackEnabled")
+    try:
+        raw = timeline.GetIsTrackEnabled(track_type, index) if present else None
+        return {"method_present": present, "raw_type": type(raw).__name__, "raw_repr": repr(raw), "reported_enabled": raw if isinstance(raw, bool) else None, "exception": None}
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        return {"method_present": present, "raw_type": None, "raw_repr": None, "reported_enabled": None, "exception": f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)}
+
+
+def _audit(timeline: Any, expected: Mapping[tuple[int, int, int], Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    tracks, items = [], []
+    for track_type in ("video", "subtitle"):
+        count = int(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetTrackCount", track_type, default=0) or 0)
+        for index in range(1, count + 1):
+            track = {"track_type": track_type, "track_index": index, "name": str(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetTrackName", track_type, index, default="") or ""), "api_reported_track_enabled_state": _track_state(timeline, track_type, index), "items": []}
+            for item in list(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetItemListInTrack", track_type, index, default=[]) or []):
+                start, end = int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart", default=-1)), int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd", default=-1))
+                fusion_count = int(carrier._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0)
+                contract_row = expected.get((index, start, end)) if track_type == "video" else None
+                media = f8a._media(item)
+                if track_type == "video" and index == 1:
+                    classification = "SOURCE_BAKED_TEXT"
+                elif contract_row is not None and fusion_count > 0:
+                    classification = "TRACKED_F7_TEXTPLUS"
+                elif track_type == "subtitle" or carrier._title_text(item) is not None or fusion_count > 0:
+                    classification = "OTHER_RESOLVE_TEXT_LAYER"
+                else:
+                    classification = "UNKNOWN"
+                row = {
+                    "track_type": track_type,
+                    "track_index": index,
+                    "item_name": str(carrier._safe(item, "GetName", default="") or ""),
+                    "item_type": media.get("Type") or ("TextPlus" if fusion_count else "Unknown"),
+                    "start": start,
+                    "end": end,
+                    "fusion_comp_count": fusion_count,
+                    "source_identity": None if contract_row is None else contract_row["source_identity"],
+                    "styled_text": carrier._title_text(item),
+                    "media_path": media.get("File Path") or media.get("FilePath") or media.get("Path"),
+                    "classification": classification,
+                }
+                track["items"].append(row)
+                items.append(row)
+            tracks.append(track)
+    cases = []
+    for case, frame, source_frame, identities in f8a.CASES:
+        active = []
+        for item in items:
+            row = dict(item)
+            row["active_at_case_frame"] = item["start"] <= frame < item["end"]
+            if row["active_at_case_frame"] and row["classification"] != "UNKNOWN":
+                active.append(row)
+        cases.append({"case": case, "timeline_frame": frame, "source_frame": source_frame, "expected_identities": list(identities), "active_text_capable_items": active})
+    states = [track["api_reported_track_enabled_state"] for track in tracks]
+    contradiction = bool(states) and all(state["reported_enabled"] is False for state in states)
+    return {
+        "tracks": tracks,
+        "cases": cases,
+        "video_track_count": sum(track["track_type"] == "video" for track in tracks),
+        "subtitle_track_count": sum(track["track_type"] == "subtitle" for track in tracks),
+        "inventory_filtered_by_enabled_state": False,
+        "other_resolve_text_layer_count": sum(item["classification"] == "OTHER_RESOLVE_TEXT_LAYER" for item in items),
+        "unknown_count": sum(item["classification"] == "UNKNOWN" for item in items),
+        "api_state_contradicts_prior_rendered_output": contradiction,
+        "api_track_enabled_interpretation": "UNRELIABLE_FOR_VISIBILITY_ATTRIBUTION" if contradiction else "REVIEW_RAW_RESULTS",
+    }
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or command.get("run_id") or "")
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "classification": "BLOCKED"}
+    project = None
+    before_inventory: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    before_target: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    report_dir = Path(str(payload.get("report_dir") or ROOT / ".agent/reports" / TASK_ID / run_id)).resolve()
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") != f8a.PROJECT:
+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        matches = [row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._safe(row, "GetName", default="") == f8a.TARGET]
+        if len(matches) != 1 or carrier._unique_id(matches[0]) != f8a.TARGET_UID:
+            raise ValueError("target_identity")
+        target = matches[0]
+        before_inventory = f8a._inventory(project)
+        before_target = carrier.timeline_snapshot(target)
+        contract_path = Path(str(payload["contract_path"])).resolve()
+        if f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.sha(contract_path) != payload.get("contract_sha256"):
+            raise ValueError("contract_hash")
+        contract = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.read(contract_path)
+        expected = {(int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]), *row["resolve_interval"]): row for row in contract["objects"]}
+        audit = _audit(target, expected)
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "resolve_layer_audit_completion.json", audit)
+        result.update({"ok": True, "classification": "F8A_LAYER_AUDIT_COMPLETED", "layer_audit": str(report_dir / "resolve_layer_audit_completion.json")})
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["error"] = f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+    finally:
+        cleanup = {"project_saved": False}
+        if project is not None:
+            cleanup["inventory_unchanged"] = f8a._inventory(project) == before_inventory
+            target = next((row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._unique_id(row) == f8a.TARGET_UID), None)
+            cleanup["target_unchanged"] = target is not None and carrier.timeline_snapshot(target) == before_target
+        cleanup["ok"] = cleanup.get("inventory_unchanged") is True and cleanup.get("target_unchanged") is True and cleanup["project_saved"] is False
+        result["cleanup"] = cleanup
+        if not cleanup["ok"]:
+            result.update({"ok": False, "classification": "BLOCKED"})
+        f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "f8a_completion_diagnostic.json", result)
+    return result
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_generated_only_review.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_generated_only_review.py

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..79fd0bd6dd3a1fd9770b21f0d9683840a5edee3f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_generated_only_review.py
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+"""Create one generated-only review timeline from the accepted F9 canonical timeline."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review as f8
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F9_CANONICAL_GENERATED_ONLY_REVIEW_V1"
+MODE = "create_f9_canonical_generated_only_review"
+
+
+def _read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"json_object:{path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _artifact(payload: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = Path(str(payload[f"{name}_path"])).resolve()
+    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != payload[f"{name}_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}_hash")
+    return _read(path)
+
+
+def canonical_case_check(contract: dict[str, Any], audit: dict[str, Any], validation: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, bool]:
+    objects = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in contract.get("objects", [])}
+    texts = [str(row.get("text", {}).get("value") or "") for row in objects.values()]
+    targeted = {row["case"]: row.get("ok") is True for row in audit.get("targeted_cases", [])}
+    checks = {
+        "calling": objects.get("caption_tracklet_0082", {}).get("text", {}).get("value") == "calling",
+        "ling_suppressed": "caption_tracklet_0083" not in objects and "ling" not in texts,
+        "buyers": objects.get("caption_tracklet_0090", {}).get("text", {}).get("value") == "buyers",
+        "buy_suppressed": "caption_tracklet_0091" not in objects and "buy" not in texts,
+        "ers_suppressed": "ers" not in texts,
+        "your": objects.get("caption_tracklet_0043", {}).get("text", {}).get("value") == "your",
+        "why": objects.get("recovered_display_object_why_0001", {}).get("text", {}).get("value") == "why?",
+        "we": objects.get("caption_tracklet_0106", {}).get("text", {}).get("value") == "we",
+        "have": objects.get("caption_tracklet_0107", {}).get("text", {}).get("value") == "have",
+        "selling_continuity": objects.get("continuous_visual_identity_0014", {}).get("resolve_interval") == [68, 108] and "caption_tracklet_0013" not in objects,
+        "matching_continuity": objects.get("caption_tracklet_0094", {}).get("resolve_interval") == [599, 629] and "caption_tracklet_0096" not in objects,
+        "targeted_cases": all(targeted.get(name) is True for name in ("calling", "buyers", "with_the_buyers", "we_have", "your_why", "Selling", "Matching")),
+        "no_duplicate_owner": validation.get("duplicate_canonical_owners") == 0 and validation.get("unsupported_fragment_renders") == 0,
+    }
+    checks["all_pass"] = all(checks.values())
+    return checks
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or command.get("run_id") or "")
+    report_dir = Path(str(payload.get("report_dir") or ROOT / ".agent/reports" / TASK_ID / run_id)).resolve()
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "classification": "BLOCKED", "mutation_counts": {}}
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        contract = _artifact(payload, "contract")
+        audit = _artifact(payload, "audit")
+        validation = _artifact(payload, "validation")
+        cases = canonical_case_check(contract, audit, validation)
+        if not cases["all_pass"] or validation.get("pass") is not True or validation.get("persisted_renderable_objects") != contract.get("object_count"):
+            raise ValueError("canonical_source_validation")
+
+        inner_command = copy.deepcopy(command)
+        inner_command.update({"task_id": f8.TASK_ID, "mode": f8.MODE})
+        inner_command["payload"].update({"f7_timeline": payload["source_timeline"], "f7_timeline_uid": payload["source_timeline_uid"]})
+        inner = f8.run(resolve, {"run_id": run_id, "command": inner_command})
+        result["mutation_counts"] = inner.get("mutation_counts", {})
+        if inner.get("ok") is not True:
+            result.update({"error": inner.get("error", "generated_only_isolation"), "rollback": inner.get("rollback")})
+            return result
+
+        machine_path = report_dir / "f8_generated_only_machine_check.json"
+        machine = _read(machine_path)
+        machine.update({
+            "canonical_case_check": cases,
+            "canonical_source_timeline_unchanged": machine.get("f7_timeline_unchanged") is True,
+            "expected_canonical_textplus_count": contract["object_count"],
+            "old_caption_object_count": machine.get("other_text_or_generated_extra_count"),
+        })
+        machine["ok"] = machine.get("ok") is True and machine["canonical_source_timeline_unchanged"] and cases["all_pass"]
+        output = report_dir / "step5_f9_canonical_generated_only_machine_check.json"
+        f8.f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(output, machine)
+        if not machine["ok"]:
+            raise ValueError("f9_machine_check")
+        result.update({
+            "ok": True,
+            "classification": "READY_FOR_F9_CANONICAL_HUMAN_REVIEW",
+            "canonical_case_check": cases,
+            "review_timeline": inner["review_timeline"],
+            "machine_check": str(output),
+        })
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["error"] = f8.f7.IMPLEMENTATION.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+    finally:
+        f8.f7.IMPLEMENTATION.base.write(report_dir / "step5_f9_canonical_generated_only_review.json", result)
+    return result
diff --git a/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_rebuild.py b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_rebuild.py

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..504a7f8c532ab7293d0707e85345c192767a7cfc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_rebuild.py
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+"""Apply a fresh F9 canonical-ownership contract with the accepted F7 adapter."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP_REBUILD_V1"
+MODE = "apply_fresh_canonical_validation_rebuild"
+
+impl = f7.IMPLEMENTATION
+base = impl.base
+carrier = impl.carrier
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or "")
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "ok": False,
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "failures": [],
+        "mutation_counts": {"timeline_create": 0, "textplus_create": 0, "project_save": 0, "rollback_delete": 0},
+    }
+    target = project = previous = None
+    created = False
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        contract_path = Path(payload["contract_path"]).resolve()
+        audit_path = Path(payload["ownership_audit_path"]).resolve()
+        baseline = Path(payload["baseline_fcpxml"]).resolve()
+        report_dir = Path(payload["report_dir"]).resolve()
+        if base.sha(contract_path) != payload["contract_sha256"] or base.sha(audit_path) != payload["ownership_audit_sha256"] or base.sha(baseline) != payload["baseline_fcpxml_sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError("artifact_hash")
+        contract = base.read(contract_path)
+        audit = base.read(audit_path)
+        count = len(contract.get("objects") or [])
+        if count <= 0 or contract.get("object_count") != count or contract.get("validation_timeline") != payload["target_timeline"]:
+            raise ValueError("compile_contract")
+        if audit.get("final_renderable_object_count") != count or audit.get("ownership_conflicts") or audit.get("source_required_missing_objects") or audit.get("unsupported_duplicate_owners"):
+            raise ValueError("ownership_audit")
+
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") != contract["project"]:

+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temp, path)

+def find_timeline(project: Any, name: str, uid: str | None = None) -> Any:
+    rows = [row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if str(carrier._safe(row, "GetName", default="") or "") == name]

+def protected_snapshot(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:

+
+def textplus(item: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any]:

+def rgb_hex(values: list[int]) -> str:

+

+        "stroke_width": row["stroke"]["resolve_width"], "shadow_enabled": shadow is not None,

+def apply_keys(tool: Any, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    results: dict[str, Any] = {}

+def read_object(item: Any, expected: Mapping[str, Any], actual_track: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    _comp, tool = textplus(item)

+def close(a: Any, b: Any, tolerance: float = 1e-4) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(a, (list, tuple)) and isinstance(b, (list, tuple)):
+        return len(a) == len(b) and all(close(x, y, tolerance) for x, y in zip(a, b))
+    try:
+        return abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= tolerance

+def parity(contract: Mapping[str, Any], readback: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:

+        if protected_validation["mutated"]: raise ValueError("protected_timeline_mutated")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path

+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild as f7

+
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_V33_BOUNDED_MATERIALIZATION_CLEANUP_V1"

+impl = f7.IMPLEMENTATION
+base = impl.base
+
+
+def _hash(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _semantic_layer_hash(parity: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return _hash(parity["rows"])
+
+
+def _delete(project: Any, timeline: Any) -> bool:
+    return bool(carrier._safe(carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool"), "DeleteTimelines", [timeline], default=False)) if timeline is not None else True
+
+
+def _readback(timeline: Any, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    maximum = max(int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) for row in manifest["objects"])
+    expected = {(int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]), *row["resolve_interval"]): row for row in manifest["objects"]}
+    rows = []
+    for track in range(2, maximum + 1):
+        for item in list(carrier._safe(timeline, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", track, default=[]) or []):
+            if not int(carrier._safe(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0):
+                continue
+            key = (track, int(carrier._safe(item, "GetStart")), int(carrier._safe(item, "GetEnd")))
+            if key not in expected:
+                raise ValueError(f"unexpected_object:{key}")
+            rows.append(impl._read(item, expected[key], track))
+    parity = impl._parity(manifest, rows)
+    return sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["source_identity"]), parity
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or command.get("run_id") or "")
+    report_dir = Path(str(payload.get("report_dir") or ROOT / ".agent/reports" / TASK_ID / run_id)).resolve()
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "classification": "BLOCKED", "mutation_counts": {"timeline_create": 0, "textplus_create": 0, "underlay_delete": 0, "project_save": 0, "rollback_delete": 0}}
+    manager = project = previous = protected = applied = review = None
+    applied_created = review_created = success = False
+    try:
+        if command.get("task_id") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        manifest_path = Path(payload["manifest_path"]).resolve()
+        baseline = Path(payload["baseline_fcpxml"]).resolve()
+        if base.sha(manifest_path) != payload["manifest_sha256"] or base.sha(baseline) != payload["baseline_fcpxml_sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError("artifact_hash")
+        manifest = base.read(manifest_path)
+        count = len(manifest.get("objects") or [])
+        if count <= 0 or manifest.get("object_count") != count or manifest.get("applied_timeline") != payload["applied_timeline"] or manifest.get("generated_only_timeline") != payload["generated_only_timeline"]:
+            raise ValueError("manifest_scope")
+        manager = carrier._safe(resolve, "GetProjectManager")
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        if project is None or carrier._safe(project, "GetName", default="") != manifest["project"]:
+            raise ValueError("project_identity")
+        protected = base.find_timeline(project, manifest["protected_timeline"]["name"], manifest["protected_timeline"]["unique_id"])
+        if protected is None:
+            raise ValueError("protected_timeline_identity")
+        protected_before = base.protected_snapshot(protected)
+        previous = carrier._safe(project, "GetCurrentTimeline", default=None)
+        if base.find_timeline(project, payload["applied_timeline"]) is not None or base.find_timeline(project, payload["generated_only_timeline"]) is not None:
+            raise ValueError("fresh_target_already_exists")
+        before = {carrier._unique_id(row) for row in carrier._timelines(project)}
+        returned = carrier._safe(carrier._safe(project, "GetMediaPool"), "ImportTimelineFromFile", str(baseline), {"timelineName": payload["applied_timeline"]})
+        delta = [row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._unique_id(row) not in before]
+        applied = returned if returned not in (None, False, True) else delta[0] if len(delta) == 1 else None
+        if applied is None or len(delta) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("applied_timeline_ownership")
+        applied_created = True
+        result["mutation_counts"]["timeline_create"] = 1
+        carrier._safe(applied, "SetName", payload["applied_timeline"])
+        maximum = max(int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) for row in manifest["objects"])
+        while int(carrier._safe(applied, "GetTrackCount", "video", default=0) or 0) < maximum:
+            if not carrier._safe(applied, "AddTrack", "video", default=False):
+                raise ValueError("track_creation")
+        if not carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", applied, default=False):
+            raise ValueError("applied_activation")
+        v1 = list(carrier._safe(applied, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", 1, default=[]) or [])
+        source = carrier._safe(v1[0], "GetMediaPoolItem") if v1 else None
+        titles = [{"caption_id": row["source_identity"], "text": row["text"]["value"], "timeline_start": row["resolve_interval"][0], "duration": row["resolve_interval"][1] - row["resolve_interval"][0], "lane": row["z_order_track"]["lane"]} for row in manifest["objects"]]
+        provision = carrier.apply_carrier_textplus_v2(project, applied, titles, source, {"ownership": carrier.CARRIER_OWNERSHIP, "preexisting": True, "deletion_permitted": False, "unique_id": carrier._unique_id(source), "source_start": 0})
+        if provision.get("ok") is not True or provision.get("created_count") != count:
+            raise ValueError("textplus_provision")
+        result["mutation_counts"]["textplus_create"] = count
+        items = {carrier._unique_id(item): item for track in range(2, maximum + 1) for item in (carrier._safe(applied, "GetItemListInTrack", "video", track, default=[]) or [])}
+        links = {row["caption_id"]: row for row in provision["rows"]}
+        for index, row in enumerate(manifest["objects"], 1):
+            item = items.get(links[row["source_identity"]]["item_unique_id"])
+            if item is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"item_reacquire:{row['source_identity']}")
+            carrier._safe(item, "SetName", row["intended_resolve_name"])
+            comp, tool = base.textplus(item)
+            if not impl._style(row, tool, comp, index)["ok"] or not base.apply_keys(tool, row)["ok"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"application:{row['source_identity']}")
+        if carrier._safe(manager, "SaveProject", default=False) is False:
+            raise ValueError("save_applied")
+        result["mutation_counts"]["project_save"] += 1
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        applied = base.find_timeline(project, payload["applied_timeline"])
+        applied_rows, applied_parity = _readback(applied, manifest)
+        if len(applied_rows) != count or not applied_parity["ok"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"applied_parity:{applied_parity['failures'][:10]}")
+        applied_uid = carrier._unique_id(applied)
+
+        applied_snapshot = carrier.timeline_snapshot(applied)
+        before = {carrier._unique_id(row) for row in carrier._timelines(project)}
+        returned = carrier._safe(applied, "DuplicateTimeline", payload["generated_only_timeline"], default=None)
+        delta = [row for row in carrier._timelines(project) if carrier._unique_id(row) not in before]
+        review = returned if returned not in (None, False, True) else delta[0] if len(delta) == 1 else None
+        if review is None or len(delta) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("generated_only_timeline_ownership")
+        review_created = True
+        result["mutation_counts"]["timeline_create"] += 1
+        if not carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", review, default=False):
+            raise ValueError("generated_only_activation")
+        deletion = generated_only._delete_underlay(review)
+        result["mutation_counts"]["underlay_delete"] = deletion["total"] if deletion["ok"] else 0
+        if not deletion["ok"]:
+            raise ValueError("generated_only_underlay_delete")
+        if carrier._safe(manager, "SaveProject", default=False) is False:
+            raise ValueError("save_generated_only")
+        result["mutation_counts"]["project_save"] += 1
+        project = carrier._safe(manager, "GetCurrentProject")
+        applied = base.find_timeline(project, payload["applied_timeline"])
+        review = base.find_timeline(project, payload["generated_only_timeline"])
+        if applied is None or review is None or carrier.timeline_snapshot(applied) != applied_snapshot:
+            raise ValueError("applied_timeline_changed_during_review_creation")
+        review_rows, review_parity = _readback(review, manifest)
+        applied_hash, review_hash = _semantic_layer_hash(applied_parity), _semantic_layer_hash(review_parity)
+        protected_after = base.protected_snapshot(base.find_timeline(project, manifest["protected_timeline"]["name"], manifest["protected_timeline"]["unique_id"]))
+        checks = {
+            "expected_generated_objects": count, "persisted_applied_objects": len(applied_rows), "persisted_generated_only_objects": len(review_rows),
+            "missing_objects": 0, "duplicate_generated_owners": 0, "text_mismatches": 0, "lifecycle_mismatches": 0,
+            "track_lane_mismatches": 0, "material_style_mismatches": 0, "material_motion_mismatches": 0,
+            "same_track_illegal_overlaps": 0, "protected_source_timeline_mutations": int(protected_before != protected_after),
+            "applied_caption_layer_sha256": applied_hash, "generated_only_caption_layer_sha256": review_hash,
+            "applied_generated_only_caption_layer_equivalent": applied_hash == review_hash,
+            "applied_parity": applied_parity, "generated_only_parity": review_parity,
+        }
+        checks["pass"] = len(applied_rows) == len(review_rows) == count and applied_parity["ok"] and review_parity["ok"] and protected_before == protected_after and applied_hash == review_hash
+        base.write(report_dir / "step5a_v33_resolve_validation.json", checks)
+        if not checks["pass"]:
+            raise ValueError("machine_validation")
+        success = True
+        result.update({"ok": True, "classification": "STEP5A_FRESH_REBUILD_MACHINE_PASS_STEP5B_HUMAN_REVIEW_CURRENT", "object_count": count, "applied_timeline": {"name": payload["applied_timeline"], "unique_id": applied_uid}, "generated_only_timeline": {"name": payload["generated_only_timeline"], "unique_id": carrier._unique_id(review)}, "machine_validation": str(report_dir / "step5a_v33_resolve_validation.json"), "protected_timeline_mutated": False})
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        result["error"] = impl.visual.base.compact_exception(exc)
+    finally:
+        if project is not None and previous is not None:
+            carrier._safe(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", previous, default=False)
+        if not success and project is not None:
+            if review_created and review is not None:
+                result["mutation_counts"]["rollback_delete"] += int(_delete(project, review))
+            if applied_created and applied is not None:
+                result["mutation_counts"]["rollback_delete"] += int(_delete(project, applied))
+            if result["mutation_counts"]["rollback_delete"]:
+                carrier._safe(manager, "SaveProject", default=False)
+        base.write(report_dir / "step5a_v33_resolve_rebuild_result.json", result)
+    return result
