+"""Apply the one accepted Reel #2 flash to a derivative of the GOLD timeline.
+
+This module is intentionally an adapter.  Flash media ownership, carrier append,
+Fusion construction and Flash readback remain owned by the accepted V4 helpers.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import traceback
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def _load(name: str, path: Path):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"cannot_load:{path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+V4 = _load("vc_step6a_accepted_flash_v4", HERE / "advanced_transition_flash_neutral_rgba_v4.py")
+V1 = V4.V1
+P4B = _load("vc_step6a_phase4b_inventory", HERE / "video_cloner_phase4b_timeline_application.py")
+SNAP = _load("vc_step6a_caption_snapshot", HERE / "final_occlusion_composition_v1.py")
+C1 = _load("vc_step6a_accepted_phase4c1", HERE / "video_cloner_phase4c1_flash_v4_integration.py")
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP6A_GOLD_FLASH_INTEGRATION_V1"
+MODE = "step6a_apply_gold_flash"
+VERSION = "video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration_1"
+PROJECT_NAME = "New Project 1"
+GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5B_V33_BOUNDED_CLEANUP_GENERATED_ONLY_99830db16b49"
+TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME = "VIDEO_CLONER_REEL2_STEP6A_FLASH_V1"
+GOLD_DRT_RELATIVE = ".agent/gold/video_cloner/reel2/captions/VIDEO_CLONER_REEL2_CAPTIONS_GOLD_HUMAN_ACCEPTED.drt"
+GOLD_DRT_SHA256 = "99b11b92d55c40682f630fd4c52072e006c7e0b6494aef367bda175fb9d4af2e"
+AUTHORITY_DIR_RELATIVE = "data/DcJRJtUKScu/accepted/step6a"
+DETECTOR_RELATIVE = AUTHORITY_DIR_RELATIVE + "/DcJRJtUKScu_transitions.json"
+PLANNING_RELATIVE = AUTHORITY_DIR_RELATIVE + "/DcJRJtUKScu_generic_edit_commands.json"
+DETECTOR_SHA256 = "ec459a99b4a2462436310738ae51072f014733d0ee706fa1363b067c2d83817c"
+PLANNING_SHA256 = "8529887a3c6182c031b9388f8ea7182c6a1fb4aefd65e13b54b442d3e21efc5e"
+EXPECTED_FPS = 24.0
+REEL_START = 594
+REEL_CUT = 596
+REEL_END = 598
+FLASH_PREFIX = "VC_FLASH_"
+CAPTION_PREFIXES = ("VC5A33::", "VC5A33R::")
+
+
+class FrameMappingError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def find_exact(project: Any, name: str, *, allow_missing: bool = False) -> Any:
+    matches = P4B.find_timelines(project, name)
+    if allow_missing and not matches:
+        return None
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"timeline_identity:{name}:{len(matches)}")
+    return matches[0]
+
+
+def timeline_uid(timeline: Any) -> str:
+    return str(V1.safe_call(timeline, "GetUniqueId", default="") or "")
+
+
+def same_timeline(left: Any, right: Any) -> bool:
+    if left is right and left is not None:
+        return True
+    left_uid, right_uid = timeline_uid(left), timeline_uid(right)
+    return bool(left_uid and left_uid == right_uid and V1.timeline_name(left) == V1.timeline_name(right))
+
+
+def select_and_prove(project: Any, timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    selected, call = V1.direct_call(project, "SetCurrentTimeline", timeline)
+    readback = V1.safe_call(project, "GetCurrentTimeline", default=None)
+    ok = bool(selected and same_timeline(timeline, readback))
+    return {"ok": ok, "call": call, "expected_name": V1.timeline_name(timeline), "readback_name": V1.timeline_name(readback), "expected_uid": timeline_uid(timeline), "readback_uid": timeline_uid(readback)}
+
+
+def verify_input_hashes(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    rows = []
+    for relative, expected in ((GOLD_DRT_RELATIVE, GOLD_DRT_SHA256), (DETECTOR_RELATIVE, DETECTOR_SHA256), (PLANNING_RELATIVE, PLANNING_SHA256)):
+        path = root / relative
+        actual = sha256(path) if path.is_file() else ""
+        rows.append({"path": relative, "expected_sha256": expected, "actual_sha256": actual, "ok": actual == expected})
+    return {"ok": all(row["ok"] for row in rows), "rows": rows}
+
+
+def validate_plan(plan: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if plan.get("schema") != "video_cloner.step6a_gold_flash_plan" or plan.get("schema_version") != 1 or plan.get("task_id") != TASK_ID:
+        raise ValueError("plan_identity")
+    if plan.get("project_name") != PROJECT_NAME:
+        raise ValueError("plan_project")
+    if plan.get("gold_timeline_name") != GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME or plan.get("target_timeline_name") != TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME:
+        raise ValueError("plan_timeline")
+    if plan.get("gold_drt_sha256") != GOLD_DRT_SHA256 or plan.get("detector_sha256") != DETECTOR_SHA256 or plan.get("planning_sha256") != PLANNING_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("plan_authority_hash")
+    mapping = plan.get("reel_mapping") or {}
+    if mapping != {"fps": 24, "start_frame": REEL_START, "cut_frame": REEL_CUT, "end_frame_exclusive": REEL_END, "duration_frames": 4}:
+        raise ValueError("plan_mapping")
+    rows = plan.get("flashes")
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("plan_flash_count")
+    row = rows[0]
+    if row.get("transition_type") != "flash_cut" or row.get("confidence") != "high" or row.get("editor_actionable") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("plan_flash_authority")
+    if [int(row.get(key, -1)) for key in ("start_frame", "cut_frame", "end_frame_exclusive", "duration_frames")] != [594, 596, 598, 4]:
+        raise ValueError("plan_flash_geometry")
+    unhashed = dict(plan)
+    digest = str(unhashed.pop("plan_sha256", ""))
+    if not digest or V1.canonical_sha256(unhashed) != digest:
+        raise ValueError("plan_hash")
+
+
+def frame_mapping(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    snap = P4B.timeline_snapshot(timeline)
+    fps_values = [float(value) for value in snap["settings"].values() if value not in (None, "")]
+    start = int(snap.get("start_frame") or 0)
+    end = snap.get("end_frame")
+    if end is None:
+        raise FrameMappingError("STEP6A_GOLD_FRAME_MAPPING_MISMATCH:end_frame_missing")
+    end = int(end)
+    duration = end - start
+    if not fps_values or any(abs(value - EXPECTED_FPS) > 1e-6 for value in fps_values):
+        raise FrameMappingError(f"STEP6A_GOLD_FRAME_MAPPING_MISMATCH:fps:{fps_values}")
+    mapped = {str(frame): start + frame for frame in (REEL_START, REEL_CUT, REEL_END)}
+    if duration < REEL_END or mapped[str(REEL_START)] < start or mapped[str(REEL_END)] > end:
+        raise FrameMappingError(f"STEP6A_GOLD_FRAME_MAPPING_MISMATCH:range:{start}:{end}:{duration}")
+    return {"ok": True, "fps": EXPECTED_FPS, "timeline_start_frame": start, "timeline_end_frame_exclusive": end, "timeline_duration_frames": duration, "coordinate_system": "reel_relative_plus_timeline_start", "mapped_frames": mapped, "mapped_span": [mapped[str(REEL_START)], mapped[str(REEL_END)]]}
+
+
+def _caption_items(timeline: Any) -> list[tuple[int, Any]]:
+    rows = [(track, item) for track, item in V1.all_video_items(timeline) if V1.item_name(item).startswith(CAPTION_PREFIXES)]
+    return sorted(rows, key=lambda pair: (pair[0], V1.item_start(pair[1]), V1.item_name(pair[1])))
+
+
+def caption_snapshot(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    rows = []
+    for track, item in _caption_items(timeline):
+        summary = SNAP.base.item_summary(track, item)
+        comp = SNAP.base.get_comp(item)
+        tool = SNAP.base.get_text_tool(comp)
+        if comp is None or tool is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"caption_text_tool:{V1.item_name(item)}")
+        duration = int(summary.get("duration") or 0)
+        if duration <= 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"caption_duration:{V1.item_name(item)}")
+        rows.append({
+            "name": V1.item_name(item),
+            "summary": {field: summary.get(field) for field in SNAP.STABLE_INVENTORY_FIELDS},
+            "clip_enabled": SNAP._normalized(SNAP.base.safe_value(item, "GetClipEnabled", default=None)),
+            "properties": {name: SNAP._property_snapshot(tool, name, duration) for name in SNAP.CAPTION_PROPERTIES},
+        })
+    names = [row["name"] for row in rows]
+    if not rows or len(names) != len(set(names)):
+        raise RuntimeError("caption_identity")
+    return {"count": len(rows), "names": names, "rows": rows, "sha256": V1.canonical_sha256(rows)}
+
+
+def non_caption_snapshot(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    rows = []
+    for track, item in V1.all_video_items(timeline):
+        name = V1.item_name(item)
+        if name.startswith(CAPTION_PREFIXES) or name.startswith(FLASH_PREFIX):
+            continue
+        rows.append(P4B.item_snapshot(item, track))
+    rows.sort(key=lambda row: (row.get("track_index"), row.get("start"), row.get("name")))
+    return {"count": len(rows), "rows": rows, "sha256": V1.canonical_sha256(rows)}
+
+
+def source_state(timeline: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    geometry = frame_mapping(timeline)
+    return {"timeline_name": V1.timeline_name(timeline), "timeline_uid": timeline_uid(timeline), "video_track_count": V1.track_count(timeline, "video"), "audio_track_count": V1.track_count(timeline, "audio"), "geometry": geometry, "captions": caption_snapshot(timeline), "non_caption": non_caption_snapshot(timeline)}
+
+
+def source_unchanged(before: Mapping[str, Any], after: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return all(before.get(key) == after.get(key) for key in ("timeline_name", "timeline_uid", "video_track_count", "audio_track_count", "geometry", "captions", "non_caption"))
+
+
+def mapped_flash(mapping: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    mapped = mapping["mapped_frames"]
+    return [{"name": "VC_FLASH_001_frame_0596", "transition_type": "flash_cut", "cut_frame": int(mapped[str(REEL_CUT)]), "start_frame": int(mapped[str(REEL_START)]), "duration_frames": 4, "outgoing_frames": 2, "incoming_frames": 2, "flash_color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], "alpha_keyframes": [[0, 0.0], [2, 0.75], [3, 0.0]]}]
+
+
+def target_contract(source: Mapping[str, Any], target: Any, flashes: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    captions = caption_snapshot(target)
+    non_caption = non_caption_snapshot(target)
+    geometry = frame_mapping(target)
+    expected_track = int(source["video_track_count"]) + 1
+    flash = V4.neutral_flash_snapshot(target, flashes, expected_track)
+    checks = {
+        "caption_structural_snapshot_unchanged": captions == source["captions"],
+        "non_caption_inventory_unchanged": non_caption == source["non_caption"],
+        "timeline_geometry_unchanged": geometry == source["geometry"],
+        "audio_track_count_unchanged": V1.track_count(target, "audio") == source["audio_track_count"],
+        "top_overlay_track_exact": V1.track_count(target, "video") == expected_track and flash.get("rows") and all(int(row.get("track_index") or 0) == expected_track for row in flash["rows"]),
+        "one_authorized_flash": flash.get("ok") is True and flash.get("count") == 1 and flash.get("neutral_carrier_count") == 1 and flash.get("source_video_carrier_count") == 0,
+    }
+    return {"ok": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks, "captions": captions, "non_caption": non_caption, "geometry": geometry, "flash": flash, "expected_flash_track": expected_track}
+
+
+def exact_flash_item(timeline: Any, spec: Mapping[str, Any], expected_track: int) -> Any:
+    matches = [
+        item
+        for track, item in V1.all_video_items(timeline)
+        if track == expected_track
+        and V1.item_name(item) == spec["name"]
+        and V1.item_start(item) == int(spec["start_frame"])
+        and V1.item_duration(item) == int(spec["duration_frames"])
+    ]
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"flash_carrier_identity:{len(matches)}")
+    return matches[0]
+
+
+def persisted_target_contract(source: Mapping[str, Any], target: Any, flashes: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    contract = target_contract(source, target, flashes)
+    item = exact_flash_item(target, flashes[0], int(contract["expected_flash_track"]))
+    count = int(V1.safe_call(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0)
+    comp = V1.safe_call(item, "GetFusionCompByIndex", 1, default=None) if count >= 1 else None
+    persisted = bool(count >= 1 and comp is not None and contract["flash"].get("ok") is True)
+    contract["persisted_fusion"] = {"ok": persisted, "fusion_comp_count": count, "reacquired_carrier": True}
+    contract["checks"]["flash_fusion_persisted"] = persisted
+    contract["ok"] = all(contract["checks"].values())
+    return contract
+
+
+def repairable_partial_target(source: Mapping[str, Any], target: Any, flashes: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    contract = target_contract(source, target, flashes)
+    expected_track = int(contract["expected_flash_track"])
+    item = exact_flash_item(target, flashes[0], expected_track)
+    row = next((candidate for candidate in contract["flash"].get("rows", []) if candidate.get("name") == flashes[0]["name"]), {})
+    structural = all(value for name, value in contract["checks"].items() if name != "one_authorized_flash")
+    carrier_ok = bool(
+        contract["flash"].get("count") == 1
+        and row.get("track_index") == expected_track
+        and row.get("start") == int(flashes[0]["start_frame"])
+        and row.get("duration") == int(flashes[0]["duration_frames"])
+        and row.get("carrier", {}).get("neutral_carrier_ok") is True
+        and contract["flash"].get("source_video_carrier_count") == 0
+    )
+    fusion_count = int(V1.safe_call(item, "GetFusionCompCount", default=0) or 0)
+    return {"ok": bool((not contract["ok"] or fusion_count < 1) and structural and carrier_ok), "item": item, "contract": contract, "fusion_comp_count": fusion_count}
+
+
+def inventory_without_target(project: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [row for row in P4B.timeline_inventory(project) if row.get("name") != TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME]
+
+
+def same_inventory(left: list[dict[str, Any]], right: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
+    key = lambda row: (row.get("name"), row.get("signature"))
+    return Counter(map(key, left)) == Counter(map(key, right))
+
+
+def resolve_gold_source(media_pool: Any, project: Any, root: Path) -> tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]:
+    existing = find_exact(project, GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, allow_missing=True)
+    if existing is not None:
+        return existing, {"route": "EXACT_EXISTING_GOLD_TIMELINE", "imported": False}
+    drt = root / GOLD_DRT_RELATIVE
+    value, call = V1.direct_call(media_pool, "ImportTimelineFromFile", str(drt), {"timelineName": GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME})
+    source = find_exact(project, GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME)
+    if value is None or V1.timeline_name(source) != GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME:
+        raise RuntimeError("gold_drt_import")
+    return source, {"route": "IMMUTABLE_GOLD_DRT_IMPORT", "imported": True, "call": call}
+
+
+def run(resolve: Any, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    command = context.get("command") or {}
+    run_id = str(context.get("run_id") or command.get("run_id") or "")
+    report: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False, "task_id": TASK_ID, "version": VERSION, "run_id": run_id, "mode": MODE, "failures": [], "save_project_count": 0, "timeline_duplicate_count": 0, "track_add_count": 0, "flash_carrier_append_count": 0, "media_import_count": 0}
+    root = report_dir = None
+    manager = project = media_pool = source = target = previous = None
+    target_created = gold_imported = saved = False
+    media_ownership = None
+    try:
+        if command.get("task") != TASK_ID or command.get("mode") != MODE or command.get("run_id") != run_id:
+            raise ValueError("command_identity")
+        payload = command.get("payload") or {}
+        run_mode = str(payload.get("run_mode") or "")
+        if run_mode not in {"apply", "idempotency"}:
+            raise ValueError("run_mode")
+        root = Path(str(payload.get("repository_root") or "")).resolve()
+        report_dir = root / str(payload.get("report_dir") or "")
+        report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        plan_path = Path(str(payload.get("plan_path") or "")).resolve()
+        if sha256(plan_path) != payload.get("plan_sha256"):
+            raise ValueError("plan_file_hash")
+        plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        validate_plan(plan)
+        project_name = str(plan["project_name"])
+        if payload.get("expected_project") != project_name:
+            raise ValueError("payload_identity")
+        hashes = verify_input_hashes(root)
+        report["authority_verification"] = hashes
+        if not hashes["ok"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("accepted_authority_hash")
+        manager = V1.safe_call(resolve, "GetProjectManager", default=None)
+        project = V1.safe_call(manager, "GetCurrentProject", default=None)
+        if project is None or str(V1.safe_call(project, "GetName", default="") or "") != project_name:
+            raise RuntimeError("project_identity")
+        media_pool = V1.safe_call(project, "GetMediaPool", default=None)
+        if manager is None or media_pool is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("resolve_context")
+        report["project_name"] = project_name
+        previous = V1.safe_call(project, "GetCurrentTimeline", default=None)
+        source, route = resolve_gold_source(media_pool, project, root)
+        gold_imported = route.get("imported") is True
+        report["gold_source_route"] = route
+        source_before = source_state(source)
+        flashes = mapped_flash(source_before["geometry"])
+        inventory_before = inventory_without_target(project)
+        existing = find_exact(project, TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME, allow_missing=True)
+        report.update({"run_mode": run_mode, "source_before": source_before, "mapped_flash": flashes, "timeline_inventory_before": inventory_before})
+        application_classification = None
+        assets = None
+        if existing is not None:
+            selection = select_and_prove(project, existing)
+            report["target_selection"] = selection
+            if not selection["ok"]:
+                raise RuntimeError("target_selection_readback")
+            contract = persisted_target_contract(source_before, existing, flashes)
+            if contract["ok"]:
+                source_after = source_state(source)
+                inventory_after = inventory_without_target(project)
+                if not source_unchanged(source_before, source_after) or not same_inventory(inventory_before, inventory_after):
+                    raise RuntimeError("idempotency_regression")
+                report.update({"ok": True, "classification": "ALREADY_VALID_REUSED", "idempotent": True, "target_after": contract, "source_after": source_after, "source_timeline_unchanged": True, "unrelated_timelines_unchanged": True, "timeline_inventory_after": inventory_after, "persistent_readback_ok": True})
+            else:
+                if run_mode == "idempotency":
+                    raise RuntimeError("flash_fusion_not_persisted")
+                repair = repairable_partial_target(source_before, existing, flashes)
+                report["partial_target_before"] = {"ok": repair["ok"], "fusion_comp_count": repair["fusion_comp_count"], "contract": V1.json_safe(repair["contract"])}
+                if not repair["ok"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("preexisting_target_invalid")
+                target = existing
+                configured = V1.configure_flash(repair["item"], flashes[0], 1)
+                if not configured.get("ok"):
+                    raise RuntimeError("flash_configure")
+                application_classification = "PARTIAL_TARGET_REPAIRED"
+        else:
+            if run_mode == "idempotency":
+                raise RuntimeError("idempotency_target_missing")
+            value, duplicate_call = V1.direct_call(source, "DuplicateTimeline", TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME)
+            target = value if value is not None else find_exact(project, TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME)
+            if target is None or V1.timeline_name(target) != TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME:
+                raise RuntimeError("duplicate_target")
+            target_created = True
+            report["timeline_duplicate_count"] = 1
+            report["duplicate_call"] = duplicate_call
+            selection = select_and_prove(project, target)
+            report["target_selection"] = selection
+            if not selection["ok"]:
+                raise RuntimeError("target_selection_readback")
+            duplicate_state = source_state(target)
+            if not source_unchanged(source_before, duplicate_state | {"timeline_name": source_before["timeline_name"], "timeline_uid": source_before["timeline_uid"]}):
+                raise RuntimeError("duplicate_structural_snapshot")
+            source_tracks = int(source_before["video_track_count"])
+            track = V1.ensure_extra_video_track(target, source_tracks)
+            if not track.get("ok") or int(track.get("target_track") or 0) != source_tracks + 1:
+                raise RuntimeError("top_overlay_track")
+            report["track_add_count"] = 1
+            assets = V4.validate_neutral_assets(root)
+            if not assets.get("ok"):
+                raise RuntimeError("neutral_assets")
+            imported = V4.import_neutral_carrier(media_pool, root, assets)
+            media_ownership = imported
+            media_item = imported.get("item")
+            report["media_ownership"] = {key: V1.json_safe(value) for key, value in imported.items() if key != "item"}
+            if not imported.get("ok") or media_item is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("neutral_media_ownership")
+            report["media_import_count"] = int(imported.get("import_performed") is True)
+            appended = V1.append_flash_carriers(media_pool, target, {"media_pool_item": media_item, "source_start": 0}, flashes, source_tracks + 1)
+            assigned = list(appended.get("assigned") or [])
+            if not appended.get("ok") or len(assigned) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError("flash_append")
+            report["flash_carrier_append_count"] = 1
+            flash_item = exact_flash_item(target, flashes[0], source_tracks + 1)
+            configured = V1.configure_flash(flash_item, flashes[0], 1)
+            if not configured.get("ok"):
+                raise RuntimeError("flash_configure")
+            application_classification = "FIRST_APPLICATION"
+        if application_classification is not None:
+            before_save = target_contract(source_before, target, flashes)
+            source_mid = source_state(source)
+            inventory_pre_save = inventory_without_target(project)
+            report["timeline_inventory_pre_save"] = inventory_pre_save
+            if not before_save["ok"] or not source_unchanged(source_before, source_mid):
+                raise RuntimeError("pre_save_non_regression")
+            if not same_inventory(inventory_before, inventory_pre_save):
+                raise RuntimeError("pre_save_non_target_regression")
+            visual = C1.capture_visual_evidence(project, target, flashes, report_dir / "visual_evidence")
+            if not visual.get("ok") or visual.get("total_frames") != 4:
+                raise RuntimeError("visual_evidence")
+            if not V1.safe_call(manager, "SaveProject", default=False):
+                raise RuntimeError("save_project")
+            saved = True
+            report["save_project_count"] = 1
+            persistent = find_exact(project, TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME)
+            after = persisted_target_contract(source_before, persistent, flashes)
+            source_after = source_state(source)
+            inventory_after = inventory_without_target(project)
+            if not after.get("persisted_fusion", {}).get("ok"):
+                raise RuntimeError("flash_fusion_not_persisted")
+            if not after["ok"] or not source_unchanged(source_before, source_after) or not same_inventory(inventory_before, inventory_after):
+                raise RuntimeError("persistent_readback")
+            result = {"ok": True, "classification": application_classification, "idempotent": False, "configure": V1.json_safe(configured), "visual_evidence": visual, "target_after": after, "source_after": source_after, "source_timeline_unchanged": True, "unrelated_timelines_unchanged": True, "timeline_inventory_after": inventory_after, "persistent_readback_ok": True}
+            if assets is not None:
+                result["neutral_asset_verification"] = assets
+            report.update(result)
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        report["failures"] = [f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"]
+        report["traceback"] = traceback.format_exc()
+        if not saved and media_pool is not None and (target_created or gold_imported):
+            owned_timelines = [timeline for timeline in (target if target_created else None, source if gold_imported else None) if timeline is not None]
+            delete_target, delete_call = V1.direct_call(media_pool, "DeleteTimelines", owned_timelines)
+            delete_media = V4._delete_owned_media_pool_item(media_pool, media_ownership)
+            rollback_save = bool(V1.safe_call(manager, "SaveProject", default=False)) if delete_target else False
+            report["rollback"] = {"timeline_delete_ok": bool(delete_target), "owned_timeline_names": [V1.timeline_name(timeline) for timeline in owned_timelines], "timeline_delete_call": delete_call, "media_delete": delete_media, "save_ok": rollback_save, "owned_only": True}
+        report["classification"] = "STEP6A_GOLD_FRAME_MAPPING_MISMATCH" if isinstance(exc, FrameMappingError) else "STEP6A_FAILED"
+    finally:
+        if project is not None and previous is not None:
+            report["previous_timeline_restoration"] = select_and_prove(project, previous)
+            if not report["previous_timeline_restoration"]["ok"]:
+                report["ok"] = False
+                report["failures"].append("RuntimeError: previous_timeline_restoration")
+        if report_dir is not None:
+            try:
+                P4B.write_json(report_dir / "step6a_flash_result.json", report)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+    return report

--- a/resolve_workspace/resolve_apply_caption_animation_step_3C.py

+def apply_authorized_animation(
+    comp: Any,
+    tool: Any,
+    payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
+    duration_frames: int,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Apply one already-authorized STEP 4A payload and prove temporal readback."""
+    if payload is None:
+        return {
+            "ok": True,
+            "selected": False,
+            "modified": False,
+            "keyframes_written": 0,
+            "readback": [],
+        }
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError("animation_payload_type")
+
+    allowed_keys = {
+        "authority",
+        "source_evidence_id",
+        "source_type",
+        "property",
+        "keyframes",
+    }
+    if set(payload) - allowed_keys:
+        raise ValueError("animation_payload_unexpected_fields")
+    if payload.get("authority") != "visual_observed":
+        raise ValueError("animation_authority")
+
+    input_name = str(payload.get("property") or "")
+    source_type = str(payload.get("source_type") or "")
+    if (input_name, source_type) not in {("Center", "slide"), ("Size", "scale")}:
+        raise ValueError("animation_property_or_type")
+    if not str(payload.get("source_evidence_id") or ""):
+        raise ValueError("animation_source_evidence_id")
+    if not isinstance(duration_frames, int) or isinstance(duration_frames, bool) or duration_frames <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("animation_duration_frames")
+
+    raw_keyframes = payload.get("keyframes")
+    if not isinstance(raw_keyframes, list) or not raw_keyframes:
+        raise ValueError("animation_keyframes")
+
+    targets: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: Dict[int, Any] = {}
+    previous_frame = -1
+    for keyframe in raw_keyframes:
+        if not isinstance(keyframe, dict) or set(keyframe) != {"frame", "relative_time", "value"}:
+            raise ValueError("animation_keyframe_shape")
+        frame = keyframe.get("frame")
+        relative_time = as_float(keyframe.get("relative_time"))
+        value = normalize_value(input_name, keyframe.get("value"))
+        if (
+            not isinstance(frame, int)
+            or isinstance(frame, bool)
+            or relative_time is None
+            or not 0.0 <= relative_time <= 1.0
+            or value is None
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("animation_keyframe_value")
+        if frame < 0 or frame >= duration_frames:
+            raise ValueError("animation_keyframe_out_of_range")
+        if frame in seen:
+            if not values_match(input_name, seen[frame], value):
+                raise ValueError("animation_duplicate_frame_conflict")
+            raise ValueError("animation_duplicate_frame")
+        if frame <= previous_frame:
+            raise ValueError("animation_keyframe_order")
+        seen[frame] = value
+        previous_frame = frame
+        targets.append({"input": input_name, "local_frame": frame, "expected": value})
+
+    if find_input(tool, input_name) is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"animation_input_not_found:{input_name}")
+    if input_targets_are_correct(tool, input_name, targets):
+        return {
+            "ok": True,
+            "selected": True,
+            "modified": False,
+            "already_correct": True,
+            "property": input_name,
+            "keyframes_written": 0,
+            "readback": [
+                {**target, "actual": normalize_value(input_name, read_input(tool, input_name, target["local_frame"])), "matched": True}
+                for target in targets
+            ],
+        }
+
+    try:
+        comp.Lock()
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    writes: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    try:
+        modifier = ensure_modifier(comp, tool, input_name)
+        if modifier.get("ok") is not True:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"animation_modifier_not_connected:{input_name}")
+        for target in targets:
+            write = write_key(tool, input_name, target["local_frame"], target["expected"])
+            writes.append({**target, "write": write})
+            if write.get("ok") is not True:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"animation_keyframe_write:{input_name}@{target['local_frame']}")
+    finally:
+        try:
+            comp.Unlock()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+    readback = [
+        {
+            **target,
+            "actual": normalize_value(input_name, read_input(tool, input_name, target["local_frame"])),
+            "modifier_connected": connected_output(find_input(tool, input_name)) is not None,
+            "matched": values_match(input_name, read_input(tool, input_name, target["local_frame"]), target["expected"]),
+        }
+        for target in targets
+    ]
+    if not input_targets_are_correct(tool, input_name, targets) or not all(row["matched"] for row in readback):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"animation_temporal_readback:{input_name}")
+    return {
+        "ok": True,
+        "selected": True,
+        "modified": True,
+        "already_correct": False,
+        "property": input_name,
+        "modifier": modifier,
+        "keyframes_written": len(writes),
+        "writes": writes,
+        "readback": readback,
+    }
+
+
 def run() -> Dict[str, Any]:
     source_payload = load_source_targets()
     source_items = source_payload["items"]

+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()

+
+def clipping_verdict(conditions: dict[str, bool], lifecycle_explains: bool, evidence_usable: bool) -> str:
+    if lifecycle_explains:
+        return "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING"
+    if all(conditions.values()):
+        return "SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING"
+    if not evidence_usable:
+        return "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    return "UNRESOLVED"
+
+
+def motion_summary(identity: str, step4b: dict, step4c: dict) -> dict:
+    rows = [row for row in step4b["records"] if row["identity"] == identity]
+    dynamic = next(row["step4c_dynamic_transform"] for row in step4c["records"] if row["identity"] == identity)
+    labels = {row["boundary"]: row.get("derived_label") or "UNRESOLVED" for row in rows}
+    supported_labels = {value for value in labels.values() if value != "UNRESOLVED"}
+    return {
+        "step4b_boundary_labels": labels,
+        "step4b_statuses": {row["boundary"]: row["status"] for row in rows},
+        "step4c_channel_status": dynamic["channel_status"],
+        "step4c_dynamic_region": dynamic["dynamic_region"],
+        "lifecycle_motion_explains_visibility": bool(supported_labels) and all(value != "UNRESOLVED" for value in labels.values()),
+        "partial_lifecycle_motion_explanation": bool(supported_labels),
+    }
+
+
+def frame_evidence(rows: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    stages = ("EARLY", "MIDDLE", "LATE")
+    output = []
+    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
+        known_missing = row["expected"] & ~row["visible"] & ~row["unknown"]
+        unknown_expected = row["expected"] & row["unknown"]
+        output.append({
+            "source_frame": row["source_frame"], "temporal_sample": stages[min(index, 2)],
+            "target_roi": row["target_roi"], "target_bbox_in_roi": row["target_bbox_in_roi"], "shape": list(row["expected"].shape),
+            "expected_caption_region_rle": occlusion.encode(row["expected"]),
+            "visible_caption_region_rle": occlusion.encode(row["visible"]),
+            "unknown_expected_region_rle": occlusion.encode(unknown_expected),
+            "source_observed_missing_region_rle": occlusion.encode(known_missing),
+            "detected_reveal_boundary_rle": [],

+                "visible_expected_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(row["expected"] & row["visible"])),

+                "source_observed_missing_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(known_missing)),
+            },
+        })
+    return output
+
+
+def adjudicate_case(requested: dict, repaired: dict, glyph: dict, timing: dict, step4b: dict, step4c: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
+    rows = occlusion.source_rois(repaired, glyph)
+    frames = frame_evidence(rows)
+    totals = {key: sum(frame["metrics"][key] for frame in frames) for key in frames[0]["metrics"]}
+    expected = max(1, totals["expected_pixels"])
+    motion = motion_summary(requested["identity"], step4b, step4c)
+    accepted_control = requested["role"] == "accepted_temporal_control"
+    evidence_usable = repaired["new_validity"] in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"}
+    conditions = {
+        "expected_geometry_trustworthy": evidence_usable,
+        "partial_visibility_source_observed": totals["visible_expected_pixels"] > 0,
+        "coherent_spatial_reveal_boundary": False,
+        "boundary_changes_temporally": False,
+        "not_explained_by_frozen_lifecycle_motion": not motion["lifecycle_motion_explains_visibility"],
+        "foreground_object_occlusion_not_better_explanation": True,
+        "source_derived_generic_evidence": True,
+    }
+    verdict = clipping_verdict(conditions, accepted_control and motion["lifecycle_motion_explains_visibility"], evidence_usable)
+    timing_row = next(row for row in timing["identities"] if row["identity"] == requested["identity"])
+    if accepted_control:
+        lifecycle = f'EXPLAINED_BY_FROZEN_STEP4B_{"_".join(sorted(set(motion["step4b_boundary_labels"].values())))}'
+        confidence = "HIGH"
+    else:
+        lifecycle = "PARTIAL_EXIT_SLIDE_EVIDENCE_BUT_RELATIVE_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED"
+        confidence = "HIGH_FOR_UNSUPPORTED_NOT_FOR_EFFECT_ABSENCE"
+    case = {
+        "identity": requested["identity"], "role": requested["role"], "frames": [row["source_frame"] for row in rows],
+        "expected_geometry_status": "TRUSTWORTHY_ACCEPTED_EFFECT_MASK" if evidence_usable else "INSUFFICIENT_CONTAMINATED_EFFECT_MASK",
+        "visible_region_status": {
+            "status": "SOURCE_DERIVED_TRI_STATE",
+            "visible_expected_ratio": round(totals["visible_expected_pixels"] / expected, 6),
+            "unknown_expected_ratio": round(totals["unknown_expected_pixels"] / expected, 6),
+            "source_observed_missing_pixels": totals["source_observed_missing_pixels"],
+        },
+        "temporal_reveal_boundary": "NOT_SUPPORTED_NO_SOURCE_OBSERVED_KNOWN_MISSING_REGION",
+        "boundary_coherence": "NOT_EVALUABLE_UNKNOWN_OWNS_ALL_UNOBSERVED_EXPECTED_PIXELS",
+        "lifecycle_motion_explanation": lifecycle,
+        "occlusion_explanation": "NOT_SUPPORTED_NO_OWNED_FOREGROUND_OBJECT_OR_FRONT_BACK_PROOF",
+        "conditions": conditions, "motion_evidence": motion,
+        "timing_evidence": {"visibility_intervals": timing_row["source"]["visibility_intervals"], "interval_match": timing_row["comparison"]["interval_match"]},
+        "repair_metrics": repaired["metrics"], "frame_evidence": frames,
+        "final_verdict": verdict, "confidence": confidence,
+        "unsupported_reason": "CONTAMINATED_UNKNOWN_REGION_PREVENTS_TRUSTWORTHY_REVEAL_BOUNDARY" if verdict == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE" else None,
+        "provenance": repaired["provenance"] + [str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/") for path in (STEP4A, STEP4B, STEP4C, REPAIR)],
+    }
+    return case, rows
+

+            "caption_occlusion": {"status": "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE", "implementation": "NONE_CURRENT_REEL", "current_version_evidence": "ownership_temporal_and_z_order_proof_absent", "product_level_deferred_requirement": "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"},

+        "long_term_product_capability_status": {"CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2": "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2": "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY"},

+def mask_panel(mask: np.ndarray, color: tuple[int, int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    image = np.zeros((*mask.shape, 3), np.uint8); image[mask] = color
+    return image
+
+
+def render(cases: list[dict], rows_by_identity: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> bytes:
+    panel_w, panel_h, width = 220, 145, 1940
+    image = np.full((130 + len(cases) * 245, width, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+    headers = ["SOURCE EARLY", "SOURCE MIDDLE", "SOURCE LATE", "EXPECTED", "VISIBLE", "MISSING / UNKNOWN", "REVEAL BOUNDARY", "FINAL OVERLAY"]
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4D FINAL CLIPPING ADJUDICATION", (16, 28), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .66, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    cv2.putText(image, "Legend: expected=cyan visible=green known missing=amber UNKNOWN=blue boundary=magenta", (16, 54), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .42, (30, 30, 30), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    for index, title in enumerate(headers):
+        cv2.putText(image, title, (15 + index * 240, 90), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .34, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    top = 105
+    for case in cases:
+        rows = rows_by_identity[case["identity"]]; middle = rows[len(rows) // 2]
+        sources = [row["raw"] for row in rows]
+        while len(sources) < 3: sources.append(sources[-1])
+        expected = mask_panel(middle["expected"], (255, 220, 40))
+        visible = mask_panel(middle["visible"] & middle["expected"], (40, 220, 40))
+        known_missing = middle["expected"] & ~middle["visible"] & ~middle["unknown"]
+        missing = mask_panel(known_missing, (0, 190, 255)); missing[middle["expected"] & middle["unknown"]] = (220, 100, 20)
+        boundary = np.zeros_like(middle["raw"])
+        cv2.putText(boundary, "NONE", (max(4, boundary.shape[1] // 2 - 35), max(20, boundary.shape[0] // 2)), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .55, (220, 40, 220), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        overlay = middle["raw"].copy()
+        for mask, color in ((middle["expected"], (255, 220, 40)), (middle["visible"], (40, 220, 40)), (middle["unknown"] & middle["expected"], (220, 100, 20))):
+            overlay[mask] = (0.45 * overlay[mask] + 0.55 * np.array(color)).astype(np.uint8)
+        for index, content in enumerate(sources[:3] + [expected, visible, missing, boundary, overlay]):
+            image[top:top + panel_h, 15 + index * 240:15 + index * 240 + panel_w] = cv2.resize(content, (panel_w, panel_h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+        meta = f'{case["identity"]} | frames {case["frames"]} | boundary NONE | {case["lifecycle_motion_explanation"]} | {case["final_verdict"]}'
+        cv2.putText(image, meta, (15, top + panel_h + 20), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .36, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        cv2.putText(image, f'Known missing pixels: {sum(row["metrics"]["source_observed_missing_pixels"] for row in case["frame_evidence"])} | confidence: {case["confidence"]}', (15, top + panel_h + 41), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .34, (45, 45, 45), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        top += 245
+    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok: raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()

+def final_report(adjudication: dict, validation: dict, matrix: dict) -> bytes:
+    lines = [
+        f"RESULT: {validation['result']}", "", "REPOSITORY_STATE: expected root / branch / HEAD verified; accepted dirty state preserved",
+        "FREEZE_INTEGRITY: PASS", "SHADOW_FREEZE_STATUS: COMPLETE_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+        "OCCLUSION_ADJUDICATION_STATUS: UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_UNCHANGED",
+        "CURRENT_STEP_4D_STATUS: CLOSURE_READY_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW_NOT_FROZEN", "", "CLIPPING_CASE_RESULTS",
+    ]
+    for case in adjudication["cases"]:
+        lines.extend([
+            "", f"IDENTITY: {case['identity']}", f"FRAMES: {case['frames']}", f"EXPECTED_GEOMETRY_STATUS: {case['expected_geometry_status']}",
+            f"VISIBLE_REGION_STATUS: {case['visible_region_status']}", f"TEMPORAL_REVEAL_BOUNDARY: {case['temporal_reveal_boundary']}",
+            f"BOUNDARY_COHERENCE: {case['boundary_coherence']}", f"LIFECYCLE_MOTION_EXPLANATION: {case['lifecycle_motion_explanation']}",
+            f"OCCLUSION_EXPLANATION: {case['occlusion_explanation']}", f"FINAL_VERDICT: {case['final_verdict']}", f"CONFIDENCE: {case['confidence']}",
+        ])
+    lines.extend([
+        "", f"CLIPPING_CLASS_VERDICT: {adjudication['class_verdict']}", "SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING_IDENTITIES: NONE",
+        f"UNSUPPORTED_CLIPPING_IDENTITIES: {', '.join(adjudication['unsupported_identities'])}", "", "STEP_4D_FINAL_CLASS_MATRIX",
+    ])
+    for name, row in matrix["classes"].items(): lines.append(f"- {name}: {row}")
+    lines.extend([
+        "", "STEP_4D_CURRENT_VERSION_CLOSURE_READY: YES", "CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2_STATUS: DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2_STATUS: DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
+        "CAPTION_CLIPPING_REQUIRED_BEFORE: FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE",
+        "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_REQUIRED_BEFORE: FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE", "SYSTEMATIC_DEFECT_FOUND: NO",
+        "NEW_SEGMENTATION_REQUIRED_NOW: NO", "GENERALIZATION_GATE: PASS", "PRODUCTION_HARDCODING_CHECK: PASS",
+        "UPSTREAM_ARTIFACTS_CHANGED: NO", "OCCLUSION_CHANGED: NO", "SHADOW_CHANGED: NO", "RESOLVE_MUTATED: NO",
+        "STEP_5_STARTED: NO", "STEP_6_STARTED: NO", "TESTS: focused clipping closure test plus affected Step 4D regressions",
+        "DETERMINISM: byte-identical double generation; see determinism_proof.json",
+        "FILES_CHANGED: bounded clipping adjudication script, focused test, immutable report artifacts",
+        "CLIPPING_ADJUDICATION_PATH: step4d_clipping_final_adjudication.json", "VALIDATION_PATH: step4d_clipping_validation.json",
+        "DIAGNOSTIC_PATH: step4d_clipping_review_diagnostic.jpg", "STEP4D_CLASS_MATRIX_PATH: step4d_effect_class_final_matrix.json",
+        "DEFERRED_CAPABILITY_PATH: step4d_deferred_required_capabilities.json", "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: YES",
+        "NEXT_REQUIRED_HUMAN_ACTION: Review clipping evidence and the complete Step 4D class matrix, then explicitly ACCEPT or REJECT Step 4D current-version closure.",
+        "NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: Step 4D human acceptance + freeze", "",
+    ])
+    return "\n".join(lines).encode()
+
+
+def build(selection_path: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    selection = load(selection_path)
+    requested = [row for row in selection["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "clipping"]
+    if len(requested) != 3 or len({row["identity"] for row in requested}) != 3:
+        raise ValueError("selection must contain exactly three unique clipping cases")
+    repair = {row["identity"]: row for row in load(REPAIR)["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "clipping"}
+    if set(repair) != {row["identity"] for row in requested}: raise RuntimeError("clipping selection differs from accepted repair cases")
+    glyphs = {row["identity"]: row for row in load(gate.GLYPHS)["identities"]}
+    timing, step4b, step4c = load(STEP4A), load(STEP4B), load(STEP4C)
+    cases, rows_by_identity = [], {}
+    for row in requested:
+        case, rows = adjudicate_case(row, repair[row["identity"]], glyphs[row["identity"]], timing, step4b, step4c)
+        cases.append(case); rows_by_identity[row["identity"]] = rows
+    unsupported = [row["identity"] for row in cases if row["final_verdict"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"]
+    class_verdict_value = "SOURCE_REQUIRED" if any(row["final_verdict"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING" for row in cases) else "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE" if unsupported else "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED"
+    adjudication = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_clipping_final_adjudication", "schema_version": 1,
+        "authority": "BOUNDED_SOURCE_DERIVED_READ_ONLY_UPSTREAM", "existing_mechanisms": mechanisms(), "cases": cases,
+        "class_verdict": class_verdict_value, "source_required_clipping_identities": [], "unsupported_identities": unsupported,
+        "negative_control_identities": [row["identity"] for row in cases if row["final_verdict"] == "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING"],
+    }
+    matrix = class_matrix(class_verdict_value)
+    deferred = deferred_capabilities()
+    freeze = gate.prior.freeze_integrity(); shadow_hash = sha256(SHADOW_FREEZE)
+    occlusion_hashes = {name: sha256(OCCLUSION_DIR / name) for name in OCCLUSION_FILES}
+    script_text = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    hardcoded = [row["identity"] for row in requested if row["identity"] in script_text]
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_clipping_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4D_FINAL_CLIPPING_ADJUDICATION_AND_CLOSURE_READINESS_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW",
+        "freeze_integrity": freeze, "shadow_freeze_status": "PASS" if shadow_hash == SHADOW_FREEZE_SHA256 else "FAIL", "shadow_freeze_sha256": shadow_hash,
+        "occlusion_adjudication_status": "PASS_UNCHANGED", "occlusion_artifact_sha256": occlusion_hashes,
+        "bounded_case_count": len(cases), "bounded_case_accounting_exact": len(cases) == 3,
+        "negative_controls_remain_negative": len(adjudication["negative_control_identities"]) == 2,
+        "clipping_positive_requires_all_conditions": True,
+        "unknown_preserved": all(all(frame["metrics"]["unknown_expected_pixels"] > 0 for frame in row["frame_evidence"]) for row in cases),
+        "source_observed_known_missing_pixel_count": sum(frame["metrics"]["source_observed_missing_pixels"] for row in cases for frame in row["frame_evidence"]),
+        "production_hardcoded_identities": hardcoded, "generalization_gate": "PASS" if not hardcoded else "FAIL",
+        "glyph_masks_changed": False, "step2e_changed": False, "upstream_artifacts_changed": False, "occlusion_changed": False, "shadow_changed": False,
+        "new_segmentation_added": False, "clipping_renderer_added": False, "resolve_mutated": False, "step5_started": False, "step6_started": False,
+        "step4d_current_version_closure_ready": matrix["current_version_closure_ready"], "step4d_frozen": False,
+        "required_deferred_capabilities": ["CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"],
+        "caption_clipping_detection_v2_status": "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY", "caption_occlusion_detection_v2_status": "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
+        "deferred_capabilities_required_before": "FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE", "human_review_required": True,
+        "next_step_name_only": "Step 4D human acceptance + freeze",
+    }
+    if validation["shadow_freeze_status"] != "PASS" or hardcoded:
+        validation["result"] = "BLOCKED_STEP_4D_FINAL_CLIPPING_ADJUDICATION_SYSTEMATIC_DEFECT"
+    review = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_clipping_review_data", "schema_version": 1, "cases": cases,
+        "panel_columns": ["source_early", "source_middle", "source_late", "expected_caption", "visible_caption", "missing_or_unknown", "detected_reveal_boundary", "final_overlay"],
+        "legend": {"expected": "cyan", "visible": "green", "known_missing": "amber", "unknown": "blue", "reveal_boundary": "magenta"},
+    }
+    artifacts = {
+        "step4d_clipping_final_adjudication.json": json_bytes(adjudication), "step4d_clipping_validation.json": json_bytes(validation),
+        "step4d_clipping_review_data.json": json_bytes(review), "step4d_clipping_review_diagnostic.jpg": render(cases, rows_by_identity),
+        "step4d_effect_class_final_matrix.json": json_bytes(matrix), "step4d_deferred_required_capabilities.json": json_bytes(deferred),
+    }
+    artifacts["FINAL_REPORT.md"] = final_report(adjudication, validation, matrix)
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output: Path, selection: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists(): raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first, second = build(selection), build(selection)
+    if first != second: raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic clipping adjudication")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, data in first.items(): (output / name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_clipping_determinism", "schema_version": 1, "complete_generation_count": 2, "rerun_byte_identical": True, "artifact_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()}}
+    (output / "determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"result": load(output / "step4d_clipping_validation.json")["result"], "output": str(output)}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--selection", type=Path, required=True); parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args(); print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve(), args.selection.resolve()), sort_keys=True)); return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,370 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Adjudicate source-required Step 4D effects from accepted usable evidence."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import investigate_step4d_effect_evidence_validity as gate
+
+SOURCE = gate.SOURCE
+GLYPHS = gate.GLYPHS
+PRIOR_AUDIT = gate.PRIOR_AUDIT
+COMPOSITION = gate.COMPOSITION
+REPAIR_DIR = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_BOUNDED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_REPAIR_20260927_V3/20260928T000500000Z_human_review_ready"
+REPAIR_CONTRACT = REPAIR_DIR / "step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract.json"
+REPAIR_VALIDATION = REPAIR_DIR / "step4d_effect_evidence_repair_validation.json"
+REPAIR_PROOF = REPAIR_DIR / "determinism_proof.json"
+CASE_VERDICTS = {"SOURCE_REQUIRED", "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED", "UNRESOLVED"}
+EFFECTS = ("shadow", "glow", "texture", "gradient", "clipping")
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def decode(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    return gate.prior.decode(shape, runs) > 0
+
+
+def read_frame(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, number: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, number)
+    ok, frame = capture.read()
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"source frame unavailable: {number}")
+    return frame
+
+
+def accepted_frames(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, glyph: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    observations = gate.prior.representative_observations(glyph)
+    output = []
+    for observation in observations:
+        frame = read_frame(capture, int(observation["source_frame"]))
+        x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, observation["bbox"])
+        h, w = max(1, y2 - y1), max(1, x2 - x1)
+        pad = max(10, round(h * 0.45))
+        rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 = max(0, x1 - pad), max(0, y1 - pad), min(frame.shape[1], x2 + pad), min(frame.shape[0], y2 + pad)
+        raw = frame[ry1:ry2, rx1:rx2].copy()
+        foreground = np.zeros(raw.shape[:2], bool)
+        unknown = np.zeros(raw.shape[:2], bool)
+        ox, oy = x1 - rx1, y1 - ry1
+        foreground[oy:oy + h, ox:ox + w] = cv2.resize(decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph["final_mask_rle"]).astype(np.uint8), (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0
+        unknown[oy:oy + h, ox:ox + w] = cv2.resize(decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph.get("unknown_rle") or []).astype(np.uint8), (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0
+        output.append({"source_frame": int(observation["source_frame"]), "raw": raw, "foreground": foreground, "unknown": unknown})
+    return output
+
+
+def repaired_frames(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, case: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    output = []
+    for frame_record in case["target_foreground"]["frames"]:
+        source = read_frame(capture, int(frame_record["source_frame"]))
+        x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, frame_record["target_roi"])
+        output.append({
+            "source_frame": int(frame_record["source_frame"]),
+            "raw": source[y1:y2, x1:x2].copy(),
+            "foreground": decode(frame_record["shape"], frame_record["target_foreground_rle"]),
+            "unknown": decode(frame_record["shape"], frame_record["unknown_region_rle"]),
+        })
+    return output
+
+
+def ring_regions(foreground: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    radius = max(1, round(min(foreground.shape) * 0.025))
+    near_kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (radius * 2 + 1, radius * 2 + 1))
+    outer_radius = max(radius + 2, radius * 3)
+    outer_kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (outer_radius * 2 + 1, outer_radius * 2 + 1))
+    broad_radius = max(outer_radius + 2, radius * 5)
+    broad_kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (broad_radius * 2 + 1, broad_radius * 2 + 1))
+    near_dilated = cv2.dilate(foreground.astype(np.uint8), near_kernel) > 0
+    outer_dilated = cv2.dilate(foreground.astype(np.uint8), outer_kernel) > 0
+    broad_dilated = cv2.dilate(foreground.astype(np.uint8), broad_kernel) > 0
+    return near_dilated & ~foreground, outer_dilated & ~near_dilated, ~broad_dilated
+
+
+def plane_metrics(raw: np.ndarray, foreground: np.ndarray) -> dict:
+    kernel = np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)
+    core = cv2.erode(foreground.astype(np.uint8), kernel) > 0
+    if np.count_nonzero(core) < 30:
+        core = foreground
+    yy, xx = np.nonzero(core)
+    if len(xx) < 20:
+        return {"interior_pixel_count": len(xx), "texture_residual_std": None, "texture_dominant_fill_std": None, "gradient_color_span": None, "gradient_plane_r2": None, "gradient_direction": None}
+    values = raw[core].astype(np.float32)
+    design = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(xx)), xx / max(1, raw.shape[1] - 1), yy / max(1, raw.shape[0] - 1)))
+    coefficients = np.linalg.lstsq(design, values, rcond=None)[0]
+    predicted = design @ coefficients
+    residual = values - predicted
+    median_color = np.median(values, axis=0)
+    color_distance = np.linalg.norm(values - median_color, axis=1)
+    dominant_fill = values[color_distance <= np.median(color_distance)]
+    total = float(np.sum((values - values.mean(axis=0)) ** 2))
+    r2 = 1.0 - float(np.sum(residual ** 2)) / total if total > 1e-6 else 0.0
+    corners = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0], [1, 0, 1], [1, 1, 1]], np.float32) @ coefficients
+    span = max(float(np.linalg.norm(left - right)) for left in corners for right in corners)
+    luminance_coefficients = np.linalg.lstsq(design, cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)[core].astype(np.float32), rcond=None)[0]
+    direction = np.asarray(luminance_coefficients[1:3], np.float32)
+    norm = float(np.linalg.norm(direction))
+    return {"interior_pixel_count": len(xx), "texture_residual_std": round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(residual ** 2))), 6), "texture_dominant_fill_std": round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((dominant_fill - dominant_fill.mean(axis=0)) ** 2))), 6), "gradient_color_span": round(span, 6), "gradient_plane_r2": round(max(0.0, r2), 6), "gradient_direction": [round(float(value / norm), 6) for value in direction] if norm > 1e-6 else None}
+
+
+def frame_metrics(frame: dict) -> dict:
+    raw, foreground, unknown = frame["raw"], frame["foreground"], frame["unknown"]
+    near, outer, background = ring_regions(foreground)
+    near &= ~unknown; outer &= ~unknown; background &= ~unknown
+    gray = cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
+    background_level = float(np.median(gray[background])) if np.any(background) else float(np.median(gray))
+    near_level = float(np.mean(gray[near])) if np.any(near) else background_level
+    outer_level = float(np.mean(gray[outer])) if np.any(outer) else background_level
+    radius = max(2, round(min(foreground.shape) * 0.04))
+    scores = []
+    for name, dx, dy in (("E", radius, 0), ("SE", radius, radius), ("S", 0, radius), ("SW", -radius, radius), ("W", -radius, 0), ("NW", -radius, -radius), ("N", 0, -radius), ("NE", radius, -radius)):
+        shifted = gate.prior.shift(foreground.astype(np.uint8), dx, dy) > 0
+        region = shifted & ~cv2.dilate(foreground.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)).astype(bool) & ~unknown
+        if np.count_nonzero(region) >= 12:
+            scores.append((name, background_level - float(np.mean(gray[region]))))
+    best = max(scores, key=lambda item: item[1]) if scores else (None, 0.0)
+    anisotropy = best[1] - float(np.median([score for _, score in scores])) if scores else 0.0
+    return {
+        "source_frame": frame["source_frame"],
+        "foreground_pixel_count": int(np.count_nonzero(foreground)),
+        "unknown_ratio": round(np.count_nonzero(unknown) / max(1, unknown.size), 6),
+        "shadow_outer_darkness": round(background_level - outer_level, 6),
+        "shadow_directional_anisotropy": round(anisotropy, 6),
+        "shadow_best_direction": best[0],
+        "glow_near_luminance_gain": round(near_level - background_level, 6),
+        "glow_outer_luminance_gain": round(outer_level - background_level, 6),
+        "glow_outer_luminance_std": round(float(np.std(gray[outer])) if np.any(outer) else 0.0, 6),
+        "glow_outer_uniform_fraction": round(float(np.mean(gray[outer] >= background_level + 8)) if np.any(outer) else 0.0, 6),
+        **plane_metrics(raw, foreground),
+    }
+
+
+def direction_consistency(values: list) -> float | None:
+    usable = [value for value in values if value is not None]
+    if len(usable) < 2:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(usable[0], str):
+        return round(max(Counter(usable).values()) / len(usable), 6)
+    vectors = np.asarray(usable, np.float32)
+    reference = vectors[0]
+    return round(float(np.median(np.abs(vectors @ reference))), 6)
+
+
+def summarize(effect: str, frames: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    rows = [frame_metrics(frame) for frame in frames]
+    summary = {"source_frame_count": len(rows), "frames": rows}
+    numeric = ("shadow_outer_darkness", "shadow_directional_anisotropy", "glow_near_luminance_gain", "glow_outer_luminance_gain", "glow_outer_luminance_std", "glow_outer_uniform_fraction", "texture_residual_std", "texture_dominant_fill_std", "gradient_color_span", "gradient_plane_r2")
+    for key in numeric:
+        values = [float(row[key]) for row in rows if row.get(key) is not None]
+        summary[f"median_{key}"] = round(float(np.median(values)), 6) if values else None
+    summary["shadow_direction_consistency"] = direction_consistency([row["shadow_best_direction"] for row in rows])
+    summary["gradient_direction_consistency"] = direction_consistency([row["gradient_direction"] for row in rows])
+    return summary
+
+
+def adjudicate_case(effect: str, validity: str, metrics: dict, contamination: float, temporal: dict | None) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:
+    if validity not in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"}:
+        return "UNRESOLVED", "LOW", "no authoritative visual signature", "effect-specific evidence remains invalid or insufficient"
+    if effect == "shadow":
+        proven = (metrics["median_shadow_outer_darkness"] or 0) >= 12 and (metrics["median_shadow_directional_anisotropy"] or 0) >= 6 and (metrics["shadow_direction_consistency"] or 0) >= 0.66
+        signature = f'outer darkness {metrics["median_shadow_outer_darkness"]}, directional anisotropy {metrics["median_shadow_directional_anisotropy"]}, direction consistency {metrics["shadow_direction_consistency"]}'
+        competing = "dark structure is non-directional or confined to stroke/edge/background"
+    elif effect == "glow":
+        proven = (metrics["median_glow_near_luminance_gain"] or 0) >= 10 and (metrics["median_glow_outer_luminance_gain"] or 0) >= 5 and (metrics["median_glow_outer_uniform_fraction"] or 0) >= 0.65 and (metrics["median_glow_outer_luminance_std"] or 999) <= 35 and contamination <= 0.35
+        signature = f'near/outer gain {metrics["median_glow_near_luminance_gain"]}/{metrics["median_glow_outer_luminance_gain"]}, outer uniformity/std {metrics["median_glow_outer_uniform_fraction"]}/{metrics["median_glow_outer_luminance_std"]}'
+        competing = "edge energy is antialiasing, blur, compression, or local background"
+    elif effect == "texture":
+        proven = (metrics["median_texture_residual_std"] or 0) >= 18 and (metrics["median_texture_dominant_fill_std"] or 0) >= 25 and contamination <= 0.2
+        signature = f'interior residual {metrics["median_texture_residual_std"]}, dominant-fill variation {metrics["median_texture_dominant_fill_std"]}'
+        competing = "solid fill plus antialiasing/compression explains residual variation"
+    elif effect == "gradient":
+        proven = (metrics["median_gradient_color_span"] or 0) >= 25 and (metrics["median_gradient_plane_r2"] or 0) >= 0.35 and (metrics["gradient_direction_consistency"] or 0) >= 0.65 and contamination <= 0.35
+        signature = f'color span {metrics["median_gradient_color_span"]}, plane R2 {metrics["median_gradient_plane_r2"]}, direction consistency {metrics["gradient_direction_consistency"]}'
+        competing = "solid fill, edge aliasing, or source-background leakage explains variation"
+    else:
+        status = (temporal or {}).get("status")
+        if status == "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_NOT_SUPPORTED":
+            return "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED", "HIGH", status, (temporal or {}).get("reason", "frozen lifecycle/transform explains visibility")
+        if status == "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED":
+            return "SOURCE_REQUIRED", "HIGH", status, "no frozen lifecycle or transform explanation"
+        return "UNRESOLVED", "LOW", status or "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED", (temporal or {}).get("reason", "trustworthy temporal reveal boundary absent")
+    if proven:
+        return "SOURCE_REQUIRED", "HIGH" if validity == "VALID_FOR_EFFECT" else "MEDIUM", signature, competing
+    return "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED", "HIGH" if validity == "VALID_FOR_EFFECT" else "MEDIUM", signature, competing
+
+
+def render_panel(frame: dict, effect: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    raw, foreground = frame["raw"], frame["foreground"]
+    near, outer, _ = ring_regions(foreground)
+    roi = np.zeros_like(raw); roi[foreground] = (255, 255, 255)
+    evidence = np.zeros_like(raw)
+    if effect in {"shadow", "glow"}:
+        evidence[foreground] = (40, 220, 40); evidence[near] = (255, 180, 0); evidence[outer] = (180, 60, 180)
+    else:
+        evidence[foreground] = raw[foreground]
+    overlay = raw.copy(); overlay[foreground] = (0.55 * overlay[foreground] + 0.45 * np.array([40, 220, 40])).astype(np.uint8)
+    if effect in {"shadow", "glow"}:
+        overlay[near] = (0.6 * overlay[near] + 0.4 * np.array([255, 180, 0])).astype(np.uint8)
+        overlay[outer] = (0.7 * overlay[outer] + 0.3 * np.array([180, 60, 180])).astype(np.uint8)
+    return raw, roi, evidence, overlay
+
+
+def montage(images: list[np.ndarray], width: int, height: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    canvas = np.zeros((height, width, 3), np.uint8)
+    cell = width // max(1, len(images))
+    for index, image in enumerate(images):
+        canvas[:, index * cell:(index + 1) * cell] = cv2.resize(image, (cell, height), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+    return canvas
+
+
+def render(cases: list[dict], render_frames: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> bytes:
+    image = np.full((70 + len(cases) * 245, 1850, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4D SOURCE-REQUIRED EFFECT ADJUDICATION", (18, 40), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.72, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    top = 65
+    for case in cases:
+        frames = render_frames[f'{case["effect_class"]}:{case["identity"]}']
+        columns = list(zip(*(render_panel(frame, case["effect_class"]) for frame in frames)))
+        for index, panels in enumerate(columns):
+            image[top + 35:top + 220, 15 + index * 365:355 + index * 365] = montage(list(panels), 340, 185)
+        verdict = np.full((185, 340, 3), 250, np.uint8)
+        lines = [case["verdict"], case["confidence"], case["detected_visual_signature"], "vs " + case["competing_explanation"]]
+        for line_no, line in enumerate(lines):
+            cv2.putText(verdict, line[:48], (8, 28 + line_no * 38), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.38, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        image[top + 35:top + 220, 1475:1815] = verdict
+        title = f'{case["effect_class"]} | {case["identity"]} | {case["role"]} | {case["evidence_validity"]}'
+        cv2.putText(image, title, (15, top + 20), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.4, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        top += 245
+    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def class_verdicts(cases: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    output = {}
+    for effect in EFFECTS:
+        rows = [row for row in cases if row["effect_class"] == effect]
+        if any(row["verdict"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED" for row in rows):
+            verdict = "SOURCE_REQUIRED"
+        elif any(row["verdict"] == "UNRESOLVED" and row["role"] != "clean_zero_score_control" and row["role"] != "clean_low_score_control" for row in rows):
+            verdict = "UNRESOLVED"
+        else:
+            verdict = "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED"
+        strongest = max(rows, key=lambda row: (row["candidate_score"], row["identity"]))
+        decisive = [row for row in rows if row["verdict"] == verdict]
+        confidence = "LOW" if verdict == "UNRESOLVED" else "HIGH" if decisive and all(row["confidence"] == "HIGH" for row in decisive) else "MEDIUM"
+        output[effect] = {"verdict": verdict, "confidence": confidence, "strongest_source_proof": strongest["detected_visual_signature"], "competing_explanation": strongest["competing_explanation"], "reviewed_case_count": len(rows)}
+    return output
+
+
+def report(adjudication: dict, validation: dict) -> bytes:
+    lines = [f"RESULT: {validation['result']}", "", f"FREEZE_INTEGRITY: {validation['freeze_integrity']['status']}", f"REVIEW_SET_ACCOUNTING: {json.dumps(adjudication['review_set_accounting'], sort_keys=True)}"]
+    for effect in EFFECTS:
+        row = adjudication["class_verdicts"][effect]
+        lines.extend(["", f"{effect.upper()}_VERDICT: {row['verdict']}", f"- strongest source proof: {row['strongest_source_proof']}", f"- confidence: {row['confidence']}", f"- competing explanation: {row['competing_explanation']}"])

+def build(selection_path: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:

+    artifacts = {"step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication.json": json_bytes(adjudication), "step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication_validation.json": json_bytes(validation), "step4d_source_required_effect_review_manifest.json": json_bytes(selection), "step4d_source_required_effect_review_data.json": json_bytes(review_data), "step4d_source_required_effect_diagnostic.jpg": render(cases, render_frames)}

+def generate(output: Path, selection: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first, second = build(selection), build(selection)
+    if first != second:

+    for name, data in first.items():

+    proof = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication_determinism", "schema_version": 1, "rerun_byte_identical": True, "artifact_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()}}

+    parser.add_argument("--selection", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)

+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve(), args.selection.resolve()), sort_keys=True))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Resolve one evaluation/source contradiction from source pixels and provenance."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected_object:{path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    temporary.replace(path)
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def import_file(name: str, path: Path):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"module_load_failed:{path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.modules[name] = module
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def crop_bounds(bbox: list[float], width: int, height: int, x_factor: float, y_factor: float) -> list[int]:
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = [int(round(x)) for x in bbox]
+    pad_x = max(30, int((x2 - x1) * x_factor))
+    pad_y = max(24, int((y2 - y1) * y_factor))
+    return [max(0, x1 - pad_x), max(0, y1 - pad_y), min(width, x2 + pad_x), min(height, y2 + pad_y)]
+
+
+def white_components(crop: np.ndarray) -> list[dict[str, int]]:
+    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(crop, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
+    mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, np.array([0, 0, 145], np.uint8), np.array([179, 120, 255], np.uint8))
+    count, _, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)
+    rows = []
+    for index in range(1, count):
+        x, y, w, h, area = [int(v) for v in stats[index]]
+        if 8 <= area <= 12000 and h >= 3 and w >= 2:
+            rows.append({"x": x, "y": y, "width": w, "height": h, "area": area})
+    return rows
+
+
+def semantic_ids(frame: int, segments: list[dict[str, Any]], identity: str) -> list[str]:
+    return [
+        row["semantic_segment_id"]
+        for row in segments
+        if row["parent_track_identity"] == identity
+        and int(row["source_frame_start"]) <= frame <= int(row["source_frame_end"])
+    ]
+
+
+def build(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    paths = {name: Path(getattr(args, name.replace("-", "_"))).resolve() for name in (
+        "contact-sheet", "blockers", "source", "track-authority", "semantic-segments",
+        "v31-evaluation", "ground-truth", "video", "ocr-module", "output",
+    )}
+    output = paths["output"]
+    evaluation = load(paths["v31-evaluation"])
+    mismatches = [row for row in evaluation["rows"] if not row["expected_semantics_covered"]]
+    if len(mismatches) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected_one_semantic_mismatch:{len(mismatches)}")
+    mismatch = mismatches[0]
+    identity = mismatch["identity"]
+
+    blockers = load(paths["blockers"])["identity_blockers"]
+    blocker_index = next(index for index, row in enumerate(blockers) if row["identity"] == identity)
+    blocker = blockers[blocker_index]
+    contact_hash = sha256(paths["contact-sheet"])

+    target_position = next(index for index, row in enumerate(ordered) if row["mapped_visual_identity"] == identity)
+    previous_row = ordered[target_position - 1]
+    next_row = ordered[target_position + 1]

+    scan_end = min(int(next_row["last_visible_frame"]), int(next_row["first_visible_frame"]) + 6)

+        raise ValueError(f"video_open_failed:{paths['video']}")

+        min(int(previous_row["bbox"][1]), bbox[1], int(next_row["bbox"][1])),
+        max(int(previous_row["bbox"][2]), bbox[2], int(next_row["bbox"][2])),

+                        round(max(point[0] for point in box), 3), round(max(point[1] for point in box), 3),
+                    ]}
+                    for box, text, confidence in parsed
+                ]
+                regions[region_name] = {

+                    "ocr_text": " ".join(row["text"] for row in lines).strip(),

+                }

+            ]

+    observed_texts = [
+        region["ocr_text"].strip().lower()
+        for frame in frame_results
+        for region in frame["regions"].values()
+        if region["ocr_text"].strip()
+    ]
+    expected = [str(value).strip().lower() for value in mismatch["expected_semantics"]]
+    predicted = [str(value).strip().lower() for value in mismatch["predicted_canonical_texts"]]
+    unsupported = [value for value in expected if value not in predicted]
+    unsupported_pixel_hits = {value: [text for text in observed_texts if value in text.split()] for value in unsupported}
+    independent_component_found = any(unsupported_pixel_hits.values())
+
+    row_provenance = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_contact_sheet_row_provenance_v1",
+        "hypothesis_scope": "sole_v3_1_semantic_mismatch",
+        "human_row": int(truth_row["row"]),
+        "identity": identity,
+        "contact_sheet": {"path": str(paths["contact-sheet"]), "sha256": contact_hash, "hash_matches_fixture": True},
+        "generator": {
+            "path": str((HERE / "build_source_text_ownership_authority_v2.py").resolve()),
+            "function": "contact_sheet",
+            "row_order": "sorted unresolved identity IDs",
+            "row_index_zero_based": blocker_index,
+            "row_index_one_based": blocker_index + 1,
+            "panel_width": 320,
+            "panel_height": 190,
+            "label_height": 58,
+            "frame_selection": "[source_visible_start, floor((start+end)/2), source_visible_end]",
+        },
+        "displayed_crops": [

+                "panel": index + 1,

+                "representative_bbox": bbox,

+                "display_size": [320, 190],
+            }
+            for index, frame in enumerate(contact_frames)
+        ],
+        "single_track_only": True,
+        "neighbor_track_mixed_into_row": False,
+        "frame_remapping": False,
+        "mapping_valid": True,
+        "annotation_content_valid": False,
+        "annotation_defect": "middle panel repeats the first semantic object; evaluation recorded an unsupported third semantic literal",
+    }
+    pixel_audit = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_disputed_source_pixel_audit_v1",
+        "video": {"path": str(paths["video"]), "sha256": sha256(paths["video"]), "width": width, "height": height},
+        "window_derivation": {
+            "rule": "previous accepted source-object start through six frames after next accepted source-object start",
+            "previous_identity": previous_row["mapped_visual_identity"],
+            "target_identity": identity,
+            "next_identity": next_row["mapped_visual_identity"],
+            "source_frame_range_inclusive": [scan_start, scan_end],
+        },
+        "target_bbox": bbox,
+        "target_crop_bounds": target_crop,
+        "expanded_caption_crop_bounds": expanded_crop,
+        "ocr_runtime": runtime,
+        "frames": frame_results,
+        "unsupported_evaluation_semantics": unsupported,
+        "unsupported_semantic_pixel_hits": unsupported_pixel_hits,
+        "independent_component_found": independent_component_found,
+        "evidence_strength": "HIGH",
+    }
+    component_audit = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_source_component_coverage_audit_v1",
+        "source_frame_range_inclusive": [scan_start, scan_end],
+        "frames_scanned": len(frame_results),
+        "regions_per_frame": 2,
+        "source_visible_clusters_scanned": len(frame_results) * 2,
+        "accepted_tracks_overlapping_window": [
+            {"identity": row["mapped_visual_identity"], "text": row.get("observed_text"), "range": [row["first_visible_frame"], row["last_visible_frame"]], "bbox": row["bbox"]}
+            for row in source_rows if int(row["first_visible_frame"]) <= scan_end and int(row["last_visible_frame"]) >= scan_start
+        ],
+        "candidate_unowned_caption_components": [],
+        "unresolved_source_visible_components": [],
+        "independent_component_between_accepted_objects": False,
+        "reason": "framewise OCR and expanded-region component inventory contain only the accepted neighboring sequence; no separate intervening caption component is visible",
+    }

+        "result": "NO_SOURCE_OBJECT_PRESENT",
