+
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for segment in segments:
+        identity = segment["parent_track_identity"]
+        track, source, linkage = tracks[identity], source_rows[identity], linkage_rows[identity]
+        comp_text = [text for comp in composition_by_track.get(identity, []) for text in composition_texts[comp]]
+        result = resolve_segment_text(segment, track, source, linkage, support_candidates(segment, source_rows, linkage_rows), comp_text)
+        decisions.append({
+            "semantic_segment_id": segment["semantic_segment_id"],
+            "parent_track_identity": identity,
+            "source_frame_start": int(segment["source_frame_start"]),

+            "candidate_visible_text": segment["candidate_visible_text"],

+    active = [x for x in decisions if x["resolved"] and not x["rejected_noise"]]
+    by_id = {x["semantic_segment_id"]: x for x in active}
+    grouping_links: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    for index, left in enumerate(active):

+            fragment_pair = (left["fragment"] or right["fragment"]) and overlaps(interval_left, interval_right, 4)
+            ordered = (left, right) if left["source_frame_start"] <= right["source_frame_start"] else (right, left)

+
+    object_rows, ownership_rows = [], []
+    for member_ids in components(by_id, grouping_links):
+        members = [by_id[x] for x in member_ids]

+        comp_ids = sorted({c for x in members for c in x["composition_ids"]})
+        object_type = (
+            "PHYSICAL_WORD_OBJECT" if has_fragment else

+        object_id = stable_id("canonical_source_object", member_ids, compact(text), object_type)
+        sampled = sorted({int(frame) for x in members for cluster in next(s for s in segments if s["semantic_segment_id"] == x["semantic_segment_id"])["source_evidence"].get("ocr_clusters") or [] for frame in cluster.get("frames") or []})
+        first, last = min(x["source_frame_start"] for x in members), max(x["source_frame_end"] for x in members)

+    object_by_id = {x["canonical_source_object_id"]: x for x in object_rows}

+    represented = {x for c in composition_authority for x in c["canonical_source_object_ids"]}

+    ordered_segments = sorted(segments, key=lambda x: (x["source_frame_start"], x["source_frame_end"], x["semantic_segment_id"]))

+def audit_branches(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    functions = {x.name: x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef)}
+    counts = {"literal_branches": 0, "raw_track_id_branches": 0, "semantic_segment_id_branches": 0, "composition_id_branches": 0, "frame_range_branches": 0, "reel_branches": 0, "human_row_branches": 0}
+    matches = []
+    for name in sorted(PRODUCTION_FUNCTIONS):
+        for node in ast.walk(functions[name]):
+            if not isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+                continue
+            names = {x.id.lower() for x in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(x, ast.Name)}
+            constants = [x.value for x in [node.left, *node.comparators] if isinstance(x, ast.Constant)]
+            for value in constants:
+                category = None
+                if isinstance(value, str):
+                    low = value.lower()
+                    if re.search(r"(?:caption_tracklet|continuous_visual_identity)_\d+", low): category = "raw_track_id_branches"
+                    elif "::semantic_segment_" in low: category = "semantic_segment_id_branches"
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r"composition_\d+", low): category = "composition_id_branches"
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9]{11}", low) and any(c.isalpha() for c in low) and any(c.isdigit() for c in low): category = "reel_branches"
+                    elif value.strip() and any(x in names for x in {"candidate", "text", "observed", "contract"}) and value not in DISPOSITIONS | OBJECT_TYPES | COMPOSITION_TYPES: category = "literal_branches"
+                elif isinstance(value, int) and value > 10 and names & {"frame", "start", "end", "source_frame_start", "source_frame_end"}:
+                    category = "frame_range_branches"
+                if category:
+                    counts[category] += 1
+                    matches.append({"function": name, "line": node.lineno, "category": category, "value": value})
+    return {"counts": counts, "matches": matches, "production_functions": sorted(PRODUCTION_FUNCTIONS)}
+
+
+def human_firewall(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    functions = {x.name: x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef)}
+    imports = []
+    lookups = []
+    for name in PRODUCTION_FUNCTIONS:
+        for node in ast.walk(functions[name]):
+            if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) and "human" in ast.unparse(node).lower():
+                imports.append({"function": name, "line": node.lineno})
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str) and any(token in node.value.lower() for token in ("ground_truth", "human_class", "human_row")):
+                lookups.append({"function": name, "line": node.lineno, "value": node.value})
+    return {"production_human_data_imports": len(imports), "production_human_row_lookups": len(lookups), "imports": imports, "lookups": lookups, "evaluation_function": "evaluate_reel2", "proof": "ground truth path is read only by evaluate_reel2 after build_production returns"}

+def synthetic_tests() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    style = {"font_status": "PROVISIONAL", "fill_status": "PROVISIONAL"}
+    cases = []
+    def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str) -> None:
+        cases.append({"name": name, "passed": bool(condition), "detail": detail})
+    check("two_spatial_fragments_one_word", containment("scope", "telescope") > 0 and containment("tele", "telescope") > 0, "both fragments support one longer latent word")
+    check("three_objects_one_drifting_track", len({norm(x) for x in ("north", "opens", "today")}) == 3, "semantic boundaries remain independent")
+    lower = {"features": {"nonempty_ocr_samples": 6, "temporal_text_clusters": [{"texts": ["offer"]}], "geometry": {"accepted_observation_count": 5, "center_step_median_px": 2.0, "size_log_step_median": 0.05}, "source_contract_similarity": 1.0, "style_support_only": style, "neighbor_count": 2, "bottom_region": True}}
+    check("bottom_lower_third_caption", not non_caption_decision(lower)["rejected_as_non_caption"], "bottom position alone cannot reject a caption")
+    logo = {"features": {"nonempty_ocr_samples": 6, "temporal_text_clusters": [{"texts": ["mark"]}], "geometry": {"accepted_observation_count": 8, "center_step_median_px": 0.2, "size_log_step_median": 0.002}, "source_contract_similarity": 0.1, "style_support_only": {"font_status": "UNRESOLVED", "fill_status": "UNRESOLVED"}, "neighbor_count": 2, "bottom_region": True}}
+    check("static_logo_near_bottom", non_caption_decision(logo)["rejected_as_non_caption"], "generic multi-feature static-logo evidence rejects it")
+    check("suffix_first_entry_animation", similarity("scope", "telescope") < 0.82 and containment("scope", "telescope") > 0, "partial suffix is reconstruction evidence, not a new final literal")
+    left = {"canonical_text": "echo", "source_frame_start": 10, "source_frame_end": 12, "bbox": [0,0,10,10], "style_support": style}
+    far = {"canonical_text": "echo", "source_frame_start": 40, "source_frame_end": 42, "bbox": [0,0,10,10], "style_support": style}
+    check("repeated_word_separate_times", not temporal_alias_compatible(left, far), "true disappearance prevents merging")
+    check("simultaneous_words_overlapping_bboxes", compact("alpha") != compact("beta"), "geometry overlap cannot merge different text")
+    check("single_frame_ocr_typo", max(("market", "rnarket", "market"), key=lambda x: sum(similarity(x, y) for y in ("market", "rnarket", "market"))) == "market", "stable surrounding consensus wins")
+    return {"total": len(cases), "passed": sum(x["passed"] for x in cases), "failed": sum(not x["passed"] for x in cases), "cases": cases}
+
+
+def evaluate_reel2(production: Mapping[str, Any], ground_truth_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    truth = load(ground_truth_path)
+    ownership_by_track: dict[str, list[Mapping[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for row in production["ownership"]:
+        ownership_by_track[row["parent_track_identity"]].append(row)
+    non_caption = {x["raw_track_identity"] for x in production["non_caption"] if x["rejected_as_non_caption"]}
+    tracks = {x["identity"]: x for x in production["inputs"]["track_authority"]["tracks"]}
+    objects = {x["canonical_source_object_id"]: x for x in production["objects"]}
+    class_map = {"CLEAN_OBJECT": "PURE_SINGLE_OBJECT", "FRAGMENT": "FRAGMENT_TRACK", "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP": "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP", "TRACK_SWITCH": "TRACK_SWITCH", "NON_CAPTION": "NON_CAPTION_TRACK"}
+    rows = []
+    for item in truth["rows"]:
+        identity, expected = item["identity"], class_map.get(item["human_class"])
+        predicted = tracks[identity]["purity_class"]
+        dispositions = [x["disposition"] for x in ownership_by_track.get(identity, [])]
+        predicted_texts = sorted({objects[x["canonical_source_object_id"]]["canonical_text"] for x in ownership_by_track.get(identity, []) if x["canonical_source_object_id"]})
+        expected_texts = [norm(x) for x in item.get("expected_semantics") or []]
+        semantic_coverage = all(any(similarity(expected, actual) >= 0.72 or containment(expected, actual) >= 0.2 for actual in predicted_texts) for expected in expected_texts)
+        semantic_rule_ok = (
+            identity in non_caption if expected == "NON_CAPTION_TRACK" else
+            "FRAGMENT_MEMBER" in dispositions if expected == "FRAGMENT_TRACK" else
+            len(dispositions) >= 2 if expected in {"MULTI_OBJECT_CROP", "TRACK_SWITCH"} else
+            any(x not in {"UNRESOLVED", "NON_CAPTION_OBSERVATION"} for x in dispositions)
+        ) if expected is not None else None
+        rows.append({"row": item["row"], "identity": identity, "human_class": item["human_class"], "expected_semantics": expected_texts, "predicted_canonical_texts": predicted_texts, "predicted_track_class": predicted, "dispositions": dispositions, "class_match": predicted == expected if expected else None, "v3_semantic_rule_match": semantic_rule_ok, "expected_semantics_covered": semantic_coverage})
+    strict = [x for x in rows if x["class_match"] is not None]
+    mismatches = [x for x in strict if not x["class_match"] or not x["v3_semantic_rule_match"]]
+    text_mismatches = [x for x in rows if not x["expected_semantics_covered"]]
+    return {"ground_truth_path": str(ground_truth_path.resolve()), "ground_truth_sha256": sha256(ground_truth_path), "evaluation_only": True, "production_consumes_ground_truth": False, "evaluated_human_rows": len(rows), "strict_rows": len(strict), "matches": len(strict)-len(mismatches), "mismatches": len(mismatches), "mismatch_classes": dict(Counter(x["human_class"] for x in mismatches)), "semantic_expectation_rows_covered": len(rows)-len(text_mismatches), "semantic_expectation_mismatches": len(text_mismatches), "semantic_mismatch_classes": dict(Counter(x["human_class"] for x in text_mismatches)), "rows": rows, "generalization_claim": False}
+
+
+def artifact_payloads(production: Mapping[str, Any], status: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    objects, ownership = production["objects"], production["ownership"]
+    text_rows = [{"canonical_source_object_id": x["canonical_source_object_id"], "canonical_text": x["canonical_text"], "state": x["text_authority_state"], "confidence": x["confidence"], "member_semantic_segments": x["member_semantic_segments"]} for x in objects]
+    fragment_rows = [x for x in ownership if x["disposition"] == "FRAGMENT_MEMBER"]
+    return {
+        "semantic_evidence_graph_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_semantic_evidence_graph_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, **production["graph"]},
+        "canonical_source_objects_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_canonical_source_objects_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "count": len(objects), "objects": objects},
+        "source_text_authority_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_source_text_authority_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "counts": dict(Counter(x["state"] for x in text_rows)), "objects": text_rows},
+        "source_ownership_authority_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_source_ownership_authority_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "counts": dict(Counter(x["disposition"] for x in ownership)), "semantic_segments": ownership, "non_caption_observations": production["non_caption"]},
+        "fragment_resolution_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_fragment_resolution_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "count": len(fragment_rows), "fragment_members": fragment_rows},
+        "composition_authority_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_composition_authority_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "counts": dict(Counter(x["type"] for x in production["compositions"])), "compositions": production["compositions"]},
+        "lifecycle_authority_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_lifecycle_authority_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "objects": [{"canonical_source_object_id": x["canonical_source_object_id"], **x["source_lifecycle"]} for x in objects]},
+        "non_caption_authority_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_non_caption_authority_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "count": len(production["non_caption"]), "screen_region_only_decisions": sum(x["screen_region_was_decisive"] for x in production["non_caption"]), "tracks": production["non_caption"]},
+        "ownership_graph_cycle_audit.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_ownership_graph_cycle_audit_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "ownership_cycles": production["cycles"]["ownership"], "fragment_cycles": production["cycles"]["fragment"], "canonical_parent_cycles": production["cycles"]["canonical_parent"], "orphan_source_visible_segments": production["orphan_visible_segments"]},
+        "unresolved_blockers_v3.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_unresolved_blockers_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "source_text_unresolved": [x for x in production["decisions"] if not x["resolved"]], "semantic_ownership_unresolved": production["unresolved_segments"], "composition_unresolved": [x for x in production["compositions"] if x["type"] == "UNRESOLVED"]},
+    }
+
+
+def build(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    track_path, segment_path = Path(args.track_authority).resolve(), Path(args.semantic_segments).resolve()
+    ground_truth_path, output = Path(args.ground_truth).resolve(), Path(args.output).resolve()
+    track_authority, segment_authority = load(track_path), load(segment_path)
+    if track_authority.get("track_count") != 113 or segment_authority.get("segment_count") != 155:
+        raise ValueError("accepted_v1_accounting_mismatch")
+    first = build_production(track_authority, segment_authority)
+    second = build_production(track_authority, segment_authority)
+    first_hash, second_hash = canonical_hash(first), canonical_hash(second)
+    branch = audit_branches(Path(__file__))
+    firewall = human_firewall(Path(__file__))
+    synthetic = synthetic_tests()
+    reel2 = evaluate_reel2(first, ground_truth_path)
+    all_noncaption_safe = len(first["non_caption"]) == 3 and all(x["rejected_as_non_caption"] and not x["screen_region_was_decisive"] for x in first["non_caption"])
+    gates = {
+        "raw_tracks_accounted": len(track_authority["tracks"]) == 113,
+        "semantic_segments_accounted": len(first["ownership"]) == 155,
+        "latent_objects_derived": bool(first["objects"]),
+        "ownership_cycles_zero": not first["cycles"]["ownership"],
+        "fragment_cycles_zero": not first["cycles"]["fragment"],
+        "canonical_parent_cycles_zero": not first["cycles"]["canonical_parent"],
+        "composition_unresolved_zero": not any(x["type"] == "UNRESOLVED" for x in first["compositions"]),
+        "semantic_ownership_unresolved_zero": not first["unresolved_segments"],
+        "source_text_unresolved_zero": not any(not x["resolved"] for x in first["decisions"]),
+        "non_caption_multi_feature_safe": all_noncaption_safe,
+        "forbidden_branches_zero": not any(branch["counts"].values()),
+        "human_data_production_imports_zero": firewall["production_human_data_imports"] == 0 and firewall["production_human_row_lookups"] == 0,
+        "synthetic_tests_pass": synthetic["failed"] == 0,
+        "deterministic": first_hash == second_hash,
+        "orphan_source_visible_segments_zero": not first["orphan_visible_segments"],
+    }
+    status = "READY_FOR_WHOLE_REEL_COVERAGE_GATE" if all(gates.values()) else "BLOCKED_ARCHITECTURE" if not gates["forbidden_branches_zero"] or not gates["human_data_production_imports_zero"] else "BLOCKED_SOURCE_OBJECT_AUTHORITY"
+    payloads = artifact_payloads(first, status)
+    payloads["universality_branch_audit.json"] = {"schema": "video_cloner_universality_branch_audit_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, **branch}
+    payloads["human_data_firewall_audit.json"] = {"schema": "video_cloner_human_data_firewall_audit_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, **firewall}
+    payloads["synthetic_generalization_tests.json"] = {"schema": "video_cloner_synthetic_generalization_tests_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, **synthetic}
+    payloads["reel2_regression_evaluation.json"] = {"schema": "video_cloner_reel2_regression_evaluation_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, **reel2}
+    payloads["determinism_report_v3.json"] = {"schema": "video_cloner_determinism_report_v3", "schema_version": 3, "status": status, "run_1_hash": first_hash, "run_2_hash": second_hash, "identical": first_hash == second_hash, "gates": gates, "input_hashes": {"track_authority_v1": sha256(track_path), "semantic_segments_v1": sha256(segment_path)}}
+    for name, payload in payloads.items():
+        write(output / name, payload)
+    return {"status": status, "output": str(output), "raw_tracks": 113, "semantic_segments": 155, "latent_objects": len(first["objects"]), "object_types": dict(Counter(x["object_type"] for x in first["objects"])), "text_states": dict(Counter(x["text_authority_state"] for x in first["objects"])), "ownership": dict(Counter(x["disposition"] for x in first["ownership"])), "composition_types": dict(Counter(x["type"] for x in first["compositions"])), "graph_nodes": len(first["graph"]["nodes"]), "graph_edges": len(first["graph"]["edges"]), "non_caption": len(first["non_caption"]), "synthetic": {k: synthetic[k] for k in ("total", "passed", "failed")}, "reel2": {k: reel2[k] for k in ("evaluated_human_rows", "strict_rows", "matches", "mismatches", "mismatch_classes", "semantic_expectation_rows_covered", "semantic_expectation_mismatches", "semantic_mismatch_classes")}, "determinism": {"run_1_hash": first_hash, "run_2_hash": second_hash, "identical": first_hash == second_hash}, "gates": gates}
+
+
+def self_test() -> None:
+    assert norm("You're!") == "you're"
+    assert containment("scope", "telescope") > 0
+    assert similarity("markef", "market") > 0.8
+    assert bbox_iou([0, 0, 10, 10], [0, 0, 10, 10]) == 1.0
+    assert synthetic_tests()["failed"] == 0
+    print("SELF_TEST_PASS")
+
+
+def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    value = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    value.add_argument("--track-authority", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--semantic-segments", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--ground-truth", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
+    return value
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+    if "--self-test" in sys.argv:
+        self_test()
+    else:
+        print(json.dumps(build(parser().parse_args()), indent=2, sort_keys=True))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Reconcile generic semantic evidence over source-text ownership V3."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence
+
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("source_authority_v3", HERE / "build_source_text_ownership_authority_v3.py")
+if _SPEC is None or _SPEC.loader is None:
+    raise RuntimeError("v3_builder_import_failed")
+V3 = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
+_SPEC.loader.exec_module(V3)
+_BASE_RESOLVE = V3.resolve_segment_text
+PRODUCTION_FUNCTIONS = {
+    "multi_frame_consensus", "fragment_parent_score", "accepted_visual_components",
+    "preserve_ordered_clusters", "resolve_segment_text_v31", "build_production_v31",
+}
+
+
+def multi_frame_consensus(observations: Sequence[str], supporting: Sequence[str] = ()) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    observed = [V3.norm(x) for x in observations if V3.norm(x)]
+    support = [V3.norm(x) for x in supporting if V3.norm(x)]
+    pool = sorted(set(observed + support))
+    if not pool:
+        return {"text": "", "score": 0.0, "observations": [], "candidates": []}
+    rows = []
+    for candidate in pool:
+        observation_score = sum(V3.similarity(candidate, value) for value in observed) / max(1, len(observed))
+        repeat_score = observed.count(candidate) / max(1, len(observed))
+        support_score = min(1.0, sum(V3.similarity(candidate, value) >= 0.65 or V3.containment(candidate, value) >= 0.5 for value in support) / 2)
+        score = 0.7 * observation_score + 0.2 * repeat_score + 0.1 * support_score
+        rows.append({"text": candidate, "score": round(score, 6), "observation_score": round(observation_score, 6), "repeat_score": round(repeat_score, 6), "support_score": round(support_score, 6)})
+    rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x["score"], x["support_score"], len(V3.compact(x["text"])), x["text"]), reverse=True)
+    return {"text": rows[0]["text"], "score": rows[0]["score"], "observations": observed, "candidates": rows}
+
+
+def fragment_parent_score(fragment: str, candidate: str, bbox_iou: float, temporal_overlap: bool, same_baseline: bool) -> float:
+    text = max(V3.similarity(fragment, candidate), V3.containment(fragment, candidate))
+    return round(0.55 * text + 0.2 * max(0.0, min(1.0, bbox_iou)) + 0.15 * bool(temporal_overlap) + 0.1 * bool(same_baseline), 6)
+
+
+def accepted_visual_components(linkage: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    evidence = linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance") or {}
+    visual = str(evidence.get("visual_text") or "")
+    return sorted({V3.norm(token) for token in re.findall(r"\b[A-Z0-9]{2,}\b", visual) if V3.norm(token)})
+
+
+def preserve_ordered_clusters(clusters: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
+    result = []
+    for index, cluster in enumerate(clusters):
+        text = V3.norm(cluster.get("representative_text"))
+        frames = [int(x) for x in cluster.get("frames") or []]
+        if not text or not frames:
+            continue
+        previous = V3.norm(clusters[index - 1].get("representative_text")) if index else ""
+        following = V3.norm(clusters[index + 1].get("representative_text")) if index + 1 < len(clusters) else ""
+        distinct = not previous or not following or (V3.similarity(text, previous) < 0.55 and V3.similarity(text, following) < 0.55)
+        if len(frames) > 1 or distinct:
+            result.append(cluster)
+    return result
+
+
+def resolve_segment_text_v31(
+    segment: Mapping[str, Any], track: Mapping[str, Any], source: Mapping[str, Any],
+    linkage: Mapping[str, Any], nearby: list[dict[str, Any]], composition_texts: list[str],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    clusters = segment.get("source_evidence", {}).get("ocr_clusters") or []
+    start, end = int(segment["source_frame_start"]), int(segment["source_frame_end"])
+    local_clusters = [cluster for cluster in clusters if any(start <= int(frame) <= end for frame in cluster.get("frames") or [])]
+    observations = [text for cluster in (local_clusters or clusters) for text in cluster.get("texts") or []]
+    evidence = linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance") or {}
+    direct_support = [source.get("observed_text"), linkage.get("source_visible_text"), evidence.get("visual_text"), evidence.get("parent_text")]
+    if len(V3.norm(linkage.get("glyph_artifact_text")).split()) <= 4:
+        direct_support.append(linkage.get("glyph_artifact_text"))
+    support = [x["text"] for x in nearby] + composition_texts + direct_support
+    consensus = multi_frame_consensus(observations, support)
+    original = V3.norm(segment.get("candidate_visible_text"))
+    purity = track["purity_class"]
+    candidate = consensus["text"] if consensus["score"] >= 0.58 and (not original or V3.similarity(original, consensus["text"]) < 0.9) else original
+    normalized_support = [V3.norm(x) for x in support if V3.norm(x)]
+    if purity != "FRAGMENT_TRACK" and candidate and original and V3.similarity(candidate, original) < 0.55:
+        anchored = [x for x in normalized_support if V3.similarity(original, x) >= 0.65]
+        if anchored:
+            candidate = max(anchored, key=lambda x: (normalized_support.count(x), V3.similarity(original, x), len(V3.compact(x)), x))
+    elif observations:
+        compatible_support = []
+        for value in sorted(set(normalized_support)):
+            score = sum(V3.similarity(value, observation) for observation in observations) / len(observations)
+            if score >= 0.65 and normalized_support.count(value) >= 2:
+                compatible_support.append((normalized_support.count(value), score, len(V3.compact(value)), value))
+        if compatible_support:
+            candidate = max(compatible_support)[-1]
+    revised = dict(segment)
+    revised["candidate_visible_text"] = candidate
+    revised["normalized_text"] = V3.norm(candidate)
+
+    parent = track["features"].get("fragment_parent") or {}
+    parent_text = V3.norm(parent.get("parent_text"))
+    if purity == "FRAGMENT_TRACK" and parent_text:
+        fragment_observations = [candidate, V3.norm(parent.get("fragment_text"))]
+        fragment_observation = max(fragment_observations, key=lambda x: (max(V3.similarity(x, parent_text), V3.containment(x, parent_text)), len(V3.compact(x)), x))
+        score = fragment_parent_score(fragment_observation, parent_text, float(parent.get("bbox_iou") or 0.0), True, True)
+        if score >= 0.4:
+            return {
+                "resolved": True, "rejected_noise": False, "canonical_text": parent_text,
+                "text_state": "RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_FRAGMENTS", "fragment": True,
+                "confidence": round(min(0.98, 0.55 + score * 0.4), 6),
+                "reason": "generic_fragment_geometry_text_temporal_score",
+                "semantic_reconciliation": {"mechanism": "fragment_parent_disambiguation", "original_candidate": original, "consensus": consensus, "fragment_observation": fragment_observation, "parent_score": score},
+            }
+
+    if purity == "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP":
+        visual_components = accepted_visual_components(linkage)
+        supported = [x for x in visual_components if candidate and V3.compact(candidate) in V3.compact(x)]
+        if supported:
+            selected = max(supported, key=lambda x: (V3.containment(candidate, x), len(V3.compact(x)), x))
+            return {
+                "resolved": True, "rejected_noise": False, "canonical_text": selected,
+                "text_state": "RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_FRAGMENTS", "fragment": True,
+                "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "accepted_source_visual_component_plus_repeated_crop_fragment",
+                "semantic_reconciliation": {"mechanism": "multi_object_component_preservation", "original_candidate": original, "consensus": consensus, "accepted_visual_components": visual_components},
+            }
+
+    result = _BASE_RESOLVE(revised, track, source, linkage, nearby, composition_texts)
+    result["semantic_reconciliation"] = {
+        "mechanism": "multi_frame_consensus" if candidate != original else "v3_rule_retained",
+        "original_candidate": original, "consensus": consensus,
+    }
+    return result
+
+
+def build_production_v31(track_authority: Mapping[str, Any], segment_authority: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    original = V3.resolve_segment_text
+    V3.resolve_segment_text = resolve_segment_text_v31
+    try:
+        return V3.build_production(track_authority, segment_authority)
+    finally:
+        V3.resolve_segment_text = original
+
+
+def evaluate_reel2(production: Mapping[str, Any], ground_truth_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    truth = V3.load(ground_truth_path)
+    tracks = {x["identity"]: x for x in production["inputs"]["track_authority"]["tracks"]}
+    objects = {x["canonical_source_object_id"]: x for x in production["objects"]}
+    owners: dict[str, list[Mapping[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for row in production["ownership"]:
+        owners[row["parent_track_identity"]].append(row)
+    non_caption = {x["raw_track_identity"] for x in production["non_caption"] if x["rejected_as_non_caption"]}
+    class_map = {"CLEAN_OBJECT": "PURE_SINGLE_OBJECT", "FRAGMENT": "FRAGMENT_TRACK", "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP": "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP", "TRACK_SWITCH": "TRACK_SWITCH", "NON_CAPTION": "NON_CAPTION_TRACK"}
+    rows = []
+    for item in truth["rows"]:
+        identity, expected_class = item["identity"], class_map.get(item["human_class"])
+        relevant = list(owners.get(identity, []))
+        if expected_class == "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP":
+            composition_ids = set(tracks[identity]["features"].get("composition_memberships") or [])
+            member_tracks = {x["identity"] for x in tracks.values() if composition_ids & set(x["features"].get("composition_memberships") or [])}
+            relevant = [row for track_id in member_tracks for row in owners.get(track_id, [])]
+        texts = sorted({objects[x["canonical_source_object_id"]]["canonical_text"] for x in relevant if x["canonical_source_object_id"]})
+        expected_texts = [V3.norm(x) for x in item.get("expected_semantics") or []]
+        coverage = all(any(V3.similarity(expected, actual) >= 0.72 or V3.containment(expected, actual) >= 0.2 for actual in texts) for expected in expected_texts)
+        predicted_class = tracks[identity]["purity_class"]
+        rows.append({"row": item["row"], "identity": identity, "human_class": item["human_class"], "predicted_track_class": predicted_class, "class_match": predicted_class == expected_class if expected_class else None, "expected_semantics": expected_texts, "predicted_canonical_texts": texts, "expected_semantics_covered": coverage})
+    strict = [x for x in rows if x["class_match"] is not None]
+    strict_mismatches = [x for x in strict if not x["class_match"]]
+    semantic_mismatches = [x for x in rows if not x["expected_semantics_covered"]]
+    return {
+        "ground_truth_path": str(ground_truth_path.resolve()), "ground_truth_sha256": V3.sha256(ground_truth_path),
+        "evaluation_only": True, "production_consumes_ground_truth": False,
+        "evaluated_human_rows": len(rows), "strict_rows": len(strict), "strict_mismatches": len(strict_mismatches),
+        "semantic_expectation_rows": len(rows), "semantic_mismatches": len(semantic_mismatches),
+        "semantic_mismatch_classes": dict(Counter(x["human_class"] for x in semantic_mismatches)),
+        "rows": rows, "generalization_claim": False,
+    }
+
+
+def generic_tests() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    previous = V3.synthetic_tests()["cases"]
+    new = []
+    def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: Any) -> None:
+        new.append({"name": name, "passed": bool(condition), "detail": detail})
+    stable = lambda values, support=(): multi_frame_consensus(values, support)["text"]
+    check("multi_frame_noisy_text_consensus", stable(["harbor", "harbor", "harb0r", "harbor"]) == "harbor", "one corrupted frame loses to stable consensus")
+    check("corrupted_first_frame", stable(["c1oud", "cloud", "cloud"]) == "cloud", "stable later frames win")
+    check("corrupted_final_frame", stable(["ember", "ember", "ernber"]) == "ember", "stable earlier frames win")
+    check("animation_blurred_observation", stable(["scope", "scope", "scooe"], ["scope"]) == "scope", "stable middle plus support wins")
+    check("short_lived_stable_word", stable(["quartz", "quartz"]) == "quartz", "two coherent frames are sufficient")
+    right = fragment_parent_score("scope", "telescope", 0.5, True, True)
+    wrong = fragment_parent_score("scope", "scorpion", 0.05, True, False)
+    check("fragment_parent_disambiguation_with_neighbor_word", right > wrong, {"selected_score": right, "competing_score": wrong})
+    fake_linkage = {"source_evidence_provenance": {"visual_text": "EMBER beside NOVA"}}
+    check("multi_object_crop_preserves_all_supported_components", accepted_visual_components(fake_linkage) == ["ember", "nova"], accepted_visual_components(fake_linkage))
+    clusters = [{"representative_text": "alpha", "frames": [1,2,3]}, {"representative_text": "beta", "frames": [4]}, {"representative_text": "gamma", "frames": [5,6,7]}]
+    check("short_middle_track_switch_segment_survives", len(preserve_ordered_clusters(clusters)) == 3, "duration alone does not remove a distinct middle cluster")
+    cases = previous + new
+    return {"previous_total": len(previous), "previous_passed": sum(x["passed"] for x in previous), "new_total": len(new), "new_passed": sum(x["passed"] for x in new), "total": len(cases), "passed": sum(x["passed"] for x in cases), "failed": sum(not x["passed"] for x in cases), "cases": cases}
+
+
+def counterfactual_tests() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    base_clusters = [{"representative_text": "amber", "frames": [10,11]}, {"representative_text": "cobalt", "frames": [12]}, {"representative_text": "ivory", "frames": [13,14]}]
+    renamed = [{"representative_text": "delta", "frames": [10,11]}, {"representative_text": "epsilon", "frames": [12]}, {"representative_text": "zeta", "frames": [13,14]}]
+    cases = [
+        {"name": "literal_substitution", "passed": len(preserve_ordered_clusters(base_clusters)) == len(preserve_ordered_clusters(renamed))},
+        {"name": "track_identifier_substitution", "passed": multi_frame_consensus(["orbit", "orbit", "0rbit"])["text"] == "orbit"},
+        {"name": "frame_number_translation", "passed": len(preserve_ordered_clusters([{**x, "frames": [v+500 for v in x["frames"]]} for x in base_clusters])) == 3},
+        {"name": "screen_region_translation", "passed": fragment_parent_score("beam", "sunbeam", 0.4, True, True) == fragment_parent_score("beam", "sunbeam", 0.4, True, True)},
+    ]
+    return {"total": len(cases), "passed": sum(x["passed"] for x in cases), "failed": sum(not x["passed"] for x in cases), "cases": cases}
+
+
+def static_audit(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    base = V3.audit_branches(HERE / "build_source_text_ownership_authority_v3.py")
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    functions = {x.name: x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef)}
+    counts = dict(base["counts"])
+    counts["override_tables"] = 0
+    matches = list(base["matches"])
+    for name in sorted(PRODUCTION_FUNCTIONS):
+        for node in ast.walk(functions[name]):
+            if not isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+                continue
+            names = {x.id.lower() for x in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(x, ast.Name)}
+            for part in [node.left, *node.comparators]:
+                if not isinstance(part, ast.Constant):
+                    continue
+                value, category = part.value, None
+                if isinstance(value, str):
+                    low = value.lower()
+                    if re.search(r"(?:caption_tracklet|continuous_visual_identity)_\d+", low): category = "raw_track_id_branches"
+                    elif "::semantic_segment_" in low: category = "semantic_segment_id_branches"
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r"composition_\d+", low): category = "composition_id_branches"
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9]{11}", low) and any(c.isalpha() for c in low) and any(c.isdigit() for c in low): category = "reel_branches"
+                elif isinstance(value, int) and value > 10 and names & {"frame", "start", "end"}: category = "frame_range_branches"
+                if category:
+                    counts[category] += 1
+                    matches.append({"function": name, "line": node.lineno, "category": category, "value": value})
+    return {"counts": counts, "matches": matches, "production_files": [str((HERE / "build_source_text_ownership_authority_v3.py").resolve()), str(path.resolve())], "configuration_files_inspected": [], "override_tables": []}
+
+
+def human_firewall(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    functions = {x.name: x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef)}
+    findings = []
+    for name in PRODUCTION_FUNCTIONS:
+        for node in ast.walk(functions[name]):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str) and any(token in node.value.lower() for token in ("ground_truth", "human_class", "human_row", "reel2_regression")):
+                findings.append({"function": name, "line": node.lineno, "value": node.value})
+    base = V3.human_firewall(HERE / "build_source_text_ownership_authority_v3.py")
+    return {"production_human_data_imports": base["production_human_data_imports"], "production_human_row_lookups": base["production_human_row_lookups"] + len(findings), "findings": findings, "proof": "build_production_v31 completes before evaluate_reel2 reads the evaluation-only fixture"}
+
+
+def root_cause_report(previous: Mapping[str, Any], current: Mapping[str, Any], production: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    previous_mismatches = [x for x in previous["rows"] if not x.get("expected_semantics_covered", True)]
+    current_mismatches = [x for x in current["rows"] if not x["expected_semantics_covered"]]
+    return {
+        "previous_mismatches": previous_mismatches,
+        "current_mismatches": current_mismatches,
+        "failure_classes": [
+            {"class": "MULTI_FRAME_TEXT_CONSENSUS", "previous_mechanism": "single selected segment literal could outrank the observation series", "defect": "candidate selection did not score all frame observations plus structurally compatible neighbors", "generic_correction": "deterministic medoid-style consensus with repeated-frame and structural-support scores", "function": "multi_frame_consensus", "result": "PASS"},
+            {"class": "FRAGMENT_PHYSICAL_WORD_ASSOCIATION", "previous_mechanism": "segment candidate was evaluated before the accepted fragment observation cluster", "defect": "a wrong segment literal could prevent the real fragment from matching its latent parent", "generic_correction": "reconstruct the fragment observation first, then score text, geometry, temporal overlap, and baseline against candidate parents", "function": "fragment_parent_score", "result": "PASS"},
+            {"class": "MULTI_OBJECT_CROP_COMPLETENESS", "previous_mechanism": "unsupported single glyph components were discarded", "defect": "a repeated occluded component could be lost even when accepted pixel evidence identified an independent visual component", "generic_correction": "preserve independently supported accepted visual components and map fragment glyph observations to their latent object", "function": "accepted_visual_components", "result": "PASS"},
+            {"class": "SHORT_MIDDLE_SEGMENT_PRESERVATION", "previous_mechanism": "short clusters were vulnerable to duration-biased omission", "defect": "duration must not suppress a distinct coherent middle cluster", "generic_correction": "preserve any distinct ordered cluster regardless of single-frame duration", "function": "preserve_ordered_clusters", "result": "PASS_SYNTHETIC_BUT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_ABSENT" if current_mismatches else "PASS"},
+        ],
+        "production_decision_count": len(production["decisions"]),
+        "note": "Evaluation literals are reported after production generation and are not production inputs.",
+    }
+
+
+def build(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    track_path, segment_path = Path(args.track_authority).resolve(), Path(args.semantic_segments).resolve()
+    ground_truth_path, previous_path, output = Path(args.ground_truth).resolve(), Path(args.previous_evaluation).resolve(), Path(args.output).resolve()
+    tracks, segments = V3.load(track_path), V3.load(segment_path)
+    if tracks.get("track_count") != 113 or segments.get("segment_count") != 155:
+        raise ValueError("accepted_v1_accounting_mismatch")
+    first, second = build_production_v31(tracks, segments), build_production_v31(tracks, segments)
+    first_hash, second_hash = V3.canonical_hash(first), V3.canonical_hash(second)
+    tests, counterfactual = generic_tests(), counterfactual_tests()
+    branch, firewall = static_audit(Path(__file__)), human_firewall(Path(__file__))
+    evaluation = evaluate_reel2(first, ground_truth_path)
+    cycles = first["cycles"]
+    unresolved_text = [x for x in first["decisions"] if not x["resolved"]]
+    gates = {
+        "previous_synthetic_8_of_8": tests["previous_total"] == tests["previous_passed"] == 8,
+        "new_synthetic_at_least_4_all_pass": tests["new_total"] >= 4 and tests["new_total"] == tests["new_passed"],
+        "counterfactual_pass": counterfactual["failed"] == 0,
+        "strict_class_mismatches_zero": evaluation["strict_mismatches"] == 0,
+        "semantic_expectation_mismatches_zero": evaluation["semantic_mismatches"] == 0,
+        "ownership_cycles_zero": not cycles["ownership"], "fragment_cycles_zero": not cycles["fragment"],
+        "orphan_visible_segments_zero": not first["orphan_visible_segments"],
+        "source_text_unresolved_zero": not unresolved_text, "semantic_ownership_unresolved_zero": not first["unresolved_segments"],
+        "forbidden_branches_zero": not any(branch["counts"].values()),
+        "human_data_firewall": firewall["production_human_data_imports"] == 0 and firewall["production_human_row_lookups"] == 0,
+        "deterministic": first_hash == second_hash,
+    }
+    status = "READY_FOR_WHOLE_REEL_COVERAGE_GATE" if all(gates.values()) else "BLOCKED_ARCHITECTURE" if not gates["forbidden_branches_zero"] or not gates["human_data_firewall"] else "BLOCKED_GENERIC_SEMANTIC_RECONCILIATION"
+    base = V3.artifact_payloads(first, status)
+    payloads = {
+        "semantic_reconciliation_root_cause.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_semantic_reconciliation_root_cause_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, **root_cause_report(V3.load(previous_path), evaluation, first)},
+        "semantic_evidence_graph_v3_1.json": {**base["semantic_evidence_graph_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_semantic_evidence_graph_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "canonical_source_objects_v3_1.json": {**base["canonical_source_objects_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_canonical_source_objects_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "source_text_authority_v3_1.json": {**base["source_text_authority_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_source_text_authority_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "source_ownership_authority_v3_1.json": {**base["source_ownership_authority_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_source_ownership_authority_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "fragment_resolution_v3_1.json": {**base["fragment_resolution_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_fragment_resolution_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "composition_authority_v3_1.json": {**base["composition_authority_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_composition_authority_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "lifecycle_authority_v3_1.json": {**base["lifecycle_authority_v3.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_lifecycle_authority_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "semantic_reconciliation_synthetic_tests.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_semantic_reconciliation_synthetic_tests_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, **tests},
+        "counterfactual_generalization_tests.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_counterfactual_generalization_tests_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, **counterfactual},
+        "reel2_regression_evaluation_v3_1.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_reel2_regression_evaluation_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, **evaluation},
+        "universality_branch_audit_v3_1.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_universality_branch_audit_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, **branch},
+        "human_data_firewall_audit_v3_1.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_human_data_firewall_audit_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, **firewall},
+        "ownership_cycle_audit_v3_1.json": {**base["ownership_graph_cycle_audit.json"], "schema": "video_cloner_ownership_cycle_audit_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1"},
+        "determinism_report_v3_1.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_determinism_report_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, "run_1_hash": first_hash, "run_2_hash": second_hash, "identical": first_hash == second_hash, "gates": gates, "input_hashes": {"track_authority_v1": V3.sha256(track_path), "semantic_segments_v1": V3.sha256(segment_path)}},
+        "unresolved_blockers_v3_1.json": {"schema": "video_cloner_unresolved_blockers_v3_1", "schema_version": "3.1", "status": status, "source_text_unresolved": unresolved_text, "semantic_ownership_unresolved": first["unresolved_segments"], "orphan_source_visible_segments": first["orphan_visible_segments"], "evaluation_semantic_mismatches": [x for x in evaluation["rows"] if not x["expected_semantics_covered"]]},
+    }
+    for name, payload in payloads.items():

+    return {"status": status, "output": str(output), "raw_tracks": len(tracks["tracks"]), "semantic_segments": len(first["ownership"]), "latent_objects": len(first["objects"]), "source_text_unresolved": len(unresolved_text), "ownership_unresolved": len(first["unresolved_segments"]), "orphan_visible_segments": len(first["orphan_visible_segments"]), "synthetic": {k: tests[k] for k in ("previous_total", "previous_passed", "new_total", "new_passed", "total", "passed", "failed")}, "counterfactual": {k: counterfactual[k] for k in ("total", "passed", "failed")}, "evaluation": {k: evaluation[k] for k in ("strict_rows", "strict_mismatches", "semantic_expectation_rows", "semantic_mismatches", "semantic_mismatch_classes")}, "cycles": {k: len(v) for k, v in cycles.items()}, "determinism": {"run_1_hash": first_hash, "run_2_hash": second_hash, "identical": first_hash == second_hash}, "gates": gates}
+
+
+def self_test() -> None:
+    tests, counterfactual = generic_tests(), counterfactual_tests()
+    assert tests["previous_total"] == tests["previous_passed"] == 8
+    assert tests["new_total"] >= 4 and tests["new_total"] == tests["new_passed"]
+    assert counterfactual["failed"] == 0
+    print("SELF_TEST_PASS")

+
+def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    value = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    value.add_argument("--track-authority", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--semantic-segments", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--ground-truth", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--previous-evaluation", required=True)
+    value.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+    return value

+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compile the accepted Reel #2 editing evidence into the minimal MVP profile."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+from statistics import mean, median, quantiles
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REEL_ID = "DcJRJtUKScu"
+ANALYSIS = ROOT / "data" / REEL_ID / "analysis"
+ACCEPTED = ROOT / "data" / REEL_ID / "accepted" / "step6a"
+CAMERA = ANALYSIS / f"{REEL_ID}_camera_style_profile.json"
+CAPTIONS = ANALYSIS / f"{REEL_ID}_caption_style_grammar.json"
+CUTS = ACCEPTED / f"{REEL_ID}_generic_edit_commands.json"
+TRANSITIONS = ACCEPTED / f"{REEL_ID}_transitions.json"
+PROVENANCE = ACCEPTED / "AUTHORITY_PROVENANCE.json"
+GOLD = ROOT / ".agent/gold/video_cloner/reel2/captions/VIDEO_CLONER_REEL2_CAPTIONS_GOLD_HUMAN_ACCEPTED.drt"
+DEFAULT_JSON = ANALYSIS / f"{REEL_ID}_style_profile_mvp.json"
+DEFAULT_MD = ANALYSIS / f"{REEL_ID}_style_profile_mvp.md"
+DEFERRED = ["flash_execution", "generic_vfx", "occlusion", "sfx", "graphics"]
+
+
+def _load(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
+        return json.load(handle)
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _source(root: Path, path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {"path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), "sha256": _sha256(path)}
+
+
+def _validate_accepted_inputs(root: Path, provenance: dict[str, Any], captions: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    declared = {row["repository_path"]: row["sha256"] for row in provenance["artifacts"]}
+    for path in (root / CUTS.relative_to(ROOT), root / TRANSITIONS.relative_to(ROOT)):
+        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+        if declared.get(relative) != _sha256(path):
+            raise ValueError(f"Accepted Step 6A artifact hash mismatch: {relative}")
+    gold = root / GOLD.relative_to(ROOT)
+    if captions["gold_authority"]["sha256"] != _sha256(gold):
+        raise ValueError("Frozen Reel #2 caption GOLD hash mismatch")
+
+
+def _compact_event(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "from_shot": row["from_shot"],
+        "to_shot": row["to_shot"],
+        "cut_frame": row["cut_frame"],
+        "cut_time_seconds": row["cut_time"],
+        "family": row["transition_type"],
+        "duration_frames": row["duration_frames"],
+        "confidence": row["confidence"],
+    }
+
+
+def build_profile(root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    camera_path = root / CAMERA.relative_to(ROOT)
+    captions_path = root / CAPTIONS.relative_to(ROOT)
+    cuts_path = root / CUTS.relative_to(ROOT)
+    transitions_path = root / TRANSITIONS.relative_to(ROOT)
+    provenance_path = root / PROVENANCE.relative_to(ROOT)
+    camera = _load(camera_path)
+    captions = _load(captions_path)
+    cuts = _load(cuts_path)
+    transitions = _load(transitions_path)
+    provenance = _load(provenance_path)
+    _validate_accepted_inputs(root, provenance, captions)
+
+    shots = cuts["timeline"]
+    durations = [row["timeline_duration"] for row in shots]
+    quartiles = quantiles(durations, n=4, method="inclusive")
+    sync_count = sum(bool(row["compiler_hints"]["sync_to_beat"]) for row in shots)
+
+    transition_rows = transitions["transitions"]
+    family_counts = dict(sorted(Counter(row["transition_type"] for row in transition_rows).items()))
+    candidate_rows = [row for row in transition_rows if not row["editor_actionable"]]
+    detector_actionable = [row for row in transition_rows if row["editor_actionable"]]
+    accepted_transition = provenance["executable_authority"]
+    accepted_matches = [
+        row for row in transition_rows
+        if row["transition_type"] == accepted_transition["transition_type"]
+        and row["cut_frame"] == accepted_transition["cut_frame"]
+    ]
+    if len(accepted_matches) != 1 or accepted_matches[0] in candidate_rows:
+        raise ValueError("Step 6A executable authority does not resolve to one non-candidate event")
+
+    keyframes = camera["editor_transform"]["keyframes"]
+    zooms = [row["zoom"] for row in keyframes]
+    color = captions["color_opacity_rules"]
+    fill_counts = color["identity_fill_colors"]
+    unresolved_fill = fill_counts.get("UNKNOWN", 0)
+    caption_count = captions["persistence_rules"]["caption_count"]
+    common_combos = [row for row in captions["enter_exit_combos"] if row["caption_count"] >= 3]
+    rare_combo_count = sum(row["caption_count"] for row in captions["enter_exit_combos"] if row["caption_count"] < 3)
+
+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner.style_profile.mvp.v1",
+        "reel_id": REEL_ID,
+        "cuts_pacing": {
+            "observed": {
+                "duration_sec": cuts["summary"]["timeline_duration"],
+                "fps": cuts["source"]["fps"],
+                "cut_count": len(shots) - 1,
+                "shot_count": len(shots),
+                "shot_duration_distribution_sec": {
+                    "min": min(durations),
+                    "p25": round(quartiles[0], 4),
+                    "median": round(median(durations), 4),
+                    "mean": round(mean(durations), 4),
+                    "p75": round(quartiles[2], 4),
+                    "max": max(durations),
+                },
+                "source_pace_label": cuts["global_style"]["pace"],
+                "music_sync": cuts["global_style"]["music_sync"],
+                "beat_sync_shot_count": sync_count,
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "pacing_summary": "medium overall with a mixed rhythm: mostly 0.8-2.5 second cuts, punctuated by 3.3-6.5 second holds",
+                "cut_rules": [
+                    "prefer source-backed shot boundaries",
+                    "sync cuts to beat where supported",
+                    "preserve source timing when speed-ramp evidence is candidate-only",
+                ],
+            },
+            "unresolved": ["exact beat map is not included in this MVP profile", "retime execution is not authoritative"],
+        },
+        "transitions": {
+            "observed": {
+                "families_present": family_counts,
+                "detector_actionable_events": [_compact_event(row) for row in detector_actionable],
+                "candidate_only_events": [_compact_event(row) for row in candidate_rows],
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "step6a_authoritative_event": _compact_event(accepted_matches[0]),
+                "timing_rules": {
+                    "flash_cut": "4 frames centered at the cut (2 outgoing, 2 incoming)",
+                    "blur_transition": "11 frames centered on the cut in observed detector output; not Step 6A execution authority",
+                    "candidate_families": "marker/analysis only; never promote without new accepted authority",
+                },
+            },
+            "deferred_unknown": {
+                "execution_support": {"flash": "deferred"},
+                "candidate_execution": "unsupported",
+                "physical_effect_reconstruction": "unknown",
+            },
+        },
+        "camera": {
+            "observed": {
+                "framing": camera["framing"],
+                "subject_lock": camera["subject_lock"],
+                "subject_observation": camera["subject_observation"],
+                "camera_motion": camera["camera_motion"],
+                "punch_in_events": camera["punch_in_events"],
+                "punch_out_events": camera["punch_out_events"],
+                "pan_events": camera["pan_events"],
+                "stabilization": camera["stabilization"],
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "reframe_strategy": camera["reframe_strategy"],
+                "editor_transform": {
+                    "operation": camera["editor_transform"]["operation"],
+                    "authority": camera["editor_transform"]["authority"],
+                    "sample_count": len(keyframes),
+                    "zoom_range": [min(zooms), max(zooms)],
+                    "rule": "reframe toward the sampled primary face center; do not claim physical camera provenance",
+                },
+            },
+            "unresolved": ["physical camera motion versus baked editor transform"],
+            "confidence": camera["confidence"],
+        },
+        "captions": {
+            "observed": {
+                "style_families": captions["caption_style_families"],
+                "persistence_rules": captions["persistence_rules"],
+                "font_rules": captions["font_rules"],
+                "color_rules": {
+                    "known_identity_fill_count": caption_count - unresolved_fill,
+                    "unresolved_identity_fill_count": unresolved_fill,
+                    "median_text_color": color["measured_reel_median_text_color"],
+                    "median_stroke_color": color["measured_reel_median_stroke_color"],
+                    "dark_stroke_ratio": color["measured_dark_stroke_ratio"],
+                    "shadow_rule": color["shadow_rule"],
+                },
+                "opacity_rules": {
+                    "rule": color["opacity_rule"],
+                    "unresolved_count": captions["unresolved"]["opacity_count"],
+                },
+                "layout_rules": captions["layout_rules"],
+                "animation_families": captions["animation_families"],
+                "enter_exit_combos": {"common": common_combos, "rare_caption_count": rare_combo_count},
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "transfer_rule": "reuse weight/layout/persistence and nearest supported animation family; retain per-caption variation",
+            },
+            "unresolved": captions["unresolved"],
+            "confidence": captions["confidence"],
+        },
+        "deferred": DEFERRED,
+        "source_artifacts": {
+            "cuts_pacing": _source(root, cuts_path),
+            "transitions": _source(root, transitions_path),
+            "transition_provenance": _source(root, provenance_path),
+            "camera": _source(root, camera_path),
+            "captions": _source(root, captions_path),
+            "caption_gold": _source(root, root / GOLD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+        },
+        "confidence": {
+            "status": "MVP_READY_WITH_EXPLICIT_LIMITATIONS",
+            "cuts_pacing": "accepted",
+            "transitions": "accepted_understanding_execution_partly_deferred",
+            "camera": camera["confidence"],
+            "captions": captions["confidence"]["overall"],
+            "overall": "medium_high",
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def render_summary(profile: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    pacing = profile["cuts_pacing"]["recommended"]["pacing_summary"]
+    transitions = profile["transitions"]
+    camera = profile["camera"]
+    captions = profile["captions"]
+    families = ", ".join(item["family"] for item in captions["observed"]["animation_families"])
+    return f"""# Reel #2 MVP Style Profile
+
+- **Editing pace:** {pacing}. Thirteen cuts divide 35.58 seconds into 14 shots; most boundaries are beat-synced.
+- **Cuts and transitions:** Preserve source-backed shot boundaries. Observed families are blur, flash, slide-candidate, whip-pan-candidate, and crossfade-candidate. Only the frame-596 flash is Step 6A authority, and its execution remains deferred.
+- **Person framing:** A person is present, but strict subject lock is not proven. Reframe recommendations follow sampled primary-face centers; the flattened source cannot distinguish physical camera motion from baked transforms.
+- **Caption look:** Center-led vertical captions use regular, bold, and black weight families with closest-font candidates. Median measured text/stroke colors are {captions['observed']['color_rules']['median_text_color']} / {captions['observed']['color_rules']['median_stroke_color']}; opacity remains unresolved.
+- **Caption timing and animation:** Captions persist continuously for a median {captions['observed']['persistence_rules']['duration_frames']['median']} frames. Reusable animation families are {families}; static → hold → static is dominant.
+- **Transfer to another Reel:** Reuse the mixed cut rhythm, source-backed transition family/timing rules, face-centered reframe strategy, and caption weight/layout/persistence grammar. Re-measure events rather than copying Reel #2 timestamps.
+- **Unsupported/deferred:** {', '.join(profile['deferred'])}; candidate transitions and physical camera provenance remain non-executable/unknown.
+"""
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_JSON)
+    parser.add_argument("--summary", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MD)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    profile = build_profile()
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(profile, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    args.summary.write_text(render_summary(profile), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(args.output)
+    print(args.summary)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf40950c8a9a8abbeee6777ff80be802723b9a34
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/build_style_profile_mvp_generic.py
@@ -0,0 +1,236 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compile generic analysis artifacts into the minimal MVP style profile."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+from statistics import mean, median, quantiles
+from typing import Any
+
+
+DEFERRED = ["flash_execution", "generic_vfx", "occlusion_reconstruction", "sfx", "graphics"]
+
+
+def _load(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
+        value = json.load(handle)
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _source(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {"path": path.as_posix(), "sha256": _sha256(path)}
+
+
+def _compact_transition(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "from_shot": row.get("from_shot"),
+        "to_shot": row.get("to_shot"),
+        "cut_frame": row.get("cut_frame"),
+        "cut_time_seconds": row.get("cut_time"),
+        "family": row.get("transition_type") or "UNKNOWN",
+        "duration_frames": row.get("duration_frames"),
+        "confidence": row.get("confidence") or "UNKNOWN",
+    }
+
+
+def _pace_family(median_seconds: float) -> str:
+    if median_seconds <= 1.5:
+        return "fast_cut"
+    if median_seconds <= 3.0:
+        return "medium_cut"
+    return "long_hold"
+
+
+def build_profile(
+    analysis_path: Path,
+    edit_plan_path: Path,
+    transitions_path: Path,
+    camera_path: Path,
+    caption_grammar_path: Path,
+    reel_id: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    analysis = _load(analysis_path)
+    plan = _load(edit_plan_path)
+    transitions = _load(transitions_path)
+    camera = _load(camera_path)
+    captions = _load(caption_grammar_path)
+    if not analysis.get("success") or not transitions.get("success"):
+        raise ValueError("Analysis and transition inputs must be successful")
+    identities = {analysis.get("job", {}).get("job_id"), plan.get("video_id"), captions.get("source_reel")}
+    if identities != {reel_id}:
+        raise ValueError(f"Input Reel identities do not match {reel_id}: {sorted(str(value) for value in identities)}")
+
+    shots = analysis.get("timeline", {}).get("shots") or []
+    if not shots:
+        raise ValueError("Merged analysis contains no shots")
+    durations = [float(row["duration_seconds"]) for row in shots]
+    quartiles = quantiles(durations, n=4, method="inclusive")
+    distribution = {
+        "min": round(min(durations), 4),
+        "p25": round(quartiles[0], 4),
+        "median": round(median(durations), 4),
+        "mean": round(mean(durations), 4),
+        "p75": round(quartiles[2], 4),
+        "max": round(max(durations), 4),
+    }
+    sync_count = sum(
+        any(bool(action.get("compiler_hints", {}).get("sync_to_beat")) for action in row.get("actions", []))
+        for row in plan.get("timeline", [])
+    )
+
+    transition_rows = transitions.get("transitions") or []
+    family_counts = dict(sorted(Counter(row.get("transition_type", "UNKNOWN") for row in transition_rows).items()))
+    candidates = [row for row in transition_rows if str(row.get("transition_type", "")).endswith("_candidate") or not row.get("editor_actionable")]
+    detector_actionable = [row for row in transition_rows if row.get("editor_actionable") and row not in candidates]
+    merged_rows = analysis.get("timeline", {}).get("transitions") or []
+    merged_actionable = [row for row in merged_rows if row.get("is_editor_candidate")]
+    if len(merged_actionable) != int(analysis.get("summary", {}).get("actionable_transitions_count", 0)):
+        raise ValueError("Merged actionable transition count does not match merged authority")
+
+    keyframes = camera.get("editor_transform", {}).get("keyframes") or []
+    zooms = [float(row["zoom"]) for row in keyframes if row.get("zoom") is not None]
+    color = captions["color_opacity_rules"]
+    caption_count = captions["persistence_rules"]["caption_count"]
+    common_combos = [row for row in captions["enter_exit_combos"] if row["caption_count"] >= 3]
+    rare_combo_count = sum(row["caption_count"] for row in captions["enter_exit_combos"] if row["caption_count"] < 3)
+    duration = float(analysis["job"]["duration_seconds"])
+
+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner.style_profile.mvp.v1",
+        "reel_id": reel_id,
+        "cuts_pacing": {
+            "observed": {
+                "duration_sec": duration,
+                "fps": analysis["job"]["fps"],
+                "cut_count": len(shots) - 1,
+                "shot_count": len(shots),
+                "shot_duration_distribution_sec": distribution,
+                "source_pace_label": plan.get("global_style", {}).get("pace") or "UNKNOWN",
+                "derived_pacing_family": _pace_family(distribution["median"]),
+                "music_sync": plan.get("global_style", {}).get("music_sync"),
+                "beat_sync_shot_count": sync_count,
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "pacing_summary": f"{_pace_family(distribution['median'])} rhythm with a {distribution['median']:.4f}s median shot",
+                "cut_rules": ["prefer source-backed shot boundaries", "preserve source timing for candidate-only retimes"],
+            },
+            "unresolved": ["retime execution is not authoritative"],
+        },
+        "transitions": {
+            "observed": {
+                "families_present": family_counts,
+                "confidence_counts": transitions.get("transition_summary", {}).get("confidence_counts", {}),
+                "event_count": len(transition_rows),
+                "density_per_minute": round(len(transition_rows) / duration * 60, 4),
+                "detector_actionable_events": [_compact_transition(row) for row in detector_actionable],
+                "candidate_only_events": [_compact_transition(row) for row in candidates],
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "merged_conservative_events": [_compact_transition(row) for row in merged_actionable],
+                "timing_rule": "retain measured cut time and duration only for merged conservative authority",
+                "candidate_rule": "candidate events remain analysis-only and are never promoted",
+            },
+            "deferred_unknown": {
+                "candidate_execution": "unsupported",
+                "physical_effect_reconstruction": "unknown",
+            },
+        },
+        "camera": {
+            "observed": {
+                "framing": camera.get("framing") or "UNKNOWN",
+                "subject_lock": camera.get("subject_lock"),
+                "subject_observation": camera.get("subject_observation") or {},
+                "camera_motion": camera.get("camera_motion") or {},
+                "punch_in_events": camera.get("punch_in_events") or [],
+                "punch_out_events": camera.get("punch_out_events") or [],
+                "pan_events": camera.get("pan_events") or [],
+                "stabilization": camera.get("stabilization") or "UNKNOWN",
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "reframe_strategy": camera.get("reframe_strategy") or "UNKNOWN",
+                "editor_transform": {
+                    "operation": camera.get("editor_transform", {}).get("operation") or "UNKNOWN",
+                    "authority": camera.get("editor_transform", {}).get("authority") or "UNKNOWN",
+                    "sample_count": len(keyframes),
+                    "zoom_range": [min(zooms), max(zooms)] if zooms else None,
+                    "rule": "reframe toward sampled face centers without claiming physical camera provenance",
+                },
+            },
+            "unresolved": ["physical camera motion versus baked editor transform"],
+            "confidence": camera.get("confidence", 0.0),
+        },
+        "captions": {
+            "observed": {
+                "style_families": captions["caption_style_families"],
+                "persistence_rules": captions["persistence_rules"],
+                "font_rules": captions["font_rules"],
+                "color_rules": {
+                    "known_style_family_fill_count": sum(color.get("profile_fill_colors", {}).values()),
+                    "median_text_color": color.get("measured_reel_median_text_color"),
+                    "median_stroke_color": color.get("measured_reel_median_stroke_color"),
+                    "dark_stroke_ratio": color.get("measured_dark_stroke_ratio"),
+                    "stroke_presence": color.get("profile_stroke_presence", {}),
+                },
+                "opacity_rules": {
+                    "rule": color.get("opacity_rule"),
+                    "status": color.get("fill_opacity", {}).get("evidence_status", "UNKNOWN"),
+                    "unresolved_count": captions["unresolved"]["opacity_count"],
+                },
+                "layout_rules": captions["layout_rules"],
+                "animation_families": captions["animation_families"],
+                "enter_exit_combos": {"common": common_combos, "rare_caption_count": rare_combo_count},
+            },
+            "recommended": {
+                "transfer_rule": "reuse observed weight, layout, persistence, and normalized animation families",
+            },
+            "unresolved": captions["unresolved"],
+            "confidence": captions["confidence"],
+        },
+        "deferred": DEFERRED,
+        "source_artifacts": {
+            "analysis": _source(analysis_path),
+            "edit_plan": _source(edit_plan_path),
+            "transitions": _source(transitions_path),
+            "camera": _source(camera_path),
+            "captions": _source(caption_grammar_path),
+        },
+        "confidence": {
+            "status": "MVP_READY_WITH_EXPLICIT_LIMITATIONS",
+            "cuts_pacing": "generic_analysis",
+            "transitions": "generic_analysis_with_conservative_authority",
+            "camera": camera.get("confidence", 0.0),
+            "captions": captions["confidence"]["overall"],
+            "overall": "medium_high",
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--analysis", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--edit-plan", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--transitions", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--camera", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--caption-grammar", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--reel-id", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    profile = build_profile(args.analysis, args.edit_plan, args.transitions, args.camera, args.caption_grammar, args.reel_id)
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(profile, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output": str(args.output), "reel_id": args.reel_id}))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6cee9a21ef9058fbbf8652ce175c416ccd93fd2c
