+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Record Step 4D bookkeeping correction, human acceptance, and final freeze."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import adjudicate_step4d_clipping_final as clipping
+from scripts.analysis import investigate_step4d_effect_evidence_validity as gate
+
+STATE_PATH = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4d_advanced_text_effects_freeze.json"
+SHADOW_FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4d_shadow_freeze.json"
+SHADOW_FREEZE_SHA256 = "bf788d25e02607e34a08b27a40005c5047906247bcce6cf8601d3b7ace9e11e8"
+SOURCE_CLOSURE = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_FINAL_CLIPPING_ADJUDICATION_CLOSURE_READINESS_20260928/20260928T170000000Z_human_review_ready"
+SOURCE_OCCLUSION = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_CAPTION_OCCLUSION_OWNERSHIP_ZORDER_20260928/20260928T153000000Z_human_review_ready"
+AUTHORITY_PATHS = {
+    "necessity_investigation": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECT_NECESSITY_INVESTIGATION_20260927_V1/20260927T190000000Z_investigation/step4d_effect_necessity_audit.json",
+    "effect_evidence_validity": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_VALIDITY_GATE_20260927_V2/20260927T223000000Z_investigation/step4d_effect_evidence_validity_audit.json",
+    "bounded_effect_evidence_repair": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_BOUNDED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_REPAIR_20260927_V3/20260928T000500000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract.json",
+    "source_required_adjudication": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_SOURCE_REQUIRED_EFFECT_ADJUDICATION_20260928_V2/20260928T013000000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication.json",
+    "bounded_shadow_implementation": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_BOUNDED_SHADOW_IMPLEMENTATION_20260928_V2/20260928T023000000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_shadow_ir_contract.json",
+    "calibrated_shadow_ir": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_SHADOW_PARAMETER_FIDELITY_20260928_V2/20260928T123000000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_shadow_ir_calibrated.json",
+    "shadow_human_acceptance": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_SHADOW_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_AND_FREEZE_20260928/20260928T130000000Z_human_accepted/step4d_shadow_human_acceptance.json",
+    "shadow_freeze": SHADOW_FREEZE,
+    "caption_occlusion_adjudication": SOURCE_OCCLUSION / "step4d_caption_occlusion_evidence.json",
+    "caption_occlusion_validation": SOURCE_OCCLUSION / "step4d_caption_occlusion_validation.json",
+    "final_clipping_adjudication": SOURCE_CLOSURE / "step4d_clipping_final_adjudication.json",
+    "final_clipping_validation": SOURCE_CLOSURE / "step4d_clipping_validation.json",
+}
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def relative(path: Path) -> str:
+    return str(path.resolve().relative_to(ROOT.resolve())).replace("\\", "/")
+
+
+def reference(path: Path) -> dict:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(path)
+    return {"path": relative(path), "sha256": sha256(path)}
+
+
+def verify_accepted_state() -> dict:
+    freeze = gate.prior.freeze_integrity()
+    if sha256(SHADOW_FREEZE) != SHADOW_FREEZE_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted shadow freeze drift")
+    for path in AUTHORITY_PATHS.values():
+        load(path)
+    clipping_adjudication = load(AUTHORITY_PATHS["final_clipping_adjudication"])
+    occlusion = load(AUTHORITY_PATHS["caption_occlusion_adjudication"])
+    if clipping_adjudication["class_verdict"] != "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE":
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted clipping verdict drift")
+    if occlusion["class_level_verdict"] != "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE":
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted occlusion verdict drift")
+    if any(row["final_verdict"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING" for row in clipping_adjudication["cases"]):
+        raise RuntimeError("unexpected clipping authority")
+    if occlusion["source_required_occlusion_identities"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("unexpected occlusion authority")
+    shadow = load(SHADOW_FREEZE)
+    if shadow["shadow_identity_accounting"]["positive_count"] != 1 or shadow["shadow_identity_accounting"]["negative_control_parameter_authority_count"] != 0 or shadow["shadow_identity_accounting"]["global_propagation"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted shadow authority drift")
+    return {"freeze_integrity": freeze, "shadow_freeze_sha256": sha256(SHADOW_FREEZE)}
+
+
+def closure_report(matrix: dict, capabilities: dict, acceptance_path: str, freeze_path: str) -> bytes:
+    lines = [
+        "RESULT: PASS_STEP_4D_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECTS_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION", "",
+        "HUMAN_DECISION: ACCEPT", "STEP_4D_CURRENT_VERSION_DECISION: ACCEPT",
+        "STEP_4D_FINAL_STATUS: COMPLETE / HUMAN-ACCEPTED / FROZEN CURRENT VERSION",
+        "ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECTS_STATUS: FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION_WITH_EXPLICIT_DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITIES", "",
+        "FINAL_EFFECT_CLASS_MATRIX",
+    ]
+    for name, row in matrix["classes"].items():
+        lines.append(f"- {name}: {json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True)}")
+    lines.extend(["", "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITIES"])
+    for row in capabilities["capabilities"]:
+        lines.append(f"- {row['id']}: {row['status']}; required before {row['required_before']}")
+    lines.extend([
+        "", "CURRENT_VERSION_COMPLETE_SEMANTICS: source-required shadow reproduced at accepted approximate fidelity; glow/texture/gradient not source-required; clipping/occlusion explicitly unsupported and not fabricated",
+        "PRODUCT_COMPLETE_SEMANTICS: NOT CLAIMED; generic clipping and occlusion detection remain required before final parity/release",
+        "QUALITY_TARGET_CLAIMED: NO", "LONG_TERM_TARGET: >=85% HUMAN-ACCEPTABLE RECONSTRUCTION on a representative benchmark",
+        "PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_CHANGED: NO", "UPSTREAM_ARTIFACTS_CHANGED: NO", "RESOLVE_MUTATED: NO",
+        "STEP_5_STATUS: UNBLOCKED / NOT STARTED", "STEP_6_STARTED: NO",
+        f"STEP4D_ACCEPTANCE_ARTIFACT_PATH: {acceptance_path}", f"STEP4D_FREEZE_ARTIFACT_PATH: {freeze_path}",
+        "STEP_4D_REOPEN_ALLOWED_NOW: NO", "NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: Step 5 — UNBLOCKED / NOT STARTED", "",
+    ])
+    return "\n".join(lines).encode()
+
+
+def build(output: Path, accepted_at: str) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    verified = verify_accepted_state()
+    matrix = clipping.class_matrix("UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE")
+    matrix.update({
+        "current_milestone_status": "COMPLETE_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+        "current_version_closure_ready": True, "human_acceptance_required_before_freeze": False,
+        "advanced_text_effects_status": "FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION_WITH_EXPLICIT_DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITIES",
+    })
+    capabilities = clipping.deferred_capabilities()
+    required_ids = ["CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"]
+    by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in capabilities["capabilities"]}
+    if set(by_id) != set(required_ids) or any(by_id[name]["status"] != "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY" or by_id[name]["required_before"] != "FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE" for name in required_ids):
+        raise RuntimeError("deferred capability accounting incomplete")
+    identities = {row["identity"] for row in load(AUTHORITY_PATHS["final_clipping_adjudication"])["cases"]}
+    shadow = load(SHADOW_FREEZE)["shadow_identity_accounting"]
+    identities.update(shadow["positive_identities"] + shadow["negative_controls"])
+    script_text = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    hardcoded = sorted(identity for identity in identities if identity in script_text)
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_final_closure_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4D_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECTS_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+        "freeze_integrity": verified["freeze_integrity"], "shadow_freeze_status": "PASS", "shadow_freeze_sha256": verified["shadow_freeze_sha256"],
+        "bookkeeping_correction": "PASS_CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2_ADDED",
+        "required_deferred_capabilities": required_ids, "required_before": "FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE",
+        "clipping_adjudication_changed": False, "occlusion_adjudication_changed": False, "unknown_pixel_semantics_changed": False,
+        "shadow_authority_changed": False, "production_effect_mechanisms_added": 0, "production_hardcoded_identities": hardcoded,
+        "generalization_gate": "PASS" if not hardcoded else "FAIL", "production_runtime_changed": False,
+        "upstream_artifacts_changed": False, "resolve_mutated": False, "step5_status": "UNBLOCKED_NOT_STARTED", "step6_started": False,
+        "human_decision": "ACCEPT", "step4d_current_version_decision": "ACCEPT", "step4d_final_status": "COMPLETE_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+    }
+    output_rel = relative(output)
+    acceptance_path = f"{output_rel}/step4d_human_acceptance.json"
+    freeze_path = relative(STATE_PATH)
+    report = closure_report(matrix, capabilities, acceptance_path, freeze_path)
+    core = {
+        "step4d_effect_class_final_matrix.json": json_bytes(matrix),
+        "step4d_deferred_required_capabilities.json": json_bytes(capabilities),
+        "step4d_final_closure_validation.json": json_bytes(validation),
+        "FINAL_REPORT.md": report,
+    }
+    acceptance = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_human_acceptance", "schema_version": 1, "accepted_at": accepted_at,
+        "human_decision": "ACCEPT", "step_4d_current_version_decision": "ACCEPT",
+        "human_decision_source": "ACCEPT_STEP_4D_CURRENT_VERSION_AFTER_REQUIRED_BOOKKEEPING_CORRECTION",
+        "bookkeeping_correction_satisfied": True,
+        "accepted_class_matrix": matrix["classes"],
+        "deferred_required_capabilities": required_ids,
+        "unsupported_capabilities_considered_solved": False,
+        "quality_target_claimed": False,
+        "accepted_artifacts": {name: {"path": f"{output_rel}/{name}", "sha256": sha256_bytes(data)} for name, data in core.items()},
+    }
+    core["step4d_human_acceptance.json"] = json_bytes(acceptance)
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_final_closure_determinism", "schema_version": 1,
+        "complete_generation_count": 2, "rerun_byte_identical": True,
+        "artifact_sha256": {name: sha256_bytes(data) for name, data in core.items()},
+    }
+    core["determinism_proof.json"] = json_bytes(proof)
+    authority = {name: reference(path) for name, path in AUTHORITY_PATHS.items()}
+    authority.update({name.removesuffix(".json").replace("FINAL_REPORT.md", "final_step4d_closure_report"): {"path": f"{output_rel}/{name}", "sha256": sha256_bytes(data)} for name, data in core.items()})
+    freeze = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_advanced_text_effects_freeze_state", "schema_version": 1, "updated_at": accepted_at,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4D_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECTS_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+        "step": "STEP_4D_ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECTS", "step4d_final_status": "COMPLETE_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+        "advanced_text_effects_status": "FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION_WITH_EXPLICIT_DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITIES",
+        "human_decision": "ACCEPT", "reopen_allowed_now": False,
+        "reopen_conditions": ["final_parity_material_inadequacy", "CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2_work_begins", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2_work_begins", "new_source_reel_requires_unsupported_advanced_effect"],
+        "effect_class_matrix": matrix["classes"], "deferred_required_capabilities": required_ids,
+        "frozen_step4d_authority": authority,
+        "upstream_freezes": verified["freeze_integrity"]["hashes"], "shadow_freeze_sha256": verified["shadow_freeze_sha256"],
+        "production_runtime_changed": False, "upstream_artifacts_changed": False, "resolve_mutated": False,
+        "quality_target_claimed": False, "step5_status": "UNBLOCKED_NOT_STARTED", "step6_started": False,
+    }
+    core["__freeze_state__"] = json_bytes(freeze)
+    return core
+
+
+def generate(output: Path, accepted_at: str) -> dict:
+    if output.exists(): raise FileExistsError(output)
+    if STATE_PATH.exists(): raise FileExistsError(STATE_PATH)
+    first, second = build(output, accepted_at), build(output, accepted_at)
+    if first != second: raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic Step 4D closure")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, data in first.items():
+        if name != "__freeze_state__": (output / name).write_bytes(data)
+    STATE_PATH.write_bytes(first["__freeze_state__"])
+    freeze = load(STATE_PATH)
+    for item in freeze["frozen_step4d_authority"].values():
+        path = ROOT / item["path"]
+        if not path.is_file() or sha256(path) != item["sha256"]: raise RuntimeError(f"frozen artifact mismatch: {path}")
+    return {"result": freeze["result"], "output": str(output), "freeze": str(STATE_PATH)}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True); parser.add_argument("--accepted-at", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args(); print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve(), args.accepted_at), sort_keys=True)); return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/compare_style_profiles_mvp.py b/scripts/analysis/compare_style_profiles_mvp.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bd86407106bb4a3167a51cbca52a2929bc786e6e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/compare_style_profiles_mvp.py
@@ -0,0 +1,238 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare two MVP style profiles without treating style differences as failures."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def _load(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
+        value = json.load(handle)
+    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != "video_cloner.style_profile.mvp.v1":
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported MVP style profile: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _unknown(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return value is None or value == "" or str(value).upper() in {"UNKNOWN", "UNRESOLVED"}
+
+
+def _check(name: str, reference: Any, candidate: Any, *, tolerance: float | None = None, limitation: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if limitation:
+        classification = "PIPELINE_LIMITATION"
+    elif _unknown(reference) or _unknown(candidate):
+        classification = "UNKNOWN"
+    elif reference == candidate:
+        classification = "MATCH"
+    elif tolerance is not None and isinstance(reference, (int, float)) and isinstance(candidate, (int, float)):
+        scale = max(abs(float(reference)), abs(float(candidate)), 1e-9)
+        classification = "SIMILAR" if abs(float(reference) - float(candidate)) / scale <= tolerance else "STYLE_DIFFERENCE"
+    else:
+        classification = "STYLE_DIFFERENCE"
+    return {"field": name, "classification": classification, "reference": reference, "candidate": candidate}
+
+
+def _set_check(name: str, reference: set[str], candidate: set[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not reference or not candidate:
+        classification = "UNKNOWN"
+    elif reference == candidate:
+        classification = "MATCH"
+    elif reference & candidate:
+        classification = "SIMILAR" if len(reference ^ candidate) <= 1 else "STYLE_DIFFERENCE"
+    else:
+        classification = "STYLE_DIFFERENCE"
+    return {
+        "field": name,
+        "classification": classification,
+        "reference": sorted(reference),
+        "candidate": sorted(candidate),
+        "shared": sorted(reference & candidate),
+    }
+
+
+def _overall(checks: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
+    labels = {row["classification"] for row in checks}
+    for label in ("STYLE_DIFFERENCE", "PIPELINE_LIMITATION", "UNKNOWN", "SIMILAR", "MATCH"):
+        if label in labels:
+            return label
+    return "UNKNOWN"
+
+
+def _transition_density(profile: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
+    observed = profile["transitions"]["observed"]
+    if observed.get("density_per_minute") is not None:
+        return float(observed["density_per_minute"])
+    count = sum((observed.get("families_present") or {}).values())
+    return round(count / float(profile["cuts_pacing"]["observed"]["duration_sec"]) * 60, 4)
+
+
+def _weights(profile: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    values = profile["captions"]["observed"]["font_rules"].get("intrinsic_weight_families", {})
+    return {str(value).lower() for value, count in values.items() if count and str(value).upper() != "UNKNOWN"}
+
+
+def _animation_families(profile: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    return {row["family"] for row in profile["captions"]["observed"].get("animation_families", []) if row["family"] != "unresolved"}
+
+
+def _hex_distance(left: str | None, right: str | None) -> float | None:
+    if _unknown(left) or _unknown(right):
+        return None
+    try:
+        a = tuple(int(left[index:index + 2], 16) for index in (1, 3, 5))
+        b = tuple(int(right[index:index + 2], 16) for index in (1, 3, 5))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    return round(sum((x - y) ** 2 for x, y in zip(a, b)) ** 0.5, 4)
+
+
+def compare_profiles(reference: dict[str, Any], candidate: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    rcuts = reference["cuts_pacing"]["observed"]
+    ccuts = candidate["cuts_pacing"]["observed"]
+    cuts = [
+        _check("duration_sec", rcuts["duration_sec"], ccuts["duration_sec"], tolerance=0.15),
+        _check("shot_count", rcuts["shot_count"], ccuts["shot_count"]),
+        _check("median_shot_duration_sec", rcuts["shot_duration_distribution_sec"]["median"], ccuts["shot_duration_distribution_sec"]["median"], tolerance=0.20),
+        _check("pacing_family", rcuts.get("source_pace_label"), ccuts.get("source_pace_label")),
+    ]
+
+    rtrans = reference["transitions"]["observed"]
+    ctrans = candidate["transitions"]["observed"]
+    candidate_authority = candidate["transitions"]["recommended"].get("merged_conservative_events", [])
+    transitions = [
+        _set_check("families", set(rtrans.get("families_present", {})), set(ctrans.get("families_present", {}))),
+        _check("density_per_minute", _transition_density(reference), _transition_density(candidate), tolerance=0.25),
+        _check("detector_actionable_count", len(rtrans.get("detector_actionable_events", [])), len(ctrans.get("detector_actionable_events", []))),
+        _check(
+            "candidate_authority_separation",
+            True,
+            not any(str(row.get("family", "")).endswith("_candidate") for row in candidate_authority),
+        ),
+    ]
+
+    rcam = reference["camera"]
+    ccam = candidate["camera"]
+    camera = [
+        _check("person_framing", rcam["observed"].get("framing"), ccam["observed"].get("framing")),
+        _check("subject_lock", rcam["observed"].get("subject_lock"), ccam["observed"].get("subject_lock")),
+        _check("reframe_strategy", rcam["recommended"].get("reframe_strategy"), ccam["recommended"].get("reframe_strategy")),
+        _check("stabilization", rcam["observed"].get("stabilization"), ccam["observed"].get("stabilization")),
+        _check("face_coverage", rcam["observed"].get("subject_observation", {}).get("coverage"), ccam["observed"].get("subject_observation", {}).get("coverage"), tolerance=0.20),
+        _check("pan_behavior_present", bool(rcam["observed"].get("pan_events")), bool(ccam["observed"].get("pan_events"))),
+        _check("punch_behavior_present", bool(rcam["observed"].get("punch_in_events") or rcam["observed"].get("punch_out_events")), bool(ccam["observed"].get("punch_in_events") or ccam["observed"].get("punch_out_events"))),
+        _check("motion_origin", rcam["observed"].get("camera_motion", {}).get("origin"), ccam["observed"].get("camera_motion", {}).get("origin")),
+    ]
+
+    rcap = reference["captions"]
+    ccap = candidate["captions"]
+    rcolor = rcap["observed"]["color_rules"]
+    ccolor = ccap["observed"]["color_rules"]
+    rlayout = rcap["observed"]["layout_rules"]
+    clayout = ccap["observed"]["layout_rules"]
+    ropacity = rcap["observed"]["opacity_rules"]
+    copacity = ccap["observed"]["opacity_rules"]
+    rtext = rcolor.get("median_text_color")
+    ctext = ccolor.get("median_text_color")
+    text_distance = _hex_distance(rtext, ctext)
+    captions = [
+        _check("layout", rlayout.get("dominant_position"), clayout.get("dominant_position")),
+        _set_check("weight_families", _weights(reference), _weights(candidate)),
+        _check("font_height_ratio", rlayout.get("measured_font_height", {}).get("ratio_median"), clayout.get("measured_font_height", {}).get("ratio_median"), tolerance=0.20),
+        {"field": "text_color", "classification": "SIMILAR" if text_distance is not None and text_distance <= 48 else "STYLE_DIFFERENCE" if text_distance is not None else "UNKNOWN", "reference": rtext, "candidate": ctext, "rgb_distance": text_distance},
+        _check("stroke_color", rcolor.get("median_stroke_color"), ccolor.get("median_stroke_color")),
+        _check("opacity_status", ropacity.get("status") or ("UNKNOWN" if ropacity.get("unresolved_count") else None), copacity.get("status") or ("UNKNOWN" if copacity.get("unresolved_count") else None)),
+        _check("median_caption_duration_sec", rcap["observed"]["persistence_rules"]["duration_seconds"]["median"], ccap["observed"]["persistence_rules"]["duration_seconds"]["median"], tolerance=0.25),
+        _set_check("animation_families", _animation_families(reference), _animation_families(candidate)),
+        _check("enter_exit_availability", "AVAILABLE", "UNKNOWN", limitation=ccap.get("confidence", {}).get("enter_exit") == 0.0),
+    ]
+
+    dimensions = {}
+    for name, checks in (("cuts_pacing", cuts), ("transitions", transitions), ("camera", camera), ("captions", captions)):
+        dimensions[name] = {"classification": _overall(checks), "checks": checks}
+
+    limitations = [
+        row["field"]
+        for dimension in dimensions.values()
+        for row in dimension["checks"]
+        if row["classification"] == "PIPELINE_LIMITATION"
+    ]
+    differences = [
+        f"{name}.{row['field']}"
+        for name, dimension in dimensions.items()
+        for row in dimension["checks"]
+        if row["classification"] == "STYLE_DIFFERENCE"
+    ]
+    candidate_sources = json.dumps(candidate.get("source_artifacts", {}), sort_keys=True).lower()
+    forbidden_source_dependency = any(term in candidate_sources for term in (reference["reel_id"].lower(), "gold", "drt"))
+    pipeline_pass = not forbidden_source_dependency and all(name in candidate for name in ("cuts_pacing", "transitions", "camera", "captions"))
+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner.style_profile_comparison.mvp.v1",
+        "reference_reel": reference["reel_id"],
+        "candidate_reel": candidate["reel_id"],
+        "dimensions": dimensions,
+        "pipeline_generalization": {
+            "status": "PASS" if pipeline_pass else "FAIL",
+            "usable_profile_produced": True,
+            "reel_specific_hacks_required": False,
+            "gold_or_drt_required": forbidden_source_dependency,
+            "resolve_required": False,
+            "manual_data_fabrication_required": False,
+            "transferred_fields": ["cuts_pacing", "transitions", "camera", "captions"],
+            "style_differences": differences,
+            "pipeline_limitations": limitations,
+            "ready_for_resolve_reconstruction_human_acceptance_test": pipeline_pass,
+        },
+        "verdict": "PASS_UNSEEN_REEL_MVP_GENERALIZATION" if pipeline_pass else "FAIL_UNSEEN_REEL_MVP_GENERALIZATION",
+    }
+
+
+def render_report(comparison: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    lines = [
+        "# MVP Style Profile Comparison",
+        "",
+        f"Reference: `{comparison['reference_reel']}`  ",
+        f"Candidate: `{comparison['candidate_reel']}`",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for name, dimension in comparison["dimensions"].items():
+        lines.extend([f"## {name.replace('_', ' ').title()} — {dimension['classification']}", ""])
+        for row in dimension["checks"]:
+            lines.append(f"- **{row['field']}**: {row['classification']} — reference `{row['reference']}`, candidate `{row['candidate']}`")
+        lines.append("")
+    gate = comparison["pipeline_generalization"]
+    lines.extend([
+        "## Generalization Verdict",
+        "",
+        f"- Pipeline quality: **{gate['status']}**",
+        f"- Style differences: {', '.join(gate['style_differences']) or 'none'}",
+        f"- Pipeline limitations: {', '.join(gate['pipeline_limitations']) or 'none'}",
+        f"- Resolve reconstruction/human test ready: **{str(gate['ready_for_resolve_reconstruction_human_acceptance_test']).upper()}**",
+        "",
+        f"**{comparison['verdict']}**",
+        "",
+    ])
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--reference", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    comparison = compare_profiles(_load(args.reference), _load(args.candidate))
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(comparison, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    args.report.write_text(render_report(comparison), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output": str(args.output), "report": str(args.report), "verdict": comparison["verdict"]}))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay.py b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..578239b4cc19beec19b572802b92aebd32a14221
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay.py
@@ -0,0 +1,250 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+
+ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("VIDEO_CLONER_ROOT", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])).resolve()
+F5A_CONTRACT = Path(
+    ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F5A_LISTING_OBJECT_LIFECYCLE_RECOVERY_20260930_V1/"
+    "20260930T171039690Z_luna_resume/first/step5a_f5a_compile_contract.json"
+)
+F5A_SHA256 = "52544783c9fa89d9bb36bdd56d2181f87b61796afe7ef34b80a101259fae6161"
+AUTO_AUTHORITY = Path("config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_static_style_position_adjudication.json")
+AUTO_AUTHORITY_SHA256 = "50ace714efe41ef0a434c17618022b96603c1965fcc16976b742d03c4ae09af4"
+HUMAN_AUTHORITY = Path("config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_human_static_style_adjudication.json")
+HUMAN_AUTHORITY_SHA256 = "151c3aac95eb71bcdd609321f85f88ab1d26c6546b89cc4d23d516fe29e113cf"
+STYLE_AUTHORITY = "ACCEPTED_HUMAN_STATIC_STYLE_ADJUDICATION"
+
+
+def _bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _load_pinned(root: Path, path: Path, expected: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    actual = _sha256(root / path)
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"pinned_hash_mismatch:{path.as_posix()}:{actual}")
+    return json.loads((root / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def _validate_human_authority(root: Path, authority: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    records = authority.get("records") or []
+    required = {"object_id", "property", "selected_value", "human_approved", "approval_phase", "source_evidence_refs"}
+    if authority.get("schema") != "video_cloner_accepted_human_static_style_adjudication":
+        raise ValueError("human_authority_schema")
+    if authority.get("authority") != STYLE_AUTHORITY or authority.get("f5_compile_authorized") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("human_authority_not_final")
+    if (authority.get("human_decision_count"), authority.get("human_approved_count"), authority.get("pending_human_decisions")) != (9, 9, 0):
+        raise ValueError("human_decision_accounting")
+    if len(records) != 9 or len({(row.get("object_id"), row.get("property")) for row in records}) != 9:
+        raise ValueError("human_authority_records")
+    for row in records:
+        if not required.issubset(row) or row["human_approved"] is not True or not row["source_evidence_refs"]:
+            raise ValueError("human_record_incomplete")
+        for evidence in row["source_evidence_refs"]:
+            if not (root / evidence).is_file():
+                raise ValueError(f"human_evidence_missing:{evidence}")
+
+
+def _targets(contract: dict[str, Any], object_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    rows = [row for collection in (contract["objects"], contract["identity_records"]) for row in collection if row["source_identity"] == object_id]
+    if not rows:
+        raise ValueError(f"style_target_missing:{object_id}")
+    return rows
+
+
+def _apply_font(row: dict[str, Any], value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    compiled = {
+        "resolve_family": value["family"],
+        "resolve_style": value["style"],
+        "source_authority": STYLE_AUTHORITY,
+        "value_role": "HUMAN_APPROVED_VALUE",
+    }
+    if value.get("italic"):
+        compiled["italic"] = True
+        compiled["italic_treatment"] = copy.deepcopy(value["italic_treatment"])
+    row["font"] = compiled
+
+
+def _apply_fill(row: dict[str, Any], value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    fill_type = value["type"]
+    if fill_type == "solid":
+        compiled = {"type": fill_type, "resolve_rgb": copy.deepcopy(value["rgb"])}
+    elif fill_type == "linear_gradient":
+        compiled = copy.deepcopy(value)
+        row["advanced_effects"]["gradient"] = "HUMAN_APPROVED_LINEAR_GRADIENT"
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported_fill_type:{fill_type}")
+    compiled.update({"source_authority": STYLE_AUTHORITY, "value_role": "HUMAN_APPROVED_VALUE"})
+    row["fill"] = compiled
+
+
+def _apply_opacity(row: dict[str, Any], value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if value.get("mode") != "constant" or not 0.0 <= float(value.get("value", -1.0)) <= 1.0:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported_opacity")
+    row["opacity"] = {
+        "mode": "constant",
+        "resolve_value": float(value["value"]),
+        "source_authority": STYLE_AUTHORITY,
+        "value_role": "HUMAN_APPROVED_VALUE",
+    }
+
+
+PROPERTY_HANDLERS: dict[str, Callable[[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]], None]] = {
+    "font": _apply_font,
+    "fill": _apply_fill,
+    "opacity": _apply_opacity,
+}
+AUTO_PATHS = {
+    "static_size": (("size", "resolve_value"), ("scale_decision", "static_base_size")),
+    "resolve_center": (("position", "resolve_center"),),
+}
+
+
+def _set_path(row: dict[str, Any], path: tuple[str, ...], value: Any) -> None:
+    target = row
+    for key in path[:-1]:
+        target = target[key]
+    target[path[-1]] = copy.deepcopy(value)
+
+
+def _apply_authorities(contract: dict[str, Any], automatic: dict[str, Any], human: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    for record in automatic.get("records") or []:
+        for row in _targets(contract, record["object_id"]):
+            for property_name in record["authorized_properties"]:
+                paths = AUTO_PATHS.get(property_name)
+                if paths is None:
+                    raise ValueError(f"unsupported_automatic_property:{property_name}")
+                for path in paths:
+                    _set_path(row, path, record[property_name])
+    for record in human["records"]:
+        handler = PROPERTY_HANDLERS.get(record["property"])
+        if handler is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported_human_property:{record['property']}")
+        for row in _targets(contract, record["object_id"]):
+            handler(row, record["selected_value"])
+
+
+def _domain(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], fields: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [{field: copy.deepcopy(row.get(field)) for field in fields} for row in rows]
+
+
+def _branch_counts(authority: dict[str, Any], f5a: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    source = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    target_ids = {row["object_id"].lower() for row in authority["records"]}
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in f5a["objects"]}
+    target_literals = {str(by_id[target]["text"]["value"]).lower() for target in target_ids}
+    reel_tokens = {Path(F5A_CONTRACT).stem.lower(), Path(HUMAN_AUTHORITY).stem.lower()}
+    counts = {"literal": 0, "identity": 0, "reel": 0, "human_choice": 0}
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        expression = node.test if isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.IfExp, ast.While, ast.Assert)) else None
+        if expression is None:
+            continue
+        values = [child.value.lower() for child in ast.walk(expression) if isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)]
+        counts["literal"] += sum(any(token in value for token in target_literals) for value in values)
+        counts["identity"] += sum(any(token in value for token in target_ids) for value in values)
+        counts["reel"] += sum(any(token in value for token in reel_tokens) for value in values)
+        counts["human_choice"] += sum("selected_winner" in value or "source_candidate_id" in value for value in values)
+    return counts
+
+
+def compile_f5_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    f5a = _load_pinned(root, F5A_CONTRACT, F5A_SHA256)
+    automatic = _load_pinned(root, AUTO_AUTHORITY, AUTO_AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    human = _load_pinned(root, HUMAN_AUTHORITY, HUMAN_AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    _validate_human_authority(root, human)
+
+    contract = copy.deepcopy(f5a)
+    _apply_authorities(contract, automatic, human)
+    branches = _branch_counts(human, f5a)
+    contract.update(
+        {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f5_human_approved_static_style_compile_contract",
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "base_f5a_contract": {"path": F5A_CONTRACT.as_posix(), "sha256": F5A_SHA256},
+            "automatic_static_style_authority": {"path": AUTO_AUTHORITY.as_posix(), "sha256": AUTO_AUTHORITY_SHA256},
+            "human_static_style_authority": {"path": HUMAN_AUTHORITY.as_posix(), "sha256": HUMAN_AUTHORITY_SHA256},
+            "human_decision_count": 9,
+            "human_approved_count": 9,
+            "pending_human_decisions": 0,
+            "production_branch_counts": branches,
+            "step_5b_status": "COMPLETE_HUMAN_APPROVED_STATIC_STYLE",
+            "resolve_mutated": False,
+        }
+    )
+
+    checks = {
+        "human_authority_complete": len(human["records"]) == 9 and human["human_approved_count"] == 9 and human["pending_human_decisions"] == 0,
+        "base_identity_accounting_113": len(contract["identity_records"]) == 113,
+        "base_renderable_accounting_62": contract["base_renderable_identity_count"] == 62,
+        "recovered_display_objects_3": contract["recovered_display_object_count"] == 3,
+        "final_renderable_objects_65": len(contract["objects"]) == contract["final_renderable_object_count"] == 65,
+        "text_domain_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("text",)) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("text",)) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("text",)) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("text",)),
+        "timing_domain_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("source_interval", "resolve_interval")) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("source_interval", "resolve_interval")) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("source_interval", "resolve_interval")) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("source_interval", "resolve_interval")),
+        "scale_domain_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("size", "scale_decision")) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("size", "scale_decision")) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("size", "scale_decision")) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("size", "scale_decision")),
+        "lifecycle_domain_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("renderable", "source_interval", "resolve_interval")) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("renderable", "source_interval", "resolve_interval")) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("renderable", "source_interval", "resolve_interval")) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("renderable", "source_interval", "resolve_interval")),
+        "ownership_domain_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("composition", "object_origin")) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("composition", "object_origin")) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("composition", "object_origin")) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("composition", "object_origin")),
+        "position_domain_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("position",)) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("position",)) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("position",)) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("position",)),
+        "motion_rotation_visibility_unchanged": _domain(contract["objects"], ("keyframes", "static_rotation")) == _domain(f5a["objects"], ("keyframes", "static_rotation")) and _domain(contract["identity_records"], ("keyframes", "static_rotation")) == _domain(f5a["identity_records"], ("keyframes", "static_rotation")),
+        "all_human_records_applied": all(any(row["source_identity"] == record["object_id"] for row in contract["objects"]) for record in human["records"]),
+        "zero_production_literal_branches": branches["literal"] == 0,
+        "zero_production_identity_branches": branches["identity"] == 0,
+        "zero_production_reel_branches": branches["reel"] == 0,
+        "zero_production_human_choice_branches": branches["human_choice"] == 0,
+        "resolve_not_mutated": contract["resolve_mutated"] is False and human["resolve_mutated"] is False and automatic["resolve_mutated"] is False,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f5d_human_approved_static_style_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_F5_HUMAN_APPROVED_STATIC_STYLE_IMPLEMENTATION" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL_F5_HUMAN_APPROVED_STATIC_STYLE_IMPLEMENTATION",
+        "all_pass": all(checks.values()),
+        "checks": checks,
+        "counts": {
+            "base_frozen_identities": 113,
+            "base_renderable_identities": 62,
+            "recovered_display_objects": 3,
+            "final_renderable_objects": 65,
+            "human_decisions": 9,
+            "human_approved": 9,
+            "pending_human_decisions": 0,
+        },
+        "production_branch_counts": branches,
+        "resolve_mutated": False,
+    }
+    if not validation["all_pass"]:
+        raise ValueError("f5_validation_failed")
+    return human, contract, validation
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    authority, contract, validation = compile_f5_contract()
+    artifacts = {
+        "step5_f5d_human_static_style_authority.json": authority,
+        "step5_f5_compile_contract.json": contract,
+        "step5_f5d_validation.json": validation,
+    }
+    for name, value in artifacts.items():
+        (output / name).write_bytes(_bytes(value))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "result": validation["result"], "counts": validation["counts"]}, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("VIDEO_CLONER_ROOT", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])).resolve()
+F5_CONTRACT = Path(
+    ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F5D_HUMAN_APPROVED_STATIC_STYLE_20261001_V1/"
+    "20261001T080530587Z/first/step5_f5_compile_contract.json"
+)
+F5_SHA256 = "2b7233d6392cae19bc5ea76446661a7be5fc23b67de0eff0d52c940fd9ab24e6"
+LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY = Path("config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_lifecycle_end_correction.json")
+LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY_SHA256 = "368092b4723021743e4f43784693f4bfbdce5645c7bdae25cbf761601214b047"
+AUTHORITY = "ACCEPTED_LIFECYCLE_END_CORRECTION"
+
+
+def _bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _load_pinned(root: Path, path: Path, expected: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    actual = _sha256(root / path)
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"pinned_hash_mismatch:{path.as_posix()}:{actual}")
+    return json.loads((root / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def _rows_by_id(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+    if len(result) != len(rows):
+        raise ValueError("duplicate_source_identity")
+    return result
+
+
+def _validate_authority(root: Path, authority: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    records = authority.get("records") or []
+    if authority.get("schema") != "video_cloner_accepted_lifecycle_end_correction":
+        raise ValueError("lifecycle_authority_schema")
+    if authority.get("authority") != AUTHORITY or authority.get("reproduction_authority") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("lifecycle_authority_not_accepted")
+    if not records or len({row.get("object_id") for row in records}) != len(records):
+        raise ValueError("lifecycle_authority_records")
+    mapping = authority.get("canonical_mapping") or {}
+    source_fps = float(mapping.get("source_fps") or 0.0)
+    timeline_fps = float(mapping.get("timeline_fps") or 0.0)
+    if source_fps <= 0.0 or timeline_fps <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("lifecycle_mapping_fps")
+    for record in records:
+        original = record.get("original_timeline_interval")
+        accepted = record.get("accepted_timeline_interval")
+        last_visible = record.get("last_visible_source_frame")
+        first_nonvisible = record.get("first_nonvisible_source_frame")
+        source_end = record.get("source_end_exclusive")
+        if not record.get("object_id") or record.get("reproduction_authority") is not True:
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_record_identity_or_authority")
+        if not isinstance(original, list) or not isinstance(accepted, list) or len(original) != 2 or len(accepted) != 2:
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_record_intervals")
+        if not all(isinstance(value, int) for value in (*original, *accepted, last_visible, first_nonvisible, source_end)):
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_record_integer_boundaries")
+        if original[0] != accepted[0] or accepted[1] <= original[1]:
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_record_end_only_extension")
+        if last_visible + 1 != first_nonvisible or first_nonvisible != source_end:
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_record_half_open_source_boundary")
+        mapped_end = round(source_end / source_fps * timeline_fps)
+        if record.get("accepted_timeline_end_exclusive") != mapped_end or accepted[1] != mapped_end:
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_record_canonical_mapping")
+        evidence = record.get("evidence_refs") or []
+        by_frame = {row.get("source_frame"): row for row in evidence if "source_frame" in row}
+        last = by_frame.get(last_visible) or {}
+        first = by_frame.get(first_nonvisible) or {}
+        if last.get("classification") not in {"VISIBLE", "TRANSITIONAL"}:
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_last_visible_evidence")
+        if last.get("classification") == "TRANSITIONAL" and last.get("object_visibility") != "PARTIALLY_VISIBLE":
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_transitional_visibility_evidence")
+        if first.get("classification") != "NOT_VISIBLE":
+            raise ValueError("lifecycle_first_nonvisible_evidence")
+        for item in evidence:
+            if _sha256(root / item["path"]) != item["sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"lifecycle_evidence_hash:{item['path']}")
+    source = authority.get("source_video") or {}
+    if _sha256(root / source["path"]) != source["sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("lifecycle_source_video_hash")
+
+
+def _branch_counts(authority: dict[str, Any], base: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    tree = ast.parse(Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    target_ids = {row["object_id"].lower() for row in authority["records"]}
+    by_id = _rows_by_id(base["objects"])
+    target_literals = {str(by_id[target]["text"]["value"]).lower() for target in target_ids}
+    reel_tokens = {Path(authority["source_video"]["path"]).stem.lower()}
+    counts = {"literal": 0, "identity": 0, "reel": 0}
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        expression = node.test if isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.IfExp, ast.While, ast.Assert)) else None
+        if expression is None:
+            continue
+        values = [child.value.lower() for child in ast.walk(expression) if isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)]
+        counts["literal"] += sum(any(token in value for token in target_literals) for value in values)
+        counts["identity"] += sum(any(token in value for token in target_ids) for value in values)
+        counts["reel"] += sum(any(token in value for token in reel_tokens) for value in values)
+    return counts
+
+
+def _without_intervals(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(row)
+    result.pop("source_interval", None)
+    result.pop("resolve_interval", None)
+    return result
+
+
+def compile_f6_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    base = _load_pinned(root, F5_CONTRACT, F5_SHA256)
+    authority = _load_pinned(root, LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY, LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    _validate_authority(root, authority)
+    contract = copy.deepcopy(base)
+    targets = {record["object_id"]: record for record in authority["records"]}
+    for collection_name in ("objects", "identity_records"):
+        rows = _rows_by_id(contract[collection_name])
+        for object_id, record in targets.items():
+            row = rows.get(object_id)
+            if row is None or row["source_interval"] != record["original_timeline_interval"] or row["resolve_interval"] != record["original_timeline_interval"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"lifecycle_original_interval_mismatch:{object_id}:{collection_name}")
+            row["source_interval"] = copy.deepcopy(record["accepted_timeline_interval"])
+            row["resolve_interval"] = copy.deepcopy(record["accepted_timeline_interval"])
+
+    branches = _branch_counts(authority, base)
+    contract.update(
+        {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction_compile_contract",
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "base_f5_contract": {"path": F5_CONTRACT.as_posix(), "sha256": F5_SHA256},
+            "lifecycle_end_correction_authority": {"path": LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY.as_posix(), "sha256": LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY_SHA256},
+            "lifecycle_end_correction_count": len(targets),
+            "production_branch_counts": branches,
+            "resolve_mutated": False,
+        }
+    )
+    base_objects, objects = _rows_by_id(base["objects"]), _rows_by_id(contract["objects"])
+    base_identities, identities = _rows_by_id(base["identity_records"]), _rows_by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+    changed = {
+        object_id
+        for before, after in ((base_objects, objects), (base_identities, identities))
+        for object_id in before
+        if (before[object_id]["source_interval"], before[object_id]["resolve_interval"])
+        != (after[object_id]["source_interval"], after[object_id]["resolve_interval"])
+    }
+    checks = {
+        "only_authorized_lifecycle_records_changed": changed == set(targets),
+        "lifecycle_start_unchanged": all(objects[key]["source_interval"][0] == targets[key]["original_timeline_interval"][0] for key in targets),
+        "source_end_is_half_open": all(row["source_end_exclusive"] == row["first_nonvisible_source_frame"] == row["last_visible_source_frame"] + 1 for row in targets.values()),
+        "canonical_source_timeline_mapping_used": all(row["accepted_timeline_end_exclusive"] == round(row["source_end_exclusive"] / authority["canonical_mapping"]["source_fps"] * authority["canonical_mapping"]["timeline_fps"]) for row in targets.values()),
+        "lifecycle_end_extended": all(row["accepted_timeline_interval"][1] > row["original_timeline_interval"][1] for row in targets.values()),
+        "all_non_lifecycle_fields_unchanged": all(_without_intervals(before[key]) == _without_intervals(after[key]) for before, after in ((base_objects, objects), (base_identities, identities)) for key in before),
+        "scale_domain_unchanged": all(before[key].get("keyframes", {}).get("scale") == after[key].get("keyframes", {}).get("scale") and before[key].get("scale_decision") == after[key].get("scale_decision") for before, after in ((base_objects, objects), (base_identities, identities)) for key in before),
+        "text_domain_unchanged": all(base_objects[key].get("text") == objects[key].get("text") for key in base_objects),
+        "style_domain_unchanged": all(_without_intervals(base_objects[key]) == _without_intervals(objects[key]) for key in base_objects),
+        "position_domain_unchanged": all(base_objects[key].get("position") == objects[key].get("position") for key in base_objects),
+        "ownership_domain_unchanged": all((base_objects[key].get("composition"), base_objects[key].get("object_origin")) == (objects[key].get("composition"), objects[key].get("object_origin")) for key in base_objects),
+        "other_lifecycle_intervals_unchanged": all((base_objects[key]["source_interval"], base_objects[key]["resolve_interval"]) == (objects[key]["source_interval"], objects[key]["resolve_interval"]) for key in set(base_objects) - set(targets)),
+        "final_renderable_objects_65": len(contract["objects"]) == contract["final_renderable_object_count"] == 65,
+        "human_approvals_unchanged": (contract["human_decision_count"], contract["human_approved_count"], contract["pending_human_decisions"]) == (9, 9, 0),
+        "zero_production_literal_branches": branches["literal"] == 0,
+        "zero_production_identity_branches": branches["identity"] == 0,
+        "zero_production_reel_branches": branches["reel"] == 0,
+        "resolve_not_mutated": contract["resolve_mutated"] is False and authority["resolve_mutated"] is False,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_F6_6000_LIFECYCLE_CORRECTION" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL_F6_6000_LIFECYCLE_CORRECTION",
+        "all_pass": all(checks.values()),
+        "checks": checks,
+        "counts": {
+            "base_frozen_identities": len(contract["identity_records"]),
+            "base_renderable_identities": contract["base_renderable_identity_count"],
+            "corrected_lifecycle_identities": len(changed),
+            "final_renderable_objects": len(contract["objects"]),
+            "human_approved": contract["human_approved_count"],
+        },
+        "production_branch_counts": branches,
+        "resolve_mutated": False,
+    }
+    if not validation["all_pass"]:
+        raise ValueError("f6_validation_failed")
+    return authority, contract, validation
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    authority, contract, validation = compile_f6_contract()
+    artifacts = {
+        "step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction_authority.json": authority,
+        "step5_f6_compile_contract.json": contract,
+        "step5_f6_validation.json": validation,
+    }
+    for name, value in artifacts.items():
+        (output / name).write_bytes(_bytes(value))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "result": validation["result"], "counts": validation["counts"]}, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(REPOSITORY_ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPOSITORY_ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_textplus_contract import ROOT, compile_contract as compile_base_contract
+
+
+LINKAGE_PATH = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/whole_reel_text_mask_linkage_audit_after_mask_isolation_repair.json"
+MISMATCH_ADJUDICATION_PATH = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_LINKAGE_CANDIDATE_ADJUDICATION_20260926/20260926T200000000Z_readonly/adjudication_decisions.json"
+DISPLAY_ADJUDICATION_PATH = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F2A_ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_AUTHORITY_20260930/20260930T095425875Z_adjudicated/step5a_f2a_accepted_display_text_adjudication.json"
+EXPECTED_DISPLAY_ADJUDICATION_SHA256 = "1e83de98b62e304d40408b2d0a74aa9de961aa87872baacc212dee5f0d81e6bb"
+STRONG_VISUAL_AUTHORITIES = {
+    "SOURCE_VISIBLE_OBSERVED_TEXT_BBOX_MATCH",
+    "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_LINKAGE_DECISION",
+    "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_OWNERSHIP_DECISION",
+}
+FRAGMENT_RELATIONSHIPS = {"ACCEPTED_PHYSICAL_WORD_FRAGMENT", "ACCEPTED_VISUAL_FRAGMENT"}
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
+    return " ".join(str(value or "").split()).casefold()
+
+
+def _decision(
+    linkage: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    renderable: bool,
+    text: str | None,
+    authority: str,
+    source_field: str | None,
+    suppression_reason: str | None,
+    provenance: dict[str, Any],
+    adjudication_group_id: str | None = None,
+    canonical_owner_identity: str | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "identity": linkage["identity"],
+        "renderable": renderable,
+        "selected_display_text": text,
+        "selected_display_text_normalized": normalize_text(text) or None,
+        "display_text_authority": authority,
+        "display_text_source_field": source_field,
+        "text_mask_relationship": linkage["text_mask_relationship"],
+        "contract_text": linkage.get("contract_text"),
+        "source_visible_text": linkage.get("source_visible_text"),
+        "font_scoring_text": linkage.get("font_scoring_text"),
+        "adjudication_group_id": adjudication_group_id,
+        "canonical_owner_identity": canonical_owner_identity,
+        "suppression_reason": suppression_reason,
+        "source_provenance": provenance,
+    }
+
+
+def build_display_adjudications(artifact: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    if artifact.get("schema") != "video_cloner_step5a_f2a_accepted_display_text_adjudication":
+        raise ValueError("display_adjudication_schema")
+    if artifact.get("authority") != "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_ADJUDICATION":
+        raise ValueError("display_adjudication_authority")
+    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for case in artifact.get("adjudications") or []:
+        for disposition in case.get("identity_dispositions") or []:
+            identity = disposition["identity"]
+            if identity in output:
+                raise ValueError(f"duplicate_display_adjudication:{identity}")
+            output[identity] = {
+                "accepted_display_text": case.get("accepted_display_text"),
+                "display_object_group_id": case.get("display_object_group_id"),
+                "case": case.get("case"),
+                **disposition,
+            }
+    return output
+
+
+def select_display_text(
+    linkage: dict[str, Any],
+    display_adjudication: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    mismatch_adjudication: dict[str, Any] | None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    relationship = str(linkage.get("text_mask_relationship") or "UNRESOLVED")
+    identity = linkage["identity"]
+    if display_adjudication is not None:
+        disposition = str(display_adjudication.get("disposition") or "")
+        group_id = display_adjudication.get("display_object_group_id")
+        owner = display_adjudication.get("canonical_owner_identity")
+        provenance = {
+            "artifact": DISPLAY_ADJUDICATION_PATH,
+            "case": display_adjudication.get("case"),
+            "disposition": disposition,
+        }
+        if disposition.startswith("RENDERABLE_CANONICAL_OWNER"):
+            text = str(display_adjudication.get("accepted_display_text") or "").strip()
+            if not text:
+                raise ValueError(f"empty_display_adjudication:{identity}")
+            return _decision(
+                linkage,
+                renderable=True,
+                text=text,
+                authority="ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_ADJUDICATION",
+                source_field="adjudications[].accepted_display_text",
+                suppression_reason=None,
+                provenance=provenance,
+                adjudication_group_id=group_id,
+                canonical_owner_identity=owner,
+            )
+        if disposition.startswith("NON_RENDERING_") or disposition.startswith("SUPPRESS_"):
+            return _decision(
+                linkage,
+                renderable=False,
+                text=None,
+                authority="ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_ADJUDICATION",
+                source_field="adjudications[].identity_dispositions[].disposition",
+                suppression_reason=disposition,
+                provenance=provenance,
+                adjudication_group_id=group_id,
+                canonical_owner_identity=owner,
+            )
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported_display_adjudication_disposition:{identity}:{disposition}")
+
+    if relationship == "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED":
+        return _decision(
+            linkage,
+            renderable=False,
+            text=None,
+            authority="UNRESOLVED",
+            source_field=None,
+            suppression_reason="EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED_WITHOUT_HIGHER_AUTHORITY",
+            provenance={"artifact": LINKAGE_PATH, "source_evidence_provenance": linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance")},
+        )
+
+    if relationship == "MISMATCH":
+        accepted = (
+            mismatch_adjudication is not None
+            and mismatch_adjudication.get("classification") == "HARMLESS_OCR_LINKAGE_MISMATCH"
+            and mismatch_adjudication.get("confidence") in {"HIGH", "MEDIUM"}
+            and mismatch_adjudication.get("layer") is None
+        )
+        text = str((mismatch_adjudication or {}).get("visual_text") or "").strip()
+        if accepted and text:
+            return _decision(
+                linkage,
+                renderable=True,
+                text=text,
+                authority="ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT_LINKAGE_ADJUDICATION",
+                source_field="adjudication_decisions[identity].visual_text",
+                suppression_reason=None,
+                provenance={"artifact": MISMATCH_ADJUDICATION_PATH, "decision": mismatch_adjudication},
+            )
+        return _decision(
+            linkage,
+            renderable=False,
+            text=None,
+            authority="CONTRADICTORY_TEXT_AUTHORITY",
+            source_field=None,
+            suppression_reason="UNSAFE_MISMATCH_WITHOUT_HIGHER_AUTHORITY",
+            provenance={"artifact": LINKAGE_PATH, "source_evidence_provenance": linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance")},
+        )
+
+    if relationship in FRAGMENT_RELATIONSHIPS:
+        text = str(linkage.get("font_scoring_text") or "").strip()
+        if text:
+            return _decision(
+                linkage,
+                renderable=True,
+                text=text,
+                authority=relationship,
+                source_field="font_scoring_text",
+                suppression_reason=None,
+                provenance={"artifact": LINKAGE_PATH, "source_evidence_provenance": linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance")},
+            )
+        return _decision(
+            linkage,
+            renderable=False,
+            text=None,
+            authority=relationship,
+            source_field=None,
+            suppression_reason="ACCEPTED_FRAGMENT_WITHOUT_LITERAL_TEXT",
+            provenance={"artifact": LINKAGE_PATH, "source_evidence_provenance": linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance")},
+        )
+
+    source_text = str(linkage.get("source_visible_text") or "").strip()
+    font_text = str(linkage.get("font_scoring_text") or "").strip()
+    contract_text = str(linkage.get("contract_text") or "").strip()
+    source_authority = str((linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance") or {}).get("authority") or "")
+    visual_agreement = (
+        bool(source_text)
+        and normalize_text(source_text) == normalize_text(font_text)
+        and source_authority in STRONG_VISUAL_AUTHORITIES
+    )
+    if relationship == "EXACT_MATCH" and visual_agreement:
+        if normalize_text(contract_text) == normalize_text(source_text):
+            text, selected_authority, source_field = contract_text, "SAFE_CONTRACT_TEXT_AGREEMENT", "contract_text"
+        else:
+            text, selected_authority, source_field = source_text, "STRONG_ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT", "source_visible_text"
+        return _decision(
+            linkage,
+            renderable=True,
+            text=text,
+            authority=selected_authority,
+            source_field=source_field,
+            suppression_reason=None,
+            provenance={"artifact": LINKAGE_PATH, "source_evidence_provenance": linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance")},
+        )
+
+    return _decision(
+        linkage,
+        renderable=False,
+        text=None,
+        authority="UNSAFE_OR_INCONSISTENT_TEXT_AUTHORITY",
+        source_field=None,
+        suppression_reason="NO_SAFE_DISPLAY_TEXT_AUTHORITY",
+        provenance={"artifact": LINKAGE_PATH, "source_evidence_provenance": linkage.get("source_evidence_provenance")},
+    )
+
+
+def looks_transcript_like(text: str | None) -> bool:
+    value = str(text or "")
+    return any(marker in value for marker in (". ", "? ", "! ", "; ", ": ", ", "))
+
+
+def _without_text_domain(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = copy.deepcopy(row)
+    value.pop("text", None)
+    value.pop("renderable", None)
+    value.pop("display_text_decision", None)
+    return value
+
+
+def compile_f2_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    base_contract, base_validation = compile_base_contract(root)
+    linkage_path = root / LINKAGE_PATH
+    mismatch_path = root / MISMATCH_ADJUDICATION_PATH
+    display_path = root / DISPLAY_ADJUDICATION_PATH
+    if sha(display_path) != EXPECTED_DISPLAY_ADJUDICATION_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("display_adjudication_hash_drift")
+    linkage_artifact = read(linkage_path)
+    mismatch_artifact = read(mismatch_path)
+    display_artifact = read(display_path)
+    linkage = {row["identity"]: row for row in linkage_artifact["identities"]}
+    display = build_display_adjudications(display_artifact)
+    base_ids = [row["source_identity"] for row in base_contract["objects"]]
+    if len(base_ids) != 113 or set(base_ids) != set(linkage) or not set(display).issubset(linkage):
+        raise ValueError("f2_identity_accounting")
+
+    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for base_row in base_contract["objects"]:
+        identity = base_row["source_identity"]
+        decision = select_display_text(linkage[identity], display.get(identity), mismatch_artifact.get(identity))
+        row = copy.deepcopy(base_row)
+        row["renderable"] = decision["renderable"]
+        row["display_text_decision"] = decision
+        row["text"] = {
+            "value": decision["selected_display_text"],
+            "source_authority": decision["display_text_authority"],
+            "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE" if decision["renderable"] else "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED",
+        }
+        records.append(row)
+        decisions.append(decision)
+
+    objects = [row for row in records if row["renderable"]]
+    suspicious = [
+        row["source_identity"]
+        for row in objects
+        if looks_transcript_like(row["text"]["value"])
+        and row["display_text_decision"]["display_text_authority"]
+        not in {"ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_ADJUDICATION", "STRONG_ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT", "ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT_LINKAGE_ADJUDICATION"}
+    ]
+    counts = {
+        "total_frozen_identities": len(records),
+        "renderable_identities": len(objects),
+        "non_rendering_alias_identities": sum(str(row["suppression_reason"] or "").startswith("NON_RENDERING_") for row in decisions),
+        "suppressed_unresolved_identities": sum(not row["renderable"] and row["text_mask_relationship"] == "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED" for row in decisions),
+        "suppressed_unsafe_mismatch_identities": sum(not row["renderable"] and row["text_mask_relationship"] == "MISMATCH" and not str(row["suppression_reason"] or "").startswith("NON_RENDERING_") for row in decisions),
+        "suppressed_other_unsafe_identities": sum(not row["renderable"] and row["text_mask_relationship"] not in {"EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED", "MISMATCH"} and not str(row["suppression_reason"] or "").startswith("NON_RENDERING_") for row in decisions),
+        "adjudicated_display_text_identities": len(display),
+        "source_visual_text_identities": sum(row["display_text_authority"] in {"STRONG_ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT", "ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT_LINKAGE_ADJUDICATION"} for row in decisions),
+        "accepted_fragment_identities": sum(row["renderable"] and row["display_text_authority"] in FRAGMENT_RELATIONSHIPS for row in decisions),
+        "safe_contract_text_identities": sum(row["display_text_authority"] == "SAFE_CONTRACT_TEXT_AGREEMENT" for row in decisions),
+    }
+    inputs = dict(base_contract["inputs"])
+    inputs.update({
+        "text_mask_linkage": {"path": LINKAGE_PATH, "sha256": sha(linkage_path)},
+        "mismatch_adjudication": {"path": MISMATCH_ADJUDICATION_PATH, "sha256": sha(mismatch_path)},
+        "accepted_display_text_adjudication": {"path": DISPLAY_ADJUDICATION_PATH, "sha256": sha(display_path)},
+    })
+    contract = copy.deepcopy(base_contract)
+    contract.update({
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f2_text_authority_compile_contract",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "inputs": inputs,
+        "base_compile_contract_sha256": digest(base_contract),
+        "identity_count": len(records),
+        "object_count": len(objects),
+        "identity_records": records,
+        "objects": objects,
+        "text_authority_precedence": [
+            "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_ADJUDICATION",
+            "STRONG_CONSISTENT_ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT",
+            "ACCEPTED_VISUAL_FRAGMENT",
+            "SAFE_CONTRACT_TEXT_AGREEMENT",
+            "FAIL_CLOSED",
+        ],
+        "resolve_mutated": False,
+    })
+    checks = {
+        "base_preflight_passed": base_validation["all_pass"] is True,
+        "identity_accounting_113": len(records) == len(decisions) == 113,
+        "renderable_object_filter_exact": len(objects) == sum(row["renderable"] for row in decisions),
+        "no_renderable_identity_lacks_authority": all(row["selected_display_text"] and row["display_text_authority"] and row["source_provenance"] for row in decisions if row["renderable"]),
+        "non_text_domains_unchanged": all(_without_text_domain(base) == _without_text_domain(current) for base, current in zip(base_contract["objects"], records)),
+        "no_unsafe_transcript_like_visible_text": not suspicious,
+        "all_adjudicated_members_follow_disposition": all(row["display_text_authority"] == "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_TEXT_ADJUDICATION" for row in decisions if row["identity"] in display),
+        "freeze_hashes_match": all(row["match"] for row in contract["freeze_integrity"]),
+        "resolve_not_mutated": contract["resolve_mutated"] is False,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f2_text_authority_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "checks": checks,
+        "all_pass": all(checks.values()),
+        "counts": counts,
+        "full_sentence_dump_cases_remaining": suspicious,
+        "unsafe_visible_text_identities": [row["identity"] for row in decisions if row["renderable"] and (not row["selected_display_text"] or not row["source_provenance"])],
+        "other_text_authority_blockers": [],
+        "contract_sha256": digest(contract),
+    }
+    decision_artifact = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f2_text_authority_decisions",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "inputs": {name: inputs[name] for name in ("text_mask_linkage", "mismatch_adjudication", "accepted_display_text_adjudication")},
+        "counts": counts,
+        "decisions": decisions,
+    }
+    return contract, validation, decision_artifact
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    out = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    first = compile_f2_contract()
+    second = compile_f2_contract()
+    names = ("step5a_f2_compile_contract.json", "step5a_f2_validation.json", "step5a_f2_text_authority_decisions.json")
+    first_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, first)}
+    second_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, second)}
+    hashes = {
+        name: {
+            "first_sha256": hashlib.sha256(first_payloads[name]).hexdigest(),
+            "second_sha256": hashlib.sha256(second_payloads[name]).hexdigest(),
+            "byte_identical": first_payloads[name] == second_payloads[name],
+        }
+        for name in names
+    }
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f2_determinism_proof",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "artifacts": hashes,
+        "deterministic": all(row["byte_identical"] for row in hashes.values()),
+    }
+    if not first[1]["all_pass"] or not proof["deterministic"]:
+        raise SystemExit(2)
+    for name, payload in first_payloads.items():
+        (out / name).write_bytes(payload)
+    (out / "step5a_f2_determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    counts = first[1]["counts"]
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output_dir": str(out), "counts": counts, "deterministic": True}))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority.py b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority.py
new file mode 100644
