--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,319 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Iterable
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+F2_CONTRACT_PATH = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F2_GENERIC_TEXT_AUTHORITY_REPAIR_20260930_V1/20260930T110048416Z_luna_execute/step5a_f2_compile_contract.json"
+EXPECTED_F2_SHA256 = "c0978298eacc3aa079e5b19a6a0ef893aac74c24f82ed0a795f37c77fe9b16d3"
+EXPECTED_SCALE_AUTHORITIES = {
+    ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F3A2_6000_SCALE_LIFECYCLE_BOUNDARY_20260930/20260930T123557715Z_adjudicated/step5a_f3a2_6000_scale_lifecycle_boundary_adjudication.json": "e8d20e25a41f6bb6929149ae5c8cac5945933ccb3cbd51d8b284b080334bb25e",
+}
+SAFE_INTERPOLATIONS = {"LINEAR", "HOLD"}
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def absolute_size(base_size: float, relative_scale: float) -> float:
+    base, ratio = float(base_size), float(relative_scale)
+    if not math.isfinite(base) or base <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid_static_base_size")
+    if not math.isfinite(ratio) or ratio <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid_relative_scale")
+    return round(base * ratio, 9)
+
+
+def load_scale_authorities(root: Path, expected: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, str]]]:
+    expected = expected or EXPECTED_SCALE_AUTHORITIES
+    authorities: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    inputs: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for relative_path, expected_hash in expected.items():
+        path = root / relative_path
+        actual_hash = sha(path)
+        if actual_hash != expected_hash:
+            raise ValueError(f"scale_authority_hash_drift:{relative_path}")
+        artifact = read(path)
+        if artifact.get("schema") != "video_cloner_step5a_f3a2_scale_lifecycle_boundary_adjudication":
+            raise ValueError(f"scale_authority_schema:{relative_path}")
+        if artifact.get("authority") != "ACCEPTED_SCALE_REPRODUCTION_ADJUDICATION" or artifact.get("reproduction_authority") is not True:
+            raise ValueError(f"scale_authority_not_accepted:{relative_path}")
+        if artifact.get("reexpansion_authorized") is not False:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsafe_reexpansion_authority:{relative_path}")
+        policy = artifact.get("interpolation_policy") or {}
+        if any(policy.get(flag) is not False for flag in ("overshoot_allowed", "undershoot_allowed", "new_extrema_allowed", "synthetic_rebound_allowed")):
+            raise ValueError(f"unsafe_interpolation_policy:{relative_path}")
+        phases = {row["phase"]: row for row in artifact.get("phase_authority") or []}
+        if not phases or any(row.get("interpolation") not in SAFE_INTERPOLATIONS for row in phases.values()):
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported_phase_interpolation:{relative_path}")
+        anchors = artifact.get("relative_scale_anchors") or []
+        identity = str(artifact.get("identity") or "")
+        if not identity or not anchors or identity in authorities:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid_scale_authority_identity:{relative_path}")
+        authorities[identity] = {**copy.deepcopy(artifact), "_path": relative_path, "_sha256": actual_hash, "_phases": phases}
+        inputs[identity] = {"path": relative_path, "sha256": actual_hash}
+    return authorities, inputs
+
+
+def _suppression_reason(row: dict[str, Any], diagnostic: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
+    if not row.get("renderable"):
+        return "NON_RENDERABLE_IDENTITY"
+    sources = {str(key.get("source") or "") for key in diagnostic}
+    if "STEP_4C_EDITOR_NEUTRAL_KEYFRAME" in sources:
+        return "NO_ACCEPTED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_ORPHAN_STEP4C"
+    if diagnostic:
+        return "NO_ACCEPTED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_RAW_MEASUREMENTS_ONLY"
+    return "NO_ACCEPTED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY"
+
+
+def compile_scale_decision(row: dict[str, Any], scale_authority: dict[str, Any] | None) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    identity = row["source_identity"]
+    renderable = row.get("renderable") is True
+    base_size = float(row["size"]["resolve_value"])
+    diagnostic = copy.deepcopy((row.get("keyframes") or {}).get("scale") or [])
+    common = {
+        "identity": identity,
+        "renderable": renderable,
+        "static_base_size": base_size,
+        "static_base_size_authority": row["size"].get("source_authority"),
+        "diagnostic_input_scale_measurements": diagnostic,
+    }
+    if not renderable or scale_authority is None:
+        reason = _suppression_reason(row, diagnostic)
+        return [], {
+            **common,
+            "scale_authority_status": "SUPPRESSED",
+            "scale_authority_source": None,
+            "relative_scale_anchors": [],
+            "compiled_absolute_size_anchors": [],
+            "interpolation_policy": "STATIC_BASE_SIZE",
+            "scale_suppression_reason": reason,
+            "provenance": {"f2_diagnostic_measurements_preserved": bool(diagnostic)},
+        }
+
+    if scale_authority.get("identity") != identity:
+        raise ValueError(f"scale_authority_identity_mismatch:{identity}")
+    start, end = map(int, row["source_interval"])
+    raw_anchors = copy.deepcopy(scale_authority["relative_scale_anchors"])
+    frames = [int(anchor["timeline_frame"]) for anchor in raw_anchors]
+    if frames != sorted(set(frames)):
+        raise ValueError(f"scale_anchor_order:{identity}")
+    if any(not start <= frame < end for frame in frames):
+        raise ValueError(f"scale_anchor_bounds:{identity}")
+    phase_rows = scale_authority["_phases"]
+    if any(str(anchor.get("phase") or "") not in phase_rows for anchor in raw_anchors):
+        raise ValueError(f"scale_anchor_phase:{identity}")
+
+    compiled: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for index, anchor in enumerate(raw_anchors):
+        phase = str(anchor["phase"])
+        ratio = float(anchor["relative_scale"])
+        if index + 1 == len(raw_anchors):
+            interpolation = "NONE"
+        else:
+            next_phase = str(raw_anchors[index + 1]["phase"])
+            interpolation = "HOLD" if phase == next_phase == "PLATEAU" else "LINEAR"
+        compiled.append({
+            "timeline_frame": int(anchor["timeline_frame"]),
+            "local_frame": int(anchor["timeline_frame"]) - start,
+            "value": absolute_size(base_size, ratio),
+            "relative_scale": ratio,
+            "authority": scale_authority["authority"],
+            "source": "STEP5A_F3A2_ACCEPTED_SCALE_AUTHORITY",
+            "phase": phase,
+            "interpolation_to_next": interpolation,
+            "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE",
+        })
+
+    contraction_start = int(scale_authority["phase_boundaries"]["contraction_start"]["timeline_frame"])
+    contraction_values = [key["relative_scale"] for key in compiled if key["timeline_frame"] >= contraction_start]
+    if any(right > left for left, right in zip(contraction_values, contraction_values[1:])):
+        raise ValueError(f"reexpansion_after_contraction:{identity}")
+    if any(key["interpolation_to_next"] not in SAFE_INTERPOLATIONS | {"NONE"} for key in compiled):
+        raise ValueError(f"unsafe_compiled_interpolation:{identity}")
+
+    source = {"path": scale_authority["_path"], "sha256": scale_authority["_sha256"], "schema": scale_authority["schema"]}
+    return compiled, {
+        **common,
+        "scale_authority_status": "AUTHORIZED",
+        "scale_authority_source": source,
+        "relative_scale_anchors": raw_anchors,
+        "compiled_absolute_size_anchors": copy.deepcopy(compiled),
+        "interpolation_policy": copy.deepcopy(scale_authority["interpolation_policy"]),
+        "scale_suppression_reason": None,
+        "provenance": {"accepted_scale_authority": source, "f2_diagnostic_measurements_replaced": len(diagnostic)},
+    }
+
+
+def _without_f3_scale(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = copy.deepcopy(row)
+    value.pop("scale_decision", None)
+    value["keyframes"]["scale"] = []
+    return value
+
+
+def _count_keys(rows: Iterable[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
+    return sum(len((row.get("keyframes") or {}).get("scale") or []) for row in rows)
+
+
+def compile_f3_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    f2_path = root / F2_CONTRACT_PATH
+    f2_hash = sha(f2_path)
+    if f2_hash != EXPECTED_F2_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("f2_contract_hash_drift")
+    f2 = read(f2_path)
+    if f2.get("schema") != "video_cloner_step5a_f2_text_authority_compile_contract":
+        raise ValueError("f2_contract_schema")
+    if f2.get("identity_count") != 113 or f2.get("object_count") != 62:
+        raise ValueError("f2_identity_accounting")
+    authorities, authority_inputs = load_scale_authorities(root)
+
+    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for source in f2["identity_records"]:
+        row = copy.deepcopy(source)
+        compiled, decision = compile_scale_decision(row, authorities.get(row["source_identity"]))
+        row["keyframes"]["scale"] = compiled
+        row["scale_decision"] = decision
+        records.append(row)
+        decisions.append(decision)
+    objects = [row for row in records if row["renderable"]]
+
+    f2_scale_rows = [key for row in f2["identity_records"] for key in row["keyframes"]["scale"]]
+    f2_renderable_scale_rows = [key for row in f2["identity_records"] if row["renderable"] for key in row["keyframes"]["scale"]]
+    compiled_rows = [key for row in records for key in row["keyframes"]["scale"]]
+    authorized = [decision["identity"] for decision in decisions if decision["scale_authority_status"] == "AUTHORIZED"]
+    unit_errors = sum(
+        abs(float(key["value"]) - absolute_size(row["size"]["resolve_value"], key["relative_scale"])) > 1e-9
+        for row in records for key in row["keyframes"]["scale"]
+    )
+    raw_ratio_as_absolute = sum(abs(float(key["value"]) - float(key["relative_scale"])) <= 1e-9 for key in compiled_rows)
+    max_static_row = max(objects, key=lambda row: float(row["size"]["resolve_value"]))
+    animated = [(row, key) for row in objects for key in row["keyframes"]["scale"]]
+    max_animated_row, max_animated_key = max(animated, key=lambda pair: float(pair[1]["value"]))
+    counts = {
+        "total_identities": len(records),
+        "renderable_identities": len(objects),
+        "current_f2_scale_key_count": len(f2_scale_rows),
+        "current_f2_renderable_scale_key_count": len(f2_renderable_scale_rows),
+        "authorized_scale_identities": len(authorized),
+        "authorized_scale_identity_list": authorized,
+        "authorized_relative_scale_key_count": sum(len(decision["relative_scale_anchors"]) for decision in decisions if decision["scale_authority_status"] == "AUTHORIZED"),
+        "final_editor_scale_key_count": len(compiled_rows),
+        "suppressed_raw_measurement_scale_keys": sum(key.get("source") == "STEP_4B_RAW_SAMPLE" for key in f2_scale_rows),
+        "suppressed_orphan_scale_keys": sum(key.get("source") == "STEP_4C_EDITOR_NEUTRAL_KEYFRAME" for key in f2_scale_rows),
+        "suppressed_renderable_orphan_scale_keys": sum(key.get("source") == "STEP_4C_EDITOR_NEUTRAL_KEYFRAME" for key in f2_renderable_scale_rows),
+        "unauthorized_scale_commands": sum(key.get("source") != "STEP5A_F3A2_ACCEPTED_SCALE_AUTHORITY" for key in compiled_rows),
+        "non_renderable_scale_commands": _count_keys(row for row in records if not row["renderable"]),
+        "relative_as_absolute_unit_errors": unit_errors,
+        "raw_ratio_as_absolute_count": raw_ratio_as_absolute,
+    }
+    safety = {
+        "max_static_base_size": float(max_static_row["size"]["resolve_value"]),
+        "identity_with_max_static_base_size": max_static_row["source_identity"],
+        "max_compiled_animated_size": float(max_animated_key["value"]),
+        "identity_with_max_animated_size": max_animated_row["source_identity"],
+        "interpolation_overshoot_risk": 0,
+        "reexpansion_after_contraction": False,
+    }
+
+    contract = copy.deepcopy(f2)
+    inputs = copy.deepcopy(f2["inputs"])
+    inputs["accepted_scale_reproduction_authorities"] = authority_inputs
+    contract.update({
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f3_scale_compile_contract",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "base_f2_contract": {"path": F2_CONTRACT_PATH, "sha256": f2_hash},
+        "inputs": inputs,
+        "identity_records": records,
+        "objects": objects,
+        "scale_compilation": {"counts": counts, "oversize_safety": safety},
+        "resolve_mutated": False,
+    })
+    base_by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in f2["identity_records"]}
+    checks = {
+        "identity_accounting_113": len(records) == 113,
+        "renderable_identity_accounting_62": len(objects) == 62,
+        "f2_scale_accounting_44_total_43_renderable": len(f2_scale_rows) == 44 and len(f2_renderable_scale_rows) == 43,
+        "only_pinned_authorities_consumed": set(authorized) == set(authorities),
+        "one_authorized_scale_identity": len(authorized) == 1,
+        "nine_authorized_relative_anchors": counts["authorized_relative_scale_key_count"] == 9,
+        "nine_final_editor_scale_keys": counts["final_editor_scale_key_count"] == 9,
+        "no_unauthorized_scale_commands": counts["unauthorized_scale_commands"] == 0,
+        "no_non_renderable_scale_commands": counts["non_renderable_scale_commands"] == 0,
+        "no_relative_as_absolute_unit_errors": unit_errors == 0 and raw_ratio_as_absolute == 0,
+        "no_interpolation_overshoot_risk": safety["interpolation_overshoot_risk"] == 0,
+        "no_reexpansion_after_contraction": safety["reexpansion_after_contraction"] is False,
+        "non_scale_domains_unchanged": all(_without_f3_scale(base_by_id[row["source_identity"]]) == _without_f3_scale(row) for row in records),
+        "text_unchanged": all(base_by_id[row["source_identity"]]["text"] == row["text"] for row in records),
+        "timing_unchanged": all(base_by_id[row["source_identity"]]["resolve_interval"] == row["resolve_interval"] for row in records),
+        "position_unchanged": all(base_by_id[row["source_identity"]]["keyframes"]["position"] == row["keyframes"]["position"] for row in records),
+        "freeze_hashes_match": all(item["match"] for item in contract["freeze_integrity"]),
+        "resolve_not_mutated": contract["resolve_mutated"] is False,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f3_scale_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "checks": checks,
+        "all_pass": all(checks.values()),
+        "counts": counts,
+        "oversize_safety": safety,
+        "contract_sha256": digest(contract),
+    }
+    decision_artifact = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f3_scale_decisions",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "inputs": {"f2": contract["base_f2_contract"], "scale_authorities": authority_inputs},
+        "counts": counts,
+        "decisions": decisions,
+    }
+    return contract, validation, decision_artifact
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    out = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    first = compile_f3_contract()
+    second = compile_f3_contract()
+    names = ("step5a_f3_compile_contract.json", "step5a_f3_validation.json", "step5a_f3_scale_decisions.json")
+    first_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, first)}
+    second_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, second)}
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f3_determinism_proof",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "artifacts": {name: {"first_sha256": hashlib.sha256(first_payloads[name]).hexdigest(), "second_sha256": hashlib.sha256(second_payloads[name]).hexdigest(), "byte_identical": first_payloads[name] == second_payloads[name]} for name in names},
+    }
+    proof["deterministic"] = all(row["byte_identical"] for row in proof["artifacts"].values())
+    if not first[1]["all_pass"] or not proof["deterministic"]:
+        raise SystemExit(2)
+    for name, payload in first_payloads.items():
+        (out / name).write_bytes(payload)
+    (out / "step5a_f3_determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output_dir": str(out), "counts": first[1]["counts"], "deterministic": True}))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery.py b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery.py

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("VIDEO_CLONER_ROOT", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])).resolve()
+F3_CONTRACT = Path(
+    ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F3_GENERIC_SCALE_SIZE_REPAIR_20260930_V1/"
+    "20260930T130023481Z_luna_execute/first/step5a_f3_compile_contract.json"
+)
+F3_SHA256 = "97a663e705854e5880fb8bdbf2c1b5ec9c135eba1bba6c54b2c85572af7f5775"
+AUTHORITY_GLOB = "config/*.accepted_display_object_recovery.json"
+AUTHORITY_SHA256 = "84897912db92d43faf63950dffaa00018e5a0ab952f400837d170839ad91fd40"
+
+
+def _bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _load_pinned(path: Path, expected_hash: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    actual_hash = _sha256(path)
+    if actual_hash != expected_hash:
+        raise ValueError(f"pinned_hash_mismatch:{path.as_posix()}:{actual_hash}")
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def load_recovery_authority(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Path]:
+    paths = sorted(root.glob(AUTHORITY_GLOB))
+    matches = [path for path in paths if _sha256(path) == AUTHORITY_SHA256]
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"accepted_recovery_authority_count:{len(matches)}")
+    authority = _load_pinned(matches[0], AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    if authority.get("schema") != "video_cloner_accepted_display_object_recovery":
+        raise ValueError("accepted_recovery_authority_schema")
+    if authority.get("authority") != "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY":
+        raise ValueError("accepted_recovery_authority_status")
+    for artifact in authority.get("evidence_artifacts", []):
+        actual_hash = _sha256(root / artifact["path"])
+        if actual_hash != artifact["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"evidence_hash_mismatch:{artifact['path']}:{actual_hash}")
+    return authority, matches[0]
+
+
+def _validate_record(record: dict[str, Any], authority: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required_text = str(record.get("accepted_display_text") or "").strip()
+    if not required_text or record.get("source_existence") != "PROVEN" or record.get("renderable") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("recovery_requires_proven_text_and_renderability")
+    source_start = record.get("source_visible_start_frame")
+    source_end = record.get("source_visible_end_frame")
+    timeline_start = record.get("timeline_start_frame")
+    timeline_end = record.get("timeline_end_frame")
+    if not all(isinstance(value, int) for value in (source_start, source_end, timeline_start, timeline_end)):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_requires_integer_lifecycle")
+    if source_start > source_end or timeline_start >= timeline_end:
+        raise ValueError("recovery_invalid_lifecycle")
+    source_fps = float(authority["source_video"]["fps"])
+    timeline_fps = float(authority["timeline_semantics"]["fps"])
+    expected_start = round(source_start / source_fps * timeline_fps)
+    expected_end = round(source_end / source_fps * timeline_fps) + 1
+    if (timeline_start, timeline_end) != (expected_start, expected_end):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_source_timeline_mapping_mismatch")
+    bbox = record.get("source_bbox")
+    width = int(authority["source_video"]["width"])
+    height = int(authority["source_video"]["height"])
+    if not isinstance(bbox, list) or len(bbox) != 4 or not (0 <= bbox[0] < bbox[2] <= width and 0 <= bbox[1] < bbox[3] <= height):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_invalid_source_bbox")
+    expected_center = [(bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / (2 * width), 1.0 - (bbox[1] + bbox[3]) / (2 * height)]
+    if any(abs(left - right) > 1e-8 for left, right in zip(record.get("resolve_center", []), expected_center)):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_center_bbox_mismatch")
+    style = record.get("static_style_source") or {}
+    if not style.get("classification") or not style.get("font_family") or not style.get("font_style"):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_style_classification_required")
+    if float(record.get("resolve_size") or 0.0) <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("recovery_positive_size_required")
+    motion = record.get("motion") or {}
+    if any(motion.get(name) for name in ("position_keyframes", "scale_keyframes", "rotation_keyframes", "relative_visibility_keyframes")):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_unsupported_motion_keyframes")
+
+
+def compile_recovery_object(record: dict[str, Any], authority_path: Path, authority_hash: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    style = record["static_style_source"]
+    recovery_id = record["recovery_object_id"]
+    interval = [record["timeline_start_frame"], record["timeline_end_frame"]]
+    return {
+        "advanced_effects": {
+            "caption_occlusion": "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED",
+            "clipping": "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED",
+            "glow": "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED",
+            "gradient": "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_F5",
+            "shadow": "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_F5",
+            "texture": "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED",
+        },
+        "composition": copy.deepcopy(record["composition_relationship"]),
+        "display_text_decision": {
+            "display_text_authority": "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY",
+            "identity": recovery_id,
+            "renderable": True,
+            "selected_display_text": record["accepted_display_text"],
+            "source_provenance": copy.deepcopy(record["source_provenance"]),
+        },
+        "fill": {
+            "resolve_rgb": copy.deepcopy(style["fill_rgb"]),
+            "source_authority": style["fill_authority"],
+            "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE" if style["fill_authority"] == "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE" else "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT",
+        },
+        "font": {
+            "resolve_family": style["font_family"],
+            "resolve_style": style["font_style"],
+            "source_authority": style["classification"],
+            "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_FALLBACK",
+        },
+        "intended_resolve_name": f"VC5A::RECOVERY::{recovery_id}",
+        "keyframes": {"position": [], "relative_visibility": [], "rotation": [], "scale": []},
+        "object_origin": "RECOVERED_DISPLAY_OBJECT",
+        "opacity": {"resolve_value": 1.0, "source_authority": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT", "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"},
+        "position": {
+            "mapping": "x_px/1080,1-y_px/1920",
+            "resolve_center": copy.deepcopy(record["resolve_center"]),
+            "source_authority": "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY",
+            "source_bbox": copy.deepcopy(record["source_bbox"]),
+            "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE",
+        },
+        "provenance": {"recovery_authority": {"path": authority_path.as_posix(), "sha256": authority_hash}},
+        "renderable": True,
+        "resolve_interval": interval,
+        "scale_decision": {
+            "compiled_absolute_size_anchors": [],
+            "interpolation_policy": "STATIC_BASE_SIZE",
+            "relative_scale_anchors": [],
+            "scale_authority_status": "SUPPRESSED",
+            "scale_suppression_reason": "NO_ACCEPTED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY",
+            "static_base_size": record["resolve_size"],
+        },
+        "size": {
+            "resolve_value": record["resolve_size"],
+            "source_authority": "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY",
+            "source_height_px": record["source_height_px"],
+            "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE",
+        },
+        "source_identity": recovery_id,
+        "source_interval": interval,
+        "static_rotation": {"resolve_degrees": None, "source_authority": "UNRESOLVED", "value_role": "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED"},
+        "stroke": {"resolve_enabled": False, "resolve_rgb": [0, 0, 0], "resolve_width": 0.0, "source_authority": "UNRESOLVED", "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"},
+        "text": {"source_authority": "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY", "value": record["accepted_display_text"], "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"},
+        "z_order_track": {"resolve_track": 3, "source_authority": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT", "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"},
+    }
+
+
+def append_recovery_objects(base_objects: list[dict[str, Any]], records: list[dict[str, Any]], authority_path: Path, authority_hash: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    output = copy.deepcopy(base_objects)
+    known_ids = {row["source_identity"] for row in output}
+    for record in records:
+        recovery_id = record["recovery_object_id"]
+        if recovery_id in known_ids:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate_recovery_object_id:{recovery_id}")
+        output.append(compile_recovery_object(record, authority_path, authority_hash))
+        known_ids.add(recovery_id)
+    return output
+
+
+def compile_f4_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    f3 = _load_pinned(root / F3_CONTRACT, F3_SHA256)
+    authority, authority_path = load_recovery_authority(root)
+    records = authority.get("recovery_objects") or []
+    if len({row.get("recovery_object_id") for row in records}) != len(records):
+        raise ValueError("recovery_object_ids_not_unique")
+    for record in records:
+        _validate_record(record, authority)
+
+    base_records = copy.deepcopy(f3["identity_records"])
+    base_objects = copy.deepcopy(f3["objects"])
+    final_objects = append_recovery_objects(base_objects, records, authority_path.relative_to(root), AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    contract = copy.deepcopy(f3)
+    contract.update(
+        {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery_compile_contract",
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "base_f3_contract": {"path": F3_CONTRACT.as_posix(), "sha256": F3_SHA256},
+            "recovery_authority": {"path": authority_path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), "sha256": AUTHORITY_SHA256},
+            "base_frozen_identity_count": len(base_records),
+            "base_renderable_identity_count": len(base_objects),
+            "recovered_display_object_count": len(records),
+            "final_renderable_object_count": len(final_objects),
+            "object_count": len(final_objects),
+            "objects": final_objects,
+            "resolve_mutated": False,
+        }
+    )
+
+    rows = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in base_records}
+    controls_ok = all(
+        control["identity"] in rows
+        and rows[control["identity"]]["renderable"] is control["renderable"]
+        and rows[control["identity"]]["text"]["value"] == control["display_text"]
+        for control in authority["regression_controls"]
+    )
+    checks = {
+        "base_identity_accounting_113": len(base_records) == 113,
+        "base_renderable_identity_accounting_62": len(base_objects) == 62,
+        "base_identity_records_unchanged": contract["identity_records"] == f3["identity_records"],
+        "base_renderable_objects_unchanged": contract["objects"][: len(base_objects)] == f3["objects"],
+        "recovery_authority_nonempty": bool(records),
+        "recovery_objects_all_renderable": all(row["renderable"] for row in final_objects[len(base_objects) :]),
+        "final_count_reconciles": len(final_objects) == len(base_objects) + len(records),
+        "regression_controls_unchanged": controls_ok,
+        "f3_scale_decisions_unchanged": [row["scale_decision"] for row in contract["identity_records"]] == [row["scale_decision"] for row in f3["identity_records"]],
+        "resolve_not_mutated": contract["resolve_mutated"] is False,
+        "upstream_not_mutated": authority["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is False,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "all_pass": all(checks.values()),
+        "checks": checks,
+        "counts": {
+            "base_frozen_identities": len(base_records),
+            "base_renderable_identities": len(base_objects),
+            "recovered_display_objects": len(records),
+            "final_renderable_objects": len(final_objects),
+        },
+    }
+    decisions = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery_decisions",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "decisions": [
+            {
+                "recovery_object_id": row["recovery_object_id"],
+                "accepted_display_text": row["accepted_display_text"],
+                "source_interval": [row["source_visible_start_frame"], row["source_visible_end_frame"] + 1],
+                "timeline_interval": [row["timeline_start_frame"], row["timeline_end_frame"]],
+                "method": "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY",
+            }
+            for row in records
+        ],
+    }
+    if not validation["all_pass"]:
+        raise ValueError("f4_validation_failed")
+    return contract, validation, decisions
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    first = compile_f4_contract()
+    second = compile_f4_contract()
+    names = ("step5a_f4_compile_contract.json", "step5a_f4_validation.json", "step5a_f4_recovery_decisions.json")
+    artifacts = {}
+    for name, left, right in zip(names, first, second):
+        left_bytes = _bytes(left)
+        right_bytes = _bytes(right)
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(left_bytes).hexdigest()
+        artifacts[name] = {"byte_identical": left_bytes == right_bytes, "first_sha256": digest, "second_sha256": hashlib.sha256(right_bytes).hexdigest()}
+        (output / name).write_bytes(left_bytes)
+    proof = {"schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f4_determinism_proof", "schema_version": 1, "deterministic": all(row["byte_identical"] for row in artifacts.values()), "artifacts": artifacts}
+    (output / "step5a_f4_determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(_bytes(proof))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output_dir": str(output), "counts": first[1]["counts"], "deterministic": proof["deterministic"]}, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery.py b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery.py

+++ b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery.py
@@ -0,0 +1,179 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery import (
+    _load_pinned,
+    _sha256,
+    _validate_record,
+    compile_recovery_object,
+)
+
+
+ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("VIDEO_CLONER_ROOT", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])).resolve()
+F4_CONTRACT = Path(
+    ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F4_MISSING_DUPLICATE_CAPTION_RECOVERY_20260930_V1/"
+    "20260930T142346380Z_luna_execute/first/step5a_f4_compile_contract.json"
+)
+F4_SHA256 = "cd4c4f56e160777d8260712b2cadf8e7f3a98a7b96d1a62435ad8b07c3531179"
+AUTHORITY = Path("config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_listing_display_object_recovery.json")
+AUTHORITY_SHA256 = "77e29431f71c7479fea412c0b12d1ee2099fb12e1fafe99af03ac2b0cf2f6a90"
+
+
+def _bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def load_listing_authority(root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    authority = _load_pinned(root / AUTHORITY, AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    if authority.get("schema") != "video_cloner_accepted_display_object_recovery":
+        raise ValueError("accepted_recovery_authority_schema")
+    if authority.get("authority") != "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY":
+        raise ValueError("accepted_recovery_authority_status")
+    for artifact in authority.get("evidence_artifacts", []):
+        if _sha256(root / artifact["path"]) != artifact["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"evidence_hash_mismatch:{artifact['path']}")
+    return authority
+
+
+def _branch_counts(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    source = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    literal_tokens = {
+        record["accepted_display_text"].lower(),
+        record["composition_relationship"]["neighbor_source_text"].lower(),
+    }
+    identity_tokens = {
+        record["composition_relationship"]["neighbor_identity"].lower(),
+        record["recovery_object_id"].lower(),
+    }
+    reel_tokens = {Path(record["source_provenance"]["geometry_evidence_path"]).stem.lower(), Path(record["source_provenance"]["entry_contact_sheet"]).stem.lower()}
+    counts = {"literal": 0, "identity": 0, "reel": 0}
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        expression = node.test if isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.IfExp, ast.While, ast.Assert)) else None
+        if expression is None:
+            continue
+        values = [child.value.lower() for child in ast.walk(expression) if isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)]
+        counts["literal"] += sum(any(token in value for token in literal_tokens) for value in values)
+        counts["identity"] += sum(any(token in value for token in identity_tokens) for value in values)
+        counts["reel"] += sum(any(token in value for token in reel_tokens) for value in values)
+    return counts
+
+
+def compile_f5a_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    f4 = _load_pinned(root / F4_CONTRACT, F4_SHA256)
+    authority = load_listing_authority(root)
+    records = authority.get("recovery_objects") or []
+    if len(records) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"listing_recovery_object_count:{len(records)}")
+    record = records[0]
+    _validate_record(record, authority)
+
+    authority_path = AUTHORITY.as_posix()
+    added = compile_recovery_object(record, Path(authority_path), AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    contract = copy.deepcopy(f4)
+    contract["objects"] = copy.deepcopy(f4["objects"]) + [added]
+    contract.update(
+        {
+            "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery_compile_contract",
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "base_f4_contract": {"path": F4_CONTRACT.as_posix(), "sha256": F4_SHA256},
+            "f5a_recovery_authority": {"path": authority_path, "sha256": AUTHORITY_SHA256},
+            "preexisting_recovered_display_object_count": 2,
+            "f5a_added_recovered_display_object_count": 1,
+            "recovered_display_object_count": 3,
+            "final_renderable_object_count": len(contract["objects"]),
+            "object_count": len(contract["objects"]),
+            "resolve_mutated": False,
+        }
+    )
+
+    rows = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in f4["identity_records"]}
+    old_recoveries = [row for row in f4["objects"] if row.get("object_origin") == "RECOVERED_DISPLAY_OBJECT"]
+    branches = _branch_counts(record)
+    checks = {
+        "01_listing_source_lifecycle_parses": [record["source_visible_start_frame"], record["source_visible_end_frame"] + 1] == [413, 433],
+        "02_canonical_source_timeline_mapping": [record["timeline_start_frame"], record["timeline_end_frame"]] == [330, 347],
+        "03_exactly_one_listing_recovery_created": len(records) == 1 and contract["objects"][-1]["text"]["value"] == record["accepted_display_text"],
+        "04_0061_remains_reels": rows[record["composition_relationship"]["neighbor_identity"]]["renderable"] is True and rows[record["composition_relationship"]["neighbor_identity"]]["text"]["value"] == record["composition_relationship"]["neighbor_source_text"],
+        "05_0062_remains_suppressed": rows["caption_tracklet_0062"]["renderable"] is False,
+        "06_0063_remains_suppressed": rows["caption_tracklet_0063"]["renderable"] is False,
+        "07_existing_f4_recoveries_unchanged": contract["objects"][62:64] == old_recoveries,
+        "08_base_113_identities_unchanged": len(contract["identity_records"]) == 113 and contract["identity_records"] == f4["identity_records"],
+        "09_base_62_renderables_unchanged": contract["objects"][:62] == f4["objects"][:62],
+        "10_total_recovered_objects_is_3": sum(row.get("object_origin") == "RECOVERED_DISPLAY_OBJECT" for row in contract["objects"]) == 3,
+        "11_final_renderable_objects_is_65": len(contract["objects"]) == 65,
+        "12_existing_timing_unchanged": [row["source_interval"] for row in contract["objects"][:-1]] == [row["source_interval"] for row in f4["objects"]],
+        "13_existing_text_unchanged": [row["text"] for row in contract["objects"][:-1]] == [row["text"] for row in f4["objects"]],
+        "14_existing_scale_unchanged": [row["scale_decision"] for row in contract["objects"][:-1]] == [row["scale_decision"] for row in f4["objects"]],
+        "15_no_style_overlay_applied": added["font"]["source_authority"] == "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_PENDING_F5" and contract["objects"][:-1] == f4["objects"],
+        "16_no_production_literal_branch": branches["literal"] == 0,
+        "17_no_production_identity_branch": branches["identity"] == 0,
+        "18_no_production_reel_branch": branches["reel"] == 0,
+        "source_geometry_is_frame_426_evidence": added["position"]["source_bbox"] == [414, 721, 678, 803] and added["size"]["source_height_px"] == 82.0,
+        "relationship_is_sequential_without_overlap": added["composition"]["relationship"] == "SEQUENTIAL_NO_OVERLAP" and record["source_provenance"]["following_object_first_source_frame"] == 433,
+        "upstream_not_mutated": authority["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is False,
+        "resolve_not_mutated": authority["resolve_mutated"] is False and contract["resolve_mutated"] is False,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_F5A_LISTING_OBJECT_LIFECYCLE_RECOVERY" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL_F5A_LISTING_OBJECT_LIFECYCLE_RECOVERY",
+        "all_pass": all(checks.values()),
+        "checks": checks,
+        "production_branch_counts": branches,
+        "counts": {
+            "base_frozen_identities": len(f4["identity_records"]),
+            "base_renderable_identities": 62,
+            "preexisting_recovered_display_objects": len(old_recoveries),
+            "total_recovered_display_objects": 3,
+            "final_renderable_objects": len(contract["objects"]),
+        },
+    }
+    if not validation["all_pass"]:
+        raise ValueError("f5a_validation_failed")
+    return authority, contract, validation
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    first = compile_f5a_contract()
+    second = compile_f5a_contract()
+    names = (
+        "step5a_f5a_listing_recovery_authority.json",
+        "step5a_f5a_compile_contract.json",
+        "step5a_f5a_validation.json",
+    )
+    artifacts = {}
+    for name, left, right in zip(names, first, second):
+        left_bytes, right_bytes = _bytes(left), _bytes(right)
+        artifacts[name] = {
+            "byte_identical": left_bytes == right_bytes,
+            "first_sha256": hashlib.sha256(left_bytes).hexdigest(),
+            "second_sha256": hashlib.sha256(right_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        }
+        (output / name).write_bytes(left_bytes)
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f5a_determinism_proof",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "deterministic": all(row["byte_identical"] for row in artifacts.values()),
+        "artifacts": artifacts,
+    }
+    (output / "step5a_f5a_determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(_bytes(proof))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "result": first[2]["result"], "counts": first[2]["counts"], "deterministic": proof["deterministic"]}, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f9_canonical_display_ownership.py b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f9_canonical_display_ownership.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9987f58f80df5a8972278330f23af1ea930ba535
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f9_canonical_display_ownership.py
@@ -0,0 +1,420 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import statistics
+import sys
+from collections import defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+
+AUTHORITY_PATH = ROOT / "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_canonical_display_ownership.json"
+STYLE_FIELDS = ("font", "fill", "opacity", "size", "stroke", "static_rotation", "advanced_effects")
+NON_RENDERING_ROLES = {"FRAGMENT_MEMBER_NON_RENDERING", "TEMPORAL_ALIAS_NON_RENDERING", "UNRESOLVED_NON_RENDERING"}
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _without_ownership_metadata(value: Any) -> Any:
+    output = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    if isinstance(output, dict):
+        output.pop("canonical_display_ownership", None)
+    return output
+
+
+def _input_path(value: str) -> Path:
+    path = Path(value)
+    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path
+
+
+def _default_role(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    if row.get("renderable") is True:
+        composition_ids = ((row.get("composition") or {}).get("composition_ids") or [])
+        return "DISTINCT_VISUAL_MEMBER" if composition_ids else "CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNER"
+    reason = str((row.get("display_text_decision") or {}).get("suppression_reason") or "")
+    if "ALIAS" in reason:
+        return "TEMPORAL_ALIAS_NON_RENDERING"
+    if "FRAGMENT" in reason:
+        return "FRAGMENT_MEMBER_NON_RENDERING"
+    return "UNRESOLVED_NON_RENDERING"
+
+
+def _union_center(member_ids: list[str], static: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[list[float], dict[str, Any]]:
+    by_frame: dict[int, list[list[float]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for identity in member_ids:
+        for observation in static[identity]["geometry"]["accepted_source_observations"]:
+            by_frame[int(observation["source_frame"])].append([float(v) for v in observation["bbox"]])
+    complete = {frame: boxes for frame, boxes in by_frame.items() if len(boxes) == len(member_ids)}
+    if not complete:
+        raise ValueError(f"canonical_geometry_no_complete_frame:{member_ids}")
+    centers = []
+    unions = []
+    for frame, boxes in sorted(complete.items()):
+        box = [min(row[0] for row in boxes), min(row[1] for row in boxes), max(row[2] for row in boxes), max(row[3] for row in boxes)]
+        unions.append({"source_frame": frame, "bbox": box})
+        centers.append(((box[0] + box[2]) / 2 / 1080, 1 - (box[1] + box[3]) / 2 / 1920))
+    center = [round(statistics.median(row[index] for row in centers), 8) for index in range(2)]
+    return center, {"rule": "COMPOSITION_UNION_ACCEPTED_BBOX", "members": member_ids, "observations": unions}
+
+
+def _mean_position_keyframes(member_ids: list[str], rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    by_member = []
+    for identity in member_ids:
+        by_member.append({int(row["timeline_frame"]): row for row in rows[identity]["keyframes"]["position"]})
+    common = sorted(set.intersection(*(set(row) for row in by_member)))
+    if not common:
+        raise ValueError(f"canonical_position_no_common_frame:{member_ids}")
+    output = []
+    for frame in common:
+        sample = copy.deepcopy(by_member[0][frame])
+        sample["value"] = [round(statistics.mean(float(row[frame]["value"][axis]) for row in by_member), 8) for axis in range(2)]
+        sample["authority"] = "CANONICAL_COMPOSITION_MEMBER_MEAN"
+        sample["source"] = "F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP"
+        output.append(sample)
+    return output
+
+
+def _set_renderability(row: dict[str, Any], decision: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    role = decision["role"]
+    metadata = {
+        "role": role,
+        "canonical_owner_identity": decision.get("canonical_owner_identity") or (row["source_identity"] if role not in NON_RENDERING_ROLES else None),
+        "reason": decision["reason"],
+        "evidence": decision["evidence"],
+    }
+    row["canonical_display_ownership"] = metadata
+    display = row.setdefault("display_text_decision", {})
+    if role in NON_RENDERING_ROLES:
+        row["renderable"] = False
+        row["text"] = {"value": None, "source_authority": "F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP", "value_role": "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED"}
+        display.update({
+            "renderable": False,
+            "selected_display_text": None,
+            "display_text_authority": "F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP",
+            "canonical_owner_identity": decision.get("canonical_owner_identity"),
+            "suppression_reason": role,
+        })
+        return
+    text = str(decision.get("selected_display_text") or (row.get("text") or {}).get("value") or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError(f"canonical_renderable_without_text:{row['source_identity']}")
+    row["renderable"] = True
+    row["text"] = {"value": text, "source_authority": "F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP", "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"}
+    display.update({
+        "renderable": True,
+        "selected_display_text": text,
+        "display_text_authority": "F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP",
+        "canonical_owner_identity": metadata["canonical_owner_identity"],
+        "suppression_reason": None,
+    })
+
+
+def _apply_decision(
+    row: dict[str, Any],
+    decision: dict[str, Any],
+    source_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    static: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    output = copy.deepcopy(row)
+    _set_renderability(output, decision)
+    if decision.get("lifecycle"):
+        start, end = map(int, decision["lifecycle"])
+        if start >= end:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical_lifecycle:{output['source_identity']}")
+        output["source_interval"] = [start, end]
+        output["resolve_interval"] = [start, end]
+        for values in (output.get("keyframes") or {}).values():
+            for keyframe in values:
+                frame = int(keyframe["timeline_frame"])
+                if not start <= frame < end:
+                    raise ValueError(f"canonical_keyframe_bounds:{output['source_identity']}:{frame}")
+                keyframe["local_frame"] = frame - start
+    members = decision.get("composition_members") or []
+    if decision.get("geometry_rule") == "COMPOSITION_UNION_ACCEPTED_BBOX":
+        center, proof = _union_center(members, static)
+        output["position"]["source_center"] = center
+        output["position"]["resolve_center"] = center
+        output["position"]["source_authority"] = "F9_CANONICAL_COMPOSITION_UNION"
+        output["position"]["value_role"] = "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"
+        output["canonical_display_ownership"]["geometry_proof"] = proof
+    if decision.get("position_keyframe_rule") == "MEAN_MEMBER_POSITION_BY_TIMELINE_FRAME":
+        keyframes = _mean_position_keyframes(members, source_rows)
+        start = output["resolve_interval"][0]
+        for keyframe in keyframes:
+            keyframe["local_frame"] = keyframe["timeline_frame"] - start
+        output["keyframes"]["position"] = keyframes
+    return output
+
+
+def _overlaps(objects: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    failures = []
+    tracks = sorted({int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) for row in objects})
+    for track in tracks:
+        rows = sorted((row for row in objects if int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) == track), key=lambda row: (row["resolve_interval"][0], row["resolve_interval"][1], row["source_identity"]))
+        for index, left in enumerate(rows):
+            for right in rows[index + 1:]:
+                if right["resolve_interval"][0] >= left["resolve_interval"][1]:
+                    break
+                failures.append({"track": track, "left": left["source_identity"], "right": right["source_identity"], "overlap": [right["resolve_interval"][0], min(left["resolve_interval"][1], right["resolve_interval"][1])]})
+    return failures
+
+
+def _allocate_new_tracks(objects: list[dict[str, Any]], newly_rendered: set[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    changes = []
+    fixed = [row for row in objects if row["source_identity"] not in newly_rendered]
+    for row in sorted((row for row in objects if row["source_identity"] in newly_rendered), key=lambda value: (value["resolve_interval"][0], value["source_identity"])):
+        before = int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"])
+        start, end = row["resolve_interval"]
+        track = 2
+        while any(int(other["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) == track and start < other["resolve_interval"][1] and other["resolve_interval"][0] < end for other in fixed):
+            track += 1
+        row["z_order_track"].update({"resolve_track": track, "lane": track - 1, "source_authority": "F9_LOWEST_FREE_OPERATIONAL_TRACK", "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"})
+        fixed.append(row)
+        if track != before:
+            changes.append({"identity": row["source_identity"], "before_track": before, "after_track": track})
+    return changes
+
+
+def compile_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    authority = read(root / AUTHORITY_PATH.relative_to(ROOT))
+    if authority.get("schema") != "video_cloner_accepted_canonical_display_ownership":
+        raise ValueError("canonical_authority_schema")
+    for value in authority["inputs"].values():
+        path = _input_path(value["path"])
+        if not path.is_file() or sha(path) != value["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical_input_drift:{value['path']}")
+    base = read(_input_path(authority["inputs"]["f7_contract"]["path"]))
+    linkage_artifact = read(_input_path(authority["inputs"]["text_mask_linkage"]["path"]))
+    composition = read(_input_path(authority["inputs"]["composition_graph"]["path"]))
+    static_artifact = read(_input_path(authority["inputs"]["static_style"]["path"]))
+    linkage = {row["identity"]: row for row in linkage_artifact["identities"]}
+    static = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in static_artifact["identities"]}
+    base_records = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in base["identity_records"]}
+    base_objects = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in base["objects"]}
+    if len(base_records) != 113 or set(base_records) != set(linkage) or set(base_records) != set(static):
+        raise ValueError("canonical_identity_accounting")
+    decisions = {row["identity"]: row for row in authority["decisions"]}
+    if len(decisions) != len(authority["decisions"]) or not set(decisions).issubset(base_records):
+        raise ValueError("canonical_decision_identity")
+
+    resolved_records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    resolved_objects: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for identity, source in base_records.items():
+        decision = decisions.get(identity)
+        record = _apply_decision(source, decision, base_records, static) if decision else copy.deepcopy(source)
+        if not decision:
+            record["canonical_display_ownership"] = {"role": _default_role(source), "canonical_owner_identity": identity if source.get("renderable") else None, "reason": "UNCHANGED_ACCEPTED_F7_AUTHORITY", "evidence": [authority["inputs"]["f7_contract"]["path"]]}
+        resolved_records[identity] = record
+        object_source = base_objects.get(identity, source)
+        obj = _apply_decision(object_source, decision, base_records, static) if decision else copy.deepcopy(object_source)
+        if not decision:
+            obj["canonical_display_ownership"] = copy.deepcopy(record["canonical_display_ownership"])
+        if obj.get("renderable"):
+            resolved_objects[identity] = obj
+
+    for identity, row in base_objects.items():
+        if identity not in base_records:
+            recovered = copy.deepcopy(row)
+            recovered["canonical_display_ownership"] = {"role": "CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNER", "canonical_owner_identity": identity, "reason": "UNCHANGED_ACCEPTED_RECOVERY_OBJECT", "evidence": [authority["inputs"]["f7_contract"]["path"]]}
+            resolved_objects[identity] = recovered
+
+    previous_renderable = {identity for identity in base_objects}
+    new_renderable = set(resolved_objects)
+    track_changes = _allocate_new_tracks(list(resolved_objects.values()), new_renderable - previous_renderable)
+    objects = sorted(resolved_objects.values(), key=lambda row: (row["resolve_interval"][0], row["resolve_interval"][1], row["source_identity"]))
+    overlaps = _overlaps(objects)
+    if overlaps:
+        raise ValueError(f"canonical_placement_overlap:{overlaps}")
+
+    output = copy.deepcopy(base)
+    output.update({
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f9_canonical_display_ownership_contract",
+        "schema_version": 1,

+        "resolve_mutated": False,

+
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in objects}
+    case_results = []

+            if row is None or row["text"]["value"] != expected["text"] or (expected.get("interval") and row["resolve_interval"] != expected["interval"]):
+                failures.append(expected["identity"])
+        failures.extend(identity for identity in case["must_not_render"] if identity in by_id)
+        case_results.append({"case": case["case"], "ok": not failures, "failures": failures})
+
+    composition_by_id = {row["composition_id"]: row for row in composition["graph"]["compositions"]}
+    composition_audit = []
+    for accepted in authority["composition_audit"]:
+        row = composition_by_id[accepted["composition_id"]]
+        composition_audit.append({
+            **accepted,
+            "member_identities": row["member_identities"],
+            "member_roles": {identity: resolved_records[identity]["canonical_display_ownership"]["role"] for identity in row["member_identities"]},
+            "renderable_members": [identity for identity in row["member_identities"] if identity in by_id],
+            "source_frame_range": row["visible_source_frame_range"],
+        })
+    if len(composition_audit) != len(composition_by_id):
+        raise ValueError("canonical_composition_accounting")
+
+    ownership_rows = []
+    for identity, old in base_records.items():

+        link = linkage[identity]
+        ownership_rows.append({
+            "source_identity": identity,
+            "current_contract_text": link.get("contract_text"),

+            "accepted_display_text_authority": decision.get("display_text_authority"),

+
+    changed = []
+    for identity in sorted(base_records):

+
+    role_counts = defaultdict(int)

+    audit = {

+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "base_identity_count": len(ownership_rows),
+        "compositions_audited": len(composition_audit),

+        "previous_renderable_count": len(base_objects),
+        "final_renderable_object_count": len(objects),
+        "ownership_conflicts": [],
+        "source_required_missing_objects": [row for row in case_results if not row["ok"]],
+        "unsupported_duplicate_owners": [],
+        "changed_identities": changed,

+
+    titles = [{"caption_id": row["source_identity"], "text": row["text"]["value"], "timeline_start": row["resolve_interval"][0], "duration": row["resolve_interval"][1] - row["resolve_interval"][0], "lane": row["z_order_track"]["lane"]} for row in objects]
+    plan = carrier.carrier_textplus_operation_plan(titles)
+    target_6000 = by_id["caption_tracklet_0089"]
+    base_6000 = base_objects["caption_tracklet_0089"]
+    style_unchanged = all(all(resolved_records[identity].get(field) == base_records[identity].get(field) for field in STYLE_FIELDS) for identity in base_records)
+    scale_unchanged = all(resolved_records[identity].get("size") == base_records[identity].get("size") and (resolved_records[identity].get("keyframes") or {}).get("scale") == (base_records[identity].get("keyframes") or {}).get("scale") for identity in base_records)
+    controls = ("launch", "invest", "reels", "social", "like")
+    control_hashes = {text: {"before": digest([row for row in base["objects"] if str(row["text"]["value"]).casefold() == text]), "after": digest([_without_ownership_metadata(row) for row in objects if str(row["text"]["value"]).casefold() == text])} for text in controls}
+    checks = {
+        "identity_accounting_113": len(ownership_rows) == 113,
+        "composition_accounting_complete": len(composition_audit) == len(composition_by_id),
+        "targeted_cases_pass": all(row["ok"] for row in case_results),
+        "ownership_conflicts_zero": not audit["ownership_conflicts"],
+        "source_required_missing_zero": not audit["source_required_missing_objects"],
+        "unsupported_duplicate_owners_zero": not audit["unsupported_duplicate_owners"],
+        "same_track_overlaps_zero": not overlaps,
+        "carrier_plan_pass": len(plan["titles"]) == len(objects),
+        "f3_scale_unchanged": scale_unchanged,
+        "f5_style_unchanged": style_unchanged,
+        "f6_6000_lifecycle": target_6000["resolve_interval"] == [542, 596],
+        "f3_6000_scale_keys": len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]) == 9,
+        "f3_6000_exact": _without_ownership_metadata(target_6000) == base_6000,
+        "unrelated_controls_unchanged": all(value["before"] == value["after"] for value in control_hashes.values()),
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f9_canonical_ownership_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,

+        "same_track_overlap_count": len(overlaps),
+        "same_track_overlaps": overlaps,
+        "placement_changes_for_new_renderables": track_changes,
+        "carrier_plan": {"result": "PASS" if checks["carrier_plan_pass"] else "FAIL", "title_count": len(plan["titles"]), "lanes": plan["lanes"], "sha256": plan["sha256"]},
+        "control_hashes": control_hashes,
+        "contract_sha256": digest(output),
+        "ownership_audit_sha256": digest(audit),
+    }
+    return output, audit, validation, authority
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    first = compile_contract()
+    second = compile_contract()
+    names = ("step5a_f9_canonical_compile_contract.json", "step5a_f9_ownership_audit.json", "step5a_f9_validation.json", "step5a_f9_ownership_authority.json")
+    first_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, first)}
+    second_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, second)}
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f9_canonical_determinism_proof",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "artifacts": {name: {"first_sha256": hashlib.sha256(first_payloads[name]).hexdigest(), "second_sha256": hashlib.sha256(second_payloads[name]).hexdigest(), "byte_identical": first_payloads[name] == second_payloads[name]} for name in names},
+    }
+    proof["deterministic"] = all(row["byte_identical"] for row in proof["artifacts"].values())
+    if not first[2]["all_pass"] or not proof["deterministic"]:
+        raise SystemExit(2)
+    for name, payload in first_payloads.items():
+        (output_dir / name).write_bytes(payload)
+    (output_dir / "determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output_dir": str(output_dir), "renderable_count": first[2]["renderable_count"], "changed_identities": len(first[1]["changed_identities"]), "deterministic": True}))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse

+import json
+import statistics

+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+EXPECTED_FREEZES = {
+    ".agent/state/video_cloner_static_caption_freeze.json": "37ecd1438cd55b03cdb85b437131f0cafab322c85024ced41a00f01e69317601",
+    ".agent/state/video_cloner_timing_persistence_freeze.json": "e3934346a227e81a83e9c21e83860fcbf43a59f57a5b29752c149875749ccc23",
+    ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4b_motion_ir_freeze.json": "414b3fa823297b060eeb719e94154e222420cca8b270efbe7bce4d184fe18b65",
+    ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4c_dynamic_transforms_freeze.json": "64f1493ec24f54968f90a66bc72b8346c5cf1af8acbc8a5661f02df7c800a54f",
+    ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4d_advanced_text_effects_freeze.json": "a9f6ec6a3de8693dd77d2497b028747a18057cc00b773bd3c4aa72df18a1d1e6",
+}
+INPUTS = {
+    "static": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2F_FONT_AUTHORITY_CALIBRATION_20260927/20260927T020000000Z_calibrated/whole_reel_static_style_contract_calibrated.json",
+    "timing": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4A_TIMING_PERSISTENCE_20260927/20260927T122000000Z_human_review_ready/step4a_timing_persistence_contract.json",
+    "motion": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4B_WHOLE_REEL_MOTION_IR_20260927/20260927T113000000Z_human_review_ready/step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir.json",
+    "dynamic": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4C_WHOLE_REEL_DYNAMIC_TRANSFORMS_20260927_V1/20260927T170000000Z_human_review_ready/step4c_dynamic_transform_contract.json",
+    "shadow": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_SHADOW_PARAMETER_FIDELITY_20260928_V2/20260928T123000000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_shadow_ir_calibrated.json",
+    "composition": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2E_COMPOSITION_RELATIONSHIPS_20260925/20260925T220000000Z_source_graph/step2e_composition_relationships.json",
+}
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def authority(value: Any) -> str:
+    return str((value or {}).get("authority", {}).get("status") or "UNRESOLVED")
+
+
+def median_center(observations: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[float] | None:
+    if not observations:
+        return None
+    xs = [(row["bbox"][0] + row["bbox"][2]) / 2 / 1080 for row in observations]
+    ys = [1 - (row["bbox"][1] + row["bbox"][3]) / 2 / 1920 for row in observations]
+    return [round(statistics.median(xs), 8), round(statistics.median(ys), 8)]
+
+
+def static_angle(rotation: dict[str, Any]) -> float | None:
+    if rotation.get("reproduction_authority") != "STATIC_ORIENTATION_ONLY":
+        return None
+    values = [float(row["angle_degrees"]) for row in rotation.get("samples") or []]
+    return round(statistics.median(values), 6) if values else None
+
+
+def lane_rows(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    ends: list[int] = []
+    for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda x: (x["source_interval"][0], x["source_interval"][1], x["source_identity"])):
+        start, end = row["source_interval"]
+        lane = next((i for i, value in enumerate(ends) if value <= start), len(ends))
+        if lane == len(ends):
+            ends.append(end)
+        else:
+            ends[lane] = end
+        row["z_order_track"] = {"resolve_track": lane + 2, "lane": lane + 1, "source_authority": "UNRESOLVED", "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"}
+
+
+def merged_keyframes(identity: str, start: int, end: int, motion: list[dict[str, Any]], dynamic: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    output: dict[str, dict[int, dict[str, Any]]] = {name: {} for name in ("position", "scale", "relative_visibility", "rotation")}
+    permitted = {"position": {"SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TRACK"}, "scale": {"CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY"}, "relative_visibility": {"SOURCE_MASK_RELATIVE_STRENGTH"}}
+    for record in motion:
+        if record["identity"] != identity or record.get("status") != "SOURCE_MEASURED":
+            continue
+        channels = record.get("channel_authority") or {}
+        for sample in record.get("samples") or []:
+            frame = int(sample["frame"])
+            if not start <= frame < end:
+                raise ValueError(f"motion_keyframe_bounds:{identity}:{frame}")
+            for channel in permitted:
+                if channels.get(channel) not in permitted[channel] or sample.get(channel) is None:
+                    continue
+                raw = sample[channel]
+                value = [float(raw["x"]), 1.0 - float(raw["y"])] if channel == "position" else float(raw.get("value") if isinstance(raw, dict) else raw)
+                output[channel][frame] = {"timeline_frame": frame, "local_frame": frame - start, "value": value, "authority": channels[channel], "source": "STEP_4B_RAW_SAMPLE"}
+    for channel, values in (dynamic.get("editor_neutral_keyframes") or {}).items():
+        for item in values or []:
+            frame = int(item["frame"])
+            if not start <= frame < end:
+                raise ValueError(f"dynamic_keyframe_bounds:{identity}:{channel}:{frame}")
+            value = item.get("value")
+            if channel == "position":
+                value = [float(value["x"]), 1.0 - float(value["y"])]
+            elif channel == "rotation":
+                value = float(item["value_degrees"])
+            else:
+                value = float(value)
+            output[channel][frame] = {"timeline_frame": frame, "local_frame": frame - start, "value": value, "authority": item.get("authority") or item.get("semantics"), "source": "STEP_4C_EDITOR_NEUTRAL_KEYFRAME"}
+    visibility = output["relative_visibility"]
+    if visibility:
+        peak = max(float(row["value"]) for row in visibility.values())
+        if peak <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"relative_visibility_peak:{identity}")
+        for row in visibility.values():
+            row["source_relative_value"] = row["value"]
+            row["value"] = min(1.0, max(0.0, float(row["value"]) / peak))
+            row["mapping"] = "PER_IDENTITY_PEAK_NORMALIZED_RELATIVE_VISIBILITY_NOT_ABSOLUTE_ALPHA"
+            row["value_role"] = "ACCEPTED_APPROXIMATION"
+    return {name: [values[key] for key in sorted(values)] for name, values in output.items()}
+
+
+def compile_contract(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    freeze_rows = []
+    for rel, expected in EXPECTED_FREEZES.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        actual = sha(path)
+        freeze_rows.append({"path": rel, "expected_sha256": expected, "actual_sha256": actual, "match": actual == expected})
+    if not all(row["match"] for row in freeze_rows):
+        raise ValueError("upstream_freeze_hash_drift")
+    data = {name: read(root / rel) for name, rel in INPUTS.items()}
+    inputs = {name: {"path": rel, "sha256": sha(root / rel)} for name, rel in INPUTS.items()}
+    static = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in data["static"]["identities"]}
+    timing = {row["identity"]: row for row in data["timing"]["identities"]}
+    dynamic = {row["identity"]: row for row in data["dynamic"]["records"]}
+    shadows = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in data["shadow"]["shadows"] if row["presence_authority"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW"}
+    ids = list(static)
+    if len(ids) != 113 or len(set(ids)) != 113 or set(ids) != set(timing) or set(ids) != set(dynamic):
+        raise ValueError("identity_accounting")
+    objects = []
+    for identity in ids:
+        source, times, dyn = static[identity], timing[identity], dynamic[identity]
+        start, end = map(int, times["generated"]["visibility_intervals"][0])
+        if start >= end or times["comparison"].get("interval_match") is not True:
+            raise ValueError(f"timing:{identity}")
+        ident = source["identity"]
+        observations = source["geometry"]["accepted_source_observations"]
+        size = source["geometry"].get("size")
+        font = source["typography"]["font"]
+        selected = font.get("selected_candidate") or {}
+        fill, opacity, stroke = source["fill"], source["opacity"], source["stroke"]
+        shadow = shadows.get(identity)
+        row = {
+            "source_identity": identity,
+            "intended_resolve_name": f"VC5A::{identity}",
+            "text": {"value": ident["text_diagnostic_only"], "source_authority": "FROZEN_STATIC_IDENTITY_TEXT", "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"},
+            "source_interval": [start, end], "resolve_interval": [start, end],
+            "font": {"requested_family": selected.get("family"), "requested_style": selected.get("style"), "source_authority": authority(font), "resolve_family": selected.get("family") or "Arial", "resolve_style": selected.get("style") or "Regular", "mapping_status": "OPERATIONAL_FALLBACK_REQUIRED" if not selected.get("family") else ("EXACT_LOCAL_MAPPING" if authority(font) == "AUTHORITATIVE" else "ACCEPTED_APPROXIMATE_MAPPING"), "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT" if not selected.get("family") else ("SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE" if authority(font) == "AUTHORITATIVE" else "ACCEPTED_APPROXIMATION")},
+            "size": {"source_height_px": size.get("median_height_px") if isinstance(size, dict) else None, "resolve_value": round(float(size["median_height_px"]) / 1080 * 1.5, 9) if isinstance(size, dict) else 0.062, "source_authority": authority(source["geometry"]), "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE" if isinstance(size, dict) else "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"},
+            "position": {"source_center": median_center(observations), "resolve_center": median_center(observations) or [0.5, 0.5], "source_authority": authority(source["geometry"]), "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE" if observations else "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT", "mapping": "x_px/1080,1-y_px/1920"},
+            "fill": {"source_rgb": fill.get("color_rgb"), "resolve_rgb": fill.get("color_rgb") or [255, 255, 255], "source_authority": authority(fill), "value_role": "ACCEPTED_APPROXIMATION" if fill.get("color_rgb") else "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"},
+            "stroke": {"presence": stroke["presence"].get("value"), "width_source_px": stroke["width"].get("value_source_px"), "color_rgb": stroke["color"].get("color_rgb"), "source_authority": authority(stroke["presence"]), "resolve_enabled": stroke["presence"].get("value") is True, "resolve_width": float(stroke["width"].get("value_source_px") or 0) / 1080, "resolve_rgb": stroke["color"].get("color_rgb") or [0, 0, 0], "value_role": "ACCEPTED_APPROXIMATION" if authority(stroke["presence"]) == "PROVISIONAL" else "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT"},
+            "opacity": {"source_value": opacity.get("value"), "resolve_value": 1.0, "source_authority": authority(opacity), "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_DEFAULT", "relative_visibility_is_absolute_alpha": False},

+from __future__ import annotations

+import copy
+import difflib
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math

+import cv2
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+CANONICAL = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_WHOLE_REEL_SOURCE_COVERAGE_GATE_V1/20261004T110112652Z_v33_final_1/canonical_caption_contract_v1.json"
+TEMPLATES = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F9_CANONICAL_DISPLAY_OWNERSHIP_REBUILD_V1/20261003T111956566999Z_69524834b9114b7e830a9b911376265e/first/step5_f9_canonical_compile_contract.json"
+LIFECYCLE = ROOT / "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_lifecycle_end_correction.json"
+CLEANUP = ROOT / "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_v33_bounded_materialization_cleanup.json"
