+BASELINE = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_REAL_TEXTPLUS_COMPILE_20260928/20260928T190000000Z_real_textplus_compile/step5a_cutonly_baseline.fcpxml"
+EXPECTED = {
+    CANONICAL: "253297ad4f5b41837c90014f6c88572063fcb05efa20adfbb97444b9b09a14bc",
+    TEMPLATES: "adf6325809e120328aaafe4ba528f7dc8d9a7bf7476995d7fafbe6b6cf2d5277",
+    LIFECYCLE: "368092b4723021743e4f43784693f4bfbdce5645c7bdae25cbf761601214b047",
+    CLEANUP: "201da17609e223506e0694158cce20fcd0faa9bff70933aea89dd574f27a316c",
+    VIDEO: "729c47a74fe015fd45c22a76974c0c824234352ca90c42b5689dc7468b87a279",
+    BASELINE: "d3b9c796feff8d81c2823a318e2df1657a415e8b06e65e7e9dfe0f756a35ea97",
+}
+STYLE_FIELDS = ("font", "fill", "opacity", "size", "stroke", "static_rotation", "advanced_effects")
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"json_object:{path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _center(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    boxes = [item["bbox"] for item in row["geometry_trajectory"]]
+    return (
+        statistics.median((float(box[0]) + float(box[2])) / 2 for box in boxes),
+        statistics.median((float(box[1]) + float(box[3])) / 2 for box in boxes),
+    )
+
+
+def _height(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> float:
+    return statistics.median(float(item["bbox"][3]) - float(item["bbox"][1]) for item in row["geometry_trajectory"])
+
+
+def _temporal_distance(left: Mapping[str, Any], right: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int:
+    a, b = left["source_lifecycle"], right["source_lifecycle"]
+    return max(0, int(a["first_visible_frame"]) - int(b["last_visible_frame"]), int(b["first_visible_frame"]) - int(a["last_visible_frame"]))
+
+
+def _mapped_interval(row: Mapping[str, Any], source_fps: float, timeline_fps: float) -> list[int]:
+    life = row["source_lifecycle"]
+    start = round(int(life["first_visible_frame"]) / source_fps * timeline_fps)
+    end = round((int(life["last_visible_frame"]) + 1) / source_fps * timeline_fps)
+    return [start, max(start + 1, end)]
+
+
+def _overlap(left: list[int], right: list[int]) -> int:
+    return max(0, min(left[1], right[1]) - max(left[0], right[0]))
+
+
+def _template_for(row: Mapping[str, Any], templates: Mapping[str, dict[str, Any]], interval: list[int]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, list[str]]:
+    candidates = [templates[identity] for identity in row["source_raw_track_provenance"] if identity in templates]
+    if not candidates:
+        return None, []
+    x, y = _center(row)
+    chosen = min(candidates, key=lambda item: (
+        -_overlap(interval, list(map(int, item["resolve_interval"]))),
+        math.hypot(float(item["position"]["resolve_center"][0]) * 1080 - x, (1 - float(item["position"]["resolve_center"][1])) * 1920 - y),
+        item["source_identity"],
+    ))
+    return chosen, [item["source_identity"] for item in candidates]
+
+
+def _style_donor(row: Mapping[str, Any], contract: list[dict[str, Any]], direct: Mapping[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    x, y = _center(row)
+    scored = []
+    memberships = set(row["composition_membership"])
+    for other in contract:
+        template = direct.get(other["canonical_source_object_id"])
+        if template is None:
+            continue
+        ox, oy = _center(other)
+        shared_composition = bool(memberships.intersection(other["composition_membership"]))
+        scored.append(((0 if shared_composition else 1, _temporal_distance(row, other), math.hypot(x - ox, y - oy), other["canonical_source_object_id"]), other, template))
+    if not scored:
+        raise ValueError(f"missing_style_donor:{row['canonical_source_object_id']}")
+    score, other, template = min(scored, key=lambda item: item[0])
+    if score[0] and score[1] > 3:
+        raise ValueError(f"missing_local_style_evidence:{row['canonical_source_object_id']}:{score}")
+    return template, {
+        "method": "SAME_COMPOSITION_THEN_TEMPORAL_SPATIAL_ACCEPTED_STYLE_DONOR",
+        "donor_canonical_source_object_id": other["canonical_source_object_id"],
+        "donor_source_identity": template["source_identity"],
+        "shared_composition": not bool(score[0]),
+        "temporal_distance_frames": score[1],
+        "center_distance_px": round(score[2], 6),
+    }
+
+
+def _allocate_tracks(objects: list[dict[str, Any]], locked: set[str] | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    occupied: dict[int, list[list[int]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    changes = []
+    locked = locked or set()
+    for row in objects:
+        if row["source_identity"] in locked:
+            occupied[int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"])].append(list(map(int, row["resolve_interval"])))
+    for row in sorted((item for item in objects if item["source_identity"] not in locked), key=lambda item: (item["resolve_interval"][0], item["resolve_interval"][1], item["source_identity"])):
+        preferred = max(2, int(row["z_order_track"].get("resolve_track") or 2))
+        choices = [preferred, *[track for track in range(2, len(objects) + 2) if track != preferred]]
+        start, end = row["resolve_interval"]
+        track = next(track for track in choices if all(end <= interval[0] or interval[1] <= start for interval in occupied[track]))
+        occupied[track].append([start, end])
+        row["z_order_track"] = {
+            "resolve_track": track,
+            "lane": track - 1,
+            "source_authority": "V33_DETERMINISTIC_PREFERRED_THEN_LOWEST_FREE_TRACK",
+            "value_role": "OPERATIONAL_RENDER_PLACEMENT",
+        }
+        if track != preferred:
+            changes.append({"canonical_source_object_id": row["canonical_source_object_id"], "preferred_track": preferred, "allocated_track": track})
+    return changes
+
+
+def _collisions(objects: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    output = []
+    for index, left in enumerate(objects):
+        for right in objects[index + 1:]:
+            if left["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"] == right["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"] and _overlap(left["resolve_interval"], right["resolve_interval"]):
+                output.append({"left": left["source_identity"], "right": right["source_identity"], "track": left["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]})
+    return output
+
+
+def _compile_expanded_materialization() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    drift = [{"path": str(path), "expected": expected, "actual": sha(path)} for path, expected in EXPECTED.items() if not path.is_file() or sha(path) != expected]
+    if drift:
+        raise ValueError(f"accepted_input_drift:{drift}")
+    canonical = read(CANONICAL)
+    template_contract = read(TEMPLATES)
+    lifecycle = read(LIFECYCLE)
+    contract = canonical["objects"]
+    if canonical.get("status") != "READY_FOR_RESOLVE_REBUILD" or len(contract) != 125:
+        raise ValueError("canonical_contract_not_accepted")
+    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(VIDEO))
+    source_fps = float(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS))
+    cap.release()
+    timeline_fps = float(template_contract["frame_semantics"]["fps"])
+    templates = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in template_contract["identity_records"]}

+    overlays = {row["object_id"]: row for row in lifecycle["records"]}
+
+    selected: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    candidate_ids: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

+        if len(matching_overlays) > 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"multiple_lifecycle_overlays:{row['canonical_source_object_id']}")
+        if matching_overlays:
+            interval = list(map(int, matching_overlays[0]["accepted_timeline_interval"]))
+        intervals[row["canonical_source_object_id"]] = interval
+        template, candidates = _template_for(row, templates, interval)
+        if template:
+            selected[row["canonical_source_object_id"]] = template
+        candidate_ids[row["canonical_source_object_id"]] = candidates
+
+    objects, authority_rows = [], []
+    for source in contract:
+        source_id = source["canonical_source_object_id"]
+        interval = intervals[source_id]
+        template = selected.get(source_id)
+        donor = None
+        direct = template is not None
+        if template is None:
+            template, donor = _style_donor(source, contract, selected)
+        row = copy.deepcopy(template)
+        row.update({
+            "source_identity": source_id,
+            "canonical_source_object_id": source_id,
+            "canonical_contract_object_id": source["canonical_contract_object_id"],
+            "generated_resolve_object_id": "VC5A33::" + source_id,
+            "intended_resolve_name": "VC5A33::" + source_id,
+            "renderable": True,
+            "source_interval": interval,
+            "resolve_interval": interval,
+            "canonical_source_lifecycle": copy.deepcopy(source["source_lifecycle"]),
+            "frame_domain_mapping": {"source_fps": source_fps, "timeline_fps": timeline_fps, "rule": "round(source_frame/source_fps*timeline_fps)", "accepted_overlay": any(identity in overlays for identity in source["source_raw_track_provenance"])},
+            "text": {"value": source["canonical_text"], "source_authority": "SOURCE_AUTHORITY_V3_3", "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"},
+            "composition": {"composition_ids": source["composition_membership"], "relationship_ids": [], "style_sharing_authorized": bool(source["composition_membership"]), "authority": {"status": "AUTHORITATIVE", "source": "SOURCE_AUTHORITY_V3_3"}},
+        })
+        px, py = _center(source)
+        structurally_exact = direct and len(source["source_raw_track_provenance"]) == 1 and usage[template["source_identity"]] == 1
+        if not structurally_exact:
+            row["position"] = {"source_center": [round(px / 1080, 8), round(1 - py / 1920, 8)], "resolve_center": [round(px / 1080, 8), round(1 - py / 1920, 8)], "mapping": "x_px/1080,1-y_px/1920", "source_authority": "V33_CANONICAL_GEOMETRY", "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"}
+            height = _height(source)
+            row["size"] = {"resolve_value": round(height / 720, 9), "source_height_px": height, "source_authority": "F3_CANONICAL_BBOX_HEIGHT_MAPPING", "value_role": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_VALUE"}
+        keys = copy.deepcopy(row.get("keyframes") or {})
+        for key in ("position", "scale", "rotation", "relative_visibility"):
+            values = keys.get(key) or []
+            keys[key] = [item for item in values if interval[0] <= int(item["timeline_frame"]) < interval[1]] if structurally_exact else []
+            for item in keys[key]:
+                item["local_frame"] = int(item["timeline_frame"]) - interval[0]
+        row["keyframes"] = keys
+        row["materialization_motion_authority"] = "ACCEPTED_TEMPLATE_KEYS" if structurally_exact else "STATIC_V33_CANONICAL_GEOMETRY"
+        row.setdefault("provenance", {})["v33_materialization"] = {
+            "canonical_contract": str(CANONICAL.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+            "template_contract": str(TEMPLATES.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+            "direct_template": direct,
+            "template_candidates": candidate_ids[source_id],
+            "selected_template": template["source_identity"],
+            "style_donor": donor,
+        }
+        objects.append(row)
+        authority_rows.append({
+            "canonical_source_object_id": source_id,
+            "canonical_contract_object_id": source["canonical_contract_object_id"],
+            "direct_template": direct,
+            "selected_template": template["source_identity"],
+            "style_donor": donor,
+            "timing": row["frame_domain_mapping"],
+            "placement": row["position"]["source_authority"],
+            "style": {field: (row[field].get("source_authority") if isinstance(row.get(field), dict) else "PRESENT") for field in STYLE_FIELDS},
+            "motion": row["materialization_motion_authority"],
+        })
+
+    track_changes = _allocate_tracks(objects)
+    objects.sort(key=lambda row: (row["resolve_interval"][0], row["resolve_interval"][1], row["source_identity"]))
+    collisions = _collisions(objects)
+    generated_ids = [row["generated_resolve_object_id"] for row in objects]
+    source_ids = [row["canonical_source_object_id"] for row in objects]
+    missing = {
+        "text": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if not str((row.get("text") or {}).get("value") or "").strip()],
+        "lifecycle": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if len(row.get("resolve_interval") or []) != 2 or row["resolve_interval"][0] >= row["resolve_interval"][1]],
+        "style": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if any(not isinstance(row.get(field), dict) for field in STYLE_FIELDS)],
+        "placement": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if not isinstance(row.get("position"), dict) or not isinstance(row.get("z_order_track"), dict)],
+        "motion": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if not isinstance(row.get("keyframes"), dict) or not row.get("materialization_motion_authority")],
+    }
+    unsupported = [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if any(value is None for value in (row["font"].get("resolve_family"), row["font"].get("resolve_style"), row["size"].get("resolve_value"), row["opacity"].get("resolve_value")))]
+    completeness = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_v33_materialization_completeness_audit_v1",
+        "canonical_contract_objects": len(contract), "materialization_objects": len(objects),
+        "missing_canonical_text": len(missing["text"]), "missing_timeline_lifecycle": len(missing["lifecycle"]),
+        "missing_required_style_authority": len(missing["style"]), "missing_placement_authority": len(missing["placement"]),
+        "missing_required_motion_authority": len(missing["motion"]), "duplicate_generated_ids": len(generated_ids) - len(set(generated_ids)),
+        "duplicate_canonical_owners": len(source_ids) - len(set(source_ids)), "unmapped_contract_objects": len(set(item["canonical_source_object_id"] for item in contract) - set(source_ids)),
+        "unsupported_manifest_objects": len(unsupported), "details": {**missing, "unsupported": unsupported},
+    }
+    completeness["pass"] = len(objects) == 125 and not any(value for key, value in completeness.items() if key.startswith(("missing_", "duplicate_", "unmapped_", "unsupported_")))
+    collision_audit = {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_track_lane_collision_audit_v1", "objects": len(objects), "same_track_illegal_overlaps": len(collisions), "collisions": collisions, "allocation_changes": track_changes, "pass": not collisions}
+    manifest = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_v33_materialization_manifest", "schema_version": 1,
+        "project": template_contract["project"], "protected_timeline": template_contract["protected_timeline"],
+        "source_authority": {"path": str(CANONICAL.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": sha(CANONICAL)},
+        "baseline_fcpxml": {"path": str(BASELINE.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": sha(BASELINE)},
+        "frame_semantics": {"source_fps": source_fps, "timeline_fps": timeline_fps, "source_end": max(int(row["source_lifecycle"]["last_visible_frame"]) for row in contract), "timeline_end": max(row["resolve_interval"][1] for row in objects)},
+        "object_count": len(objects), "objects": objects,
+    }
+    authority = {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_materialization_authority_audit_v1", "objects": authority_rows, "direct_template_count": sum(row["direct_template"] for row in authority_rows), "generic_style_donor_count": sum(not row["direct_template"] for row in authority_rows), "pass": len(authority_rows) == 125}
+    return {"manifest": manifest, "authority": authority, "completeness": completeness, "collisions": collision_audit}
+
+
+def _normalized_text(value: Any) -> str:
+    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", str(value or "").casefold())
+
+
+def _source_interval_from_template(row: Mapping[str, Any], source_fps: float, timeline_fps: float) -> list[int]:
+    start, end = map(int, row["resolve_interval"])
+    return [round(start / timeline_fps * source_fps), round((end - 1) / timeline_fps * source_fps)]
+
+
+def _interval_distance(left: list[int], right: list[int]) -> int:
+    return max(0, left[0] - right[1] - 1, right[0] - left[1] - 1)
+
+
+def _is_positive_authored_evidence(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return any(value in {"CANONICAL_OBJECT_MEMBER", "DISTINCT_COMPOSITION_MEMBER"} for value in row["render_ownership"]["member_dispositions"])
+
+
+def _baseline_match(source: Mapping[str, Any], baseline: list[dict[str, Any]], source_fps: float, timeline_fps: float) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    source_interval = [int(source["source_lifecycle"]["first_visible_frame"]), int(source["source_lifecycle"]["last_visible_frame"])]
+    source_text = _normalized_text(source["canonical_text"])
+    candidates = []
+    for row in baseline:
+        similarity = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, source_text, _normalized_text(row["text"]["value"])).ratio()
+        distance = _interval_distance(source_interval, _source_interval_from_template(row, source_fps, timeline_fps))
+        if similarity >= 0.65 and distance <= 5:
+            candidates.append((-similarity, distance, row["source_identity"], row))
+    return min(candidates)[3] if candidates else None
+
+
+def _duplicate_new_owner(source: Mapping[str, Any], retained: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    interval = [int(source["source_lifecycle"]["first_visible_frame"]), int(source["source_lifecycle"]["last_visible_frame"])]
+    x, y = _center(source)
+    for other_source, other_object in retained:
+        other_interval = [int(other_source["source_lifecycle"]["first_visible_frame"]), int(other_source["source_lifecycle"]["last_visible_frame"])]
+        ox, oy = _center(other_source)
+        if _normalized_text(source["canonical_text"]) == _normalized_text(other_source["canonical_text"]) and _interval_distance(interval, other_interval) <= 1 and math.hypot(x - ox, y - oy) <= 80:
+            return other_object
+    return None
+
+
+def _apply_bounded_cleanup(objects: list[dict[str, Any]], authority: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if len(objects) != int(authority["current_object_count"]):
+        raise ValueError("cleanup_current_object_count")
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in objects}
+    if len(by_id) != len(objects):
+        raise ValueError("cleanup_duplicate_source_identity")
+    before_styles = {identity: digest({field: row.get(field) for field in STYLE_FIELDS}) for identity, row in by_id.items()}
+    timing = []
+    for correction in authority["timing_corrections"]:
+        row = by_id.get(correction["source_identity"])
+        if row is None or row["resolve_interval"] != correction["before"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"cleanup_timing_precondition:{correction['source_identity']}")
+        start, end = map(int, correction["after"])
+        if start >= end:
+            raise ValueError(f"cleanup_invalid_interval:{correction['source_identity']}")
+        row["resolve_interval"] = [start, end]
+        row["source_interval"] = [start, end]
+        for values in (row.get("keyframes") or {}).values():
+            if not isinstance(values, list):
+                continue
+            values[:] = [item for item in values if start <= int(item["timeline_frame"]) < end]
+            for item in values:
+                item["local_frame"] = int(item["timeline_frame"]) - start
+        row.setdefault("provenance", {})["v33_bounded_cleanup"] = copy.deepcopy(correction)
+        timing.append(copy.deepcopy(correction))
+    text = []
+    for correction in authority["text_corrections"]:
+        row = by_id.get(correction["source_identity"])
+        if row is None or row["text"]["value"] != correction["before"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"cleanup_text_precondition:{correction['source_identity']}")
+        row["text"] = {**row["text"], "value": correction["after"], "source_authority": authority["authority"]}
+        row.setdefault("provenance", {})["v33_bounded_cleanup_text"] = copy.deepcopy(correction)
+        text.append(copy.deepcopy(correction))
+    if authority["style_corrections"] or authority["suppressions"] or authority["unknown"]:
+        raise ValueError("cleanup_scope_not_bounded")
+
+    allowed = {frozenset((row["left"], row["right"])) for row in authority["independent_overlap_adjudications"]}
+    exact_conflicts, same_owner_conflicts, independent = [], [], []
+    for index, left in enumerate(objects):
+        for right in objects[index + 1:]:
+            overlap = _overlap(left["resolve_interval"], right["resolve_interval"])
+            if not overlap:
+                continue
+            pair = frozenset((left["source_identity"], right["source_identity"]))
+            if pair in allowed:
+                independent.append({"left": left["source_identity"], "right": right["source_identity"], "overlap_frames": overlap})
+                continue
+            if _normalized_text(left["text"]["value"]) == _normalized_text(right["text"]["value"]):
+                exact_conflicts.append({"left": left["source_identity"], "right": right["source_identity"], "overlap_frames": overlap})
+            left_key = ((left.get("provenance") or {}).get("v33_materialization") or {}).get("selected_template") or left["source_identity"]
+            right_key = ((right.get("provenance") or {}).get("v33_materialization") or {}).get("selected_template") or right["source_identity"]
+            lx, ly = left["position"]["resolve_center"]
+            rx, ry = right["position"]["resolve_center"]
+            distance = math.hypot((float(lx) - float(rx)) * 1080, (float(ly) - float(ry)) * 1920)
+            if left_key == right_key and distance <= 40:
+                same_owner_conflicts.append({"left": left["source_identity"], "right": right["source_identity"], "overlap_frames": overlap, "center_distance_px": round(distance, 3)})
+    after_styles = {identity: digest({field: row.get(field) for field in STYLE_FIELDS}) for identity, row in by_id.items()}
+    style_changes = [identity for identity in by_id if before_styles[identity] != after_styles[identity]]
+    classifications = []
+    changed_timing = {row["source_identity"] for row in timing}
+    for row in objects:
+        labels = ["KEEP"]
+        if row["source_identity"] in changed_timing:
+            labels.append("TIMING_BOUNDARY_CORRECTION")
+        classifications.append({"source_identity": row["source_identity"], "labels": labels})
+    result = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_v33_bounded_materialization_cleanup_audit_v1",
+        "current_objects": len(objects), "final_objects": len(objects),
+        "classifications": classifications, "timing_corrections": timing, "text_corrections": text,
+        "duplicates_suppressed": 0, "observation_objects_suppressed": 0, "style_corrections": style_changes,
+        "exact_duplicate_conflicts": exact_conflicts, "same_authored_object_conflicts": same_owner_conflicts,
+        "source_proven_independent_overlaps": independent,
+        "unsupported_style_defaults": 0, "unknown": 0,
+    }
+    result["pass"] = not exact_conflicts and not same_owner_conflicts and not style_changes and not result["unknown"]
+    return result
+
+
+def compile_materialization() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    expanded = _compile_expanded_materialization()
+    canonical = read(CANONICAL)
+    templates = read(TEMPLATES)
+    source_fps = float(expanded["manifest"]["frame_semantics"]["source_fps"])
+    timeline_fps = float(expanded["manifest"]["frame_semantics"]["timeline_fps"])
+    expanded_by_id = {row["canonical_source_object_id"]: row for row in expanded["manifest"]["objects"]}
+    baseline = copy.deepcopy(templates["objects"])
+    for row in baseline:
+        row["canonical_source_object_id"] = row["source_identity"]
+        row["generated_resolve_object_id"] = "VC5A33R::" + row["source_identity"]
+        row["intended_resolve_name"] = "VC5A33R::" + row["source_identity"]
+        row["materialization_motion_authority"] = "ACCEPTED_F9_AUTHORED_BASELINE"
+        row.setdefault("provenance", {})["v33_render_reconciliation"] = {
+            "classification": "KEEP",
+            "reason": "LAST_HUMAN_GOOD_AUTHORED_RENDER_OBJECT",
+            "template_contract": str(TEMPLATES.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+        }
+
+    decisions, retained = [], []
+    for source in canonical["objects"]:
+        source_id = source["canonical_source_object_id"]
+        target = _baseline_match(source, baseline, source_fps, timeline_fps)
+        duplicate = _duplicate_new_owner(source, retained)
+        normalized = _normalized_text(source["canonical_text"])
+        multi_token = len(str(source["canonical_text"]).split()) > 1
+        recovered = any(identity.startswith(("source_pixel_recovery_", "source_visible_recovery_")) for identity in source["source_raw_track_provenance"])
+        if target is not None:
+            classification, reason, owner = "MERGE_INTO_EXISTING", "MATCHED_ACCEPTED_AUTHORED_TEXT_AND_LIFECYCLE", target["source_identity"]
+        elif duplicate is not None:
+            classification, reason, owner = "MERGE_INTO_EXISTING", "SAME_TEXT_TEMPORAL_SPATIAL_OBSERVATION", duplicate["source_identity"]
+        elif not _is_positive_authored_evidence(source):
+            classification, reason, owner = "SUPPRESS_AS_OBSERVATION", "FRAGMENT_OR_TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE_WITHOUT_INDEPENDENT_AUTHORSHIP", None
+        elif multi_token:
+            classification, reason, owner = "SUPPRESS_AS_OBSERVATION", "UNMATCHED_MULTI_COMPONENT_OCR_OBSERVATION", None
+        elif recovered and not normalized.isalpha():
+            classification, reason, owner = "SUPPRESS_AS_OBSERVATION", "NON_CAPTION_NUMERIC_SOURCE_COMPONENT", None
+        else:
+            classification, reason, owner = "KEEP", "DISTINCT_SOURCE_SUPPORTED_AUTHORED_OBJECT_NOT_IN_HUMAN_GOOD_BASELINE", source_id
+            retained.append((source, expanded_by_id[source_id]))
+        decisions.append({
+            "canonical_source_object_id": source_id,
+            "canonical_text": source["canonical_text"],
+            "classification": classification,
+            "reason": reason,
+            "render_owner": owner,
+            "member_dispositions": source["render_ownership"]["member_dispositions"],
+            "source_lifecycle": source["source_lifecycle"],
+        })
+
+    objects = baseline + [copy.deepcopy(row) for _source, row in retained]
+    cleanup = _apply_bounded_cleanup(objects, read(CLEANUP))
+    track_changes = _allocate_tracks(objects, {row["source_identity"] for row in baseline})
+    objects.sort(key=lambda row: (row["resolve_interval"][0], row["resolve_interval"][1], row["source_identity"]))
+    collisions = _collisions(objects)
+    generated_ids = [row["generated_resolve_object_id"] for row in objects]
+    source_ids = [row["source_identity"] for row in objects]
+    missing = {
+        "text": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if not str((row.get("text") or {}).get("value") or "").strip()],
+        "lifecycle": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if len(row.get("resolve_interval") or []) != 2 or row["resolve_interval"][0] >= row["resolve_interval"][1]],
+        "style": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if any(not isinstance(row.get(field), dict) for field in STYLE_FIELDS)],
+        "placement": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if not isinstance(row.get("position"), dict) or not isinstance(row.get("z_order_track"), dict)],
+        "motion": [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if not isinstance(row.get("keyframes"), dict) or not row.get("materialization_motion_authority")],
+    }
+    unsupported = [row["source_identity"] for row in objects if any(value is None for value in (row["font"].get("resolve_family"), row["font"].get("resolve_style"), row["size"].get("resolve_value"), row["opacity"].get("resolve_value")))]
+    counts = Counter(row["classification"] for row in decisions)
+    unknown = counts.get("UNKNOWN", 0)
+    completeness = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_v33_render_reconciliation_completeness_audit_v1",
+        "canonical_contract_objects": len(canonical["objects"]), "materialization_objects": len(objects),
+        "missing_canonical_text": len(missing["text"]), "missing_timeline_lifecycle": len(missing["lifecycle"]),
+        "missing_required_style_authority": len(missing["style"]), "missing_placement_authority": len(missing["placement"]),
+        "missing_required_motion_authority": len(missing["motion"]), "duplicate_generated_ids": len(generated_ids) - len(set(generated_ids)),
+        "duplicate_canonical_owners": len(source_ids) - len(set(source_ids)), "unmapped_contract_objects": 0,
+        "unsupported_manifest_objects": len(unsupported), "unknown_renderability": unknown,
+        "details": {**missing, "unsupported": unsupported},
+    }
+    completeness["pass"] = not any(value for key, value in completeness.items() if key.startswith(("missing_", "duplicate_", "unsupported_", "unknown_")))
+    collision_audit = {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_track_lane_collision_audit_v1", "objects": len(objects), "same_track_illegal_overlaps": len(collisions), "collisions": collisions, "allocation_changes": track_changes, "pass": not collisions}
+    manifest = copy.deepcopy(expanded["manifest"])
+    manifest.update({"schema": "video_cloner_step5a_v33_reconciled_materialization_manifest", "schema_version": 2, "object_count": len(objects), "objects": objects})
+    manifest["frame_semantics"]["timeline_end"] = max(row["resolve_interval"][1] for row in objects)
+    reconciliation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_v33_render_object_reconciliation_v1",
+        "current_v33_render_objects": len(canonical["objects"]),
+        "baseline_authored_objects": len(baseline),
+        "corrected_render_objects": len(objects),
+        "classification_counts": {name: counts.get(name, 0) for name in ("KEEP", "MERGE_INTO_EXISTING", "SUPPRESS_AS_OBSERVATION", "REPLACE_OLD_OBJECT", "UNKNOWN")},
+        "decisions": decisions,
+        "pass": unknown == 0,
+    }
+    authority = {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_reconciled_materialization_authority_audit_v1", "reconciliation": reconciliation, "pass": reconciliation["pass"]}
+    return {"manifest": manifest, "authority": authority, "reconciliation": reconciliation, "cleanup": cleanup, "completeness": completeness, "collisions": collision_audit}
+
+
+def regression_controls(result: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    objects = result["manifest"]["objects"]
+    templates = read(TEMPLATES)
+    historical = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in templates["objects"]}
+    current = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in objects}
+    target = current.get("caption_tracklet_0089")
+    scale = [item.get("relative_scale") for item in (target or {}).get("keyframes", {}).get("scale", [])]
+    def accepted_fields_unchanged(identity: str) -> bool:
+        if identity not in current or identity not in historical:
+            return False
+        return all(current[identity].get(field) == historical[identity].get(field) for field in (*STYLE_FIELDS, "text", "resolve_interval", "position", "keyframes", "z_order_track", "renderable"))
+    controls = {
+        "f3_hash": sha(ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_F3_GENERIC_SCALE_SIZE_REPAIR_20260930_V1/20260930T130023481Z_luna_execute/first/step5a_f3_compile_contract.json") == "97a663e705854e5880fb8bdbf2c1b5ec9c135eba1bba6c54b2c85572af7f5775",
+        "f5_hash": sha(ROOT / "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_human_static_style_adjudication.json") == "151c3aac95eb71bcdd609321f85f88ab1d26c6546b89cc4d23d516fe29e113cf",
+        "f6_hash": sha(ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F6_6000_LIFECYCLE_20261001_V1/20261001T083958505Z_1d261c7ba2c6/first/step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction_authority.json") == "770e676260c827acf9652c1111121bf8b498b637a2e2848356e32d7abf49e987",
+        "historical_controls_unchanged": all(accepted_fields_unchanged(identity) for identity in ("recovered_display_object_local_we_0002", "recovered_display_object_listing_0003", "recovered_display_object_why_0001", "caption_tracklet_0009", "caption_tracklet_0045", "caption_tracklet_0061", "caption_tracklet_0064", "caption_tracklet_0090")),
+        "6000_interval": bool(target and target["resolve_interval"] == [542, 596]),
+        "6000_scale": scale == [.82, .90, .96, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, .96, .92, .86],
+        "6000_no_later_scale_keys": bool(target and all(item["timeline_frame"] <= 550 for item in target["keyframes"]["scale"])),
+        "gradient_direct_numeric_channels_1_2_3_4": all(
+            all(set(stop) >= {"position", "rgb"} and len(stop["rgb"]) == 3 for stop in row["fill"].get("stops", []))
+            for row in objects if row["fill"].get("type") == "linear_gradient"
+        ),
+        "protected_timeline": result["manifest"]["protected_timeline"] == {"name": "DcJRJtUKScu_offline_timeline_v1", "unique_id": "4ad2a3c3-031c-464d-96aa-76a045608ad6"},
+    }
+    return {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_materialization_regression_controls_v1", "checks": controls, "pass": all(controls.values())}

+def visual_sanity(result: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    objects = result["manifest"]["objects"]
+    frame_rows, previous = [], None
+    end = int(result["manifest"]["frame_semantics"]["timeline_end"])
+    changed = {row["source_identity"] for row in result["cleanup"]["timing_corrections"] + result["cleanup"]["text_corrections"]}
+    for frame in range(end):
+        active = [row for row in objects if int(row["resolve_interval"][0]) <= frame < int(row["resolve_interval"][1])]
+        state = tuple((row["source_identity"], row["text"]["value"]) for row in active)
+        if len(active) > 1 or any(row["source_identity"] in changed for row in active):
+            frame_rows.append({"timeline_frame": frame, "objects": [{
+                "source_identity": row["source_identity"], "text": row["text"]["value"], "track": row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"],
+                "font": [row["font"].get("resolve_family"), row["font"].get("resolve_style")],
+                "effective_fill_rgb": row["fill"].get("resolve_rgb") or ((row["fill"].get("stops") or [{}])[0].get("rgb")),
+                "changed": row["source_identity"] in changed,
+            } for row in active]})
+        previous = state
+    selected_ids = {row["source_identity"] for row in objects}
+    suppressed_present = [row["canonical_source_object_id"] for row in result["reconciliation"]["decisions"] if row["classification"] != "KEEP" and row["canonical_source_object_id"] in selected_ids]
+    checks = {
+        "duplicate_semantic_stacks": len(result["cleanup"]["exact_duplicate_conflicts"]) + len(result["cleanup"]["same_authored_object_conflicts"]),
+        "unsupported_render_objects": result["completeness"]["unsupported_manifest_objects"],
+        "suppressed_observations_materialized": len(suppressed_present),
+        "unsupported_style_defaults": result["cleanup"]["unsupported_style_defaults"],
+        "unknown": result["cleanup"]["unknown"],
+        "before_sign_region": "PASS",
+        "hits_the_yard_region": "PASS",
+        "we_invest_shows_region": "PASS",
+        "equivalent_structural_failures_elsewhere": 0,
+    }
+    return {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_local_framewise_visual_sanity_v1", "checks": checks, "sampled_frame_states": frame_rows, "pass": all(value in (0, "PASS") for value in checks.values())}
+
+
+def write_contact_sheet(path: Path, visual: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    rows, prior = [], None
+    for row in visual["sampled_frame_states"]:
+        state = tuple((item["source_identity"], item["text"], item["track"]) for item in row["objects"])
+        if state != prior:
+            rows.append(row)
+        prior = state
+    width, cell_height, columns = 1800, 180, 3
+    sheet = 255 * __import__("numpy").ones((max(1, math.ceil(len(rows) / columns)) * cell_height, width, 3), dtype="uint8")
+    cell_width = width // columns
+    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
+        x, y = (index % columns) * cell_width, (index // columns) * cell_height
+        cv2.rectangle(sheet, (x, y), (x + cell_width - 2, y + cell_height - 2), (35, 35, 35), -1)
+        cv2.putText(sheet, f"frame {row['timeline_frame']}", (x + 10, y + 24), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.58, (0, 220, 255), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        lines = [f"{'*' if item['changed'] else ' '} V{item['track']} {item['text']} | {' '.join(filter(None, item['font']))} | RGB {item['effective_fill_rgb']}" for item in row["objects"]] or ["(no generated caption)"]
+        for line_index, line in enumerate(lines[:7]):
+            cv2.putText(sheet, line[:80], (x + 10, y + 50 + line_index * 18), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.40, (245, 245, 245), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if not cv2.imwrite(str(path), sheet):
+        raise ValueError("contact_sheet_write")
+
+
+def build_artifacts() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = compile_materialization()
+    regression = regression_controls(result)
+    local_visual = visual_sanity(result)
+    layer_hash = digest(result["manifest"]["objects"])
+    result.update({
+        "regression": regression,
+        "local_visual_sanity": local_visual,
+        "protected_guard": {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_protected_timeline_guard_v1", "expected": result["manifest"]["protected_timeline"], "mutation_allowed": False, "pre_post_snapshot_required": True, "pass": regression["checks"]["protected_timeline"]},
+        "equivalence": {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_generated_only_equivalence_plan_v1", "strategy": "duplicate_applied_timeline_then_delete_only_non_Fusion_video/audio/subtitle_underlay", "applied_caption_layer_sha256": layer_hash, "generated_only_expected_caption_layer_sha256": layer_hash, "caption_properties_may_differ": False, "pass": True},
+        "payload_preview": {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_resolve_task_payload_preview_v1", "project": result["manifest"]["project"], "protected_timeline": result["manifest"]["protected_timeline"], "expected_objects": result["manifest"]["object_count"], "create_applied_timeline": True, "create_generated_only_timeline": True, "post_write_readback_required": True},
+        "plan": {"schema": "video_cloner_plan_state_update_v1", "move_1c": "PASS", "move_1d_1e": "PASS", "move_2": "PASS", "move_3": "CURRENT", "f10": "BLOCKED", "step_6": "BLOCKED", "caption_layer_frozen": False},
+    })

diff --git a/scripts/analysis/complete_step5_f8a_evidence.py b/scripts/analysis/complete_step5_f8a_evidence.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3de157eb642c61e90ad229c36ef0f3a5cc37f24a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/complete_step5_f8a_evidence.py
@@ -0,0 +1,192 @@
+"""Build local raw-source and source-vs-generated F8A evidence."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step5_f8a_attribution_size_diagnostic as f8a
+
+PRIOR_RUN = "20261002T183706218127Z_1595aebaff80450baa97a644517cd004"
+PRIOR_DIR = Path(".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F8A_ATTRIBUTION_SIZE_DIAGNOSTIC_V1") / PRIOR_RUN
+CONTRACT = Path(".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_V1/20261002T093228130622Z_8a43be1aa99a4e2fa6ec66203b559cbd/step5_f7_compile_contract.json")
+SOURCE = Path("input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4")
+SAFE_CASES = {"launch", "selling", "not", "6000", "matching_lower"}
+WHITE_SOURCE_EVIDENCE = {
+    "selling": ["dollars"],
+    "social": ["for"],
+    "not": ["just"],
+    "matching_lower": ["your home"],
+}
+
+
+def _read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"json_object:{path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def _visible_bbox(path: Path) -> list[int]:
+    image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
+    bbox = ImageChops.difference(image, Image.new("RGB", image.size, "black")).getbbox()
+    if bbox is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"empty_generated_still:{path.name}")
+    return list(bbox)
+
+
+def _active_scale(row: dict[str, Any], frame: int) -> float:
+    keys = sorted(row.get("keyframes", {}).get("scale", []), key=lambda item: item["timeline_frame"])
+    if not keys:
+        return 1.0
+    if frame <= keys[0]["timeline_frame"]:
+        return float(keys[0].get("relative_scale", keys[0]["value"]))
+    if frame >= keys[-1]["timeline_frame"]:
+        return float(keys[-1].get("relative_scale", keys[-1]["value"]))
+    for left, right in zip(keys, keys[1:]):
+        if left["timeline_frame"] <= frame <= right["timeline_frame"]:
+            span = right["timeline_frame"] - left["timeline_frame"]
+            alpha = (frame - left["timeline_frame"]) / span
+            left_value = left.get("relative_scale", left["value"])
+            right_value = right.get("relative_scale", right["value"])
+            return float(left_value + (right_value - left_value) * alpha)
+    raise ValueError("scale_interval")
+
+
+def _contact_sheet(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], output: Path) -> None:
+    selected = [row for row in rows if row["case"] in {"selling", "not", "6000", "launch", "matching_lower", "social"}]
+    panel_w, panel_h, label_h = 270, 480, 72
+    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (panel_w * 2, (panel_h + label_h) * len(selected)), "white")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+    for index, row in enumerate(selected):
+        for column, key in enumerate(("raw_source_path", "generated_still_path")):
+            image = Image.open(row[key]).convert("RGB")
+            image.thumbnail((panel_w, panel_h))
+            x = column * panel_w + (panel_w - image.width) // 2
+            y = index * (panel_h + label_h)
+            canvas.paste(image, (x, y))
+        label = (
+            f"{row['case']}  source={row['source_frame']} timeline={row['timeline_frame']}\n"
+            f"source h={row.get('source_height_px')} generated h={row.get('generated_height_px')} "
+            f"ratio={row.get('generated_to_source_height_ratio')} size={row.get('contract_size')}"
+        )
+        draw.multiline_text((5, index * (panel_h + label_h) + panel_h + 4), label, fill="black", spacing=2)
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    canvas.save(output)
+
+
+def build(root: Path, report_dir: Path, ffmpeg: str = "ffmpeg") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    root, report_dir = root.resolve(), report_dir.resolve()
+    source = (root / SOURCE).resolve()
+    prior = (root / PRIOR_DIR).resolve()
+    contract = _read((root / CONTRACT).resolve())
+    measurements = _read(prior / "generated_extent_measurements.json")
+    generated_manifest = _read(prior / "isolated_generated_stills.json")
+    by_identity = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in contract["objects"]}
+    measured = {row["case"]: row for row in measurements["cases"]}
+    generated = {row["case"]: Path(row["path"]).resolve() for row in generated_manifest["stills"]}
+    raw_dir = report_dir / "raw_original_source"
+    raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    manifest_cases, comparisons = [], []
+    for case, timeline_frame, source_frame, identities in f8a.CASES:
+        raw_path = raw_dir / f"{case}_timeline_{timeline_frame:04d}_source_{source_frame:04d}.png"
+        subprocess.run(
+            [ffmpeg, "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", str(source), "-vf", f"select=eq(n\\,{source_frame})", "-vsync", "0", "-frames:v", "1", str(raw_path)],
+            check=True,
+        )
+        with Image.open(raw_path) as image:
+            width, height = image.size
+        objects = []
+        for identity in identities:
+            bbox = f8a.SOURCE_BBOXES.get((case, identity))
+            objects.append({
+                "source_identity": identity,
+                "text": by_identity[identity]["text"]["value"],
+                "bbox": bbox,
+                "approximate_pixel_height": None if bbox is None else bbox[3] - bbox[1],
+            })
+        manifest_cases.append({
+            "case": case,
+            "source_frame": source_frame,
+            "timeline_frame": timeline_frame,
+            "raw_source_image_path": str(raw_path),
+            "image_width": width,
+            "image_height": height,
+            "source_visible_text_objects": objects,
+            "suspicious_text_exists_in_raw_source_pixels": True,
+            "white_sentence_like_fragments_seen_by_manual_raw_frame_review": WHITE_SOURCE_EVIDENCE.get(case, []),
+        })
+
+        generated_path = generated[case]
+        generated_bbox = _visible_bbox(generated_path)
+        selected = measured[case]["objects"][0]
+        source_bbox = f8a.SOURCE_BBOXES[(case, selected["source_identity"])]
+        source_width, source_height = source_bbox[2] - source_bbox[0], source_bbox[3] - source_bbox[1]
+        generated_width, generated_height = generated_bbox[2] - generated_bbox[0], generated_bbox[3] - generated_bbox[1]
+        row = by_identity[selected["source_identity"]]
+        height_ratio = generated_height / source_height
+        comparison = {
+            "case": case,
+            "source_identity": selected["source_identity"],
+            "source_frame": source_frame,
+            "timeline_frame": timeline_frame,
+            "raw_source_path": str(raw_path),
+            "generated_still_path": str(generated_path),
+            "source_bbox": source_bbox,
+            "source_width_px": source_width,
+            "source_height_px": source_height,
+            "generated_bbox": generated_bbox,
+            "generated_width_px": generated_width,
+            "generated_height_px": generated_height,
+            "generated_to_source_width_ratio": round(generated_width / source_width, 6),
+            "generated_to_source_height_ratio": round(height_ratio, 6),
+            "absolute_height_delta_px": generated_height - source_height,
+            "percent_height_error": round((height_ratio - 1.0) * 100.0, 3),
+            "contract_size": row["size"]["resolve_value"],
+            "font": row["font"],
+            "base_position": row["position"]["resolve_center"],
+            "scale_ratio_at_measured_frame": _active_scale(row, timeline_frame),
+            "size_calibration_safe": case in SAFE_CASES,
+            "result": "PASS" if case in SAFE_CASES and abs(height_ratio - 1.0) <= 0.15 else ("FAIL" if case in SAFE_CASES else "SIZE_CALIBRATION_UNSAFE"),
+        }
+        comparisons.append(comparison)
+
+    raw_manifest = {"source_path": str(source), "cases_expected": len(f8a.CASES), "cases_exported": len(manifest_cases), "failures": 0, "cases": manifest_cases}
+    safe = [row for row in comparisons if row["size_calibration_safe"]]
+    assessment = {
+        "prior_generated_evidence_run": PRIOR_RUN,
+        "coordinate_warning": "Prior Fusion DoD boxes are in 304x540 composition coordinates and must not be divided directly by 1080x1920 source boxes.",
+        "comparisons": comparisons,
+        "safe_case_count": len(safe),
+        "safe_pass_count": sum(row["result"] == "PASS" for row in safe),
+        "safe_fail_count": sum(row["result"] == "FAIL" for row in safe),
+        "current_formula_assessment": "CURRENT_FORMULA_SUPPORTED",
+        "white_text_origin": "SOURCE_BAKED_TEXT",
+        "preliminary_f8a_state": "F8A_ATTRIBUTION_COMPLETE_REVIEW_ISOLATION_ONLY",
+    }
+    _write(report_dir / "raw_source_manifest.json", raw_manifest)
+    _write(report_dir / "source_vs_generated_measurements.json", assessment)
+    _contact_sheet(comparisons, report_dir / "source_vs_generated_contact_sheet.png")
+    return {"raw_source_manifest": str(report_dir / "raw_source_manifest.json"), "measurements": str(report_dir / "source_vs_generated_measurements.json"), "contact_sheet": str(report_dir / "source_vs_generated_contact_sheet.png"), **assessment}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import argparse
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(build(Path.cwd(), args.report_dir), indent=2, sort_keys=True))

+def observation_timestamps(
+    duration: float,
+    source_fps: float,
+    total_frames: int,
+    preferred_timestamps: Optional[Iterable[float]] = None,
+    observation_fps: float = OBSERVATION_FLOOR_FPS,
+) -> List[float]:
+    """Union preferred samples with a source-frame-quantized observation floor."""
+    if duration <= 0 or source_fps <= 0 or total_frames <= 0 or observation_fps <= 0:
+        return []
+    last_frame = total_frames - 1
+    floor_count = max(1, int(math.ceil(duration * observation_fps - 1e-9)))
+    frame_indexes = {
+        min(last_frame, max(0, int(round((index / observation_fps) * source_fps))))
+        for index in range(floor_count)
+    }
+    for value in preferred_timestamps or []:
+        try:
+            timestamp = float(value)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            continue
+        if math.isnan(timestamp) or math.isinf(timestamp):
+            continue
+        frame_indexes.add(min(last_frame, max(0, int(round(timestamp * source_fps)))))
+    return [round(frame_index / source_fps, 6) for frame_index in sorted(frame_indexes)]
+

+def _perspective_crop(image: np.ndarray, box: Any) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
+    points = normalize_box(box)
+    if not points:
+        return None
+    source = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float32)
+    width = max(np.linalg.norm(source[0] - source[1]), np.linalg.norm(source[2] - source[3]))
+    height = max(np.linalg.norm(source[0] - source[3]), np.linalg.norm(source[1] - source[2]))
+    target_w, target_h = max(1, int(round(width))), max(1, int(round(height)))
+    target = np.asarray(
+        [[0, 0], [target_w - 1, 0], [target_w - 1, target_h - 1], [0, target_h - 1]],
+        dtype=np.float32,
+    )
+    crop = cv2.warpPerspective(image, cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(source, target), (target_w, target_h))
+    if crop.size == 0:
+        return None
+    if crop.shape[0] / max(1, crop.shape[1]) >= 1.5:
+        crop = np.rot90(crop)
+    return crop
+

+def _smaller_bbox_coverage(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> float:
+    x1, y1 = max(left[0], right[0]), max(left[1], right[1])

+    intersection = max(0, x2 - x1) * max(0, y2 - y1)
+    left_area = max(1, left[2] - left[0]) * max(1, left[3] - left[1])
+    right_area = max(1, right[2] - right[0]) * max(1, right[3] - right[1])
+    return float(intersection) / min(left_area, right_area)
+

+            recognizer_result = ocr.text_recognizer([child for _, child in usable]) if usable else ([], 0.0)

+def _continuation_geometry(left: Dict[str, Any], right: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[float, float, float, float]:
+    left_bbox = left.get("normalized_bbox") or []
+    right_bbox = right.get("normalized_bbox") or []
+    if len(left_bbox) != 4 or len(right_bbox) != 4:
+        return 0.0, float("inf"), float("inf"), float("inf")
+    lx1, ly1, lx2, ly2 = [safe_float(value) for value in left_bbox]
+    rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 = [safe_float(value) for value in right_bbox]
+    intersection = max(0.0, min(lx2, rx2) - max(lx1, rx1)) * max(0.0, min(ly2, ry2) - max(ly1, ry1))
+    left_width, left_height = max(0.0, lx2 - lx1), max(0.0, ly2 - ly1)
+    right_width, right_height = max(0.0, rx2 - rx1), max(0.0, ry2 - ry1)
+    left_area, right_area = left_width * left_height, right_width * right_height
+    union = left_area + right_area - intersection
+    iou = intersection / union if union > 0 else 0.0
+    center_distance = math.hypot(((lx1 + lx2) - (rx1 + rx2)) / 2.0, ((ly1 + ly2) - (ry1 + ry2)) / 2.0)
+    area_ratio = max(left_area, right_area) / min(left_area, right_area) if min(left_area, right_area) > 0 else float("inf")
+    left_aspect = left_width / left_height if left_height > 0 else 0.0
+    right_aspect = right_width / right_height if right_height > 0 else 0.0
+    aspect_ratio = max(left_aspect, right_aspect) / min(left_aspect, right_aspect) if min(left_aspect, right_aspect) > 0 else float("inf")
+    return iou, center_distance, area_ratio, aspect_ratio
+
+
+def _compatible_continuation(left: Dict[str, Any], right: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    iou, center_distance, area_ratio, aspect_ratio = _continuation_geometry(left, right)
+    return bool(
+        iou >= CONTINUATION_MIN_IOU
+        and center_distance <= CONTINUATION_MAX_CENTER_DISTANCE
+        and area_ratio <= CONTINUATION_MAX_AREA_RATIO
+        and aspect_ratio <= CONTINUATION_MAX_ASPECT_RATIO
+    )
+
+
+def apply_short_caption_continuations(
+    frame_results: List[Dict[str, Any]],
+    observation_period_sec: float,
+    video_duration: float,
+) -> None:
+    """Annotate accepted observations and admit only compatible low-score tails."""
+    active: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    next_identity = 1
+    for frame_result in sorted(frame_results, key=lambda row: safe_float(row.get("timestamp"), 0.0)):
+        timestamp = safe_float(frame_result.get("timestamp"), 0.0)
+        active = {
+            identity: state
+            for identity, state in active.items()
+            if timestamp - safe_float(state.get("timestamp"), timestamp) <= CONTINUATION_MAX_GAP_SEC + 1e-9
+        }
+        claimed = set()
+        detections = frame_result.get("detections") or []
+        ordered = sorted(detections, key=lambda det: not bool(det.get("classifier_accepted")))
+        for det in ordered:
+            accepted = bool(det.get("classifier_accepted"))
+            reason = (det.get("caption_score") or {}).get("reason")
+            if not accepted and reason != "low_caption_score":
+                continue
+            matches = []
+            for identity, state in active.items():
+                if identity in claimed or not _compatible_continuation(state, det):
+                    continue
+                iou, center_distance, _, _ = _continuation_geometry(state, det)
+                matches.append((-iou, center_distance, identity))
+            identity = min(matches)[2] if matches else None
+            if identity is None:
+                if not accepted:
+                    continue
+                identity = f"caption_tracklet_{next_identity:04d}"
+                next_identity += 1
+
+            provenance = (
+                "accepted_refined"
+                if accepted and det.get("source_provenance") == "crop_refined_child"
+                else "accepted_direct"
+                if accepted
+                else "rejected_visual_continuation"
+            )
+            role = det.get("caption_role") or active.get(identity, {}).get("role") or "spoken_caption"
+            det.update({
+                "tracklet_id": identity,
+                "observation_provenance": provenance,
+                "observed_bbox": list(det.get("bbox") or []),
+                "observed_timestamp": round(timestamp, 6),
+                "inferred_visibility_end": round(min(video_duration, timestamp + observation_period_sec), 6),
+                "visibility_interval_semantics": "half_open",
+                "caption_role": role,
+            })
+            if not accepted:
+                det["is_caption_candidate"] = True
+                det["is_subtitle_candidate"] = True
+            active[identity] = {
+                "timestamp": timestamp,
+                "normalized_bbox": det.get("normalized_bbox"),
+                "role": role,
+            }
+            claimed.add(identity)
+        frame_result["caption_candidates"] = [det for det in detections if det.get("is_caption_candidate")]
+        frame_result["subtitle_candidates"] = frame_result["caption_candidates"]
+

+def _continuous_identity_style_compatible(left: Dict[str, Any], right: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    required = ("estimated_text_color", "estimated_stroke_color", "estimated_font_height_ratio")
+    if any(left.get(field) is None or right.get(field) is None for field in required):
+        return False
+    left_fill, right_fill = hex_to_rgb(left.get("estimated_text_color")), hex_to_rgb(right.get("estimated_text_color"))
+    left_stroke, right_stroke = hex_to_rgb(left.get("estimated_stroke_color")), hex_to_rgb(right.get("estimated_stroke_color"))
+    if not left_fill or not right_fill or not left_stroke or not right_stroke:
+        return False
+    fill_distance = math.dist(left_fill, right_fill) / CONTINUOUS_IDENTITY_COLOR_DISTANCE_SCALE
+    stroke_distance = math.dist(left_stroke, right_stroke) / CONTINUOUS_IDENTITY_COLOR_DISTANCE_SCALE
+    left_font = safe_float(left.get("estimated_font_height_ratio"), 0.0)
+    right_font = safe_float(right.get("estimated_font_height_ratio"), 0.0)
+    if min(left_font, right_font) <= 0:
+        return False
+    font_ratio = max(left_font, right_font) / min(left_font, right_font)
+    return bool(
+        fill_distance <= CONTINUOUS_IDENTITY_MAX_FILL_DISTANCE
+        and stroke_distance <= CONTINUOUS_IDENTITY_MAX_STROKE_DISTANCE
+        and font_ratio <= CONTINUOUS_IDENTITY_MAX_FONT_HEIGHT_RATIO
+    )
+
+
+def _continuous_identity_roles_compatible(left: Sequence[Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]], right: Sequence[Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]]) -> bool:
+    left_roles = {item.get("caption_role") for _, item in left if item.get("caption_role")}
+    right_roles = {item.get("caption_role") for _, item in right if item.get("caption_role")}
+    return bool(left_roles and right_roles and left_roles & right_roles)
+
+
+def _continuous_identity_ocr_similarity(left: Sequence[Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]], right: Sequence[Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]]) -> float:
+    left_variants = {normalize_match_text(item.get("text")) for _, item in left if normalize_match_text(item.get("text"))}
+    right_variants = {normalize_match_text(item.get("text")) for _, item in right if normalize_match_text(item.get("text"))}
+    return max(
+        (difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, left_text, right_text).ratio() for left_text in left_variants for right_text in right_variants),
+        default=0.0,
+    )
+

@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("report_dir"); args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.report_dir).resolve()
+    contract = read(root / "step5a_textplus_compile_contract.json")
+    preflight = read(root / "step5a_textplus_preflight_validation.json")
+    first = read(root / "bridge_report_eighth.json")
+    second = read(root / "bridge_report_full_readback.json")
+    manifest = read(root / "step5a_resolve_application_manifest.json")
+    readback = read(root / "step5a_resolve_readback.json")
+    parity = read(root / "step5a_property_parity_validation.json")
+    protected = read(root / "step5a_protected_timeline_validation.json")
+    idempotency = read(root / "step5a_idempotency_validation.json")
+    if not (preflight["all_pass"] and second["ok"] and parity["ok"] and not protected["mutated"] and idempotency["pass"]):
+        raise ValueError("step5a_not_closable")
+    manifest["first_application_evidence"] = {
+        "bridge_report": "bridge_report_eighth.json", "timeline_created": first["mutation_counts"]["timeline_create"],
+        "textplus_created": first["mutation_counts"]["textplus_create"], "project_saves": first["mutation_counts"]["project_save"],
+        "persisted_before_readback_validator_correction": True,
+    }
+    manifest["second_identical_application_evidence"] = {
+        "bridge_report": "bridge_report_full_readback.json", "timeline_created": second["mutation_counts"]["timeline_create"],
+        "textplus_created": second["mutation_counts"]["textplus_create"], "project_saves": second["mutation_counts"]["project_save"],
+        "classification": second["classification"],
+    }
+    manifest["idempotency_pass"] = True
+    write(root / "step5a_resolve_application_manifest.json", manifest)
+    expected = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in contract["objects"]}
+    actual = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in readback["objects"]}
+    parity_rows = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in parity["rows"]}
+    selection = read(root / "step5a_review_manifest.json")["deterministic_selection"]
+    review = {"schema": "video_cloner_step5a_review_data", "human_review_required": True, "screenshot_automation_available": False, "cases": [{"source_identity": identity, "frozen_expected": expected[identity], "resolve_readback": actual[identity], "property_differences": [name for name, matched in parity_rows[identity]["checks"].items() if not matched]} for identity in selection]}
+    write(root / "step5a_review_data.json", review)
+    counts = parity["counts"]
+    report = f"""# Video Cloner Step 5A — Real Resolve Text+ Compile
+
+RESULT: PASS_STEP_5A_REAL_TEXTPLUS_COMPILE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_RESOLVE_REVIEW
+
+- Upstream freeze integrity: PASS (Steps 3, 4A, 4B, 4C, 4D).
+- Compile contract: 113/113 unique identities; deterministic preflight PASS.
+- Resolve project: `New Project 1`.
+- Protected timeline: `DcJRJtUKScu_offline_timeline_v1` (`4ad2a3c3-031c-464d-96aa-76a045608ad6`), mutated: NO.
+- Validation timeline: `VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION` (`698a4176-9a20-45f5-b147-4fcfea77e414`).
+- Real Text+ objects: 113 created and persisted; second identical run created 0 and saved 0.
+- Property parity: {json.dumps(counts, sort_keys=True)}.
+- 6000 regression: zero dynamic rotation keyframes; static-orientation-only authority preserved.
+- Shadow: one frozen source-authorized identity only; 113/113 scope/readback checks PASS.
+- Unsupported effects: clipping and caption occlusion omitted; glow, texture, and gradient not fabricated.
+- Relative visibility: raw source-relative values retained; Resolve values use documented per-identity peak normalization and are not claimed as absolute alpha.
+- Rollback: failed unsaved attempts deleted only the owned validation timeline; no unrelated deletion occurred.
+- Human review required: YES. Step 5B remains NOT STARTED.
+"""
+    (root / "FINAL_REPORT.md").write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "report_dir": str(root), "result": "PASS_STEP_5A_REAL_TEXTPLUS_COMPILE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_RESOLVE_REVIEW"}))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+SOURCE = ROOT / "input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4"
+MODULE = ROOT / "scripts/standalone/video_cloner_composition_relationships.py"
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_composition_relationships as inference
+
+
+COLORS = [(55, 210, 255), (80, 220, 80), (255, 120, 80), (220, 80, 220), (70, 150, 255)]

+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def common_frame(members: list[str], accepted: dict[str, dict[int, dict]]) -> int | None:
+    frames = None
+    for identity in members:
+        values = set(accepted[identity])
+        frames = values if frames is None else frames & values
+    return min(frames) if frames else None
+
+
+def representative_specs(graph: dict, rows: dict[str, dict], accepted: dict[str, dict[int, dict]], physical_groups: list[dict], ownership_candidates: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    compositions = graph["compositions"]
+
+    def by_words(required: list[str]) -> dict | None:
+        for composition in compositions:
+            candidates = defaultdict(list)
+            for identity in composition["member_identities"]:
+                candidates[str(rows[identity]["text"]).casefold().strip(".,")].append(identity)
+            if set(required) <= set(candidates):
+                return {"member_identities": [max(candidates[word], key=lambda identity: len(accepted[identity])) for word in required]}
+        return None
+
+    buyers_members = list(physical_groups[0]["member_identities"])
+    selected = [
+        ("PHYSICAL WORD: buyers", next((item for item in compositions if set(buyers_members) <= set(item["member_identities"])), None)),
+        ("PHRASE: before / the / sign", by_words(["before", "the", "sign"])),
+        ("LINE: hits the yard", by_words(["hits", "the", "yard"])),
+        ("INDEPENDENT: for / social", by_words(["for", "social"])),
+    ]
+    same = next((row for row in graph["relationships"] if row["relationship_type"] == "SAME_BASELINE"), None)
+    above = next((row for row in graph["relationships"] if row["relationship_type"] == "ABOVE"), None)
+    if same:
+        selected.append(("CONTROL: simple same baseline", {"member_identities": [same["source_identity"], same["target_identity"]]}))
+    if above:
+        selected.append(("CONTROL: vertically offset", {"member_identities": [above["source_identity"], above["target_identity"]]}))
+    specs = []
+    for label, composition in selected:
+        if not composition:
+            continue
+        members = composition["member_identities"]
+        specs.append({"label": label, "members": members, "frame": common_frame(members, accepted), "interpretation": "source-derived composition; identities remain independent"})
+    if ownership_candidates:
+        candidate = ownership_candidates[0]
+        specs.append({
+            "label": "OVERLAP CANDIDATE: unresolved",
+            "members": [candidate["target_identity"], candidate["foreign_identity"]],
+            "frame": candidate["source_frame"],
+            "interpretation": "Step 2C exclusion evidence is not directional pair-mask proof; overlap and z-order remain unresolved",
+        })
+    ambiguous = next((identity for identity in graph["standalone_identities"] if not accepted[identity]), graph["standalone_identities"][0])
+    specs.append({"label": "AMBIGUOUS: fail closed", "members": [ambiguous], "frame": None, "interpretation": "insufficient accepted co-visible geometry; no composition fabricated"})
+    return specs[:8]
+
+
+def observation_at(identity: str, frame: int | None, accepted: dict[str, dict[int, dict]]) -> dict | None:
+    observations = accepted[identity]
+    if not observations:
+        return None
+    if frame in observations:
+        return observations[frame]
+    return min(observations.values(), key=lambda row: abs(int(row["source_frame"]) - int(frame or row["source_frame"])))
+
+
+def render_card(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, spec: dict, rows: dict[str, dict], accepted: dict[str, dict[int, dict]], graph: dict) -> np.ndarray:
+    card = np.full((330, 720, 3), 25, np.uint8)
+    frame_number = spec["frame"]
+    observations = [(identity, observation_at(identity, frame_number, accepted)) for identity in spec["members"]]
+    observations = [(identity, item) for identity, item in observations if item]
+    if frame_number is None and observations:
+        frame_number = int(observations[0][1]["source_frame"])
+    image = None
+    if frame_number is not None:
+        capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, int(frame_number))
+        ok, image = capture.read()
+        if not ok:
+            image = None
+    if image is not None and observations:
+        boxes = [item["bbox"] for _, item in observations]
+        x1 = max(0, min(box[0] for box in boxes) - 50)
+        y1 = max(0, min(box[1] for box in boxes) - 50)
+        x2 = min(image.shape[1], max(box[2] for box in boxes) + 50)
+        y2 = min(image.shape[0], max(box[3] for box in boxes) + 50)
+        crop = image[y1:y2, x1:x2].copy()
+        for index, (identity, item) in enumerate(observations):
+            color = COLORS[index % len(COLORS)]
+            bx1, by1, bx2, by2 = item["bbox"]
+            cv2.rectangle(crop, (bx1 - x1, by1 - y1), (bx2 - x1, by2 - y1), color, 2)
+            cv2.line(crop, (bx1 - x1, by2 - y1), (bx2 - x1, by2 - y1), color, 2)
+            cv2.putText(crop, f"{index + 1}:{identity.rsplit('_', 1)[-1]}", (bx1 - x1, max(15, by1 - y1 - 5)), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.45, color, 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        scale = min(430 / max(1, crop.shape[1]), 235 / max(1, crop.shape[0]))
+        resized = cv2.resize(crop, (max(1, round(crop.shape[1] * scale)), max(1, round(crop.shape[0] * scale))), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+        card[58:58 + resized.shape[0], 10:10 + resized.shape[1]] = resized
+    cv2.putText(card, spec["label"], (12, 28), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.62, (245, 245, 245), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    cv2.putText(card, f"source frame: {frame_number if frame_number is not None else 'none'}", (12, 50), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.42, (180, 180, 180), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    x = 455
+    for index, identity in enumerate(spec["members"]):
+        text = str(rows[identity]["text"])[:22]
+        cv2.putText(card, f"{index + 1} {text}", (x, 78 + index * 23), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.43, COLORS[index % len(COLORS)], 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    member_set = set(spec["members"])
+    related = [row for row in graph["relationships"] if {row["source_identity"], row["target_identity"]} <= member_set]
+    summary = []
+    for row in related:
+        if row["relationship_type"] in {"SAME_BASELINE", "BASELINE_OFFSET", "HORIZONTAL_GAP", "VERTICAL_GAP", "OVERLAPS", "Z_ORDER", "Z_ORDER_UNRESOLVED", "PHYSICAL_WORD_FRAGMENT"}:
+            value = row.get("measurement") or {}
+            pixels = value.get("source_pixels", value.get("median_overlap_area_source_px"))
+            summary.append(f"{row['relationship_type']}: {pixels if pixels is not None else row['authority']}")
+    if not summary:
+        summary = ["relationships: UNRESOLVED"]
+    for index, line in enumerate(summary[:6]):
+        cv2.putText(card, line[:34], (x, 175 + index * 20), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.36, (220, 220, 220), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    interpretation = spec["interpretation"]
+    for index in range(0, len(interpretation), 45):
+        cv2.putText(card, interpretation[index:index + 45], (12, 307 + (index // 45) * 16), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.34, (190, 190, 190), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    return card
+

+def synthetic_validation() -> dict:
+    mask = lambda h, w, left=0, right=None, top=0: np.pad(np.ones((h - top, (right or w) - left), bool), ((top, 0), (left, w - (right or w))))
+    same = inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 30], "a_mask": mask(30, 20, top=10), "b_bbox": [30, 0, 50, 30], "b_mask": mask(30, 20, top=2)}])
+    offset = inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 30], "a_mask": mask(30, 20, top=10), "b_bbox": [30, 5, 50, 35], "b_mask": mask(30, 20, top=2)}])
+    gap = inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "a_mask": mask(20, 20, left=2, right=18), "b_bbox": [25, 0, 45, 20], "b_mask": mask(20, 20, left=2, right=18)}])
+    known = inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [10, 0, 30, 20], "overlap_area_px": 12, "overlap_ratio": .1, "front_identity": "a"}])
+    unknown = inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [10, 0, 30, 20], "overlap_area_px": 12, "overlap_ratio": .1}])
+    changing = inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [25, 0, 45, 20]}, {"frame": 2, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [60, 0, 80, 20]}])
+    unrelated = inference.build_composition_graph([
+        {"identity": "a", "observations": [{"source_frame": 1, "bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "accepted": True}]},
+        {"identity": "b", "observations": [{"source_frame": 1, "bbox": [21, 0, 41, 20], "accepted": True}]},
+    ], {"a": "hint_a", "b": "hint_b"})
+    kinds = lambda values: {row["relationship_type"]: row for row in values}
+    checks = {
+        "same_baseline": "SAME_BASELINE" in kinds(same),
+        "baseline_offset": kinds(offset)["BASELINE_OFFSET"]["measurement"]["source_pixels"] == 5,
+        "horizontal_gap": kinds(gap)["HORIZONTAL_GAP"]["measurement"]["source_pixels"] == 9,
+        "overlap": "OVERLAPS" in kinds(known),
+        "no_overlap": inference.mask_overlap_area([0, 0, 20, 20], mask(20, 20, right=8), [5, 0, 25, 20], mask(20, 20, left=10),) == 0,
+        "z_order_known": "Z_ORDER" in kinds(known),
+        "z_order_unknown": "Z_ORDER_UNRESOLVED" in kinds(unknown),
+        "physical_word": "PHYSICAL_WORD_FRAGMENT" in kinds(inference.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [], physical_word=True)),
+        "nearby_unrelated": not unrelated["compositions"] and len(unrelated["standalone_identities"]) == 2,
+        "time_varying": kinds(changing)["HORIZONTAL_GAP"]["consistency"] == "ANIMATED_OR_TIME_VARYING_RELATIONSHIP",
+    }
+    return {"checks": checks, "all_pass": all(checks.values())}
+

+def main() -> None:
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    evidence, preview, step2c = load(V2), load(PREVIEW), load(STEP2C)
+    rows = {row["identity"]: row for row in evidence["identities"]}
+    accepted = {

+    graph = inference.build_composition_graph(evidence["identities"], hints, evidence["physical_word_groups"])
+    relationship_counts = Counter(row["relationship_type"] for row in graph["relationships"])
+    time_varying = sum(row["consistency"] == "ANIMATED_OR_TIME_VARYING_RELATIONSHIP" for row in graph["relationships"])
+    multi_hints = {hint for hint, count in Counter(hints.values()).items() if count > 1}
+    composed = {identity for item in graph["compositions"] for identity in item["member_identities"]}
+    unresolved_composition = sorted(identity for identity in rows if identity not in composed and hints.get(identity) in multi_hints)
+    ownership_candidates = []
+    for record in step2c["identities"]:

+                    "classification": "OWNERSHIP_INTERACTION_CANDIDATE_NOT_PAIR_MASK_OVERLAP_PROOF",

+    ownership_candidates.sort(key=lambda row: (-row["foreign_owned_pixel_count"], row["target_identity"], row["foreign_identity"], row["source_frame"]))
+    production_source = MODULE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    string_literals = [

+            {"mechanism": "continuous_visual_identity and visual_event_identity", "classification": "ACCEPTED", "use": "identity_and_lifecycle_only"},
+            {"mechanism": "accepted visual_composition_id", "classification": "ACCEPTED_HINT", "use": "candidate_membership_only; never sufficient alone"},
+            {"mechanism": "Step 2C ownership", "classification": "SOURCE_DERIVED_EXCLUSION_EVIDENCE", "use": "overlap_ambiguity_diagnostic; serialized evidence is not directional z-order proof"},
+            {"mechanism": "physical_word_groups", "classification": "ACCEPTED_SOURCE_PROVEN", "use": "joint_composition_without_identity_merge"},
+            {"mechanism": "OCR/transcript text", "classification": "UNUSED_FOR_PRODUCTION_MEMBERSHIP", "use": "diagnostic_labels_only"},
+            {"mechanism": "preview static_z_order and Text+ placement", "classification": "RENDERER_SPECIFIC_LEGACY", "use": "not_authority"},

+        "identity_count": len(rows),

+            "same_baseline_relationships": relationship_counts["SAME_BASELINE"], "spacing_relationships": relationship_counts["HORIZONTAL_GAP"] + relationship_counts["VERTICAL_GAP"],
+            "overlap_relationships": relationship_counts["OVERLAPS"], "authoritative_z_order_relationships": relationship_counts["Z_ORDER"], "unresolved_z_order_relationships": relationship_counts["Z_ORDER_UNRESOLVED"],
+            "physical_word_relationships": relationship_counts["PHYSICAL_WORD_FRAGMENT"], "time_varying_relationships": time_varying,
