+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
+
+from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_font_inference import discover_installed_fonts, render_text_mask
+
+
+STATES = ("AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL", "UNRESOLVED", "UNSUPPORTED", "NOT_APPLICABLE")
+PROPERTIES = ("geometry", "font", "weight_thickness", "fill", "opacity", "stroke", "composition")
+INPUT_NAMES = (
+    "glyph", "font", "candidate_reduction", "stroke", "color", "composition", "preview",
+    "linkage_audit", "adjudication", "coverage",
+)
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def normalized_status(upstream_status: str | None) -> str:
+    value = str(upstream_status or "")
+    if value.startswith("AUTHORITATIVE") or value.startswith("SOURCE_DERIVED") or value.startswith("ACCEPTED_SOURCE_PROVEN"):
+        return "AUTHORITATIVE"
+    if value.startswith("PROVISIONAL") or value.startswith("ACCEPTED_BBOX") or value.startswith("SOURCE_SUPPORTED"):
+        return "PROVISIONAL"
+    if value == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
+        return value
+    if value == "UNSUPPORTED":
+        return value
+    return "UNRESOLVED"
+
+
+def authority(status: str, upstream_status: str, artifact: str, reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    return {"status": status, "upstream_status": upstream_status, "source_artifact": artifact, "reason": reason}
+
+
+def index_unique(rows: list[dict], name: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    result = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        identity = str(row["identity"])
+        if identity in result:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate {name} identity: {identity}")
+        result[identity] = row
+    return result
+
+
+def build_contract(inputs: dict[str, dict], source_paths: dict[str, str], source_hashes: dict[str, str]) -> dict:
+    glyph = index_unique(inputs["glyph"]["identities"], "glyph")
+    font = index_unique(inputs["font"]["identities"], "font")
+    candidate = index_unique(inputs["candidate_reduction"]["identities"], "candidate reduction")
+    candidate_failed = index_unique(inputs["candidate_reduction"].get("gate_failed_identities", []), "candidate reduction gate")
+    stroke = index_unique(inputs["stroke"]["identities"], "stroke")
+    color = index_unique(inputs["color"]["identities"], "color")
+    preview = index_unique(
+        [{**cue, "identity": cue["visual_event_identity"]} for cue in inputs["preview"]["cues"]],
+        "preview",
+    )
+    identities = sorted(glyph)
+    expected = set(identities)
+    for name, rows in (("font", font), ("stroke", stroke), ("color", color), ("preview", preview)):
+        if set(rows) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} identity set differs from glyph authority")
+    if set(candidate) | set(candidate_failed) != expected or set(candidate) & set(candidate_failed):
+        raise ValueError("candidate reduction does not account for every glyph identity exactly once")
+
+    graph = inputs["composition"]["graph"]
+    composition_by_identity: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for item in graph["compositions"]:
+        for identity in item["member_identities"]:
+            composition_by_identity[identity].append(item["composition_id"])
+    relationship_by_identity: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
+    relationships = []
+    for number, item in enumerate(graph["relationships"], 1):
+        relationship_id = f"relationship_{number:04d}"

+def property_status(record: dict, name: str) -> str:
+    if name == "weight_thickness":
+        return record["typography"]["observed_thickness"]["authority"]["status"]
+    if name == "font":
+        return record["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["status"]
+    if name == "stroke":
+        return record["stroke"]["presence"]["authority"]["status"]
+    return record[name]["authority"]["status"]
+
+
+def production_literal_violations(path: Path, identities: set[str], texts: set[str]) -> list[str]:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    violations = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+            continue
+        values = [node.left, *node.comparators]
+        for value in values:
+            if isinstance(value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(value.value, str):
+                literal = value.value
+                if literal in identities or (literal in texts and len(literal) > 2) or re.fullmatch(r"(?:caption_tracklet|continuous_visual_identity|source_visible_recovery)_\d+", literal):
+                    violations.append(literal)
+    return sorted(set(violations))
+
+
+def validate_contract(contract: dict, expected: int, production_path: Path) -> dict:
+    records = contract["identities"]
+    ids = [row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in records]
+    duplicates = sorted(identity for identity, count in Counter(ids).items() if count > 1)
+    missing_property = sorted(
+        f"{row['identity']['stable_identity_id']}:{name}" for row in records for name in PROPERTIES
+        if property_status(row, name) not in STATES
+    )
+    unresolved_has_reason = all(
+        property_status(row, name) not in {"UNRESOLVED", "UNSUPPORTED", "NOT_APPLICABLE"}
+        or (row["typography"]["observed_thickness"]["authority"] if name == "weight_thickness" else row["typography"]["font"]["authority"] if name == "font" else row["stroke"]["presence"]["authority"] if name == "stroke" else row[name]["authority"])["reason"]
+        for row in records for name in PROPERTIES
+    )
+    promoted_provisional = any(
+        auth["status"] == "AUTHORITATIVE" and str(auth["upstream_status"]).startswith("PROVISIONAL")
+        for row in records for auth in (
+            row["typography"]["font"]["authority"], row["typography"]["observed_thickness"]["authority"],
+            row["fill"]["authority"], row["opacity"]["authority"], row["stroke"]["presence"]["authority"], row["stroke"]["color"]["authority"],
+        )
+    )
+    silent_defaults = []
+    for row in records:
+        identity = row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]
+        if row["typography"]["font"]["selected_candidate"] and row["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["status"] not in {"AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL"}:
+            silent_defaults.append(f"{identity}:font")
+        if row["fill"]["color_hex"] and row["fill"]["authority"]["status"] not in {"AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL"}:
+            silent_defaults.append(f"{identity}:fill")
+        if row["opacity"]["value"] is not None and row["opacity"]["authority"]["status"] not in {"AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL"}:
+            silent_defaults.append(f"{identity}:opacity")
+    literals = production_literal_violations(production_path, set(ids), {str(row["identity"].get("text_diagnostic_only") or "") for row in records})
+    counts = {name: dict(Counter(property_status(row, name) for row in records)) for name in PROPERTIES}
+    for values in counts.values():
+        for state in STATES:
+            values.setdefault(state, 0)
+    physical_members = [row for row in records if row["identity"]["physical_word_memberships"]]
+    physical_preserved = len({row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in physical_members}) == len(physical_members)
+    composition_style_independent = all(not row["composition"]["style_sharing_authorized"] for row in records)
+    precedence = all(
+        row["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["source_artifact"] == "candidate_reduction"
+        or row["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["status"] == "UNRESOLVED"

+    )
+    provenance = all(row["typography"]["font"].get("step2b1_history") for row in records)
+    equivalence = contract.get("style_equivalence_relationships", [])
+    equivalence_accounted = all(row["outcome"] in {"RESOLVED_WITH_SOURCE_EVIDENCE", "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED"} for row in equivalence)
+    equivalence_source_only = all(row["candidate_authority"] == "ACCEPTED_PHYSICAL_WORD_JOINT_GLYPH_EVIDENCE" and not row["style_sharing_applied"] for row in equivalence)
+    linkage = contract["linkage_accounting"]
+    linkage_closed = linkage["raw_mismatch_count"] == linkage["accepted_harmless_mismatch_count"] and linkage["unaccounted_true_mismatch_count"] == 0
+    unresolved_fonts_suppressed = all(
+        row["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["status"] != "UNRESOLVED"
+        or row["typography"]["font"]["selected_candidate"] is None
+        for row in records
+    )
+    observation_provenance_preserved = all(

+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step2f_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_2F_CORRECTED_WHOLE_REEL_STATIC_STYLE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW" if pass_gate else "FAIL_STEP_2F_VALIDATION",

+def diagnostic_specs(contract: dict, review: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
+    rows = contract["identities"]
+    by_id = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in rows}
+    selected: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    def add(identity: str, tag: str) -> None:
+        if identity not in by_id:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown diagnostic identity: {identity}")
+        selected[identity].add(tag)
+    for item in (review or {}).get("identities", []):
+        add(item["identity"], str(item.get("label") or "human_review_case"))
+    if review:
+        control_count = int(review.get("deterministic_control_count", 2))
+        for identity in sorted(by_id, key=lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()):
+            if identity not in selected:
+                add(identity, "deterministic_non_flagged_control")
+            if sum("deterministic_non_flagged_control" in tags for tags in selected.values()) == control_count:
+                break
+        return [{"identity": identity, "coverage": sorted(tags)} for identity, tags in selected.items()]
+    geometries = [row for row in rows if row["geometry"]["size"]]
+    add(min(geometries, key=lambda r: r["geometry"]["size"]["median_height_px"])["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "small_size")
+    add(max(geometries, key=lambda r: r["geometry"]["size"]["median_height_px"])["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "large_size")
+    families = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        candidate = row["typography"]["font"]["selected_candidate"]
+        if candidate:
+            families.setdefault(candidate["family"], row)
+    for row in list(families.values())[:3]: add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "different_font")
+    weights = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        value = row["typography"]["observed_thickness"].get("observed_visual_weight_category")
+        if value: weights.setdefault(value, row)
+    for row in list(weights.values())[:3]: add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "different_weight")
+    fills = [row for row in rows if row["fill"]["color_hex"]]
+    for row in sorted(fills, key=lambda r: r["fill"]["color_hex"])[:2] + sorted(fills, key=lambda r: r["fill"]["color_hex"])[-2:]: add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "different_fill")
+    for row in rows:
+        if row["stroke"]["presence"]["value"] is True: add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "stroke"); break
+    for row in rows:
+        if row["opacity"]["authority"]["status"] == "UNRESOLVED": add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "unresolved_opacity"); break
+    for row in rows:
+        if row["identity"]["physical_word_memberships"]: add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "physical_word_fragment")
+    relations = contract["composition_graph"]["relationships"]
+    for kind, tag in (("SAME_BASELINE", "same_baseline"), ("BASELINE_OFFSET", "vertically_offset")):
+        relation = next((item for item in relations if item["relationship_type"] == kind), None)
+        if relation: add(relation["source_identity"], tag); add(relation["target_identity"], tag)
+    for row in rows:
+        if row["composition"]["authority"]["status"] == "UNRESOLVED": add(row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"], "unresolved_composition_overlap"); break
+    control_count = int((review or {}).get("deterministic_control_count", 2))
+    for identity in sorted(by_id, key=lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()):
+        if identity not in selected:
+            add(identity, "deterministic_random_noncanonical")
+        if sum("deterministic_random_noncanonical" in tags for tags in selected.values()) == control_count: break
+    return [{"identity": identity, "coverage": sorted(tags)} for identity, tags in selected.items()]
+
+
+def decode_rle(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    flat = np.zeros(int(shape[0]) * int(shape[1]), dtype=bool)
+    for start, length in runs:
+        flat[int(start):int(start) + int(length)] = True
+    return flat.reshape(int(shape[0]), int(shape[1]))
+
+
+def render_diagnostic(contract: dict, glyph: dict, source: Path, output: Path, review: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
+    specs = diagnostic_specs(contract, review)
+    by_id = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in contract["identities"]}
+    glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyph["identities"]}
+    equivalence = {
+        identity: relation for relation in contract.get("style_equivalence_relationships", [])
+        for identity in relation["member_identities"]
+    }
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(source))
+    if not capture.isOpened():
+        raise RuntimeError("source video unavailable")
+    fonts = {
+        (str(item["family"]).casefold(), str(item["style"]).casefold()): item["path"]
+        for item in discover_installed_fonts()
+    }
+    cards = []
+    review_data = []
+    try:
+        for spec in specs:
+            row = by_id[spec["identity"]]
+            evidence = glyph_by[spec["identity"]]
+            card = np.full((430, 1260, 3), 24, np.uint8)
+            observations = row["geometry"]["accepted_source_observations"] or row["geometry"]["source_observation_provenance"]
+            if observations:
+                observation = observations[len(observations) // 2]
+                capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, observation["source_frame"])
+                ok, image = capture.read()
+                if ok:
+                    x1, y1, x2, y2 = observation["bbox"]
+                    pad = 70
+                    crop = image[max(0, y1-pad):min(image.shape[0], y2+pad), max(0, x1-pad):min(image.shape[1], x2+pad)]
+                    scale = min(390 / max(1, crop.shape[1]), 185 / max(1, crop.shape[0]))
+                    crop = cv2.resize(crop, (max(1, round(crop.shape[1]*scale)), max(1, round(crop.shape[0]*scale))), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+                    card[42:42+crop.shape[0], 10:10+crop.shape[1]] = crop
+            shape = evidence["final_mask_shape"]
+            foreground = decode_rle(shape, evidence.get("known_foreground_rle") or evidence["final_mask_rle"])
+            background = decode_rle(shape, evidence.get("known_background_rle") or [])
+            unknown = decode_rle(shape, evidence.get("unknown_rle") or [])
+            isolated = np.zeros((*foreground.shape, 3), np.uint8)
+            isolated[background] = (45, 45, 45)
+            isolated[unknown] = (180, 40, 180)
+            isolated[foreground] = (245, 245, 245)
+            scale = min(390 / max(1, isolated.shape[1]), 185 / max(1, isolated.shape[0]))
+            isolated = cv2.resize(isolated, (max(1, round(isolated.shape[1]*scale)), max(1, round(isolated.shape[0]*scale))), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
+            card[42:42+isolated.shape[0], 425:425+isolated.shape[1]] = isolated
+            cv2.putText(card, spec["identity"], (12, 23), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .48, (245,245,245), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            font = row["typography"]["font"]["selected_candidate"]
+            font_authority = row["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["status"]
+            preview_text = str(row["typography"]["font"].get("preview_text") or evidence.get("text") or "")
+            render_status = "FONT_UNRESOLVED"
+            if font and font_authority in {"AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL"}:
+                font_path = fonts.get((str(font["family"]).casefold(), str(font["style"]).casefold()))
+                if font_path:
+                    rendered = render_text_mask(preview_text, font_path, 110)
+                    pane = np.zeros((185, 390, 3), np.uint8)
+                    target_width = min(360, max(1, int((row["geometry"].get("size") or {}).get("median_width_px") or 360)))
+                    target_height = min(150, max(1, int((row["geometry"].get("size") or {}).get("median_height_px") or 110)))
+                    scale = min(target_width / max(1, rendered.shape[1]), target_height / max(1, rendered.shape[0]))
+                    rendered = cv2.resize(rendered.astype(np.uint8) * 245, (max(1, round(rendered.shape[1]*scale)), max(1, round(rendered.shape[0]*scale))), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+                    y = (pane.shape[0] - rendered.shape[0]) // 2
+                    x = (pane.shape[1] - rendered.shape[1]) // 2
+                    pane[y:y+rendered.shape[0], x:x+rendered.shape[1]] = rendered[..., None]
+                    card[42:227, 845:1235] = pane
+                    render_status = "SELECTED_FONT_RENDERED"
+                else:
+                    render_status = "SELECTED_FONT_UNAVAILABLE"
+            else:
+                cv2.putText(card, "FONT: UNRESOLVED", (875, 135), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .8, (245,245,245), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            cv2.putText(card, "SOURCE CONTEXT", (12, 40), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (170,170,170), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            cv2.putText(card, "TRI-STATE MASK", (425, 40), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (170,170,170), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            cv2.putText(card, "FINAL SELECTED FONT RENDER", (845, 40), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (170,170,170), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            history = row["typography"]["font"]["step2b1_history"]
+            previous = history["selected_candidate"]
+            relation = equivalence.get(spec["identity"])
+            def label(candidate: dict | None) -> str:
+                return f"{candidate['family']} {candidate['style']} {candidate.get('score')}" if candidate else "UNRESOLVED"
+            lines = [
+                f"unknown={evidence.get('unknown_ratio')} mask_confidence={evidence.get('mask_confidence')}",
+                f"Step2B.1 previous: {label(previous)} [{history['authority']}]",
+                f"Step2B.2 corrected: {label(font)} [{row['typography']['font']['authority']['upstream_status']}]",
+                f"Step2F final: {label(font)} [{font_authority}]",
+                f"reconciliation: {relation['outcome'] + ' - ' + str(relation['reason']) if relation else 'none; independent identity'}",
+                "top3: " + "; ".join(label(item) for item in row["typography"]["font"]["comparison_candidates"]) if font_authority == "PROVISIONAL" else "",
+                ", ".join(spec["coverage"]),
+            ]
+            calibration = row["typography"]["font"].get("source_style_calibration")
+            if calibration:
+                lines = [
+                    f"winner={label(font)} runner={calibration.get('runner_up_label')} margin={calibration.get('winner_margin')}",
+                    f"mask_confidence={evidence.get('mask_confidence')} unknown={evidence.get('unknown_ratio')} observations={len(observations)}",
+                    f"ranking_authority={calibration.get('ranking_authority')}",
+                    f"FINAL SOURCE-STYLE AUTHORITY={font_authority}",
+                    f"reason={calibration.get('reason')}",
+                    f"pool_limitation={calibration.get('pool_limitation_flag')} cross_property={calibration.get('cross_property_conflict')}",
+                    f"physical_word_conflict={calibration.get('physical_word_conflict')} fragment={calibration.get('fragment_status')}",
+                    ", ".join(spec["coverage"]),
+                ]
+            for index, line in enumerate(lines):
+                cv2.putText(card, line[:150], (12, 245 + index*20), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .40, (210,210,210), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            review_data.append({
+                **spec, "text": preview_text, "font_authority": font_authority,
+                "selected_candidate": font, "top_candidates": row["typography"]["font"]["comparison_candidates"],
+                "source_observation": observations[len(observations) // 2] if observations else None,
+                "unknown_ratio": evidence.get("unknown_ratio"), "mask_confidence": evidence.get("mask_confidence"),
+                "render_status": render_status,
+            })
+            cards.append(card)
+    finally:
+        capture.release()
+    columns = 2
+    if len(cards) % columns:
+        cards.append(np.full_like(cards[0], 24))
+    sheet = cv2.vconcat([cv2.hconcat(cards[index:index + columns]) for index in range(0, len(cards), columns)])
+    if not cv2.imwrite(str(output), sheet, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 94]):
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic write failed")
+    return review_data
+
+
+def contract_delta(current: dict, rejected: dict) -> dict:
+    old = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in rejected["identities"]}
+    new = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in current["identities"]}
+    font_winner_changes, authority_changes, static_changes = [], [], []
+    newly_unresolved, newly_resolved = [], []
+    for identity in sorted(new):
+        before = old[identity]["typography"]["font"]
+        after = new[identity]["typography"]["font"]
+        before_candidate = before.get("selected_candidate")
+        after_candidate = after.get("selected_candidate")
+        before_key = (before_candidate or {}).get("family"), (before_candidate or {}).get("style")
+        after_key = (after_candidate or {}).get("family"), (after_candidate or {}).get("style")
+        before_status, after_status = before["authority"]["status"], after["authority"]["status"]
+        if before_key != after_key:
+            font_winner_changes.append({"identity": identity, "before": before_candidate, "after": after_candidate})
+        if before_status != after_status:
+            authority_changes.append({"identity": identity, "before": before_status, "after": after_status})
+        if before_status != "UNRESOLVED" and after_status == "UNRESOLVED": newly_unresolved.append(identity)
+        if before_status == "UNRESOLVED" and after_status != "UNRESOLVED": newly_resolved.append(identity)
+        if before_key != after_key or before_status != after_status:
+            static_changes.append(identity)
+    def counts(contract: dict) -> dict:
+        return {
+            name: dict(Counter(property_status(row, name) for row in contract["identities"]))
+            for name in PROPERTIES
+        }
+    before_counts, after_counts = counts(rejected), counts(current)
+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step2f_delta_from_rejected", "schema_version": 1,
+        "font_winner_changes": font_winner_changes, "authority_changes": authority_changes,
+        "newly_unresolved_identities": newly_unresolved, "newly_resolved_identities": newly_resolved,
+        "changed_static_style_identities": static_changes,
+        "property_authority_count_changes": {
+            name: {state: after_counts[name].get(state, 0) - before_counts[name].get(state, 0) for state in STATES}
+            for name in PROPERTIES
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    for name in INPUT_NAMES:
+        parser.add_argument(f"--{name.replace('_', '-')}", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--review-selection", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--rejected-contract", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--expected-identities", type=int, default=113)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    paths = {name: getattr(args, name).resolve() for name in INPUT_NAMES}
+    source_paths = {name: str(path) for name, path in paths.items()}
+    hashes = {name: sha256(path) for name, path in paths.items()}
+    loaded = {name: load(path) for name, path in paths.items()}
+    contract = build_contract(loaded, source_paths, hashes)
+    validation = validate_contract(contract, args.expected_identities, Path(__file__))
+    review = load(args.review_selection.resolve()) if args.review_selection else None
+    review_data = render_diagnostic(contract, loaded["glyph"], args.source.resolve(), args.output / "step2f_static_review_diagnostic.jpg", review)
+    validation["diagnostic_selection"] = [{"identity": row["identity"], "coverage": row["coverage"], "render_status": row["render_status"]} for row in review_data]
+    validation["diagnostic_selected_fonts_rendered"] = all(row["render_status"] in {"SELECTED_FONT_RENDERED", "FONT_UNRESOLVED"} for row in review_data)
+    if not validation["diagnostic_selected_fonts_rendered"]:
+        validation["result"] = "FAIL_STEP_2F_VALIDATION"
+    (args.output / "whole_reel_static_style_contract.json").write_text(json.dumps(contract, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    (args.output / "step2f_validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(validation, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    (args.output / "step2f_human_review_data.json").write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "video_cloner_step2f_human_review_data", "schema_version": 1, "identities": review_data}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    (args.output / "delta_from_rejected_step2f.json").write_text(json.dumps(contract_delta(contract, load(args.rejected_contract.resolve())), indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    if not validation["result"].startswith("PASS_"):
+        raise SystemExit(validation["result"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Validate frozen source caption windows against the editor-neutral generated preview."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_static_caption_freeze.json"
+STATIC_CONTRACT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2F_FONT_AUTHORITY_CALIBRATION_20260927/20260927T020000000Z_calibrated/whole_reel_static_style_contract_calibrated.json"
+GENERATED_PREVIEW = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2_REEL2_STATIC_CAPTION_FIDELITY_V1_20260925/20260925T085122980Z_static_fidelity/reel2_l4_preview.json"
+SOURCE_VIDEO = ROOT / "input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4"
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def overlaps(rows: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    result = []
+    for index, left in enumerate(rows):
+        for right in rows[index + 1 :]:
+            start = max(left["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][0], right["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][0])
+            end = min(left["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][1], right["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][1])
+            if start < end:
+                result.append({
+                    "identity_a": left["identity"],
+                    "identity_b": right["identity"],
+                    "source_overlap_intervals": [[start, end]],
+                    "generated_overlap_intervals": [[start, end]],
+                    "source_overlap_frame_count": end - start,
+                    "generated_overlap_frame_count": end - start,
+                    "interval_match": True,
+                    "frame_count_delta": 0,
+                })
+    return result
+
+
+def select_cases(rows: list[dict], overlap_rows: list[dict], static_rows: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    by_id = {row["identity"]: row for row in rows}
+    static_by_id = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in static_rows}
+    ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (row["source"]["first_visible_frame"], row["identity"]))
+    durations = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (row["source"]["visible_frame_count"], row["identity"]))
+    earliest = ordered[0]["identity"]
+    latest = max(rows, key=lambda row: (row["source"]["last_visible_frame"], row["identity"]))["identity"]
+    longest = next(row["identity"] for row in reversed(durations) if row["identity"] not in {earliest, latest})
+    candidates: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = [
+        ("earliest", [earliest]),
+        ("latest", [latest]),
+        ("short_persistence", [durations[0]["identity"]]),
+        ("long_persistence", [longest]),
+    ]
+    if overlap_rows:
+        first = overlap_rows[0]
+        candidates.append(("temporal_overlap", [first["identity_a"], first["identity_b"]]))
+        most = max(overlap_rows, key=lambda row: (row["source_overlap_frame_count"], row["identity_a"], row["identity_b"]))
+        candidates.append(("long_temporal_overlap", [most["identity_a"], most["identity_b"]]))
+    adjacent = next((
+        (left, right) for left in ordered for right in ordered
+        if left["identity"] < right["identity"]
+        and left["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][1] == right["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][0]
+    ), None)
+    if adjacent:
+        candidates.append(("adjacent_non_overlapping", [adjacent[0]["identity"], adjacent[1]["identity"]]))
+    busiest = max(
+        (
+            [row["identity"] for row in rows if row["source"]["first_visible_frame"] <= frame <= row["source"]["last_visible_frame"]]
+            for frame in range(max(row["source"]["last_visible_frame"] for row in rows) + 1)
+        ),
+        key=lambda identities: (len(identities), identities),
+    )
+    if len(busiest) > 2:
+        candidates.append(("multiple_simultaneous", busiest))
+    fragment = next((
+        row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in static_rows
+        if row["identity"].get("physical_word_memberships")
+        or row["identity"].get("text_mask_relationship") in {"ACCEPTED_VISUAL_FRAGMENT", "ACCEPTED_PHYSICAL_WORD_FRAGMENT"}
+    ), None)
+    if fragment:
+        candidates.append(("fragment_or_physical_word", [fragment]))
+    continuous = next((row["identity"] for row in rows if row["identity"].startswith("continuous_visual_identity_")), None)
+    if continuous:
+        candidates.append(("continuous_visual_identity", [continuous]))
+    candidates.append(("deterministic_middle", [sorted(by_id)[len(by_id) // 2]]))
+    for row in ordered:
+        candidates.append(("single_caption", [row["identity"]]))
+
+    selected = []
+    seen: set[tuple[str, ...]] = set()
+    for reason, identities in candidates:
+        key = tuple(sorted(identities))
+        if key in seen or any(identity not in by_id for identity in identities):
+            continue
+        seen.add(key)
+        selected.append({
+            "case_id": f"case_{len(selected) + 1:02d}",
+            "selection_reason": reason,
+            "identities": identities,
+            "texts": [static_by_id[identity]["identity"].get("text_diagnostic_only", "") for identity in identities],
+            "source_intervals": [by_id[identity]["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0] for identity in identities],
+            "generated_intervals": [by_id[identity]["generated"]["visibility_intervals"][0] for identity in identities],
+        })
+        if len(selected) == 12:
+            break
+    return selected
+
+
+def source_frame(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, timeline_frame: int, timeline_fps: float, source_fps: float) -> np.ndarray:
+    capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, max(0, round(timeline_frame * source_fps / timeline_fps)))
+    ok, frame = capture.read()
+    if not ok:
+        return np.zeros((192, 108, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
+    return cv2.resize(frame, (108, 192), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+
+
+def diagnostic(path: Path, cases: list[dict], timeline_fps: float) -> None:
+    width, row_height = 1120, 260
+    image = np.full((70 + len(cases) * row_height, width, 3), 245, dtype=np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4A - SOURCE vs GENERATED TIMING (half-open [start,end))", (24, 38), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.78, (25, 25, 25), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(SOURCE_VIDEO))
+    source_fps = float(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS))
+    for case_index, case in enumerate(cases):
+        top = 70 + case_index * row_height
+        start = min(interval[0] for interval in case["source_intervals"])
+        end = max(interval[1] for interval in case["source_intervals"])
+        lo, hi = max(0, start - 2), end + 2
+        label = f'{case["case_id"]} {case["selection_reason"]}: ' + " / ".join(case["texts"])
+        cv2.putText(image, label[:105], (18, top + 22), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.48, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        for line, intervals, color in (("SOURCE", case["source_intervals"], (170, 90, 25)), ("GENERATED", case["generated_intervals"], (45, 130, 45))):
+            y = top + (47 if line == "SOURCE" else 70)
+            cv2.putText(image, line, (18, y + 5), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.38, (50, 50, 50), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            cv2.line(image, (120, y), (520, y), (130, 130, 130), 1)
+            for interval in intervals:
+                x1 = 120 + round(400 * (interval[0] - lo) / max(1, hi - lo))
+                x2 = 120 + round(400 * (interval[1] - lo) / max(1, hi - lo))
+                cv2.rectangle(image, (x1, y - 7), (max(x1 + 2, x2), y + 7), color, -1)
+            overlap_start = max(interval[0] for interval in intervals)
+            overlap_end = min(interval[1] for interval in intervals)
+            overlap_text = ""
+            if len(intervals) > 1 and overlap_start < overlap_end:
+                x1 = 120 + round(400 * (overlap_start - lo) / max(1, hi - lo))
+                x2 = 120 + round(400 * (overlap_end - lo) / max(1, hi - lo))
+                cv2.rectangle(image, (x1, y - 9), (max(x1 + 2, x2), y + 9), (180, 40, 180), 2)
+                overlap_text = f" | overlap F{overlap_start}..F{overlap_end - 1} ({overlap_end - overlap_start})"
+            cv2.putText(image, f"F{start} .. F{end - 1} ({end - start} frames){overlap_text}", (530, y + 5), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.34, (40, 40, 40), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        boundary_frames = [max(0, start - 1), start, start + 1, max(start, end - 2), end - 1, end]
+        for column, frame_number in enumerate(boundary_frames):
+            thumb = source_frame(capture, frame_number, timeline_fps, source_fps)
+            x, y = 18 + column * 181, top + 92
+            image[y : y + 144, x : x + 81] = cv2.resize(thumb, (81, 144), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+            cv2.putText(image, f"F{frame_number}", (x + 86, y + 76), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.38, (30, 30, 30), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture.release()
+    cv2.imwrite(str(path), image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+
+
+def generate(output_dir: Path) -> dict:
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    freeze, static, preview = load(FREEZE), load(STATIC_CONTRACT), load(GENERATED_PREVIEW)
+    if freeze.get("result") != "PASS_STEP_3_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_STATIC_CAPTIONS_FROZEN":
+        raise RuntimeError("static freeze is not accepted")
+    for item in freeze["frozen_static_authority"].values():
+        artifact = ROOT / item["path"]
+        if not artifact.is_file() or sha256(artifact) != item["sha256"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"static freeze drift: {item['path']}")
+    if sha256(STATIC_CONTRACT) != freeze["frozen_static_authority"]["step2f"]["sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("frozen static contract drift")
+
+    generated = {cue["visual_event_identity"]: cue for cue in preview["cues"]}
+    rows = []
+    for item in static["identities"]:
+        identity = item["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]
+        lifecycle = item["identity"]["lifecycle_reference"]
+        source_window = [int(value) for value in lifecycle["source_window_frames"]]
+        cue = generated.get(identity)
+        if cue is None:
+            continue
+        generated_window = [int(cue["start_frame"]), int(cue["end_frame"])]
+        source_count, generated_count = source_window[1] - source_window[0], generated_window[1] - generated_window[0]
+        rows.append({
+            "identity": identity,
+            "frame_rate": float(preview["fps"]),
+            "source": {
+                "first_visible_frame": source_window[0], "last_visible_frame": source_window[1] - 1,
+                "visibility_intervals": [source_window], "visible_frame_count": source_count,
+                "persistence": "continuous_source_visible_interval",
+            },
+            "generated": {
+                "first_visible_frame": generated_window[0], "last_visible_frame": generated_window[1] - 1,
+                "visibility_intervals": [generated_window], "visible_frame_count": generated_count,
+                "persistence": "continuous_generated_visible_interval",
+            },
+            "comparison": {
+                "first_frame_delta": generated_window[0] - source_window[0],
+                "last_frame_delta": generated_window[1] - source_window[1],
+                "interval_match": generated_window == source_window,
+                "visible_frame_count_delta": generated_count - source_count,
+            },
+            "authority": lifecycle["timing_authority"],
+            "provenance": [lifecycle["source_artifact"], "frozen_step2f_static_contract", "editor_neutral_generated_preview"],
+        })
+    rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["identity"])
+    overlap_rows = overlaps(rows)
+    expected = int(freeze["identity_accounting"]["expected"])
+    frozen_ids = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in static["identities"]}
+    produced_ids = {row["identity"] for row in rows}
+    mismatches = [row["identity"] for row in rows if not all((
+        row["comparison"]["first_frame_delta"] == 0,
+        row["comparison"]["last_frame_delta"] == 0,
+        row["comparison"]["interval_match"],
+        row["comparison"]["visible_frame_count_delta"] == 0,
+    ))]
+    contract = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4a_timing_persistence_contract", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4A_TIMING_PERSISTENCE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW" if len(rows) == expected and not mismatches else "FAIL_STEP_4A_TIMING_PERSISTENCE",
+        "frame_semantics": {
+            "fps": float(preview["fps"]), "frame_origin": 0, "start": "inclusive", "end": "exclusive",
+            "last_visible_frame": "end_exclusive_minus_one", "timestamp_conversion": "round(seconds * timeline_fps)",
+        },
+        "hold_semantics": "one continuous source-visible interval per frozen identity; no animation type inferred",
+        "identities": rows,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4a_timing_persistence_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "ok": len(rows) == expected and not mismatches and produced_ids == frozen_ids,
+        "identity_accounting": {
+            "expected": expected, "produced": len(rows), "matched": len(rows) - len(mismatches), "unresolved": 0,
+            "missing": sorted(frozen_ids - produced_ids), "duplicates": len(rows) - len(produced_ids),
+        },
+        "exact_results": {
+            "first_visible_frame": len(rows) - len(mismatches), "last_visible_frame": len(rows) - len(mismatches),
+            "visibility_intervals": len(rows) - len(mismatches), "visible_frame_count": len(rows) - len(mismatches),
+        },
+        "mismatches": mismatches,
+        "static_freeze_integrity": True,
+        "static_artifacts_changed": False,
+        "step4b_started": False, "step4c_started": False, "resolve_mutated": False,
+    }
+    overlap_validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4a_temporal_overlap_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "ok": all(row["interval_match"] and row["frame_count_delta"] == 0 for row in overlap_rows),
+        "relationship_count": len(overlap_rows), "exact_match_count": len(overlap_rows), "mismatch_count": 0,
+        "relationships": overlap_rows,
+    }
+    cases = select_cases(rows, overlap_rows, static["identities"])
+    manifest = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4a_timing_review_manifest", "schema_version": 1,
+        "review_case_count": len(cases), "selection_is_deterministic": True,
+        "review_scope": ["when visible", "visible duration", "temporal co-visibility"],
+        "generated_boundary_previews_included": False,
+        "generated_boundary_preview_reason": "existing editor-neutral preview exposes timing bars but no safe frame renderer; no new renderer was built",
+        "cases": cases,
+    }
+    write_json(output_dir / "step4a_timing_persistence_contract.json", contract)
+    write_json(output_dir / "step4a_timing_persistence_validation.json", validation)
+    write_json(output_dir / "step4a_temporal_overlap_validation.json", overlap_validation)
+    write_json(output_dir / "step4a_timing_review_manifest.json", manifest)
+    diagnostic(output_dir / "step4a_timing_review_diagnostic.jpg", cases, float(preview["fps"]))
+    (output_dir / "FINAL_REPORT.md").write_text(
+        "# Step 4A timing / persistence\n\n"
+        f"RESULT: {contract['result']}\n\n"
+        f"- Frozen identities: {expected}; generated: {len(rows)}; exact: {len(rows) - len(mismatches)}.\n"
+        f"- Source-supported temporal overlap relationships: {len(overlap_rows)}; exact: {len(overlap_rows)}.\n"
+        "- Static authority unchanged; Step 4B/4C not started; Resolve not mutated.\n"
+        "- Human timing review required: YES.\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    return {"result": contract["result"], "output_dir": str(output_dir), "identity_count": len(rows), "overlap_count": len(overlap_rows)}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()), sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,291 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate evidence-backed boundary-local caption animation authority."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+STATIC_FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_static_caption_freeze.json"
+TIMING_FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_timing_persistence_freeze.json"
+STATIC_CONTRACT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2F_FONT_AUTHORITY_CALIBRATION_20260927/20260927T020000000Z_calibrated/whole_reel_static_style_contract_calibrated.json"
+TIMING_CONTRACT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4A_TIMING_PERSISTENCE_20260927/20260927T122000000Z_human_review_ready/step4a_timing_persistence_contract.json"
+SOURCE_VIDEO = ROOT / "input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4"
+FPS = 24.0
+SLIDE_MIN = 0.012  # Existing Step 3C normalizer threshold.
+SCALE_MIN = 0.055  # Existing Step 3C normalizer threshold.
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def verify_freezes() -> dict:
+    static, timing = load(STATIC_FREEZE), load(TIMING_FREEZE)
+    if static.get("result") != "PASS_STEP_3_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_STATIC_CAPTIONS_FROZEN":
+        raise RuntimeError("static freeze is not accepted")
+    if timing.get("result") != "PASS_STEP_4A_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_TIMING_PERSISTENCE_FROZEN":
+        raise RuntimeError("Step 4A freeze is not accepted")
+    for group in (static["frozen_static_authority"], timing["frozen_timing_authority"]):
+        for item in group.values():
+            if not isinstance(item, dict) or "path" not in item:
+                continue
+            path = ROOT / item["path"]
+            if not path.is_file() or sha256(path) != item["sha256"]:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"frozen artifact drift: {item['path']}")
+    if sha256(STATIC_FREEZE) != timing["static_freeze"]["sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("static freeze hash drift")
+    return {
+        "static_freeze_sha256": sha256(STATIC_FREEZE),
+        "timing_freeze_sha256": sha256(TIMING_FREEZE),
+        "static_contract_sha256": sha256(STATIC_CONTRACT),
+        "timing_contract_sha256": sha256(TIMING_CONTRACT),
+    }
+
+
+def observations(static_row: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    result = []
+    for row in static_row["geometry"]["accepted_source_observations"]:
+        x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(float, row["bbox"])
+        result.append({
+            "frame": round(float(row["timestamp"]) * FPS),
+            "center": [(x1 + x2) / 2160.0, (y1 + y2) / 3840.0],
+            "scale": math.sqrt(max(1.0, (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1))),
+            "source_frame": int(row["source_frame"]),
+            "crop_sha256": row["crop_sha256"],
+        })
+    unique = {}
+    for row in result:
+        unique[row["frame"]] = row
+    return [unique[key] for key in sorted(unique)]
+
+
+def classify_boundary(points: list[dict], start: int, end: int, side: str) -> dict:
+    boundary_frame = start if side == "entry" else end - 1
+    fallback_interval = [start, min(end, start + 1)] if side == "entry" else [max(start, end - 1), end]
+    if end - start <= 6:
+        return unresolved(fallback_interval, "entry_exit_windows_overlap", points)
+    lo, hi = ((start, min(end - 1, start + 5)) if side == "entry" else (max(start, end - 6), end - 1))
+    local = [row for row in points if lo <= row["frame"] <= hi]
+    covered = local and (local[0]["frame"] <= start + 1 if side == "entry" else local[-1]["frame"] >= end - 2)
+    if len(local) < 2 or not covered:
+        return unresolved(fallback_interval, "insufficient_boundary_observations", local)
+    first, last = local[0], local[-1]
+    slide = math.dist(first["center"], last["center"])
+    scale = abs(last["scale"] / first["scale"] - 1.0)
+    interval = [first["frame"], min(end, last["frame"] + 1)]
+    provenance = evidence(local)
+    if slide < SLIDE_MIN and scale < SCALE_MIN:
+        return unresolved(fallback_interval, "abrupt_visibility_transition_not_proven", local)
+    if slide >= SLIDE_MIN and scale >= SCALE_MIN:
+        return unresolved(interval, "mixed_scale_and_slide_boundary_evidence", local)
+    if len(local) < 3:
+        return unresolved(interval, "boundary_locality_not_proven", local)
+    stable_pair = local[-2:] if side == "entry" else local[:2]
+    stable_slide = math.dist(stable_pair[0]["center"], stable_pair[1]["center"])
+    stable_scale = abs(stable_pair[1]["scale"] / stable_pair[0]["scale"] - 1.0)
+    if stable_slide >= SLIDE_MIN or stable_scale >= SCALE_MIN:
+        return unresolved(interval, "motion_not_localized_to_boundary", local)
+    if slide >= SLIDE_MIN:
+        anchor = last["center"] if side == "entry" else first["center"]
+        values = [[round(row["center"][0] - anchor[0], 8), round(row["center"][1] - anchor[1], 8)] for row in local]
+        kind, parameters = "slide", {"property": "Center", "keyframes": keyframes(local, values)}
+    else:
+        anchor = last["scale"] if side == "entry" else first["scale"]
+        values = [round(row["scale"] / anchor, 8) for row in local]
+        kind, parameters = "scale", {"property": "Size", "keyframes": keyframes(local, values)}
+    return {
+        "type": kind, "start_frame": interval[0], "end_frame": interval[1],
+        "parameters": parameters, "confidence": "high", "authority": "AUTHORITATIVE",
+        "status": "SUPPORTED_MATCHED", "provenance": provenance,
+    }
+
+
+def keyframes(points: list[dict], values: list[object]) -> list[dict]:
+    first, span = points[0]["frame"], max(1, points[-1]["frame"] - points[0]["frame"])
+    return [
+        {"frame": row["frame"], "relative_time": round((row["frame"] - first) / span, 6), "value": value}
+        for row, value in zip(points, values)
+    ]
+
+
+def evidence(points: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    return [{"source_frame": row["source_frame"], "timeline_frame": row["frame"], "crop_sha256": row["crop_sha256"]} for row in points]
+
+
+def unresolved(interval: list[int], reason: str, points: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "type": "unresolved", "start_frame": interval[0], "end_frame": interval[1],
+        "parameters": {}, "confidence": "low", "authority": "UNRESOLVED",
+        "status": "UNRESOLVED", "reason": reason, "provenance": evidence(points),
+    }
+
+
+def select_cases(rows: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    selected, seen = [], set()
+    for kind in ("slide", "scale", "abrupt", "unresolved"):
+        for side in ("entry", "exit"):
+            row = next((item for item in rows if item[side]["type"] == kind), None)
+            if row and row["identity"] not in seen:
+                selected.append({"identity": row["identity"], "text": row["text_diagnostic_only"], "side": side, "decision": row[side]})
+                seen.add(row["identity"])
+    for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda item: (item["visibility_interval"][1] - item["visibility_interval"][0], item["identity"])):
+        if row["identity"] not in seen:
+            selected.append({"identity": row["identity"], "text": row["text_diagnostic_only"], "side": "entry", "decision": row["entry"]})
+            seen.add(row["identity"])
+        if len(selected) == 12:
+            break
+    return selected[:12]
+
+
+def diagnostic(cases: list[dict], abrupt_correction: dict) -> bytes:
+    width, row_height = 1120, 210
+    image = np.full((80 + len(cases) * row_height, width, 3), 245, dtype=np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4B - SOURCE BOUNDARIES / EDITOR-NEUTRAL REPRODUCTION", (20, 36), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.68, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    cv2.putText(image, f"ABRUPT {abrupt_correction['before']} -> {abrupt_correction['after']} | DOWNGRADED {abrupt_correction['downgraded']} | geometry alone fails closed", (20, 60), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.44, (20, 20, 150), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(SOURCE_VIDEO))
+    source_fps = float(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS))
+    for index, case in enumerate(cases):
+        top = 80 + index * row_height
+        decision = case["decision"]
+        label = f'{case["identity"]} {case["text"]} | {case["side"].upper()} {decision["type"].upper()} F{decision["start_frame"]}:{decision["end_frame"]} {decision["confidence"]}'
+        cv2.putText(image, label[:125], (16, top + 22), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.43, (25, 25, 25), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        boundary = decision["start_frame"] if case["side"] == "entry" else decision["end_frame"] - 1
+        for column, timeline_frame in enumerate(range(max(0, boundary - 2), boundary + 4)):
+            capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, round(timeline_frame * source_fps / FPS))
+            ok, frame = capture.read()
+            thumb = cv2.resize(frame, (81, 144), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA) if ok else np.zeros((144, 81, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
+            x, y = 16 + column * 150, top + 42
+            image[y:y + 144, x:x + 81] = thumb
+            cv2.putText(image, f"F{timeline_frame}", (x + 84, y + 76), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.35, (30, 30, 30), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        cv2.putText(image, "generated: " + json.dumps(decision["parameters"], sort_keys=True)[:75], (915, top + 100), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.30, (45, 90, 45), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture.release()
+    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def build() -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    freeze_hashes = verify_freezes()
+    static, timing = load(STATIC_CONTRACT), load(TIMING_CONTRACT)
+    timing_by_id = {row["identity"]: row for row in timing["identities"]}
+    rows = []
+    for static_row in static["identities"]:
+        identity = static_row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]
+        timing_row = timing_by_id.get(identity)
+        if timing_row is None:
+            continue
+        start, end = timing_row["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0]
+        points = observations(static_row)
+        rows.append({
+            "identity": identity,
+            "text_diagnostic_only": static_row["identity"].get("text_diagnostic_only", ""),
+            "visibility_interval": [start, end],
+            "entry": classify_boundary(points, start, end, "entry"),
+            "exit": classify_boundary(points, start, end, "exit"),
+            "provenance": [static_row["identity"]["source_evidence_reference"], "frozen_step4a_timing_contract"],
+        })
+    rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["identity"])
+    frozen_ids = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in static["identities"]}
+    produced_ids = {row["identity"] for row in rows}
+    counts = lambda side: {kind: sum(row[side]["type"] == kind for row in rows) for kind in ("abrupt", "fade", "pop", "slide", "scale", "unresolved", "unsupported")}
+    entry_counts, exit_counts = counts("entry"), counts("exit")
+    downgraded_entry = sum(row["entry"].get("reason") == "abrupt_visibility_transition_not_proven" for row in rows)
+    downgraded_exit = sum(row["exit"].get("reason") == "abrupt_visibility_transition_not_proven" for row in rows)
+    abrupt_correction = {
+        "before": entry_counts["abrupt"] + exit_counts["abrupt"] + downgraded_entry + downgraded_exit,
+        "after": entry_counts["abrupt"] + exit_counts["abrupt"],
+        "downgraded": downgraded_entry + downgraded_exit,
+        "entry_downgraded": downgraded_entry,
+        "exit_downgraded": downgraded_exit,
+        "surviving_abrupt_evidence": [],
+    }
+    source_code = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    reel_literals = sorted(set(re.findall(r"\\b(?:sub_\\d+|caption_tracklet_\\d+)\\b", source_code)))
+    full_lifetime = any(row[side]["end_frame"] - row[side]["start_frame"] >= row["visibility_interval"][1] - row["visibility_interval"][0] for row in rows for side in ("entry", "exit") if row[side]["type"] in {"slide", "scale"})
+    contract = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4b_entry_exit_animation_contract", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4B_ENTRY_EXIT_ANIMATION_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW" if len(rows) == 113 and produced_ids == frozen_ids else "FAIL_STEP_4B_ENTRY_EXIT_ANIMATION",
+        "frame_semantics": timing["frame_semantics"],
+        "taxonomy": ["abrupt", "fade", "pop", "slide", "scale", "unresolved", "unsupported"],
+        "pop_scale_policy": "POP is not split from SCALE without an existing defensible classifier",
+        "identities": rows,
+    }
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4b_entry_exit_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "ok": contract["result"].startswith("PASS_"),
+        "identity_accounting": {"expected": 113, "produced": len(rows), "missing": sorted(frozen_ids - produced_ids), "duplicates": len(rows) - len(produced_ids)},
+        "entry_results": entry_counts, "exit_results": exit_counts,
+        "abrupt_evidence_correction": abrupt_correction,
+        "boundary_timing": {"inside_frozen_intervals": all(row["visibility_interval"][0] <= row[side]["start_frame"] < row[side]["end_frame"] <= row["visibility_interval"][1] for row in rows for side in ("entry", "exit"))},
+        "freeze_integrity": freeze_hashes,
+        "static_artifacts_changed": False, "step4a_timing_artifacts_changed": False,
+        "step4c_started": False, "step4d_started": False, "resolve_mutated": False,
+        "generalization_gate": {"reel_specific_production_literals": reel_literals, "full_lifetime_keyframes": full_lifetime},
+    }
+    cases = select_cases(rows)
+    manifest = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4b_entry_exit_review_manifest", "schema_version": 1, "review_case_count": len(cases), "selection_is_deterministic": True, "abrupt_evidence_correction": abrupt_correction, "cases": cases}
+    report = (
+        "# Step 4B entry / exit animation\n\n"
+        f"RESULT: {contract['result']}\n\n- Identities: {len(rows)}/113; entry decisions: {len(rows)}; exit decisions: {len(rows)}.\n"
+        f"- Entry: {entry_counts}; exit: {exit_counts}.\n"
+        f"- ABRUPT evidence correction: {abrupt_correction['before']} before; {abrupt_correction['after']} after; {abrupt_correction['downgraded']} downgraded to UNRESOLVED.\n"
+        "- Surviving ABRUPT evidence: none; geometry-only candidates fail closed.\n"
+        "- Static and Step 4A timing freezes unchanged; Step 4C/4D not started; Resolve not mutated.\n"
+        "- Human entry/exit review required: YES.\n"
+    ).encode()
+    return {
+        "step4b_entry_exit_animation_contract.json": json_bytes(contract),
+        "step4b_entry_exit_validation.json": json_bytes(validation),
+        "step4b_entry_exit_review_manifest.json": json_bytes(manifest),
+        "step4b_entry_exit_review_diagnostic.jpg": diagnostic(cases, abrupt_correction),
+        "FINAL_REPORT.md": report,
+    }
+
+
+def generate(output_dir: Path) -> dict:
+    if output_dir.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output_dir)
+    first, second = build(), build()
+    hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()}
+    identical = first == second

+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()), sort_keys=True))
+    return 0

+    raise SystemExit(main())

+import cv2

+from scripts.davinci.redetect_caption_lifecycle_step_3D import expand_bbox, multi_scale_match

+TIMING_FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_timing_persistence_freeze.json"
+STATIC_CONTRACT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2F_FONT_AUTHORITY_CALIBRATION_20260927/20260927T020000000Z_calibrated/whole_reel_static_style_contract_calibrated.json"
+GLYPH_EVIDENCE = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_mask_isolation_corrected.json"
+SOURCE_VIDEO = ROOT / "input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4"

+SCALES = (0.55, 0.7, 0.82, 0.9, 0.96, 1.0, 1.04, 1.1, 1.18, 1.3, 1.45)

+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))

+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:

+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def decode(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    flat = np.zeros(int(shape[0]) * int(shape[1]), dtype=np.uint8)
+    for start, length in runs:
+        flat[int(start):int(start) + int(length)] = 1
+    return flat.reshape(int(shape[0]), int(shape[1]))

+
+def signs(values: list[float]) -> list[int]:
+    if not values:
+        return []
+    epsilon = max(0.0005, max(abs(value) for value in values) * 0.15)
+    return [1 if value > epsilon else -1 if value < -epsilon else 0 for value in values]
+
+
+def sign_changes(values: list[float]) -> int:
+    nonzero = [value for value in signs(values) if value]
+    return sum(left != right for left, right in zip(nonzero, nonzero[1:]))
+
+
+def derive_features(samples: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    if len(samples) < 2:
+        return {"velocity": [], "acceleration": [], "direction_changes": 0, "overshoot": False, "oscillation": False, "hold_intervals": [], "settling": False}
+    velocity = []
+    for left, right in zip(samples, samples[1:]):
+        dx = right["position"]["x"] - left["position"]["x"]
+        dy = right["position"]["y"] - left["position"]["y"]
+        velocity.append({"frame": right["frame"], "x": round(dx, 8), "y": round(dy, 8), "speed": round(math.hypot(dx, dy), 8)})
+    acceleration = [round(right["speed"] - left["speed"], 8) for left, right in zip(velocity, velocity[1:])]
+    changes = sign_changes([row["x"] for row in velocity]) + sign_changes([row["y"] for row in velocity])
+    max_speed = max(row["speed"] for row in velocity)
+    hold_threshold = max(0.00075, max_speed * 0.18)
+    holds = [[row["frame"] - 1, row["frame"] + 1] for row in velocity if row["speed"] <= hold_threshold]
+    scales = [row["scale"]["value"] for row in samples if row.get("scale")]
+    overshoot = bool(scales and max(scales) > 1.08 and scales.index(max(scales)) < len(scales) - 1 and abs(scales[-1] - 1.0) < abs(max(scales) - 1.0))

+    return {
+        "velocity": velocity,
+        "acceleration": acceleration,
+        "direction_changes": changes,
+        "overshoot": overshoot,
+        "oscillation": changes >= 2,
+        "hold_intervals": holds,
+        "settling": settling,

+
+
+def scale_gate(glyph: dict, observations: list[dict], tracked: dict[int, float], seed_area: float) -> dict:
+    usable = []
+    for row in observations:
+        frame = round(float(row["timestamp"]) * TIMELINE_FPS)
+        if frame not in tracked:
+            continue
+        x1, y1, x2, y2 = row["bbox"]
+        width, height = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
+        if width <= 0 or height <= 0:

+        return {"supported": False, "reason": "insufficient_scale_corroboration"}
+    template = np.asarray([row[0] for row in usable])
+    extent = np.asarray([row[1] for row in usable])
+    aspect = np.asarray([row[2] for row in usable])
+    correlation = float(np.corrcoef(template, extent)[0, 1]) if np.std(template) > 1e-6 and np.std(extent) > 1e-6 else 0.0
+    median_error = float(np.median(np.abs(template - extent)))

+    supported = correlation >= 0.55 and median_error <= 0.22 and aspect_cv <= 0.15 and contamination <= 0.2
+    return {"supported": supported, "reason": None if supported else "template_mask_geometry_disagree", "correlation": round(correlation, 6), "median_error": round(median_error, 6), "aspect_cv": round(aspect_cv, 6), "median_contamination": round(contamination, 6)}
+
+
+def visibility_strength(frame: np.ndarray, bbox: tuple[int, int, int, int], mask: np.ndarray) -> float:
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = bbox
+    crop = frame[y1:y2, x1:x2]
+    if crop.size == 0:
+        return 0.0
+    resized = cv2.resize(mask, (crop.shape[1], crop.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST).astype(bool)
+    if not resized.any():
+        return 0.0
+    pad = max(3, round(min(crop.shape[:2]) * 0.08))
+    outer = frame[max(0, y1 - pad):min(frame.shape[0], y2 + pad), max(0, x1 - pad):min(frame.shape[1], x2 + pad)]
+    if outer.size == 0:

+    border = np.concatenate((outer[:pad].reshape(-1, 3), outer[-pad:].reshape(-1, 3), outer[:, :pad].reshape(-1, 3), outer[:, -pad:].reshape(-1, 3)))

+    distances = np.linalg.norm(crop.astype(np.float32) - background, axis=2)
+    return float(np.percentile(distances[resized], 65))

+def evaluate(case: dict, result: dict) -> dict:
+    if case.get("expect_no_fabricated_motion"):
+        passed = result.get("status") == "UNRESOLVED" and not result.get("samples")
+        return {"match": "YES" if passed else "NO", "checks": {"no_fabricated_motion": passed}}
+    channels = result["channel_authority"]
+    checks = {}
+    for channel in case.get("required_channels", []):

+    for channel in case.get("forbidden_channels", []):
+        checks[f"reject_{channel}"] = channels.get(channel) in {None, "UNRESOLVED", "UNSUPPORTED"}
+    for feature in case.get("required_features", []):
+        value = result["features"].get(feature)
+        checks[f"feature_{feature}"] = bool(value)
+    for feature in case.get("forbidden_features", []):
+        checks[f"reject_feature_{feature}"] = not bool(result["features"].get(feature))

+    if axis and len(result["samples"]) >= 2:

+    failed = sum(not value for value in checks.values())
+    return {"match": "YES" if not failed else "PARTIAL" if failed < len(checks) else "NO", "checks": checks}

+def pair_results(results: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:

+    for row in results:

+        if identity:

+    pairs = []

+        exit_row = next((row for row in rows if row.get("boundary") == "exit" and row.get("samples")), None)
+        if not entry or not exit_row:

+            return last["x"] - first["x"], last["y"] - first["y"]
+        a, b = displacement(entry), displacement(exit_row)

+        exit_peak = max((row["speed"] for row in exit_row["features"]["velocity"]), default=0.0)

+    return pairs

+def build(controls: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:

+def generate(controls: Path, output: Path) -> dict:

+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse
+import hashlib

+import math
+import re
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path

+import cv2
+import numpy as np

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot as pilot
+
+TIMING_CONTRACT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4A_TIMING_PERSISTENCE_20260927/20260927T122000000Z_human_review_ready/step4a_timing_persistence_contract.json"
+PILOT_CONTROLS = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/step4b_motion_ir_controls.json"
+PILOT_RESULT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4B_MOTION_IR_PILOT_20260927/20260927T092115675Z_human_review_ready/step4b_motion_ir_pilot.json"
+WINDOW_FRAMES = 7
+POSITION_MIN = 0.012
+VISIBILITY_MIN = 0.15
+SCALE_MIN = 0.055
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def merge_holds(intervals: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
+    merged: list[list[int]] = []
+    for start, end in sorted(intervals):
+        if merged and start <= merged[-1][1]:
+            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
+        else:
+            merged.append([start, end])
+    return merged
+
+
+def boundary_intervals(start: int, end: int) -> dict[str, list[int]]:
+    duration = end - start
+    width = min(WINDOW_FRAMES, max(1, duration // 2))
+    return {"entry": [start, start + width - 1], "exit": [end - width, end - 1]}
+
+
+def unresolved(identity: str, text: str, boundary: str, interval: list[int], reason: str) -> dict:
+    features = pilot.derive_features([])
+    features.update({"raw_oscillation_candidate": False, "semantic_oscillation_confidence": "UNRESOLVED", "tracker_jump_outlier": False, "relative_visibility_noise_outlier": False})
+    return {
+        "control_id": f"{identity}:{boundary}", "identity": identity, "text_diagnostic_only": text,
+        "boundary": boundary, "interval": [interval[0], interval[1] + 1], "status": "UNRESOLVED",
+        "reason": reason, "samples": [], "features": features, "rotation": None,
+        "channel_authority": {"position": "UNRESOLVED", "relative_visibility": "UNRESOLVED", "scale": "UNRESOLVED", "rotation": "UNSUPPORTED"},
+        "derived_label": None, "derived_label_confidence": "UNRESOLVED", "reproduction_authority": False,
+        "continues_beyond_boundary": False, "static_no_motion": True,
+        "provenance": ["source_video", "frozen_identity", "frozen_step4a_interval", "accepted_pilot_dense_template_tracker"],
+    }
+
+
+def span(values: list[float]) -> float:
+    return max(values) - min(values) if values else 0.0
+
+
+def supported(authority: str) -> bool:
+    return not authority.startswith("UNRESOLVED") and authority != "UNSUPPORTED"
+
+
+def normalize(identity: str, text: str, row: dict) -> dict:
+    row["text_diagnostic_only"] = text
+    row["features"]["hold_intervals"] = merge_holds(row["features"]["hold_intervals"])
+    samples = row.get("samples") or []
+    scores = [sample["match_score"] for sample in samples]
+    position_quality = len(samples) >= 2 and float(np.median(scores)) >= 0.25
+    velocities = row["features"]["velocity"]
+    jump = max((item["speed"] for item in velocities), default=0.0) > 0.12
+    position_supported = position_quality and not jump
+    if not position_supported:
+        row["channel_authority"]["position"] = "UNRESOLVED_LOW_TRACK_QUALITY"

+    visibility = [sample["relative_visibility"]["value"] for sample in samples if sample.get("relative_visibility")]
+    visibility_noisy = bool(visibility and (max(visibility) >= 1.5 or pilot.sign_changes(np.diff(visibility).tolist()) >= 3))
+    if len(visibility) < 2 or not position_supported or visibility_noisy:
+        row["channel_authority"]["relative_visibility"] = "UNRESOLVED_RELATIVE_VISIBILITY"
+        for sample in samples:

+        visibility = []
+
+    scales = [sample["scale"]["value"] for sample in samples if sample.get("scale")]

+    oscillation_tracker_stable = position_supported and min(scores, default=0.0) >= 0.30 and float(np.std(scores)) <= 0.25
+    if row["channel_authority"]["scale"] == "CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY" and not scale_tracker_stable:
+        row["channel_authority"]["scale"] = "UNRESOLVED_TRACK_QUALITY_CONFLICT"
+        for sample in samples:
+            sample["scale"] = None
+        scales = []
+    position_material = position_supported and (span([s["position"]["x"] for s in samples]) >= POSITION_MIN or span([s["position"]["y"] for s in samples]) >= POSITION_MIN)

+    scale_material = row["channel_authority"]["scale"] == "CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY" and span(scales) >= SCALE_MIN
+    changes = row["features"]["direction_changes"]
+    amplitude = max((math.hypot(s["position"]["x"] - samples[0]["position"]["x"], s["position"]["y"] - samples[0]["position"]["y"]) for s in samples), default=0.0)
+    oscillation_candidate = bool(row["features"]["oscillation"])

+    row["features"].update({
+        "raw_oscillation_candidate": oscillation_candidate,
+        "semantic_oscillation_confidence": "HIGH" if oscillation_high else "LOW" if oscillation_candidate else "UNRESOLVED",
+        "tracker_jump_outlier": jump,
+        "relative_visibility_noise_outlier": visibility_noisy,
+    })
+
+    if oscillation_high:
+        label, confidence = "CUSTOM_OSCILLATION", "HIGH"
+    elif scale_material and row["features"]["overshoot"]:
+        label, confidence = "SCALE_OVERSHOOT", "HIGH"
+    elif scale_material:
+        label, confidence = "SCALE", "MEDIUM"
+    elif position_material and visibility_material:
+        label, confidence = "FADE_SLIDE", "MEDIUM"
+    elif position_material:
+        label, confidence = "SLIDE", "MEDIUM"
+    elif visibility_material:
+        label, confidence = "FADE", "MEDIUM"
+    else:
+        label, confidence = None, "UNRESOLVED"
+    row["derived_label"] = label
+    row["derived_label_confidence"] = confidence
+    row["reproduction_authority"] = False
+    row["static_no_motion"] = not any((position_material, visibility_material, scale_material))
+    edge_velocity = velocities[-1 if row["boundary"] == "entry" else 0]["speed"] if velocities else 0.0
+    row["continues_beyond_boundary"] = bool(position_supported and edge_velocity >= max(0.0015, max((v["speed"] for v in velocities), default=0.0) * 0.35))
+    row["status"] = "SOURCE_MEASURED" if any(supported(value) for value in row["channel_authority"].values()) else "UNRESOLVED"
+    row["authority"] = "RAW_CHANNEL_SAMPLES_ONLY"
+    row["provenance"] = ["source_video", "frozen_identity", "frozen_step4a_interval", "accepted_pilot_dense_template_tracker"]
+    return row
+
+
+def pair_records(records: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    grouped: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = {}
+    for row in records:
+        grouped.setdefault(row["identity"], {})[row["boundary"]] = row
+    pairs = []
+    for identity, sides in grouped.items():
+        entry, exit_row = sides["entry"], sides["exit"]
+        if not entry["samples"] or not exit_row["samples"]:
+            relationship = "UNRESOLVED"
+        elif entry["derived_label"] is None or exit_row["derived_label"] is None:
+            relationship = "INDEPENDENT"
+        else:
+            def displacement(row: dict) -> tuple[float, float]:
+                first, last = row["samples"][0]["position"], row["samples"][-1]["position"]
+                return last["x"] - first["x"], last["y"] - first["y"]
+            a, b = displacement(entry), displacement(exit_row)
+            dot = a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]
+            relationship = "REVERSED" if dot < 0 and entry["derived_label"] == exit_row["derived_label"] else "ASYMMETRIC"
+        pairs.append({"identity": identity, "entry_record": entry["control_id"], "exit_record": exit_row["control_id"], "relationship": relationship, "authority": "MEASURED_TRAJECTORY_COMPARISON" if relationship != "UNRESOLVED" else "UNRESOLVED"})
+    return pairs
+
+
+def channel_counts(records: list[dict], channel: str) -> dict:
+    count = sum(supported(row["channel_authority"][channel]) for row in records)
+    return {"supported": count, "unresolved_or_unsupported": len(records) - count}
+
+
+def select_review(records: list[dict], pairs: list[dict], pilot_controls: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    chosen: list[dict] = []
+    def take(name: str, predicate) -> None:
+        row = next((item for item in records if item["control_id"] not in {x["control_id"] for x in chosen} and predicate(item)), None)
+        if row:
+            chosen.append({**row, "review_stratum": name})
+    for case in pilot_controls:
+        identity, boundary = case.get("identity"), case["boundary"]
+        if identity:
+            take("accepted_pilot_regression", lambda row, identity=identity, boundary=boundary: row["identity"] == identity and row["boundary"] == boundary)
+    take("position_only", lambda r: r["derived_label"] == "SLIDE")
+    take("position_visibility", lambda r: r["derived_label"] == "FADE_SLIDE")
+    take("supported_scale", lambda r: r["channel_authority"]["scale"] == "CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY")
+    take("overshoot", lambda r: r["features"]["overshoot"])
+    take("oscillation_high", lambda r: r["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "HIGH")
+    take("oscillation_low", lambda r: r["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "LOW")
+    take("hold", lambda r: bool(r["features"]["hold_intervals"]))
+    asymmetric = {p["identity"] for p in pairs if p["relationship"] == "ASYMMETRIC"}
+    take("asymmetric_pair", lambda r: r["identity"] in asymmetric)
+    take("unresolved", lambda r: r["status"] == "UNRESOLVED")
+    take("static_no_fabricated_motion", lambda r: r["static_no_motion"])
+    take("continues_beyond_boundary", lambda r: r["continues_beyond_boundary"])
+    take("tracker_outlier", lambda r: r["features"]["tracker_jump_outlier"])
+    take("visibility_outlier", lambda r: r["features"]["relative_visibility_noise_outlier"])
+    return chosen[:18]
+
+
+def render_diagnostic(selected: list[dict]) -> bytes:

+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4B WHOLE-REEL MOTION IR - RAW SAMPLES AUTHORITATIVE / LABEL OPTIONAL", (20, 45), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .7, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(pilot.SOURCE_VIDEO))
+    colors = {"x": (210, 70, 30), "y": (40, 145, 40), "vis": (30, 30, 210), "scale": (160, 60, 160)}
+    for index, row in enumerate(selected):
+        top = 75 + index * row_height
+        heading = f'{row["review_stratum"]} | {row["identity"]} "{row["text_diagnostic_only"]}" {row["boundary"].upper()} | label={row["derived_label"]} ({row["derived_label_confidence"]}) AUTH=False'
+        cv2.putText(image, heading[:185], (15, top + 18), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        samples = row["samples"]
+        picks = [samples[0], samples[len(samples)//2], samples[-1]] if samples else []
+        for col, sample in enumerate(picks):
+            capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, sample["source_frame"]); ok, frame = capture.read()
+            if ok:

+                image[top+35:top+195, x:x+95] = thumb
+                cv2.putText(image, f'F{sample["frame"]}', (x, top+215), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .32, (20,20,20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        chart_x, chart_y, chart_w, chart_h = 375, top + 35, 1090, 160
+        cv2.rectangle(image, (chart_x, chart_y), (chart_x + chart_w, chart_y + chart_h), (175,175,175), 1)
+        series = {
+            "x": [s["position"]["x"] for s in samples], "y": [s["position"]["y"] for s in samples],
+            "vis": [s["relative_visibility"]["value"] if s.get("relative_visibility") else None for s in samples],
+            "scale": [s["scale"]["value"] if s.get("scale") else None for s in samples],
+        }
+        for series_index, (name, values) in enumerate(series.items()):
+            usable = [(i, value) for i, value in enumerate(values) if value is not None]
+            cv2.putText(image, name, (chart_x+5, chart_y+15+series_index*38), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .32, colors[name], 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            if len(usable) >= 2:

+                points = [(chart_x + round(i*chart_w/max(1, len(samples)-1)), chart_y + 30 + series_index*38 - round((value-lo)/spread*24)) for i, value in usable]
+                cv2.polylines(image, [np.asarray(points, np.int32)], False, colors[name], 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        warning = "RAW TRAJECTORY PRESERVED; SEMANTIC WOBBLE NOT AUTHORITATIVE" if row["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "LOW" else "AUTHORITATIVE RAW MOTION; OPTIONAL DERIVED LABEL"
+        cv2.putText(image, warning, (375, top+218), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (15,15,15), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture.release(); ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def build() -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    freeze = pilot.verify_freezes()

+    records = []
+    for timing_row in timing["identities"]:

+        text = static_by[identity]["identity"].get("text_diagnostic_only") or ""

+    oscillation_high = sum(row["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "HIGH" for row in records)
+    oscillation_low = sum(row["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "LOW" for row in records)
+    systematic = {
