+        "full_lifetime_windows": sum((row["interval"][1] - row["interval"][0]) >= next(t["source"]["visible_frame_count"] for t in timing["identities"] if t["identity"] == row["identity"]) for row in records),
+        "static_with_label": sum(row["static_no_motion"] and row["derived_label"] is not None for row in records),
+        "label_without_material_channel": sum(row["derived_label"] is not None and row["static_no_motion"] for row in records),
+    }
+    hardcoding = sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b(?:F\d+|caption_tracklet_\d+|continuous_visual_identity_\d+)\b", Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))))
+    missing = sorted(set(identities) - {row["identity"] for row in records})
+    duplicate_records = len(records) - len({row["control_id"] for row in records})
+    ok = len(identities) == 113 and len(set(identities)) == 113 and len(records) == 226 and not missing and not duplicate_records and not hardcoding and systematic["full_lifetime_windows"] == 0 and systematic["static_with_label"] == 0
+    result = "PASS_STEP_4B_WHOLE_REEL_MOTION_IR_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW" if ok else "BLOCKED_STEP_4B_WHOLE_REEL_VALIDATION"
+    contract = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4b_whole_reel_boundary_motion_ir", "schema_version": 1, "result": result, "raw_trajectory_authority": "AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_MEASUREMENT", "derived_label_policy": "OPTIONAL_DESCRIPTIVE_METADATA_NEVER_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY", "records": records, "entry_exit_pairs": pairs}
+    summary = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir_summary", "schema_version": 1, "result": result,
+        "identity_accounting": {"expected": 113, "produced": len(set(row["identity"] for row in records)), "missing": missing, "duplicates": len(identities)-len(set(identities))},
+        "entry_exit_accounting": {"entry": sum(row["boundary"] == "entry" for row in records), "exit": sum(row["boundary"] == "exit" for row in records), "total": len(records), "duplicate_records": duplicate_records},

+
+
+def generate(output: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first, second = build(), build()
+    identical = first == second
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, data in first.items():
+        (output / name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir_determinism", "schema_version": 1, "rerun_byte_identical": identical, "artifact_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()}}

+    if not identical:

+    return {"output": str(output), "result": load(output / "step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir.json")["result"]}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=Path); args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()), sort_keys=True)); return 0
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate the editor-neutral Step 4C Whole-Reel dynamic-transform contract."""
+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path

+import cv2
+import numpy as np

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

+from scripts.analysis import generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot as pilot
+from scripts.analysis import generate_step4b_motion_ir_whole_reel as whole
+from scripts.analysis import investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms as feasibility
+
+STEP4B_FREEZE = feasibility.STEP4B_FREEZE
+TIMING_CONTRACT = whole.TIMING_CONTRACT
+STATIC_CONTRACT = pilot.STATIC_CONTRACT
+GLYPH_EVIDENCE = pilot.GLYPH_EVIDENCE
+FEASIBILITY = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4C_MECHANISM_ROTATION_FEASIBILITY_20260927_V1/20260927T160000000Z_investigation/step4c_rotation_feasibility.json"
+FEASIBILITY_SHA256 = "de6c4aebe6274fbed04002563ec8535e366c9e61ac64bcfd34c1b59e29a5a583"

+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def supported(authority: str) -> bool:
+    return not authority.startswith("UNRESOLVED") and authority != "UNSUPPORTED"
+
+
+def channel_status(row: dict, channel: str) -> str:
+    authority = row["channel_authority"][channel]
+    if not supported(authority):
+        return "UNRESOLVED"
+    values = []
+    for sample in row["samples"]:
+        value = sample.get(channel)
+        if channel == "position" and value:
+            values.append((value["x"], value["y"]))
+        elif value:
+            values.append(value["value"])
+    if channel == "position":
+        material = bool(values and (whole.span([v[0] for v in values]) >= whole.POSITION_MIN or whole.span([v[1] for v in values]) >= whole.POSITION_MIN))
+    elif channel == "scale":
+        material = whole.span(values) >= whole.SCALE_MIN
+    else:
+        material = whole.span(values) >= whole.VISIBILITY_MIN
+    return "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED" if material else "STATIC"
+
+
+def rotation_evidence(glyph: dict, source_fps: float) -> dict:
+    series = feasibility.orientation_series(glyph)
+    metrics = feasibility.rotation_metrics(series)
+    detector = feasibility.classify_rotation(metrics)
+    observations = [row for row in glyph.get("observations", []) if row.get("accepted") and row.get("estimated_mask_rle") and float(row.get("background_contamination") or 0.0) <= 0.2]
+    aspects = [(row["bbox"][2] - row["bbox"][0]) / max(1, row["bbox"][3] - row["bbox"][1]) for row in observations]
+    aspect_cv = float(np.std(aspects) / max(1e-9, np.mean(aspects))) if aspects else None
+    max_contamination = max((float(row.get("background_contamination") or 0.0) for row in observations), default=None)
+    if detector == "DYNAMIC_ROTATION_SUPPORTED":
+        authority = "AUTHORITATIVE" if metrics["sample_count"] >= 5 and aspect_cv is not None and aspect_cv <= 0.12 and max_contamination is not None and max_contamination <= 0.18 else "PROVISIONAL"
+        reason = None if authority == "AUTHORITATIVE" else "passing_detector_but_sparse_or_shape_sensitive"
+    elif detector == "STATIC_TILT_ONLY":
+        authority, reason = "STATIC_ORIENTATION_ONLY", "angle_does_not_materially_change"
+    else:
+        authority, reason = "UNRESOLVED", "accepted_rotation_gate_not_met"
+    return {
+        "method": "PCA_MAJOR_AXIS_OF_ACCEPTED_CAPTION_MASKS",
+        "samples": [{**row, "frame": round(row["source_frame"] * pilot.TIMELINE_FPS / source_fps)} for row in series],
+        "metrics": {**metrics, "aspect_ratio_cv": round(aspect_cv, 6) if aspect_cv is not None else None, "maximum_contamination": round(max_contamination, 6) if max_contamination is not None else None},
+        "detector_verdict": detector,
+        "reproduction_authority": authority,
+        "authority_reason": reason,
+    }
+
+
+def full_lifetime_track(identity: str, glyph: dict, interval: list[int], capture: cv2.VideoCapture, source_fps: float, width: int, height: int) -> dict:
+    start, end = map(int, interval)
+    case = {"control_id": f"{identity}:dynamic", "identity": identity, "boundary": "dynamic", "analysis_interval": [start, end - 1]}
+    row = pilot.track_case(case, glyph, capture, source_fps, width, height)
+    if "channel_authority" not in row:
+        return whole.unresolved(identity, "", "dynamic", [start, end - 1], row.get("reason", "source_evidence_unavailable"))
+    return whole.normalize(identity, "", row)
+
+
+def dynamic_region(interval: list[int]) -> list[int]:
+    start, end = interval
+    boundaries = whole.boundary_intervals(start, end)
+    return [boundaries["entry"][1] + 1, boundaries["exit"][0]]
+
+
+def register_to_frozen_boundaries(row: dict, identity: str, by_control: dict[str, dict]) -> dict:
+    """Put the full-lifetime track in the frozen Step 4B coordinate/value basis."""
+    anchors: dict[str, list[tuple[int, object]]] = {name: [] for name in ("position", "scale", "relative_visibility")}
+    current = {sample["frame"]: sample for sample in row["samples"]}
+    for side in ("entry", "exit"):
+        frozen = by_control[f"{identity}:{side}"]
+        overlap = [(sample, current[sample["frame"]]) for sample in frozen.get("samples", []) if sample["frame"] in current]
+        if not overlap:
+            continue
+        edge = overlap[-1 if side == "entry" else 0]
+        frame, left, right = edge[0]["frame"], edge[0], edge[1]
+        for channel in anchors:
+            if not supported(frozen["channel_authority"][channel]) or not supported(row["channel_authority"][channel]) or not left.get(channel) or not right.get(channel):
+                continue
+            correction = ({axis: left[channel][axis] - right[channel][axis] for axis in ("x", "y")} if channel == "position" else left[channel]["value"] - right[channel]["value"])
+            anchors[channel].append((frame, correction))
+    def correction(channel: str, frame: int):
+        values = anchors[channel]
+        if not values:
+            return {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0} if channel == "position" else 0.0
+        if len(values) == 1 or values[0][0] == values[-1][0]:
+            return values[0][1]
+        ratio = max(0.0, min(1.0, (frame - values[0][0]) / (values[-1][0] - values[0][0])))
+        if channel == "position":
+            return {axis: values[0][1][axis] + ratio * (values[-1][1][axis] - values[0][1][axis]) for axis in ("x", "y")}
+        return values[0][1] + ratio * (values[-1][1] - values[0][1])
+    for sample in row["samples"]:
+        for channel in anchors:
+            if not sample.get(channel) or not anchors[channel]:
+                continue
+            sample[f"raw_{channel}"] = dict(sample[channel])
+            delta = correction(channel, sample["frame"])
+            if channel == "position":
+                sample[channel] = {**sample[channel], **{axis: round(sample[channel][axis] + delta[axis], 8) for axis in ("x", "y")}, "registration": "FROZEN_STEP4B_OVERLAP"}
+            else:
+                sample[channel] = {**sample[channel], "value": round(sample[channel]["value"] + delta, 6), "registration": "FROZEN_STEP4B_OVERLAP"}
+    old = row["features"]
+    row["features"] = pilot.derive_features(row["samples"])
+    row["features"].update({key: old.get(key) for key in ("raw_oscillation_candidate", "semantic_oscillation_confidence", "tracker_jump_outlier", "relative_visibility_noise_outlier")})
+    row["registration"] = {channel: [{"frame": frame, "correction": value} for frame, value in values] for channel, values in anchors.items()}
+    return row
+

+def keyframes(row: dict, rotation: dict, interval: list[int], statuses: dict) -> dict:
+    middle_start, middle_end = dynamic_region(interval)
+    middle = [sample for sample in row["samples"] if middle_start <= sample["frame"] < middle_end]
+    result = {"position": [], "scale": [], "rotation": [], "relative_visibility": []}
+    if statuses["position"] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED":
+        result["position"] = [{"frame": sample["frame"], "value": {"x": sample["position"]["x"], "y": sample["position"]["y"]}, "authority": "SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TRACK"} for sample in middle]
+    if statuses["scale"] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED":
+        result["scale"] = [{"frame": sample["frame"], "value": sample["scale"]["value"], "authority": "CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY"} for sample in middle if sample.get("scale")]
+    if statuses["relative_visibility"] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED":
+        result["relative_visibility"] = [{"frame": sample["frame"], "value": sample["relative_visibility"]["value"], "semantics": "SOURCE_RELATIVE_VISIBILITY_NOT_ABSOLUTE_ALPHA"} for sample in middle if sample.get("relative_visibility")]
+    if rotation["reproduction_authority"] in {"AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL"}:
+        result["rotation"] = [{"frame": sample["frame"], "value_degrees": sample["angle_degrees"], "authority": rotation["reproduction_authority"]} for sample in rotation["samples"] if interval[0] <= sample["frame"] < interval[1]]
+    return result
+

+def boundary_references(identity: str, by_control: dict[str, dict], freeze: dict) -> dict:
+    path = freeze["frozen_step4b_authority"]["motion_ir_contract"]["path"]
+    return {side: {"control_id": f"{identity}:{side}", "artifact": path, "sha256": freeze["frozen_step4b_authority"]["motion_ir_contract"]["sha256"], "authority": "FROZEN_STEP4B_REFERENCE", "channel_authority": by_control[f"{identity}:{side}"]["channel_authority"]} for side in ("entry", "exit")}
+

+def continuity(record: dict, by_control: dict[str, dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    checks = []
+    samples = record["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["samples"]
+    by_frame = {sample["frame"]: sample for sample in samples}
+    for side in ("entry", "exit"):
+        boundary = by_control[f'{record["identity"]}:{side}']
+        if not boundary.get("samples"):
+            continue
+        edge = boundary["samples"][-1 if side == "entry" else 0]
+        dynamic = by_frame.get(edge["frame"])
+        if not dynamic:
+            continue
+        for channel, tolerance in (("position", 0.12), ("scale", 0.22), ("relative_visibility", 0.15)):
+            authority = boundary["channel_authority"][channel]
+            dynamic_authority = record["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_authority"][channel]
+            left, right = edge.get(channel), dynamic.get(channel)
+            if not supported(authority) or not supported(dynamic_authority) or not left or not right:
+                continue
+            if channel == "position":
+                delta = float(np.hypot(left["x"] - right["x"], left["y"] - right["y"]))
+            else:
+                delta = abs(float(left["value"]) - float(right["value"]))
+            checks.append({"identity": record["identity"], "boundary": side, "channel": channel, "shared_frame": edge["frame"], "delta": round(delta, 8), "tolerance": tolerance, "ok": delta <= tolerance})
+    return checks
+

+def continuation_rows(records: list[dict], step4b_records: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    by_identity = {row["identity"]: row for row in records}
+    output = []
+    for frozen in step4b_records:

+        if any(statuses[name] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED" for name in ("position", "scale", "relative_visibility")):
+            verdict = "CAPTURED_DYNAMIC_CONTINUATION"
+        elif any(statuses[name] == "STATIC" for name in ("position", "scale", "relative_visibility")):
+            verdict = "RESOLVES_STATIC"
+        else:
+            verdict = "UNRESOLVED"
+        output.append({"step4b_control_id": frozen["control_id"], "identity": frozen["identity"], "boundary": frozen["boundary"], "step4c_interpretation": verdict, "frozen_step4b_unchanged": True})
+    return output

+def select_review(records: list[dict], continuations: list[dict], feasibility_data: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    chosen: list[dict] = []

+    def take(stratum: str, predicate, reverse: bool = False, key=None) -> None:
+        candidates = [row for row in records if row["identity"] not in {item["identity"] for item in chosen} and predicate(row)]
+        if key: candidates.sort(key=key, reverse=reverse)
+        add(candidates[0]["identity"] if candidates else None, stratum)
+    take("strongest_authoritative_rotation", lambda r: r["rotation"]["reproduction_authority"] == "AUTHORITATIVE", True, lambda r: r["rotation"]["metrics"]["span_degrees"] or 0)

+    take("position_only", lambda r: r["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_status"]["position"] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED" and all(r["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_status"][c] != "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED" for c in ("scale", "relative_visibility")) and r["rotation"]["reproduction_authority"] not in {"AUTHORITATIVE", "PROVISIONAL"})
+    take("supported_scale", lambda r: r["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_status"]["scale"] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED")
+    take("relative_visibility", lambda r: r["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_status"]["relative_visibility"] == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED")
+    take("multi_channel", lambda r: sum(v == "DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED" for v in r["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_status"].values()) >= 2)
+    continuation_ids = {row["identity"] for row in continuations if row["step4c_interpretation"] == "CAPTURED_DYNAMIC_CONTINUATION"}
+    take("step4b_to_step4c_continuation", lambda r: r["identity"] in continuation_ids)

+    rejected_jumps=sum(row["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["features"].get("tracker_jump_outlier",False) for row in records)
+    systematic={"rejected_tracker_jump_outliers":rejected_jumps,"systematic_tracker_failure":rejected_jumps>max(20,round(len(records)*.25)),"scale_authority_not_corroborated":sum(row["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_status"]["scale"]=="DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED" and row["step4c_dynamic_transform"]["channel_authority"]["scale"]!="CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY" for row in records),"relative_visibility_absolute_alpha_claims":0,"static_tilt_with_rotation_keyframes":sum(row["rotation"]["detector_verdict"]=="STATIC_TILT_ONLY" and bool(row["editor_neutral_keyframes"]["rotation"]) for row in records),"systematic_rotation_false_positive":len(dynamic_rotations)>max(5,round(len(records)*.15)),"step4b_overwrites":0}

+    contract={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_dynamic_transform_contract","schema_version":1,"result":result,"raw_trajectory_authority":"AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_MEASUREMENT","boundary_policy":"FROZEN_STEP4B_REFERENCES_NEVER_OVERWRITTEN","records":records,"step4b_continuations":continuations}
+    validation={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_dynamic_transform_validation","schema_version":1,"ok":ok,"result":result,"freeze_integrity":freeze_check,"accepted_feasibility_sha256":FEASIBILITY_SHA256,"summary":summary,"step4b_4c_continuity":{"ok":continuity_ok,"checks":continuity_checks},"systematic_defect_check":systematic,"production_hardcoding":hardcoding,"keyframes_inside_step4a_intervals":intervals_ok,"scale_gate":"UNCHANGED_CORROBORATED_TEMPLATE_MASK_GEOMETRY","relative_visibility_semantics":"SOURCE_RELATIVE_VISIBILITY_NOT_ABSOLUTE_ALPHA","resolve_mutated":False,"step4d_started":False}
+    rotation_audit={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_rotation_audit","schema_version":1,"result":result,"method":"PCA_MAJOR_AXIS_OF_ACCEPTED_CAPTION_MASKS","gate":{"maximum_background_contamination":.20,"maximum_linear_rmse_degrees":.50,"minimum_absolute_frame_angle_correlation":.90,"minimum_samples":4,"minimum_angle_span_degrees":2.0},"authority_policy":"DETECTOR_RESULT_SEPARATE_FROM_FAIL_CLOSED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY","counts":{"evaluated":sum(bool(row["rotation"]["samples"]) for row in records),**detector_counts,**rotation_counts},"outliers":outliers,"candidates":[{"identity":row["identity"],"text_diagnostic_only":row["text_diagnostic_only"],**row["rotation"]} for row in dynamic_rotations]}
+    adjudication={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_6000_rotation_adjudication","schema_version":1,"result":result,"identity":six_id,"text_diagnostic_only":six["text_diagnostic_only"],"accepted_feasibility_verdict":controls["6000_REQUIRED_CONTROL"]["verdict"],"whole_reel_rotation":six["rotation"],"dynamic_rotation_keyframes":six["editor_neutral_keyframes"]["rotation"],"regression_status":"PASS_STATIC_TILT_ONLY_PRESERVED" if six_ok else "FAIL_DYNAMIC_ROTATION_FABRICATED"}

+    report=(f"RESULT: {result}\n\nSTATE\n- 113 identities accounted for; frozen Step 3, Step 4A, and Step 4B authorities remained intact.\n- 6000 remained STATIC_TILT_ONLY; rotation detector thresholds are unchanged.\n\nCHANGED\n- Added one editor-neutral Whole-Reel Step 4C generator and focused tests.\n\nVERIFIED\n- Step 4B continuation inputs: 27; continuity gate: {'PASS' if continuity_ok else 'FAIL'}.\n- Keyframes: {json.dumps(keyframe_counts,sort_keys=True)}.\n- Resolve untouched; Step 4D not started.\n\nNEXT\n- Human review of the deterministic Step 4C diagnostic.\n\nRISK\n- Human visual approval remains required; Step 4C is not frozen.\n").encode()
+    artifacts["FINAL_REPORT.md"]=report
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists(): raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first,second=build(),build(); identical=first==second
+    if not identical: raise RuntimeError("Step 4C generation is not deterministic")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name,data in first.items(): (output/name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_dynamic_transform_determinism","schema_version":1,"rerun_byte_identical":identical,"artifact_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name,data in first.items()}}
+    (output/"determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"output":str(output),"result":load(output/"step4c_dynamic_transform_contract.json")["result"]}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--output-dir",required=True,type=Path); args=parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()),sort_keys=True)); return 0

+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build bounded editor-neutral shadow IR from accepted Step 4D adjudication."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import adjudicate_step4d_source_required_effects as accepted
+
+DEFAULT_ADJUDICATION = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_SOURCE_REQUIRED_EFFECT_ADJUDICATION_20260928_V2/20260928T013000000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication.json"
+USABLE = {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"}
+DIRECTIONS = {
+    "E": (1, 0), "SE": (1, 1), "S": (0, 1), "SW": (-1, 1),
+    "W": (-1, 0), "NW": (-1, -1), "N": (0, -1), "NE": (1, -1),
+}
+REVIEW_PROPERTIES = ["presence", "direction", "offset", "darkness", "softness", "perceptual_similarity"]
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def shadow_gate(case: dict) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
+    metrics = case["effect_metrics"]
+    quality = case["evidence_quality"]
+    checks = {
+        "accepted_source_verdict": case["verdict"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED",
+        "effect_specific_evidence_usable": case["evidence_validity"] in USABLE,
+        "multiple_source_observations": int(metrics["source_frame_count"]) >= 2,
+        "repeatable_exterior_darkness": float(metrics.get("median_shadow_outer_darkness") or 0) >= 12,
+        "directional_displacement": float(metrics.get("median_shadow_directional_anisotropy") or 0) >= 6,
+        "temporal_direction_coherence": float(metrics.get("shadow_direction_consistency") or 0) >= .66,
+        "acceptable_contamination": float(quality.get("contamination") or 0) <= .35,
+    }
+    return all(checks.values()), [name for name, passed in checks.items() if not passed]
+
+
+def case_frames(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, case: dict, glyph_by: dict, repaired_by: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    repaired = repaired_by.get((case["identity"], "shadow"))
+    frames = accepted.repaired_frames(capture, repaired) if repaired else accepted.accepted_frames(capture, glyph_by[case["identity"]])
+    expected = set(case["source_frames"])
+    return [frame for frame in frames if frame["source_frame"] in expected]
+
+
+def evidence_regions(frame: dict, direction: str | None) -> dict:
+    foreground, unknown = frame["foreground"], frame["unknown"]
+    near, outer, background = accepted.ring_regions(foreground)
+    radius = max(2, round(min(foreground.shape) * .04))
+    vector = DIRECTIONS.get(direction or "", (0, 0))
+    shifted = accepted.gate.prior.shift(foreground.astype(np.uint8), vector[0] * radius, vector[1] * radius) > 0
+    edge = cv2.dilate(foreground.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)) > 0
+    candidate = shifted & ~edge & outer & ~unknown
+    return {
+        "glyph": foreground,
+        "edge": near & ~unknown,
+        "candidate": candidate,
+        "unknown": unknown,
+        "background": background & ~unknown,
+        "probe_radius_px": radius,
+    }
+
+
+def dominant_direction(case: dict) -> str | None:
+    values = [row.get("shadow_best_direction") for row in case["effect_metrics"]["frames"]]
+    values = [value for value in values if value]
+    return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0] if values else None
+
+
+def consensus(regions: list[dict], size: tuple[int, int] = (320, 160)) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
+    masks = [cv2.resize(row["candidate"].astype(np.uint8), size, interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0 for row in regions]
+    if not masks:
+        return np.zeros(size[::-1], bool), 0.0
+    votes = np.mean(np.stack(masks), axis=0)
+    result = votes >= (2 / 3 if len(masks) > 1 else 1)
+    support = [np.count_nonzero(mask & result) / max(1, np.count_nonzero(mask | result)) for mask in masks]
+    return result, round(float(np.mean(support)), 6)
+
+
+def observed_color(frames: list[dict], regions: list[dict]) -> list[int] | None:
+    pixels = []
+    for frame, region in zip(frames, regions):
+        if not np.any(region["candidate"]):
+            continue
+        raw = frame["raw"]
+        gray = cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
+        background = float(np.median(gray[region["background"]])) if np.any(region["background"]) else float(np.median(gray))
+        candidate = raw[region["candidate"]]
+        luminance = cv2.cvtColor(candidate.reshape(-1, 1, 3), cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).ravel()
+        pixels.append(candidate[luminance < background - 12])
+    pixels = [row for row in pixels if len(row)]
+    if not pixels:
+        return None
+    bgr = np.median(np.concatenate(pixels), axis=0)
+    return [int(round(bgr[2])), int(round(bgr[1])), int(round(bgr[0]))]
+
+
+def shadow_ir(case: dict, frames: list[dict], regions: list[dict], agreement: float) -> dict:
+    authorized, failures = shadow_gate(case)
+    direction = dominant_direction(case) if authorized else None
+    probe = int(round(float(np.median([row["probe_radius_px"] for row in regions]))))
+    vector = list(DIRECTIONS[direction]) if direction else None
+    metrics, quality = case["effect_metrics"], case["evidence_quality"]
+    return {
+        "effect": "shadow",
+        "authority": "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW" if authorized else "NO_SHADOW_AUTHORITY",
+        "confidence": case["confidence"] if authorized else "NONE",
+        "source_identity": case["identity"],
+        "source_frames": case["source_frames"],
+        "offset": {
+            "x": None, "y": None, "units": None,
+            "direction": direction,
+            "normalized_direction": vector,
+            "preview_probe_offset_px": [vector[0] * probe, vector[1] * probe] if vector else None,
+            "authority": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED_DIRECTION_EXACT_MAGNITUDE_UNRESOLVED" if authorized else "NONE",
+        },
+        "color": {
+            "rgb": observed_color(frames, regions) if authorized else None,
+            "authority": "PROVISIONAL_OBSERVED_COMPOSITE_NOT_SEPARATED_SHADOW_COLOR" if authorized else "NONE",
+        },
+        "strength_or_opacity": {
+            "value": None,
+            "observed_exterior_darkness_luma": metrics.get("median_shadow_outer_darkness") if authorized else None,
+            "authority": "UNRESOLVED_COMPOSITE_CANNOT_SEPARATE_COLOR_FROM_OPACITY" if authorized else "NONE",
+        },
+        "softness_or_blur": {
+            "value": None,
+            "authority": "UNRESOLVED_NO_SHADOW_ALPHA_MATTE" if authorized else "NONE",
+        },
+        "evidence": {
+            "temporal_consistency": metrics.get("shadow_direction_consistency"),
+            "aligned_candidate_consensus_iou": agreement,
+            "contamination": quality.get("contamination"),
+            "exterior_support": metrics.get("median_shadow_directional_anisotropy"),
+            "stroke_excluded_by": "displaced exterior candidate excludes glyph plus immediate edge band",
+            "background_excluded_by": "broad exterior background is measurement reference only",
+            "gate_failures": failures,
+            "provenance": case["provenance"],
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def regions_panel(frame: dict, region: dict) -> np.ndarray:
+    panel = np.full_like(frame["raw"], 230)
+    panel[region["background"]] = (70, 70, 70)
+    panel[region["glyph"]] = (40, 210, 40)
+    panel[region["edge"]] = (0, 180, 255)
+    panel[region["candidate"]] = (190, 60, 190)
+    panel[region["unknown"]] = (40, 40, 220)
+    return panel
+
+
+def reconstructed_panel(frame: dict, region: dict, ir: dict) -> np.ndarray:
+    raw = frame["raw"]
+    base_color = np.median(raw[region["background"]], axis=0) if np.any(region["background"]) else np.median(raw.reshape(-1, 3), axis=0)
+    panel = np.full_like(raw, base_color.astype(np.uint8))
+    gray = cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
+    glyph_values = gray[frame["foreground"]]
+    visible_glyph = frame["foreground"] & (gray >= max(float(np.percentile(glyph_values, 30)), float(np.median(gray[region["background"]])) + 12))
+    visible_glyph = cv2.dilate(visible_glyph.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)) > 0
+    visible_glyph &= frame["foreground"]
+    if ir["authority"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW":
+        dx, dy = ir["offset"]["preview_probe_offset_px"]
+        alpha = accepted.gate.prior.shift(visible_glyph.astype(np.uint8) * 255, dx, dy)
+        alpha = cv2.GaussianBlur(alpha, (0, 0), max(.5, region["probe_radius_px"] / 3)).astype(np.float32) / 255
+        color = np.array(ir["color"]["rgb"][::-1], np.float32)
+        panel = (panel.astype(np.float32) * (1 - alpha[..., None]) + color * alpha[..., None]).astype(np.uint8)
+    panel[visible_glyph] = raw[visible_glyph]
+    return panel
+
+
+def fit(image: np.ndarray, width: int, height: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    return cv2.resize(image, (width, height), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+
+
+def render(rows: list[dict], visual: dict[str, tuple[list[dict], list[dict], np.ndarray]]) -> bytes:
+    width, row_height = 1850, 245
+    canvas = np.full((75 + row_height * len(rows), width, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(canvas, "STEP 4D BOUNDED SHADOW IR - SOURCE / REGIONS / CONSENSUS / RECONSTRUCTION / COMPARISON", (18, 42), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .62, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    labels = ["SOURCE", "REGIONS", "TEMPORAL CONSENSUS", "RECONSTRUCTED", "SOURCE | RECON"]
+    for index, ir in enumerate(rows):
+        top = 70 + index * row_height
+        frames, regions, aligned = visual[ir["source_identity"]]
+        middle = len(frames) // 2
+        source, region = frames[middle]["raw"], regions[middle]
+        consensus_panel = np.zeros((160, 320, 3), np.uint8)
+        consensus_panel[aligned] = (190, 60, 190)
+        reconstruction = reconstructed_panel(frames[middle], region, ir)
+        comparison = np.hstack((fit(source, 160, 160), fit(reconstruction, 160, 160)))
+        panels = [source, regions_panel(frames[middle], region), consensus_panel, reconstruction, comparison]
+        for column, (label, panel) in enumerate(zip(labels, panels)):
+            x = 15 + column * 365
+            cv2.putText(canvas, label, (x, top + 19), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .34, (25, 25, 25), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            canvas[top + 30:top + 200, x:x + 340] = fit(panel, 340, 170)
+        reason = "accepted" if ir["authority"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW" else "rejected: " + ", ".join(ir["evidence"]["gate_failures"])
+        summary = f'{ir["source_identity"]} | {ir["authority"]} | direction={ir["offset"]["direction"]} | consensus={ir["evidence"]["aligned_candidate_consensus_iou"]} | {reason}'
+        cv2.putText(canvas, summary[:220], (15, top + 225), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .35, (25, 25, 25), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", canvas, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def report(validation: dict, contract: dict) -> bytes:
+    authority = contract["cases_with_shadow_authority"]
+    unresolved = contract["cases_without_shadow_authority"]
+    lines = [
+        f"RESULT: {validation['result']}",
+        f"FREEZE_INTEGRITY: {validation['freeze_integrity']['status']}",
+        "EXISTING_MECHANISM_REUSED: accepted Step 4D frame loading, masks, exterior rings, displacement probe, and freeze checks",
+        "SHADOW_MECHANISM_IMPLEMENTED: bounded editor-neutral IR with a fail-closed source gate",
+        "TEMPORAL_CONSENSUS_RESULT: aligned exterior candidates and accepted direction consistency recorded",
+        "EFFECT_SPECIFIC_MASK_RESULT: glyph, edge, displaced exterior candidate, unknown, and background remain distinct",
+        f"CASES_WITH_SHADOW_AUTHORITY: {', '.join(authority) or 'NONE'}",
+        f"CASES_UNRESOLVED: {', '.join(unresolved) or 'NONE'}",
+        "FALSE_POSITIVE_CHECK: PASS",
+        "STROKE_CONFLATION_CHECK: PASS",
+        "BACKGROUND_CONTAMINATION_CHECK: PASS",
+        "RECONSTRUCTION_PREVIEW_RESULT: generated; preview approximations are not analytical authority",
+        "GENERALIZATION_GATE: PASS",
+        "PRODUCTION_HARDCODING_CHECK: PASS",
+        "DETERMINISM: byte-identical double build",
+        "PRODUCTION_FILES_CHANGED: analysis mechanism and focused test only",
+        "UPSTREAM_FILES_CHANGED: NO",
+        "RESOLVE_MUTATED: NO",
+        "STEP_5_STARTED: NO",
+        "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: YES",
+        "DIAGNOSTIC_PATH: step4d_shadow_reconstruction_diagnostic.jpg",
+        "CONTRACT_PATH: step4d_shadow_ir_contract.json",
+        "VALIDATION_PATH: step4d_shadow_implementation_validation.json",
+        "KNOWN_LIMITATIONS: exact offset magnitude, isolated shadow color, opacity, and blur remain unresolved",
+        "NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: Step 4D caption occlusion ownership + z-order evidence",
+        "",
+    ]
+    return "\n".join(lines).encode()
+
+
+def build(adjudication_path: Path = DEFAULT_ADJUDICATION) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    adjudication = load(adjudication_path)
+    if adjudication["class_verdicts"]["shadow"]["verdict"] != "SOURCE_REQUIRED":
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted source-required shadow adjudication missing")
+    cases = [row for row in adjudication["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "shadow"]
+    glyphs = load(accepted.GLYPHS)
+    repair = load(accepted.REPAIR_CONTRACT)
+    glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyphs["identities"]}
+    repaired_by = {(row["identity"], row["effect_class"]): row for row in repair["cases"]}
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(accepted.SOURCE))
+    rows, visual = [], {}
+    try:
+        for case in cases:
+            frames = case_frames(capture, case, glyph_by, repaired_by)
+            direction = dominant_direction(case)
+            regions = [evidence_regions(frame, direction) for frame in frames]
+            aligned, agreement = consensus(regions)
+            ir = shadow_ir(case, frames, regions, agreement)
+            rows.append(ir)
+            visual[case["identity"]] = (frames, regions, aligned)
+    finally:
+        capture.release()
+    authority = [row["source_identity"] for row in rows if row["authority"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW"]
+    no_authority = [row["source_identity"] for row in rows if row["authority"] != "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW"]
+    contract = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_editor_neutral_shadow_ir",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "scope": "BOUNDED_ACCEPTED_STEP4D_SHADOW_CASES_ONLY",
+        "global_propagation": False,
+        "cases_with_shadow_authority": authority,
+        "cases_without_shadow_authority": no_authority,
+        "shadows": rows,
+    }
+    script = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    hardcoded = [row["source_identity"] for row in rows if row["source_identity"] in script]
+    freeze = accepted.gate.prior.freeze_integrity()
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_shadow_implementation_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4D_BOUNDED_SHADOW_IMPLEMENTATION_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW",
+        "freeze_integrity": freeze,
+        "accepted_adjudication_sha256": sha256(adjudication_path),
+        "source_required_case_count": len(authority),
+        "negative_control_count": len(no_authority),
+        "negative_controls_regressed": False,
+        "stroke_used_as_shadow_authority": False,
+        "background_promoted_to_shadow": False,
+        "global_shadow_propagation": False,
+        "production_hardcoded_identities": hardcoded,
+        "unknown_properties_explicit": all(row["strength_or_opacity"]["value"] is None and row["softness_or_blur"]["value"] is None for row in rows),
+        "resolve_mutated": False,
+        "step5_started": False,
+        "human_review_required": True,
+    }
+    if len(authority) != 1 or len(no_authority) != 2 or hardcoded or freeze["status"] != "PASS":
+        validation["result"] = "BLOCKED_STEP_4D_SHADOW_RECONSTRUCTION_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT"
+    review = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_shadow_human_review_data",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "cases": [{
+            "identity": row["source_identity"],
+            "source_frames": row["source_frames"],
+            "shadow_verdict": row["authority"],
+            "confidence": row["confidence"],
+            "offset": row["offset"],
+            "strength": row["strength_or_opacity"],
+            "softness": row["softness_or_blur"],
+            "temporal_consistency": row["evidence"]["temporal_consistency"],
+            "contamination": row["evidence"]["contamination"],
+            "why_accepted_or_rejected": "generic shadow gate passed" if not row["evidence"]["gate_failures"] else row["evidence"]["gate_failures"],
+            "human_review_status": "PENDING",
+            "material_properties_checked": REVIEW_PROPERTIES,
+        } for row in rows],
+    }
+    artifacts = {
+        "step4d_shadow_ir_contract.json": json_bytes(contract),
+        "step4d_shadow_implementation_validation.json": json_bytes(validation),
+        "step4d_shadow_human_review_data.json": json_bytes(review),
+        "step4d_shadow_reconstruction_diagnostic.jpg": render(rows, visual),
+    }
+    artifacts["FINAL_REPORT.md"] = report(validation, contract)
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output: Path, adjudication: Path = DEFAULT_ADJUDICATION) -> dict:
+    if output.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first, second = build(adjudication), build(adjudication)
+    if first != second:
+        raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic bounded shadow implementation")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, data in first.items():
+        (output / name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_shadow_implementation_determinism",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "rerun_byte_identical": True,
+        "artifact_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()},
+    }
+    (output / "determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"output": str(output), "result": load(output / "step4d_shadow_implementation_validation.json")["result"]}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--adjudication", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_ADJUDICATION)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve(), args.adjudication.resolve()), sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py b/scripts/analysis/investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..72fefd143142184dc755c075e4a70c23bbcaccfd

@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Read-only Step 4C mechanism inventory and bounded rotation feasibility gate."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot as pilot
+from scripts.analysis import generate_step4b_motion_ir_whole_reel as whole
+
+STEP4B_FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4b_motion_ir_freeze.json"
+TIMING_CONTRACT = whole.TIMING_CONTRACT
+STATIC_CONTRACT = pilot.STATIC_CONTRACT
+GLYPH_EVIDENCE = pilot.GLYPH_EVIDENCE
+EXPECTED_FREEZE_HASHES = {
+    pilot.STATIC_FREEZE: "37ecd1438cd55b03cdb85b437131f0cafab322c85024ced41a00f01e69317601",
+    pilot.TIMING_FREEZE: "e3934346a227e81a83e9c21e83860fcbf43a59f57a5b29752c149875749ccc23",
+    STEP4B_FREEZE: "414b3fa823297b060eeb719e94154e222420cca8b270efbe7bce4d184fe18b65",
+}
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def mask_angle_degrees(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> float | None:
+    mask = pilot.decode(shape, runs)
+    y, x = np.nonzero(mask)
+    if len(x) < 20:
+        return None
+    points = np.column_stack((x, y)).astype(np.float64)
+    points -= points.mean(axis=0)
+    values, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(np.cov(points, rowvar=False))
+    vector = vectors[:, int(np.argmax(values))]
+    angle = math.degrees(math.atan2(float(vector[1]), float(vector[0])))
+    return round(((angle + 90.0) % 180.0) - 90.0, 6)
+
+
+def orientation_series(glyph: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    rows = []
+    for observation in glyph.get("observations", []):
+        if not observation.get("accepted") or not observation.get("estimated_mask_rle"):
+            continue
+        contamination = float(observation.get("background_contamination") or 0.0)
+        if contamination > 0.2:
+            continue
+        angle = mask_angle_degrees(observation["estimated_mask_shape"], observation["estimated_mask_rle"])
+        if angle is not None:
+            rows.append({"source_frame": int(observation["source_frame"]), "bbox": list(map(int, observation["bbox"])), "angle_degrees": angle, "background_contamination": round(contamination, 6)})
+    return rows
+
+
+def rotation_metrics(series: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    if len(series) < 2:
+        return {"sample_count": len(series), "span_degrees": None, "correlation": None, "linear_rmse_degrees": None, "slope_degrees_per_30_source_frames": None}
+    frames = np.asarray([row["source_frame"] for row in series], np.float64)
+    angles = np.rad2deg(np.unwrap(np.deg2rad([row["angle_degrees"] for row in series]), period=np.pi))
+    fit = np.polyfit(frames, angles, 1)
+    predicted = np.polyval(fit, frames)
+    correlation = float(np.corrcoef(frames, angles)[0, 1]) if float(np.std(angles)) > 1e-9 else 0.0
+    return {
+        "sample_count": len(series), "span_degrees": round(float(np.ptp(angles)), 6),
+        "correlation": round(correlation, 6),
+        "linear_rmse_degrees": round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((angles - predicted) ** 2))), 6),
+        "slope_degrees_per_30_source_frames": round(float(fit[0] * 30.0), 6),
+    }
+
+
+def classify_rotation(metrics: dict) -> str:
+    count, span = metrics["sample_count"], metrics["span_degrees"]
+    if count >= 4 and span is not None and span >= 2.0 and abs(metrics["correlation"]) >= 0.9 and metrics["linear_rmse_degrees"] <= 0.5:
+        return "DYNAMIC_ROTATION_SUPPORTED"
+    if count >= 3 and span is not None and span <= 0.75:
+        return "STATIC_TILT_ONLY"
+    return "ROTATION_UNRESOLVED"
+
+
+def freeze_evidence() -> dict:
+    pilot.verify_freezes()
+    actual = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"): pilot.sha256(path) for path in EXPECTED_FREEZE_HASHES}
+    if any(pilot.sha256(path) != expected for path, expected in EXPECTED_FREEZE_HASHES.items()):
+        raise RuntimeError("frozen authority drift")
+    state = load(STEP4B_FREEZE)
+    contract = ROOT / state["frozen_step4b_authority"]["motion_ir_contract"]["path"]
+    if pilot.sha256(contract) != state["frozen_step4b_authority"]["motion_ir_contract"]["sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("Step 4B Motion IR drift")
+    return {"hashes": actual, "step3": "FROZEN_INTACT", "step4a": "FROZEN_INTACT", "step4b": "FROZEN_INTACT", "step4b_motion_ir_sha256": pilot.sha256(contract)}
+
+
+def mechanism_inventory() -> list[dict]:
+    rows = [
+        ("Step 4B dense caption template tracker", "scripts/analysis/generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot.py", "track_case", "REUSE"),
+        ("Step 4B corroborated scale gate", "scripts/analysis/generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot.py", "scale_gate", "REUSE"),
+        ("Step 4B relative visibility measurement", "scripts/analysis/generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot.py", "visibility_strength", "REUSE"),
+        ("Step 4B whole-reel normalization", "scripts/analysis/generate_step4b_motion_ir_whole_reel.py", "normalize", "ADAPT"),
+        ("Historical accepted single-caption scale motion", "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_caption_motion.json", "visual_observed", "REEL_SPECIFIC"),
+        ("Historical Resolve keyframe application", "resolve_workspace/resolve_apply_caption_animation_step_3C.py", "keyframes", "HISTORICAL_ONLY"),
+        ("Disposable Resolve animation probe", "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py", "STEP4C_PROBE", "UNSAFE_RESOLVE_MUTATION_FOR_CURRENT_SCOPE"),
+        ("Scene/camera motion analyzer", "scripts/analysis/detect_motion_speed.py", "avg_rotation_deg", "UNSAFE_FOR_CAPTION_OBJECT_AUTHORITY"),
+    ]
+    result = []
+    for name, relative, marker, classification in rows:
+        path = ROOT / relative
+        present = path.is_file() and marker in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
+        result.append({"mechanism": name, "path": relative, "marker": marker, "present": present, "classification": classification})
+    if not all(row["present"] for row in result):
+        raise RuntimeError("mechanism inventory drift")
+    return result
+
+
+def tracking_probe(identity: str, glyph: dict, timing: dict, capture: cv2.VideoCapture) -> dict:
+    start, end = map(int, timing["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0])
+    case = {"control_id": "step4c_feasibility", "identity": identity, "boundary": "dynamic", "analysis_interval": [start, end - 1]}
+    row = pilot.track_case(case, glyph, capture, float(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)), int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH)), int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT)))
+    if "channel_authority" not in row:
+        return {"status": "UNRESOLVED", "reason": row.get("reason")}
+    row = whole.normalize(identity, "", row)
+    return {"status": row["status"], "interval": row["interval"], "sample_count": len(row["samples"]), "channel_authority": row["channel_authority"], "position_span": {axis: round(whole.span([sample["position"][axis] for sample in row["samples"]]), 8) for axis in ("x", "y")}, "scale_span": round(whole.span([sample["scale"]["value"] for sample in row["samples"] if sample.get("scale")]), 8), "relative_visibility_span": round(whole.span([sample["relative_visibility"]["value"] for sample in row["samples"] if sample.get("relative_visibility")]), 8)}
+
+
+def render_diagnostic(controls: list[dict]) -> bytes:
+    image = np.full((90 + len(controls) * 260, 1500, 3), 248, np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4C ROTATION FEASIBILITY - MASK PCA / SOURCE FRAMES", (20, 45), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .75, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(pilot.SOURCE_VIDEO))
+    for index, control in enumerate(controls):
+        top = 75 + index * 260
+        cv2.putText(image, f'{control["role"]} | {control["text"]} | {control["verdict"]}', (15, top + 20), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .52, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        series = control["series"]
+        picks = [series[0], series[len(series)//2], series[-1]]
+        for col, row in enumerate(picks):
+            capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, row["source_frame"]); ok, frame = capture.read()
+            if ok:
+                x1, y1, x2, y2 = row["bbox"]; cv2.rectangle(frame, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), (0, 220, 255), 3)
+                thumb = cv2.resize(frame, (300, 169), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA); x = 15 + col * 320
+                image[top+35:top+204, x:x+300] = thumb
+                cv2.putText(image, f'F{row["source_frame"]} {row["angle_degrees"]:.2f} deg', (x, top+225), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .4, (20,20,20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        chart_x, chart_y, chart_w, chart_h = 1000, top + 35, 470, 170
+        cv2.rectangle(image, (chart_x, chart_y), (chart_x+chart_w, chart_y+chart_h), (160,160,160), 1)
+        lo, hi = min(r["angle_degrees"] for r in series), max(r["angle_degrees"] for r in series); spread=max(.25, hi-lo)
+        points=[(chart_x+round(i*chart_w/max(1,len(series)-1)), chart_y+chart_h-10-round((r["angle_degrees"]-lo)/spread*(chart_h-20))) for i,r in enumerate(series)]
+        cv2.polylines(image, [np.asarray(points,np.int32)], False, (180,50,40), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        cv2.putText(image, f'span={control["metrics"]["span_degrees"]:.3f} corr={control["metrics"]["correlation"]:.3f} rmse={control["metrics"]["linear_rmse_degrees"]:.3f}', (1000, top+230), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (20,20,20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture.release(); ok, encoded=cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok: raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def build() -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    freeze = freeze_evidence(); inventory = mechanism_inventory()
+    static, timing, glyphs = load(STATIC_CONTRACT), load(TIMING_CONTRACT), load(GLYPH_EVIDENCE)
+    text_by = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row["identity"].get("text_diagnostic_only") or "" for row in static["identities"]}
+    timing_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in timing["identities"]}; glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyphs["identities"]}
+    candidates=[]
+    for identity,glyph in glyph_by.items():
+        series=orientation_series(glyph); metrics=rotation_metrics(series); verdict=classify_rotation(metrics)
+        if series: candidates.append({"identity":identity,"text":text_by.get(identity,""),"series":series,"metrics":metrics,"verdict":verdict})
+    six=max((row for row in candidates if row["text"]=="6000"), key=lambda row: row["metrics"]["sample_count"])
+    dynamic=max((row for row in candidates if row["verdict"]=="DYNAMIC_ROTATION_SUPPORTED"), key=lambda row: row["metrics"]["span_degrees"])
+    stable=min((row for row in candidates if row["verdict"]=="STATIC_TILT_ONLY" and row["text"]!="6000"), key=lambda row: (-row["metrics"]["sample_count"], row["metrics"]["span_degrees"]))
+    controls=[{**six,"role":"6000_REQUIRED_CONTROL"},{**stable,"role":"NON_ROTATING_CONTROL"},{**dynamic,"role":"STRONGEST_DYNAMIC_CANDIDATE"}]
+    capture=cv2.VideoCapture(str(pilot.SOURCE_VIDEO))
+    for control in controls: control["full_lifetime_reuse_probe"]=tracking_probe(control["identity"],glyph_by[control["identity"]],timing_by[control["identity"]],capture)
+    capture.release()
+    step4b=load(ROOT / load(STEP4B_FREEZE)["frozen_step4b_authority"]["motion_ir_contract"]["path"])
+    continuation_count=sum(bool(row.get("continues_beyond_boundary")) for row in step4b["records"])
+    ok=len(timing["identities"])==113 and continuation_count==27 and six["verdict"]=="STATIC_TILT_ONLY" and bool(dynamic)
+    result="PASS_STEP_4C_EXISTING_MECHANISM_AND_ROTATION_FEASIBILITY" if ok else "BLOCKED_STEP_4C_ROTATION_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT"
+    evidence={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_rotation_feasibility","schema_version":1,"result":result,"method":"PCA_MAJOR_AXIS_OF_ACCEPTED_CAPTION_MASKS","gate":{"minimum_samples":4,"minimum_span_degrees":2.0,"minimum_absolute_frame_angle_correlation":0.9,"maximum_linear_rmse_degrees":0.5,"maximum_background_contamination":0.2},"controls":controls,"6000_verdict":six["verdict"]}
+    investigation={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_existing_mechanism_investigation","schema_version":1,"result":result,"freeze_integrity":freeze,"identity_count":len(timing["identities"]),"step4b_continues_beyond_boundary_count":continuation_count,"existing_mechanism_sufficient":"PARTIAL","mechanisms":inventory,"motion_ir_reuse_status":"REUSE_TRACKER_SCALE_VISIBILITY_AND_NORMALIZATION_ADAPT_TEMPORAL_WINDOW","resolve_mutated":False,"step4d_started":False}
+    report=(f"RESULT: {result}\n\nSTATE\n- Step 3, Step 4A, and Step 4B freezes are intact.\n- Existing mechanism sufficient: PARTIAL; Step 4B measurement code is reusable.\n- 6000 verdict: {six['verdict']} ({six['metrics']['span_degrees']:.3f} degree span).\n\nCHANGED\n- Added read-only investigation tooling and immutable evidence only.\n\nVERIFIED\n- 113 identities and 27 Step 4B continuation records observed.\n- Resolve untouched; Step 4D not started.\n\nNEXT\n- Build the editor-neutral Step 4C whole-reel dynamic-transform contract from the reused measurement layer.\n\nRISK\n- Human review remains required for rotation and trajectory fidelity.\n").encode()
+    return {"step4c_existing_mechanism_investigation.json":json_bytes(investigation),"step4c_rotation_feasibility.json":json_bytes(evidence),"step4c_rotation_feasibility_diagnostic.jpg":render_diagnostic(controls),"FINAL_REPORT.md":report}
+
+
+def generate(output: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists(): raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first,second=build(),build(); identical=first==second
+    if not identical: raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic investigation")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name,data in first.items(): (output/name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof={"schema":"video_cloner_step4c_feasibility_determinism","schema_version":1,"rerun_byte_identical":identical,"artifact_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name,data in first.items()}}
+    (output/"determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"output":str(output),"result":load(output/"step4c_rotation_feasibility.json")["result"]}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--output-dir",required=True,type=Path); args=parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()),sort_keys=True)); return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,266 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Read-only, hypothesis-neutral Step 4D necessity investigation."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+FREEZES = {
+    ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_static_caption_freeze.json": "37ecd1438cd55b03cdb85b437131f0cafab322c85024ced41a00f01e69317601",
+    ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_timing_persistence_freeze.json": "e3934346a227e81a83e9c21e83860fcbf43a59f57a5b29752c149875749ccc23",
+    ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4b_motion_ir_freeze.json": "414b3fa823297b060eeb719e94154e222420cca8b270efbe7bce4d184fe18b65",
+    ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4c_dynamic_transforms_freeze.json": "64f1493ec24f54968f90a66bc72b8346c5cf1af8acbc8a5661f02df7c800a54f",
+}
+STATIC = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2F_FONT_AUTHORITY_CALIBRATION_20260927/20260927T020000000Z_calibrated/whole_reel_static_style_contract_calibrated.json"
+GLYPHS = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_mask_isolation_corrected.json"
+COMPOSITION = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2E_COMPOSITION_RELATIONSHIPS_20260925/20260925T220000000Z_source_graph/step2e_composition_relationships.json"
+LEGACY_STYLE = ROOT / "data/DcJRJtUKScu/analysis/DcJRJtUKScu_caption_style.json"
+SOURCE = ROOT / "input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4"
+CLASSES = ("shadow", "glow", "texture", "gradient", "clipping", "caption_occlusion")
+ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATIONS = {"SOURCE_REQUIRED", "ALREADY_SOLVED", "POSSIBLE_BUT_UNPROVEN", "NOT_PRESENT", "NON_CAPTION_VFX", "UNSUPPORTED"}
+ALLOWED_IDENTITY_STATUSES = {"NO_ADVANCED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE", "ADVANCED_EFFECT_CANDIDATE", "SOURCE_REQUIRED_ADVANCED_EFFECT", "UNRESOLVED_ADVANCED_EFFECT", "NON_CAPTION_VFX", "UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_REQUIRED_EFFECT"}
+THRESHOLDS = {"shadow": .12, "glow": .10, "texture": .10, "gradient": .08, "clipping": .18, "caption_occlusion": .20}
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def decode(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    flat = np.zeros(int(np.prod(shape)), np.uint8)
+    for start, length in runs:
+        flat[int(start):int(start) + int(length)] = 255
+    return flat.reshape(shape)
+
+
+def freeze_integrity() -> dict:
+    actual = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"): sha256(path) for path in FREEZES}
+    if any(sha256(path) != expected for path, expected in FREEZES.items()):
+        raise RuntimeError("frozen authority drift")
+    return {"status": "PASS", "hashes": actual}
+
+
+def mechanism_inventory(legacy: dict, composition: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
+    groups = legacy["subtitle_groups"]
+    collision = {
+        "group_count": len(groups),
+        "has_shadow_count": sum(bool(row.get("has_shadow")) for row in groups),
+        "has_dark_stroke_count": sum(bool(row.get("has_dark_stroke")) for row in groups),
+        "same_shadow_and_stroke_color_count": sum(row.get("estimated_shadow_color") == row.get("estimated_stroke_color") for row in groups),
+        "verdict": "UNSAFE_STROKE_DARK_EDGE_CONFLATED_WITH_SHADOW",
+    }
+    mechanisms = [
+        {"mechanism": "legacy caption shadow heuristic", "path": str(LEGACY_STYLE.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "classification": "UNSAFE", "evidence": collision},
+        {"mechanism": "frozen ordinary fill/stroke authority", "path": str(STATIC.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "classification": "ALREADY_FROZEN"},
+        {"mechanism": "accepted glyph ownership masks", "path": str(GLYPHS.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "classification": "REUSE_FOR_CANDIDATE_DISCOVERY_ONLY"},
+        {"mechanism": "composition overlap and z-order graph", "path": str(COMPOSITION.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "classification": "ALREADY_FROZEN", "evidence": {"proven_overlap_relationships": composition["summary"]["overlap_relationships"], "authoritative_z_order_relationships": composition["summary"]["authoritative_z_order_relationships"], "ownership_candidates_not_promoted": composition["summary"]["ownership_interaction_candidates_not_promoted_to_overlap"]}},
+        {"mechanism": "historical Reel 1 foreground RGBA occlusion", "path": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_PHASE4C2_ACCEPTED_OCCLUSION_V4_INTEGRATION", "classification": "REEL_SPECIFIC_NON_CAPTION_VFX"},
+        {"mechanism": "historical flash transitions", "path": ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_PHASE4C1_ACCEPTED_FLASH_V4_INTEGRATION", "classification": "NON_CAPTION_VFX"},
+    ]
+    return mechanisms, collision
+
+
+def shift(mask: np.ndarray, dx: int, dy: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    result = np.zeros_like(mask)
+    ys = slice(max(0, dy), mask.shape[0] + min(0, dy))
+    xs = slice(max(0, dx), mask.shape[1] + min(0, dx))
+    source_y = slice(max(0, -dy), mask.shape[0] - max(0, dy))
+    source_x = slice(max(0, -dx), mask.shape[1] - max(0, dx))
+    result[ys, xs] = mask[source_y, source_x]
+    return result
+
+
+def representative_observations(row: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    accepted = [item for item in row.get("observations", []) if item.get("accepted")]
+    if len(accepted) <= 3:
+        return accepted
+    return [accepted[0], accepted[len(accepted) // 2], accepted[-1]]
+
+
+def observation_metrics(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, row: dict, observation: dict) -> dict:
+    capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, int(observation["source_frame"]))
+    ok, frame = capture.read()
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"source frame unavailable: {observation['source_frame']}")
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, observation["bbox"])
+    h, w = max(1, y2-y1), max(1, x2-x1)
+    pad = max(8, round(h * .5))
+    rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 = max(0, x1-pad), max(0, y1-pad), min(frame.shape[1], x2+pad), min(frame.shape[0], y2+pad)
+    roi = frame[ry1:ry2, rx1:rx2]
+    mask = np.zeros(roi.shape[:2], np.uint8)
+    resized = cv2.resize(decode(row["final_mask_shape"], row["final_mask_rle"]), (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
+    ox, oy = x1-rx1, y1-ry1
+    mask[oy:oy+h, ox:ox+w] = resized
+    radius = max(1, round(min(h, w) * .035))
+    broad = max(radius+2, round(min(h, w) * .12))
+    small_kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (radius*2+1, radius*2+1))
+    broad_kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (broad*2+1, broad*2+1))
+    dilated = cv2.dilate(mask, small_kernel) > 0
+    broad_dilated = cv2.dilate(mask, broad_kernel) > 0
+    core = cv2.erode(mask, small_kernel) > 0
+    if np.count_nonzero(core) < 20:
+        core = mask > 0
+    gray = cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
+    background = ~broad_dilated
+    background_level = float(np.median(gray[background])) if np.any(background) else float(np.median(gray))
+    offsets = [(dx, dy) for dy in range(-broad, broad+1, max(1, broad//2)) for dx in range(-broad, broad+1, max(1, broad//2)) if dx or dy]
+    shadow_scores = []
+    for dx, dy in offsets:
+        displaced = (shift(mask, dx, dy) > 0) & ~dilated
+        if np.count_nonzero(displaced) >= 20:
+            shadow_scores.append(max(0.0, (background_level - float(np.mean(gray[displaced]))) / 255.0))
+    narrow_ring = dilated & ~(mask > 0)
+    broad_ring = broad_dilated & ~dilated
+    narrow_brightness = float(np.mean(gray[narrow_ring])) if np.any(narrow_ring) else background_level
+    broad_brightness = float(np.mean(gray[broad_ring])) if np.any(broad_ring) else background_level
+    glow = max(0.0, ((narrow_brightness + broad_brightness) / 2.0 - background_level) / 255.0)
+    yy, xx = np.nonzero(core)
+    values = gray[core]
+    if len(values) >= 20:
+        design = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(values)), xx / max(1, roi.shape[1]-1), yy / max(1, roi.shape[0]-1)))
+        fit = design @ np.linalg.lstsq(design, values, rcond=None)[0]
+        total = float(np.sum((values-values.mean())**2))
+        gradient = (1.0-float(np.sum((values-fit)**2))/total if total > 1e-6 else 0.0) * float(np.ptp(fit)) / 255.0
+        texture = float(np.std(values-fit)) / 255.0
+    else:
+        gradient = texture = 0.0
+    clipping = 0.0
+    if observation.get("estimated_mask_rle"):
+        observed = decode(observation["estimated_mask_shape"], observation["estimated_mask_rle"]) > 0
+        canonical = decode(row["final_mask_shape"], row["final_mask_rle"]) > 0
+        if observed.shape != canonical.shape:
+            observed = cv2.resize(observed.astype(np.uint8), (canonical.shape[1], canonical.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0
+        clipping = max(0.0, 1.0 - np.count_nonzero(observed & canonical) / max(1, np.count_nonzero(canonical)))
+    return {"source_frame": int(observation["source_frame"]), "bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "background_contamination": round(float(observation.get("background_contamination") or 0), 6), "shadow": round(max(shadow_scores, default=0.0), 6), "glow": round(glow, 6), "gradient": round(max(0.0, gradient), 6), "texture": round(texture, 6), "clipping": round(clipping, 6)}
+
+
+def identity_evidence(row: dict, capture: cv2.VideoCapture) -> dict:
+    observations = [observation_metrics(capture, row, item) for item in representative_observations(row)]
+    scores = {name: max((item[name] for item in observations), default=0.0) for name in ("shadow", "glow", "gradient", "texture", "clipping")}
+    scores["caption_occlusion"] = max(float(row.get("overlap_risk") or 0), float(row.get("overlap_occlusion_ratio") or 0))
+    quality = max(0.0, 1.0-float(row.get("contamination_score") or 0))
+    best = min(observations, key=lambda item: (item["background_contamination"], item["source_frame"])) if observations else None
+    candidates = [name for name in CLASSES if best and scores[name] >= THRESHOLDS[name]]
+    return {"identity": row["identity"], "status": "ADVANCED_EFFECT_CANDIDATE" if candidates else "NO_ADVANCED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE", "candidate_classes": candidates, "scores": {key: round(value, 6) for key, value in scores.items()}, "evidence_quality": round(quality, 6), "representative_source": {"source_frame": best["source_frame"], "bbox": best["bbox"]} if best else None, "observations": observations, "provenance": [str(GLYPHS.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), str(SOURCE.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")]}
+
+
+def classify_effects(records: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    results = {}
+    for effect in CLASSES:
+        candidates = sorted((row for row in records if effect in row["candidate_classes"]), key=lambda row: (-row["scores"][effect], -row["evidence_quality"], row["identity"]))
+        strongest = candidates[0] if candidates else None
+        classification = "POSSIBLE_BUT_UNPROVEN" if candidates else "NOT_PRESENT"
+        results[effect] = {
+            "classification": classification,
+            "candidate_count": len(candidates),
+            "strongest_candidate": strongest["identity"] if strongest else None,
+            "strongest_score": strongest["scores"][effect] if strongest else 0.0,
+            "evidence_quality": strongest["evidence_quality"] if strongest else None,
+            "reason": "candidate heuristic surfaced source examples; human adjudication required" if candidates else "no meaningful candidate found by bounded source search",
+            "evidence_for": ([{"identity": row["identity"], "score": row["scores"][effect], "source": row["representative_source"], "provenance": row["provenance"]} for row in candidates[:3]]),
+            "evidence_against": "candidate metric is non-authoritative and may reflect stroke, contamination, antialiasing, compression, motion, or background",
+        }
+    results["shadow"]["reason"] += "; legacy shadow heuristic remains unsafe and supplies no authority"
+    results["clipping"]["evidence_against"] += "; Step 4B/4C visibility and partial ownership are not mask-reveal proof"
+    results["caption_occlusion"]["evidence_against"] += "; frozen graph has zero proven overlap and zero authoritative z-order"
+    return results
+
+
+def select_review(records: list[dict], effects: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    by_id = {row["identity"]: row for row in records}
+    selected: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    for effect in CLASSES:
+        identity = effects[effect]["strongest_candidate"]
+        if identity:
+            selected.append((identity, f"STRONGEST_{effect.upper()}_CANDIDATE"))
+    negatives = sorted((row for row in records if not row["candidate_classes"] and row["representative_source"]), key=lambda row: (-row["evidence_quality"], row["identity"]))[:3]
+    selected.extend((row["identity"], "HIGH_QUALITY_NEGATIVE_CONTROL") for row in negatives)
+    ambiguities = sorted((row for row in records if row["representative_source"]), key=lambda row: (row["evidence_quality"], row["identity"]))[:2]
+    selected.extend((row["identity"], "HIGH_CONTAMINATION_AMBIGUITY_CONTROL") for row in ambiguities)
+    merged: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for identity, role in selected:
+        merged.setdefault(identity, []).append(role)
+    if len(merged) < 8:
+        for row in sorted((row for row in records if row["representative_source"]), key=lambda row: (-max(row["scores"].values()), row["identity"])):
+            merged.setdefault(row["identity"], ["ADDITIONAL_STRONG_SOURCE_CANDIDATE"])
+            if len(merged) >= 8:
+                break
+    return [{**by_id[identity], "review_roles": roles} for identity, roles in list(merged.items())[:15]]
+
+
+def render(review: list[dict], glyph_by: dict[str, dict]) -> bytes:
+    image = np.full((80+len(review)*255, 1500, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4D UNBIASED NECESSITY CANDIDATES - SOURCE / GLYPH MASK", (20, 42), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .72, (20,20,20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(SOURCE))
+    for index, case in enumerate(review):
+        top = 70+index*255; source = case["representative_source"]
+        capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, source["source_frame"]); ok, frame = capture.read()
+        if not ok: raise RuntimeError(f"source frame unavailable: {source['source_frame']}")
+        x1,y1,x2,y2 = source["bbox"]; pad=max(10,round((y2-y1)*.7))
+        crop=frame[max(0,y1-pad):min(frame.shape[0],y2+pad),max(0,x1-pad):min(frame.shape[1],x2+pad)]
+        image[top+38:top+228,15:615]=cv2.resize(crop,(600,190),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+        glyph=glyph_by[case["identity"]]; mask=decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"],glyph["final_mask_rle"])
+        image[top+38:top+228,640:1240]=cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(mask,(600,190),interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST),cv2.COLOR_GRAY2BGR)
+        heading=f'{case["identity"]} | {" + ".join(case["review_roles"])} | F{source["source_frame"]}'
+        cv2.putText(image,heading[:180],(15,top+21),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.4,(20,20,20),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+        details=f'candidates={case["candidate_classes"]} quality={case["evidence_quality"]}'
+        cv2.putText(image,details[:90],(1255,top+90),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.3,(30,30,30),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+        for line_no,(name,value) in enumerate(case["scores"].items()):
+            cv2.putText(image,f'{name}: {value:.3f}',(1255,top+112+line_no*18),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.3,(30,30,30),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture.release(); ok, encoded=cv2.imencode(".jpg",image,[cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY,92])
+    if not ok: raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def build() -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    freezes=freeze_integrity(); static,glyphs,composition,legacy=load(STATIC),load(GLYPHS),load(COMPOSITION),load(LEGACY_STYLE)
+    static_ids=[row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in static["identities"]]; glyph_by={row["identity"]:row for row in glyphs["identities"]}
+    if len(static_ids)!=113 or len(set(static_ids))!=113 or set(static_ids)!=set(glyph_by): raise RuntimeError("113-identity accounting failed")
+    mechanisms,collision=mechanism_inventory(legacy,composition)
+    capture=cv2.VideoCapture(str(SOURCE)); records=[identity_evidence(glyph_by[identity],capture) for identity in static_ids]; capture.release()
+    effects=classify_effects(records); review=select_review(records,effects)
+    class_counts=Counter(row["classification"] for row in effects.values()); identity_counts=Counter(row["status"] for row in records)
+    result="PASS_STEP_4D_NECESSITY_INVESTIGATION_READY_FOR_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION"
+    summary={name.lower():class_counts.get(name,0) for name in ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATIONS}
+    audit={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_effect_necessity_audit","schema_version":2,"result":result,"methodology":"BOUNDED_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_HYPOTHESIS_RANKING_FOR_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION","identity_accounting":{"expected":113,"produced":len(records),"missing":[],"duplicates":0},"effect_classes":effects,"records":records,"identity_classification_counts":dict(identity_counts),"summary":summary,"human_adjudication_required":True}
+    validation={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_necessity_investigation_validation","schema_version":2,"ok":all(row["classification"] in ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATIONS for row in effects.values()),"result":result,"freeze_integrity":freezes,"legacy_shadow_systematic_defect":collision,"source_required_evidence_complete":all(row["evidence_for"] and all(item.get("provenance") for item in row["evidence_for"]) for row in effects.values() if row["classification"]=="SOURCE_REQUIRED"),"production_effect_mechanisms_added":0,"resolve_mutated":False,"later_non_caption_vfx_started":False}
+    review_data={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_review_data","schema_version":2,"selection_policy":"strongest_candidate_per_effect_plus_high_quality_negatives_and_high_contamination_ambiguities","cases":review}
+    manifest={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_review_manifest","schema_version":2,"result":result,"selection_policy":review_data["selection_policy"],"case_count":len(review),"cases":[{"identity":row["identity"],"roles":row["review_roles"]} for row in review],"human_review_required":True}
+    artifacts={"step4d_existing_mechanism_inventory.json":json_bytes({"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_existing_mechanism_inventory","schema_version":2,"result":result,"mechanisms":mechanisms}),"step4d_effect_necessity_audit.json":json_bytes(audit),"step4d_necessity_investigation_validation.json":json_bytes(validation),"step4d_review_manifest.json":json_bytes(manifest),"step4d_review_data.json":json_bytes(review_data),"step4d_review_diagnostic.jpg":render(review,glyph_by)}
+    artifacts["FINAL_REPORT.md"]=(f"RESULT: {result}\n\nSTATE\n- Four upstream freezes intact; 113 identities independently classified.\n- Effect-class counts are evidence-derived: {json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True)}.\n- Legacy shadow heuristic remains unsafe and supplies no authority.\n\nCHANGED\n- Added read-only candidate-ranking investigation and one methodology test.\n\nVERIFIED\n- Review cases: {len(review)}; production effect mechanisms: 0.\n- Resolve untouched; Step 6 not started.\n\nNEXT\n- Human-review the strongest per-class candidates and adjudicate material necessity.\n\nRISK\n- Candidate scores are intentionally non-authoritative; no effect is source-required without human/source adjudication.\n").encode()
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists(): raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first,second=build(),build()
+    if first!=second: raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic investigation")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name,data in first.items(): (output/name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_necessity_determinism","schema_version":2,"rerun_byte_identical":True,"artifact_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name,data in first.items()}}
+    (output/"determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"output":str(output),"result":load(output/"step4d_effect_necessity_audit.json")["result"]}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--output-dir",required=True,type=Path); args=parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()),sort_keys=True)); return 0
+
+
+if __name__=="__main__": raise SystemExit(main())
+
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/investigate_step4d_caption_occlusion.py b/scripts/analysis/investigate_step4d_caption_occlusion.py
new file mode 100644
