@@ -0,0 +1,407 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Adjudicate bounded Step 4D caption-occlusion evidence without rendering."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import investigate_step4d_effect_evidence_validity as gate
+
+CONTRACT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_BOUNDED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_REPAIR_20260927_V3/20260928T000500000Z_human_review_ready/step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract.json"
+SHADOW_FREEZE = ROOT / ".agent/state/video_cloner_step4d_shadow_freeze.json"
+SHADOW_FREEZE_SHA256 = "bf788d25e02607e34a08b27a40005c5047906247bcce6cf8601d3b7ace9e11e8"
+HISTORICAL = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_PHASE4C2_ACCEPTED_OCCLUSION_V4_INTEGRATION/20260818T161210850Z_a881603cc00b44fbb812313196448885"
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def decode(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    return gate.prior.decode(shape, runs) > 0
+
+
+def encode(mask: np.ndarray) -> list[list[int]]:
+    flat = mask.reshape(-1).astype(np.uint8)
+    changes = np.flatnonzero(np.pad(flat, (1, 1))[1:] != np.pad(flat, (1, 1))[:-1])
+    return [[int(start), int(end - start)] for start, end in changes.reshape(-1, 2)]
+
+
+def expected_mask(glyph: dict, frame_number: int, bbox: list[int], shape: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = bbox
+    observation = next((row for row in glyph.get("observations", []) if int(row["source_frame"]) == frame_number), None)
+    if observation and observation.get("estimated_mask_rle"):
+        mask = decode(observation["estimated_mask_shape"], observation["estimated_mask_rle"])
+        source = "accepted_same_frame_glyph_observation"
+    else:
+        mask = decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph["final_mask_rle"])
+        source = "accepted_identity_canonical_glyph"
+    resized = cv2.resize(mask.astype(np.uint8), (max(1, x2 - x1), max(1, y2 - y1)), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0
+    result = np.zeros(shape, bool)
+    result[y1:y2, x1:x2] = resized[: y2 - y1, : x2 - x1]
+    return result, source
+
+
+def normalized_iou(rows: list[dict], key: str) -> float | None:
+    masks = []
+    for row in rows:
+        x1, y1, x2, y2 = row["target_bbox_in_roi"]
+        mask = row[key][y1:y2, x1:x2].astype(np.uint8)
+        masks.append(cv2.resize(mask, (256, 96), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0)
+    scores = [np.count_nonzero(a & b) / max(1, np.count_nonzero(a | b)) for a, b in zip(masks, masks[1:])]
+    return round(float(np.median(scores)), 6) if scores else None
+
+
+def source_rois(contract_case: dict, glyph: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(gate.SOURCE))
+    rows = []
+    try:
+        for record in contract_case["target_foreground"]["frames"]:
+            frame_number = int(record["source_frame"])
+            capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_number)
+            ok, frame = capture.read()
+            if not ok:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"source frame unavailable: {frame_number}")
+            rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 = record["target_roi"]
+            raw = frame[ry1:ry2, rx1:rx2].copy()
+            shape = record["shape"]
+            expected, expected_source = expected_mask(glyph, frame_number, record["target_bbox_in_roi"], shape)
+            visible = decode(shape, record["target_foreground_rle"])
+            unknown = decode(shape, record["unknown_region_rle"])
+            foreign = decode(shape, record["foreign_object_region_rle"])
+            missing = expected & ~visible
+            missing_observed = missing & ~unknown
+            overlap = missing_observed & foreign
+            rows.append({
+                "source_frame": frame_number,
+                "target_roi": record["target_roi"],
+                "target_bbox_in_roi": record["target_bbox_in_roi"],
+                "raw": raw,
+                "expected": expected,
+                "expected_source": expected_source,
+                "visible": visible,
+                "unknown": unknown,
+                "foreign": foreign,
+                "missing": missing,
+                "missing_observed": missing_observed,
+                "overlap": overlap,
+                "metrics": {
+                    "expected_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(expected)),
+                    "visible_expected_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(expected & visible)),
+                    "missing_expected_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(missing)),
+                    "unknown_expected_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(expected & unknown)),
+                    "candidate_overlap_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(overlap)),
+                },
+            })
+    finally:
+        capture.release()
+    return rows
+
+
+def public_case(contract_case: dict, glyph: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
+    rows = source_rois(contract_case, glyph)
+    totals = {key: sum(row["metrics"][key] for row in rows) for key in rows[0]["metrics"]}
+    expected_pixels = max(1, totals["expected_pixels"])
+    missing_pixels = max(1, totals["missing_expected_pixels"])
+    temporal_iou = normalized_iou(rows, "foreign")
+    stages = ("EARLY_SAMPLE_NOT_PROVEN_BEFORE", "MIDDLE_SAMPLE_NOT_PROVEN_DURING", "LATE_SAMPLE_NOT_PROVEN_AFTER")
+    evidence = {
+        "caption_identity": contract_case["identity"],
+        "frames": [row["source_frame"] for row in rows],
+        "frame_evidence": [{
+            "source_frame": row["source_frame"], "temporal_stage": stages[min(index, 2)],
+            "target_roi": row["target_roi"], "target_bbox_in_roi": row["target_bbox_in_roi"], "shape": list(row["expected"].shape),
+            "expected_caption_region_rle": encode(row["expected"]), "visible_caption_region_rle": encode(row["visible"]),
+            "missing_expected_region_rle": encode(row["missing_observed"]), "unknown_region_rle": encode(row["unknown"]),
+            "candidate_occluder_region_rle": encode(row["foreign"]), "candidate_intersection_rle": encode(row["overlap"]),
+            "metrics": row["metrics"],
+        } for index, row in enumerate(rows)],
+        "expected_caption_region": {
+            "status": "TASK_LOCAL_ESTIMATE_FROM_FROZEN_GLYPH_AND_TRACKED_BBOX",
+            "sources": sorted({row["expected_source"] for row in rows}),
+            "confidence": "MEDIUM",
+        },
+        "visible_caption_region": {
+            "status": "SOURCE_DERIVED_TRI_STATE_PARTIAL_OBSERVATION",
+            "visible_expected_ratio": round(totals["visible_expected_pixels"] / expected_pixels, 6),
+            "confidence": "LOW_DUE_TO_ACCEPTED_REPAIR_CONTAMINATION",
+        },
+        "missing_expected_caption_region": {
+            "status": "CANDIDATE_ONLY_NOT_OCCLUSION_PROOF",
+            "missing_expected_ratio": round(totals["missing_expected_pixels"] / expected_pixels, 6),
+            "unknown_expected_ratio": round(totals["unknown_expected_pixels"] / expected_pixels, 6),
+        },
+        "candidate_occluder_region": {
+            "status": "SOURCE_DERIVED_FOREIGN_PIXELS_UNOWNED",
+            "overlap_with_missing_ratio": round(totals["candidate_overlap_pixels"] / missing_pixels, 6),
+            "ownership": "OWNERSHIP_UNRESOLVED",
+            "ownership_class": "UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_CONTENT_POSSIBLY_OTHER_TEXT_OR_BACKGROUND",
+            "confidence": "LOW",
+        },
+        "temporal_overlap": {
+            "status": "THREE_ORDERED_SOURCE_SAMPLES_NO_PROVEN_BEFORE_DURING_AFTER",
+            "foreign_region_normalized_median_iou": temporal_iou,
+            "confidence": "LOW",
+        },
+        "motion_consistency": "UNSUPPORTED_NO_OWNED_OBJECT_TRACK",
+        "z_order": {"relation": "NO_FRONT_BACK_PROOF", "authority": "UNRESOLVED"},
+        "competing_explanations": [
+            "partial_tracklet_or_glyph_observation_failure",
+            "another_caption_or_text_vfx_layer",
+            "lifecycle_or_dynamic_transform",
+            "blur_compression_or_background_contamination",
+        ],
+        "conditions": {
+            "expected_geometry_sufficient": False,
+            "missing_region_source_observed": True,
+            "coherent_foreign_object_owned": False,
+            "temporal_relationship_supported": False,
+            "object_in_front_supported": False,
+            "competing_explanations_rejected": False,
+            "generic_source_derived_evidence": True,
+        },
+        "narrow_reasons": ["OCCLUDER_OWNERSHIP_UNSUPPORTED", "Z_ORDER_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE"],
+        "verdict": "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE",
+        "confidence": "HIGH_FOR_UNSUPPORTED_NOT_FOR_EFFECT_ABSENCE",
+        "provenance": contract_case["provenance"] + [str(CONTRACT.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")],
+    }
+    return evidence, rows
+
+
+def historical_positive_control() -> dict:
+    base = HISTORICAL / "generated_pixel_restore_v3"
+    glyphs = {path.stem.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]: path for path in (base / "glyph_masks").glob("*.png")}
+    persons = {path.stem.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]: path for path in (base / "person_masks").glob("*.png")}
+    overlaps = []
+    for key in sorted(glyphs.keys() & persons.keys()):
+        glyph = cv2.imread(str(glyphs[key]), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) > 0
+        person = cv2.imread(str(persons[key]), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) > 0
+        if glyph.shape != person.shape:
+            person = cv2.resize(person.astype(np.uint8), (glyph.shape[1], glyph.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0
+        pixels = int(np.count_nonzero(glyph & person))
+        if pixels:
+            overlaps.append(pixels)
+    validation = load(HISTORICAL / "validation.json")
+    passed = bool(validation.get("ok")) and len(overlaps) >= 2 and "V4 foreground pixel restore" in validation["matte"]["layer_order"]
+    return {
+        "result": "PASS_HISTORICAL_ACCEPTED_OWNED_MASK_OVERLAP_RECOGNIZED" if passed else "UNAVAILABLE_OR_INCOMPATIBLE",
+        "scope": "FIXTURE_ONLY_NOT_REEL2_AUTHORITY",
+        "paired_frame_count": len(glyphs.keys() & persons.keys()),
+        "positive_overlap_frame_count": len(overlaps),
+        "accepted_front_layer_verified": bool(passed),
+    }
+
+
+def mechanisms() -> dict:
+    return {
+        "REUSE": [
+            "frozen glyph shape and tracked bbox for task-local expected geometry",
+            "bounded source-frame extraction and tri-state visible/UNKNOWN/foreign ROI records",
+            "connected mask overlap and deterministic temporal comparison primitives",
+        ],
+        "ADAPT": ["caption-relative three-sample diagnostic and fail-closed seven-condition occlusion gate"],
+        "HISTORICAL_ONLY": ["Reel #1 person masks, RGBA pixel restore, and accepted editor layer order"],
+        "UNSAFE": [
+            "missing glyph pixels as occlusion authority",
+            "Step 2E proximity candidates as front/back authority",
+            "general human segmentation or video matting for this bounded adjudication",
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def panel(mask: np.ndarray, color: tuple[int, int, int], raw: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
+    image = np.zeros((*mask.shape, 3), np.uint8) if raw is None else raw.copy()
+    image[mask] = color if raw is None else (0.35 * image[mask] + 0.65 * np.array(color)).astype(np.uint8)
+    return image
+
+
+def render(cases: list[dict], rows_by_identity: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> bytes:
+    width, panel_w, panel_h = 1940, 220, 145
+    image = np.full((130 + len(cases) * 245, width, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+    headers = ["SOURCE EARLY", "SOURCE MIDDLE", "SOURCE LATE", "EXPECTED", "VISIBLE", "MISSING", "CANDIDATE", "FINAL OVERLAY"]
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4D CAPTION OCCLUSION - BOUNDED OWNERSHIP / Z-ORDER EVIDENCE", (16, 28), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .62, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    cv2.putText(image, "Legend: expected=cyan visible=green missing=amber candidate=red intersection=magenta UNKNOWN=blue", (16, 54), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .42, (30, 30, 30), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    for index, title in enumerate(headers):
+        cv2.putText(image, title, (15 + index * 240, 90), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .36, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    top = 105
+    for case in cases:
+        rows = rows_by_identity[case["caption_identity"]]
+        middle = rows[len(rows) // 2]
+        source_panels = [row["raw"] for row in rows]
+        while len(source_panels) < 3:
+            source_panels.append(source_panels[-1])
+        expected = panel(middle["expected"], (255, 220, 40))
+        visible = panel(middle["visible"], (40, 220, 40)); visible[middle["unknown"]] = (220, 100, 20)
+        missing = panel(middle["missing_observed"], (0, 190, 255)); missing[middle["unknown"] & middle["expected"]] = (220, 100, 20)
+        candidate = panel(middle["foreign"], (40, 40, 220))
+        overlay = middle["raw"].copy()
+        for mask, color in ((middle["expected"], (255, 220, 40)), (middle["visible"], (40, 220, 40)), (middle["foreign"], (40, 40, 220)), (middle["overlap"], (220, 40, 220))):
+            overlay[mask] = (0.45 * overlay[mask] + 0.55 * np.array(color)).astype(np.uint8)
+        for index, content in enumerate(source_panels[:3] + [expected, visible, missing, candidate, overlay]):
+            image[top:top + panel_h, 15 + index * 240:15 + index * 240 + panel_w] = cv2.resize(content, (panel_w, panel_h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+        meta = f'{case["caption_identity"]} | frames {case["frames"]} | ownership UNRESOLVED | temporal stages UNPROVEN | z-order NO PROOF | {case["verdict"]}'
+        cv2.putText(image, meta, (15, top + panel_h + 20), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .38, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        cv2.putText(image, "Competing: mask/tracklet failure; other text/VFX; lifecycle/transform; blur/compression/background", (15, top + panel_h + 41), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, .34, (45, 45, 45), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+        top += 245
+    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def final_report(evidence: dict, validation: dict) -> bytes:
+    lines = [
+        f"RESULT: {validation['result']}", "", "REPOSITORY_STATE: expected root / branch / HEAD verified; accepted dirty state preserved",
+        "FREEZE_INTEGRITY: PASS", "SHADOW_FREEZE_STATUS: COMPLETE_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION",
+        "CURRENT_STEP_4D_STATUS: IN_PROGRESS_NOT_FROZEN", "", "EXISTING_OCCLUSION_MECHANISMS",
+    ]
+    for classification, values in evidence["existing_occlusion_mechanisms"].items():
+        lines.append(f"- {classification}: {'; '.join(values)}")
+    lines.extend(["", "BOUNDED_CANDIDATES"])
+    for case in evidence["cases"]:
+        lines.extend([
+            "", f"IDENTITY: {case['caption_identity']}", f"SOURCE_FRAMES: {case['frames']}",
+            f"EXPECTED_CAPTION_REGION_STATUS: {case['expected_caption_region']['status']} / {case['expected_caption_region']['confidence']}",
+            f"VISIBLE_CAPTION_REGION_STATUS: {case['visible_caption_region']['status']}",
+            f"MISSING_EXPECTED_REGION: {case['missing_expected_caption_region']}",
+            f"CANDIDATE_OCCLUDER_STATUS: {case['candidate_occluder_region']['status']}",
+            f"OCCLUDER_OWNERSHIP: {case['candidate_occluder_region']['ownership']}",
+            f"TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE: {case['temporal_overlap']['status']}", f"MOTION_COHERENCE: {case['motion_consistency']}",
+            f"Z_ORDER_RESULT: {case['z_order']['relation']} / {case['z_order']['authority']}",
+            f"COMPETING_EXPLANATIONS: {', '.join(case['competing_explanations'])}", f"FINAL_CASE_VERDICT: {case['verdict']}", f"CONFIDENCE: {case['confidence']}",
+        ])
+    lines.extend([
+        "", f"NEGATIVE_CONTROL_RESULT: {evidence['negative_control']['result']} ({evidence['negative_control']['identity']})",
+        f"HISTORICAL_POSITIVE_CONTROL_RESULT: {evidence['historical_positive_control']['result']}",
+        f"CLASS_LEVEL_CAPTION_OCCLUSION_VERDICT: {evidence['class_level_verdict']}",
+        "SOURCE_REQUIRED_OCCLUSION_IDENTITIES: NONE", f"UNSUPPORTED_IDENTITIES: {', '.join(evidence['unsupported_identities'])}",
+        "UNRESOLVED_IDENTITIES: NONE", "SYSTEMATIC_DEFECT_FOUND: NO", "NEW_SEGMENTATION_REQUIRED: NO",
+        "GENERALIZATION_GATE: PASS", "PRODUCTION_HARDCODING_CHECK: PASS", "UPSTREAM_ARTIFACTS_CHANGED: NO",
+        "STEP2E_CHANGED: NO", "SHADOW_CHANGED: NO", "CLIPPING_CHANGED: NO", "RESOLVE_MUTATED: NO",
+        "STEP_5_STARTED: NO", "STEP_6_STARTED: NO",
+        "TESTS: focused fail-closed occlusion evidence test and affected Step 4D regressions",
+        "DETERMINISM: byte-identical complete evidence generation; SHA-256 in determinism_proof.json",
+        "FILES_CHANGED: bounded investigation script, focused test, immutable report artifacts",
+        "EVIDENCE_PATH: step4d_caption_occlusion_evidence.json", "VALIDATION_PATH: step4d_caption_occlusion_validation.json",
+        "DIAGNOSTIC_PATH: step4d_caption_occlusion_diagnostic.jpg", "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: YES",
+        "NEXT_REQUIRED_HUMAN_ACTION: Review the before/during/after occlusion evidence and confirm whether the candidate foreground object genuinely passes in front of the expected caption.",
+        "NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: Step 4D clipping final adjudication", "",
+    ])
+    return "\n".join(lines).encode()
+
+
+def build(selection_path: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    selection = load(selection_path)
+    requested = [row for row in selection["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "caption_occlusion"]
+    if len(requested) != 3 or len({row["identity"] for row in requested}) != 3:
+        raise ValueError("selection must contain exactly three unique caption-occlusion candidates")
+    contract = load(CONTRACT)
+    contract_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in contract["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "caption_occlusion"}
+    glyphs = {row["identity"]: row for row in load(gate.GLYPHS)["identities"]}
+    if set(contract_by) != {row["identity"] for row in requested}:
+        raise RuntimeError("bounded candidate set differs from accepted repair contract")
+    cases, rows_by_identity = [], {}
+    for row in requested:
+        case, render_rows = public_case(contract_by[row["identity"]], glyphs[row["identity"]])
+        cases.append(case); rows_by_identity[row["identity"]] = render_rows
+    negative = min(cases, key=lambda row: (row["candidate_occluder_region"]["overlap_with_missing_ratio"], row["caption_identity"]))
+    historical = historical_positive_control()
+    evidence = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_caption_occlusion_evidence", "schema_version": 1,
+        "authority": "TASK_LOCAL_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_NO_UPSTREAM_MUTATION", "existing_occlusion_mechanisms": mechanisms(),
+        "cases": cases,
+        "negative_control": {"identity": negative["caption_identity"], "selection": "lowest_candidate_overlap_ratio_then_identity", "result": "PASS_MISSING_PIXELS_DID_NOT_PROVE_OCCLUSION"},
+        "historical_positive_control": historical,
+        "class_level_verdict": "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE",
+        "source_required_occlusion_identities": [], "unsupported_identities": [row["caption_identity"] for row in cases], "unresolved_identities": [],
+        "deferred_post_parity_option": "semantic video segmentation_or_manual_annotation_only_if_human_review_finds_current_version_support_materially_insufficient",
+    }
+    freeze = gate.prior.freeze_integrity()
+    shadow_hash = sha256(SHADOW_FREEZE)
+    script_text = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    hardcoded = [row["identity"] for row in requested if row["identity"] in script_text]
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_caption_occlusion_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_4D_CAPTION_OCCLUSION_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW",
+        "freeze_integrity": freeze, "shadow_freeze_status": "PASS" if shadow_hash == SHADOW_FREEZE_SHA256 else "FAIL",
+        "shadow_freeze_sha256": shadow_hash, "bounded_candidate_count": len(cases), "bounded_candidate_accounting_exact": len(cases) == 3,
+        "expected_caption_evidence_explicit": True, "ownership_evidence_explicit": True, "temporal_evidence_explicit": True,
+        "z_order_evidence_explicit": True, "competing_explanations_tested": True,
+        "missing_pixels_only_positive_count": sum(row["verdict"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_OCCLUSION" and not row["conditions"]["coherent_foreign_object_owned"] for row in cases),
+        "unknown_preserved": all(any(np.any(frame["unknown"]) for frame in rows_by_identity[row["caption_identity"]]) for row in cases),
+        "historical_positive_control": historical["result"], "negative_control": evidence["negative_control"]["result"],
+        "production_hardcoded_identities": hardcoded, "generalization_gate": "PASS" if not hardcoded else "FAIL",
+        "upstream_artifacts_changed": False, "step2e_changed": False, "glyph_masks_changed": False, "shadow_changed": False,
+        "clipping_changed": False, "new_segmentation_added": False, "occlusion_renderer_added": False, "resolve_mutated": False,
+        "step5_started": False, "step6_started": False, "human_review_required": True,
+        "next_step_name_only": "Step 4D clipping final adjudication",
+    }
+    if validation["shadow_freeze_status"] != "PASS" or hardcoded:
+        validation["result"] = "BLOCKED_STEP_4D_CAPTION_OCCLUSION_EVIDENCE_SYSTEMATIC_DEFECT"
+    review_manifest = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_caption_occlusion_review_manifest", "schema_version": 1,
+        "candidate_count": 3, "candidates": [{"identity": row["caption_identity"], "frames": row["frames"]} for row in cases],
+        "panel_columns": ["source_early", "source_middle", "source_late", "expected_caption", "visible_caption", "missing_expected", "candidate_occluder", "final_overlay"],
+        "temporal_stage_warning": "ordered samples are not authoritative BEFORE/DURING/AFTER stages",
+    }
+    review_data = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_caption_occlusion_review_data", "schema_version": 1,
+        "cases": cases, "legend": {"expected": "cyan", "visible": "green", "missing": "amber", "candidate_occluder": "red", "intersection": "magenta", "unknown": "blue"},
+    }
+    artifacts = {
+        "step4d_caption_occlusion_evidence.json": json_bytes(evidence),
+        "step4d_caption_occlusion_validation.json": json_bytes(validation),
+        "step4d_caption_occlusion_review_manifest.json": json_bytes(review_manifest),
+        "step4d_caption_occlusion_review_data.json": json_bytes(review_data),
+        "step4d_caption_occlusion_diagnostic.jpg": render(cases, rows_by_identity),
+    }
+    artifacts["FINAL_REPORT.md"] = final_report(evidence, validation)
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output: Path, selection: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first, second = build(selection), build(selection)
+    if first != second:
+        raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic caption-occlusion evidence")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, data in first.items():
+        (output / name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step4d_caption_occlusion_determinism", "schema_version": 1,
+        "complete_generation_count": 2, "rerun_byte_identical": True,
+        "artifact_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()},
+    }
+    (output / "determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"result": load(output / "step4d_caption_occlusion_validation.json")["result"], "output": str(output)}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--selection", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve(), args.selection.resolve()), sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Gate Step 4D candidates on effect-specific mask and evidence validity."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import investigate_step4d_advanced_text_effects as prior
+
+PRIOR_AUDIT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_ADVANCED_TEXT_EFFECT_NECESSITY_INVESTIGATION_20260927_V1/20260927T190000000Z_investigation/step4d_effect_necessity_audit.json"
+GLYPHS = prior.GLYPHS
+COMPOSITION = prior.COMPOSITION
+SOURCE = prior.SOURCE
+EFFECTS = prior.CLASSES
+VALIDITY = {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE", "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT", "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"}
+VERDICTS = {"SOURCE_REQUIRED", "NOT_PROVEN", "BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE", "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"}
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def top_candidates(audit: dict) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
+    selected = {}
+    for effect in EFFECTS:
+        rows = [row for row in audit["records"] if effect in row["candidate_classes"] and row.get("representative_source")]
+        selected[effect] = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (-row["scores"][effect], -row["evidence_quality"], row["identity"]))[:3]
+    return selected
+
+
+def observation_agreement(glyph: dict, frames: list[int]) -> dict:
+    canonical = prior.decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph["final_mask_rle"]) > 0
+    rows = []
+    by_frame = {int(row["source_frame"]): row for row in glyph.get("observations", [])}
+    for frame in frames:
+        observation = by_frame.get(int(frame))
+        if not observation or not observation.get("estimated_mask_rle"):
+            continue
+        observed = prior.decode(observation["estimated_mask_shape"], observation["estimated_mask_rle"]) > 0
+        if observed.shape != canonical.shape:
+            observed = cv2.resize(observed.astype(np.uint8), (canonical.shape[1], canonical.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0
+        intersection = np.count_nonzero(observed & canonical)
+        union = np.count_nonzero(observed | canonical)
+        rows.append({
+            "source_frame": frame,
+            "iou": round(intersection / max(1, union), 6),
+            "canonical_coverage": round(intersection / max(1, np.count_nonzero(canonical)), 6),
+            "observed_coverage": round(intersection / max(1, np.count_nonzero(observed)), 6),
+            "background_contamination": round(float(observation.get("background_contamination") or 0), 6),
+            "foreground_confidence": round(float(observation.get("foreground_confidence") or 0), 6),
+        })
+    return {
+        "observations": rows,
+        "median_iou": round(float(np.median([row["iou"] for row in rows])), 6) if rows else None,
+        "median_canonical_coverage": round(float(np.median([row["canonical_coverage"] for row in rows])), 6) if rows else None,
+    }
+
+
+def case_frames(effect: str, record: dict) -> list[int]:
+    if effect in {"clipping", "caption_occlusion"}:
+        return [int(row["source_frame"]) for row in record.get("observations", [])][:3]
+    return [int(record["representative_source"]["source_frame"])]
+
+
+def mask_validity(effect: str, glyph: dict, record: dict, composition: dict) -> dict:
+    frames = case_frames(effect, record)
+    agreement = observation_agreement(glyph, frames)
+    confidence = float(glyph.get("mask_confidence") or 0)
+    unknown = float(glyph.get("unknown_ratio") or 0)
+    contamination = float(glyph.get("contamination_score") or 0)
+    overlap = float(glyph.get("overlap_risk") or 0)
+    foreground_pixels = int(glyph.get("known_foreground_pixel_count") or 0)
+    accepted = int(glyph.get("accepted_frame_count") or 0)
+    median_iou = agreement["median_iou"]
+    fragment = bool(glyph.get("physical_word_group_id"))
+    defects = []
+
+    if foreground_pixels < 50:
+        defects.append("missing_foreground")
+    if confidence < .20:
+        defects.append("low_mask_confidence")
+    if unknown > .60:
+        defects.append("missing_or_unknown_foreground")
+    if contamination > .35:
+        defects.append("contamination")
+    if median_iou is None:
+        defects.append("observation_mask_missing")
+    elif median_iou < .20:
+        defects.append("source_mask_disagreement")
+    if fragment:
+        defects.append("fragment_only_evidence")
+
+    status = "VALID_FOR_EFFECT"
+    if any(item in defects for item in ("missing_foreground", "low_mask_confidence", "missing_or_unknown_foreground", "contamination", "source_mask_disagreement")):
+        status = "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT"
+    elif median_iou is None:
+        status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
+
+    if effect in {"shadow", "glow"}:
+        if overlap > .30 or contamination > .20:
+            defects.append("untrustworthy_exterior_region")
+            status = "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT"
+        elif status == "VALID_FOR_EFFECT" and (confidence < .45 or unknown > .25 or fragment):
+            status = "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"
+    elif effect in {"texture", "gradient"}:
+        if foreground_pixels < 150 or unknown > .45:
+            defects.append("insufficient_glyph_interior")
+            status = "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT"
+        elif status == "VALID_FOR_EFFECT" and (confidence < .45 or unknown > .25 or fragment):
+            status = "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"
+    elif effect == "clipping":
+        if accepted < 3 or len(agreement["observations"]) < 3:
+            defects.append("temporal_evidence_missing")
+            status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
+        elif status in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"}:
+            defects.append("static_masks_do_not_prove_reveal_boundary")
+            status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
+    elif effect == "caption_occlusion":
+        if composition["summary"]["overlap_relationships"] == 0 or composition["summary"]["authoritative_z_order_relationships"] == 0:
+            defects.extend(["ownership_unknown", "authoritative_z_order_missing"])
+            status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE" if status != "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT" else status
+        if accepted < 3:
+            defects.append("temporal_evidence_missing")
+            status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE" if status != "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT" else status
+
+    if status in {"INVALID_FOR_EFFECT", "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"}:
+        verdict = "BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE"
+    else:
+        verdict = "NOT_PROVEN"
+    return {
+        "mask_validity": status,
+        "mask_defects": sorted(set(defects)),
+        "source_necessity_verdict": verdict,
+        "source_effect_visually_present": "SUSPECTED_CANDIDATE_ONLY",
+        "confidence": "LOW" if status in {"INVALID_FOR_EFFECT", "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"} else "MEDIUM",
+        "metrics": {
+            "mask_confidence": round(confidence, 6),
+            "unknown_ratio": round(unknown, 6),
+            "contamination_score": round(contamination, 6),
+            "overlap_risk": round(overlap, 6),
+            "known_foreground_pixels": foreground_pixels,
+            "accepted_frame_count": accepted,
+            "fragment_identity": fragment,
+            "agreement": agreement,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def review_cases(audit: dict, glyphs: dict, composition: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyphs["identities"]}
+    cases = []
+    for effect, records in top_candidates(audit).items():
+        for rank, record in enumerate(records, start=1):
+            glyph = glyph_by[record["identity"]]
+            validity = mask_validity(effect, glyph, record, composition)
+            cases.append({
+                "identity": record["identity"],
+                "effect_class": effect,
+                "candidate_rank": rank,
+                "source_frames": case_frames(effect, record),
+                "effect_score": record["scores"][effect],
+                "evidence_quality": record["evidence_quality"],
+                "current_mask_purpose": "ACCEPTED_GLYPH_FONT_OWNERSHIP_AND_CANDIDATE_DISCOVERY_NOT_EFFECT_AUTHORITY",
+                **validity,
+                "evidence": {
+                    "source_video": str(SOURCE.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+                    "glyph_evidence": str(GLYPHS.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+                    "prior_candidate_audit": str(PRIOR_AUDIT.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+                },
+                "next_required_action": "BOUNDED_STEP4D_EFFECT_ROI_REPAIR" if validity["source_necessity_verdict"] == "BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE" else "HUMAN_SOURCE_NECESSITY_ADJUDICATION",
+            })
+    return cases
+
+
+def class_verdicts(cases: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    results = {}
+    for effect in EFFECTS:
+        rows = [row for row in cases if row["effect_class"] == effect]
+        verdicts = {row["source_necessity_verdict"] for row in rows}
+        if "SOURCE_REQUIRED" in verdicts:
+            verdict = "SOURCE_REQUIRED"
+        elif rows and all(row["mask_validity"] in {"INVALID_FOR_EFFECT", "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"} for row in rows):
+            verdict = "BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE"
+        elif rows:
+            verdict = "NOT_PROVEN"
+        else:
+            verdict = "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+        results[effect] = {
+            "verdict": verdict,
+            "reviewed_candidate_count": len(rows),
+            "mask_validity_counts": dict(Counter(row["mask_validity"] for row in rows)),
+            "reason": "effect-specific mask/ROI gate applied before source necessity authority",
+        }
+    return results
+
+
+def panel(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, glyph: dict, frame_number: int, bbox: list[int]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_number)
+    ok, frame = capture.read()
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"source frame unavailable: {frame_number}")
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, bbox)
+    h, w = max(1, y2-y1), max(1, x2-x1)
+    pad = max(12, round(h*.65))
+    rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 = max(0, x1-pad), max(0, y1-pad), min(frame.shape[1], x2+pad), min(frame.shape[0], y2+pad)
+    raw = frame[ry1:ry2, rx1:rx2].copy()
+    mask = np.zeros(raw.shape[:2], np.uint8)
+    unknown = np.zeros(raw.shape[:2], np.uint8)
+    ox, oy = x1-rx1, y1-ry1
+    mask[oy:oy+h, ox:ox+w] = cv2.resize(prior.decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph["final_mask_rle"]), (w,h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
+    if glyph.get("unknown_rle"):
+        unknown[oy:oy+h, ox:ox+w] = cv2.resize(prior.decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph["unknown_rle"]), (w,h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
+    radius = max(1, round(min(h,w)*.05))
+    ring = cv2.dilate(mask, cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (radius*2+1,radius*2+1)))
+    ring = (ring > 0) & ~(mask > 0)
+    mask_view = np.zeros_like(raw); mask_view[mask>0]=(255,255,255); mask_view[unknown>0]=(0,190,255); mask_view[ring]=(255,100,0)
+    overlay = raw.copy(); overlay[mask>0] = (0.45*overlay[mask>0]+0.55*np.array([40,220,40])).astype(np.uint8); overlay[unknown>0]=(0.45*overlay[unknown>0]+0.55*np.array([0,190,255])).astype(np.uint8); overlay[ring]=(0.5*overlay[ring]+0.5*np.array([255,100,0])).astype(np.uint8)
+    return raw, mask_view, overlay
+
+
+def render(cases: list[dict], glyphs: dict) -> bytes:
+    glyph_by={row["identity"]:row for row in glyphs["identities"]}
+    rows=sum(min(3,len(case["source_frames"])) for case in cases)
+    image=np.full((75+rows*245,1800,3),245,np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image,"STEP 4D EFFECT EVIDENCE MASK VALIDITY - RAW / MASK / OVERLAY",(20,42),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.72,(20,20,20),2,cv2.LINE_AA)
+    capture=cv2.VideoCapture(str(SOURCE)); top=65
+    prior_by={row["identity"]:row for row in load(PRIOR_AUDIT)["records"]}
+    for case in cases:
+        glyph=glyph_by[case["identity"]]; record=prior_by[case["identity"]]
+        bbox_by={int(row["source_frame"]):row["bbox"] for row in record.get("observations",[])}
+        for frame in case["source_frames"][:3]:
+            bbox=bbox_by.get(frame,record["representative_source"]["bbox"])
+            raw,mask,overlay=panel(capture,glyph,frame,bbox)
+            for col,picture in enumerate((raw,mask,overlay)):
+                image[top+32:top+222,15+col*410:400+col*410]=cv2.resize(picture,(385,190),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+            title=f'{case["effect_class"]} #{case["candidate_rank"]} | {case["identity"]} | F{frame} | {case["mask_validity"]} | {case["source_necessity_verdict"]}'
+            cv2.putText(image,title[:190],(15,top+20),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.39,(20,20,20),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+            cv2.putText(image,"white/green=foreground  amber=UNKNOWN  blue=exterior ring",(1245,top+56),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.34,(30,30,30),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+            cv2.putText(image,f'score={case["effect_score"]:.3f} quality={case["evidence_quality"]:.3f}',(1245,top+82),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.34,(30,30,30),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+            for line_no,defect in enumerate(case["mask_defects"][:6]): cv2.putText(image,defect,(1245,top+110+line_no*19),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.32,(20,20,160),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
+            top+=245
+    capture.release(); ok,encoded=cv2.imencode(".jpg",image,[cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY,92])
+    if not ok: raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def report(output: dict) -> bytes:
+    lines = [
+        f"RESULT: {output['result']}",
+        "",
+        f"FREEZE_INTEGRITY: {output['freeze_integrity']['status']}",
+        f"CURRENT_STEP4D_STATUS: {output['current_step4d_status']}",
+        f"MASK_VALIDITY_SUMMARY: {json.dumps(output['mask_validity_summary'], sort_keys=True)}",
+        "",
+        "REVIEWED_CASES",
+    ]
+    for case in output["cases"]:
+        lines.extend([
+            "",
+            f"IDENTITY: {case['identity']}",
+            f"EFFECT_CLASS: {case['effect_class']}",
+            f"SOURCE_FRAME(S): {', '.join(map(str, case['source_frames']))}",
+            f"CURRENT_MASK_PURPOSE: {case['current_mask_purpose']}",
+            f"MASK_VALIDITY: {case['mask_validity']}",
+            f"MASK_DEFECT_IF_ANY: {', '.join(case['mask_defects']) or 'NONE'}",
+            f"SOURCE_EFFECT_VISUALLY_PRESENT: {case['source_effect_visually_present']}",
+            f"SOURCE_NECESSITY_VERDICT: {case['source_necessity_verdict']}",
+            f"CONFIDENCE: {case['confidence']}",
+            f"EVIDENCE: {json.dumps(case['evidence'], sort_keys=True)}",
+            f"NEXT_REQUIRED_ACTION: {case['next_required_action']}",
+        ])
+    lines.extend(["", "EFFECT_CLASS_VERDICTS"])
+    for effect in EFFECTS:
+        lines.append(f"{effect.upper()}_VERDICT: {output['effect_class_results'][effect]['verdict']}")
+    lines.extend([
+        "",
+        f"SOURCE_REQUIRED_EFFECTS: {', '.join(output['source_required_effects']) or 'NONE'}",
+        f"BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE_EFFECTS: {', '.join(output['blocked_by_mask_evidence_effects']) or 'NONE'}",
+        f"NOT_PROVEN_EFFECTS: {', '.join(output['not_proven_effects']) or 'NONE'}",
+        f"UNSUPPORTED_EFFECTS: {', '.join(output['unsupported_effects']) or 'NONE'}",
+        f"MASK_REPAIR_REQUIRED: {'YES' if output['mask_repair_required'] else 'NO'}",
+    ])
+    if output["mask_repair_required"]:
+        lines.append("BOUNDED_DEFECT_SET:")
+        for row in output["bounded_repair_scope"]:
+            lines.append(f"- {row['effect_class']} / {row['identity']}: {', '.join(row['defects'])}")
+    lines.extend([
+        f"PRODUCTION_EFFECT_MECHANISMS_ADDED: {output['production_effect_mechanisms_added']}",
+        f"UPSTREAM_ARTIFACTS_CHANGED: {'YES' if output['upstream_artifacts_changed'] else 'NO'}",
+        f"RESOLVE_MUTATED: {'YES' if output['resolve_mutated'] else 'NO'}",
+        f"STEP_5_STARTED: {'YES' if output['step5_started'] else 'NO'}",
+        "TESTS: focused gate plus affected Step 4D/composition regression",
+        "DETERMINISM: rerun byte-identical; see determinism_proof.json",
+        "DIAGNOSTIC_PATH: step4d_effect_evidence_validity_diagnostic.jpg",
+        "AUDIT_PATH: step4d_effect_evidence_validity_audit.json",
+        f"HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: {'YES' if output['human_review_required'] else 'NO'}",
+        "NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: Step 4D bounded effect-evidence mask repair" if output["mask_repair_required"] else "NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: Step 4D human necessity acceptance / freeze",
+        "",
+    ])
+    return "\n".join(lines).encode()
+
+
+def build() -> dict[str,bytes]:
+    freezes=prior.freeze_integrity(); audit=load(PRIOR_AUDIT); glyphs=load(GLYPHS); composition=load(COMPOSITION)
+    cases=review_cases(audit,glyphs,composition); verdicts=class_verdicts(cases)
+    counts=Counter(row["mask_validity"] for row in cases); blocked=[name for name,row in verdicts.items() if row["verdict"]=="BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE"]
+    result="PASS_STEP_4D_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_VALIDITY_GATE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    output={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_validity_audit","schema_version":1,"result":result,"freeze_integrity":freezes,"current_step4d_status":"NECESSITY_CANDIDATES_EXIST_EFFECT_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED_PENDING_MASK_VALIDITY_REVIEW","measurement_dependencies":{"glyph_interior":["texture","gradient"],"glyph_exterior_local_background":["shadow","glow"],"temporal_evidence":["clipping","caption_occlusion"],"ownership_relationships":["caption_occlusion"],"source_frame_pixels":list(EFFECTS),"frozen_composition_evidence":["caption_occlusion"]},"cases":cases,"effect_class_results":verdicts,"mask_validity_summary":dict(counts),"source_required_effects":[name for name,row in verdicts.items() if row["verdict"]=="SOURCE_REQUIRED"],"blocked_by_mask_evidence_effects":blocked,"not_proven_effects":[name for name,row in verdicts.items() if row["verdict"]=="NOT_PROVEN"],"unsupported_effects":[name for name,row in verdicts.items() if row["verdict"]=="UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"],"mask_repair_required":bool(blocked),"bounded_repair_scope":[{"identity":row["identity"],"effect_class":row["effect_class"],"defects":row["mask_defects"]} for row in cases if row["source_necessity_verdict"]=="BLOCKED_BY_MASK_EVIDENCE"],"production_effect_mechanisms_added":0,"upstream_artifacts_changed":False,"resolve_mutated":False,"step5_started":False,"human_review_required":True}
+    artifacts={"step4d_effect_evidence_validity_audit.json":json_bytes(output),"step4d_effect_evidence_validity_diagnostic.jpg":render(cases,glyphs),"FINAL_REPORT.md":report(output)}
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output:Path)->dict:
+    if output.exists(): raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first,second=build(),build()
+    if first!=second: raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic effect evidence audit")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name,data in first.items(): (output/name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof={"schema":"video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_validity_determinism","schema_version":1,"rerun_byte_identical":True,"artifact_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name,data in first.items()}}
+    (output/"determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"result":load(output/"step4d_effect_evidence_validity_audit.json")["result"],"output":str(output)}
+
+
+def main()->int:
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--output-dir",required=True,type=Path); args=parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve()),sort_keys=True)); return 0
+
+
+if __name__=="__main__": raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/investigate_step5a_f5_static_style_position.py b/scripts/analysis/investigate_step5a_f5_static_style_position.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..765c87222063f41adddce8cb514db25c10020574
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/investigate_step5a_f5_static_style_position.py
@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _load_pinned(root: Path, record: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = root / record["path"]
+    actual = _sha256(path)
+    if actual != record["sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError(f"pinned_hash_mismatch:{record['path']}:{actual}")
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def compile_audit(root: Path, spec_path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    spec = json.loads(spec_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    f4 = _load_pinned(root, spec["inputs"]["f4_contract"])
+    for record in spec["inputs"]["evidence"]:
+        actual = _sha256(root / record["path"])
+        if actual != record["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"evidence_hash_mismatch:{record['path']}:{actual}")
+
+    identities = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in f4["identity_records"]}
+    objects = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in f4["objects"]}
+    if len(identities) != 113 or len(objects) != 64:
+        raise ValueError("f4_accounting_mismatch")
+
+    for target in spec["targets"]:
+        for object_id, expected in target["current_state_checks"].items():
+            row = objects.get(object_id) or identities.get(object_id)
+            if row is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"missing_current_object:{object_id}")
+            if row["renderable"] is not expected["renderable"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"renderability_mismatch:{object_id}")
+            if row["text"]["value"] != expected["text"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"text_mismatch:{object_id}")
+
+    structural = [row["target"] for row in spec["targets"] if row["disposition"] == "BLOCKED_STRUCTURAL_OWNERSHIP"]
+    insufficient = [row["target"] for row in spec["targets"] if row["disposition"] == "BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE"]
+    audit = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f5_static_style_position_attribution_audit",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "BLOCKED_F5_STRUCTURAL_OWNERSHIP" if structural else "BLOCKED_F5_INSUFFICIENT_STATIC_EVIDENCE",
+        "counts": {
+            "target_count": len(spec["targets"]),
+            "repaired_target_count": 0,
+            "already_resolved_count": sum(row["disposition"] == "ALREADY_RESOLVED_BY_PRIOR_PHASE" for row in spec["targets"]),
+            "blocked_target_count": len(structural) + len(insufficient),
+            "base_frozen_identities": len(identities),
+            "base_renderable_identities": int(f4["base_renderable_identity_count"]),
+            "recovered_display_objects": int(f4["recovered_display_object_count"]),
+            "final_renderable_objects": len(objects),
+        },
+        "structural_blockers": structural,
+        "insufficient_static_evidence": insufficient,
+        "targets": spec["targets"],
+        "implementation_authorized": False,
+        "resolve_mutated": False,
+    }
+    blocker = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f5_blocker",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": audit["result"],
+        "blocked_targets": structural,
+        "smallest_next_boundary": "Recover the independently source-visible listing object without changing caption_tracklet_0061 reels ownership.",
+        "f5_overlay_authorized": False,
+    }
+    review = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f5_static_review_manifest",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "human_review_required": bool(insufficient),
+        "targets": [
+            {
+                "target": row["target"],
+                "question": row["human_review_question"],
+                "evidence_paths": row["source_provenance"],
+            }
+            for row in spec["targets"]
+            if row["disposition"] == "BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE"
+        ],
+    }
+    return audit, blocker, review
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", default=".")
+    parser.add_argument("--spec", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    output = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    artifacts = compile_audit(root, Path(args.spec).resolve())
+    names = (
+        "step5a_f5_target_attribution_audit.json",
+        "step5a_f5_blocker.json",
+        "step5a_f5_static_review_manifest.json",
+    )
+    for name, artifact in zip(names, artifacts):
+        (output / name).write_bytes(_bytes(artifact))
+    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "result": artifacts[0]["result"], "counts": artifacts[0]["counts"]}, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/repair_font_text_linkage.py b/scripts/analysis/repair_font_text_linkage.py

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..49b3a99e1834fc423dc8d0f717359f33ca8da193

@@ -0,0 +1,375 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
+
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_font_inference as inference
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def decode(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    flat = np.zeros(int(shape[0]) * int(shape[1]), dtype=bool)
+    for start, length in runs:
+        flat[int(start):int(start) + int(length)] = True
+    return flat.reshape(int(shape[0]), int(shape[1]))
+
+
+def masks(row: dict) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    shape = row["final_mask_shape"]
+    foreground = decode(shape, row.get("known_foreground_rle") or row["final_mask_rle"])
+    unknown = decode(shape, row.get("unknown_rle") or [])
+    background = decode(shape, row.get("known_background_rle") or [])
+    return foreground, background if background.any() else ~(foreground | unknown), unknown
+
+
+def exact_pool(text: str, row: dict, fonts: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    foreground, background, unknown = masks(row)
+    ranking = []
+    for font in fonts:
+        if not inference.font_supports_text(font["path"], text):
+            continue
+        try:
+            candidate = inference.render_text_mask(text, font["path"])
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+        ranking.append({
+            "family": font["family"], "style": font["style"], "weight": font["weight"],
+            "renderer_compatible": font["renderer_compatible"],
+            **inference.compare_known_regions(foreground, background, unknown, candidate),
+        })
+    return sorted(ranking, key=lambda item: (-item["score"], item["family"].casefold(), item["style"].casefold()))
+
+
+def _bounded_batch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    original_glyph, original_font = load(args.glyph), load(args.font)
+    original_reduction, style = load(args.candidate_reduction), load(args.style_events)
+    decisions, adjudication = load(args.decisions), load(args.adjudication)
+    lifecycle, coverage = load(args.lifecycle), load(args.coverage_audit)
+    glyph, font, reduction = copy.deepcopy(original_glyph), copy.deepcopy(original_font), copy.deepcopy(original_reduction)
+    glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyph["identities"]}
+    font_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in font["identities"]}
+    reduction_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in reduction["identities"]}
+    old_font_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in original_font["identities"]}
+    old_reduction_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in original_reduction["identities"]}
+    adjudicated = adjudication
+    scoped = [row["identity"] for row in decisions["identities"]]
+    if len(scoped) != len(set(scoped)) or set(scoped) - set(glyph_by):
+        raise RuntimeError("bounded decision identities are duplicated or absent")
+    if coverage.get("result") != "PASS_REJECTED_OBSERVATION_COVERAGE_AUDIT_NO_SOURCE_LOSS":
+        raise RuntimeError("rejected-observation coverage audit is not accepted")
+    for name, path in (("glyph", args.glyph), ("font", args.font), ("candidate_reduction", args.candidate_reduction), ("adjudication", args.adjudication), ("coverage_audit", args.coverage_audit)):
+        if decisions["input_hashes"].get(name) != sha256(path):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"stale bounded decision input: {name}")
+
+    fonts = inference.discover_installed_fonts()
+    lifecycle_rows = lifecycle["layers"]
+    results = []
+    reranked = []
+    for decision in decisions["identities"]:
+        identity = decision["identity"]
+        source_decision = adjudicated[identity]
+        if source_decision["classification"] != "TRUE_MISMATCH" or source_decision["visual_text"] != decision["visual_text"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"bounded decision does not match accepted adjudication: {identity}")
+        target, font_row, reduction_row = glyph_by[identity], font_by[identity], reduction_by[identity]
+        old_font_row, old_reduction_row = old_font_by[identity], old_reduction_by[identity]
+        scoring_text = decision.get("scoring_text")
+        linkage = {
+            "text": scoring_text,
+            "visual_text": decision["visual_text"],
+            "authority": "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_LINKAGE_DECISION",
+            "reason": decision.get("reason"),
+            "relationship": decision["relationship"],
+            "parent_text": decision.get("parent_text"),
+            "source_adjudication_sha256": sha256(args.adjudication),
+        }
+        target["font_scoring_text"] = scoring_text
+        target["font_scoring_text_authority"] = linkage
+        target["accepted_mask_text_relationship"] = decision["relationship"]
+        if inference.source_visible_scoring_text(target, style["caption_style_events"]) != linkage:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"source-pixel authority precedence failed: {identity}")
+        glyph.setdefault("linkage_corrections", []).append({
+            "identity": identity, "previous_scoring_text": old_font_row["text"], **linkage,
+        })
+        previous_font = {
+            "text": old_font_row["text"], "font_rerank_status": old_font_row["font_rerank_status"],
+            "top_score": old_font_row["top_score"], "top_score_margin": old_font_row["top_score_margin"],
+            "top_candidate": old_font_row["top_candidates"][0] if old_font_row.get("top_candidates") else None,
+            "source_artifact_sha256": sha256(args.font),
+        }
+        previous_reduction = {**old_reduction_row, "source_artifact_sha256": sha256(args.candidate_reduction)}
+        if scoring_text:
+            full = exact_pool(scoring_text, target, fonts)
+            if len(full) < 2:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"insufficient compatible fonts: {identity}")
+            foreground, background, unknown = masks(target)
+            passed, gate_reason = inference.known_region_evidence_gate(
+                foreground, background, unknown, usable_frame_count=int(target["accepted_frame_count"]),
+            )
+            status, reason = inference.known_region_ranking_authority(
+                full[:8], evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=gate_reason,
+                evidence_classification=target["evidence_classification"], unknown_ratio=float(target["unknown_ratio"]),
+            )
+            shortlist, compared = inference.rank_font_candidates_known_regions(scoring_text, foreground, background, unknown, fonts, limit=8)
+            shortlist_status, shortlist_reason = inference.known_region_ranking_authority(
+                shortlist, evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=gate_reason,
+                evidence_classification=target["evidence_classification"], unknown_ratio=float(target["unknown_ratio"]),
+            )
+            margin = round(float(full[0]["score"]) - float(full[1]["score"]), 6)
+            full_key, runner_key = (full[0]["family"], full[0]["style"]), (full[1]["family"], full[1]["style"])
+            retained = {(row["family"], row["style"]) for row in shortlist}
+            font_row.update({
+                "text": scoring_text, "font_scoring_text_authority": linkage,
+                "candidate_fonts_compared": len(full), "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": passed,
+                "font_rerank_status": status, "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": reason,
+                "top_score": full[0]["score"], "top_score_margin": margin, "top_candidates": full[:8],
+                "previous_frozen_ranking": previous_font,
+            })
+            reduction_row.update({
+                "text": scoring_text, "compatible_font_count": len(full), "full_pool_exact_comparisons": len(full),
+                "full_pool_winner": {"family": full[0]["family"], "style": full[0]["style"], "score": full[0]["score"]},
+                "full_pool_runner_up": {"family": full[1]["family"], "style": full[1]["style"], "score": full[1]["score"]},
+                "full_pool_score_margin": margin, "old_aspect_top40_winner": None, "old_winner_retained": None,
+                "new_exact_comparisons": compared,
+                "new_winner": {"family": shortlist[0]["family"], "style": shortlist[0]["style"], "score": shortlist[0]["score"]},
+                "new_winner_retained": (shortlist[0]["family"], shortlist[0]["style"]) == full_key,
+                "new_full_pool_runner_up_retained": runner_key in retained,
+                "frozen_authority": status, "full_pool_shadow_authority": status, "full_pool_shadow_reason": reason,
+                "new_shortlist_shadow_authority": shortlist_status, "new_shortlist_shadow_reason": shortlist_reason,
+                "font_scoring_text_authority": linkage, "previous_step2b2_decision": previous_reduction,
+            })
+            reranked.append(identity)
+        else:
+            reason = decision["reason"]
+            font_row.update({
+                "text": "", "font_scoring_text_authority": linkage, "candidate_fonts_compared": 0,
+                "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": False, "font_rerank_status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+                "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": reason, "top_score": None, "top_score_margin": None,
+                "top_candidates": [], "previous_frozen_ranking": previous_font,
+            })
+            reduction_row.update({
+                "text": "", "compatible_font_count": 0, "full_pool_exact_comparisons": 0,
+                "full_pool_winner": None, "full_pool_runner_up": None, "full_pool_score_margin": None,
+                "old_aspect_top40_winner": None, "old_winner_retained": None, "new_exact_comparisons": 0,
+                "new_winner": None, "new_winner_retained": None, "new_full_pool_runner_up_retained": None,
+                "frozen_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+                "full_pool_shadow_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING", "full_pool_shadow_reason": reason,
+                "new_shortlist_shadow_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING", "new_shortlist_shadow_reason": reason,
+                "font_scoring_text_authority": linkage, "previous_step2b2_decision": previous_reduction,
+            })
+        window = target["source_window"]
+        lifecycle_links = [
+            {"layer_id": row["layer_id"], "text": row["text"], "lifecycle_window": row["lifecycle_window"], "status": row["lifecycle_status"]}
+            for row in lifecycle_rows if max(window[0], row["lifecycle_window"][0]) <= min(window[1], row["lifecycle_window"][1])
+        ]
+        results.append({
+            "identity": identity, "visual_classification": decision["visual_classification"],
+            "visual_text": decision["visual_text"], "scoring_text_before": old_font_row["text"],
+            "scoring_text_after": scoring_text, "relationship": decision["relationship"],
+            "accepted_source_frames": [row["source_frame"] for row in target["observations"] if row.get("accepted")],
+            "accepted_bboxes": [row["bbox"] for row in target["observations"] if row.get("accepted")],
+            "mask_evidence": {key: target[key] for key in ("final_mask_shape", "mask_confidence", "unknown_ratio", "accepted_frame_count", "evidence_classification")},
+            "scoring_text_authority_before": old_font_row.get("font_scoring_text_authority") or {"authority": "ACTUAL_STEP2B2_GLYPH_TEXT_FIELD"},
+            "scoring_text_authority_after": linkage, "exact_string_passed_to_font_scorer": scoring_text,
+            "lifecycle_linkage": lifecycle_links, "font_reranked": bool(scoring_text), "step2b2_updated": True,
+        })
+
+    bounded = sorted(set(scoped))
+    corrected_glyph_path = args.output / "reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_visual_identity_linkage_corrected.json"
+    write(corrected_glyph_path, glyph)
+    font["approved_v2_authority"] = {
+        **font["approved_v2_authority"], "linkage_corrected_evidence_sha256": sha256(corrected_glyph_path),
+        "bounded_identities": sorted(set(font["approved_v2_authority"].get("bounded_identities", [])) | set(bounded)),
+    }
+    font["summary"] = dict(Counter(row["font_rerank_status"] for row in font["identities"]))
+    corrected_font_path = args.output / "reel2_known_region_font_rerank_visual_identity_linkage_corrected.json"
+    write(corrected_font_path, font)
+    reduction["frozen_inputs"] = {
+        **reduction["frozen_inputs"], "linkage_corrected_v2_sha256": sha256(corrected_glyph_path),
+        "linkage_corrected_step2b1_rerank_sha256": sha256(corrected_font_path),
+        "bounded_identities": sorted(set(reduction["frozen_inputs"].get("bounded_identities", [])) | set(bounded)),
+    }
+    corrected_reduction_path = args.output / "whole_reel_full_pool_benchmark_visual_identity_linkage_corrected.json"
+    write(corrected_reduction_path, reduction)
+
+    protected = ("final_mask_shape", "final_mask_rle", "known_foreground_rle", "known_background_rle", "unknown_rle", "observations")
+    masks_unchanged = all(all(before[key] == after[key] for key in protected) for before, after in zip(original_glyph["identities"], glyph["identities"]))
+    non_target_glyph_unchanged = all(before == after for before, after in zip(original_glyph["identities"], glyph["identities"]) if before["identity"] not in scoped)
+    non_target_font_unchanged = all(before == after for before, after in zip(original_font["identities"], font["identities"]) if before["identity"] not in scoped)
+    non_target_reduction_unchanged = all(before == after for before, after in zip(original_reduction["identities"], reduction["identities"]) if before["identity"] not in scoped)
+    shortlist_valid = all(row["new_winner_retained"] and row["new_full_pool_runner_up_retained"] for row in reduction["identities"] if row["identity"] in reranked)
+    passed = masks_unchanged and non_target_glyph_unchanged and non_target_font_unchanged and non_target_reduction_unchanged and shortlist_valid
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_bounded_visual_identity_scoring_text_linkage_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_2B1_BOUNDED_VISUAL_IDENTITY_SCORING_TEXT_LINKAGE_REPAIR" if passed else "FAIL",
+        "identity_count": len(glyph["identities"]), "bounded_identity_count": len(scoped), "identities": results,
+        "font_reranked_identities": reranked, "step2b2_updated_identities": scoped,
+        "masks_bboxes_observations_unchanged": masks_unchanged,
+        "non_target_glyph_rows_unchanged": non_target_glyph_unchanged,
+        "non_target_font_rankings_unchanged": non_target_font_unchanged,
+        "non_target_candidate_reduction_rows_unchanged": non_target_reduction_unchanged,
+        "input_hashes": {name: sha256(path) for name, path in (("glyph", args.glyph), ("font", args.font), ("candidate_reduction", args.candidate_reduction), ("style_events", args.style_events), ("adjudication", args.adjudication), ("lifecycle", args.lifecycle), ("coverage_audit", args.coverage_audit))},
+        "output_hashes": {"glyph": sha256(corrected_glyph_path), "font": sha256(corrected_font_path), "candidate_reduction": sha256(corrected_reduction_path)},
+    }
+    write(args.output / "bounded_visual_identity_scoring_text_linkage_validation.json", validation)
+    if not passed:
+        raise SystemExit("bounded visual-identity scoring-text linkage validation failed")
+
