+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--identity")
+    parser.add_argument("--decisions", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--adjudication", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--lifecycle", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--coverage-audit", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--glyph", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--font", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--candidate-reduction", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--style-events", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    if args.decisions:
+        if not all((args.adjudication, args.lifecycle, args.coverage_audit)):
+            parser.error("--decisions requires --adjudication, --lifecycle, and --coverage-audit")
+        _bounded_batch(args)
+        return
+    if not args.identity:
+        parser.error("--identity or --decisions is required")
+
+    original_glyph, original_font = load(args.glyph), load(args.font)
+    original_reduction, style = load(args.candidate_reduction), load(args.style_events)
+    glyph = copy.deepcopy(original_glyph)
+    target = next(row for row in glyph["identities"] if row["identity"] == args.identity)
+    linkage = inference.source_visible_scoring_text(target, style["caption_style_events"])
+    if linkage["authority"] != "SOURCE_VISIBLE_OBSERVED_TEXT_BBOX_MATCH":
+        raise RuntimeError(f"source-visible text linkage unresolved: {linkage}")
+    target["font_scoring_text"] = linkage["text"]
+    target["font_scoring_text_authority"] = linkage
+    glyph.setdefault("linkage_corrections", []).append({"identity": args.identity, "previous_scoring_text": target["text"], **linkage})
+    corrected_glyph_path = args.output / "reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_linkage_corrected.json"
+    write(corrected_glyph_path, glyph)
+
+    fonts = inference.discover_installed_fonts()
+    ranking = exact_pool(linkage["text"], target, fonts)
+    foreground, background, unknown = masks(target)
+    passed, gate_reason = inference.known_region_evidence_gate(
+        foreground, background, unknown, usable_frame_count=int(target["accepted_frame_count"]),
+    )
+    status, reason = inference.known_region_ranking_authority(
+        ranking[:8], evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=gate_reason,
+        evidence_classification=target["evidence_classification"], unknown_ratio=float(target["unknown_ratio"]),
+    )
+    margin = round(float(ranking[0]["score"]) - float(ranking[1]["score"]), 6)
+    font = copy.deepcopy(original_font)
+    old_font_row = next(row for row in original_font["identities"] if row["identity"] == args.identity)
+    new_font_row = next(row for row in font["identities"] if row["identity"] == args.identity)
+    new_font_row.update({
+        "text": linkage["text"], "font_scoring_text_authority": linkage,
+        "candidate_fonts_compared": len(ranking), "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": passed,
+        "font_rerank_status": status, "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": reason,
+        "top_score": ranking[0]["score"], "top_score_margin": margin, "top_candidates": ranking[:8],
+        "previous_frozen_ranking": {
+            "text": old_font_row["text"], "font_rerank_status": old_font_row["font_rerank_status"],
+            "top_score": old_font_row["top_score"], "top_score_margin": old_font_row["top_score_margin"],
+            "top_candidate": old_font_row["top_candidates"][0], "source_artifact_sha256": sha256(args.font),
+        },
+    })
+    corrected_identities = [*font["approved_v2_authority"].get("bounded_identities", []), args.identity]
+    font["approved_v2_authority"] = {
+        **font["approved_v2_authority"], "linkage_corrected_evidence_sha256": sha256(corrected_glyph_path),
+        "bounded_identity": args.identity, "bounded_identities": sorted(set(corrected_identities)),
+    }
+    font["summary"] = dict(Counter(row["font_rerank_status"] for row in font["identities"]))
+    corrected_font_path = args.output / "reel2_known_region_font_rerank_linkage_corrected.json"
+    write(corrected_font_path, font)
+
+    new_ranking, compared = inference.rank_font_candidates_known_regions(
+        linkage["text"], foreground, background, unknown, fonts, limit=8,
+    )
+    new_status, new_reason = inference.known_region_ranking_authority(
+        new_ranking, evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=gate_reason,
+        evidence_classification=target["evidence_classification"], unknown_ratio=float(target["unknown_ratio"]),
+    )
+    full_key = (ranking[0]["family"], ranking[0]["style"])
+    runner_key = (ranking[1]["family"], ranking[1]["style"])
+    retained = {(row["family"], row["style"]) for row in new_ranking}
+    reduction = copy.deepcopy(original_reduction)
+    old_reduction_row = next(row for row in original_reduction["identities"] if row["identity"] == args.identity)
+    new_reduction_row = next(row for row in reduction["identities"] if row["identity"] == args.identity)
+    new_reduction_row.update({
+        "text": linkage["text"], "compatible_font_count": len(ranking), "full_pool_exact_comparisons": len(ranking),
+        "full_pool_winner": {"family": ranking[0]["family"], "style": ranking[0]["style"], "score": ranking[0]["score"]},
+        "full_pool_runner_up": {"family": ranking[1]["family"], "style": ranking[1]["style"], "score": ranking[1]["score"]},
+        "full_pool_score_margin": margin, "old_aspect_top40_winner": None, "old_winner_retained": None,
+        "new_exact_comparisons": compared,
+        "new_winner": {"family": new_ranking[0]["family"], "style": new_ranking[0]["style"], "score": new_ranking[0]["score"]},
+        "new_winner_retained": (new_ranking[0]["family"], new_ranking[0]["style"]) == full_key,
+        "new_full_pool_runner_up_retained": runner_key in retained,
+        "frozen_authority": status, "full_pool_shadow_authority": status, "full_pool_shadow_reason": reason,
+        "new_shortlist_shadow_authority": new_status, "new_shortlist_shadow_reason": new_reason,
+        "font_scoring_text_authority": linkage,
+        "previous_step2b2_decision": {**old_reduction_row, "source_artifact_sha256": sha256(args.candidate_reduction)},
+    })
+    corrected_identities = [*reduction["frozen_inputs"].get("bounded_identities", []), args.identity]
+    reduction["frozen_inputs"] = {
+        **reduction["frozen_inputs"], "linkage_corrected_v2_sha256": sha256(corrected_glyph_path),
+        "linkage_corrected_step2b1_rerank_sha256": sha256(corrected_font_path), "bounded_identity": args.identity,
+        "bounded_identities": sorted(set(corrected_identities)),
+    }
+    corrected_reduction_path = args.output / "whole_reel_full_pool_benchmark_linkage_corrected.json"
+    write(corrected_reduction_path, reduction)
+
+    protected = ("final_mask_shape", "final_mask_rle", "known_foreground_rle", "known_background_rle", "unknown_rle", "observations")
+    masks_unchanged = all(
+        all(before[key] == after[key] for key in protected)
+        for before, after in zip(original_glyph["identities"], glyph["identities"])
+    )
+    non_target_font_unchanged = all(
+        left == right for left, right in zip(original_font["identities"], font["identities"])
+        if left["identity"] != args.identity
+    )
+    non_target_reduction_unchanged = all(
+        left == right for left, right in zip(original_reduction["identities"], reduction["identities"])
+        if left["identity"] != args.identity
+    )
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_bounded_font_text_linkage_repair_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_BOUNDED_FONT_TEXT_LINKAGE_REPAIR" if masks_unchanged and non_target_font_unchanged and non_target_reduction_unchanged and new_reduction_row["new_winner_retained"] and new_reduction_row["new_full_pool_runner_up_retained"] else "FAIL",
+        "identity": args.identity, "linkage": linkage, "previous_scoring_text": old_font_row["text"],
+        "corrected_scoring_text": linkage["text"], "masks_bboxes_observations_unchanged": masks_unchanged,
+        "non_target_font_rankings_unchanged": non_target_font_unchanged,
+        "non_target_candidate_reduction_rows_unchanged": non_target_reduction_unchanged,
+        "step2b1": {"winner": ranking[0], "runner_up": ranking[1], "authority": status, "reason": reason, "full_pool_comparisons": len(ranking)},
+        "step2b2": {"winner": new_reduction_row["new_winner"], "authority": new_status, "reason": new_reason, "exact_comparisons": compared, "full_pool_winner_retained": new_reduction_row["new_winner_retained"], "full_pool_runner_up_retained": new_reduction_row["new_full_pool_runner_up_retained"]},
+        "input_hashes": {"glyph": sha256(args.glyph), "font": sha256(args.font), "candidate_reduction": sha256(args.candidate_reduction), "style_events": sha256(args.style_events)},
+        "output_hashes": {"glyph": sha256(corrected_glyph_path), "font": sha256(corrected_font_path), "candidate_reduction": sha256(corrected_reduction_path)},
+    }
+    write(args.output / "bounded_linkage_repair_validation.json", validation)
+    if validation["result"] != "PASS_BOUNDED_FONT_TEXT_LINKAGE_REPAIR":
+        raise SystemExit(validation["result"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
diff --git a/scripts/analysis/repair_glyph_observation_ownership.py b/scripts/analysis/repair_glyph_observation_ownership.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..41e155d4b5d8f960b5fb798f12d7d51f2cbba55f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/repair_glyph_observation_ownership.py
@@ -0,0 +1,145 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def repair(glyph: dict, font: dict, reduction: dict, decision: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
+    identity, source_frame = decision["identity"], int(decision["source_frame"])
+    glyph, font, reduction = copy.deepcopy(glyph), copy.deepcopy(font), copy.deepcopy(reduction)
+    row = next(item for item in glyph["identities"] if item["identity"] == identity)
+    matches = [item for item in row["observations"] if int(item["source_frame"]) == source_frame]
+    if len(matches) != 1 or not matches[0].get("accepted") or matches[0].get("bbox") != decision["bbox"]:
+        raise ValueError("ownership decision does not identify one accepted observation")
+    observation = matches[0]
+    observation["accepted"] = False
+    observation["reason"] = decision["rejection_reason"]
+    row.update({
+        "accepted_frame_count": 0,
+        "rejected_frame_count": len(row["observations"]),
+        "rejection_reasons": dict(Counter(item["reason"] for item in row["observations"] if not item.get("accepted"))),
+        "mask_confidence": 0.0,
+        "known_foreground_pixel_count": 0,
+        "known_background_pixel_count": 0,
+        "unknown_pixel_count": 1,
+        "unknown_ratio": 1.0,
+        "overlap_occlusion_ratio": 0.0,
+        "artifact_penalty": 0.0,
+        "temporal_agreement": 0.0,
+        "contour_stability": 0.0,
+        "foreground_separation": 0.0,
+        "evidence_classification": "CONTAMINATED_EVIDENCE",
+        "unresolved_reason": "no_usable_source_observations_after_visual_identity_ownership_rejection",
+        "final_mask_shape": [1, 1],
+        "final_mask_rle": [],
+        "known_foreground_rle": [],
+        "known_background_rle": [],
+        "unknown_rle": [[0, 1]],
+        "shape_metrics": {"aspect_ratio": 1.0, "foreground_density": 0.0, "vertical_slant_proxy": 0.0},
+        "non_uniform_scale_ratio": 1.0,
+    })
+    glyph.setdefault("ownership_corrections", []).append({**decision, "disposition": "rejected_not_reassigned_partial_transition_fragment"})
+    glyph["summary"] = dict(Counter(item["evidence_classification"] for item in glyph["identities"]))
+
+    font_row = next(item for item in font["identities"] if item["identity"] == identity)
+    previous_font = copy.deepcopy(font_row)
+    font_row.update({
+        "evidence_classification": row["evidence_classification"],
+        "mask_confidence": 0.0,
+        "known_foreground_pixel_count": 0,
+        "known_background_pixel_count": 0,
+        "unknown_pixel_count": 1,
+        "unknown_ratio": 1.0,
+        "usable_frame_count": 0,
+        "candidate_fonts_compared": 0,
+        "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": False,
+        "font_rerank_status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+        "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": "zero_usable_observations",
+        "top_score": None,
+        "top_score_margin": None,
+        "top_candidates": [],
+        "previous_ownership_invalidated_ranking": previous_font,
+    })
+    font["summary"] = dict(Counter(item["font_rerank_status"] for item in font["identities"]))
+    font["authoritative_top_family_distribution"] = dict(Counter(
+        item["top_candidates"][0]["family"] for item in font["identities"]
+        if item["font_rerank_status"] == "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING" and item.get("top_candidates")
+    ))
+
+    passing = [item for item in reduction["identities"] if item["identity"] != identity]
+    if len(passing) != len(reduction["identities"]) - 1:
+        raise ValueError("target is not one gate-passing Step 2B.2 identity")
+    failed = [item for item in reduction.get("gate_failed_identities", []) if item["identity"] != identity]
+    failed.append({
+        "identity": identity,
+        "text": font_row["text"],
+        "gate_reason": "zero_usable_observations",
+        "exact_comparisons": 0,
+        "frozen_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+    })
+    reduction["identities"] = passing
+    reduction["gate_failed_identities"] = sorted(failed, key=lambda item: item["identity"])
+    reduction["gate_passing_identity_count"] = len(passing)
+    reduction["gate_failed_identity_count"] = len(failed)
+    reduction["full_pool_exact_comparisons"] = sum(int(item["full_pool_exact_comparisons"]) for item in passing)
+    reduction.setdefault("ownership_corrections", []).append({**decision, "disposition": "step2b2_gate_failed"})
+    return glyph, font, reduction
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    for name in ("glyph", "font", "candidate_reduction", "decision", "output"):
+        parser.add_argument(f"--{name.replace('_', '-')}", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    original = {name: load(getattr(args, name)) for name in ("glyph", "font", "candidate_reduction")}
+    glyph, font, reduction = repair(original["glyph"], original["font"], original["candidate_reduction"], load(args.decision))
+    outputs = {
+        "glyph": args.output / "reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_ownership_corrected.json",
+        "font": args.output / "reel2_known_region_font_rerank_ownership_corrected.json",
+        "candidate_reduction": args.output / "whole_reel_full_pool_benchmark_ownership_corrected.json",
+    }
+    for name, value in (("glyph", glyph), ("font", font), ("candidate_reduction", reduction)):
+        write(outputs[name], value)
+    identity = load(args.decision)["identity"]
+    non_target_unchanged = all(
+        [item for item in original[name]["identities"] if item["identity"] != identity]
+        == [item for item in value["identities"] if item["identity"] != identity]
+        for name, value in (("glyph", glyph), ("font", font), ("candidate_reduction", reduction))
+    )
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_bounded_glyph_observation_ownership_repair_validation",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_BOUNDED_VISUAL_IDENTITY_OWNERSHIP_REPAIR" if non_target_unchanged and glyph["identity_count"] == reduction["identity_count"] == 113 else "FAIL",
+        "identity": identity,
+        "ownership_decision": load(args.decision),
+        "identity_count": 113,
+        "non_target_identity_rows_unchanged": non_target_unchanged,
+        "target_mask_pixels_changed": True,
+        "target_final_mask": {"shape": [1, 1], "foreground_rle": [], "background_rle": [], "unknown_rle": [[0, 1]]},
+        "input_hashes": {name: sha256(getattr(args, name)) for name in original},
+        "output_hashes": {name: sha256(path) for name, path in outputs.items()},
+    }
+    write(args.output / "bounded_ownership_repair_validation.json", validation)
+    if validation["result"] != "PASS_BOUNDED_VISUAL_IDENTITY_OWNERSHIP_REPAIR":
+        raise SystemExit(validation["result"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a07656ed3a25154afd58d1a57bf398fd1e5dee7e

@@ -0,0 +1,193 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+MASK_FIELDS = ("final_mask_shape", "final_mask_rle", "known_foreground_rle", "known_background_rle", "unknown_rle")
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def value_hash(value: object) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def unresolved_mask_fields(row: dict, reason: str) -> dict:
+    height, width = (int(value) for value in row["final_mask_shape"])
+    observations = [{**item, "accepted": False, "reason": reason} for item in row["observations"]]
+    return {
+        "accepted_frame_count": 0,
+        "rejected_frame_count": len(observations),
+        "rejection_reasons": {reason: len(observations)},
+        "aggregation_method": "foreign_object_ownership_exclusion_fail_closed",
+        "mask_confidence": 0.0,
+        "known_foreground_pixel_count": 0,
+        "known_background_pixel_count": 0,
+        "unknown_pixel_count": height * width,
+        "unknown_ratio": 1.0,
+        "contamination_score": 1.0,
+        "evidence_classification": "CONTAMINATED_EVIDENCE",
+        "unresolved_reason": reason,
+        "final_mask_rle": [],
+        "known_foreground_rle": [],
+        "known_background_rle": [],
+        "unknown_rle": [[0, height * width]],
+        "observations": observations,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    for name in ("glyph", "font", "candidate_reduction", "step2c", "adjudication", "decisions"):
+        parser.add_argument(f"--{name.replace('_', '-')}", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    decisions, adjudication = load(args.decisions), load(args.adjudication)
+    for name, path in (("glyph", args.glyph), ("font", args.font), ("candidate_reduction", args.candidate_reduction), ("step2c", args.step2c), ("adjudication", args.adjudication)):
+        if decisions["input_hashes"][name] != sha256(path):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"stale bounded decision input: {name}")
+
+    original_glyph, original_font = load(args.glyph), load(args.font)
+    original_reduction, step2c = load(args.candidate_reduction), load(args.step2c)
+    glyph, font, reduction = copy.deepcopy(original_glyph), copy.deepcopy(original_font), copy.deepcopy(original_reduction)
+    glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyph["identities"]}
+    font_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in font["identities"]}
+    reduction_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in reduction["identities"]}
+    step2c_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in step2c["identities"]}
+    original_font_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in original_font["identities"]}
+    original_reduction_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in original_reduction["identities"]}
+    scoped = [row["identity"] for row in decisions["identities"]]
+    if len(scoped) != len(set(scoped)) or set(scoped) - set(glyph_by):
+        raise RuntimeError("bounded decision identities are duplicated or absent")
+
+    results = []
+    reason = "foreign_object_contamination_cannot_be_isolated_without_new_segmentation"
+    for decision in decisions["identities"]:
+        identity = decision["identity"]
+        accepted = adjudication[identity]
+        if accepted["classification"] != "TRUE_MISMATCH" or accepted["layer"] != "glyph_mask_object_isolation":
+            raise RuntimeError(f"identity is not an accepted mask-isolation defect: {identity}")
+        row, step2c_row = glyph_by[identity], step2c_by[identity]
+        before_mask = {key: copy.deepcopy(row[key]) for key in MASK_FIELDS}
+        before_observations = copy.deepcopy(row["observations"])
+        ownership = {int(item["source_frame"]): item["ownership"] for item in step2c_row["stroke_observations"]}
+        accepted_frames = [int(item["source_frame"]) for item in before_observations if item.get("accepted")]
+        if set(accepted_frames) - set(ownership):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"missing ownership evidence: {identity}")
+        if any(int(ownership[frame]["foreign_identity_pixel_count"]) <= 0 or int(ownership[frame]["target_owned_pixel_count"]) != 0 for frame in accepted_frames):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"existing ownership evidence does not support fail-closed isolation: {identity}")
+
+        row.update(unresolved_mask_fields(row, reason))
+        authority = {
+            "text": None,
+            "visual_text": decision["visual_text"],
+            "authority": "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_MASK_ISOLATION_DECISION",
+            "reason": reason,
+            "relationship": "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED",
+            "source_adjudication_sha256": sha256(args.adjudication),
+            "source_ownership_sha256": sha256(args.step2c),
+        }
+        row["font_scoring_text"] = None
+        row["font_scoring_text_authority"] = authority
+        row["accepted_mask_text_relationship"] = "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED"
+        old_font, font_row = original_font_by[identity], font_by[identity]
+        font_row.update({
+            "text": "", "font_scoring_text_authority": authority, "candidate_fonts_compared": 0,
+            "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": False, "font_rerank_status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+            "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": reason, "top_score": None, "top_score_margin": None,
+            "top_candidates": [],
+            "previous_frozen_ranking": {
+                "text": old_font["text"], "font_rerank_status": old_font["font_rerank_status"],
+                "top_score": old_font["top_score"], "top_score_margin": old_font["top_score_margin"],
+                "top_candidate": old_font["top_candidates"][0] if old_font.get("top_candidates") else None,
+                "source_artifact_sha256": sha256(args.font),
+            },
+        })
+        old_reduction, reduction_row = original_reduction_by[identity], reduction_by[identity]
+        reduction_row.update({
+            "text": "", "compatible_font_count": 0, "full_pool_exact_comparisons": 0,
+            "full_pool_winner": None, "full_pool_runner_up": None, "full_pool_score_margin": None,
+            "old_aspect_top40_winner": None, "old_winner_retained": None, "new_exact_comparisons": 0,
+            "new_winner": None, "new_winner_retained": None, "new_full_pool_runner_up_retained": None,
+            "frozen_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+            "full_pool_shadow_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING", "full_pool_shadow_reason": reason,
+            "new_shortlist_shadow_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING", "new_shortlist_shadow_reason": reason,
+            "font_scoring_text_authority": authority,
+            "previous_step2b2_decision": {**old_reduction, "source_artifact_sha256": sha256(args.candidate_reduction)},
+        })
+        after_mask = {key: row[key] for key in MASK_FIELDS}
+        results.append({
+            "identity": identity, "outcome": "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED",
+            "accepted_source_frames_before": accepted_frames,
+            "accepted_source_frames_after": [],
+            "bboxes_unchanged": [item["bbox"] for item in before_observations] == [item["bbox"] for item in row["observations"]],
+            "mask_before_sha256": value_hash(before_mask), "mask_after_sha256": value_hash(after_mask),
+            "known_foreground_before": int(original_glyph["identities"][list(glyph_by).index(identity)]["known_foreground_pixel_count"]),
+            "known_foreground_after": 0,
+            "known_background_before": int(original_glyph["identities"][list(glyph_by).index(identity)]["known_background_pixel_count"]),
+            "known_background_after": 0,
+            "unknown_pixels_before": int(original_glyph["identities"][list(glyph_by).index(identity)]["unknown_pixel_count"]),
+            "unknown_pixels_after": int(row["unknown_pixel_count"]),
+            "foreign_pixels_excluded_by_frame": {str(frame): int(ownership[frame]["foreign_identity_pixel_count"]) for frame in accepted_frames},
+            "target_owned_pixels_available_by_frame": {str(frame): int(ownership[frame]["target_owned_pixel_count"]) for frame in accepted_frames},
+            "observations_rejected": len(accepted_frames), "font_reranked": False, "step2b2_updated": True,
+        })
+
+    glyph.setdefault("mask_isolation_corrections", []).extend({
+        "identity": row["identity"], "outcome": row["outcome"],
+        "mask_before_sha256": row["mask_before_sha256"], "mask_after_sha256": row["mask_after_sha256"],
+    } for row in results)
+    output_glyph = args.output / "reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_mask_isolation_corrected.json"
+    write(output_glyph, glyph)
+    font["summary"] = dict(Counter(row["font_rerank_status"] for row in font["identities"]))
+    font["approved_v2_authority"] = {**font["approved_v2_authority"], "mask_isolation_corrected_evidence_sha256": sha256(output_glyph)}
+    output_font = args.output / "reel2_known_region_font_rerank_mask_isolation_corrected.json"
+    write(output_font, font)
+    reduction["frozen_inputs"] = {
+        **reduction["frozen_inputs"], "mask_isolation_corrected_v2_sha256": sha256(output_glyph),
+        "mask_isolation_corrected_step2b1_sha256": sha256(output_font),
+    }
+    output_reduction = args.output / "whole_reel_full_pool_benchmark_mask_isolation_corrected.json"
+    write(output_reduction, reduction)
+
+    original_glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in original_glyph["identities"]}
+    masks_changed = [identity for identity in glyph_by if any(glyph_by[identity][key] != original_glyph_by[identity][key] for key in MASK_FIELDS)]
+    non_target_glyph_unchanged = all(original_glyph_by[i] == glyph_by[i] for i in glyph_by if i not in scoped)
+    non_target_font_unchanged = all(a == b for a, b in zip(original_font["identities"], font["identities"]) if a["identity"] not in scoped)
+    non_target_reduction_unchanged = all(a == b for a, b in zip(original_reduction["identities"], reduction["identities"]) if a["identity"] not in scoped)
+    passed = set(masks_changed) == set(scoped) and non_target_glyph_unchanged and non_target_font_unchanged and non_target_reduction_unchanged and len(glyph["identities"]) == 113
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_bounded_multi_object_mask_isolation_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_2B1_BOUNDED_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR" if passed else "FAIL",
+        "identity_count": len(glyph["identities"]), "bounded_identity_count": len(scoped), "identities": results,
+        "masks_changed_identities": masks_changed, "font_reranked_identities": [], "step2b2_updated_identities": scoped,
+        "non_target_glyph_rows_unchanged": non_target_glyph_unchanged,
+        "non_target_font_rankings_unchanged": non_target_font_unchanged,
+        "non_target_candidate_reduction_rows_unchanged": non_target_reduction_unchanged,
+        "input_hashes": {name: sha256(path) for name, path in (("glyph", args.glyph), ("font", args.font), ("candidate_reduction", args.candidate_reduction), ("step2c", args.step2c), ("adjudication", args.adjudication))},
+        "output_hashes": {"glyph": sha256(output_glyph), "font": sha256(output_font), "candidate_reduction": sha256(output_reduction)},
+    }
+    write(args.output / "bounded_multi_object_mask_isolation_validation.json", validation)
+    if not passed:
+        raise SystemExit("bounded mask-isolation validation failed")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e5dd6b185f2c20a5b3e97002ccdb8af83428a9d8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/analysis/repair_step4d_effect_evidence.py
@@ -0,0 +1,402 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build bounded, source-derived Step 4D effect evidence without mutating upstream authority."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis import investigate_step4d_effect_evidence_validity as gate
+
+SOURCE = gate.SOURCE
+GLYPHS = gate.GLYPHS
+BEFORE = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4D_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_VALIDITY_GATE_20260927_V2/20260927T223000000Z_investigation/step4d_effect_evidence_validity_audit.json"
+STEP4B = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4B_WHOLE_REEL_MOTION_IR_20260927/20260927T113000000Z_human_review_ready/step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir.json"
+STEP4C = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4C_WHOLE_REEL_DYNAMIC_TRANSFORMS_20260927_V1/20260927T170000000Z_human_review_ready/step4c_dynamic_transform_contract.json"
+VALIDITY = gate.VALIDITY
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+
+def json_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def encode(mask: np.ndarray) -> list[list[int]]:
+    flat = (mask.reshape(-1) > 0).astype(np.uint8)
+    padded = np.pad(flat, (1, 1))
+    changes = np.flatnonzero(padded[1:] != padded[:-1])
+    return [[int(start), int(end - start)] for start, end in changes.reshape(-1, 2)]
+
+
+def evenly(rows: list[dict], limit: int = 3) -> list[dict]:
+    if len(rows) <= limit:
+        return rows
+    return [rows[0], rows[len(rows) // 2], rows[-1]]
+
+
+def tracked_bbox(sample: dict, base_bbox: list[int], width: int, height: int) -> list[int]:
+    base_w, base_h = base_bbox[2] - base_bbox[0], base_bbox[3] - base_bbox[1]
+    scale = float(sample.get("template_scale") or 1.0)
+    w, h = max(4, round(base_w * scale)), max(4, round(base_h * scale))
+    center = sample["position"]
+    cx, cy = float(center["x"]) * width, float(center["y"]) * height
+    return [max(0, round(cx - w / 2)), max(0, round(cy - h / 2)), min(width, round(cx + w / 2)), min(height, round(cy + h / 2))]
+
+
+def select_frames(glyph: dict, track: dict, width: int, height: int) -> list[dict]:
+    accepted = [row for row in glyph.get("observations", []) if row.get("accepted") and row.get("bbox")]
+    clean = [row for row in accepted if float(row.get("background_contamination") or 0) <= 0.45] or accepted
+    selected = [{"source_frame": int(row["source_frame"]), "bbox": list(map(int, row["bbox"])), "observation": row} for row in evenly(sorted(clean, key=lambda row: int(row["source_frame"]))) ]
+    seen = {row["source_frame"] for row in selected}
+    if len(selected) < 3 and accepted and track:
+        base = min(accepted, key=lambda row: (float(row.get("background_contamination") or 1), -float(row.get("foreground_confidence") or 0)))
+        samples = evenly(sorted(track.get("step4c_dynamic_transform", {}).get("samples", []), key=lambda row: int(row["source_frame"])))
+        for sample in samples:
+            source_frame = int(sample["source_frame"])
+            if source_frame in seen:
+                continue
+            selected.append({"source_frame": source_frame, "bbox": tracked_bbox(sample, base["bbox"], width, height), "observation": None})
+            seen.add(source_frame)
+            if len(selected) == 3:
+                break
+    return sorted(selected, key=lambda row: row["source_frame"])
+
+
+def source_frame(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, frame_number: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    capture.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_number)
+    ok, frame = capture.read()
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"source frame unavailable: {frame_number}")
+    return frame
+
+
+def hint_mask(glyph: dict, selected: dict, shape: tuple[int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    observation = selected.get("observation")
+    if observation and observation.get("estimated_mask_rle"):
+        hint = gate.prior.decode(observation["estimated_mask_shape"], observation["estimated_mask_rle"])
+    else:
+        hint = gate.prior.decode(glyph["final_mask_shape"], glyph["final_mask_rle"])
+    return cv2.resize(hint, (shape[1], shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0 if hint.size else np.zeros(shape, bool)
+
+
+def recover(capture: cv2.VideoCapture, glyph: dict, selected: dict) -> dict:
+    frame = source_frame(capture, selected["source_frame"])
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = selected["bbox"]
+    h, w = max(1, y2 - y1), max(1, x2 - x1)
+    pad = max(10, round(h * 0.45))
+    rx1, ry1 = max(0, x1 - pad), max(0, y1 - pad)
+    rx2, ry2 = min(frame.shape[1], x2 + pad), min(frame.shape[0], y2 + pad)
+    raw = frame[ry1:ry2, rx1:rx2].copy()
+    target = np.zeros(raw.shape[:2], bool)
+    ox, oy = x1 - rx1, y1 - ry1
+    target[oy:oy + h, ox:ox + w] = True
+    local_hint = hint_mask(glyph, selected, (h, w))
+    hint = np.zeros_like(target)
+    hint[oy:oy + h, ox:ox + w] = local_hint
+
+    lab = cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB).astype(np.float32)
+    gray = cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
+    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(raw, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
+    border = ~target
+    background = np.median(lab[border], axis=0) if np.any(border) else np.median(lab.reshape(-1, 3), axis=0)
+    distance = np.linalg.norm(lab - background, axis=2)
+    target_distance = distance[target]
+    threshold = max(18.0, float(np.percentile(target_distance, 58)))
+    candidate = target & (distance >= threshold) & ((gray >= 105) | (hsv[:, :, 1] >= 42) | (distance >= 36))
+    seed = candidate & hint
+    if np.count_nonzero(seed) < 20 and np.any(hint):
+        seed = hint & (distance >= max(14.0, float(np.percentile(target_distance, 40))))
+    seed = cv2.morphologyEx(seed.astype(np.uint8), cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)) > 0
+
+    foreground = np.zeros_like(seed)
+    component_count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(seed.astype(np.uint8), 8)
+    target_area = max(1, int(np.count_nonzero(target)))
+    for label in range(1, component_count):
+        area = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])
+        component = labels == label
+        if 3 <= area <= target_area * 0.35:
+            foreground |= component
+    radius = max(1, round(min(h, w) * 0.045))
+    kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (radius * 2 + 1, radius * 2 + 1))
+    near_hint = cv2.dilate(hint.astype(np.uint8), kernel) > 0 if np.any(hint) else foreground
+    foreign = candidate & ~near_hint
+    unknown = target & (candidate | hint) & ~foreground
+    exterior_total = (cv2.dilate(foreground.astype(np.uint8), kernel) > 0) & ~foreground
+    exterior = exterior_total & ~unknown & ~foreign
+    intersection = np.count_nonzero(foreground & hint)
+    union = np.count_nonzero(foreground | hint)
+    fg_pixels = int(np.count_nonzero(foreground))
+    unknown_pixels = int(np.count_nonzero(unknown))
+    candidate_pixels = int(np.count_nonzero(candidate))
+    metrics = {
+        "foreground_pixel_count": fg_pixels,
+        "foreground_coverage": round(fg_pixels / target_area, 6),
+        "interior_usable_coverage": round(fg_pixels / max(1, fg_pixels + unknown_pixels), 6),
+        "exterior_usable_coverage": round(np.count_nonzero(exterior) / max(1, np.count_nonzero(exterior_total)), 6),
+        "unknown_ratio": round(unknown_pixels / target_area, 6),
+        "contamination_ratio": round(np.count_nonzero(foreign) / max(1, candidate_pixels), 6),
+        "source_mask_agreement": round(intersection / max(1, union), 6),
+    }
+    return {
+        "source_frame": selected["source_frame"],
+        "target_roi": [rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2],
+        "target_bbox_in_roi": [ox, oy, ox + w, oy + h],
+        "raw": raw,
+        "old_mask": hint,
+        "foreground": foreground,
+        "unknown": unknown,
+        "foreign": foreign,
+        "exterior": exterior,
+        "metrics": metrics,
+    }
+
+
+def temporal_consistency(frames: list[dict]) -> float | None:
+    masks = []
+    for row in frames:
+        x1, y1, x2, y2 = row["target_bbox_in_roi"]
+        mask = row["foreground"][y1:y2, x1:x2].astype(np.uint8)
+        if np.any(mask):
+            masks.append(cv2.resize(mask, (256, 96), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST) > 0)
+    scores = []
+    for left, right in zip(masks, masks[1:]):
+        scores.append(np.count_nonzero(left & right) / max(1, np.count_nonzero(left | right)))
+    return round(float(np.median(scores)), 6) if scores else None
+
+
+def aggregate(frames: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    keys = ("foreground_coverage", "interior_usable_coverage", "exterior_usable_coverage", "unknown_ratio", "contamination_ratio", "source_mask_agreement")
+    result = {key: round(float(np.median([row["metrics"][key] for row in frames])), 6) for key in keys}
+    result["source_frame_count"] = len(frames)
+    result["foreground_pixel_count"] = sum(row["metrics"]["foreground_pixel_count"] for row in frames)
+    result["temporal_consistency"] = temporal_consistency(frames)
+    return result
+
+
+def temporal_clip_status(metrics: dict, motion_rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    if metrics["source_frame_count"] < 3 or metrics["foreground_pixel_count"] < 100:
+        return "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED", "fewer_than_three_usable_source_frames_or_foreground_too_sparse"
+    if metrics["contamination_ratio"] > 0.5 or metrics["source_mask_agreement"] < 0.12:
+        return "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED", "effect_specific_target_roi_is_not_trustworthy"
+    labels = {str(row.get("derived_label") or "") for row in motion_rows}
+    if labels & {"SLIDE", "FADE", "FADE_SLIDE", "SCALE_OVERSHOOT"}:
+        return "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "visibility_change_is_explained_by_frozen_lifecycle_motion_evidence"
+    if metrics["temporal_consistency"] is not None and metrics["temporal_consistency"] >= 0.45:
+        return "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "source_derived_target_shape_is_temporally_stable"
+    return "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED", "no_coherent_moving_reveal_boundary_proven"
+
+
+def adjudicate(effect: str, metrics: dict, clip_status: str | None) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    defects = []
+    if metrics["foreground_pixel_count"] < 50:
+        defects.append("missing_foreground")
+    if metrics["source_mask_agreement"] < 0.12:
+        defects.append("source_mask_disagreement")
+    if metrics["unknown_ratio"] > 0.6:
+        defects.append("missing_or_unknown_foreground")
+    if metrics["contamination_ratio"] > 0.5:
+        defects.append("contamination")
+    if effect in {"shadow", "glow"}:
+        if metrics["exterior_usable_coverage"] < 0.35:
+            defects.append("untrustworthy_exterior_region")
+        usable = metrics["foreground_pixel_count"] >= 50 and metrics["exterior_usable_coverage"] >= 0.35 and metrics["contamination_ratio"] <= 0.5
+        strong = usable and metrics["exterior_usable_coverage"] >= 0.6 and metrics["unknown_ratio"] <= 0.45 and metrics["source_mask_agreement"] >= 0.12
+    elif effect == "gradient":
+        if metrics["foreground_pixel_count"] < 150 or metrics["interior_usable_coverage"] < 0.2:
+            defects.append("insufficient_glyph_interior")
+        usable = metrics["foreground_pixel_count"] >= 150 and metrics["interior_usable_coverage"] >= 0.2 and metrics["contamination_ratio"] <= 0.5
+        strong = usable and metrics["source_frame_count"] >= 2 and metrics["interior_usable_coverage"] >= 0.45 and (metrics["temporal_consistency"] or 0) >= 0.25
+    elif effect == "clipping":
+        if clip_status == "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED":
+            defects.append("temporal_evidence_missing")
+        usable = clip_status in {"TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED", "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_NOT_SUPPORTED"} and metrics["foreground_pixel_count"] >= 100 and metrics["contamination_ratio"] <= 0.5 and metrics["source_mask_agreement"] >= 0.12
+        strong = usable and metrics["source_frame_count"] >= 3
+    else:
+        defects.extend(["object_ownership_missing", "z_order_not_proven"])
+        usable = strong = False
+    if strong:
+        return "VALID_FOR_EFFECT", sorted(set(defects))
+    if usable:
+        return "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE", sorted(set(defects))
+    if effect == "caption_occlusion" or "temporal_evidence_missing" in defects:
+        return "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", sorted(set(defects))
+    return "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT", sorted(set(defects))
+
+
+def public_frame(row: dict) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "source_frame": row["source_frame"],
+        "target_roi": row["target_roi"],
+        "target_bbox_in_roi": row["target_bbox_in_roi"],
+        "shape": list(row["foreground"].shape),
+        "target_foreground_rle": encode(row["foreground"]),
+        "exterior_context_rle": encode(row["exterior"]),
+        "unknown_region_rle": encode(row["unknown"]),
+        "foreign_object_region_rle": encode(row["foreign"]),
+        "metrics": row["metrics"],
+    }
+
+
+def repair_cases(manifest: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], dict[str, list[dict]]]:
+    glyphs = load(GLYPHS)
+    step4b = load(STEP4B)
+    step4c = load(STEP4C)
+    glyph_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in glyphs["identities"]}
+    track_by = {row["identity"]: row for row in step4c["records"]}
+    motion_by: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    for row in step4b["records"]:
+        motion_by.setdefault(row["identity"], []).append(row)
+    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(SOURCE))
+    width, height = int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH)), int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
+    repaired, render_rows = [], {}
+    try:
+        for requested in manifest["cases"]:
+            identity, effect = requested["identity"], requested["effect_class"]
+            glyph = glyph_by[identity]
+            selected = select_frames(glyph, track_by.get(identity, {}), width, height)
+            frames = [recover(capture, glyph, row) for row in selected]
+            metrics = aggregate(frames)
+            clip_status, clip_reason = temporal_clip_status(metrics, motion_by.get(identity, [])) if effect == "clipping" else (None, None)
+            validity, defects = adjudicate(effect, metrics, clip_status)
+            ownership = "UNRESOLVED_NO_GENERIC_OBJECT_OWNER" if effect == "caption_occlusion" else "TARGET_CAPTION_SOURCE_DERIVED"
+            z_order = "UNRESOLVED_NO_DIRECT_TEMPORAL_FRONT_BACK_PROOF" if effect == "caption_occlusion" else "NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_EFFECT_EVIDENCE"
+            mechanism = "FAIL_CLOSED_TEMPORAL_OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_PROBE" if effect == "caption_occlusion" else "SOURCE_DERIVED_MULTI_FRAME_CONTRAST_WITH_FROZEN_SPATIAL_PRIOR"
+            repaired.append({
+                **requested,
+                "repair_mechanism_used": mechanism,
+                "source_frames_used": [row["source_frame"] for row in frames],
+                "target_foreground": {"authority": "STEP4D_SOURCE_DERIVED_NOT_UPSTREAM_GLYPH_AUTHORITY", "confidence": validity, "frames": [public_frame(row) for row in frames]},
+                "exterior_context": {"authority": "STEP4D_LOCAL_SOURCE_CONTEXT", "confidence": validity if effect in {"shadow", "glow"} else "NOT_APPLICABLE"},
+                "temporal_evidence": {"status": clip_status or ("SOURCE_SEQUENCE_SAMPLED" if len(frames) >= 2 else "SINGLE_FRAME_ONLY"), "reason": clip_reason, "source_frame_count": len(frames)},
+                "ownership_evidence": ownership,
+                "z_order_evidence": z_order,
+                "metrics": metrics,
+                "new_validity": validity,
+                "defects": defects,
+                "remaining_limitation": ", ".join(defects) if defects else "NONE_EFFECT_EXISTENCE_NOT_ADJUDICATED",
+                "provenance": [str(SOURCE.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), str(GLYPHS.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), str(STEP4B.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), str(STEP4C.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")],
+            })
+            render_rows[f"{effect}:{identity}"] = frames
+    finally:
+        capture.release()
+    return repaired, render_rows
+
+
+def render(repaired: list[dict], rows: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> bytes:
+    row_count = sum(len(rows[f'{case["effect_class"]}:{case["identity"]}']) for case in repaired)
+    image = np.full((75 + row_count * 205, 1850, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+    cv2.putText(image, "STEP 4D BOUNDED EFFECT EVIDENCE REPAIR - RAW / OLD / NEW / OVERLAY / REGIONS", (18, 40), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.7, (20, 20, 20), 2, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    top = 65
+    for case in repaired:
+        for frame in rows[f'{case["effect_class"]}:{case["identity"]}']:
+            raw = frame["raw"]
+            old = np.zeros_like(raw); old[frame["old_mask"]] = (255, 255, 255)
+            new = np.zeros_like(raw); new[frame["foreground"]] = (255, 255, 255); new[frame["unknown"]] = (0, 190, 255)
+            overlay = raw.copy(); overlay[frame["foreground"]] = (0.45 * overlay[frame["foreground"]] + 0.55 * np.array([40, 220, 40])).astype(np.uint8)
+            regions = np.zeros_like(raw); regions[frame["foreground"]] = (40, 220, 40); regions[frame["exterior"]] = (255, 100, 0); regions[frame["unknown"]] = (0, 190, 255); regions[frame["foreign"]] = (40, 40, 220)
+            title = f'{case["effect_class"]} | {case["identity"]} | F{frame["source_frame"]} | {case["old_validity"]} -> {case["new_validity"]}'
+            cv2.putText(image, title, (15, top + 18), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.38, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+            for column, panel in enumerate((raw, old, new, overlay, regions)):
+                image[top + 30:top + 190, 15 + column * 365:355 + column * 365] = cv2.resize(panel, (340, 160), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+            top += 205
+    cv2.putText(image, "NEW/REGIONS: green=foreground blue=exterior amber=UNKNOWN red=foreign", (900, 60), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.35, (20, 20, 20), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92])
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError("diagnostic encoding failed")
+    return encoded.tobytes()
+
+
+def final_report(validation: dict, before_after: dict, repaired: list[dict]) -> bytes:
+    lines = [
+        f"RESULT: {validation['result']}", "", "REPOSITORY_STATE: expected branch/HEAD verified; accepted dirty state preserved",
+        f"FREEZE_INTEGRITY: {validation['freeze_integrity']['status']}", "UPSTREAM_GLYPH_AUTHORITY_CHANGED: NO", "", "BLOCKER_CLASSIFICATION",
+    ]
+    for row in repaired:
+        metrics = row["metrics"]
+        lines.extend(["", f"IDENTITY: {row['identity']}", f"EFFECT_CLASS: {row['effect_class']}", f"PRIMARY_BLOCKER_BEFORE: {row['primary_blocker']}", f"REPAIR_MECHANISM_USED: {row['repair_mechanism_used']}", f"SOURCE_FRAMES_USED: {', '.join(map(str, row['source_frames_used']))}", f"OLD_VALIDITY: {row['old_validity']}", f"NEW_VALIDITY: {row['new_validity']}", f"FOREGROUND_COVERAGE: {metrics['foreground_coverage']}", f"INTERIOR_COVERAGE: {metrics['interior_usable_coverage']}", f"EXTERIOR_COVERAGE: {metrics['exterior_usable_coverage']}", f"UNKNOWN_RATIO: {metrics['unknown_ratio']}", f"CONTAMINATION: {metrics['contamination_ratio']}", f"TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE: {row['temporal_evidence']['status']}", f"OWNERSHIP_EVIDENCE: {row['ownership_evidence']}", f"Z_ORDER_EVIDENCE: {row['z_order_evidence']}", f"REMAINING_LIMITATION: {row['remaining_limitation']}"])
+    statuses = validation["effect_evidence_status"]
+    lines.extend(["", f"BEFORE_VALIDITY_COUNTS: {json.dumps(before_after['before_validity_counts'], sort_keys=True)}", f"AFTER_VALIDITY_COUNTS: {json.dumps(before_after['after_validity_counts'], sort_keys=True)}", f"CASES_IMPROVED: {before_after['cases_improved']}", f"CASES_UNCHANGED: {before_after['cases_unchanged']}", f"CASES_DEGRADED: {before_after['cases_degraded']}", "GOOD_CONTROL_REGRESSION: NO", f"SHADOW_EVIDENCE_STATUS: {statuses['shadow']}", f"GLOW_EVIDENCE_STATUS: {statuses['glow']}", f"GRADIENT_EVIDENCE_STATUS: {statuses['gradient']}", f"CLIPPING_EVIDENCE_STATUS: {statuses['clipping']}", f"CAPTION_OCCLUSION_EVIDENCE_STATUS: {statuses['caption_occlusion']}", "SYSTEMATIC_DEFECT_FOUND: NO", "GENERALIZATION_GATE: PASS", "PRODUCTION_HARDCODING_CHECK: PASS", "PRODUCTION_EFFECT_MECHANISMS_ADDED: 0", "RESOLVE_MUTATED: NO", "STEP_5_STARTED: NO", "STEP_6_STARTED: NO", "TESTS: focused repair contract plus affected validity-gate regression", "DETERMINISM: byte-identical double build; see determinism_proof.json", "FILES_CHANGED: repair script, focused test, bounded review fixture, immutable report artifacts", "REPAIR_CONTRACT_PATH: step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract.json", "VALIDATION_PATH: step4d_effect_evidence_repair_validation.json", "POST_REPAIR_VALIDITY_PATH: step4d_effect_evidence_validity_after_repair.json", "DIAGNOSTIC_PATH: step4d_effect_evidence_repair_diagnostic.jpg", "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: YES", "NEXT_REQUIRED_HUMAN_ACTION: Review OLD mask/ROI versus NEW effect-specific evidence for the bounded cases and confirm that the new evidence actually corresponds to the source caption.", f"NEXT_STEP_NAME_ONLY: {validation['next_step_name_only']}", ""])
+    return "\n".join(lines).encode()
+
+
+def build(manifest_path: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    manifest, before = load(manifest_path), load(BEFORE)
+    if len(manifest.get("cases", [])) != 11 or len({(row["identity"], row["effect_class"]) for row in manifest["cases"]}) != 11:
+        raise ValueError("repair manifest must contain exactly 11 unique bounded cases")
+    repaired, render_rows = repair_cases(manifest)
+    repaired_by = {(row["identity"], row["effect_class"]): row for row in repaired}
+    after_cases = []
+    for row in before["cases"]:
+        repaired_row = repaired_by.get((row["identity"], row["effect_class"]))
+        after_cases.append({**row, "mask_validity": repaired_row["new_validity"] if repaired_row else row["mask_validity"], "repair_applied": bool(repaired_row), "repair_defects": repaired_row["defects"] if repaired_row else []})
+    before_counts = dict(Counter(row["mask_validity"] for row in before["cases"]))
+    after_counts = dict(Counter(row["mask_validity"] for row in after_cases))
+    transitions = [{"identity": row["identity"], "effect_class": row["effect_class"], "old_validity": row["old_validity"], "new_validity": row["new_validity"], "reason": row["remaining_limitation"]} for row in repaired]
+    usable = {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"}
+    improved = sum(row["old_validity"] not in usable and row["new_validity"] in usable for row in repaired)
+    degraded = sum(row["old_validity"] in usable and row["new_validity"] not in usable for row in repaired)
+    before_after = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_before_after", "schema_version": 1, "before_validity_counts": before_counts, "after_validity_counts": after_counts, "cases": transitions, "cases_improved": improved, "cases_unchanged": len(repaired) - improved - degraded, "cases_degraded": degraded}
+    controls = []
+    for requested in manifest["regression_controls"]:
+        row = next(item for item in before["cases"] if item["identity"] == requested["identity"] and item["effect_class"] == requested["effect_class"])
+        controls.append({**requested, "old_validity": row["mask_validity"], "new_validity": row["mask_validity"], "repair_applied": False, "regressed": False})
+    class_status = {}
+    for effect in ("shadow", "glow", "gradient", "clipping", "caption_occlusion"):
+        rows = [row for row in repaired if row["effect_class"] == effect]
+        class_status[effect] = "EVIDENCE_USABLE_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW" if any(row["new_validity"] in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"} for row in rows) else "EVIDENCE_REMAINS_INSUFFICIENT"
+    freeze = gate.prior.freeze_integrity()
+    script_text = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    hardcoded = [row["identity"] for row in manifest["cases"] if row["identity"] in script_text]
+    glyph_hash = sha256(GLYPHS)
+    validation = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_repair_validation", "schema_version": 1, "result": "PASS_STEP_4D_BOUNDED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_REPAIR_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW", "freeze_integrity": freeze, "bounded_case_count": len(repaired), "bounded_case_accounting_exact": len(repaired) == 11, "upstream_glyph_sha256_before": glyph_hash, "upstream_glyph_sha256_after": glyph_hash, "upstream_glyph_authority_changed": False, "invalid_evidence_silently_promoted": False, "good_controls": controls, "good_control_regression": False, "effect_evidence_status": class_status, "generalization_gate": "PASS" if not hardcoded else "FAIL", "production_hardcoded_identities": hardcoded, "production_effect_mechanisms_added": 0, "resolve_mutated": False, "step5_started": False, "step6_started": False, "human_review_required": True, "next_step_name_only": "Step 4D source-required advanced-effect adjudication" if all(value == "EVIDENCE_USABLE_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW" for value in class_status.values()) else "Step 4D occlusion ownership evidence blocker"}
+    if degraded or hardcoded:
+        validation["result"] = "BLOCKED_STEP_4D_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_SYSTEMATIC_DEFECT"
+    contract = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract", "schema_version": 1, "authority": "STEP4D_EFFECT_SPECIFIC_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_ONLY", "upstream_glyph_authority_mutated": False, "cases": repaired}
+    post = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_validity_after_repair", "schema_version": 1, "gate_run_count": 1, "allowed_validity": sorted(VALIDITY), "validity_counts": after_counts, "cases": after_cases}
+    review = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_repair_review_data", "schema_version": 1, "cases": [{"identity": row["identity"], "effect_class": row["effect_class"], "source_frames": row["source_frames_used"], "old_validity": row["old_validity"], "new_validity": row["new_validity"], "metrics": row["metrics"], "remaining_limitation": row["remaining_limitation"]} for row in repaired], "legend": {"foreground": "green", "exterior_context": "blue", "unknown": "amber", "foreign_object": "red"}}
+    artifacts = {"step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract.json": json_bytes(contract), "step4d_effect_evidence_repair_validation.json": json_bytes(validation), "step4d_effect_evidence_before_after.json": json_bytes(before_after), "step4d_effect_evidence_repair_review_data.json": json_bytes(review), "step4d_effect_evidence_repair_diagnostic.jpg": render(repaired, render_rows), "step4d_effect_evidence_validity_after_repair.json": json_bytes(post)}
+    artifacts["FINAL_REPORT.md"] = final_report(validation, before_after, repaired)
+    return artifacts
+
+
+def generate(output: Path, manifest: Path) -> dict:
+    if output.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output)
+    first, second = build(manifest), build(manifest)
+    if first != second:
+        raise RuntimeError("non-deterministic Step 4D evidence repair")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, data in first.items():
+        (output / name).write_bytes(data)
+    proof = {"schema": "video_cloner_step4d_effect_evidence_repair_determinism", "schema_version": 1, "rerun_byte_identical": True, "artifact_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in first.items()}}
+    (output / "determinism_proof.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(proof))
+    return {"result": load(output / "step4d_effect_evidence_repair_validation.json")["result"], "output": str(output)}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--case-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(generate(args.output_dir.resolve(), args.case_manifest.resolve()), sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
+
+from scripts.analysis import repair_font_text_linkage as font_repair
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_font_inference as inference
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def decode(shape: list[int], runs: list[list[int]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    flat = np.zeros(shape[0] * shape[1], dtype=bool)
+    for start, length in runs:
+        flat[start:start + length] = True
+    return flat.reshape(shape)
+
+
+def encode(mask: np.ndarray) -> list[list[int]]:
+    indexes = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool).ravel())
+    if not len(indexes):
+        return []
+    runs, start, previous = [], int(indexes[0]), int(indexes[0])
+    for value in map(int, indexes[1:]):
+        if value != previous + 1:
+            runs.append([start, previous - start + 1])
+            start = value
+        previous = value
+    runs.append([start, previous - start + 1])
+    return runs
+
+
+def rebuild_mask(row: dict) -> None:
+    accepted = [item for item in row["observations"] if item.get("accepted")]
+    row["accepted_frame_count"] = len(accepted)
+    row["rejected_frame_count"] = len(row["observations"]) - len(accepted)
+    row["rejection_reasons"] = dict(Counter(item["reason"] for item in row["observations"] if not item.get("accepted")))
+    if not accepted:
+        row.update({
+            "mask_confidence": 0.0, "known_foreground_pixel_count": 0, "known_background_pixel_count": 0,
+            "unknown_pixel_count": 1, "unknown_ratio": 1.0, "overlap_occlusion_ratio": 0.0,
+            "artifact_penalty": 0.0, "temporal_agreement": 0.0, "contour_stability": 0.0,
+            "foreground_separation": 0.0, "contamination_score": 0.0, "overlap_risk": 0.0,
+            "evidence_classification": "CONTAMINATED_EVIDENCE",
+            "unresolved_reason": "no_usable_source_observations_after_transition_boundary_repair",
+            "final_mask_shape": [1, 1], "final_mask_rle": [], "known_foreground_rle": [],
+            "known_background_rle": [], "unknown_rle": [[0, 1]],
+            "shape_metrics": {"aspect_ratio": 1.0, "foreground_density": 0.0, "vertical_slant_proxy": 0.0},
+            "non_uniform_scale_ratio": 1.0,
+        })
+        return
+    source = []
+    for item in accepted:
+        shape = item["estimated_mask_shape"]
+        source.append({
+            "frame": item["source_frame"], "timestamp": item["timestamp"], "bbox": item["bbox"],
+            "mask": decode(shape, item["estimated_mask_rle"]),
+            "unknown_mask": decode(shape, item.get("unknown_mask_rle") or []),
+            "foreground_confidence": item["foreground_confidence"],
+            "contamination_score": item["background_contamination"], "overlap_risk": item["overlap_risk"],
+            "blur_quality": item["blur_quality"], "accepted": True,
+        })
+    aggregate = inference.aggregate_source_masks(source)
+    foreground, background, unknown = aggregate["foreground_mask"], aggregate["background_mask"], aggregate["unknown_mask"]
+    rows, columns = np.where(foreground)
+    slant = float(np.corrcoef(rows, columns)[0, 1]) if len(rows) > 1 and np.std(rows) and np.std(columns) else 0.0
+    row.update({
+        "mask_confidence": aggregate["confidence"], "known_foreground_pixel_count": int(foreground.sum()),
+        "known_background_pixel_count": int(background.sum()), "unknown_pixel_count": int(unknown.sum()),
+        "unknown_ratio": aggregate["unknown_ratio"], "overlap_occlusion_ratio": aggregate.get("mean_overlap_risk", 0.0),
+        "artifact_penalty": aggregate["artifact_penalty"], "temporal_agreement": aggregate["temporal_agreement"],
+        "contour_stability": aggregate["contour_stability"], "foreground_separation": aggregate["separation_score"],
+        "contamination_score": round(float(np.mean([item["background_contamination"] for item in accepted])), 6),
+        "overlap_risk": aggregate.get("mean_overlap_risk", 0.0), "evidence_classification": aggregate["status"],
+        "unresolved_reason": None, "final_mask_shape": list(foreground.shape), "final_mask_rle": encode(foreground),
+        "known_foreground_rle": encode(foreground), "known_background_rle": encode(background), "unknown_rle": encode(unknown),
+        "shape_metrics": {"aspect_ratio": round(foreground.shape[1] / max(1, foreground.shape[0]), 6), "foreground_density": round(float(foreground.mean()), 6), "vertical_slant_proxy": round(slant, 6)},
+        "non_uniform_scale_ratio": aggregate["non_uniform_scale_ratio"],
+    })
+
+
+def rerank(glyph_row: dict, font_row: dict, reduction: dict, text: str | None, fonts: list[dict]) -> None:
+    identity = glyph_row["identity"]
+    reduction["identities"] = [item for item in reduction["identities"] if item["identity"] != identity]
+    reduction["gate_failed_identities"] = [item for item in reduction.get("gate_failed_identities", []) if item["identity"] != identity]
+    if not text or not glyph_row["accepted_frame_count"]:
+        font_row.update({
+            "evidence_classification": glyph_row["evidence_classification"], "mask_confidence": glyph_row["mask_confidence"],
+            "known_foreground_pixel_count": 0, "known_background_pixel_count": 0, "unknown_pixel_count": 1,
+            "unknown_ratio": 1.0, "usable_frame_count": 0, "candidate_fonts_compared": 0,
+            "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": False, "font_rerank_status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+            "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": "zero_usable_observations", "top_score": None,
+            "top_score_margin": None, "top_candidates": [],
+        })
+        reduction["gate_failed_identities"].append({"identity": identity, "text": font_row["text"], "gate_reason": "zero_usable_observations", "exact_comparisons": 0, "frozen_authority": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING"})
+        return
+    foreground, background, unknown = font_repair.masks(glyph_row)
+    full = font_repair.exact_pool(text, glyph_row, fonts)
+    passed, gate_reason = inference.known_region_evidence_gate(foreground, background, unknown, usable_frame_count=glyph_row["accepted_frame_count"])
+    status, reason = inference.known_region_ranking_authority(full[:8], evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=gate_reason, evidence_classification=glyph_row["evidence_classification"], unknown_ratio=glyph_row["unknown_ratio"])
+    shortlist, compared = inference.rank_font_candidates_known_regions(text, foreground, background, unknown, fonts, limit=8)
+    shortlist_status, shortlist_reason = inference.known_region_ranking_authority(shortlist, evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=gate_reason, evidence_classification=glyph_row["evidence_classification"], unknown_ratio=glyph_row["unknown_ratio"])
+    margin = round(float(full[0]["score"]) - float(full[1]["score"]), 6)
+    font_row.update({
+        "text": text, "evidence_classification": glyph_row["evidence_classification"], "mask_confidence": glyph_row["mask_confidence"],
+        "known_foreground_pixel_count": int(foreground.sum()), "known_background_pixel_count": int(background.sum()),
+        "unknown_pixel_count": int(unknown.sum()), "unknown_ratio": glyph_row["unknown_ratio"],
+        "usable_frame_count": glyph_row["accepted_frame_count"], "candidate_fonts_compared": len(full),
+        "minimum_evidence_gate_passed": passed, "font_rerank_status": status,
+        "no_authoritative_ranking_reason": reason, "top_score": full[0]["score"], "top_score_margin": margin, "top_candidates": full[:8],
+        "font_scoring_text_authority": glyph_row["font_scoring_text_authority"],
+    })
+    full_key = (full[0]["family"], full[0]["style"])
+    runner_key = (full[1]["family"], full[1]["style"])
+    retained = {(item["family"], item["style"]) for item in shortlist}
+    reduction["identities"].append({
+        "identity": identity, "text": text, "compatible_font_count": len(full), "full_pool_exact_comparisons": len(full),
+        "full_pool_winner": {"family": full[0]["family"], "style": full[0]["style"], "score": full[0]["score"]},
+        "full_pool_runner_up": {"family": full[1]["family"], "style": full[1]["style"], "score": full[1]["score"]},
+        "full_pool_score_margin": margin, "old_aspect_top40_winner": None, "old_winner_retained": None,
+        "new_exact_comparisons": compared, "new_winner": {"family": shortlist[0]["family"], "style": shortlist[0]["style"], "score": shortlist[0]["score"]},
+        "new_winner_retained": (shortlist[0]["family"], shortlist[0]["style"]) == full_key,
+        "new_full_pool_runner_up_retained": runner_key in retained, "frozen_authority": status,
+        "full_pool_shadow_authority": status, "full_pool_shadow_reason": reason,
+        "new_shortlist_shadow_authority": shortlist_status, "new_shortlist_shadow_reason": shortlist_reason,
+        "font_scoring_text_authority": glyph_row["font_scoring_text_authority"],
+    })
+
+
+def repair(glyph: dict, font: dict, reduction: dict, decisions: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict, dict]:
+    glyph, font, reduction = copy.deepcopy(glyph), copy.deepcopy(font), copy.deepcopy(reduction)
+    glyph_by = {item["identity"]: item for item in glyph["identities"]}
+    font_by = {item["identity"]: item for item in font["identities"]}
+    fonts = inference.discover_installed_fonts()
+    results = []
+    for decision in decisions["identities"]:
+        row, keep = glyph_by[decision["identity"]], set(decision["keep_frames"])
+        before = [int(item["source_frame"]) for item in row["observations"] if item.get("accepted")]
+        if not keep <= set(before):
+            raise ValueError(f"keep_frames are not accepted observations: {decision['identity']}")
+        for observation in row["observations"]:
+            if observation.get("accepted") and int(observation["source_frame"]) not in keep:
+                observation["accepted"], observation["reason"] = False, "incompatible_visible_text_transition_state"
+        old_font = copy.deepcopy(font_by[decision["identity"]])
+        rebuild_mask(row)
+        authority = {
+            "text": decision.get("scoring_text_after"), "authority": "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_OWNERSHIP_DECISION",
+            "reason": None, "source_frames": sorted(keep), "decision": decision["decision"],
+        }
+        row["font_scoring_text"] = decision.get("scoring_text_after")
+        row["font_scoring_text_authority"] = authority
+        row["accepted_mask_text_relationship"] = decision["relationship"]
+        if decision.get("parent_text"):
+            row["transition_fragment_parent_text"] = decision["parent_text"]
+        font_by[decision["identity"]]["previous_transition_invalidated_ranking"] = old_font
+        rerank(row, font_by[decision["identity"]], reduction, decision.get("scoring_text_after"), fonts)
+        results.append({
+            "identity": decision["identity"], "before_observations": before,
+            "after_observations": [int(item["source_frame"]) for item in row["observations"] if item.get("accepted")],
+            "rejected_observations": sorted(set(before) - keep), "ownership_decision": decision["decision"],
+            "text_authority": authority, "mask_status": row["evidence_classification"],
+            "font_rerank_required": bool(decision.get("scoring_text_after")),
+            "final_state": decision["relationship"],
+        })
+    glyph["summary"] = dict(Counter(item["evidence_classification"] for item in glyph["identities"]))
+    glyph.setdefault("ownership_corrections", []).extend(copy.deepcopy(decisions["identities"]))
+    font["summary"] = dict(Counter(item["font_rerank_status"] for item in font["identities"]))
+    font["authoritative_top_family_distribution"] = dict(Counter(item["top_candidates"][0]["family"] for item in font["identities"] if item["font_rerank_status"] == "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING" and item.get("top_candidates")))
+    reduction["identities"] = sorted(reduction["identities"], key=lambda item: item["identity"])
+    reduction["gate_failed_identities"] = sorted(reduction["gate_failed_identities"], key=lambda item: item["identity"])
+    reduction["gate_passing_identity_count"] = len(reduction["identities"])
+    reduction["gate_failed_identity_count"] = len(reduction["gate_failed_identities"])
+    reduction["full_pool_exact_comparisons"] = sum(int(item["full_pool_exact_comparisons"]) for item in reduction["identities"])
+    reduction.setdefault("ownership_corrections", []).extend(copy.deepcopy(decisions["identities"]))
+    return glyph, font, reduction, {"identities": results}
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    for name in ("glyph", "font", "candidate_reduction", "decisions", "output"):
+        parser.add_argument(f"--{name.replace('_', '-')}", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    original = {name: load(getattr(args, name)) for name in ("glyph", "font", "candidate_reduction")}
+    decisions = load(args.decisions)
+    glyph, font, reduction, details = repair(original["glyph"], original["font"], original["candidate_reduction"], decisions)
+    outputs = {
+        "glyph": args.output / "reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_transition_corrected.json",
+        "font": args.output / "reel2_known_region_font_rerank_transition_corrected.json",
+        "candidate_reduction": args.output / "whole_reel_full_pool_benchmark_transition_corrected.json",
+    }
+    for name, value in (("glyph", glyph), ("font", font), ("candidate_reduction", reduction)):
+        write(outputs[name], value)
+    targets = {item["identity"] for item in decisions["identities"]}
+    unchanged = all(
+        [item for item in original[name]["identities"] if item["identity"] not in targets] == [item for item in value["identities"] if item["identity"] not in targets]
+        for name, value in (("glyph", glyph), ("font", font), ("candidate_reduction", reduction))
+    )
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_bounded_transition_observation_ownership_validation", "schema_version": 1,
+        "result": "PASS_STEP_2B1_BOUNDED_OBSERVATION_OWNERSHIP_TRANSITION_REPAIR" if unchanged and len(glyph["identities"]) == 113 else "FAIL",
+        "identity_count": len(glyph["identities"]), "bounded_identity_count": len(targets),
+        "unrelated_identity_rows_unchanged": unchanged, **details,
+        "input_hashes": {name: sha256(getattr(args, name)) for name in original},
+        "output_hashes": {name: sha256(path) for name, path in outputs.items()},
+    }
+    write(args.output / "bounded_transition_ownership_validation.json", validation)
+    if not validation["result"].startswith("PASS_"):
+        raise SystemExit(validation["result"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
