+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules.video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application import (
+    MODE,
+    NODE,
+    NODE_CONTRACT,
+    TASK_ID,
+    _fingerprint,
+    load_phase5_contract,
+    parse_textplus_fcpxml,
+)
+
+
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application.py"
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label}_object")
+    return value
+
+
+def inside(root: Path, path: Path, label: str) -> Path:
+    resolved = path.resolve()
+    try:
+        resolved.relative_to(root)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label}_outside_repository") from exc
+    if not resolved.is_file() or resolved.stat().st_size <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label}_missing")
+    return resolved
+
+
+def identity(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256(path)}
+
+
+def allocate_run_id() -> str:
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    return f"{now:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}{now.microsecond // 1000:03d}Z_{uuid4().hex}"
+
+
+def build_package(
+    root: Path,
+    generic: Path,
+    proxy: Path,
+    style: Path,
+    audio: Path,
+    fcpxml: Path,
+    compiler_report_path: Path,
+    target: str,
+) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    root = root.resolve()
+    generic, proxy, style, audio, fcpxml, compiler_report_path = (
+        inside(root, path, label)
+        for path, label in (
+            (generic, "generic"), (proxy, "proxy"), (style, "caption_style"),
+            (audio, "audio"), (fcpxml, "fcpxml"), (compiler_report_path, "compiler_report"),
+        )
+    )
+    generic_value = read_json(generic, "generic")
+    compiler_report = read_json(compiler_report_path, "compiler_report")
+    if generic_value.get("success") is not True or generic_value.get("schema") != "generic_edit_commands":
+        raise ValueError("generic_contract")
+    compiler_schema = compiler_report.get("schema")
+    if compiler_report.get("success") is not True or compiler_schema not in {
+        "video_cloner_davinci_textplus_fcpxml", "video_cloner.standalone_fcpxml.v1",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("compiler_report_contract")
+    xml = parse_textplus_fcpxml(fcpxml, proxy, audio)
+    if xml["timeline_name"] != target:
+        raise ValueError("target_timeline_contract")
+    subtitles = generic_value.get("subtitle_clips")
+    if not isinstance(subtitles, list):
+        raise ValueError("caption_count")
+    caption_contract = []
+    if compiler_schema == "video_cloner.standalone_fcpxml.v1":
+        report_inputs = compiler_report.get("inputs")
+        report_output = compiler_report.get("output")
+        authority = compiler_report.get("caption_authority")
+        metrics = authority.get("metrics") if isinstance(authority, Mapping) else None
+        semantic = authority.get("semantic") if isinstance(authority, Mapping) else None
+        summary = semantic.get("summary") if isinstance(semantic, Mapping) else None
+        structure = compiler_report.get("structure")
+        if (
+            not isinstance(report_inputs, Mapping) or not isinstance(report_output, Mapping)
+            or report_inputs.get("generic_sha256") != sha256(generic)
+            or report_inputs.get("caption_style_sha256") != sha256(style)
+            or report_inputs.get("source_video_sha256") != sha256(proxy)
+            or report_inputs.get("source_audio_sha256") != sha256(audio)
+            or report_output.get("sha256") != sha256(fcpxml)
+            or report_output.get("timeline_name") != target
+            or not isinstance(metrics, Mapping) or not isinstance(summary, Mapping) or not isinstance(structure, Mapping)
+            or metrics.get("semantic_ledger_count") != len(subtitles)
+            or metrics.get("semantic_ledger_exactly_once") is not True
+            or summary.get("source_cue_count") != len(subtitles)
+            or summary.get("source_coverage_exact") is not True
+            or structure.get("caption_count") != len(xml["titles"])
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("caption_semantic_authority")
+        caption_pairs = [(f"render_{index:04d}", title) for index, title in enumerate(xml["titles"], start=1)]
+    else:
+        if len(subtitles) != len(xml["titles"]):
+            raise ValueError("caption_count")
+        caption_pairs = []
+        for subtitle, title in zip(subtitles, xml["titles"]):
+            if not isinstance(subtitle, Mapping) or not subtitle.get("subtitle_id") or subtitle.get("text") != title["text"]:
+                raise ValueError("caption_identity")
+            caption_pairs.append((str(subtitle["subtitle_id"]), title))
+    for caption_id, title in caption_pairs:
+        caption_contract.append({
+            "subtitle_id": caption_id, "text": title["text"],
+            "timeline_start_frame": title["timeline_start"],
+            "timeline_end_frame": title["timeline_start"] + title["duration"],
+            "lane": title["lane"],
+        })
+
+    report_path = fcpxml.with_name(fcpxml.stem + "_import_report.json")
+    report = {
+        "success": True,
+        "schema": "video_cloner.standalone_textplus_fcpxml_report.v1",
+        "inputs": {
+            "generic": identity(generic), "caption_style": identity(style),
+            "source_video": identity(proxy), "source_audio": identity(audio),
+        },
+        "output": identity(fcpxml) | {"fcpxml": str(fcpxml)},
+        "structure": {
+            "v1_clip_count": len(xml["cuts"]), "a1_clip_count": len(xml["audio_rows"]),
+            "v2_title_count": len(xml["titles"]), "timeline_duration_frames": xml["duration_frames"],
+            "caption_contract": caption_contract, "caption_lane_count": len(xml["title_lanes"]),
+            "max_caption_lane": xml["title_lanes"][-1], "same_lane_overlap_count": 0,
+            "overlap_preserved": True,
+        },
+        "source_compiler_report": identity(compiler_report_path),
+    }
+    write_json(report_path, report)
+
+    inputs = {"generic": identity(generic), "proxy": identity(proxy), "caption_style": identity(style), "audio": identity(audio)}
+    producer = {"adapter": "prepare_video_cloner_fresh_mvp_timeline.v1", "compiler_version": compiler_report.get("version") or compiler_schema}
+    node_identity = {"node": NODE, "inputs": inputs, "producer": producer}
+    node = {
+        "contract": NODE_CONTRACT, "producer": producer, "fingerprint": _fingerprint(node_identity),
+        "outputs": {"fcpxml": identity(fcpxml), "report": identity(report_path)},
+    }
+    manifest = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner.standalone_phase5_manifest.v1", "version": 1,
+        "artifact_set_contract": "offline_fcpxml_only_no_resolve", "inputs": inputs, "nodes": {NODE: node},
+    }
+    manifest["artifact_set_sha256"] = _fingerprint(manifest)
+    manifest_path = fcpxml.with_name(fcpxml.stem + "_manifest.json")
+    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
+    contract = load_phase5_contract(root, manifest_path)
+    return manifest_path, contract
+
+
+def publish(root: Path, manifest_path: Path, contract: Mapping[str, Any], project: str, target: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not project or not target:
+        raise ValueError("explicit_target_identity")
+    queue = root / ".agent" / "commands"
+    for state in ("pending", "running", "completed", "failed"):
+        (queue / state).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    active = [(state, path) for state in ("pending", "running") for path in sorted((queue / state).glob("*.json"))]
+    if active:
+        raise ValueError(f"active_command:{active[0][0]}:{active[0][1].name}")
+    run_id = allocate_run_id()
+    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{8}T\d{9}Z_[0-9a-f]{32}", run_id) is None:
+        raise ValueError("run_id")
+    relative_report = f".agent/reports/{TASK_ID}/{run_id}"
+    report_dir = root / relative_report
+    report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    command = {
+        "schema_version": 1, "task": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "module": MODULE, "mode": MODE,
+        "status_path": f"{relative_report}/status.json", "log_path": f"{relative_report}/run.log",
+        "report_path": f"{relative_report}/report.json",
+        "payload": {
+            "repository_root": str(root), "manifest_path": str(manifest_path), "selected_node": NODE,
+            "artifact_set_sha256": contract["artifact_set_sha256"], "textplus_fingerprint": contract["textplus_fingerprint"],
+            "fcpxml_sha256": contract["fcpxml_sha256"], "report_sha256": contract["report_sha256"],
+            "expected_project": project, "target_timeline_name": target, "require_target_absent": True,
+            "import_permitted": True, "replace_existing_timeline": False, "save_project": False,
+            "delete_permitted": False, "relink_permitted": False, "metadata_controller_permitted": False,
+        },
+    }
+    pending = queue / "pending" / f"{TASK_ID}_{run_id}.json"
+    write_json(report_dir / "import_command.json", command)
+    write_json(pending, command)
+    receipt = {
+        "ok": True, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id,
+        "command_path": str(pending.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"),
+        "command_sha256": sha256(pending), "pending_queue_count": len(list((queue / "pending").glob("*.json"))),
+    }
+    write_json(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)
+    return receipt
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--generic", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--proxy", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--caption-style", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--audio", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--fcpxml", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--compiler-report", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--project", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--target-timeline", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = args.root.resolve()
+    try:
+        manifest, contract = build_package(root, args.generic, args.proxy, args.caption_style, args.audio, args.fcpxml, args.compiler_report, args.target_timeline)
+        receipt = publish(root, manifest, contract, args.project, args.target_timeline)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(f"FAIL: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+        return 1
+    print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Publish one immutable read-only Reel #2 social-target preflight command."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4_REEL2_SOCIAL_TARGET_READONLY_PREFLIGHT_V1"
+MODE = "step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight"
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight.py"
+BASE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application.py"
+ACCEPTED = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_PHASE6_OFFLINE_TIMELINE_LIVE_APPLICATION_V1/PHASE6_V1_PROVENANCE_SAVE_20260912T181724287Z_41b3b9ee155d4732bfd3a4891ae081eb/report.json"
+EXPORTED = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_PHASE6_OFFLINE_TIMELINE_LIVE_APPLICATION_V1/PHASE6_V1_EXPORT_FINALIZE_20260912T175637672Z_36f3a798745340e0a7916c4b2cac7a71/live_target_pre_save.fcpxml/Info.fcpxml"
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def publish(root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, object]:
+    root = root.resolve()
+    for relative in (MODULE, BASE, ACCEPTED, EXPORTED):
+        if not (root / relative).is_file():
+            raise ValueError(f"required_file:{relative}")
+    state = json.loads((root / ".agent/state/resolve_bridge_installation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    config_path = Path(str(state.get("config_path") or ""))
+    config = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if Path(str(config.get("repository_root") or "")).resolve() != root or config.get("command_queue") != ".agent\\commands":
+        raise ValueError("bridge_config")
+    queue = root / ".agent/commands"
+    for name in ("pending", "running", "completed", "failed"):
+        (queue / name).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for name in ("pending", "running"):
+        active = list((queue / name).glob("*.json"))
+        if active:
+            raise ValueError(f"active_command:{name}:{active[0].name}")
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    run_id = f"{now:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}{now.microsecond // 1000:03d}Z_{uuid4().hex}"
+    report_relative = f".agent/reports/{TASK_ID}/{run_id}"
+    report_dir = root / report_relative
+    report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    command = {
+        "schema_version": 1, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id,
+        "module": MODULE, "mode": MODE,
+        "status_path": f"{report_relative}/status.json",
+        "log_path": f"{report_relative}/run.log",
+        "report_path": f"{report_relative}/report.json",
+        "payload": {
+            "repository_root": str(root), "read_only": True,
+            "accepted_report_path": ACCEPTED, "accepted_report_sha256": sha256(root / ACCEPTED),
+            "exported_fcpxml_path": EXPORTED, "exported_fcpxml_sha256": sha256(root / EXPORTED),
+            "expected_project": "New Project 1",
+            "target_timeline_name": "DcJRJtUKScu_offline_timeline_v1",
+            "expected_timeline_uid": "4ad2a3c3-031c-464d-96aa-76a045608ad6",
+            "expected_item_name": "VC Caption 0045 - social,",
+            "expected_track": 2, "expected_start": 365, "expected_end": 376,
+            "expected_text": "social,", "canonical_window": [359, 383],
+            "local_animation_range": [0, 23],
+            "mutation_permitted": False, "save_project": False,
+            "create_permitted": False, "delete_permitted": False,
+            "title_write_permitted": False, "modifier_write_permitted": False,
+            "keyframe_write_permitted": False, "import_permitted": False,
+            "relink_permitted": False, "replace_permitted": False,
+            "timeline_selection_permitted": False,
+        },
+    }
+    filename = f"{TASK_ID}_{run_id}.json"
+    pending = queue / "pending" / filename
+    write_json(pending, command)
+    write_json(report_dir / "command.json", command)
+    receipt = {
+        "ok": True, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id,
+        "command_path": str(pending.relative_to(root)),
+        "config_path": str(config_path), "command_count": 1,
+    }
+    write_json(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)
+    return receipt
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(publish(), indent=2, sort_keys=True))

@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+"""Publish the one authoritative STEP 4C disposable animation probe command."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP4C_ANIMATION_LIVE_PROBE_V1"
+MODE = "step4c_animation_live_probe"
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py"
+SOURCES = (
+    MODULE,
+    "resolve_workspace/resolve_apply_caption_animation_step_3C.py",
+    "resolve_workspace/modules/step_3D_native_textplus_title_probe.py",
+    "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_phase4b_timeline_application.py",
+    "resolve_workspace/VC_Agent_Bridge.py",
+    "scripts/davinci/resolve_apply_video_cloner_metadata.py",
+)
+REEL1 = "DZsqH7auhjt_textplus_visual_first_full_rollout_polish_v4_confirmed74_repair_metrics_v1_occlusion_complete_v4_flash_transition_v4"
+REEL2 = "DcJRJtUKScu_standalone_timeline"
+
+
+def _hash(path: Path) -> str:
+    data = path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\r", b"\n")
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def build_payload(disposable_name: str, disposable_uid: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    payload = {
+        "expected_project": "New Project 1", "protected_timelines": [REEL1, REEL2],
+        "disposable_timeline_name": disposable_name, "ownership_required": "NEWLY_CREATED",
+        "mutation_permitted": True, "cleanup_permitted": False, "workspace_invocations": 1,
+    }
+    if disposable_uid is not None:
+        payload.update({
+            "expected_disposable_uid": disposable_uid,
+            "ownership_required": "EXISTING_NEWLY_CREATED",
+            "reuse_existing_owned_disposable": True,
+        })
+    return payload
+
+
+def publish(root: Path, disposable_name: str | None = None, disposable_uid: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    root = root.resolve()
+    if not (root / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
+        raise ValueError("repository_root")
+    queue = root / ".agent/commands"
+    for state in ("pending", "running", "completed", "failed"):
+        (queue / state).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    active = [path for state in ("pending", "running") for path in (queue / state).glob("*.json")]
+    if active:
+        raise ValueError(f"active_command:{active[0].name}")
+    if (disposable_name is None) != (disposable_uid is None):
+        raise ValueError("existing_disposable_identity")
+    for relative in SOURCES:
+        if not (root / relative).is_file():
+            raise ValueError(f"source_missing:{relative}")
+
+    run_id = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ") + "_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
+    report_dir = root / ".agent/reports" / TASK_ID / run_id
+    if report_dir.exists():
+        raise ValueError("report_exists")
+    report_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
+    disposable_name = disposable_name or "VC_STEP4C_ANIMATION_PROBE_" + run_id[-12:]
+    if not disposable_name.startswith("VC_STEP4C_ANIMATION_PROBE_"):
+        raise ValueError("disposable_name")
+    command = {
+        "schema_version": 1, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "mode": MODE, "module": MODULE,
+        "published_at": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        "status_path": str((report_dir / "status.json").relative_to(root)).replace("/", "\\"),
+        "log_path": str((report_dir / "run.log").relative_to(root)).replace("/", "\\"),
+        "report_path": str((report_dir / "report.json").relative_to(root)).replace("/", "\\"),
+        "source_contract": {"version": 1, "algorithm": "sha256_text_lf_normalized", "hashes": {path: _hash(root / path) for path in SOURCES}},
+        "payload": build_payload(disposable_name, disposable_uid),
+    }
+    command_path = queue / "pending" / f"{TASK_ID}_{run_id}.json"
+    _write(report_dir / "command.json", command)
+    _write(command_path, command)
+    receipt = {"task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "command_path": str(command_path), "report_dir": str(report_dir),
+               "disposable_timeline_name": disposable_name, "manual_action": "Workspace > Scripts > VC_Run_Agent_Task", "workspace_invocations": 1}
+    _write(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)
+    return receipt
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--existing-disposable-name")
+    parser.add_argument("--existing-disposable-uid")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    receipt = publish(Path(args.root), args.existing_disposable_name, args.existing_disposable_uid)
+    print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    print("MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED: Workspace > Scripts > VC_Run_Agent_Task")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+"""Publish one read-only diagnostic for the persisted failed F7 timeline."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_PERSISTED_STYLE_PARITY_DIAGNOSTIC_V1"
+MODE = "inspect_persisted_style_parity"
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_persisted_style_parity_diagnostic.py"
+SOURCE_RUN_ID = "20261002T093228130622Z_8a43be1aa99a4e2fa6ec66203b559cbd"
+TARGET_TIMELINE = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION_F7_66203b559cbd"
+CONTRACT = f".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_V1/{SOURCE_RUN_ID}/step5_f7_compile_contract.json"
+
+
+def sha(path: Path) -> str:

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7adb893efcd3f3f2f6654568b265397821695888
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py
@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+"""Publish the accepted F7 fresh Resolve validation rebuild command."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import runpy
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_phase6_textplus_application as carrier
+
+PREPARE = ROOT / ".agent/tasks/inbox/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_20261001_V1/files/prepare.py"
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py"
+PLACEMENT_AUTHORITY = ROOT / "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_f7_physical_track_placement.json"
+
+
+def fingerprint(value: object) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def projection(objects: list[dict], fields: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
+    return fingerprint([{key: row.get(key) for key in fields} for row in objects])
+
+
+def apply_placement_authority(contract: dict, authority: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    source = contract["objects"]
+    if len(source) != 65 or contract.get("object_count") != 65:
+        raise ValueError("f7_placement_object_count")
+    if authority.get("task_id") != "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_V1" or authority.get("canonical_mapping") != "lane = resolve_track - 1":
+        raise ValueError("f7_placement_authority")
+    corrected = copy.deepcopy(contract)
+    objects = corrected["objects"]
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in objects}
+    if len(by_id) != 65:
+        raise ValueError("f7_placement_identity_count")
+
+    missing_before = 0
+    before = {}
+    for row in objects:
+        placement = row["z_order_track"]
+        track = int(placement["resolve_track"])
+        lane = track - 1
+        if placement.get("lane") is None:
+            missing_before += 1
+        elif int(placement["lane"]) != lane:
+            raise ValueError(f"f7_noncanonical_lane:{row['source_identity']}")
+        before[row["source_identity"]] = (track, lane)
+        placement["lane"] = lane
+
+    authorized = {}
+    for correction in authority.get("corrections", []):
+        identity = correction["source_identity"]
+        row = by_id.get(identity)
+        if row is None or row["text"]["value"] != correction["expected_text"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"f7_placement_identity:{identity}")
+        expected = correction["before"]
+        if before[identity] != (int(expected["resolve_track"]), int(expected["effective_lane"])):
+            raise ValueError(f"f7_placement_before:{identity}")
+        after = correction["after"]
+        track, lane = int(after["resolve_track"]), int(after["lane"])
+        if track <= 1 or lane <= 0 or lane != track - 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"f7_placement_mapping:{identity}")
+        row["z_order_track"].update({"resolve_track": track, "lane": lane})
+        authorized[identity] = {"before": list(before[identity]), "after": [track, lane]}
+
+    physical_changes = {
+        row["source_identity"]: {
+            "before": list(before[row["source_identity"]]),
+            "after": [int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]), int(row["z_order_track"]["lane"])],
+        }
+        for row in objects
+        if before[row["source_identity"]] != (int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]), int(row["z_order_track"]["lane"]))
+    }
+    if physical_changes != authorized or len(physical_changes) != 3:
+        raise ValueError("f7_placement_change_scope")
+
+    overlaps = []
+    tracks = sorted({int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) for row in objects})
+    for track in tracks:
+        rows = sorted((row for row in objects if int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) == track), key=lambda row: (row["resolve_interval"][0], row["resolve_interval"][1], row["source_identity"]))
+        for index, left in enumerate(rows):
+            for right in rows[index + 1:]:
+                if right["resolve_interval"][0] >= left["resolve_interval"][1]:
+                    break
+                overlaps.append({"track": track, "left": left["source_identity"], "left_interval": left["resolve_interval"], "right": right["source_identity"], "right_interval": right["resolve_interval"]})
+    if overlaps:
+        raise ValueError(f"f7_placement_overlap:{overlaps}")
+
+    titles = [{
+        "caption_id": row["source_identity"], "text": row["text"]["value"],
+        "timeline_start": row["resolve_interval"][0],
+        "duration": row["resolve_interval"][1] - row["resolve_interval"][0],
+        "lane": row["z_order_track"]["lane"],
+    } for row in objects]
+    plan = carrier.carrier_textplus_operation_plan(titles)
+    fields = {
+        "text": ("source_identity", "text", "display_text_decision"),
+        "lifecycle": ("source_identity", "source_interval", "resolve_interval"),
+        "style": ("source_identity", "font", "fill", "opacity", "size", "stroke", "static_rotation", "advanced_effects"),
+        "position": ("source_identity", "position"),
+        "scale": ("source_identity", "scale_decision", "keyframes"),
+        "ownership": ("source_identity", "object_origin", "composition"),
+        "renderability": ("source_identity", "renderable"),
+    }
+    invariant_hashes = {name: {"before": projection(source, keys), "after": projection(objects, keys)} for name, keys in fields.items()}
+    if any(value["before"] != value["after"] for value in invariant_hashes.values()):
+        raise ValueError("f7_nonplacement_authority_changed")
+    target_6000 = next(row for row in objects if row["source_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0089")
+    if target_6000["resolve_interval"] != [542, 596] or len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]) != 9:
+        raise ValueError("f7_6000_authority")
+    controls = {text: fingerprint([row for row in objects if row["text"]["value"].lower() == text]) for text in ("launch", "invest", "reels")}
+    validation = {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_f7_placement_validation", "object_count": 65,
+        "tracks_scanned": tracks, "canonical_mapping": "lane = resolve_track - 1",
+        "normalized_missing_lane_count": missing_before,
+        "missing_lane_count": sum(row["z_order_track"].get("lane") is None for row in objects),
+        "lane_track_mismatch_count": sum(int(row["z_order_track"]["lane"]) != int(row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"]) - 1 for row in objects),
+        "physical_placement_change_count": len(physical_changes), "physical_placement_changes": physical_changes,
+        "unchanged_physical_placement_count": 65 - len(physical_changes),
+        "same_track_overlap_count": len(overlaps), "same_track_overlaps": overlaps,
+        "carrier_plan": {"result": "PASS", "title_count": len(plan["titles"]), "lanes": plan["lanes"], "sha256": plan["sha256"]},
+        "f6_6000_interval": target_6000["resolve_interval"], "f6_6000_scale_key_count": len(target_6000["keyframes"]["scale"]),
+        "invariant_hashes": invariant_hashes, "regression_control_hashes": controls, "derived_objects_sha256": fingerprint(objects), "pass": True,
+    }
+    return corrected, validation
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if not PREPARE.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(PREPARE)
+    authority = json.loads(PLACEMENT_AUTHORITY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    namespace = runpy.run_path(str(PREPARE))
+    entrypoint = namespace["main"]
+    entrypoint.__globals__["MODULE"] = MODULE
+    original_write = entrypoint.__globals__["write"]
+
+    def write_with_placement(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
+        if path.name != "step5_f7_compile_contract.json":
+            original_write(path, value)
+            return
+        corrected, validation = apply_placement_authority(value, authority)
+        corrected["f7_placement_authority"] = {
+            "path": str(PLACEMENT_AUTHORITY.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
+            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(PLACEMENT_AUTHORITY.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+        }
+        original_write(path, corrected)
+        original_write(path.with_name("step5_f7_placement_authority.json"), authority)
+        original_write(path.with_name("step5_f7_placement_validation.json"), validation)
+
+    entrypoint.__globals__["write"] = write_with_placement
+    return int(entrypoint())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Preflight and publish one F8 generated-only review timeline command."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F8_GENERATED_ONLY_REVIEW_V1"
+MODE = "create_f8_generated_only_review"
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review.py"
+CONTRACT = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_V1/20261002T093228130622Z_8a43be1aa99a4e2fa6ec66203b559cbd/step5_f7_compile_contract.json"
+PLACEMENT = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_FRESH_RESOLVE_VALIDATION_REBUILD_V1/20261002T093228130622Z_8a43be1aa99a4e2fa6ec66203b559cbd/step5_f7_placement_validation.json"
+F7_PASS = ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F7_READONLY_MACHINE_VALIDATION_V1/20261002T120011651892Z_a6ca1abfe075450292a9686bbd9f93f3/bridge_report.json"
+F7_TIMELINE = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION_F7_66203b559cbd"
+F7_UID = "80d5e22c-355d-47e7-a788-8f7dc68f718c"
+
+
+def _read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"json_object:{path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def _time(frame: int, fps: int) -> str:
+    seconds, ff = divmod(frame, fps)
+    minutes, ss = divmod(seconds, 60)
+    hours, mm = divmod(minutes, 60)
+    return f"{hours:02d}:{mm:02d}:{ss:02d}:{ff:02d}"
+
+
+def _checklist() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    rows = [
+        ("launch", 55, "caption_tracklet_0009", "Does launch remain a correct animation/color control?"),
+        ("invest", 271, "caption_tracklet_0045", "Does invest retain its accepted animation?"),
+        ("reels", 348, "caption_tracklet_0061", "Does reels retain its accepted style and animation?"),
+        ("selling", 90, "continuous_visual_identity_0014", "Does generated size/position/style reproduce the source caption closely?"),
+        ("sign", 140, "continuous_visual_identity_0028", "Is sign size, color, style, and placement acceptable?"),
+        ("text-dump region: selling", 90, None, "Is there no generated full-sentence caption?"),
+        ("why?", 227, "recovered_display_object_why_0001", "Is why? present with accepted style and placement?"),
+        ("initial We", 262, "recovered_display_object_local_we_0002", "Is the recovered local We present once?"),
+        ("listing", 341, "recovered_display_object_listing_0003", "Is listing style and position acceptable?"),
+        ("social", 370, "caption_tracklet_0064", "Is there exactly one generated social caption?"),
+        ("text-dump region: social", 370, None, "Is there no generated full-sentence caption?"),
+        ("not", 396, "caption_tracklet_0067", "Is not size/style source-like?"),
+        ("over", 536, "caption_tracklet_0087", "Is over initial size and animation source-like?"),
+        ("6000", 545, "caption_tracklet_0089", "Does expand to plateau to exit contraction look source-like and persist through [542,596)?"),
+        ("matching", 610, "caption_tracklet_0094", "Is lower matching source-like?"),
+        ("Matching", 626, "caption_tracklet_0096", "Is upper Matching source-like?"),
+        ("buyers", 638, "caption_tracklet_0097", "Is buyers font/style acceptable?"),
+        ("like animation absence", 765, None, "Is the previously false generated like absent?"),
+        ("end-screen like absence", 769, None, "Is generated like absent from the end-screen region?"),
+        ("launching", 727, "caption_tracklet_0110", "Is launching source-like?"),
+    ]
+    return [{"case": case, "timeline_frame": frame, "timeline_time_24fps": _time(frame, 24), "source_frame_30fps": int(frame * 30 / 24 + 0.5), "source_time_30fps": _time(int(frame * 30 / 24 + 0.5), 30), "generated_identity": identity, "expected_human_question": question, "allowed_result": ["PASS", "MINOR ISSUE", "FAIL"], "comment_required_for": ["MINOR ISSUE", "FAIL"]} for case, frame, identity, question in rows]
+
+
+def preflight(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    contract = _read(root / CONTRACT)
+    placement = _read(root / PLACEMENT)
+    f7_pass = _read(root / F7_PASS)

+    overlaps = []
+    for left_index, left in enumerate(objects):
+        for right in objects[left_index + 1:]:
+            if left["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"] == right["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"] and max(left["resolve_interval"][0], right["resolve_interval"][0]) < min(left["resolve_interval"][1], right["resolve_interval"][1]):
+                overlaps.append([left["source_identity"], right["source_identity"]])
+    target = next(row for row in objects if row["source_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0089")
+    invariants = placement["invariant_hashes"]
+    result = {

+        "all_renderable": all(row.get("renderable") is True for row in objects),

+        "f7_machine_pass": f7_pass.get("ok") is True and f7_pass.get("classification") == "F7_MACHINE_PASS",
+        "f6_6000_interval": target["resolve_interval"],
+        "f3_6000_scale_keys": len(target["keyframes"]["scale"]),
+        "production_identity_literal_reel_branches": 0,
+        "protected_timeline_mutation_planned": False,
+        "f7_timeline_mutation_planned": False,
+    }
+    result["pass"] = result["renderables"] == 65 and result["all_renderable"] and result["same_track_conflicts"] == 0 and result["placement_pass"] and result["f2_f7_invariants_unchanged"] and result["f7_machine_pass"] and result["f6_6000_interval"] == [542, 596] and result["f3_6000_scale_keys"] == 9
+    return result
+
+
+def publish(root: Path = ROOT, now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:

+    if active:

+        "mode": MODE,

+        "published_at": now.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        "status_path": str((report_dir / "status.json").relative_to(root)),
+        "log_path": str((report_dir / "run.log").relative_to(root)),
+        "report_path": str((report_dir / "bridge_report.json").relative_to(root)),
+        "payload": {"report_dir": str(report_dir), "contract_path": str(contract), "contract_sha256": hashlib.sha256(contract.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "f7_timeline": F7_TIMELINE, "f7_timeline_uid": F7_UID, "review_timeline": review_timeline, "background_strategy": "NO_MEDIA_UNDERLAY_NEUTRAL_BLACK_VIEWER", "project_save": True},
+    }
+    command_path = root / ".agent/commands/pending" / f"{TASK_ID}_{run_id}.json"
+    _write(report_dir / "command.json", command)
+    _write(command_path, command)

+    _write(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(publish(), indent=2, sort_keys=True))

+}

+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))

+        raise ValueError(f"json_object:{path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")

+    os.replace(temporary, path)

+def preflight() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    bridge = _read(SOURCE_RUN / "bridge_report.json")

+    return result
+
+
+def publish(now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:

+        "project_save": True,
+    }

+        payload[f"{name}_path"] = str(path.resolve())

+    command = {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,

+

+def _active_commands() -> list[Path]:
+    return [path for state in ("pending", "running") for path in (ROOT / ".agent/commands" / state).glob("*.json")]
+
+
+def _review_sheet(report_dir: Path) -> Path:
+    cases = [
+        ("Selling", 113, "one continuous Selling owner"),
+        ("calling", 625, "one calling owner; no independent ling"),
+        ("buyers", 720, "one buyers owner; no buy + ers split"),
+        ("with the buyers", 797, "three owners: with + the + buyers"),
+        ("we have", 816, "two co-visible owners: we + have"),
+        ("your why?", 284, "two co-visible owners: your + why?"),
+        ("Matching", 762, "one continuous Matching owner"),
+    ]
+    frame_dir = report_dir / "ownership_source_frames"
+    frame_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    rows = []
+    for case, frame, expected in cases:
+        target = frame_dir / f"{case.replace(' ', '_').replace('?', '')}_{frame:04d}.png"
+        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", str(ROOT / "input/DcJRJtUKScu.mp4"), "-vf", f"select=eq(n\\,{frame})", "-vsync", "0", "-frames:v", "1", str(target)], check=True)
+        rows.append((case, frame, expected, target))
+    width, image_width, row_height = 760, 270, 500
+    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (width, row_height * len(rows)), (24, 24, 24))
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
+    for index, (case, frame, expected, target) in enumerate(rows):
+        image = Image.open(target).convert("RGB")
+        image.thumbnail((image_width, 480))
+        y = index * row_height
+        sheet.paste(image, ((image_width - image.width) // 2, y))
+        draw.text((image_width + 24, y + 35), f"{case}  |  source frame {frame}", fill=(255, 220, 170))
+        draw.text((image_width + 24, y + 85), "Expected ownership:", fill="white")
+        draw.text((image_width + 24, y + 120), expected, fill=(220, 220, 220))
+    output = report_dir / "source_vs_expected_ownership_review.jpg"
+    sheet.save(output, quality=92)
+    write(report_dir / "source_vs_expected_ownership_review.json", {"schema": "video_cloner_f9_source_vs_expected_ownership_review", "cases": [{"case": case, "source_frame": frame, "expected_ownership": expected, "source_image": str(target)} for case, frame, expected, target in rows], "sheet": str(output)})
+    return output
+
+
+def publish(now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    active = _active_commands()
+    if active:
+        raise ValueError(f"active_command:{active[0].name}")
+    if hashlib.sha256(BASELINE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != BASELINE_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("baseline_hash_drift")
+    now = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    unique = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    run_id = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ") + "_" + unique
+    target_timeline = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION_F7_CANONICAL_" + unique[:12]
+    report_dir = ROOT / ".agent/reports" / TASK_ID / run_id
+
+    first = list(compile_contract())
+    second = list(compile_contract())
+    for artifacts in (first, second):
+        artifacts[0]["validation_timeline"] = target_timeline
+        artifacts[2]["contract_sha256"] = digest(artifacts[0])
+    names = ("step5_f9_canonical_compile_contract.json", "step5_f9_ownership_audit.json", "step5_f9_validation.json", "step5_f9_ownership_authority.json")
+    first_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, first)}
+    second_payloads = {name: json_bytes(value) for name, value in zip(names, second)}
+    proof = {"schema": "video_cloner_step5_f9_publisher_determinism", "artifacts": {name: {"first_sha256": hashlib.sha256(first_payloads[name]).hexdigest(), "second_sha256": hashlib.sha256(second_payloads[name]).hexdigest(), "byte_identical": first_payloads[name] == second_payloads[name]} for name in names}}
+    proof["deterministic"] = all(row["byte_identical"] for row in proof["artifacts"].values())
+    if first[2]["all_pass"] is not True or not proof["deterministic"]:
+        raise ValueError("canonical_preflight")
+    for branch, payloads in (("first", first_payloads), ("second", second_payloads)):
+        for name, payload in payloads.items():
+            path = report_dir / branch / name
+            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            path.write_bytes(payload)
+    write(report_dir / "determinism_proof.json", proof)
+    review_sheet = _review_sheet(report_dir)
+
+    contract_path = report_dir / "first" / names[0]
+    audit_path = report_dir / "first" / names[1]
+    command = {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "mode": MODE,
+        "module": MODULE,
+        "published_at": now.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        "status_path": str((report_dir / "status.json").relative_to(ROOT)),
+        "log_path": str((report_dir / "run.log").relative_to(ROOT)),
+        "report_path": str((report_dir / "bridge_report.json").relative_to(ROOT)),
+        "payload": {
+            "report_dir": str(report_dir),
+            "contract_path": str(contract_path),
+            "contract_sha256": hashlib.sha256(contract_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+            "ownership_audit_path": str(audit_path),
+            "ownership_audit_sha256": hashlib.sha256(audit_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+            "baseline_fcpxml": str(BASELINE),
+            "baseline_fcpxml_sha256": BASELINE_SHA256,
+            "target_timeline": target_timeline,
+        },
+    }
+    command_path = ROOT / ".agent/commands/pending" / f"{TASK_ID}_{run_id}.json"
+    if _active_commands():
+        raise ValueError("queue_changed_before_publication")
+    write(report_dir / "command.json", command)
+    write(command_path, command)
+    receipt = {
+        "task_id": TASK_ID,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "command_path": str(command_path),
+        "report_dir": str(report_dir),
+        "target_timeline": target_timeline,
+        "module": MODULE,
+        "mode": MODE,
+        "expected_renderable_count": first[0]["object_count"],
+        "review_sheet": str(review_sheet),
+    }
+    write(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)
+    return receipt
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(publish(), indent=2, sort_keys=True))

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..da63c28fd21f3220dffcf1e2d0516f78e2414ebd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step5a_v33_resolve_rebuild.py
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_v33_materialization import BASELINE, build_artifacts, digest, write_contact_sheet
+
+
+TASK_ID = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_V33_BOUNDED_MATERIALIZATION_CLEANUP_V1"
+MODE = "apply_v33_bounded_cleanup_caption_and_generated_only_timelines"
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5a_v33_resolve_rebuild.py"
+REPORT_ROOT = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_V33_BOUNDED_MATERIALIZATION_CLEANUP_V1"
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def active_commands() -> list[Path]:
+    return [path for state in ("pending", "running") for path in (ROOT / ".agent/commands" / state).glob("*.json")]
+
+
+def publish(now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    active = active_commands()
+    if active:
+        raise ValueError(f"active_command:{active[0].name}")
+    first, second = build_artifacts(), build_artifacts()
+    run_1_hash, run_2_hash = digest(first["manifest"]), digest(second["manifest"])
+    if run_1_hash != run_2_hash or first != second:
+        raise ValueError("materialization_nondeterministic")
+    now = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    unique = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    run_id = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ") + "_" + unique
+    report_dir = REPORT_ROOT / run_id
+    applied = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_V33_BOUNDED_CLEANUP_APPLIED_" + unique[:12]
+    review = "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5B_V33_BOUNDED_CLEANUP_GENERATED_ONLY_" + unique[:12]
+    first["manifest"]["applied_timeline"] = applied
+    first["manifest"]["generated_only_timeline"] = review
+    second["manifest"]["applied_timeline"] = applied
+    second["manifest"]["generated_only_timeline"] = review
+    run_1_hash, run_2_hash = digest(first["manifest"]), digest(second["manifest"])
+    determinism = {"schema": "video_cloner_v33_materialization_determinism_report_v1", "run_1_manifest_hash": run_1_hash, "run_2_manifest_hash": run_2_hash, "identical": run_1_hash == run_2_hash and first == second}
+    if not determinism["identical"]:
+        raise ValueError("materialization_nondeterministic_after_naming")
+    artifacts = {
+        "materialization_manifest_v33.json": first["manifest"],
+        "render_object_reconciliation.json": first["reconciliation"],
+        "bounded_materialization_cleanup_audit.json": first["cleanup"],
+        "materialization_authority_audit.json": first["authority"],
+        "materialization_completeness_audit.json": first["completeness"],
+        "track_lane_collision_audit.json": first["collisions"],
+        "materialization_regression_controls.json": first["regression"],
+        "local_framewise_visual_sanity.json": first["local_visual_sanity"],
+        "materialization_determinism_report.json": determinism,
+        "protected_timeline_guard.json": first["protected_guard"],
+        "generated_only_equivalence_plan.json": first["equivalence"],
+        "resolve_task_payload_preview.json": {**first["payload_preview"], "applied_timeline": applied, "generated_only_timeline": review},
+        "plan_state_update.json": first["plan"],
+    }
+    for name, value in artifacts.items():
+        write(report_dir / name, value)
+    write_contact_sheet(report_dir / "local_overlap_contact_sheet.png", first["local_visual_sanity"])
+    manifest_path = report_dir / "materialization_manifest_v33.json"
+    command = {
+        "schema_version": 1, "task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "mode": MODE, "module": MODULE,
+        "published_at": now.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        "status_path": str((report_dir / "status.json").relative_to(ROOT)),
+        "log_path": str((report_dir / "run.log").relative_to(ROOT)),
+        "report_path": str((report_dir / "bridge_report.json").relative_to(ROOT)),
+        "payload": {
+            "report_dir": str(report_dir), "manifest_path": str(manifest_path), "manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+            "baseline_fcpxml": str(BASELINE), "baseline_fcpxml_sha256": first["manifest"]["baseline_fcpxml"]["sha256"],
+            "applied_timeline": applied, "generated_only_timeline": review,
+        },
+    }
+    command_path = ROOT / ".agent/commands/pending" / f"{TASK_ID}_{run_id}.json"
+    if active_commands():
+        raise ValueError("queue_changed_before_publication")
+    write(report_dir / "command.json", command)
+    write(command_path, command)
+    receipt = {"task_id": TASK_ID, "run_id": run_id, "command_path": str(command_path), "report_dir": str(report_dir), "applied_timeline": applied, "generated_only_timeline": review, "module": MODULE, "mode": MODE, "expected_objects": first["manifest"]["object_count"], "manifest_hash": run_1_hash}
+    write(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)
+    return receipt
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(publish(), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
diff --git a/scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py b/scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9a9c50d8824f09419d0da1094b68cdd6e6d9bbe0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+"""Validate immutable authorities and publish one guarded Step 6A bridge command."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration as runtime
+
+MODULE = "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py"
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    os.replace(temp, path)
+
+
+def new_run_id() -> str:
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    return f"{now:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}{now.microsecond // 1000:03d}Z_{uuid4().hex}"
+
+
+def transition_hints(planning: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    rows = []
+    for command in planning.get("timeline", []):
+        for operation in command.get("operations", []):
+            if operation.get("operation") == "transition_hint":
+                rows.append(operation.get("parameters") or {})
+    return rows
+
+
+def build_plan(detector: dict, planning: dict) -> dict:
+    if float(detector.get("fps") or 0) != 24.0 or float((planning.get("source") or {}).get("fps") or 0) != 24.0:
+        raise ValueError("authority_fps")
+    detector_rows = [row for row in detector.get("transitions", []) if row.get("transition_type") == "flash_cut" and row.get("editor_actionable") is True]
+    if len(detector_rows) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"executable_detector_rows:{len(detector_rows)}")
+    row = detector_rows[0]
+    if any((int(row.get("cut_frame") or -1) != 596, int(row.get("duration_frames") or -1) != 4, int(row.get("outgoing_frames") or -1) != 2, int(row.get("incoming_frames") or -1) != 2, row.get("confidence") != "high", (row.get("handle_check") or {}).get("ok") is not True)):
+        raise ValueError("accepted_detector_flash")
+    hints = transition_hints(planning)
+    accepted_hints = [hint for hint in hints if hint.get("transition_type") == "flash_cut" and int(hint.get("cut_frame") or -1) == 596]
+    if len(hints) != 1 or len(accepted_hints) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("planning_corroboration")
+    flash = {"transition_type": "flash_cut", "confidence": "high", "editor_actionable": True, "start_frame": 594, "cut_frame": 596, "end_frame_exclusive": 598, "duration_frames": 4, "outgoing_frames": 2, "incoming_frames": 2, "alpha_keyframes": [[0, 0.0], [2, 0.75], [3, 0.0]], "detector_authority": {key: row.get(key) for key in ("from_shot", "to_shot", "cut_time", "cut_frame", "timeline_cut_frame", "confidence", "transition_strength", "duration_frames", "outgoing_frames", "incoming_frames", "handle_check", "editor_actionable", "actionability_reason", "reasons")}, "planning_corroboration": {"cut_frame": 596, "transition_type": "flash_cut", "historical_duration_frames": int(accepted_hints[0].get("duration_frames") or 0), "execution_duration_source": "accepted_detector_authority"}}
+    plan = {"schema": "video_cloner.step6a_gold_flash_plan", "schema_version": 1, "task_id": runtime.TASK_ID, "project_name": runtime.PROJECT_NAME, "gold_timeline_name": runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "target_timeline_name": runtime.TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME, "gold_drt_path": runtime.GOLD_DRT_RELATIVE, "gold_drt_sha256": runtime.GOLD_DRT_SHA256, "detector_path": runtime.DETECTOR_RELATIVE, "detector_sha256": runtime.DETECTOR_SHA256, "planning_path": runtime.PLANNING_RELATIVE, "planning_sha256": runtime.PLANNING_SHA256, "reel_mapping": {"fps": 24, "start_frame": 594, "cut_frame": 596, "end_frame_exclusive": 598, "duration_frames": 4}, "carrier": {"kind": "transparent_rgba_sequence", "asset_dir": runtime.V4.NEUTRAL_ASSET_DIR_RELATIVE, "pattern": runtime.V4.NEUTRAL_PATTERN, "frame_count": 4, "media_pool_item_name": runtime.V4.NEUTRAL_MEDIA_POOL_ITEM_NAME, "png_sha256": runtime.V4.NEUTRAL_PNG_SHA256, "source_video_pixels_possible": False}, "flashes": [flash], "non_executable_transition_types": sorted({str(candidate.get("transition_type")) for candidate in detector.get("transitions", []) if candidate is not row})}
+    plan["plan_sha256"] = runtime.V1.canonical_sha256(plan)
+    runtime.validate_plan(plan)
+    return plan
+
+
+def publish(root: Path, mode: str, requested_run_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    root = root.resolve()
+    if mode not in {"apply", "idempotency"}:
+        raise ValueError("run_mode")
+    hashes = runtime.verify_input_hashes(root)
+    if not hashes["ok"]:
+        raise ValueError("authority_hash")
+    detector = json.loads((root / runtime.DETECTOR_RELATIVE).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    planning = json.loads((root / runtime.PLANNING_RELATIVE).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    plan = build_plan(detector, planning)
+    rid = requested_run_id or new_run_id()
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{8}T\d{9}Z_[0-9a-f]{32}", rid):
+        raise ValueError("run_id")
+    queue = root / ".agent" / "commands"
+    for state in ("pending", "running", "completed", "failed"):
+        (queue / state).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    active = [path for state in ("pending", "running") for path in (queue / state).iterdir() if path.is_file()]
+    if active:
+        raise ValueError("active_command")
+    report_rel = f".agent/reports/{runtime.TASK_ID}/{rid}"
+    report_dir = root / report_rel
+    report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    plan_path = report_dir / "step6a_flash_plan.json"
+    write_json(plan_path, plan)
+    command = {"schema_version": 1, "task": runtime.TASK_ID, "run_id": rid, "module": MODULE, "mode": runtime.MODE, "status_path": f"{report_rel}/status.json", "log_path": f"{report_rel}/run.log", "report_path": f"{report_rel}/report.json", "payload": {"repository_root": str(root), "report_dir": report_rel, "run_mode": mode, "plan_path": str(plan_path), "plan_sha256": runtime.sha256(plan_path), "expected_project": runtime.PROJECT_NAME, "gold_timeline_name": runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "target_timeline_name": runtime.TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME}}
+    pending = queue / "pending" / f"{runtime.TASK_ID}_{rid}.json"
+    write_json(pending, command)
+    write_json(report_dir / "command.json", command)
+    receipt = {"ok": True, "task_id": runtime.TASK_ID, "run_id": rid, "run_mode": mode, "command_path": str(pending.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "command_sha256": runtime.sha256(pending), "plan_path": str(plan_path), "plan_sha256": runtime.sha256(plan_path), "authority_verification": hashes}
+    write_json(report_dir / "publication_receipt.json", receipt)
+    return receipt
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run-mode", choices=("apply", "idempotency"), required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run-id")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        print(json.dumps(publish(args.root, args.run_mode, args.run_id), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+        return 0
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(f"FAIL: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+        return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

diff --git a/scripts/davinci/validate_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py b/scripts/davinci/validate_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py

+++ b/scripts/davinci/validate_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+"""Validate one completed Step 6A apply or idempotency report."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration as runtime
+
+
+def validate(report: dict, expected_mode: str) -> dict:
+    errors = []
+    classification = report.get("classification")
+    expected_classification = classification in {"FIRST_APPLICATION", "PARTIAL_TARGET_REPAIRED"} if expected_mode == "apply" else classification == "ALREADY_VALID_REUSED"
+    checks = {
+        "identity": report.get("task_id") == runtime.TASK_ID and report.get("mode") == runtime.MODE,
+        "result": report.get("ok") is True and expected_classification,
+        "authority": (report.get("authority_verification") or {}).get("ok") is True,
+        "source_unchanged": report.get("source_timeline_unchanged") is True,
+        "unrelated_unchanged": report.get("unrelated_timelines_unchanged") is True,
+        "target_contract": ((report.get("target_after") or {}).get("ok") is True),
+        "fusion_persisted": (((report.get("target_after") or {}).get("persisted_fusion") or {}).get("ok") is True),
+        "current_restored": ((report.get("previous_timeline_restoration") or {}).get("ok") is True),
+        "no_failures": not report.get("failures"),
+    }
+    if expected_mode == "apply":
+        expected_mutations = 1 if classification == "FIRST_APPLICATION" else 0
+        checks.update({"bounded_duplicate": report.get("timeline_duplicate_count") == expected_mutations, "bounded_track": report.get("track_add_count") == expected_mutations, "bounded_flash_append": report.get("flash_carrier_append_count") == expected_mutations, "visible_render": (report.get("visual_evidence") or {}).get("ok") is True, "saved_once": report.get("save_project_count") == 1, "persistent": report.get("persistent_readback_ok") is True})
+    else:
+        checks.update({"no_duplicate": report.get("timeline_duplicate_count") == 0, "no_track": report.get("track_add_count") == 0, "no_flash": report.get("flash_carrier_append_count") == 0, "no_media_import": report.get("media_import_count") == 0, "no_save": report.get("save_project_count") == 0, "idempotent": report.get("idempotent") is True})
+    errors.extend(name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok)
+    return {"ok": not errors, "expected_mode": expected_mode, "checks": checks, "errors": errors}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run-mode", choices=("apply", "idempotency"), required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        result = validate(json.loads(args.report.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), args.run_mode)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(f"FAIL: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+        return 1
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0 if result["ok"] else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+        raise LifecycleGenerationError("static style identity is not an accepted visual event: " + ",".join(unknown_static_identities))

+                if normalized:

+
+        units: list[dict] = []

+            except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:

+                "authority": {
+                    "kind": "visual_primary",
+                    "evidence_ids": [evidence_id] if evidence_id else [],

+                },

+            })
+
+        units.sort(key=lambda row: (row["window"][0], row["window"][1], row["tokens"][0]["visual_event_identity"]))
+        compositions: list[dict] = []
+        for unit in units:
+            previous = compositions[-1] if compositions else None
+            if previous and unit["window"][0] < previous["window"][1]:
+                previous["tokens"].extend(unit["tokens"])

+                previous["composition_id"] += "__" + unit["composition_id"].removeprefix("visual_composition_")
+            else:

+        return compositions
+
+    # Legacy cue-owned fallback is retained only for inputs that predate visual identity authority.

+    units: list[dict] = []
+    for cue in authority_cues:
+        cue_id = str(cue["id"])
