@@ -0,0 +1,259 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Iterable
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+
+WEIGHTS = ("LIGHT", "REGULAR", "SEMIBOLD", "BOLD", "BLACK")
+
+
+def project_bbox_to_crop(
+    crop_bbox: Iterable[int],
+    foreign_bbox: Iterable[int],
+    crop_shape: tuple[int, int],
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Project a source-space bbox into the target crop without inventing pixels."""
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = (int(value) for value in crop_bbox)
+    fx1, fy1, fx2, fy2 = (int(value) for value in foreign_bbox)
+    mask = np.zeros(crop_shape, dtype=bool)
+    left, top = max(x1, fx1), max(y1, fy1)
+    right, bottom = min(x2, fx2), min(y2, fy2)
+    if right > left and bottom > top:
+        mask[top - y1:bottom - y1, left - x1:right - x1] = True
+    return mask
+
+
+def build_crop_ownership(
+    target_fill: np.ndarray,
+    foreign_identity_masks: Iterable[np.ndarray] = (),
+    ambiguous_or_occluded_masks: Iterable[np.ndarray] = (),
+) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
+    """Return mutually exclusive crop-space ownership classes, failing closed."""
+    target_fill = np.asarray(target_fill, dtype=bool)
+    foreign = np.zeros_like(target_fill)
+    unknown = np.zeros_like(target_fill)
+    for mask in foreign_identity_masks:
+        value = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool)
+        if value.shape != target_fill.shape:
+            raise ValueError("foreign identity mask shape does not match target crop")
+        foreign |= value
+    for mask in ambiguous_or_occluded_masks:
+        value = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool)
+        if value.shape != target_fill.shape:
+            raise ValueError("unknown/occluded mask shape does not match target crop")
+        unknown |= value
+    unknown &= ~foreign
+    target = target_fill & ~foreign & ~unknown
+    usable_background = ~(target | foreign | unknown)
+    return {
+        "TARGET_OWNED": target,
+        "FOREIGN_IDENTITY": foreign,
+        "UNKNOWN_OR_OCCLUDED": unknown,
+        "USABLE_BACKGROUND": usable_background,
+    }
+
+
+def segment_fill_core(crop_bgr: np.ndarray, fill_hex: str, threshold: float = 70.0) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return a crop-aligned fill mask; unlike the frozen glyph helper this is not tightened."""
+    value = fill_hex.strip().lstrip("#")
+    if crop_bgr.size == 0 or len(value) != 6:
+        return np.zeros(crop_bgr.shape[:2] or (1, 1), dtype=bool)
+    bgr = np.array([int(value[4:6], 16), int(value[2:4], 16), int(value[0:2], 16)], np.float32)
+    distance = np.linalg.norm(crop_bgr.astype(np.float32) - bgr, axis=2)
+    mask = cv2.morphologyEx((distance <= threshold).astype(np.uint8), cv2.MORPH_OPEN, np.ones((2, 2), np.uint8))
+    count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask, 8)
+    kept = np.zeros_like(mask)
+    minimum = max(2, round(mask.size * 0.0015))
+    for label in range(1, count):
+        if stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA] >= minimum:
+            kept[labels == label] = 1
+    return kept.astype(bool)
+
+
+def measure_glyph_thickness(mask: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float | int] | None:
+    mask = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool)
+    if int(mask.sum()) < 24:
+        return None
+    rows, columns = np.where(mask)
+    mask = mask[rows.min():rows.max() + 1, columns.min():columns.max() + 1]
+    distance = cv2.distanceTransform(np.pad(mask, 1).astype(np.uint8), cv2.DIST_L2, 5)[1:-1, 1:-1]
+    peaks = mask & (distance >= cv2.dilate(distance, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)) - 1e-6) & (distance >= 1.0)
+    values = 2.0 * distance[peaks]
+    if len(values) < 3:
+        return None
+    return {
+        "median_px": round(float(np.median(values)), 6),
+        "p25_px": round(float(np.percentile(values, 25)), 6),
+        "p75_px": round(float(np.percentile(values, 75)), 6),
+        "normalized_to_glyph_height": round(float(np.median(values)) / max(1, mask.shape[0]), 6),
+        "glyph_height_px": int(mask.shape[0]),
+        "medial_sample_count": int(len(values)),
+    }
+
+
+def _weight_category(value: str) -> str:
+    normalized = value.casefold().replace(" ", "")
+    if "black" in normalized or "heavy" in normalized:
+        return "BLACK"
+    if "bold" in normalized:
+        return "BOLD"
+    if "semibold" in normalized or "demibold" in normalized:
+        return "SEMIBOLD"
+    if "light" in normalized or "thin" in normalized:
+        return "LIGHT"
+    return "REGULAR"
+
+
+def infer_thickness(
+    source_mask: np.ndarray,
+    candidate_mask: np.ndarray,
+    metadata_weight: str,
+    *,
+    font_authority: str,
+    evidence_classification: str,
+    mask_confidence: float,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    source = measure_glyph_thickness(source_mask)
+    candidate = measure_glyph_thickness(candidate_mask)
+    intrinsic = _weight_category(metadata_weight)
+    intrinsic_authority = (
+        "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_WEIGHT" if font_authority == "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING"
+        else "PROVISIONAL_FONT_WEIGHT" if font_authority == "PROVISIONAL_FONT_RANKING"
+        else "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_WEIGHT"
+    )
+    if source is None or candidate is None:
+        return {
+            "status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_THICKNESS_INFERENCE",
+            "reason": "insufficient_glyph_structure",
+            "intrinsic_weight_category": intrinsic if intrinsic_authority != "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_WEIGHT" else None,
+            "intrinsic_weight_authority": intrinsic_authority,
+            "observed_visual_weight_category": None,
+        }
+    candidate_at_source = float(candidate["median_px"]) * float(source["glyph_height_px"]) / max(1, int(candidate["glyph_height_px"]))
+    ratio = float(source["median_px"]) / max(1e-6, candidate_at_source)
+    index = WEIGHTS.index(intrinsic)
+    shift = -2 if ratio < 0.72 else -1 if ratio < 0.88 else 2 if ratio > 1.35 else 1 if ratio > 1.12 else 0
+    observed = WEIGHTS[max(0, min(len(WEIGHTS) - 1, index + shift))]
+    source_spread = (float(source["p75_px"]) - float(source["p25_px"])) / max(1e-6, float(source["median_px"]))
+    stable_measurement = (
+        source_spread <= 0.75
+        and 0.04 <= float(source["normalized_to_glyph_height"]) <= 0.45
+        and 0.25 <= ratio <= 2.0
+    )
+    source_status = (
+        "AUTHORITATIVE_THICKNESS_INFERENCE"
+        if evidence_classification == "CLEAN_MULTI_FRAME_EVIDENCE" and mask_confidence >= 0.40 and stable_measurement
+        else "PROVISIONAL_THICKNESS_INFERENCE"
+    )
+    if not stable_measurement and (ratio < 0.25 or ratio > 2.0):
+        observed = None
+    if intrinsic_authority == "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_WEIGHT":
+        observed = None
+        source_status = "PROVISIONAL_THICKNESS_INFERENCE"
+    elif intrinsic_authority != "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_WEIGHT" and source_status == "AUTHORITATIVE_THICKNESS_INFERENCE":
+        source_status = "PROVISIONAL_THICKNESS_INFERENCE"
+    return {
+        "status": source_status,
+        "reason": None if source_status == "AUTHORITATIVE_THICKNESS_INFERENCE" else "font_source_or_measurement_is_not_authoritative",
+        "source": source,
+        "candidate": candidate,
+        "candidate_median_at_source_height_px": round(candidate_at_source, 6),
+        "source_to_candidate_thickness_ratio": round(ratio, 6),
+        "source_thickness_spread_ratio": round(source_spread, 6),
+        "intrinsic_weight_category": intrinsic if intrinsic_authority != "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_WEIGHT" else None,
+        "intrinsic_weight_authority": intrinsic_authority,
+        "observed_visual_weight_category": observed,
+    }
+
+
+def detect_outline_observation(
+    crop_bgr: np.ndarray,
+    fill_mask: np.ndarray,
+    unknown_mask: np.ndarray | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    fill_mask = np.asarray(fill_mask, dtype=bool)
+    unknown = np.zeros_like(fill_mask) if unknown_mask is None else np.asarray(unknown_mask, dtype=bool)
+    if crop_bgr.shape[:2] != fill_mask.shape or unknown.shape != fill_mask.shape or int(fill_mask.sum()) < 24:
+        return {"status": "UNRESOLVED_EDGE_EVIDENCE", "present": None, "reason": "insufficient_or_misaligned_fill_core"}
+    rows, columns = np.where(fill_mask)
+    glyph_height = int(rows.max() - rows.min() + 1)
+    maximum = max(4, min(12, round(glyph_height * 0.12)))
+    distance = cv2.distanceTransform((~fill_mask).astype(np.uint8), cv2.DIST_L2, 5)
+    near = (distance > 0.2) & (distance <= maximum) & ~unknown
+    pixels = crop_bgr[near]
+    if len(pixels) < 24:
+        return {"status": "UNRESOLVED_EDGE_EVIDENCE", "present": None, "reason": "insufficient_known_edge_pixels"}
+    quantized = (pixels // 24).astype(np.int16)
+    colors, counts = np.unique(quantized, axis=0, return_counts=True)
+    fill_color = np.median(crop_bgr[fill_mask], axis=0)
+    best = None
+    for index in np.argsort(counts)[-8:]:
+        members = pixels[np.all(quantized == colors[index], axis=1)]
+        color = np.median(members, axis=0)
+        if float(np.linalg.norm(color - fill_color)) < 35.0:
+            continue
+        matches = np.linalg.norm(crop_bgr.astype(np.float32) - color.astype(np.float32), axis=2) <= 34.0
+        support = []
+        for band_index in range(1, maximum + 5):
+            band = (distance > band_index - 1) & (distance <= band_index) & ~unknown
+            support.append(float((matches & band).sum()) / max(1, int(band.sum())))
+        for width in range(1, maximum + 1):
+            inner = float(np.mean(support[:width]))
+            outer = float(np.mean(support[width + 1:min(len(support), width + 4)]))
+            candidate = (inner - outer, inner, -outer, -width, color, support, matches)
+            if best is None or candidate[:4] > best[:4]:
+                best = candidate
+    if best is None:
+        return {"status": "UNRESOLVED_EDGE_EVIDENCE", "present": None, "reason": "no_color_separated_edge_candidate"}
+    score, inner, negative_outer, negative_width, color, support, matches = best
+    width = -negative_width
+    outer = -negative_outer
+    stroke_mask = matches & (distance > 0.2) & (distance <= width) & ~unknown
+    result = {
+        "score": round(float(score), 6), "inner_support": round(float(inner), 6),
+        "outer_support": round(float(outer), 6), "width_px": int(width),
+        "color_bgr": [int(round(value)) for value in color],
+        "known_edge_pixel_count": int(near.sum()), "unknown_edge_pixel_count": int(((distance > 0.2) & (distance <= maximum) & unknown).sum()),
+        "stroke_mask": stroke_mask,
+    }
+    if width >= 2 and score >= 0.15 and inner >= 0.18 and outer <= 0.22:
+        return {**result, "status": "CANDIDATE_STROKE_EVIDENCE", "present": True, "reason": None}
+    if score <= 0.06 or inner <= 0.12:
+        return {**result, "status": "NO_STROKE_EVIDENCE", "present": False, "reason": None}
+    return {**result, "status": "UNRESOLVED_EDGE_EVIDENCE", "present": None, "reason": "anti_aliasing_background_or_shadow_ambiguity"}
+
+
+def aggregate_outline_observations(observations: Iterable[dict[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
+    rows = list(observations)
+    positive = [row for row in rows if row.get("present") is True]
+    negative = [row for row in rows if row.get("present") is False]
+    if len(positive) >= 2 and len(positive) / max(1, len(rows)) >= 0.5:
+        colors = np.asarray([row["color_bgr"] for row in positive], dtype=np.float32)
+        color = np.median(colors, axis=0)
+        widths = np.asarray([row["width_px"] for row in positive], dtype=np.float32)
+        stable_color = bool(np.max(np.linalg.norm(colors - color, axis=1)) <= 55.0)
+        stable_width = bool(np.max(np.abs(widths - np.median(widths))) <= max(1.5, 0.5 * float(np.median(widths))))
+        if stable_color and stable_width:
+            b, g, r = (int(round(value)) for value in color)
+            return {
+                "status": "PROVISIONAL_STROKE_INFERENCE", "present": True,
+                "width_px_source_space": round(float(np.median(widths)), 6),
+                "color_hex": f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}",
+                "supporting_observation_count": len(positive), "observation_count": len(rows),
+                "reason": "visual_human_review_required",
+            }
+    if len(rows) >= 2 and len(negative) == len(rows):
+        return {
+            "status": "PROVISIONAL_NO_STROKE_INFERENCE", "present": False,
+            "width_px_source_space": 0.0, "color_hex": None,
+            "supporting_observation_count": len(negative), "observation_count": len(rows),
+            "reason": "absence_requires_visual_human_review",
+        }
+    return {
+        "status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_STROKE_INFERENCE", "present": None,
+        "width_px_source_space": None, "color_hex": None,
+        "supporting_observation_count": len(positive), "observation_count": len(rows),
+        "reason": "inconsistent_or_ambiguous_edge_evidence",
+    }

diff --git a/tests/test_adjudicate_step4d_clipping_final.py b/tests/test_adjudicate_step4d_clipping_final.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..1aba9cbe37c848abcc54ce26bffc9d6bb1b3155a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_adjudicate_step4d_clipping_final.py
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/adjudicate_step4d_clipping_final.py"
+SELECTION = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/step4d_source_effect_adjudication_cases.json"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4d_clipping_final", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_final_clipping_adjudication_is_bounded_fail_closed_and_closure_ready():
+    first = MODULE.build(SELECTION)
+    assert first == MODULE.build(SELECTION)
+    adjudication = json.loads(first["step4d_clipping_final_adjudication.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(first["step4d_clipping_validation.json"])
+    matrix = json.loads(first["step4d_effect_class_final_matrix.json"])
+    deferred = json.loads(first["step4d_deferred_required_capabilities.json"])
+
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4D_FINAL_CLIPPING_ADJUDICATION_AND_CLOSURE_READINESS_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == validation["shadow_freeze_status"] == "PASS"
+    assert validation["occlusion_adjudication_status"] == "PASS_UNCHANGED"
+    assert validation["bounded_case_count"] == len(adjudication["cases"]) == 3
+    assert validation["negative_controls_remain_negative"] is True
+    assert validation["source_observed_known_missing_pixel_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["unknown_preserved"] is True
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is validation["occlusion_changed"] is validation["shadow_changed"] is False
+    assert validation["new_segmentation_added"] is validation["clipping_renderer_added"] is validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert validation["step5_started"] is validation["step6_started"] is validation["step4d_frozen"] is False
+    assert adjudication["class_verdict"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    assert len(adjudication["negative_control_identities"]) == 2 and len(adjudication["unsupported_identities"]) == 1
+    assert matrix["current_version_closure_ready"] is True
+    assert matrix["classes"]["caption_occlusion"]["status"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    capabilities = {row["id"]: row for row in deferred["capabilities"]}
+    assert set(capabilities) == {"CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"}
+    assert all(row["status"] == "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY" for row in capabilities.values())
+    assert all(row["required_before"] == "FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE" for row in capabilities.values())
+    assert matrix["classes"]["clipping"]["product_level_deferred_requirement"] == "CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2"
+    assert set(matrix["long_term_product_capability_status"]) == set(capabilities)
+    assert validation["required_deferred_capabilities"] == ["CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"]
+
+    all_true = dict.fromkeys(adjudication["cases"][0]["conditions"], True)
+    assert MODULE.clipping_verdict(all_true, False, True) == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING"
+    all_true["boundary_changes_temporally"] = False
+    assert MODULE.clipping_verdict(all_true, False, False) == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    assert MODULE.clipping_verdict(all_true, True, True) == "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED_CLIPPING"
diff --git a/tests/test_adjudicate_step4d_source_required_effects.py b/tests/test_adjudicate_step4d_source_required_effects.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..811dab882b57fd142ea1507416602e994d290389
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_adjudicate_step4d_source_required_effects.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/adjudicate_step4d_source_required_effects.py"
+SELECTION = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/step4d_source_effect_adjudication_cases.json"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4d_source_adjudication", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_source_required_adjudication_is_bounded_and_fail_closed():
+    artifacts = MODULE.build(SELECTION)
+    adjudication = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_source_required_effect_adjudication_validation.json"])
+
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4D_SOURCE_REQUIRED_EFFECT_ADJUDICATION_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == "PASS"
+    assert set(adjudication["class_verdicts"]) == set(MODULE.EFFECTS)
+    assert all(row["verdict"] in MODULE.CASE_VERDICTS for row in adjudication["cases"])
+    assert all(row["evidence_validity"] in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"} for row in adjudication["cases"] if row["verdict"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED")
+    assert all(row["verdict"] == "UNRESOLVED" for row in adjudication["cases"] if row["evidence_validity"] not in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"})
+    assert {effect: row["verdict"] for effect, row in adjudication["class_verdicts"].items()} == {
+        "shadow": "SOURCE_REQUIRED",
+        "glow": "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED",
+        "texture": "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED",
+        "gradient": "NOT_SOURCE_REQUIRED",
+        "clipping": "UNRESOLVED",
+    }
+    assert adjudication["caption_occlusion_status"]["verdict"] == "BLOCKED_BY_OWNERSHIP_EVIDENCE"
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["production_effect_mechanisms_added"] == 0
+    assert validation["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is validation["resolve_mutated"] is validation["step5_started"] is validation["step6_started"] is False

+from scripts.analysis.build_camera_style_profile import build_camera_style_profile
+
+
+def test_builds_locked_talking_head_profile_and_reframe_plan():
+    motion = {
+        "summary": {"dominant_motion_family": "pan_tilt"},
+        "segments": [
+            {"shot_id": 1, "start_seconds": 0.0, "end_seconds": 2.0, "motion_family": "pan_tilt", "confidence": "high", "global_motion": {"translation": {"direction": "pan_right"}}},
+            {"shot_id": 2, "start_seconds": 2.0, "end_seconds": 4.0, "motion_family": "push_in", "confidence": "medium"},
+        ],
+    }
+    observations = [
+        {"shot_id": 1, "time_sec": 0.2, "detected": True, "center": [0.49, 0.37], "size": [0.16, 0.2]},
+        {"shot_id": 1, "time_sec": 1.0, "detected": True, "center": [0.51, 0.38], "size": [0.17, 0.21]},
+        {"shot_id": 2, "time_sec": 2.5, "detected": True, "center": [0.5, 0.39], "size": [0.18, 0.22]},
+        {"shot_id": 2, "time_sec": 3.5, "detected": False},
+    ]
+
+    profile = build_camera_style_profile(motion, observations)
+
+    assert profile["schema"] == "video_cloner.camera_style.v1"
+    assert profile["framing"] == "centered_talking_head"
+    assert profile["subject_lock"] is True
+    assert profile["camera_motion"]["behavior"] == "moving"
+    assert profile["camera_motion"]["origin"] == "source_or_baked_editor_indeterminate"
+    assert profile["reframe_strategy"] == "sampled_primary_face_center"
+    assert len(profile["editor_transform"]["keyframes"]) == 3
+    assert len(profile["punch_in_events"]) == 1
+    assert profile["pan_events"][0]["direction"] == "pan_right"
+
+
+def test_fails_closed_when_no_face_is_detected():
+    profile = build_camera_style_profile({"segments": []}, [{"shot_id": 1, "time_sec": 0.0, "detected": False}])
+
+    assert profile["framing"] == "unknown"
+    assert profile["subject_lock"] is False
+    assert profile["reframe_strategy"] == "preserve_source_frame"
+    assert profile["editor_transform"]["operation"] == "none"
+    assert profile["confidence"] == 0.0

diff --git a/tests/test_build_caption_style_grammar_generic.py b/tests/test_build_caption_style_grammar_generic.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2bb45f5a8c947b4bab1daf77472dfdf27f3884d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_build_caption_style_grammar_generic.py
@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/build_caption_style_grammar_generic.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("build_caption_style_grammar_generic", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+assert SPEC.loader
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def _hash(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def test_normalizes_hints_without_inventing_boundaries(tmp_path):
+    source = {
+        "success": True,
+        "video_info": {"width": 1080, "height": 1920},
+        "summary": {"position": "middle_center", "text_color_median": "#ffffff"},
+        "caption_style_resolved": {
+            "confidence": {"score": 0.8, "frame_coverage_ratio": 0.75},
+            "typography": {"density": {"label": "word_by_word"}},
+        },
+        "caption_style_profiles": [{
+            "style_id": "style_01",
+            "sample_count": 3,
+            "typography": {"font_family": "unknown", "font_weight": "bold", "font_height_px": 60},
+            "placement": {"position": "middle_center"},
+            "colors": {"fill": "#ffffff", "stroke": "#000000"},
+            "stroke": {"enabled": True, "width_px_estimate": 4},
+        }],
+        "caption_style_events": [
+            {"event_id": "one", "style_profile_id": "style_01", "start": 0.0, "end": 0.5, "duration": 0.5, "typography": {"font_family": "unknown"}, "animation": {"type": "slide", "confidence": 0.7, "samples": 5}},
+            {"event_id": "two", "style_profile_id": "style_01", "start": 0.5, "end": 1.0, "duration": 0.5, "typography": {"font_family": "unknown"}, "animation": {"type": "scale_pop", "confidence": 0.8, "samples": 5}},
+            {"event_id": "three", "style_profile_id": "style_01", "start": 1.0, "end": 1.1, "duration": 0.1, "typography": {"font_family": "unknown"}, "animation": {"type": "unknown_or_static_insufficient_samples", "samples": 1}},
+        ],
+    }
+    path = tmp_path / "caption_style.json"
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(source), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    grammar = MODULE.build_grammar(path, "fresh_reel")
+
+    assert {row["family"]: row["boundary_count"] for row in grammar["animation_families"]} == {
+        "combination": 1,
+        "slide": 1,
+        "unresolved": 1,
+    }
+    assert grammar["font_rules"]["font_family_status"] == "UNKNOWN"
+    assert grammar["color_opacity_rules"]["fill_opacity"]["evidence_status"] == "UNKNOWN"
+    assert grammar["enter_exit_combos"] == [{
+        "combo": "unresolved->continuous_hold->unresolved",
+        "caption_count": 3,
+        "relationship_counts": {"UNKNOWN": 3},
+        "evidence_status": "UNKNOWN",
+        "reason": "generic event samples do not distinguish enter from exit",
+    }]
+    assert all(row["animation"]["enter"]["direction"] == "unknown" for row in grammar["per_caption_or_cluster_evidence"])
+    assert all(row["animation"]["exit"]["easing_category"] == "unknown" for row in grammar["per_caption_or_cluster_evidence"])
+
+
+def test_fresh_artifact_is_deterministic_and_does_not_touch_accepted_reel2():
+    source = ROOT / "data/DZatr0EJt4B/analysis/DZatr0EJt4B_caption_style.json"
+    accepted = ROOT / "data/DcJRJtUKScu/analysis/DcJRJtUKScu_caption_style_grammar.json"
+    accepted_hash = _hash(accepted)
+
+    first = MODULE.build_grammar(source, "DZatr0EJt4B")
+    second = MODULE.build_grammar(source, "DZatr0EJt4B")
+
+    assert json.dumps(first, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(second, sort_keys=True)
+    assert json.loads(json.dumps(first)) == first
+    assert first["schema"] == "video_cloner_caption_style_grammar"
+    assert first["persistence_rules"]["caption_count"] == 162
+    assert len(first["caption_style_families"]) == 5
+    assert len(first["per_caption_or_cluster_evidence"]) == 162
+    assert first["font_rules"]["font_family_status"] == "UNKNOWN"
+    assert first["unresolved"]["opacity_count"] == 162
+    assert first["unresolved"]["entry_animation_count"] == 162
+    assert _hash(accepted) == accepted_hash
+    source_text = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
+    assert "dcjrjtukscu" not in source_text
+    assert "gold" not in source_text
+    assert "drt" not in source_text

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/calibrate_step2f_font_authority.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("calibration", SCRIPT)
+calibration = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+assert SPEC.loader
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(calibration)
+
+
+def test_existing_source_style_thresholds_downgrade_ranking_only_certainty():
+    from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_font_inference import authority_classification
+
+    assert authority_classification([{"score": .746}, {"score": .723}], .455) == ("BEST_AVAILABLE_FONT_MATCH_MEDIUM", "MEDIUM")
+    assert authority_classification([{"score": .80}, {"score": .70}], .70) == ("BEST_AVAILABLE_FONT_MATCH_HIGH", "HIGH")
+
+
+def test_authoritative_cross_property_disagreement_is_detected():
+    record = {
+        "typography": {
+            "intrinsic_weight": {"category": "REGULAR", "authority": {"status": "AUTHORITATIVE"}},
+            "observed_thickness": {"observed_visual_weight_category": "LIGHT", "authority": {"status": "PROVISIONAL"}},
+        }
+    }
+    assert calibration.cross_property_conflicts(record, "BLACK") == ["selected_BLACK_vs_authoritative_intrinsic_weight_REGULAR"]
+
+
+def test_provisional_cross_property_signal_does_not_create_false_conflict():
+    record = {
+        "typography": {
+            "intrinsic_weight": {"category": "REGULAR", "authority": {"status": "PROVISIONAL"}},
+            "observed_thickness": {"observed_visual_weight_category": "LIGHT", "authority": {"status": "PROVISIONAL"}},
+        }
+    }
+    assert calibration.cross_property_conflicts(record, "BLACK") == []
+
+
+def test_production_calibrator_contains_no_control_specific_rules():
+    source = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    for value in ("caption_tracklet_0091", "caption_tracklet_0061", '"buy"', '"reels"'):
+        assert value not in source
diff --git a/tests/test_calibrate_step4d_shadow_parameters.py b/tests/test_calibrate_step4d_shadow_parameters.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e75c846d1531f7767ab2e03d37f8375c66d1aa8d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_calibrate_step4d_shadow_parameters.py
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/calibrate_step4d_shadow_parameters.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4d_shadow_parameters", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_shadow_parameter_calibration_is_bounded_deconfounded_and_fail_closed():
+    artifacts = MODULE.build()
+    calibrated = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_ir_calibrated.json"])
+    fit = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_parameter_fit.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_parameter_validation.json"])
+    review = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_parameter_human_review_data.json"])
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in calibrated["shadows"]}
+
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4D_SHADOW_PARAMETER_FIDELITY_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == "PASS"
+    assert validation["shadow_presence_authority_changed"] is False
+    assert validation["positive_presence_unchanged"] is validation["negative_controls_unchanged"] is True
+    assert validation["negative_control_parameter_authority_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["font_geometry_deconfounded"] is validation["source_domain_fit_improved"] is True
+    assert fit["method"]["font_renderer_used"] is False
+    assert "unknown_contaminated_pixels" in fit["method"]["excluded"]
+    positive = next(row for row in calibrated["shadows"] if row["presence_authority"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED_SHADOW")
+    assert positive["offset"]["authority"] == "BOUNDED_RANGE_ONLY"
+    assert positive["offset"]["y_range_px"][0] > 5
+    assert positive["softness"]["authority"] == "BOUNDED_RANGE_ONLY"
+    assert positive["strength"]["alpha"] is None
+    assert positive["color"]["isolated_color_authority"] == "UNRESOLVED"
+    assert all(row["parameter_authority"] == "NONE_UPSTREAM_PRESENCE_GATE_FAILED" for row in calibrated["shadows"] if row is not positive)
+    assert any(frame["excluded_unknown_pixel_count"] > 0 for case in fit["cases"] for frame in case["frame_fits"])
+    assert validation["global_shadow_propagation"] is validation["general_mask_repair_added"] is validation["segmentation_system_added"] is False
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is validation["resolve_mutated"] is validation["occlusion_started"] is validation["step5_started"] is validation["step6_started"] is False
+    assert review["human_review_status"] == "PENDING"
+    assert review["review_order"][0] == "DECONFOUNDED_SOURCE_GLYPH_SHADOW"
+    placed = MODULE.place_mask(np.ones((3, 5), bool), (20, 30), np.pad(np.ones((8, 12), bool), ((6, 6), (9, 9))))
+    assert placed.max() == 255 and np.count_nonzero(placed) > 0
diff --git a/tests/test_caption_style_event_normalization_identity.py b/tests/test_caption_style_event_normalization_identity.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..223c22ed0041071b2767c29e8de11bbcfeb6ddf1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_caption_style_event_normalization_identity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+from scripts.davinci.compile_davinci_textplus_fcpxml import extract_caption_style_events
+
+
+def _event(identity, text="the", start=5.4, end=6.4, **extra):
+    row = {"event_id": extra.pop("event_id", identity or "legacy"), "text": text, "start": start, "end": end, **extra}
+    if identity is not None:
+        row["visual_event_identity"] = identity
+    return row
+
+
+def test_different_visual_identities_survive_same_legacy_key_with_metadata():
+    hits = _event("caption_tracklet_0029", text="broad phrase", tracklet_ids=["caption_tracklet_0029"])
+    yard = _event("caption_tracklet_0031", text="broad phrase", tracklet_ids=["caption_tracklet_0031"])
+
+    events = extract_caption_style_events({"caption_style_events": [hits, yard]}, fps=30.0)
+
+    assert [event["raw"]["visual_event_identity"] for event in events] == [
+        "caption_tracklet_0029", "caption_tracklet_0031"
+    ]
+    assert events[1]["raw"]["tracklet_ids"] == ["caption_tracklet_0031"]
+
+
+def test_same_visual_identity_keeps_first_row_deterministically():
+    first = _event("continuous_visual_identity_0028", text="sign", start=5.333, end=6.3, event_id="first")
+    duplicate = _event("continuous_visual_identity_0028", text="different", start=8.0, end=9.0, event_id="second")
+
+    events = extract_caption_style_events({"caption_style_events": [first, duplicate]}, fps=30.0)
+
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    assert events[0]["id"] == "first"
+    assert (events[0]["start"], events[0]["end"]) == (5.333, 6.3)
+
+
+def test_legacy_collision_keeps_existing_first_row_behavior():
+    first = _event(None, text="legacy", event_id="first")
+    duplicate = _event(None, text="legacy", event_id="second")
+
+    events = extract_caption_style_events({"caption_style_events": [first, duplicate]}, fps=30.0)
+
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    assert events[0]["id"] == "first"
+
+
+def test_repeated_the_and_continuous_sign_survive_in_deterministic_time_order():
+    rows = [
+        _event("lower_the", start=5.4, end=6.4, bbox=[370, 803, 526, 878]),
+        _event("continuous_visual_identity_0028", text="sign", start=5.333, end=6.3, tracklet_ids=["caption_tracklet_0028", "caption_tracklet_0033"]),
+        _event("upper_the", start=5.3, end=6.433, bbox=[508, 389, 620, 445]),
+    ]
+
+    events = extract_caption_style_events({"caption_style_events": rows}, fps=30.0)
+
+    assert [event["raw"]["visual_event_identity"] for event in events] == [
+        "upper_the", "continuous_visual_identity_0028", "lower_the"
+    ]
+    assert events[1]["raw"]["tracklet_ids"] == ["caption_tracklet_0028", "caption_tracklet_0033"]
+    assert events[0]["raw"]["bbox"] != events[2]["raw"]["bbox"]
diff --git a/tests/test_close_step4d_advanced_text_effects.py b/tests/test_close_step4d_advanced_text_effects.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..36f7662c1274d73756b2658bf38210bab2f76bb3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_close_step4d_advanced_text_effects.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/close_step4d_advanced_text_effects.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("close_step4d", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_step4d_closure_pins_corrected_bookkeeping_without_runtime_changes():
+    output = ROOT / ".pytest-tmp-step4d-freeze/unit"
+    first = MODULE.build(output, "2026-09-28T18:30:00+03:00")
+    assert first == MODULE.build(output, "2026-09-28T18:30:00+03:00")
+    matrix = json.loads(first["step4d_effect_class_final_matrix.json"])
+    capabilities = json.loads(first["step4d_deferred_required_capabilities.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(first["step4d_final_closure_validation.json"])
+    acceptance = json.loads(first["step4d_human_acceptance.json"])
+    freeze = json.loads(first["__freeze_state__"])
+
+    by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in capabilities["capabilities"]}
+    required = {"CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"}
+    assert set(by_id) == required
+    assert all(row["status"] == "DEFERRED_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY" for row in by_id.values())
+    assert all(row["required_before"] == "FINAL_PARITY / RELEASE ACCEPTANCE" for row in by_id.values())
+    assert matrix["classes"]["clipping"]["status"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    assert matrix["classes"]["caption_occlusion"]["status"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    assert set(matrix["long_term_product_capability_status"]) == required
+    assert acceptance["human_decision"] == acceptance["step_4d_current_version_decision"] == "ACCEPT"
+    assert freeze["step4d_final_status"] == "COMPLETE_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_FROZEN_CURRENT_VERSION"
+    assert freeze["deferred_required_capabilities"] == ["CAPTION_CLIPPING_DETECTION_V2", "CAPTION_OCCLUSION_DETECTION_V2"]
+    assert freeze["reopen_allowed_now"] is False
+    assert validation["production_runtime_changed"] is validation["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert validation["step5_status"] == "UNBLOCKED_NOT_STARTED" and validation["step6_started"] is False
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
diff --git a/tests/test_compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay.py b/tests/test_compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..130a0a010fe7726e6f55b697a3ef431612b1bdec

+++ b/tests/test_compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay.py
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5_f5d_static_style_overlay import (
+    F5A_CONTRACT,
+    ROOT,
+    _bytes,
+    compile_f5_contract,
+)
+
+
+def _by_id(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    return {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def test_all_nine_human_approvals_compile_to_generic_style_ir() -> None:
+    authority, contract, validation = compile_f5_contract()
+    rows = _by_id(contract["objects"])
+
+    assert authority["human_decision_count"] == authority["human_approved_count"] == 9
+    assert authority["pending_human_decisions"] == 0
+    assert all(row["human_approved"] is True for row in authority["records"])
+
+    assert rows["continuous_visual_identity_0028"]["font"]["resolve_family"] == "Tahoma"
+    assert rows["continuous_visual_identity_0028"]["font"]["resolve_style"] == "Bold"
+    assert rows["continuous_visual_identity_0028"]["fill"]["resolve_rgb"] == [205, 139, 99]
+
+    listing = rows["recovered_display_object_listing_0003"]
+    assert (listing["font"]["resolve_family"], listing["font"]["resolve_style"]) == ("Arial", "Black")
+    assert listing["fill"]["resolve_rgb"] == [250, 218, 172]
+    assert listing["size"]["resolve_value"] == listing["scale_decision"]["static_base_size"] == 0.113888889
+    assert listing["position"]["resolve_center"] == [0.50555556, 0.603125]
+    assert listing["resolve_interval"] == [330, 347]
+
+    buyers = rows["caption_tracklet_0097"]
+    assert (buyers["font"]["resolve_family"], buyers["font"]["resolve_style"]) == ("Arial", "Black")
+    assert buyers["font"]["italic"] is True
+    assert buyers["font"]["italic_treatment"] == {
+        "type": "textplus_transform_shear",
+        "input": "TransformShear",
+        "value": 0.08393,
+        "authority": "SOURCE_MEASURED_VERTICAL_SLANT_PROXY",
+    }
+
+    why = rows["recovered_display_object_why_0001"]
+    assert (why["font"]["resolve_family"], why["font"]["resolve_style"]) == ("Tahoma", "Bold")
+    assert why["fill"]["type"] == "linear_gradient"
+    assert why["fill"]["orientation"] == "HORIZONTAL"
+    assert why["fill"]["direction"] == "LEFT_TO_RIGHT_A_TO_B"
+    assert why["fill"]["stops"] == [
+        {"position": 0.0, "rgb": [190, 68, 78]},
+        {"position": 1.0, "rgb": [169, 50, 115]},
+    ]
+    assert why["opacity"]["mode"] == "constant"
+    assert why["opacity"]["resolve_value"] == 0.75
+    assert "opacity_stops" not in json.dumps(why, sort_keys=True)
+    assert why["keyframes"]["relative_visibility"] == []
+
+    local_we = rows["recovered_display_object_local_we_0002"]
+    assert (local_we["font"]["resolve_family"], local_we["font"]["resolve_style"]) == ("Segoe UI", "Regular")
+    assert validation["all_pass"] is True
+
+
+def test_protected_domains_and_required_controls_are_unchanged() -> None:
+    _, contract, validation = compile_f5_contract()
+    base = json.loads((ROOT / F5A_CONTRACT).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    base_objects, objects = _by_id(base["objects"]), _by_id(contract["objects"])
+    base_identities, identities = _by_id(base["identity_records"]), _by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+
+    assert len(contract["identity_records"]) == 113
+    assert contract["base_renderable_identity_count"] == 62
+    assert contract["recovered_display_object_count"] == 3
+    assert len(contract["objects"]) == 65
+    for key in ("text_domain_unchanged", "timing_domain_unchanged", "scale_domain_unchanged", "lifecycle_domain_unchanged", "ownership_domain_unchanged", "position_domain_unchanged", "motion_rotation_visibility_unchanged"):
+        assert validation["checks"][key] is True
+
+    for identity in ("caption_tracklet_0045", "caption_tracklet_0064", "caption_tracklet_0089", "continuous_visual_identity_0113"):
+        assert objects[identity] == base_objects[identity]
+    for identity in ("caption_tracklet_0061", "caption_tracklet_0062", "caption_tracklet_0063"):
+        assert identities[identity] == base_identities[identity]
+    assert identities["caption_tracklet_0061"]["text"]["value"] == "reels"
+    assert identities["caption_tracklet_0061"]["renderable"] is True
+    assert identities["caption_tracklet_0062"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert identities["caption_tracklet_0063"]["renderable"] is False
+
+
+def test_generalization_guards_and_determinism_pass() -> None:
+    first = compile_f5_contract()
+    second = compile_f5_contract()
+    validation = first[2]
+    assert validation["production_branch_counts"] == {"literal": 0, "identity": 0, "reel": 0, "human_choice": 0}
+    assert [_bytes(value) for value in first] == [_bytes(value) for value in second]
+    assert validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_F5_HUMAN_APPROVED_STATIC_STYLE_IMPLEMENTATION"
diff --git a/tests/test_compile_step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction.py b/tests/test_compile_step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..734f12ddfa3153a207f76b7069feffa41a742f43
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_compile_step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction.py
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5_f6_lifecycle_end_correction import (
+    F5_CONTRACT,
+    ROOT,
+    _bytes,
+    compile_f6_contract,
+)
+
+
+def _by_id(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    return {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def test_source_proven_half_open_boundary_uses_canonical_mapping() -> None:
+    authority, contract, validation = compile_f6_contract()
+    record = authority["records"][0]
+    target = _by_id(contract["objects"])[record["object_id"]]
+
+    assert record["last_visible_source_frame"] == 744
+    assert record["first_nonvisible_source_frame"] == record["source_end_exclusive"] == 745
+    assert record["accepted_timeline_end_exclusive"] == round(745 / 30.0 * 24.0) == 596
+    assert record["original_timeline_interval"] == [542, 570]
+    assert record["accepted_timeline_interval"] == target["source_interval"] == target["resolve_interval"] == [542, 596]
+    assert target["source_interval"][0] == 542
+    assert target["source_interval"][1] > 570
+    assert validation["checks"]["canonical_source_timeline_mapping_used"] is True
+    assert validation["checks"]["source_end_is_half_open"] is True
+
+
+def test_only_lifecycle_end_changes_and_f5_domains_remain_frozen() -> None:
+    authority, contract, validation = compile_f6_contract()
+    base = json.loads((ROOT / F5_CONTRACT).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    target_id = authority["records"][0]["object_id"]
+    base_objects, objects = _by_id(base["objects"]), _by_id(contract["objects"])
+    base_identities, identities = _by_id(base["identity_records"]), _by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+
+    assert len(contract["identity_records"]) == 113
+    assert contract["base_renderable_identity_count"] == 62
+    assert contract["recovered_display_object_count"] == 3
+    assert len(contract["objects"]) == contract["final_renderable_object_count"] == 65
+    assert (contract["human_decision_count"], contract["human_approved_count"], contract["pending_human_decisions"]) == (9, 9, 0)
+    assert validation["counts"]["corrected_lifecycle_identities"] == 1
+    assert validation["checks"]["only_authorized_lifecycle_records_changed"] is True
+    for key, value in validation["checks"].items():
+        assert value is True, key
+
+    for before, after in ((base_objects, objects), (base_identities, identities)):
+        for identity in before:
+            expected = json.loads(json.dumps(before[identity]))
+            if identity == target_id:
+                expected["source_interval"][1] = 596
+                expected["resolve_interval"][1] = 596
+            assert after[identity] == expected
+
+    target_before, target_after = base_objects[target_id], objects[target_id]
+    assert target_after["text"] == target_before["text"]
+    assert target_after["position"] == target_before["position"]
+    assert (target_after.get("composition"), target_after.get("object_origin")) == (target_before.get("composition"), target_before.get("object_origin"))
+    assert target_after["keyframes"]["scale"] == target_before["keyframes"]["scale"]
+    assert target_after["scale_decision"] == target_before["scale_decision"]
+    assert len(target_after["keyframes"]["scale"]) == 9
+    assert [key["timeline_frame"] for key in target_after["keyframes"]["scale"]] == [542, 543, 544, 545, 546, 547, 548, 549, 550]
+    assert max(key["timeline_frame"] for key in target_after["keyframes"]["scale"]) == 550
+
+
+def test_generalization_guards_and_determinism_pass() -> None:
+    first = compile_f6_contract()
+    second = compile_f6_contract()
+    validation = first[2]
+
+    assert validation["production_branch_counts"] == {"literal": 0, "identity": 0, "reel": 0}
+    assert [_bytes(value) for value in first] == [_bytes(value) for value in second]
+    assert validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_F6_6000_LIFECYCLE_CORRECTION"
diff --git a/tests/test_compile_step5a_f2_text_authority.py b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f2_text_authority.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cdb4bc28f4eaf26a75062836c3bfc7d3d3a2f431
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f2_text_authority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+import copy
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f2_text_authority import compile_f2_contract, select_display_text
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_textplus_contract import compile_contract as compile_base_contract
+
+
+def _link(identity: str, relationship: str, contract: str, source: str | None, font: str | None) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "identity": identity,
+        "contract_text": contract,
+        "source_visible_text": source,
+        "font_scoring_text": font,
+        "text_mask_relationship": relationship,
+        "source_evidence_provenance": {"authority": "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_LINKAGE_DECISION"},
+    }
+
+
+def _by_id(rows: list[dict], key: str = "identity") -> dict[str, dict]:
+    return {row[key]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def _without_text(row: dict) -> dict:
+    value = copy.deepcopy(row)
+    value.pop("text", None)
+    value.pop("renderable", None)
+    value.pop("display_text_decision", None)
+    return value
+
+
+def test_generic_selection_precedence_and_fail_closed_policy() -> None:
+    unresolved = select_display_text(_link("a", "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED", "diagnostic", None, "diagnostic"), None, None)
+    assert unresolved["renderable"] is False
+    assert unresolved["suppression_reason"] == "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED_WITHOUT_HIGHER_AUTHORITY"
+
+    mismatch = select_display_text(_link("b", "MISMATCH", "word", "noise", "word"), None, None)
+    assert mismatch["renderable"] is False
+    assert mismatch["suppression_reason"] == "UNSAFE_MISMATCH_WITHOUT_HIGHER_AUTHORITY"
+
+    visual = select_display_text(_link("c", "EXACT_MATCH", "wrong", "RIGHT", "RIGHT"), None, None)
+    assert visual["renderable"] is True
+    assert visual["selected_display_text"] == "RIGHT"
+    assert visual["display_text_authority"] == "STRONG_ACCEPTED_VISUAL_TEXT"
+
+    inconsistent = select_display_text(_link("d", "EXACT_MATCH", "home.", "home", "home."), None, None)
+    assert inconsistent["renderable"] is False
+
+    fragment = select_display_text(_link("e", "ACCEPTED_VISUAL_FRAGMENT", "calling", "calling", "ling"), None, None)
+    assert fragment["renderable"] is True
+    assert fragment["selected_display_text"] == "ling"
+
+    owner = {
+        "accepted_display_text": "accepted",
+        "display_object_group_id": "g",
+        "case": "CASE",
+        "disposition": "RENDERABLE_CANONICAL_OWNER",
+        "canonical_owner_identity": "f",
+    }
+    alias = {**owner, "disposition": "NON_RENDERING_LIFECYCLE_ALIAS_MERGED_INTO_CANONICAL_OWNER"}
+    duplicate = {**owner, "disposition": "SUPPRESS_UNRESOLVED_DUPLICATE"}
+    assert select_display_text(_link("f", "MISMATCH", "x", "y", "x"), owner, None)["selected_display_text"] == "accepted"
+    assert select_display_text(_link("g", "MISMATCH", "x", "y", "x"), alias, None)["renderable"] is False
+    assert select_display_text(_link("h", "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED", "x", None, "x"), duplicate, None)["renderable"] is False
+
+    duplicate_one = select_display_text(_link("i", "EXACT_MATCH", "same", "same", "same"), None, None)
+    duplicate_two = select_display_text(_link("j", "EXACT_MATCH", "same", "same", "same"), None, None)
+    assert duplicate_one["renderable"] is duplicate_two["renderable"] is True
+
+
+def test_whole_reel_f2_authority_accounting_and_regressions() -> None:
+    contract, validation, decisions_artifact = compile_f2_contract()
+    rerun = compile_f2_contract()
+    assert (contract, validation, decisions_artifact) == rerun
+    assert validation["all_pass"] is True
+    counts = validation["counts"]
+    assert counts == {
+        "total_frozen_identities": 113,
+        "renderable_identities": 62,
+        "non_rendering_alias_identities": 1,
+        "suppressed_unresolved_identities": 47,
+        "suppressed_unsafe_mismatch_identities": 0,
+        "suppressed_other_unsafe_identities": 3,
+        "adjudicated_display_text_identities": 5,
+        "source_visual_text_identities": 19,
+        "accepted_fragment_identities": 10,
+        "safe_contract_text_identities": 31,
+    }
+    decisions = _by_id(decisions_artifact["decisions"])
+    objects = _by_id(contract["objects"], "source_identity")
+
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0045"]["selected_display_text"] == "invest"
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0045"]["renderable"] is True
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0044"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0048"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert sum(row["selected_display_text"] == "invest" and row["renderable"] for row in decisions.values()) == 1
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0064"]["selected_display_text"] == "social"
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0066"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert sum(row["selected_display_text"] == "social" and row["renderable"] for row in decisions.values()) == 1
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0044"]["selected_display_text"] is None
+
+    assert decisions["continuous_visual_identity_0113"]["selected_display_text"] == "PAMELA"
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0114"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0115"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0012"]["selected_display_text"] == "launch"
+    assert decisions["caption_tracklet_0061"]["selected_display_text"] == "reels"
+
+    dump_ids = {
+        "caption_tracklet_0034",
+        "caption_tracklet_0035",
+        "caption_tracklet_0038",
+        "caption_tracklet_0053",
+        "caption_tracklet_0056",
+        "caption_tracklet_0071",
+        "caption_tracklet_0074",
+    }
+    assert all(
+        not decisions[identity]["renderable"]
+        or decisions[identity]["selected_display_text"] != decisions[identity]["contract_text"]
+        for identity in dump_ids
+    )
+    assert validation["full_sentence_dump_cases_remaining"] == []
+    assert validation["unsafe_visible_text_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["other_text_authority_blockers"] == []
+    assert set(objects) == {row["identity"] for row in decisions.values() if row["renderable"]}
+
+    base, _ = compile_base_contract()
+    base_rows = _by_id(base["objects"], "source_identity")
+    all_rows = _by_id(contract["identity_records"], "source_identity")
+    assert set(base_rows) == set(all_rows)
+    assert all(_without_text(base_rows[identity]) == _without_text(all_rows[identity]) for identity in base_rows)
+    assert contract["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert all(row["match"] for row in contract["freeze_integrity"])
diff --git a/tests/test_compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority.py b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..ddde39293d9b5a4e6c469b17c2dc1eb462f97475
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,145 @@
+import copy
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f3_scale_authority import (
+    absolute_size,
+    compile_f3_contract,
+    compile_scale_decision,
+    load_scale_authorities,
+)
+
+
+def _row(identity: str = "sample", *, base: float = 0.4, renderable: bool = True, source: str = "STEP_4B_RAW_SAMPLE") -> dict:
+    return {
+        "source_identity": identity,
+        "renderable": renderable,
+        "source_interval": [10, 20],
+        "size": {"resolve_value": base, "source_authority": "AUTHORITATIVE"},
+        "keyframes": {"scale": [{"timeline_frame": 11, "local_frame": 1, "value": 1.3, "source": source}]},
+    }
+
+
+def _authority(identity: str = "sample") -> dict:
+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_step5a_f3a2_scale_lifecycle_boundary_adjudication",
+        "identity": identity,
+        "authority": "ACCEPTED_SCALE_REPRODUCTION_ADJUDICATION",
+        "relative_scale_anchors": [
+            {"timeline_frame": 10, "relative_scale": 0.82, "phase": "ENTRY_EXPANSION"},
+            {"timeline_frame": 11, "relative_scale": 1.0, "phase": "PLATEAU"},
+            {"timeline_frame": 12, "relative_scale": 1.0, "phase": "PLATEAU"},
+            {"timeline_frame": 13, "relative_scale": 0.9, "phase": "EXIT_CONTRACTION"},
+        ],
+        "phase_boundaries": {"contraction_start": {"timeline_frame": 13}},
+        "interpolation_policy": {"overshoot_allowed": False},
+        "_path": "accepted.json",
+        "_sha256": "abc",
+        "_phases": {
+            "ENTRY_EXPANSION": {"interpolation": "LINEAR"},
+            "PLATEAU": {"interpolation": "HOLD"},
+            "EXIT_CONTRACTION": {"interpolation": "LINEAR"},
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _by_id(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    return {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def test_relative_scale_maps_to_each_identity_base_size() -> None:
+    assert absolute_size(0.4, 1.0) == pytest.approx(0.4)
+    assert absolute_size(0.4, 0.82) == pytest.approx(0.328)
+    assert absolute_size(0.4, 1.3) == pytest.approx(0.52)
+    first, _ = compile_scale_decision(_row("first", base=0.4), _authority("first"))
+    second, _ = compile_scale_decision(_row("second", base=0.2), _authority("second"))
+    assert first[0]["value"] == pytest.approx(0.328)
+    assert second[0]["value"] == pytest.approx(0.164)
+    assert all(key["value"] == pytest.approx(0.4 * key["relative_scale"]) for key in first)
+
+
+def test_scale_gate_suppresses_measurements_labels_orphans_and_nonrenderable_rows() -> None:
+    for label in ("SCALE", "SCALE_OVERSHOOT"):
+        row = _row()
+        row["derived_label"] = label
+        keys, decision = compile_scale_decision(row, None)
+        assert keys == []
+        assert decision["scale_suppression_reason"] == "NO_ACCEPTED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_RAW_MEASUREMENTS_ONLY"
+    orphan = _row(source="STEP_4C_EDITOR_NEUTRAL_KEYFRAME")
+    assert compile_scale_decision(orphan, None)[1]["scale_suppression_reason"] == "NO_ACCEPTED_REPRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_ORPHAN_STEP4C"
+    nonrenderable = _row(renderable=False)
+    assert compile_scale_decision(nonrenderable, _authority())[0] == []
+    assert compile_scale_decision(nonrenderable, _authority())[1]["scale_suppression_reason"] == "NON_RENDERABLE_IDENTITY"
+
+
+def test_authority_is_consumed_generically_with_safe_segments() -> None:
+    keys, decision = compile_scale_decision(_row(), _authority())
+    assert decision["scale_authority_status"] == "AUTHORIZED"
+    assert [key["interpolation_to_next"] for key in keys] == ["LINEAR", "HOLD", "LINEAR", "NONE"]
+    assert [key["relative_scale"] for key in keys] == [0.82, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9]
+    assert all(key["source"] == "STEP5A_F3A2_ACCEPTED_SCALE_AUTHORITY" for key in keys)
+
+
+
+def test_whole_reel_f3_scale_contract_and_regressions() -> None:
+    contract, validation, decisions = compile_f3_contract()
+    assert (contract, validation, decisions) == compile_f3_contract()
+    assert validation["all_pass"] is True
+    assert contract["identity_count"] == 113
+    assert contract["object_count"] == 62
+    counts = validation["counts"]
+    assert counts["current_f2_scale_key_count"] == 44
+    assert counts["current_f2_renderable_scale_key_count"] == 43
+    assert counts["authorized_scale_identities"] == 1
+    assert counts["authorized_scale_identity_list"] == ["caption_tracklet_0089"]
+    assert counts["authorized_relative_scale_key_count"] == 9
+    assert counts["final_editor_scale_key_count"] == 9
+    assert counts["suppressed_raw_measurement_scale_keys"] == 42
+    assert counts["suppressed_orphan_scale_keys"] == 2
+    assert counts["suppressed_renderable_orphan_scale_keys"] == 1
+    assert counts["unauthorized_scale_commands"] == 0
+    assert counts["non_renderable_scale_commands"] == 0
+    assert counts["relative_as_absolute_unit_errors"] == 0
+    assert counts["raw_ratio_as_absolute_count"] == 0
+
+    rows = _by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+    six_thousand = rows["caption_tracklet_0089"]
+    keys = six_thousand["keyframes"]["scale"]
+    expected_ratios = [0.82, 0.9, 0.96, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.96, 0.92, 0.86]
+    assert [key["timeline_frame"] for key in keys] == list(range(542, 551))
+    assert [key["relative_scale"] for key in keys] == expected_ratios
+    base = six_thousand["size"]["resolve_value"]
+    assert [key["value"] for key in keys] == pytest.approx([base * ratio for ratio in expected_ratios])
+    assert [key["interpolation_to_next"] for key in keys] == ["LINEAR", "LINEAR", "LINEAR", "HOLD", "HOLD", "LINEAR", "LINEAR", "LINEAR", "NONE"]
+    assert max(key["timeline_frame"] for key in keys) == 550
+    assert all(right <= left for left, right in zip(expected_ratios[6:], expected_ratios[7:]))
+
+    assert rows["continuous_visual_identity_0014"]["keyframes"]["scale"] == []
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0067"]["keyframes"]["scale"] == []
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0086"]["keyframes"]["scale"] == []
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0087"]["keyframes"]["scale"] == []
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0112"]["keyframes"]["scale"] == []
+    assert all(row["keyframes"]["scale"] == [] for identity, row in rows.items() if identity != "caption_tracklet_0089")
+    assert all(key["value"] == pytest.approx(base * key["relative_scale"]) for key in keys)
+
+
+def test_f2_text_timing_position_and_other_domains_remain_exact() -> None:
+    contract, _, _ = compile_f3_contract()
+    f2 = __import__("json").loads((__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / contract["base_f2_contract"]["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    f2_rows = _by_id(f2["identity_records"])
+    for row in contract["identity_records"]:
+        before = copy.deepcopy(f2_rows[row["source_identity"]])
+        after = copy.deepcopy(row)
+        after.pop("scale_decision")
+        before["keyframes"]["scale"] = []
+        after["keyframes"]["scale"] = []
+        assert after == before
+    assert [row["text"] for row in contract["identity_records"]] == [row["text"] for row in f2["identity_records"]]
+    assert [row["resolve_interval"] for row in contract["identity_records"]] == [row["resolve_interval"] for row in f2["identity_records"]]
+    assert [row["keyframes"]["position"] for row in contract["identity_records"]] == [row["keyframes"]["position"] for row in f2["identity_records"]]
+
+
+def test_pinned_f3a2_authority_loads_without_identity_specific_code() -> None:
+    authorities, inputs = load_scale_authorities(__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
+    assert set(authorities) == set(inputs) == {"caption_tracklet_0089"}
+    assert authorities["caption_tracklet_0089"]["authority"] == "ACCEPTED_SCALE_REPRODUCTION_ADJUDICATION"
diff --git a/tests/test_compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery.py b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..52099488bf9e53cf24d81e0fc0a46f6c5734427f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery.py
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import copy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+import scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery as compiler
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f4_display_object_recovery import (
+    AUTHORITY_SHA256,
+    F3_CONTRACT,
+    ROOT,
+    _sha256,
+    _validate_record,
+    append_recovery_objects,
+    compile_f4_contract,
+    load_recovery_authority,
+)
+
+
+def _by_id(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    return {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def test_recovery_authority_parses_generically_and_is_pinned() -> None:
+    authority, path = load_recovery_authority()
+    assert authority["authority"] == "ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY"
+    assert _sha256(path) == AUTHORITY_SHA256
+    assert len(authority["recovery_objects"]) == 2
+
+
+def test_recovery_requires_source_supported_lifecycle_and_text() -> None:
+    authority, _ = load_recovery_authority()
+    record = copy.deepcopy(authority["recovery_objects"][0])
+    record["source_visible_start_frame"] = None
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="integer_lifecycle"):
+        _validate_record(record, authority)
+    record = copy.deepcopy(authority["recovery_objects"][0])
+    record["accepted_display_text"] = ""
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="proven_text"):
+        _validate_record(record, authority)
+
+
+def test_whole_reel_f4_contract_recovers_two_objects_without_mutating_base() -> None:
+    contract, validation, decisions = compile_f4_contract()
+    f3 = json.loads((ROOT / F3_CONTRACT).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    assert validation["all_pass"] is True
+    assert validation["counts"] == {
+        "base_frozen_identities": 113,
+        "base_renderable_identities": 62,
+        "recovered_display_objects": 2,
+        "final_renderable_objects": 64,
+    }
+    assert contract["identity_records"] == f3["identity_records"]
+    assert contract["objects"][:62] == f3["objects"]
+    assert [row["method"] for row in decisions["decisions"]] == ["ACCEPTED_DISPLAY_OBJECT_RECOVERY"] * 2
+
+
+def test_bounded_missing_objects_and_invest_ownership_match_source_evidence() -> None:
+    contract, _, _ = compile_f4_contract()
+    base = _by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+    recovered = {row["text"]["value"]: row for row in contract["objects"] if row.get("object_origin") == "RECOVERED_DISPLAY_OBJECT"}
+    assert recovered["why?"]["source_interval"] == [222, 233]
+    assert recovered["why?"]["position"]["source_bbox"] == [212, 290, 918, 520]
+    assert recovered["We"]["source_interval"] == [238, 287]
+    assert recovered["We"]["composition"]["neighbor_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0045"
+    assert base["caption_tracklet_0045"]["renderable"] is True
+    assert base["caption_tracklet_0045"]["text"]["value"] == "invest"
+    assert base["caption_tracklet_0044"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert base["caption_tracklet_0044"]["text"]["value"] is None
+
+
+def test_duplicate_regressions_and_f3_scale_decisions_remain_exact() -> None:
+    contract, _, _ = compile_f4_contract()
+    f3 = json.loads((ROOT / F3_CONTRACT).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    rows = _by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0064"]["renderable"] is True
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0064"]["text"]["value"] == "social"
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0066"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert rows["continuous_visual_identity_0113"]["text"]["value"] == "PAMELA"
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0114"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0115"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert [row["scale_decision"] for row in contract["identity_records"]] == [row["scale_decision"] for row in f3["identity_records"]]
+
+
+def test_repeated_semantic_words_are_not_globally_deduplicated() -> None:
+    authority, path = load_recovery_authority()
+    first = copy.deepcopy(authority["recovery_objects"][0])
+    second = copy.deepcopy(authority["recovery_objects"][1])
+    first["accepted_display_text"] = second["accepted_display_text"] = "repeat"
+    objects = append_recovery_objects([], [first, second], path.relative_to(ROOT), AUTHORITY_SHA256)
+    assert [row["text"]["value"] for row in objects] == ["repeat", "repeat"]
+
+
+def test_production_has_no_caption_literal_identity_or_reel_specific_branch() -> None:
+    source = Path(compiler.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    forbidden = ("why", "caption_tracklet_", "continuous_visual_identity_", "dcjrjtukscu")
+    hits = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        expression = node.test if isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.IfExp, ast.While, ast.Assert)) else None
+        if expression is None:
+            continue
+        for value in (child.value for child in ast.walk(expression) if isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)):
+            if any(token in value.lower() for token in forbidden):
+                hits.append((node.lineno, value))
+    assert hits == []
diff --git a/tests/test_compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery.py b/tests/test_compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery.py
new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery as compiler
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f5a_listing_recovery import (
+    AUTHORITY,
+    AUTHORITY_SHA256,
+    F4_CONTRACT,
+    ROOT,
+    compile_f5a_contract,
+    load_listing_authority,
+)
+
+
+def _by_id(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    return {row["source_identity"]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def test_authority_lifecycle_geometry_and_mapping_are_source_pinned() -> None:
+    authority = load_listing_authority()
+    record = authority["recovery_objects"][0]
+    assert len(authority["recovery_objects"]) == 1
+    assert record["accepted_display_text"] == "listing"
+    assert [record["source_visible_start_frame"], record["source_visible_end_frame"] + 1] == [413, 433]
+    assert [record["timeline_start_frame"], record["timeline_end_frame"]] == [330, 347]
+    assert record["source_bbox"] == [414, 721, 678, 803]
+    assert record["resolve_center"] == [0.50555556, 0.603125]
+    assert record["source_height_px"] == 82.0
+    assert record["composition_relationship"]["relationship"] == "SEQUENTIAL_NO_OVERLAP"
+    assert record["source_provenance"]["following_object_first_source_frame"] == 433
+    assert compiler._sha256(ROOT / AUTHORITY) == AUTHORITY_SHA256
+
+
+def test_one_generic_recovery_preserves_all_f4_objects_and_identities() -> None:
+    _, contract, validation = compile_f5a_contract()
+    f4 = json.loads((ROOT / F4_CONTRACT).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    base_rows = _by_id(f4["identity_records"])
+    rows = _by_id(contract["identity_records"])
+    assert validation["all_pass"] is True
+    assert len(contract["identity_records"]) == 113
+    assert len(f4["objects"]) == 64
+    assert len(contract["objects"]) == 65
+    assert contract["identity_records"] == f4["identity_records"]
+    assert contract["objects"][:-1] == f4["objects"]
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0061"]["renderable"] is True
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0061"]["text"]["value"] == "reels"
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0062"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0063"]["renderable"] is False
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0045"] == base_rows["caption_tracklet_0045"]
+    assert rows["caption_tracklet_0064"] == base_rows["caption_tracklet_0064"]
+    assert rows["continuous_visual_identity_0113"] == base_rows["continuous_visual_identity_0113"]
+    assert [row["text"]["value"] for row in contract["objects"][62:64]] == ["why?", "We"]
+    assert contract["recovered_display_object_count"] == 3
+
+
+def test_listing_is_independent_and_style_and_motion_remain_unresolved() -> None:
+    _, contract, _ = compile_f5a_contract()
+    listing = contract["objects"][-1]
+    assert listing["object_origin"] == "RECOVERED_DISPLAY_OBJECT"
+    assert listing["source_identity"] == "recovered_display_object_listing_0003"
+    assert listing["text"]["value"] == "listing"
+    assert listing["source_interval"] == [330, 347]
+    assert listing["position"]["source_bbox"] == [414, 721, 678, 803]
+    assert listing["size"]["source_height_px"] == 82.0
+    assert listing["font"]["source_authority"] == "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_PENDING_F5"
+    assert listing["composition"]["neighbor_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0061"
+    assert listing["composition"]["ownership"] == "INDEPENDENT_DISPLAY_OBJECT"
+    assert all(not values for values in listing["keyframes"].values())
+    assert contract["resolve_mutated"] is False
+
+
+def test_required_18_checks_pass_and_all_existing_domains_are_byte_semantic_equal() -> None:
+    _, contract, validation = compile_f5a_contract()
+    f4 = json.loads((ROOT / F4_CONTRACT).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    required = [key for key in validation["checks"] if key[:2].isdigit()]
+    assert len(required) == 18
+    assert all(validation["checks"][key] for key in required)
+    for field in ("source_interval", "text", "scale_decision", "font", "position", "composition"):
+        assert [row.get(field) for row in contract["objects"][:-1]] == [row.get(field) for row in f4["objects"]]
+    assert validation["counts"] == {
+        "base_frozen_identities": 113,
+        "base_renderable_identities": 62,
+        "preexisting_recovered_display_objects": 2,
+        "total_recovered_display_objects": 3,
+        "final_renderable_objects": 65,
+    }
+
+
+def test_production_has_no_literal_identity_reel_or_recovery_id_branch() -> None:
+    source = Path(compiler.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    forbidden = (
+        "listing",
+        "reels",
+        "caption_tracklet_0061",
+        "caption_tracklet_0062",
+        "caption_tracklet_0063",
+        "dcjrjtukscu",
+        "recovered_display_object_listing_0003",
+    )
+    hits = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        expression = node.test if isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.IfExp, ast.While, ast.Assert)) else None
+        if expression is None:
+            continue
+        values = [child.value for child in ast.walk(expression) if isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str)]
+        hits.extend((node.lineno, value) for value in values if any(token in value.lower() for token in forbidden))
+    assert hits == []

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_f9_canonical_display_ownership import compile_contract, digest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def test_all_113_identities_resolve_deterministically() -> None:
+    first = compile_contract()
+    second = compile_contract()
+    contract, audit, validation, _authority = first
+    assert digest(first) == digest(second)
+    assert audit["base_identity_count"] == 113
+    assert audit["compositions_audited"] == 15
+    assert sum(audit["role_counts"].values()) == 113
+    assert audit["ownership_conflicts"] == []
+    assert audit["source_required_missing_objects"] == []
+    assert audit["unsupported_duplicate_owners"] == []
+    assert validation["all_pass"] is True
+    assert validation["same_track_overlap_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["carrier_plan"]["title_count"] == contract["object_count"] == 65
+
+
+def test_source_backed_failure_cases_and_unrelated_fragments() -> None:
+    contract, audit, validation, _authority = compile_contract()
+    objects = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in contract["objects"]}
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0082"]["text"]["value"] == "calling"
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0083" not in objects
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0090"]["text"]["value"] == "buyers"
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0091" not in objects
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0101"]["text"]["value"] == "with"
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0102" not in objects
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0105"]["text"]["value"] == "have"
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0106"]["text"]["value"] == "we"
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0107"]["text"]["value"] == "have"
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0043"]["text"]["value"] == "your"
+    assert objects["continuous_visual_identity_0014"]["resolve_interval"] == [68, 108]
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0013" not in objects
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0094"]["text"]["value"] == "Matching"
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0094"]["resolve_interval"] == [599, 629]
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0096" not in objects
+    assert all(row["ok"] for row in audit["targeted_cases"])
+    for identity in ("caption_tracklet_0002", "caption_tracklet_0030", "caption_tracklet_0031", "caption_tracklet_0032", "caption_tracklet_0050"):
+        assert identity in objects
+    assert sum(row["text"]["value"] == "personally" for row in objects.values()) == 3
+    assert validation["checks"]["f3_scale_unchanged"] is True
+    assert validation["checks"]["f5_style_unchanged"] is True
+    assert validation["checks"]["f6_6000_lifecycle"] is True
+    assert validation["checks"]["f3_6000_scale_keys"] is True
+    assert validation["checks"]["unrelated_controls_unchanged"] is True
+
+
+def test_resolver_has_no_case_specific_production_branch_and_runtime_count_is_dynamic() -> None:
+    source = (ROOT / "scripts/analysis/compile_step5a_f9_canonical_display_ownership.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    banned = {"calling", "ling", "buy", "ers", "buyers", "the", "we", "have", "your", "why?", "selling", "matching"}
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.If, ast.IfExp, ast.Match)):
+            assert not any(isinstance(child, ast.Constant) and isinstance(child.value, str) and child.value.casefold() in banned for child in ast.walk(node))
+    runtime = (ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f9_canonical_rebuild.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "count != 65" not in runtime
+    assert 'audit.get("final_renderable_object_count") != count' in runtime
