+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_textplus_contract import compile_contract
+
+
+def test_step5a_contract_is_authority_aware_and_complete() -> None:
+    contract, preflight = compile_contract()
+    assert preflight["all_pass"] is True
+    assert contract["object_count"] == 113
+    assert len({row["source_identity"] for row in contract["objects"]}) == 113
+    assert sum(bool(row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"]) for row in contract["objects"]) == 1
+    assert all(
+        0 <= key["value"] <= 1
+        and key["source_relative_value"] >= 0
+        and key["mapping"] == "PER_IDENTITY_PEAK_NORMALIZED_RELATIVE_VISIBILITY_NOT_ABSOLUTE_ALPHA"
+        for row in contract["objects"]
+        for key in row["keyframes"]["relative_visibility"]
+    )
+    six_thousand = [row for row in contract["objects"] if row["text"]["value"] == "6000"]
+    assert len(six_thousand) == 2
+    assert all(not row["keyframes"]["rotation"] for row in six_thousand)
+    assert all(
+        row["advanced_effects"]["clipping"] == row["advanced_effects"]["caption_occlusion"] == "UNSUPPORTED_OMITTED"
+        for row in contract["objects"]
+    )
diff --git a/tests/test_detect_caption_style_classifier.py b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_classifier.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..74053a99d253aa123210d49c9438e089185f93e8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_classifier.py
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import types
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+import scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style as detector
+
+
+def _args() -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        mode="viral_transcript_aware",
+        viral_min_y=0.18,
+        viral_min_x=0.10,
+        viral_max_x=0.90,
+        transcript_match_threshold=0.30,
+        regular_caption_score_threshold=0.46,
+        enable_visual_spoken_fallback=True,
+        visual_spoken_min_confidence=0.55,
+        visual_spoken_score_threshold=0.56,
+        visual_spoken_min_y=0.38,
+        visual_spoken_max_y=0.84,
+        visual_spoken_min_x=0.12,
+        visual_spoken_max_x=0.88,
+        visual_spoken_min_font_ratio=0.020,
+        visual_spoken_min_width_ratio=0.055,
+        visual_hook_score_threshold=0.64,
+        hook_min_confidence=0.70,
+        hook_min_y=0.15,
+        top_ui_caption_max_y=0.40,
+        top_ui_max_font_ratio=0.018,
+        top_ui_allow_match_threshold=0.55,
+    )
+
+
+def _detection(text: str, timestamp: float = 5.4) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "text": text,
+        "timestamp": timestamp,
+        "confidence": 0.70,
+        "center": {"x": 0.50, "y": 0.25},
+        "estimated_font_height_ratio": 0.06,
+        "estimated_box_width_ratio": 0.30,
+        "has_dark_stroke": True,
+        "has_shadow": False,
+        "has_bright_text": True,
+    }
+
+
+def _context(text: str, timestamp: float, cue_text: str, start: float, end: float) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "timestamp": timestamp,
+        "text": text,
+        "cue_ids": ["context"],
+        "cues": [{
+            "id": "nearby",
+            "source": "subtitle_candidates",
+            "text": cue_text,
+            "start": start,
+            "end": end,
+        }],
+    }
+
+
+def test_nearby_individual_cue_rescues_sign_ocr_variants(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(detector, "visual_caption_score", lambda _det: 0.80)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(detector, "hook_visual_score", lambda _det: 0.43)
+
+    for text, timestamp in (("sion", 5.4), ("Sian", 6.045)):
+        accepted, score = detector.classify_caption_candidate(
+            _detection(text, timestamp),
+            _context("before the sign hits the yard", timestamp, "sign", 5.42, 5.64),
+            _args(),
+        )
+        assert accepted is True
+        assert score["transcript_match_score"] == 0.375
+        assert score["score"] >= 0.46
+
+
+def test_distant_individual_cue_does_not_rescue_branding_collision(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(detector, "visual_caption_score", lambda _det: 0.61)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(detector, "hook_visual_score", lambda _det: 0.20)
+
+    accepted, score = detector.classify_caption_candidate(
+        _detection("REALTY", 32.242),
+        _context("", 32.242, "really", 31.00, 31.44),
+        _args(),
+    )
+
+    assert accepted is False
+    assert score["transcript_match_score"] == 0.0
+
+
+def test_individual_match_cannot_replace_stronger_existing_context(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(detector, "visual_caption_score", lambda _det: 0.80)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(detector, "hook_visual_score", lambda _det: 0.43)
+    detection = _detection("matching", 10.0)
+    args = _args()
+
+    without_individual, without_score = detector.classify_caption_candidate(
+        detection, {"timestamp": 10.0, "text": "matching", "cue_ids": [], "cues": []}, args
+    )
+    with_individual, with_score = detector.classify_caption_candidate(
+        detection, _context("matching", 10.0, "x", 9.9, 10.1), args
+    )
+
+    assert with_individual == without_individual
+    assert with_score["transcript_match_score"] == without_score["transcript_match_score"]
+    assert with_score["score"] == without_score["score"]
diff --git a/tests/test_detect_caption_style_color_roles.py b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_color_roles.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9a78a2f3bfb170c6419a4c48250ac5226444ccc2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_color_roles.py
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import types
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+from scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style import choose_fill_stroke_shadow
+
+
+def _cluster(hex_color: str, ratio: float, brightness: float, saturation: float) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "hex": hex_color,
+        "ratio": ratio,
+        "brightness": brightness,
+        "saturation": saturation,
+    }
+
+
+def _resolve(clusters: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    return choose_fill_stroke_shadow(
+        clusters,
+        dark_ratio=0.4,
+        bright_ratio=0.2,
+        saturated_ratio=0.4,
+        font_ratio=0.07,
+        width_ratio=0.4,
+    )
+
+
+def test_we_dont_prefers_recorded_orange_cream_foreground_over_teal_crop():
+    result = _resolve([
+        _cluster("#071717", 0.4423, 23, 177),
+        _cluster("#f3ca9a", 0.2043, 243, 93),
+        _cluster("#18636b", 0.1705, 107, 198),
+        _cluster("#e4814b", 0.1522, 228, 171),
+        _cluster("#f6f6f9", 0.0307, 249, 3),
+    ])
+
+    assert result["fill"] in {"#f3ca9a", "#e4814b"}
+    assert result["fill"] != "#18636b"
+    assert result["stroke"] == "#071717"
+
+
+def test_before_sign_prefers_recorded_gold_foreground_over_crop_and_highlight():
+    result = _resolve([
+        _cluster("#20221c", 0.2507, 34, 45),
+        _cluster("#dcb999", 0.2472, 220, 78),
+        _cluster("#b48d6e", 0.2237, 180, 99),
+        _cluster("#5c4c3c", 0.1963, 92, 89),
+        _cluster("#eceae6", 0.0822, 236, 6),
+    ])
+
+    assert result["fill"] == "#dcb999"
+    assert result["stroke"] == "#20221c"
+
+
+def test_6000_promotes_recorded_gold_to_fill_instead_of_stroke():
+    result = _resolve([
+        _cluster("#061312", 0.4978, 19, 174),
+        _cluster("#f6d09d", 0.2130, 246, 92),
+        _cluster("#0c6177", 0.1320, 119, 229),
+        _cluster("#d09a70", 0.0985, 208, 118),
+        _cluster("#533f31", 0.0587, 83, 104),
+    ])
+
+    assert result["fill"] == "#f6d09d"
+    assert result["fill"] != "#0c6177"
+    assert result["stroke"] == "#061312"
diff --git a/tests/test_detect_caption_style_continuous_visual_identity.py b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_continuous_visual_identity.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d1158d14563bb6e6112ce7b008ffae83d6571c84
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_continuous_visual_identity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,215 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+from scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style import apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations
+
+
+def _det(
+    tracklet_id,
+    timestamp,
+    bbox=(0.3, 0.2, 0.7, 0.28),
+    *,
+    text="sign",
+    inferred_end=None,
+    fill="#dcb999",
+    stroke="#20221c",
+    font_ratio=0.07,
+    role="spoken_caption",
+    provenance="accepted_direct",
+):
+    return {
+        "tracklet_id": tracklet_id,
+        "text": text,
+        "bbox": [int(value * 1000) for value in bbox],
+        "normalized_bbox": list(bbox),
+        "observed_bbox": [int(value * 1000) for value in bbox],
+        "observed_timestamp": timestamp,
+        "inferred_visibility_end": timestamp + 0.1 if inferred_end is None else inferred_end,
+        "estimated_text_color": fill,
+        "estimated_stroke_color": stroke,
+        "estimated_font_height_ratio": font_ratio,
+        "caption_role": role,
+        "observation_provenance": provenance,
+        "is_caption_candidate": True,
+    }
+
+
+def _frames(*detections):
+    return [{"timestamp": det["observed_timestamp"], "detections": [det]} for det in detections]
+
+
+def _pairs(diagnostics):
+    return {
+        (link["predecessor_tracklet_id"], link["successor_tracklet_id"])
+        for relation in diagnostics["relations"]
+        for link in relation["links"]
+    }
+
+
+def test_four_independent_source_verified_relations_share_continuous_identities():
+    rows = [
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0014", 0.0, text="Setong", inferred_end=0.1),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0016", 0.267, text="Solang"),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0028", 2.0, text="sion", inferred_end=2.1),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0033", 2.6, text="Sian"),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0098", 4.0, text="vers", inferred_end=4.1),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0103", 4.3, text="Mers"),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0113", 6.0, text="PAMEILA", inferred_end=6.1),
+        _det("caption_tracklet_0116", 6.3, text="PAMEILA"),
+    ]
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(*rows))
+
+    assert _pairs(diagnostics) == {
+        ("caption_tracklet_0014", "caption_tracklet_0016"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0028", "caption_tracklet_0033"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0098", "caption_tracklet_0103"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0113", "caption_tracklet_0116"),
+    }
+    assert rows[0]["continuous_visual_identity_id"] == rows[1]["continuous_visual_identity_id"]
+    assert rows[2]["continuous_visual_identity_id"] == rows[3]["continuous_visual_identity_id"]
+    assert diagnostics["transcript_used_for_eligibility"] is False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("left_text", "right_text"),
+    [("behind", "scenes"), ("And", "from"), ("scenes", "personally"), ("in how", "home")],
+)
+def test_sequential_same_style_captions_do_not_stitch(left_text, right_text):
+    left = _det("left", 0.0, text=left_text, inferred_end=0.1)
+    right = _det("right", 0.3, text=right_text)
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(left, right))
+
+    assert not diagnostics["relations"]
+    assert "continuous_visual_identity_id" not in left
+    assert "continuous_visual_identity_id" not in right
+
+
+def test_repeated_word_and_hierarchy_neighbors_remain_separate():
+    first_we = _det("we_1", 0.0, (0.31, 0.22, 0.43, 0.26), text="We", inferred_end=0.1)
+    second_we = _det("we_2", 0.4, (0.27, 0.23, 0.40, 0.28), text="We")
+    upper_the = _det("upper_the", 1.0, (0.47, 0.19, 0.58, 0.23), text="the", inferred_end=2.0)
+    lower_the = _det("lower_the", 1.0, (0.34, 0.41, 0.50, 0.46), text="the", inferred_end=2.0)
+    before = _det("before", 3.0, (0.27, 0.19, 0.47, 0.22), text="before", inferred_end=3.1)
+    sign = _det("sign", 3.2, (0.31, 0.21, 0.72, 0.28), text="sign")
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(first_we, second_we, upper_the, lower_the, before, sign))
+
+    assert not diagnostics["relations"]
+
+
+def test_one_to_many_and_many_to_one_ambiguity_fail_closed():
+    predecessor = _det("pred", 0.0, text="listing", inferred_end=0.1)
+    successor_a = _det("successor_a", 0.3, text="listinq")
+    successor_b = _det("successor_b", 0.3, text="listina")
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(predecessor, successor_a, successor_b))
+    assert not diagnostics["relations"]
+    assert diagnostics["ambiguous_pair_count"] == 2
+
+    predecessor_a = _det("predecessor_a", 2.0, text="buyers", inferred_end=2.1)
+    predecessor_b = _det("predecessor_b", 2.0, text="buyars", inferred_end=2.1)
+    successor = _det("successor", 2.4, text="buyors")
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(predecessor_a, predecessor_b, successor))
+    assert not diagnostics["relations"]
+    assert diagnostics["ambiguous_pair_count"] == 2
+
+
+def test_tracklet_role_must_overlap_despite_noisy_endpoint_role():
+    left = _det("left", 0.0, text="Selling", inferred_end=0.1, role="spoken_caption")
+    right_endpoint = _det("right", 0.3, text="Selang", role="hook_caption")
+    right_stable = _det("right", 0.4, text="Selling", role="spoken_caption")
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(left, right_endpoint, right_stable))
+
+    assert _pairs(diagnostics) == {("left", "right")}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("field", "value"),
+    [("estimated_text_color", None), ("estimated_stroke_color", None), ("estimated_font_height_ratio", None)],
+)
+def test_missing_required_style_fails_closed(field, value):
+    left = _det("left", 0.0, text="PAMEILA", inferred_end=0.1)
+    right = _det("right", 0.3, text="PAMEILA")
+    right[field] = value
+
+    assert not apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(left, right))["relations"]
+
+
+def test_ocr_below_threshold_and_gap_above_point_six_do_not_stitch():
+    low_ocr_left = _det("low_ocr_left", 0.0, text="behind", inferred_end=0.1)
+    low_ocr_right = _det("low_ocr_right", 0.3, text="scenes")
+    late_left = _det("late_left", 2.0, text="PAMEILA", inferred_end=2.1)
+    late_right = _det("late_right", 2.7001, text="PAMEILA")
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(low_ocr_left, low_ocr_right, late_left, late_right))
+    assert not diagnostics["relations"]
+
+
+def test_exact_text_is_not_required_when_weak_ocr_corroborates():
+    left = _det("left", 0.0, text="sion", inferred_end=0.1)
+    right = _det("right", 0.6, text="Sian")
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(left, right))
+    assert _pairs(diagnostics) == {("left", "right")}
+
+
+def test_6000_overlap_and_split_geometry_receive_no_bridge():
+    whole = _det("caption_tracklet_0089", 0.0, (0.11, 0.19, 0.87, 0.34), text="6000", inferred_end=1.2)
+    suffix = _det("caption_tracklet_0090", 1.1, (0.53, 0.24, 0.68, 0.28), text="ers")
+    prefix = _det("caption_tracklet_0091", 1.1, (0.33, 0.23, 0.55, 0.28), text="buy")
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(whole, suffix, prefix))
+    assert not diagnostics["relations"]
+
+
+def test_relation_preserves_provenance_and_geometry_without_fabricated_samples():
+    left = _det("left", 0.0, text="sion", inferred_end=0.1, provenance="accepted_direct")
+    right = _det("right", 0.6, text="Sian", provenance="rejected_visual_continuation")
+    frames = _frames(left, right)
+    original = copy.deepcopy(frames)
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(frames)
+
+    assert len(frames) == len(original) == 2
+    assert sum(len(frame["detections"]) for frame in frames) == 2
+    for before, after in zip(original, frames):
+        before_det, after_det = before["detections"][0], after["detections"][0]
+        assert after_det["bbox"] == before_det["bbox"]
+        assert after_det["normalized_bbox"] == before_det["normalized_bbox"]
+        assert after_det["observed_bbox"] == before_det["observed_bbox"]
+        assert after_det["observation_provenance"] == before_det["observation_provenance"]
+    relation = diagnostics["relations"][0]
+    assert relation["observed_start"] == 0.0
+    assert relation["last_observed"] == 0.6
+    assert relation["inferred_visibility_end"] == 0.7
+    assert [window["tracklet_id"] for window in relation["tracklet_windows"]] == ["left", "right"]
+
+
+def test_gap_is_seconds_based_and_frame_rate_independent():
+    for frame_indices in ((0, 14), (0, 36)):
+        left = _det(f"left_{frame_indices[1]}", 0.0, text="buyers", inferred_end=0.1)
+        right = _det(f"right_{frame_indices[1]}", 0.6, text="buyars")
+        left["frame_index"], right["frame_index"] = frame_indices
+        assert apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(left, right))["linked_pair_count"] == 1
+
+
+def test_natural_chain_requires_each_pairwise_link_and_shares_one_identity():
+    first = _det("first", 0.0, text="PAMEILA", inferred_end=0.1)
+    middle = _det("middle", 0.3, text="PAMEILA", inferred_end=0.4)
+    last = _det("last", 0.6, text="PAMEILA")
+
+    diagnostics = apply_continuous_visual_identity_relations(_frames(first, middle, last))
+
+    assert _pairs(diagnostics) == {("first", "middle"), ("middle", "last")}
+    assert len({first["continuous_visual_identity_id"], middle["continuous_visual_identity_id"], last["continuous_visual_identity_id"]}) == 1
diff --git a/tests/test_detect_caption_style_crop_refinement.py b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_crop_refinement.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7e8a675ade71b559434b39173165f72a7634685b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_crop_refinement.py
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import types
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+from scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style import box_to_bbox, refine_merged_ocr_regions
+
+
+def _box(x1: float, y1: float, x2: float, y2: float) -> list[list[float]]:
+    return [[x1, y1], [x2, y1], [x2, y2], [x1, y2]]
+
+
+class FakeOCR:
+    def __init__(self, calls: list[tuple[list[list[list[float]]], list[tuple[str, float]]]]):
+        self.calls = list(calls)
+        self.recognitions: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
+
+    def text_detector(self, _image):
+        boxes, self.recognitions = self.calls.pop(0)
+        return np.asarray(boxes, dtype=np.float32), 0.0
+
+    def text_recognizer(self, crops):
+        assert len(crops) == len(self.recognitions)
+        return self.recognitions, 0.0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "recognitions",
+    [[], [("", 0.99)], [("child", 0.49)], [("child", 0.99)]],
+)
+def test_weak_crop_refinement_preserves_parent_exactly(recognitions):
+    parent = (_box(100, 200, 300, 300), "parent", 0.91)
+    child_boxes = [_box(30, 30, 330, 180) for _ in recognitions]
+
+    result = refine_merged_ocr_regions(FakeOCR([(child_boxes, recognitions)]), np.zeros((600, 600, 3), np.uint8), [parent])
+
+    assert result == [parent]
+
+
+def test_multi_child_replacement_maps_geometry_to_source_coordinates():
+    parent = (_box(100, 200, 300, 300), "merged", 0.91)
+    ocr = FakeOCR([(
+        [_box(30, 60, 330, 180), _box(360, 60, 570, 180)],
+        [("left", 0.95), ("right", 0.90)],
+    )])
+
+    result = refine_merged_ocr_regions(ocr, np.zeros((600, 600, 3), np.uint8), [parent])
+
+    assert [(text, confidence) for _, text, confidence in result] == [("left", 0.95), ("right", 0.90)]
+    assert box_to_bbox(result[0][0], 600, 600) == [110, 220, 210, 260]
+    assert box_to_bbox(result[1][0], 600, 600) == [220, 220, 290, 260]
+
+
+def test_refined_child_duplicate_prefers_direct_detection():
+    merged = (_box(100, 100, 300, 220), "merged", 0.91)
+    direct = (_box(220, 120, 280, 180), "direct", 0.88)
+    ocr = FakeOCR([
+        (
+            [_box(15, 30, 315, 180), _box(330, 30, 570, 180), _box(360, 60, 540, 240)],
+            [("left", 0.95), ("right", 0.90), ("duplicate", 0.99)],
+        ),
+        ([], []),
+    ])
+
+    result = refine_merged_ocr_regions(ocr, np.zeros((600, 600, 3), np.uint8), [merged, direct])
+
+    assert [text for _, text, _ in result] == ["direct", "left", "right"]
+    assert result[0] == direct
+
+
+def test_simple_parent_with_one_child_remains_unsplit():
+    parent = (_box(40, 50, 200, 120), "simple", 0.97)
+    ocr = FakeOCR([([_box(15, 15, 450, 180)], [("simple", 0.99)])])
+
+    assert refine_merged_ocr_regions(ocr, np.zeros((300, 300, 3), np.uint8), [parent]) == [parent]
+
+
+def test_crop_refinement_failure_preserves_parent_exactly():
+    parent = (_box(40, 50, 200, 120), "simple", 0.97)
+
+    class FailingOCR:
+        def text_detector(self, _image):
+            raise RuntimeError("crop OCR unavailable")
+
+        def text_recognizer(self, _crops):
+            raise AssertionError("recognizer must not run")
+
+    assert refine_merged_ocr_regions(FailingOCR(), np.zeros((300, 300, 3), np.uint8), [parent]) == [parent]

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..dc00481f8dbf3486ec4590b54d01c2b4e05f096e

+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_group_members.py
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import types
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+from scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style import build_caption_style_events, group_caption_candidates
+
+
+def _candidate(text: str, bbox: list[int], score: float, match: float) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "text": text, "confidence": 0.8, "bbox": bbox,
+        "normalized_bbox": [value / 1080 for value in bbox],
+        "center": {"x": (bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / 2160, "y": (bbox[1] + bbox[3]) / 3840},
+        "position": {"vertical_zone": "top", "horizontal_align": "center"},
+        "estimated_font_height_px": 80, "estimated_font_height_ratio": 0.04,
+        "estimated_box_width_ratio": 0.3, "estimated_box_height_ratio": 0.05,
+        "estimated_text_color": "#dcb999" if text == "sion" else "#f1efea",
+        "estimated_stroke_color": "#20221c" if text == "sion" else "#292a23",
+        "estimated_shadow_color": "#20221c" if text == "sion" else "#292a23",
+        "has_dark_stroke": True, "has_shadow": True, "has_bright_text": True,
+        "has_saturated_text": True, "text_area_ratio": 0.2, "dark_area_ratio": 0.2,
+        "saturated_area_ratio": 0.2, "contrast_area_ratio": 0.8,
+        "caption_role": "spoken_caption",
+        "caption_score": {
+            "score": score, "transcript_match_score": match, "hook_score": 0.4,
+            "reason": "transcript_matched_caption", "matched_cue_ids": ["sub_0016", "sub_0018"],
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _args() -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        emit_caption_style_events=True, style_event_match_window_sec=1.25,
+        style_event_min_match_score=0.18, max_style_events=0,
+        animation_min_samples=3, animation_max_samples=7,
+    )
+
+
+def test_parent_group_keeps_union_geometry_and_member_identity():
+    groups = group_caption_candidates([
+        _candidate("beforethe", [284, 346, 637, 444], 0.6541, 0.4),
+        _candidate("sion", [336, 408, 778, 536], 0.5867, 0.375),
+    ], (1920, 1080, 3), y_tolerance=0.05)
+
+    assert len(groups) == 1
+    assert groups[0]["bbox"] == [284, 346, 778, 536]
+    assert [member["text"] for member in groups[0]["members"]] == ["beforethe", "sion"]
+    assert groups[0]["items_count"] == 2
+
+
+def test_stronger_member_match_emits_sign_style_event_without_splitting_parent():
+    groups = group_caption_candidates([
+        _candidate("beforethe", [284, 346, 637, 444], 0.6541, 0.4),
+        _candidate("sion", [336, 408, 778, 536], 0.5867, 0.375),
+    ], (1920, 1080, 3), y_tolerance=0.05)
+    groups[0].update(timestamp=5.4, frame_index=26)
+    cues = [
+        {"id": "sub_0016", "text": "before", "start": 4.82, "end": 5.16, "mid": 4.99},
+        {"id": "sub_0018", "text": "sign", "start": 5.42, "end": 5.64, "mid": 5.53},
+    ]
+    profiles = [{"style_id": "style_01_spoken_caption", "role": "spoken_caption", "confidence": {"score": 1}, "sample_count": 1}]
+    events, _ = build_caption_style_events(groups, cues, profiles, {"width": 1080, "height": 1920}, _args())
+    sign = next(event for event in events if event["cue_id"] == "sub_0018")
+
+    assert sign["observed_texts"] == ["sion"]
+    assert sign["colors"]["fill"] == "#dcb999"
+    assert sign["colors"]["stroke"] == "#20221c"
+    assert groups[0]["bbox"] == [284, 346, 778, 536]
+
+
+def test_unrelated_same_line_grouping_predicate_remains_unchanged():
+    groups = group_caption_candidates([
+        _candidate("one", [400, 500, 500, 560], 0.8, 1.0),
+        _candidate("two", [510, 505, 610, 565], 0.8, 1.0),
+    ], (1920, 1080, 3), y_tolerance=0.05)
+
+    assert len(groups) == 1
+    assert groups[0]["items_count"] == 2
diff --git a/tests/test_detect_caption_style_temporal_authority.py b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_temporal_authority.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..42be60a10de6a93ec321aa59dc19f06bd1c1cb35
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_temporal_authority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+from scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style import (
+    _compatible_continuation,
+    apply_short_caption_continuations,
+    observation_timestamps,
+)
+
+
+def _det(
+    bbox=(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 0.5),
+    *,
+    accepted=True,
+    reason=None,
+    text="sign",
+    source="direct",
+):
+    return {
+        "text": text,
+        "bbox": [int(value * 1000) for value in bbox],
+        "normalized_bbox": list(bbox),
+        "classifier_accepted": accepted,
+        "is_caption_candidate": accepted,
+        "is_subtitle_candidate": accepted,
+        "source_provenance": source,
+        "caption_role": "spoken_caption" if accepted else None,
+        "caption_score": {"reason": reason or ("transcript_matched_caption" if accepted else "low_caption_score")},
+    }
+
+
+def _frames(*rows):
+    return [{"timestamp": timestamp, "detections": detections} for timestamp, detections in rows]
+
+
+def test_schedule_unions_floor_and_preferred_on_valid_source_frames():
+    timestamps = observation_timestamps(1.0, 24.0, 24, [0.041, 0.333, 0.333])
+
+    assert any(math.isclose(timestamp, 1 / 24, abs_tol=1e-6) for timestamp in timestamps)
+    assert any(math.isclose(timestamp, 8 / 24, abs_tol=1e-6) for timestamp in timestamps)
+    assert len(timestamps) == len(set(timestamps))
+    assert all(math.isclose(timestamp * 24, round(timestamp * 24), abs_tol=1e-5) for timestamp in timestamps)
+    assert max(timestamps) <= 23 / 24
+
+
+def test_schedule_is_ten_fps_floor_not_full_fps_and_is_frame_rate_generic():
+    for fps in (24.0, 60.0):
+        timestamps = observation_timestamps(2.0, fps, int(2 * fps))
+        assert len(timestamps) == 20
+        assert len(timestamps) < int(2 * fps)
+        assert max(b - a for a, b in zip(timestamps, timestamps[1:])) <= 0.1 + (1.0 / fps) + 1e-6
+
+
+def test_rejected_evidence_never_seeds_and_other_rejection_classes_are_ineligible():
+    frames = _frames((0.0, [_det(accepted=False)]), (0.1, [_det(accepted=False, reason="noise_text")]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert all(not frame["caption_candidates"] for frame in frames)
+    assert all("tracklet_id" not in det for frame in frames for det in frame["detections"])
+
+
+def test_text_mismatch_low_score_tail_continues_with_explicit_provenance_and_grace():
+    seed = _det(text="sign")
+    tail = _det(accepted=False, text="totally different")
+    frames = _frames((0.0, [seed]), (0.2, [tail]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert tail["tracklet_id"] == seed["tracklet_id"]
+    assert tail["observation_provenance"] == "rejected_visual_continuation"
+    assert tail["observed_bbox"] == tail["bbox"]
+    assert tail["inferred_visibility_end"] == 0.3
+    assert tail["visibility_interval_semantics"] == "half_open"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("left", "right"),
+    [
+        ((0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.50), (0.48, 0.40, 0.68, 0.50)),  # IoU below 0.45
+        ((0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.50), (0.461, 0.40, 0.661, 0.50)),  # center distance above 0.06
+        ((0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.50), (0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.449)),  # area ratio above 2
+        ((0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.50), (0.40, 0.40, 0.52, 0.50)),  # aspect ratio above 1.6
+    ],
+)
+def test_each_geometry_threshold_rejects_out_of_contract_match(left, right):
+    assert not _compatible_continuation(_det(left), _det(right))
+
+
+def test_geometry_threshold_boundaries_are_inclusive():
+    base = _det((0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.50))
+    same = _det((0.40, 0.40, 0.60, 0.50))
+    assert _compatible_continuation(base, same)
+
+
+def test_gap_over_point_two_seconds_does_not_bridge_6000_or_any_identity():
+    seed = _det(text="6000")
+    tail = _det(accepted=False, text="6000")
+    frames = _frames((0.0, [seed]), (0.2001, [tail]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert "tracklet_id" not in tail
+    assert not frames[1]["caption_candidates"]
+
+
+def test_direct_and_refined_reacquisition_restore_strong_authority():
+    seed = _det()
+    rejected = _det(accepted=False, text="sion")
+    refined = _det(source="crop_refined_child", text="Sian")
+    frames = _frames((0.0, [seed]), (0.1, [rejected]), (0.2, [refined]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert len({seed["tracklet_id"], rejected["tracklet_id"], refined["tracklet_id"]}) == 1
+    assert seed["observation_provenance"] == "accepted_direct"
+    assert refined["observation_provenance"] == "accepted_refined"
+
+
+def test_repeated_words_remain_separate_by_geometry_and_assign_one_to_one():
+    upper = _det((0.2, 0.2, 0.35, 0.28), text="the")
+    lower = _det((0.2, 0.7, 0.35, 0.78), text="the")
+    upper_tail = _det((0.2, 0.2, 0.35, 0.28), accepted=False, text="x")
+    lower_tail = _det((0.2, 0.7, 0.35, 0.78), accepted=False, text="y")
+    frames = _frames((0.0, [upper, lower]), (0.1, [lower_tail, upper_tail]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert upper["tracklet_id"] != lower["tracklet_id"]
+    assert upper_tail["tracklet_id"] == upper["tracklet_id"]
+    assert lower_tail["tracklet_id"] == lower["tracklet_id"]
+
+
+def test_known_dont_low_score_continuation_stays_on_its_geometry():
+    dont = _det((0.25, 0.24, 0.58, 0.31), text="don't")
+    nearby_other = _det((0.62, 0.24, 0.78, 0.31), text="We")
+    dont_tail = _det((0.26, 0.24, 0.59, 0.31), accepted=False, text="dont")
+    frames = _frames((0.0, [dont, nearby_other]), (0.1, [dont_tail]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert dont_tail["tracklet_id"] == dont["tracklet_id"]
+    assert dont_tail["tracklet_id"] != nearby_other["tracklet_id"]
+
+
+def test_visibility_grace_clamps_to_source_end_without_fabricating_geometry():
+    seed = _det()
+    frames = _frames((0.95, [seed]))
+    apply_short_caption_continuations(frames, 0.1, 1.0)
+
+    assert seed["inferred_visibility_end"] == 1.0
+    assert seed["observed_bbox"] == seed["bbox"]
+    assert len(frames) == 1
diff --git a/tests/test_detect_caption_style_visual_events.py b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_visual_events.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..13b13d1e0759fe684124b62e8dbdd027f60bc68f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_detect_caption_style_visual_events.py
@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import types
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+
+if "paddleocr" not in sys.modules:
+    paddleocr = types.ModuleType("paddleocr")
+    paddleocr.PaddleOCR = object
+    sys.modules["paddleocr"] = paddleocr
+
+from scripts.analysis.detect_caption_style import build_caption_style_events
+
+
+VIDEO = {"width": 1080, "height": 1920}
+PROFILES = [{
+    "style_id": "style_01_spoken_caption",
+    "role": "spoken_caption",
+    "confidence": {"score": 1.0},
+    "sample_count": 1,
+}]
+
+
+def _args():
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        emit_caption_style_events=True,
+        style_event_match_window_sec=1.25,
+        style_event_min_match_score=0.18,
+        max_style_events=0,
+        animation_min_samples=3,
+        animation_max_samples=7,
+    )
+
+
+def _member(tracklet_id, timestamp, text, bbox, *, end=None, cue_id=None, continuous=None, provenance="accepted_direct"):
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = bbox
+    row = {
+        "text": text,
+        "confidence": 0.9,
+        "caption_score": 0.8,
+        "transcript_match_score": 0.8,
+        "hook_score": 0.2,
+        "candidate_reason": "transcript_matched_caption",
+        "role": "spoken_caption",
+        "tracklet_id": tracklet_id,
+        "observation_provenance": provenance,
+        "observed_timestamp": timestamp,
+        "inferred_visibility_end": timestamp + 0.1 if end is None else end,
+        "bbox": bbox,
+        "normalized_bbox": [x1 / 1080, y1 / 1920, x2 / 1080, y2 / 1920],
+        "center": {"x": (x1 + x2) / 2160, "y": (y1 + y2) / 3840},
+        "estimated_font_height_px": y2 - y1,
+        "estimated_font_height_ratio": (y2 - y1) / 1920,
+        "estimated_box_width_ratio": (x2 - x1) / 1080,
+        "estimated_box_height_ratio": (y2 - y1) / 1920,
+        "estimated_text_color": "#f2cb9b",
+        "estimated_stroke_color": "#122017",
+        "estimated_shadow_color": "#122017",
+        "has_dark_stroke": True,
+        "has_shadow": True,
+        "has_saturated_text": True,
+        "text_area_ratio": 0.2,
+        "dark_area_ratio": 0.2,
+        "saturated_area_ratio": 0.2,
+        "contrast_area_ratio": 0.8,
+        "matched_cue_ids": [cue_id] if cue_id else [],
+    }
+    if continuous:
+        row.update({
+            "continuous_visual_identity_id": continuous["id"],
+            "continuous_visual_identity_tracklet_ids": continuous["tracklets"],
+            "continuous_visual_identity_observed_start": continuous["start"],
+            "continuous_visual_identity_last_observed": continuous["last"],
+            "continuous_visual_identity_inferred_end": continuous["end"],
+            "continuous_visual_identity_interval_semantics": "half_open",
+        })
+    return row
+
+
+def _group(timestamp, *members, text=None):
+    boxes = [member["bbox"] for member in members]
+    bbox = [min(box[0] for box in boxes), min(box[1] for box in boxes), max(box[2] for box in boxes), max(box[3] for box in boxes)]
+    return {
+        "timestamp": timestamp,
+        "frame_index": round(timestamp * 30),
+        "text": text or " ".join(member["text"] for member in members),
+        "bbox": bbox,
+        "tracklet_ids": [member["tracklet_id"] for member in members],
+        "members": list(members),
+    }
+
+
+def test_standalone_tracklet_owns_event_timing_and_transcript_is_annotation_only():
+    member = _member("caption_tracklet_0001", 1.2, "We", [200, 400, 320, 470], end=1.7, cue_id="sub_1")
+    cues = [{"id": "sub_1", "text": "We", "start": 9.0, "end": 9.2, "mid": 9.1}]
+
+    events, diagnostics = build_caption_style_events([_group(1.2, member)], cues, PROFILES, VIDEO, _args())
+
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    assert events[0]["visual_event_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0001"
+    assert (events[0]["start"], events[0]["end"]) == (1.2, 1.7)
+    assert events[0]["cue_id"] == "sub_1"
+    assert events[0]["semantic_reference"]["cue_start"] == 9.0
+    assert diagnostics["visual_identity_authority"] is True
+
+
+def test_continuous_identity_owns_one_event_without_synthetic_gap_observation():
+    identity = {"id": "continuous_visual_identity_0028", "tracklets": ["caption_tracklet_0028", "caption_tracklet_0033"], "start": 5.333, "last": 6.2, "end": 6.3}
+    left = _member("caption_tracklet_0028", 5.4, "sion", [336, 408, 778, 536], continuous=identity)
+    right = _member("caption_tracklet_0033", 6.0, "Sian", [340, 410, 780, 538], continuous=identity)
+
+    events, _ = build_caption_style_events([_group(5.4, left), _group(6.0, right)], [], PROFILES, VIDEO, _args())
+
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    event = events[0]
+    assert event["tracklet_ids"] == ["caption_tracklet_0028", "caption_tracklet_0033"]
+    assert (event["start"], event["last_observed"], event["end"]) == (5.333, 6.2, 6.3)
+    assert [row["observed_timestamp"] for row in event["observations"]] == [5.4, 6.0]
+
+
+def test_repeated_semantic_labels_and_upper_lower_the_remain_distinct():
+    upper = _member("upper_the", 5.0, "the", [420, 330, 560, 390], cue_id="the")
+    lower = _member("lower_the", 5.0, "the", [360, 710, 500, 770], cue_id="the")
+    cues = [{"id": "the", "text": "the", "start": 4.9, "end": 5.2, "mid": 5.05}]
+
+    events, _ = build_caption_style_events([_group(5.0, upper, lower)], cues, PROFILES, VIDEO, _args())
+
+    assert len(events) == 2
+    assert {event["visual_event_identity"] for event in events} == {"upper_the", "lower_the"}
+    assert {event["cue_id"] for event in events} == {"the"}
+    assert len({tuple(event["placement"]["bbox"]) for event in events}) == 2
+
+
+def test_parent_phrase_never_suppresses_visible_children():
+    before = _member("before", 5.0, "before", [280, 350, 470, 440], cue_id="before")
+    sign = _member("sign", 5.0, "sion", [500, 350, 760, 440], cue_id="sign")
+    cues = [
+        {"id": "before", "text": "before", "start": 4.8, "end": 5.2, "mid": 5.0},
+        {"id": "sign", "text": "sign", "start": 5.42, "end": 5.64, "mid": 5.53},
+    ]
+
+    events, _ = build_caption_style_events([_group(5.0, before, sign, text="before the sign")], cues, PROFILES, VIDEO, _args())
+
+    assert {event["visual_event_identity"] for event in events} == {"before", "sign"}
+    assert all(event["observations"][0]["composition"]["text"] == "before the sign" for event in events)
+
+
+def test_missing_semantic_mapping_preserves_visual_event_and_provenance():
+    member = _member("caption_tracklet_6000", 22.6, "6000", [120, 400, 880, 600], end=23.7, provenance="accepted_refined")
+
+    events, diagnostics = build_caption_style_events([_group(22.6, member)], [], PROFILES, VIDEO, _args())
+
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    assert events[0]["cue_id"] is None
+    assert events[0]["label_source"] == "image_ocr"
+    assert events[0]["observation_provenance"] == ["accepted_refined"]
+    assert (events[0]["start"], events[0]["end"]) == (22.6, 23.7)
+    assert diagnostics["visual_only_count"] == 1
diff --git a/tests/test_generate_step2f_static_style_contract.py b/tests/test_generate_step2f_static_style_contract.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2c2860c0d3bac4911f4d5ec5e9496803debd7a3d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_generate_step2f_static_style_contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/generate_step2f_static_style_contract.py"
+LINKAGE_VALIDATION = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_LINKAGE_STEP2B2_RERANK_CORRECTION_20260926/20260926T160000000Z_caption_tracklet_0074/bounded_linkage_repair_validation.json"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step2f", SCRIPT)
+step2f = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+assert SPEC.loader
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(step2f)
+
+PATHS = {
+    "glyph": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/reel2_glyph_evidence_v2_mask_isolation_corrected.json",
+    "font": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/reel2_known_region_font_rerank_mask_isolation_corrected.json",
+    "candidate_reduction": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/whole_reel_full_pool_benchmark_mask_isolation_corrected.json",
+    "stroke": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2C_STROKE_OWNERSHIP_CORRECTION_20260925/20260925T162120849Z_identity_ownership/step2c_stroke_ownership_inference.json",
+    "color": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2D_COLOR_OPACITY_INFERENCE_20260925/20260925T180000000Z_first_run/step2d_color_opacity_inference.json",
+    "composition": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2E_COMPOSITION_RELATIONSHIPS_20260925/20260925T220000000Z_source_graph/step2e_composition_relationships.json",
+    "preview": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2_REEL2_STATIC_CAPTION_FIDELITY_V1_20260925/20260925T085122980Z_static_fidelity/reel2_l4_preview.json",
+    "linkage_audit": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_FINAL_MULTI_OBJECT_MASK_ISOLATION_REPAIR_20260927/20260927T000000000Z_bounded/whole_reel_text_mask_linkage_audit_after_mask_isolation_repair.json",
+    "adjudication": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_LINKAGE_CANDIDATE_ADJUDICATION_20260926/20260926T200000000Z_readonly/adjudication_decisions.json",
+    "coverage": ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP2B1_REJECTED_OBSERVATION_COVERAGE_AUDIT_20260926/20260926T223000000Z_readonly/step2b1_rejected_observation_coverage_audit.json",
+}
+
+
+def contract():
+    inputs = {name: step2f.load(path) for name, path in PATHS.items()}
+    names = {name: str(path) for name, path in PATHS.items()}
+    hashes = {name: step2f.sha256(path) for name, path in PATHS.items()}
+    return step2f.build_contract(inputs, names, hashes)
+
+
+def test_bounded_linkage_repair_preserves_masks_and_non_target_decisions():
+    validation = step2f.load(LINKAGE_VALIDATION)
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_BOUNDED_FONT_TEXT_LINKAGE_REPAIR"
+    assert validation["corrected_scoring_text"] == "behind"
+    assert validation["masks_bboxes_observations_unchanged"]
+    assert validation["non_target_font_rankings_unchanged"]
+    assert validation["non_target_candidate_reduction_rows_unchanged"]
+
+
+def test_whole_reel_contract_and_authority_guards():
+    value = contract()
+    validation = step2f.validate_contract(value, 113, SCRIPT)
+    ids = [row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in value["identities"]]
+    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)) == 113
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_2F_CORRECTED_WHOLE_REEL_STATIC_STYLE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["silent_default_check"]["pass"]
+    assert validation["unresolved_properties_have_reasons"]
+    assert not validation["provisional_authority_promoted"]
+    assert not validation["composition_creates_shared_style"]
+    assert not validation["physical_word_members_merged"]
+    assert validation["generalization_gate"]["pass"]
+    assert validation["step2b2_precedence_applied"]
+    assert validation["step2b1_history_preserved"]
+    assert validation["linkage_accounting"]["raw_mismatch_count"] == 14
+    assert validation["linkage_accounting"]["accepted_harmless_mismatch_count"] == 14
+    assert validation["linkage_accounting"]["unaccounted_true_mismatch_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["linkage_accounting"]["coverage_gap_count"] == 0
+    assert all(item["provenance"]["composition"]["sha256"] for item in value["identities"])
+
+
+def test_step2b2_winner_and_downgrade_override_step2b1_with_history():
+    value = contract()
+    rows = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in value["identities"]}
+    primary_launch = rows["caption_tracklet_0009"]["typography"]["font"]
+    matching = rows["caption_tracklet_0094"]["typography"]["font"]
+    behind = rows["caption_tracklet_0074"]["typography"]["font"]
+
+    assert primary_launch["step2b1_history"]["selected_candidate"]["family"] == "Impact"
+    assert primary_launch["selected_candidate"]["family"] == "Verdana"
+    assert matching["step2b1_history"]["authority"] == "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING"
+    assert matching["authority"]["status"] == "PROVISIONAL"
+    assert behind["selected_candidate"]["family"] == "Franklin Gothic Medium"
+    assert behind["step2b1_history"]["selected_candidate"]["family"] == "Corbel"
+    assert behind["authority"]["status"] == "PROVISIONAL"
+
+
+def test_unresolved_and_renderer_defaults_cannot_be_promoted():
+    value = contract()
+    unresolved = next(row for row in value["identities"] if row["opacity"]["authority"]["status"] == "UNRESOLVED")
+    assert unresolved["opacity"]["value"] is None
+    broken = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    broken["identities"][0]["opacity"]["value"] = 1.0
+    assert not step2f.validate_contract(broken, 113, SCRIPT)["silent_default_check"]["pass"]
+    broken = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    provisional = next(row for row in broken["identities"] if row["fill"]["authority"]["status"] == "PROVISIONAL")
+    provisional["fill"]["authority"]["status"] = "AUTHORITATIVE"
+    assert step2f.validate_contract(broken, 113, SCRIPT)["provisional_authority_promoted"]
+
+
+def test_latest_mask_isolation_downgrade_removes_stale_font_but_keeps_bbox_provenance():
+    rows = {row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"]: row for row in contract()["identities"]}
+    for identity in ("caption_tracklet_0068", "caption_tracklet_0069"):
+        row = rows[identity]
+        assert row["typography"]["font"]["authority"]["status"] == "UNRESOLVED"
+        assert row["typography"]["font"]["selected_candidate"] is None
+        assert row["geometry"]["source_observation_provenance"]
+        assert not row["geometry"]["accepted_source_observations"]
+
+
+def test_composition_and_physical_word_are_references_not_style_merges():
+    value = contract()
+    composed = [row for row in value["identities"] if row["composition"]["composition_ids"]]
+    assert composed and all(not row["composition"]["style_sharing_authorized"] for row in composed)
+    fragments = [row for row in value["identities"] if row["identity"]["physical_word_memberships"]]
+    assert len(fragments) == 2
+    assert len({row["identity"]["stable_identity_id"] for row in fragments}) == 2
+    assert value["style_equivalence_relationships"][0]["outcome"] == "EXPLICITLY_UNRESOLVED"
+    assert value["style_equivalence_relationships"][0]["style_sharing_applied"] is False
+
+
+def test_generation_is_deterministic():
+    import json
+    first = json.dumps(contract(), indent=2) + "\n"
+    second = json.dumps(contract(), indent=2) + "\n"
+    assert first.encode() == second.encode()
diff --git a/tests/test_generate_step4a_timing_persistence.py b/tests/test_generate_step4a_timing_persistence.py

@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+from scripts.analysis.generate_step4a_timing_persistence import overlaps
+
+
+def test_half_open_overlap_and_adjacency():
+    def row(identity, start, end):
+        return {"identity": identity, "source": {"visibility_intervals": [[start, end]]}}
+
+    result = overlaps([row("a", 1, 5), row("b", 4, 8), row("c", 8, 9)])
+
+    assert result == [{
+        "identity_a": "a", "identity_b": "b",
+        "source_overlap_intervals": [[4, 5]], "generated_overlap_intervals": [[4, 5]],
+        "source_overlap_frame_count": 1, "generated_overlap_frame_count": 1,
+        "interval_match": True, "frame_count_delta": 0,
+    }]
diff --git a/tests/test_generate_step4b_entry_exit_animation.py b/tests/test_generate_step4b_entry_exit_animation.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..67636eb743e25acf90b997917a0b1664d1edcfda
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_generate_step4b_entry_exit_animation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from scripts.analysis.generate_step4b_entry_exit_animation import classify_boundary, generate
+
+
+def point(frame, center=(0.5, 0.5), scale=100.0):
+    return {"frame": frame, "center": list(center), "scale": scale, "source_frame": frame, "crop_sha256": str(frame)}
+
+
+def test_boundary_taxonomy_is_fail_closed_and_boundary_local():
+    stable_geometry = classify_boundary([point(10), point(12), point(14)], 10, 30, "entry")
+    assert stable_geometry["type"] == "unresolved"
+    assert stable_geometry["authority"] == "UNRESOLVED"
+    assert stable_geometry["confidence"] == "low"
+    assert stable_geometry["reason"] == "abrupt_visibility_transition_not_proven"
+
+    slide = classify_boundary([
+        point(10, (0.45, 0.5)), point(12, (0.5, 0.5)), point(14, (0.5, 0.5))
+    ], 10, 30, "entry")
+    assert slide["type"] == "slide"
+    assert slide["parameters"]["property"] == "Center"
+
+    scale = classify_boundary([
+        point(10, scale=70), point(12, scale=100), point(14, scale=100)
+    ], 10, 30, "entry")
+    assert scale["type"] == "scale"
+    assert scale["parameters"]["property"] == "Size"
+
+    mixed = classify_boundary([
+        point(10, (0.45, 0.5), 70), point(12), point(14)
+    ], 10, 30, "entry")
+    assert mixed["type"] == "unresolved"
+    assert mixed["reason"] == "mixed_scale_and_slide_boundary_evidence"
+
+    ongoing = classify_boundary([
+        point(10, (0.45, 0.5)), point(12, (0.48, 0.5)), point(14, (0.5, 0.5))
+    ], 10, 30, "entry")
+    assert ongoing["type"] == "unresolved"
+    assert ongoing["reason"] == "motion_not_localized_to_boundary"
+
+    short = classify_boundary([point(10), point(11)], 10, 14, "entry")
+    assert short["type"] == "unresolved"
+    assert short["reason"] == "entry_exit_windows_overlap"
+
+
+def test_actual_generation_accounts_for_all_identities_and_is_deterministic(tmp_path):
+    output = tmp_path / "step4b"
+    result = generate(output)
+    contract = json.loads((output / "step4b_entry_exit_animation_contract.json").read_text())
+    validation = json.loads((output / "step4b_entry_exit_validation.json").read_text())
+    proof = json.loads((output / "determinism_proof.json").read_text())
+
+    assert result["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4B_ENTRY_EXIT_ANIMATION_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert len(contract["identities"]) == 113
+    assert all("entry" in row and "exit" in row for row in contract["identities"])
+    assert validation["identity_accounting"] == {"expected": 113, "produced": 113, "missing": [], "duplicates": 0}
+    assert validation["boundary_timing"]["inside_frozen_intervals"] is True
+    assert validation["static_artifacts_changed"] is False
+    assert validation["step4a_timing_artifacts_changed"] is False
+    assert validation["step4c_started"] is False
+    assert validation["step4d_started"] is False
+    assert validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert validation["entry_results"]["abrupt"] == validation["exit_results"]["abrupt"] == 0
+    assert validation["abrupt_evidence_correction"] == {
+        "before": 25,
+        "after": 0,
+        "downgraded": 25,
+        "entry_downgraded": 17,
+        "exit_downgraded": 8,
+        "surviving_abrupt_evidence": [],
+    }
+    assert proof["rerun_byte_identical"] is True
+    assert (output / "step4b_entry_exit_review_diagnostic.jpg").stat().st_size > 0

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import json
+
+from scripts.analysis.generate_step4b_motion_ir_pilot import derive_features, generate, scale_gate
+
+
+def sample(frame, x, y, scale=None, visibility=None):
+    return {"frame": frame, "position": {"x": x, "y": y}, "scale": {"value": scale} if scale is not None else None, "relative_visibility": {"value": visibility} if visibility is not None else None}
+
+
+def test_generic_features_keep_channels_and_trajectory_shape():
+    rows = [sample(0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.2), sample(1, 0.1, 0.0, 1.3, 0.7), sample(2, 0.1, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), sample(3, 0.05, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0)]
+    features = derive_features(rows)
+    assert features["overshoot"] is True
+    assert features["hold_intervals"]
+    assert features["direction_changes"] >= 1
+
+
+def test_scale_requires_corroboration_and_rejects_bbox_only_change():
+    glyph = {"mask_confidence": 0.8}
+    observations = [
+        {"timestamp": frame / 24, "bbox": [0, 0, size, size], "background_contamination": 0.01}
+        for frame, size in [(1, 100), (2, 120), (3, 95)]
+    ]
+    rejected = scale_gate(glyph, observations, {1: 1.0, 2: 1.0, 3: 1.0}, 10000)
+    assert rejected["supported"] is False
+    accepted = scale_gate(glyph, observations, {1: 1.0, 2: 1.2, 3: 0.95}, 10000)
+    assert accepted["supported"] is True
+
+
+def test_actual_bounded_pilot_is_deterministic_and_preserves_freezes(tmp_path):
+    output = tmp_path / "pilot"
+    result = generate(__import__("pathlib").Path("tests/fixtures/step4b_motion_ir_controls.json"), output)
+    pilot = json.loads((output / "step4b_motion_ir_pilot.json").read_text())
+    validation = json.loads((output / "step4b_motion_ir_pilot_validation.json").read_text())
+    proof = json.loads((output / "determinism_proof.json").read_text())
+    assert result["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4B_BOUNDARY_LOCAL_MOTION_IR_PILOT_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["ok"] is True
+    assert validation["identity_graph_count"] == 113
+    assert validation["production_hardcoding"] == []
+    assert validation["step4c_started"] is False
+    assert validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert proof["rerun_byte_identical"] is True
+    assert all(sample["rotation"] is None for row in pilot["controls"] for sample in row.get("samples", []))

+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/generate_step4b_motion_ir_whole_reel.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4b_whole", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC); SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_generic_safety_helpers():
+    assert MODULE.boundary_intervals(10, 30) == {"entry": [10, 16], "exit": [23, 29]}
+    assert MODULE.boundary_intervals(10, 13) == {"entry": [10, 10], "exit": [12, 12]}
+    assert MODULE.merge_holds([[3, 5], [4, 6], [9, 10]]) == [[3, 6], [9, 10]]
+    source = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert not __import__("re").search(r"\b(?:F\d+|caption_tracklet_\d+|continuous_visual_identity_\d+)\b", source)
+    assert '"derived_label": "ABRUPT"' not in source
+
+
+def test_weak_tracker_oscillation_cannot_become_authoritative_label():
+    samples = []
+    xs = [0.1, 0.14, 0.1, 0.14, 0.1, 0.14, 0.1]
+    scores = [0.92, 0.25, 0.94, 0.25, 0.95, 0.96, 0.95]
+    for frame, (x, score) in enumerate(zip(xs, scores)):
+        samples.append({"frame": frame, "source_frame": frame, "position": {"x": x, "y": 0.5, "authority": "SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TRACK"}, "match_score": score, "relative_visibility": None, "scale": None, "rotation": None})
+    row = {"control_id": "generic:entry", "identity": "generic", "boundary": "entry", "interval": [0, 7], "samples": samples, "features": MODULE.pilot.derive_features(samples), "channel_authority": {"position": "SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TRACK", "relative_visibility": "UNRESOLVED", "scale": "UNRESOLVED", "rotation": "UNSUPPORTED"}, "scale_gate": {"supported": False}}
+    result = MODULE.normalize("generic", "", row)
+    assert result["features"]["raw_oscillation_candidate"] is True
+    assert result["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "LOW"
+    assert result["derived_label"] != "CUSTOM_OSCILLATION"
+
+
+def test_generated_whole_reel_contract(tmp_path):
+    output = tmp_path / "whole"
+    result = MODULE.generate(output)
+    contract = json.loads((output / "step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir.json").read_text())
+    validation = json.loads((output / "step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir_validation.json").read_text())
+    summary = json.loads((output / "step4b_whole_reel_motion_ir_summary.json").read_text())
+    diagnostic = json.loads((output / "step4b_whole_reel_review_sample.json").read_text())
+    proof = json.loads((output / "determinism_proof.json").read_text())
+    assert result["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4B_WHOLE_REEL_MOTION_IR_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert len(contract["records"]) == 226
+    assert summary["identity_accounting"] == {"duplicates": 0, "expected": 113, "missing": [], "produced": 113}
+    assert summary["entry_exit_accounting"]["entry"] == summary["entry_exit_accounting"]["exit"] == 113
+    assert all(row["reproduction_authority"] is False for row in contract["records"])
+    assert all(set(row["channel_authority"]) == {"position", "relative_visibility", "scale", "rotation"} for row in contract["records"])
+    assert all(row["interval"][0] >= next(t["source"]["visibility_intervals"][0][0] for t in MODULE.load(MODULE.TIMING_CONTRACT)["identities"] if t["identity"] == row["identity"]) for row in contract["records"])
+    assert all(not (row["features"]["semantic_oscillation_confidence"] == "LOW" and row["derived_label"] == "CUSTOM_OSCILLATION") for row in contract["records"])
+    assert all(row["derived_label"] is None for row in contract["records"] if row["static_no_motion"])
+    assert validation["false_scale_gate"].startswith("PASS")
+    assert validation["abrupt_regression_gate"].startswith("PASS")
+    assert len(diagnostic["pilot_regression"]["controls"]) == 13
+    assert all(row["match"] in {"YES", "PARTIAL"} for row in diagnostic["pilot_regression"]["controls"])
+    assert validation["step4c_started"] is validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert proof["rerun_byte_identical"] is True

+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT=ROOT/"scripts/analysis/generate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py"
+SPEC=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4c_dynamic",SCRIPT)
+MODULE=importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC); SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_channel_status_and_rotation_authority_are_fail_closed():
+    samples=[{"frame":i,"position":{"x":.5+i*.003,"y":.5},"scale":None,"relative_visibility":None} for i in range(5)]
+    row={"samples":samples,"channel_authority":{"position":"SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TRACK","scale":"UNRESOLVED","relative_visibility":"UNRESOLVED","rotation":"UNSUPPORTED"}}
+    assert MODULE.channel_status(row,"position")=="DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED"
+    assert MODULE.channel_status(row,"scale")=="UNRESOLVED"
+    assert MODULE.feasibility.classify_rotation({"sample_count":4,"span_degrees":2.0,"correlation":.9,"linear_rmse_degrees":.5})=="DYNAMIC_ROTATION_SUPPORTED"
+    assert MODULE.feasibility.classify_rotation({"sample_count":4,"span_degrees":.75,"correlation":.99,"linear_rmse_degrees":.01})=="STATIC_TILT_ONLY"
+
+
+def test_generated_whole_reel_contract(tmp_path):
+    output=tmp_path/"step4c"
+    result=MODULE.generate(output)
+    contract=json.loads((output/"step4c_dynamic_transform_contract.json").read_text())
+    validation=json.loads((output/"step4c_dynamic_transform_validation.json").read_text())
+    rotation=json.loads((output/"step4c_rotation_audit.json").read_text())
+    adjudication=json.loads((output/"step4c_6000_rotation_adjudication.json").read_text())
+    manifest=json.loads((output/"step4c_dynamic_transform_review_manifest.json").read_text())
+    proof=json.loads((output/"determinism_proof.json").read_text())
+    assert result["result"]=="PASS_STEP_4C_DYNAMIC_TRANSFORMS_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert len(contract["records"])==113
+    assert validation["summary"]["identity_accounting"]=={"expected":113,"produced":113,"missing":[],"duplicates":0}
+    assert validation["summary"]["continuations"]["total"]==27
+    assert validation["step4b_4c_continuity"]["ok"] is True
+    assert validation["keyframes_inside_step4a_intervals"] is True
+    assert validation["scale_gate"].startswith("UNCHANGED_CORROBORATED")
+    assert validation["relative_visibility_semantics"].endswith("NOT_ABSOLUTE_ALPHA")
+    assert validation["resolve_mutated"] is validation["step4d_started"] is False
+    assert adjudication["regression_status"]=="PASS_STATIC_TILT_ONLY_PRESERVED"
+    assert adjudication["dynamic_rotation_keyframes"]==[]
+    assert rotation["gate"]=={"maximum_background_contamination":.20,"maximum_linear_rmse_degrees":.50,"minimum_absolute_frame_angle_correlation":.90,"minimum_samples":4,"minimum_angle_span_degrees":2.0}
+    assert 10<=manifest["case_count"]<=15
+    assert proof["rerun_byte_identical"] is True
+    assert any(len(row["editor_neutral_keyframes"][channel]) for row in contract["records"] for channel in ("position","scale","rotation","relative_visibility"))
+    for row in contract["records"]:
+        start,end=row["visibility_interval"]
+        assert all(start<=key["frame"]<end for values in row["editor_neutral_keyframes"].values() for key in values)
+        if row["rotation"]["detector_verdict"]=="STATIC_TILT_ONLY": assert not row["editor_neutral_keyframes"]["rotation"]
+    assert not re.search(r"\b(?:F\d+|caption_tracklet_\d+|continuous_visual_identity_\d+)\b",SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/generate_step4d_shadow_ir.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4d_shadow_ir", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_bounded_shadow_ir_preserves_positive_and_negative_controls():
+    artifacts = MODULE.build()
+    contract = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_ir_contract.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_implementation_validation.json"])
+    review = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_shadow_human_review_data.json"])
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in contract["shadows"]}
+
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4D_BOUNDED_SHADOW_IMPLEMENTATION_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == "PASS"
+    assert contract["cases_with_shadow_authority"] == ["caption_tracklet_0090"]
+    assert set(contract["cases_without_shadow_authority"]) == {"caption_tracklet_0026", "caption_tracklet_0013"}
+    assert by_id["caption_tracklet_0090"]["offset"]["direction"] == "S"
+    assert by_id["caption_tracklet_0090"]["evidence"]["temporal_consistency"] == 1.0
+    assert by_id["caption_tracklet_0026"]["authority"] == "NO_SHADOW_AUTHORITY"
+    assert "temporal_direction_coherence" in by_id["caption_tracklet_0026"]["evidence"]["gate_failures"]
+    assert "multiple_source_observations" in by_id["caption_tracklet_0013"]["evidence"]["gate_failures"]
+    assert all(row["strength_or_opacity"]["value"] is None and row["softness_or_blur"]["value"] is None for row in contract["shadows"])
+    assert contract["global_propagation"] is validation["global_shadow_propagation"] is False
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["stroke_used_as_shadow_authority"] is validation["background_promoted_to_shadow"] is False
+    assert all(row["human_review_status"] == "PENDING" and row["material_properties_checked"] == MODULE.REVIEW_PROPERTIES for row in review["cases"])
+
+
+def test_shadow_gate_fails_closed_for_contamination_and_stroke_like_symmetry():
+    accepted_case = json.loads(MODULE.build()["step4d_shadow_ir_contract.json"])["shadows"][0]
+    adjudication = MODULE.load(MODULE.DEFAULT_ADJUDICATION)
+    source_case = next(row for row in adjudication["cases"] if row["identity"] == accepted_case["source_identity"] and row["effect_class"] == "shadow")
+
+    contaminated = json.loads(json.dumps(source_case))
+    contaminated["evidence_quality"]["contamination"] = .9
+    assert MODULE.shadow_gate(contaminated) == (False, ["acceptable_contamination"])
+
+    symmetric = json.loads(json.dumps(source_case))
+    symmetric["effect_metrics"]["median_shadow_directional_anisotropy"] = 0
+    assert MODULE.shadow_gate(symmetric) == (False, ["directional_displacement"])
diff --git a/tests/test_investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py b/tests/test_investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b18493202d954d8c2c41cfd75438986c908bdd46
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/investigate_step4c_dynamic_transforms.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4c_investigation", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC); SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_rotation_gate_distinguishes_static_tilt_from_dynamic_rotation():
+    static = [{"source_frame": frame, "angle_degrees": angle} for frame, angle in zip((1, 4, 7, 10), (-3.70, -3.68, -3.72, -3.69))]
+    dynamic = [{"source_frame": frame, "angle_degrees": angle} for frame, angle in zip((1, 4, 7, 10), (-4.0, -4.8, -5.6, -6.4))]
+    assert MODULE.classify_rotation(MODULE.rotation_metrics(static)) == "STATIC_TILT_ONLY"
+    assert MODULE.classify_rotation(MODULE.rotation_metrics(dynamic)) == "DYNAMIC_ROTATION_SUPPORTED"
+
+
+def test_mask_angle_is_translation_invariant():
+    mask = np.zeros((60, 120), np.uint8)
+    points = np.asarray([[10, 35], [105, 20], [108, 27], [13, 42]], np.int32)
+    import cv2
+    cv2.fillConvexPoly(mask, points, 1)
+    flat = mask.reshape(-1); runs=[]; start=None
+    for index,value in enumerate(np.append(flat,0)):
+        if value and start is None: start=index
+        elif not value and start is not None: runs.append([start,index-start]); start=None
+    angle = MODULE.mask_angle_degrees(list(mask.shape), runs)
+    shifted = np.zeros_like(mask); shifted[5:, 7:] = mask[:-5, :-7]
+    flat = shifted.reshape(-1); runs=[]; start=None
+    for index,value in enumerate(np.append(flat,0)):
+        if value and start is None: start=index
+        elif not value and start is not None: runs.append([start,index-start]); start=None
+    assert abs(angle - MODULE.mask_angle_degrees(list(shifted.shape), runs)) < 0.01

+import importlib.util

+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_investigation_enforces_methodology_without_preferring_a_conclusion():
+    first = MODULE.build()
+    second = MODULE.build()
+    audit = json.loads(first["step4d_effect_necessity_audit.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(first["step4d_necessity_investigation_validation.json"])
+    manifest = json.loads(first["step4d_review_manifest.json"])
+    assert first == second
+    assert audit["identity_accounting"] == {"expected": 113, "produced": 113, "missing": [], "duplicates": 0}
+    assert set(audit["effect_classes"]) == set(MODULE.CLASSES)
+    assert all(row["classification"] in MODULE.ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATIONS for row in audit["effect_classes"].values())
+    assert all(row["status"] in MODULE.ALLOWED_IDENTITY_STATUSES for row in audit["records"])
+    assert all(row["evidence_for"] and all(item["provenance"] for item in row["evidence_for"]) for row in audit["effect_classes"].values() if row["classification"] == "SOURCE_REQUIRED")
+    expected = {name.lower(): sum(row["classification"] == name for row in audit["effect_classes"].values()) for name in MODULE.ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATIONS}
+    assert audit["summary"] == expected
+    assert sum(audit["identity_classification_counts"].values()) == 113
+    assert validation["legacy_shadow_systematic_defect"]["has_shadow_count"] == 113
+    assert validation["legacy_shadow_systematic_defect"]["verdict"].startswith("UNSAFE_")
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == "PASS"
+    assert validation["production_effect_mechanisms_added"] == 0
+    assert validation["resolve_mutated"] is validation["later_non_caption_vfx_started"] is False
+    assert 8 <= manifest["case_count"] <= 15
+

+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/investigate_step4d_caption_occlusion.py"
+SELECTION = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/step4d_effect_evidence_repair_cases.json"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4d_caption_occlusion", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_caption_occlusion_adjudication_is_bounded_deterministic_and_fail_closed():
+    first = MODULE.build(SELECTION)
+    second = MODULE.build(SELECTION)
+    assert first == second
+
+    evidence = json.loads(first["step4d_caption_occlusion_evidence.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(first["step4d_caption_occlusion_validation.json"])
+
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4D_CAPTION_OCCLUSION_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == validation["shadow_freeze_status"] == "PASS"
+    assert validation["bounded_candidate_count"] == len(evidence["cases"]) == 3
+    assert validation["missing_pixels_only_positive_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["unknown_preserved"] is True
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["upstream_artifacts_changed"] is validation["step2e_changed"] is validation["glyph_masks_changed"] is False
+    assert validation["shadow_changed"] is validation["clipping_changed"] is validation["new_segmentation_added"] is False
+    assert validation["occlusion_renderer_added"] is validation["resolve_mutated"] is False
+    assert validation["step5_started"] is validation["step6_started"] is False
+    assert evidence["class_level_verdict"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE"
+    assert evidence["negative_control"]["result"] == "PASS_MISSING_PIXELS_DID_NOT_PROVE_OCCLUSION"
+    assert evidence["historical_positive_control"]["result"] == "PASS_HISTORICAL_ACCEPTED_OWNED_MASK_OVERLAP_RECOGNIZED"
+    assert all(row["verdict"] == "UNSUPPORTED_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE" for row in evidence["cases"])
+    assert all(row["candidate_occluder_region"]["ownership"] == "OWNERSHIP_UNRESOLVED" for row in evidence["cases"])
+    assert all(row["z_order"]["relation"] == "NO_FRONT_BACK_PROOF" for row in evidence["cases"])

+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.davinci import prepare_video_cloner_fresh_mvp_timeline as prepare
+
+
+def test_publish_writes_one_safe_bridge_command(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    manifest = tmp_path / "timeline_manifest.json"
+    manifest.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare, "allocate_run_id", lambda: "20261007T120000000Z_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
+
+    receipt = prepare.publish(
+        tmp_path,
+        manifest,
+        {
+            "artifact_set_sha256": "artifact",
+            "textplus_fingerprint": "textplus",
+            "fcpxml_sha256": "fcpxml",
+            "report_sha256": "report",
+        },
+        "Project",
+        "Timeline",
+    )
+
+    command = json.loads((tmp_path / receipt["command_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    assert command["module"] == prepare.MODULE
+    assert command["payload"] | {
+        "import_permitted": True,
+        "replace_existing_timeline": False,
+        "save_project": False,
+        "delete_permitted": False,
+        "relink_permitted": False,
+        "metadata_controller_permitted": False,
+    } == command["payload"]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="active_command"):
+        prepare.publish(tmp_path, manifest, command["payload"], "Project", "Timeline")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/repair_glyph_observation_ownership.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ownership", SCRIPT)
+ownership = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+assert SPEC.loader
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(ownership)
+
+
+def test_rejects_only_selected_cross_identity_observation():
+    glyph = {"identity_count": 2, "summary": {}, "identities": [
+        {"identity": "a", "evidence_classification": "CLEAN_SINGLE_FRAME_EVIDENCE", "observations": [{"source_frame": 7, "bbox": [1, 2, 3, 4], "accepted": True, "reason": "accepted"}]},
+        {"identity": "b", "evidence_classification": "CLEAN_SINGLE_FRAME_EVIDENCE", "observations": []},
+    ]}
+    font = {"approved_v2_authority": {}, "identities": [
+        {"identity": "a", "text": "wrong", "font_rerank_status": "AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING", "top_candidates": [{"family": "Impact"}]},
+        {"identity": "b", "text": "kept", "font_rerank_status": "PROVISIONAL_FONT_RANKING", "top_candidates": []},
+    ]}
+    reduction = {"identity_count": 2, "identities": [{"identity": "a", "full_pool_exact_comparisons": 9}, {"identity": "b", "full_pool_exact_comparisons": 8}], "gate_failed_identities": []}
+    decision = {"identity": "a", "source_frame": 7, "bbox": [1, 2, 3, 4], "rejection_reason": "cross_identity"}
+    repaired_glyph, repaired_font, repaired_reduction = ownership.repair(glyph, font, reduction, decision)
+    assert repaired_glyph["identities"][0]["accepted_frame_count"] == 0
+    assert repaired_glyph["identities"][0]["unknown_rle"] == [[0, 1]]
+    assert repaired_glyph["identities"][1] == glyph["identities"][1]
+    assert repaired_font["identities"][0]["font_rerank_status"] == "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING"
+    assert repaired_reduction["gate_failed_identities"][0]["identity"] == "a"
+    assert repaired_reduction["full_pool_exact_comparisons"] == 8
diff --git a/tests/test_repair_multi_object_mask_isolation.py b/tests/test_repair_multi_object_mask_isolation.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..408d880758031b01ff505bcec19cbf2e19973105
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repair_multi_object_mask_isolation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from scripts.analysis.repair_multi_object_mask_isolation import unresolved_mask_fields
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_font_inference as glyphs
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_thickness_stroke as ownership
+
+
+def test_fail_closed_mask_excludes_foreign_and_marks_ambiguity_unknown():
+    target = np.zeros((5, 8), dtype=bool)
+    target[1:4, 2:6] = True
+    foreign = np.zeros_like(target)
+    foreign[1:4, 4:7] = True
+    ambiguous = np.zeros_like(target)
+    ambiguous[:, 3:5] = True
+
+    result = ownership.build_crop_ownership(target, [foreign], [ambiguous])
+
+    assert not np.any(result["TARGET_OWNED"] & result["FOREIGN_IDENTITY"])
+    assert not np.any(result["USABLE_BACKGROUND"] & result["FOREIGN_IDENTITY"])
+    assert np.all(result["UNKNOWN_OR_OCCLUDED"][:, 3] & ~result["TARGET_OWNED"][:, 3])
+
+
+def test_unresolved_mask_has_no_false_foreground_background_or_font_evidence():
+    row = {"final_mask_shape": [5, 8], "observations": [{"accepted": True, "reason": "accepted", "bbox": [1, 2, 3, 4]}]}
+
+    result = unresolved_mask_fields(row, "foreign_object_contamination")
+
+    assert result["known_foreground_rle"] == result["known_background_rle"] == result["final_mask_rle"] == []
+    assert result["unknown_rle"] == [[0, 40]]
+    assert result["accepted_frame_count"] == 0
+    assert result["observations"][0]["accepted"] is False
+    assert result["evidence_classification"] == "CONTAMINATED_EVIDENCE"
+
+
+def test_clean_temporal_evidence_survives_a_contaminated_frame():
+    clean = np.zeros((8, 12), dtype=bool)
+    clean[2:6, 3:9] = True
+    rows = [{"frame": frame, "timestamp": frame / 10, "bbox": [0, 0, 12, 8], "mask": clean, "unknown_mask": np.zeros_like(clean), "foreground_confidence": .9, "contamination_score": .0, "overlap_risk": .0, "blur_quality": 1.0, "accepted": True} for frame in (1, 2)]
+    rows.append({**rows[0], "frame": 3, "contamination_score": 1.0})
+
+    result = glyphs.aggregate_source_masks(rows)
+
+    assert result["usable_frame_count"] == 2
+    assert result["foreground_mask"].shape == (4, 6)
+    assert result["foreground_mask"].all()
+
+
+def test_production_adapter_contains_no_reel_specific_rules():
+    source = (Path(__file__).parents[1] / "scripts/analysis/repair_multi_object_mask_isolation.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0068" not in source
+    assert "caption_tracklet_0069" not in source
+    assert '"listing"' not in source
+    assert '"NOT"' not in source
