@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/analysis/repair_step4d_effect_evidence.py"
+MANIFEST = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/step4d_effect_evidence_repair_cases.json"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4d_effect_repair", SCRIPT)
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+
+
+def test_bounded_effect_evidence_repair_is_fail_closed_and_generic():
+    artifacts = MODULE.build(MANIFEST)
+    contract = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_effect_evidence_repair_contract.json"])
+    validation = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_effect_evidence_repair_validation.json"])
+    before_after = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_effect_evidence_before_after.json"])
+    post = json.loads(artifacts["step4d_effect_evidence_validity_after_repair.json"])
+
+    assert validation["result"] == "PASS_STEP_4D_BOUNDED_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_REPAIR_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW"
+    assert validation["freeze_integrity"]["status"] == "PASS"
+    assert validation["bounded_case_count"] == len(contract["cases"]) == 11
+    assert validation["upstream_glyph_authority_changed"] is False
+    assert validation["upstream_glyph_sha256_before"] == validation["upstream_glyph_sha256_after"]
+    assert validation["production_hardcoded_identities"] == []
+    assert validation["good_control_regression"] is False
+    assert before_after["cases_degraded"] == 0
+    assert post["gate_run_count"] == 1
+    assert all(row["new_validity"] in MODULE.VALIDITY for row in contract["cases"])
+    assert all(row["new_validity"] == "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE" for row in contract["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "caption_occlusion")
+    assert all(row["temporal_evidence"]["status"] != "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED" for row in contract["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "clipping")
+    assert all(row["temporal_evidence"]["status"] == "TEMPORAL_CLIP_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED" for row in contract["cases"] if row["effect_class"] == "clipping" and row["new_validity"] == "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT")
+    promoted = [row for row in contract["cases"] if row["old_validity"] == "INVALID_FOR_EFFECT" and row["new_validity"] in {"VALID_FOR_EFFECT", "PARTIAL_BUT_USABLE"}]
+    assert all(row["metrics"]["source_mask_agreement"] >= 0.12 and row["metrics"]["contamination_ratio"] <= 0.5 for row in promoted)
+
+    for case in contract["cases"]:
+        for frame in case["target_foreground"]["frames"]:
+            shape = frame["shape"]
+            foreground = MODULE.gate.prior.decode(shape, frame["target_foreground_rle"]) > 0
+            exterior = MODULE.gate.prior.decode(shape, frame["exterior_context_rle"]) > 0
+            unknown = MODULE.gate.prior.decode(shape, frame["unknown_region_rle"]) > 0
+            assert not np.any(foreground & exterior)
+            assert not np.any(foreground & unknown)
+            assert bool(np.any(unknown)) == (frame["metrics"]["unknown_ratio"] > 0)

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..07e4b9484e9c01ce3ace2a90364e674b86bf45d8

@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+MODULE_PATH = ROOT / "scripts" / "davinci" / "resolve_apply_video_cloner_metadata.py"
+
+
+def load_module():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("resolve_textplus_carrier_range", MODULE_PATH)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("source_start", "duration", "expected_api_end"), [(0, 12, 12), (20, 7, 27)])
+def test_textplus_carrier_uses_exclusive_resolve_api_end(monkeypatch, source_start, duration, expected_api_end):
+    module = load_module()
+    captured = {}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_find_textplus_carrier_source", lambda _items, _duration: {
+        "ok": True,
+        "source_item": object(),
+        "media_pool_item": object(),
+        "source_start": source_start,
+        "source_end_inclusive": expected_api_end - 1,
+        "attempts": [],
+    })
+
+    def capture(_project, _timeline, rows, _track):
+        captured.update(rows[0])
+        return {"ok": False, "returned_items": [], "detected_items": [], "errors": ["stop_after_payload"]}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_append_media_clip_infos", capture)
+    module.provision_textplus_media_carrier(
+        project=object(), timeline=object(), video_items=[], start_frame=100,
+        end_frame=100 + duration, target_track=3, generated_name="proof",
+    )
+
+    assert captured["source_start"] == source_start
+    assert captured["source_end_inclusive"] == expected_api_end - 1
+    assert captured["source_end_frame_api"] == expected_api_end
+    assert captured["api_end_semantics"] == "exclusive"
diff --git a/tests/test_resolve_textplus_shading_order.py b/tests/test_resolve_textplus_shading_order.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..42d2fb65cd789f8ebaaf585e01122ca85450fa5c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_resolve_textplus_shading_order.py
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+from argparse import Namespace
+
+from scripts.davinci.resolve_apply_video_cloner_metadata import probe_safe_textplus_shading
+
+
+class FakeInput:
+    def __init__(self, name):
+        self.name = name
+
+    def GetAttrs(self):
+        return {"INPS_ID": self.name, "INPS_Name": self.name}
+
+
+class FakeTextPlus:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.values = {f"Enabled{index}": 0 for index in range(2, 9)}
+        self.writes = []
+
+    def GetInputList(self):
+        names = list(self.values)
+        if self.values["Enabled2"]:
+            names += ["ElementShape2", "Red2", "Green2", "Blue2", "Alpha2", "Thickness2", "OutsideOnly2"]
+        return {name: FakeInput(name) for name in names}
+
+    def SetInput(self, name, value):
+        if name not in self.GetInputList():
+            return False
+        self.values[name] = value
+        self.writes.append((name, value))
+        return True
+
+    def GetInput(self, name, *_args):
+        return self.values.get(name)
+
+
+class FakeComp:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.locked = False
+
+    def Lock(self):
+        self.locked = True
+
+    def Unlock(self):
+        self.locked = False
+
+
+def test_requested_outline_is_enabled_before_its_controls_are_written():
+    tool = FakeTextPlus()
+    comp = FakeComp()
+    args = Namespace(
+        caption_apply_outline=True,
+        caption_apply_shadow=False,
+        caption_shading_probe_only=False,
+        caption_outline_element=2,
+        caption_shadow_element=3,
+        caption_outline_width_scale=1.0,
+        caption_outline_thickness=None,
+        caption_shadow_opacity=None,
+        caption_shadow_offset_x=0.003,
+        caption_shadow_offset_y=0.003,
+        caption_shadow_softness=None,
+    )
+
+    result = probe_safe_textplus_shading(
+        tool,
+        {"stroke_width": 5, "font_size_px": 91, "stroke_color": "#7d878b"},
+        args,
+        comp=comp,
+    )
+
+    assert result["safe"] is True
+    assert result["can_write_stroke"] is True
+    assert result["outline"]["applied"] is True
+    assert tool.writes.index(("Enabled2", 1)) < tool.writes.index(("ElementShape2", 1))
+    assert tool.values["ElementShape2"] == 1
+    assert tool.values["Enabled2"] == 1
+    assert all(tool.values[f"Enabled{index}"] == 0 for index in range(3, 9))
+    assert comp.locked is False
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_caption_animation_authority.py b/tests/test_standalone_caption_animation_authority.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..12db1b33efa8317c3a13b1bdf924587acf51ac78
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_caption_animation_authority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,234 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_textplus import (
+    StandaloneTextplusError,
+    attach_visual_animation_authority,
+    render_visual_compositions,
+    resolve_visual_style_authority,
+)
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]
+STYLE = ROOT / "data" / "DcJRJtUKScu" / "analysis" / "DcJRJtUKScu_caption_style.json"
+
+
+def _composition(text: str, cue_id: str, event_id: str, window: list[int], authority: str = "visual_primary") -> dict:
+    return {
+        "composition_id": f"visual_composition_{cue_id}",
+        "window": window,
+        "authority": {"kind": authority, "evidence_ids": [event_id]},
+        "tokens": [{
+            "token_id": f"visual_token_{cue_id}",
+            "text": text,
+            "semantic_ids": [cue_id],
+            "window": window,
+            "style_evidence_id": event_id,
+        }],
+    }
+
+
+def _attach(composition: dict, style_data: dict) -> tuple[dict, int]:
+    cue_id = composition["tokens"][0]["semantic_ids"][0]
+    cues, _ = render_visual_compositions([composition], [cue_id], 30.0)
+    styles, _ = resolve_visual_style_authority(cues, style_data, 30.0)
+    return cues[0], attach_visual_animation_authority(cues, style_data, styles, 30.0)
+
+
+def test_reel2_slide_and_scale_attach_normalized_local_textplus_payloads():
+    style_data = json.loads(STYLE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+
+    we, we_count = _attach(_composition("We", "sub_007", "style_event_sub_0007", [49, 52]), style_data)
+    selling, selling_count = _attach(
+        _composition("Selling", "sub_010", "style_event_sub_0010", [67, 75]), style_data
+    )
+
+    assert we_count == selling_count == 1
+    assert we["animation_authority"] == {
+        "authority": "visual_observed",
+        "source_evidence_id": "style_event_sub_0007",
+        "source_type": "slide",
+        "property": "Center",
+        "keyframes": [
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": [-0.0106, 0.0565]},
+            {"frame": 2, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": [0.0, 0.0]},
+        ],
+    }
+    assert selling["animation_authority"] == {
+        "authority": "visual_observed",
+        "source_evidence_id": "style_event_sub_0010",
+        "source_type": "scale",
+        "property": "Size",
+        "keyframes": [
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": pytest.approx(0.3255441425)},
+            {"frame": 7, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 0.25},
+        ],
+    }
+

+def test_simultaneous_parent_window_is_order_independent_union():
+    cues = [cue(7, "We", 49, 53), cue(8, "launch", 52, 62)]
+    events = [event("sub_0007", "We"), event("sub_0008", "launch")]
+
+    def layers(order):
+        return [
+            {
+                "cue_id": row["id"],
+                "timing_authority": "visual_primary",
+                "lifecycle_window": window,
+            }
+            for row, window in order
+        ]
+
+    forward = lifecycle._visual_compositions(
+        cues,
+        events,
+        layers([(cues[0], [49, 53]), (cues[1], [48, 63])]),
+        [],
+    )
+    reverse = lifecycle._visual_compositions(
+        list(reversed(cues)),
+        events,
+        layers([(cues[1], [48, 63]), (cues[0], [49, 53])]),
+        [],
+    )
+
+    assert forward[0]["window"] == [48, 63]
+    assert reverse[0]["window"] == [48, 63]
+    assert all(
+        composition["window"][0] <= token["window"][0]
+        and token["window"][1] <= composition["window"][1]
+        for composition in forward + reverse
+        for token in composition["tokens"]
+    )

@@ -0,0 +1,284 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_caption_lifecycle as lifecycle
+
+
+def cue(index: int, text: str, source_ids=None) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "id": f"sub_{index:03d}",
+        "text": text,
+        "source_cue_ids": source_ids or [f"sub_{index:03d}"],
+    }
+
+
+def event(identity: str, cue_id: str, text: str, start: float, end: float, *, accepted=True) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "event_id": f"style_event_{identity}",
+        "visual_event_identity": identity,
+        "continuous_visual_identity_id": f"continuous_{identity}",
+        "tracklet_ids": [identity],
+        "cue_id": cue_id,
+        "text": text,
+        "start": start,
+        "end": end,
+        "style_profile_id": "style_test",
+        "match": {"reason": "accepted" if accepted else "low_caption_score"},
+        "observation_provenance": ["accepted_direct"],
+        "semantic_reference": {"cue_id": cue_id},
+    }
+
+
+def compositions(cues, events, *, fps=24.0, accepted_motion=None, display_text_authority=None):
+    return lifecycle._visual_compositions(cues, events, [], [], accepted_motion, fps, display_text_authority)
+
+
+def tokens(rows):
+    return [token for row in rows for token in row["tokens"]]
+
+
+def active(rows, seconds: float, fps=24.0):
+    frame = seconds * fps
+    return [token for token in tokens(rows) if token["window"][0] <= frame < token["window"][1]]
+
+
+def test_accepted_visual_identity_owns_object_and_provenance():
+    source = event("caption_tracklet_0001", "sub_001", "We", 0.5, 1.0)
+    row = tokens(compositions([cue(1, "We")], [source]))[0]
+
+    assert row["visual_event_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0001"
+    assert row["window"] == [12, 24]
+    assert row["style_evidence_id"] == "style_event_caption_tracklet_0001"
+    assert row["style_ref"] == "style_test"
+    assert row["tracklet_ids"] == ["caption_tracklet_0001"]
+    assert row["continuous_visual_identity_id"] == "continuous_caption_tracklet_0001"
+    assert row["semantic_ids"] == ["sub_001"]
+
+
+def test_shared_or_broad_cue_does_not_gate_visual_object_cardinality():
+    rows = compositions(
+        [cue(17, "the")],
+        [
+            event("caption_tracklet_0026", "sub_017", "the", 5.3, 6.0),
+            event("caption_tracklet_0030", "sub_017", "the", 5.5, 6.1),
+            event("caption_tracklet_0029", "2", "before the sign hits the yard", 5.4, 6.0),
+        ],
+    )
+    by_identity = {row["visual_event_identity"]: row for row in tokens(rows)}
+
+    assert set(by_identity) == {
+        "caption_tracklet_0026", "caption_tracklet_0030", "caption_tracklet_0029"
+    }
+    assert by_identity["caption_tracklet_0026"]["semantic_ids"] == ["sub_017"]
+    assert by_identity["caption_tracklet_0030"]["semantic_ids"] == ["sub_017"]
+    assert by_identity["caption_tracklet_0029"]["semantic_cue_id"] == "2"
+    assert by_identity["caption_tracklet_0029"]["semantic_ids"] == []
+
+
+def test_duplicate_identity_fails_closed_and_nonaccepted_or_missing_identity_does_not_seed():
+    duplicate = event("caption_tracklet_0001", "sub_001", "We", 0.5, 1.0)
+    with pytest.raises(lifecycle.LifecycleGenerationError, match="duplicate accepted visual_event_identity"):
+        compositions([cue(1, "We")], [duplicate, {**duplicate, "event_id": "duplicate"}])
+
+    rejected = event("caption_tracklet_0002", "sub_002", "don't", 0.5, 1.0, accepted=False)
+    missing = {**event("unused", "sub_002", "don't", 0.5, 1.0), "visual_event_identity": ""}
+    assert tokens(compositions([cue(1, "We")], [duplicate, rejected, missing])) == [
+        tokens(compositions([cue(1, "We")], [duplicate]))[0]
+    ]
+
+
+def test_six_member_hierarchy_coexists_with_shared_the_and_broad_hits_yard():
+    hierarchy = [
+        event("caption_tracklet_0027", "sub_016", "before", 5.30, 6.00),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0026", "sub_017", "the", 5.30, 6.00),
+        event("continuous_visual_identity_0028", "sub_018", "sign", 5.35, 6.00),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0029", "2", "before the sign hits the yard", 5.40, 6.00),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0030", "sub_017", "the", 5.45, 6.05),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0031", "2", "before the sign hits the yard", 5.50, 6.10),
+    ]
+    rows = compositions([cue(16, "before"), cue(17, "the"), cue(18, "sign")], hierarchy)
+    current = active(rows, 5.83)
+
+    assert len(current) == 6
+    assert len({row["visual_event_identity"] for row in current}) == 6
+    assert sum(row["semantic_cue_id"] == "sub_017" for row in current) == 2
+    assert sum(row["semantic_cue_id"] == "2" for row in current) == 2
+    assert len(rows) == 1
+    assert rows[0]["relation"]["mode"] == "simultaneous"
+
+
+def test_group_window_merge_does_not_extend_first_visual_identity():
+    rows = compositions(
+        [cue(1, "first"), cue(2, "second")],
+        [
+            event("caption_tracklet_first", "sub_001", "first", 1.0, 1.1),
+            event("caption_tracklet_second", "sub_002", "second", 1.05, 2.0),
+        ],
+    )
+
+    assert rows[0]["window"] == [24, 48]
+    assert [row["window"] for row in tokens(rows)] == [[24, 26], [25, 48]]
+
+
+def test_source_visible_recovery_clones_style_without_reusing_visual_identity():
+    source = {
+        **event("caption_tracklet_0092", "sub_069", "our", 23.9, 24.1),
+        "placement": {"anchor": {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.44}},
+        "typography": {"font_height_px": 50},
+    }
+    recovered = lifecycle._source_visible_recovery_events({
+        "source_visible_recoveries": [{
+            "visual_event_identity": "source_visible_recovery_0113",
+            "style_source_visual_identity": "caption_tracklet_0092",
+            "cue_id": "sub_0068",
+            "text": "in",
+            "source_frame_window": [707, 713],
+            "bbox": [535, 805, 594, 862],
+            "evidence": [{"path": "frame.jpg", "sha256": "a" * 64, "kind": "source_frame"}],
+        }],
+    }, [source], 30.0, 1080, 1920)
+
+    assert len(recovered) == 1
+    assert recovered[0]["visual_event_identity"] == "source_visible_recovery_0113"
+    assert recovered[0]["cue_id"] == "sub_0068"
+    assert recovered[0]["text"] == recovered[0]["observed_text"] == "in"
+    assert recovered[0]["start"] == 707 / 30
+    assert recovered[0]["end"] == 713 / 30
+    assert recovered[0]["placement"]["bbox"] == [535, 805, 594, 862]
+
+
+def test_we_dont_and_two_6000_identities_remain_independent():
+    rows = compositions(
+        [cue(1, "We"), cue(2, "don't"), cue(65, "6000", ["sub_065", "sub_066"])],
+        [
+            event("caption_tracklet_0001", "sub_001", "We", 0.5, 1.0),
+            event("caption_tracklet_0002", "sub_002", "don't", 0.6, 1.0),
+            event("caption_tracklet_0088", "sub_066", "6000", 22.5, 22.8),
+            event("caption_tracklet_0089", "sub_066", "6000", 23.0, 23.4),
+        ],
+    )
+    assert {row["visual_event_identity"] for row in active(rows, 0.8)} == {
+        "caption_tracklet_0001", "caption_tracklet_0002"
+    }
+    six_thousand = [row for row in tokens(rows) if row["text"] == "6000"]
+    assert [row["visual_event_identity"] for row in six_thousand] == [
+        "caption_tracklet_0088", "caption_tracklet_0089"
+    ]
+    assert [row["window"] for row in six_thousand] == [[540, 547], [552, 562]]
+
+
+def test_social_motion_owner_and_payload_are_unchanged():
+    accepted = json.loads(
+        (Path(__file__).parents[1] / "config" / "DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_caption_motion.json")
+        .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    )
+    decision = {
+        **accepted,
+        "animation": {
+            **accepted["animation"],
+            "source_evidence_id": accepted["style_evidence_id"],
+            "source_visual_event_identity": accepted["visual_event_identity"],
+        },
+    }
+    row = tokens(compositions(
+        [cue(45, "social,")],
+        [event("caption_tracklet_0064", "sub_045", "social,", 36.5, 37.6)],
+        accepted_motion=decision,
+    ))[0]
+
+    assert row["visual_event_identity"] == "caption_tracklet_0064"
+    assert row["window"] == [359, 383]
+    assert row["accepted_motion_authority"]["keyframes"] == [
+        {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 0.080528214},
+        {"frame": 23, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 0.10833333333333332},
+    ]
+
+
+def display_authority(decisions):
+    return {
+        "schema": "video_cloner_reel_display_text_authority",
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "decisions": [
+            {
+                "visual_event_identity": identity,
+                "source_text": source_text,
+                "display_text": display_text,
+                "authority": authority,
+                "evidence": [{"path": "evidence.json", "sha256": "a" * 64, "kind": "test"}],
+            }
+            for identity, source_text, display_text, authority in decisions
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def test_reel_display_text_changes_only_configured_identity_text_and_provenance():
+    broad = "sign hits the yard. It starts with a conversation about your why. We invest in how your home shows"
+    source_events = [
+        event("caption_tracklet_0001", "sub_001", "We", 0.5, 1.0),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0002", "sub_002", "don't", 0.6, 1.0),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0027", "sub_016", "before", 5.30, 6.00),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0026", "sub_017", "the", 5.30, 6.00),
+        event("continuous_visual_identity_0028", "sub_018", "sign", 5.35, 6.00),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0029", "2", broad, 5.40, 6.00),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0030", "sub_017", "the", 5.45, 6.05),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0031", "2", broad, 5.50, 6.10),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0088", "sub_066", ",000", 22.5, 22.8),
+        event("caption_tracklet_0089", "sub_066", ",000", 23.0, 23.4),
+    ]
+    authority = display_authority([
+        ("continuous_visual_identity_0028", "sign", "sign", "confirmed_semantic_correction"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0029", broad, "hits", "confirmed_source_observed"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0031", broad, "yard", "confirmed_source_observed"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0088", ",000", "6000", "confirmed_source_observed"),
+        ("caption_tracklet_0089", ",000", "6000", "confirmed_source_observed"),
+    ])
+    cues = [cue(1, "We"), cue(2, "don't"), cue(16, "before"), cue(17, "the"), cue(18, "sign"), cue(66, ",000")]
+    baseline = {row["visual_event_identity"]: row for row in tokens(compositions(cues, source_events))}
+    actual = {row["visual_event_identity"]: row for row in tokens(compositions(cues, source_events, display_text_authority=authority))}
+
+    assert set(actual) == set(baseline)
+    assert {identity: row["window"] for identity, row in actual.items()} == {
+        identity: row["window"] for identity, row in baseline.items()
+    }
+    assert actual["caption_tracklet_0001"]["text"] == "We"
+    assert actual["caption_tracklet_0002"]["text"] == "don't"
+    hierarchy = {
+        row["visual_event_identity"]: row["text"]
+        for row in active(list(compositions(cues, source_events, display_text_authority=authority)), 5.83)
+    }
+    assert hierarchy == {
+        "caption_tracklet_0027": "before", "caption_tracklet_0026": "the",
+        "continuous_visual_identity_0028": "sign", "caption_tracklet_0029": "hits",
+        "caption_tracklet_0030": "the", "caption_tracklet_0031": "yard",
+    }
+    assert [actual[identity]["text"] for identity in ("caption_tracklet_0088", "caption_tracklet_0089")] == ["6000", "6000"]
+    configured = {row["visual_event_identity"] for row in authority["decisions"]}
+    assert {
+        identity for identity, row in actual.items() if row.get("display_text_authority")
+    } == configured
+    for identity in configured:
+        assert actual[identity]["display_text_evidence"] == [
+            {"path": "evidence.json", "sha256": "a" * 64, "kind": "test"}
+        ]
+    for identity in set(actual) - configured:
+        assert "display_text_authority" not in actual[identity]
+        assert "display_text_evidence" not in actual[identity]
+
+
+def test_display_text_authority_fails_closed_for_stale_or_unknown_identity():
+    source = event("caption_tracklet_0029", "2", "broad phrase", 5.4, 6.0)
+    stale = display_authority([
+        ("caption_tracklet_0029", "different phrase", "hits", "confirmed_source_observed")
+    ])
+    with pytest.raises(lifecycle.LifecycleGenerationError, match="stale display text decision"):
+        compositions([], [source], display_text_authority=stale)
+
+    unknown = display_authority([
+        ("caption_tracklet_9999", "missing", "missing", "confirmed_source_observed")
+    ])
+    with pytest.raises(lifecycle.LifecycleGenerationError, match="not an accepted visual event"):
+        compositions([], [source], display_text_authority=unknown)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.davinci import compile_davinci_textplus_fcpxml as canonical
+from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_textplus import (
+    StandaloneTextplusError,
+    render_visual_compositions,
+    resolve_visual_style_authority,
+)
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]
+STYLE = ROOT / "data" / "DcJRJtUKScu" / "analysis" / "DcJRJtUKScu_caption_style.json"
+
+
+def _token(token_id: str, text: str, semantic_ids: list[str], window: list[int], event_id: str) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "token_id": token_id,
+        "visual_event_identity": "test_" + token_id.removeprefix("visual_token_"),
+        "text": text,
+        "semantic_ids": semantic_ids,
+        "window": window,
+        "style_evidence_id": event_id,
+    }
+
+
+def test_reel2_exact_visual_style_authority_compiles_without_reset_or_rematch(monkeypatch):
+    style_data = json.loads(STYLE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    compositions = [
+        {
+            "composition_id": "visual_composition_sub_004",
+            "window": [20, 24],
+            "authority": {"kind": "transcript_fallback", "evidence_ids": ["style_event_sub_0004"]},
+            "tokens": [_token("visual_token_sub_004", "list", ["sub_004"], [20, 24], "style_event_sub_0004")],
+        },
+        {
+            "composition_id": "visual_composition_sub_061__sub_062",
+            "window": [493, 514],
+            "relation": {"mode": "simultaneous", "predecessor_token_ids": []},
+            "authority": {"kind": "visual_primary", "evidence_ids": ["style_event_sub_0061", "style_event_sub_0062"]},
+            "tokens": [
+                _token("visual_token_sub_061", "calling", ["sub_061"], [493, 514], "style_event_sub_0061"),
+                _token("visual_token_sub_062", "and", ["sub_062"], [493, 514], "style_event_sub_0062"),
+            ],
+        },
+        {
+            "composition_id": "visual_composition_sub_065",
+            "window": [542, 554],
+            "authority": {"kind": "visual_primary", "evidence_ids": ["style_event_sub_0066"]},
+            "tokens": [_token("visual_token_sub_065", "6000", ["sub_065", "sub_066"], [542, 554], "style_event_sub_0066")],
+        },
+    ]
+    cues, info = render_visual_compositions(
+        compositions, ["sub_004", "sub_061", "sub_062", "sub_065", "sub_066"], 24.0
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(canonical, "score_style_event_for_cue", lambda *_args, **_kwargs: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("heuristic rematch")))
+    cue_styles, count = resolve_visual_style_authority(cues, style_data, 24.0)
+    xml = canonical.build_caption_only_fcpxml(
+        cues, canonical.extract_style_contract(style_data), cue_styles, 24.0, 1080, 1920,
+        "STEP3", "VC Caption", "1.10", canonical.DEFAULT_BASIC_TITLE_UID, 1, "reset", 0.0, 0.0,
+    )
+    titles = ET.fromstring(xml).findall(".//title")
+    compiled = {
+        title.find("text/text-style").text: (
+            title.find("adjust-transform").attrib["position"],
+            title.find("text-style-def/text-style").attrib,
+        )
+        for title in titles
+    }
+
+    assert info["semantic_coverage_exact"] is True
+    assert count == 4
+    assert [(cue["text"], cue["start_frame"], cue["end_frame"]) for cue in cues[1:3]] == [
+        ("calling", 493, 514), ("and", 493, 514)
+    ]
+    assert compiled["list"][0] == "28.512 183.936"
+    assert compiled["6000"][0] == "-12.960 459.840"
+    assert compiled["calling"][0] == "-201.960 -23.232"
+    assert compiled["and"][0] == "-213.516 -30.336"
+    assert compiled["calling"][1]["alignment"] == compiled["and"][1]["alignment"] == "left"
+    assert compiled["list"][1]["alignment"] == compiled["6000"][1]["alignment"] == "center"
+
+    expected = {
+        "list": (68, "#f8f4f2", "#3d2924", 4.0, "#3d2924", 0.85, 2.0),
+        "6000": (295, "#f6d19e", "#061312", 22.0, "#061312", 0.85, 2.0),
+        "calling": (124, "#f5f3f1", "#291914", 7.0, "#291914", 0.85, 2.0),
+        "and": (103, "#f6f5f5", "#291711", 6.0, "#291711", 0.85, 2.0),
+    }
+    for cue in cues:
+        contract = cue_styles[cue["index"]]
+        assert contract["matched_style_event_id"] == cue["style_evidence_id"]
+        assert (
+            contract["font_size_px"], contract["fill"], contract["outline"], contract["outline_px"],
+            contract["shadow"], contract["shadow_opacity"], contract["shadow_px"],
+        ) == expected[cue["text"]]
+        assert contract["bold"] is True
+        assert contract["font_name"] == contract["renderer_font_fallback"] == "Arial"
+        assert contract["font_family_authority"] == "unresolved"
+        assert contract["unresolved_style_properties"] == [
+            "font_family", "static_scale", "glow", "semantic_emphasis"
+        ]
+
+
+def test_alignment_defaults_to_center_when_authority_is_absent_or_invalid():
+    base = {
+        "font_name": "Arial", "font_size_px": 60, "fill_fcpxml": "1 1 1 1", "bold": False,
+        "italic": False, "outline_fcpxml": "0 0 0 1", "outline_px": 2,
+        "shadow_fcpxml": "0 0 0 0.85", "shadow_px": 2,
+    }
+    assert 'alignment=\"center\"' in canonical.fcpxml_text_style_attrs(base)
+    assert 'alignment=\"center\"' in canonical.fcpxml_text_style_attrs({**base, "alignment": "diagonal"})
+
+
+def test_missing_direct_style_evidence_fails_closed():
+    cue = {
+        "id": "visual_token_sub_004", "index": 1, "text": "list",
+        "source_cue_ids": ["sub_004"], "style_evidence_id": "missing_event",
+    }
+    with pytest.raises(StandaloneTextplusError, match="missing or unaccepted"):
+        resolve_visual_style_authority([cue], {"caption_style_events": []}, 24.0)
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_color_opacity.py b/tests/test_standalone_color_opacity.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2cde8c8f62c5037a8085de5a6f68e15a5c05ee5a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_color_opacity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_color_opacity as inference
+
+
+def _observation(foreground, alpha, background):
+    foreground = np.asarray(foreground, dtype=float) / 255.0
+    background = np.asarray(background, dtype=float) / 255.0
+    observed = inference.linear_to_bt709(
+        alpha * inference.bt709_to_linear(foreground)
+        + (1.0 - alpha) * inference.bt709_to_linear(background)
+    )
+    return {
+        "accepted": True,
+        "fill_rgb": observed.tolist(),
+        "background_rgb": background.tolist(),
+        "trusted_fill_pixel_count": 100,
+    }
+
+
+def test_opaque_and_semitransparent_colors_are_recovered_in_linear_light():
+    backgrounds = ([20, 40, 60], [90, 30, 120], [180, 150, 40], [30, 170, 150])
+    foreground = [224, 92, 38]
+    opaque = inference.infer_fill_color_opacity(_observation(foreground, 1.0, bg) for bg in backgrounds)
+    translucent = inference.infer_fill_color_opacity(_observation(foreground, 0.7, bg) for bg in backgrounds)
+
+    assert opaque["fill"]["status"] == "AUTHORITATIVE_FILL_COLOR"
+    assert max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(opaque["fill"]["color_rgb"], foreground)) <= 1
+    assert abs(opaque["opacity"]["opacity"] - 1.0) <= 0.01
+    assert max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(translucent["fill"]["color_rgb"], foreground)) <= 1
+    assert abs(translucent["opacity"]["opacity"] - 0.7) <= 0.01
+
+
+def test_antialiased_boundary_does_not_reduce_opaque_style_opacity():
+    mask = np.zeros((50, 90), np.uint8)
+    mask[10:40, 25:65] = 1
+    boundary = cv2.dilate(mask, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)).astype(bool) & ~mask.astype(bool)
+    rows = []
+    for background in ((20, 40, 60), (100, 20, 90), (180, 130, 20)):
+        crop = np.full((50, 90, 3), background[::-1], np.uint8)
+        crop[boundary] = np.rint((np.asarray(background[::-1]) + np.asarray((240, 240, 240))) / 2).astype(np.uint8)
+        crop[mask.astype(bool)] = (240, 240, 240)
+        rows.append(inference.sample_fill_observation(crop, mask))
+    result = inference.infer_fill_color_opacity(rows)
+
+    assert result["opacity"]["status"] == "AUTHORITATIVE_OPACITY"
+    assert result["opacity"]["opacity"] >= 0.99
+
+
+def test_foreign_and_unknown_pixels_are_excluded_from_fill_authority():
+    mask = np.zeros((40, 80), bool)
+    mask[8:32, 20:60] = True
+    foreign = np.zeros_like(mask)
+    foreign[8:32, 20:40] = True
+    unknown = np.zeros_like(mask)
+    unknown[8:32, 40:48] = True
+    crop = np.full((40, 80, 3), (30, 30, 30), np.uint8)
+    crop[mask] = (220, 220, 220)
+    crop[foreign] = (0, 0, 255)
+    crop[unknown] = (0, 255, 0)
+
+    sample = inference.sample_fill_observation(crop, mask, foreign_mask=foreign, unknown_mask=unknown)
+
+    assert sample["accepted"] is True
+    assert sample["fill_rgb"] == [round(220 / 255, 8)] * 3
+    assert sample["trusted_fill_pixel_count"] < int(mask.sum())
+
+
+def test_single_background_is_explicitly_underdetermined():
+    result = inference.infer_fill_color_opacity([_observation([240, 240, 240], 0.5, [30, 40, 50])])
+
+    assert result["fill"]["status"] == "PROVISIONAL_FILL_COLOR"
+    assert result["opacity"] == {
+        "status": "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_OPACITY",
+        "opacity": None,
+        "reason": "insufficient_independent_background_variation",
+    }
+
+
+def test_stroke_color_respects_frozen_step2c_authority_ceiling():
+    rows = [
+        {"accepted": True, "stroke_rgb": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], "stroke_pixel_count": 20},
+        {"accepted": True, "stroke_rgb": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], "stroke_pixel_count": 22},
+    ]
+
+    result = inference.infer_stroke_color(
+        rows, upstream_status="PROVISIONAL_STROKE_INFERENCE", upstream_present=True,
+    )
+
+    assert result["status"] == "PROVISIONAL_STROKE_COLOR"
+    assert result["color_rgb"] == [26, 51, 76]
+    assert inference.infer_stroke_color([], upstream_status="PROVISIONAL_NO_STROKE_INFERENCE", upstream_present=False)["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE"
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_composition_relationships.py b/tests/test_standalone_composition_relationships.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..0ed69fe6ea33769e3301c15f2b2997b4c3f21674
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_composition_relationships.py
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+import numpy as np
+
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_composition_relationships as relationships
+
+
+def _kinds(rows):
+    return {row["relationship_type"]: row for row in rows}
+
+
+def _mask(height, width, top=0, bottom=None, left=0, right=None):
+    value = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=bool)
+    value[top:bottom, left:right] = True
+    return value
+
+
+def test_same_baseline_and_known_offset_use_visible_glyph_geometry():
+    same = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{
+        "frame": 1,
+        "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 30], "a_mask": _mask(30, 20, top=10),
+        "b_bbox": [30, 0, 50, 30], "b_mask": _mask(30, 20, top=2),
+    }])
+    offset = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{
+        "frame": 1,
+        "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 30], "a_mask": _mask(30, 20, top=10),
+        "b_bbox": [30, 5, 50, 35], "b_mask": _mask(30, 20, top=2),
+    }])
+
+    assert _kinds(same)["SAME_BASELINE"]["measurement"]["source_pixels"] == 0
+    assert _kinds(same)["SAME_BASELINE"]["measurement"]["typographic_baseline_exact"] is False
+    assert _kinds(offset)["BASELINE_OFFSET"]["measurement"]["source_pixels"] == 5
+
+
+def test_horizontal_glyph_gap_and_mask_overlap_are_measured():
+    gap = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{
+        "frame": 2,
+        "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "a_mask": _mask(20, 20, left=2, right=18),
+        "b_bbox": [25, 0, 45, 20], "b_mask": _mask(20, 20, left=2, right=18),
+    }])
+    overlap = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{
+        "frame": 3,
+        "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "a_mask": _mask(20, 20, left=5),
+        "b_bbox": [10, 0, 30, 20], "b_mask": _mask(20, 20, right=15),
+    }])
+
+    assert _kinds(gap)["HORIZONTAL_GAP"]["measurement"]["source_pixels"] == 9
+    assert _kinds(overlap)["OVERLAPS"]["measurement"]["median_overlap_area_source_px"] == 200
+
+
+def test_intersecting_bboxes_without_common_mask_pixels_do_not_invent_overlap():
+    rows = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{
+        "frame": 4,
+        "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "a_mask": _mask(20, 20, left=0, right=8),
+        "b_bbox": [5, 0, 25, 20], "b_mask": _mask(20, 20, left=10, right=20),
+    }])
+
+    assert "OVERLAPS" not in _kinds(rows)
+
+
+def test_z_order_requires_directional_ownership_and_otherwise_fails_closed():
+    base = {"frame": 5, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [10, 0, 30, 20], "overlap_area_px": 12, "overlap_ratio": 0.1}
+    known = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [{**base, "front_identity": "b"}])
+    unknown = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [base])
+
+    assert _kinds(known)["Z_ORDER"]["source_identity"] == "b"
+    assert "Z_ORDER_UNRESOLVED" not in _kinds(known)
+    assert _kinds(unknown)["Z_ORDER_UNRESOLVED"]["authority"] == "UNRESOLVED"
+
+
+def test_physical_word_preserves_members_and_nearby_unrelated_items_stay_separate():
+    identities = [
+        {"identity": "fragment_a", "observations": [{"source_frame": 1, "bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "accepted": True}]},
+        {"identity": "fragment_b", "observations": [{"source_frame": 1, "bbox": [20, 0, 40, 20], "accepted": True}]},
+        {"identity": "nearby", "observations": [{"source_frame": 1, "bbox": [42, 0, 62, 20], "accepted": True}]},
+    ]
+    graph = relationships.build_composition_graph(
+        identities,
+        {"fragment_a": "hint_one", "fragment_b": "hint_two", "nearby": "hint_three"},
+        [{"joint_evidence_available": True, "member_identities": ["fragment_a", "fragment_b"]}],
+    )
+
+    assert graph["compositions"] == [{
+        "composition_id": "composition_0001",
+        "member_identities": ["fragment_a", "fragment_b"],
+        "visible_source_frame_range": [1, 1],
+        "supporting_frames": [1],
+        "authority": "SOURCE_DERIVED_MEMBERSHIP",
+    }]
+    assert "nearby" in graph["standalone_identities"]
+    assert "PHYSICAL_WORD_FRAGMENT" in _kinds(graph["relationships"])
+
+
+def test_changing_spacing_is_time_varying_not_static_average():
+    rows = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("a", "b", [
+        {"frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [25, 0, 45, 20]},
+        {"frame": 2, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 20, 20], "b_bbox": [60, 0, 80, 20]},
+    ])
+    gap = _kinds(rows)["HORIZONTAL_GAP"]
+
+    assert gap["consistency"] == "ANIMATED_OR_TIME_VARYING_RELATIONSHIP"
+    assert gap["measurement"]["spread_source_pixels"] == 35
+
+
+def test_vertical_composition_is_reported_without_renderer_coordinates():
+    rows = relationships.infer_pair_relationships("top", "bottom", [{
+        "frame": 1, "a_bbox": [0, 0, 40, 20], "b_bbox": [0, 30, 40, 50],
+    }])
+
+    assert _kinds(rows)["ABOVE"]["source_identity"] == "top"
+    assert _kinds(rows)["VERTICAL_GAP"]["measurement"]["source_pixels"] == 10
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_fcpxml.py b/tests/test_standalone_fcpxml.py
index af0262cdfe73993dbe2f3040e7d60863e3c0326d..69a20319631ef0c59bcb0148a31d8091efd9f01a 100644

+++ b/tests/test_standalone_fcpxml.py
@@ -100,6 +100,23 @@ def test_generic_commands_compile_to_cut_only_fcpxml(tmp_path: Path):
     assert asset.attrib["src"] == canonical.path_to_file_url(str(video.resolve()))
 
 
+def test_cut_only_audio_is_emitted_without_caption_titles(tmp_path: Path):
+    generic, video, output, report_path = _fixture(tmp_path)
+    audio = tmp_path / "source.wav"
+    audio.write_bytes(b"audio")
+    data = json.loads(generic.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    data["source"]["source_audio"] = str(audio)
+    generic.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    report = compile_fcpxml(generic, output, report_path, audio_path=audio)
+    root = ET.parse(output).getroot()
+    assert report["structure"]["clip_count"] == 3
+    assert report["structure"]["audio_asset_count"] == 1
+    assert report["structure"]["caption_count"] == 0
+    assert root.findall(".//title") == []
+    assert len(root.findall(".//asset-clip")) == 4
+
+
 def test_clip_timing_and_order_match_generic_frames(tmp_path: Path):
     generic, _, output, report = _fixture(tmp_path)
     compile_fcpxml(generic, output, report)
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_font_inference.py b/tests/test_standalone_font_inference.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..035214c07ce6a8de511f2fbb7a461af32b95a1a3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_font_inference.py
@@ -0,0 +1,226 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_font_inference as inference
+
+
+FONTS = Path(r"C:\Windows\Fonts")
+
+
+def test_source_visible_scoring_text_uses_bbox_linkage_not_transcript_text():
+    evidence = {"text": "long transcript sentence", "observations": [{"accepted": True, "timestamp": 2.0, "bbox": [10, 20, 80, 50]}]}
+    events = [{"event_id": "visual_1", "observed_text": "visible", "text": "long transcript sentence", "start": 1.5, "end": 2.5, "observations": [{"bbox": [11, 20, 79, 50]}]}]
+
+    result = inference.source_visible_scoring_text(evidence, events)
+
+    assert result["text"] == "visible"
+    assert result["authority"] == "SOURCE_VISIBLE_OBSERVED_TEXT_BBOX_MATCH"
+
+
+def test_source_pixel_authority_precedes_bbox_ocr_linkage_and_can_fail_closed():
+    evidence = {
+        "font_scoring_text_authority": {
+            "text": None,
+            "visual_text": "partial transition fragment",
+            "authority": "SOURCE_VISIBLE_PIXELS_BOUNDED_LINKAGE_DECISION",
+            "reason": "fragment_has_no_full_word_scoring_authority",
+        },
+        "observations": [{"accepted": True, "timestamp": 2.0, "bbox": [10, 20, 80, 50]}],
+    }
+    events = [{"event_id": "ocr", "observed_text": "unrelated transcript", "start": 1.5, "end": 2.5, "placement": {"bbox": [10, 20, 80, 50]}}]
+
+    assert inference.source_visible_scoring_text(evidence, events) == evidence["font_scoring_text_authority"]
+
+
+def test_source_visible_scoring_text_fails_closed_when_bbox_match_is_ambiguous():
+    evidence = {"observations": [{"accepted": True, "timestamp": 2.0, "bbox": [10, 20, 80, 50]}]}
+    events = [
+        {"event_id": "a", "observed_text": "one", "start": 1.5, "end": 2.5, "observations": [{"bbox": [10, 20, 80, 50]}]},
+        {"event_id": "b", "observed_text": "two", "start": 1.5, "end": 2.5, "observations": [{"bbox": [10, 20, 80, 50]}]},
+    ]
+
+    assert inference.source_visible_scoring_text(evidence, events)["reason"] == "ambiguous_source_visible_text_bbox_match"
+
+
+def test_uniform_mask_comparison_preserves_aspect_and_rejects_non_uniform_fit():
+    source = inference.render_text_mask("sign", FONTS / "ariblk.ttf")
+    candidate = inference.render_text_mask("sign", FONTS / "arial.ttf")
+
+    result = inference.compare_masks(source, candidate)
+
+    assert result["non_uniform_scale_ratio"] == 1.0
+    assert result["final_height"] == source.shape[0]
+    assert result["candidate_aspect_ratio"] == round(candidate.shape[1] / candidate.shape[0], 6)
+
+
+def test_candidate_ranking_is_deterministic_and_prefers_matching_glyphs():
+    fonts = [
+        {"family": "Arial", "style": "Bold", "weight": "Bold", "path": FONTS / "arialbd.ttf", "renderer_compatible": True},
+        {"family": "Ink Free", "style": "Regular", "weight": "Regular", "path": FONTS / "Inkfree.ttf", "renderer_compatible": True},
+    ]
+    source = inference.render_text_mask("buyers", FONTS / "arialbd.ttf")
+
+    first = inference.rank_font_candidates("buyers", source, fonts)
+    second = inference.rank_font_candidates("buyers", source, list(reversed(fonts)))
+
+    assert [(row["family"], row["style"], row["score"]) for row in first] == [
+        (row["family"], row["style"], row["score"]) for row in second
+    ]
+    assert first[0]["family"] == "Arial"
+    assert first[0]["score"] > first[1]["score"]
+
+
+def test_source_mask_reports_low_confidence_instead_of_fabricating_empty_evidence():
+    mask, confidence = inference.source_text_mask(np.zeros((40, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8), "#ffffff")
+
+    assert mask.shape == (1, 1)
+    assert confidence == 0.0
+
+
+def test_symbol_font_without_real_text_glyphs_is_rejected():
+    assert inference.font_supports_text(FONTS / "arial.ttf", "sign") is True
+    assert inference.font_supports_text(FONTS / "segmdl2.ttf", "sign") is False
+
+
+def test_weak_real_world_score_fails_closed_as_unresolved():
+    authority, confidence = inference.authority_classification(
+        [{"score": 0.48}, {"score": 0.47}], 0.95
+    )
+
+    assert (authority, confidence) == ("UNRESOLVED_FONT_STYLE", "LOW")
+
+
+def test_multi_frame_aggregation_is_order_independent_and_rejects_contamination():
+    clean = inference.render_text_mask("hits", FONTS / "arial.ttf")
+    corrupt = np.ones((clean.shape[0], clean.shape[1] * 2), dtype=bool)
+    rows = [
+        {"frame": frame, "timestamp": frame / 24, "bbox": [0, 0, clean.shape[1], clean.shape[0]],
+         "mask": clean, "foreground_confidence": 0.8, "contamination_score": 0.05,
+         "overlap_risk": 0.0, "blur_quality": 0.9, "accepted": True, "reason": "accepted"}
+        for frame in (1, 2, 3)
+    ] + [{"frame": 4, "timestamp": 4 / 24, "bbox": [0, 0, corrupt.shape[1], corrupt.shape[0]],
+          "mask": corrupt, "foreground_confidence": 0.9, "contamination_score": 0.95,
+          "overlap_risk": 0.9, "blur_quality": 0.9, "accepted": True, "reason": "accepted"}]
+
+    first = inference.aggregate_source_masks(rows)
+    second = inference.aggregate_source_masks(reversed(rows))
+
+    assert np.array_equal(first["mask"], second["mask"])
+    assert first["usable_frame_count"] == 3
+    assert first["status"] == "CLEAN_MULTI_FRAME_EVIDENCE"
+    assert inference.compare_masks(first["mask"], clean)["iou"] > 0.95
+
+
+def test_tristate_evidence_is_deterministic_and_unknown_has_no_score_authority():
+    foreground = np.zeros((8, 12), dtype=bool)
+    foreground[2:6, 2:5] = True
+    unknown = np.zeros_like(foreground)
+    unknown[2:6, 7:10] = True
+    background = ~(foreground | unknown)
+    clean = foreground.copy()
+    mismatch_only_unknown = foreground | unknown
+    mismatch_known = foreground.copy()
+    mismatch_known[0, 0] = True
+    mismatch_foreground = foreground.copy()
+    mismatch_foreground[2, 2] = False
+
+    clean_score = inference.compare_known_regions(foreground, background, unknown, clean)
+    unknown_score = inference.compare_known_regions(foreground, background, unknown, mismatch_only_unknown)
+    known_score = inference.compare_known_regions(foreground, background, unknown, mismatch_known)
+    foreground_score = inference.compare_known_regions(foreground, background, unknown, mismatch_foreground)
+
+    assert clean_score == unknown_score
+    assert known_score["score"] < clean_score["score"]
+    assert foreground_score["score"] < clean_score["score"]
+    assert foreground_score["foreground_mismatch_count"] == 1
+    assert known_score["background_mismatch_count"] == 1
+    assert unknown_score["unknown_pixel_count"] == int(unknown.sum())
+
+
+def test_overlap_pixels_remain_unknown_and_residual_strip_reduces_confidence():
+    glyph = np.zeros((20, 40), dtype=bool)
+    glyph[4:17, 8:14] = True
+    overlap = np.zeros_like(glyph)
+    overlap[:, 10:18] = True
+    clean_rows = [
+        {"frame": frame, "timestamp": frame / 24, "bbox": [0, 0, 40, 20], "mask": glyph,
+         "unknown_mask": overlap, "foreground_confidence": 0.8, "contamination_score": 0.05,
+         "overlap_risk": 0.2, "blur_quality": 0.9, "accepted": True, "reason": "accepted"}
+        for frame in (1, 2, 3)
+    ]
+    strip = glyph.copy()
+    strip[1:2, :] = True
+    strip_rows = [{**row, "mask": strip, "unknown_mask": np.zeros_like(strip)} for row in clean_rows]
+
+    clean = inference.aggregate_source_masks(clean_rows)
+    contaminated = inference.aggregate_source_masks(strip_rows)
+
+    assert np.array_equal(clean["unknown_mask"], inference.aggregate_source_masks(reversed(clean_rows))["unknown_mask"])
+    assert clean["unknown_mask"].any()
+    assert not np.logical_and(clean["foreground_mask"], clean["unknown_mask"]).any()
+    assert contaminated["artifact_penalty"] > 0
+    assert contaminated["confidence"] < inference.aggregate_source_masks([
+        {**row, "unknown_mask": np.zeros_like(glyph)} for row in clean_rows
+    ])["confidence"]
+
+
+def test_known_region_gate_fails_closed_without_discriminative_foreground():
+    empty = np.zeros((20, 40), dtype=bool)
+
+    passed, reason = inference.known_region_evidence_gate(
+        empty, ~empty, empty, usable_frame_count=3
+    )
+
+    assert passed is False
+    assert reason == "insufficient_known_foreground_pixels"
+    assert inference.known_region_ranking_authority(
+        [], evidence_gate_passed=passed, evidence_gate_reason=reason,
+        evidence_classification="CONTAMINATED_EVIDENCE", unknown_ratio=0.0,
+    ) == ("NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING", reason)
+
+
+def test_known_region_font_ranking_is_deterministic():
+    source = inference.render_text_mask("sign", FONTS / "arial.ttf")
+    foreground = np.pad(source, 4)
+    unknown = np.zeros_like(foreground)
+    background = ~foreground
+    fonts = [
+        {"family": "Arial", "style": "Regular", "weight": "Regular", "path": FONTS / "arial.ttf", "renderer_compatible": True},
+        {"family": "Arial", "style": "Bold", "weight": "Bold", "path": FONTS / "arialbd.ttf", "renderer_compatible": True},
+    ]
+
+    first, first_count = inference.rank_font_candidates_known_regions("sign", foreground, background, unknown, fonts)
+    second, second_count = inference.rank_font_candidates_known_regions("sign", foreground, background, unknown, list(reversed(fonts)))
+
+    assert first == second
+    assert first_count == second_count == 2
+    assert first[0]["family"] == "Arial"
+
+
+def test_known_region_coarse_shortlist_retains_full_pool_winner():
+    fonts = inference.discover_installed_fonts()
+    source = inference.render_text_mask("sign", FONTS / "impact.ttf")
+    foreground = np.pad(source, 12)
+    unknown = np.zeros_like(foreground)
+    background = ~foreground
+    full_pool = []
+    for font in fonts:
+        if not inference.font_supports_text(font["path"], "sign"):
+            continue
+        try:
+            mask = inference.render_text_mask("sign", font["path"])
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+        full_pool.append((
+            -float(inference.compare_known_regions(foreground, background, unknown, mask)["score"]),
+            str(font["family"]).casefold(), str(font["style"]).casefold(),
+        ))
+    expected = min(full_pool)[1:]
+
+    ranking, compared = inference.rank_font_candidates_known_regions(
+        "sign", foreground, background, unknown, list(reversed(fonts)),
+    )
+
+    assert compared == 16
+    assert (ranking[0]["family"].casefold(), ranking[0]["style"].casefold()) == expected

diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_textplus_size_contract.py b/tests/test_standalone_textplus_size_contract.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bf80369dda5e0ba91d00c2e6861eb1d455220e49
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_textplus_size_contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_textplus import (
+    _ensure_textplus_size,
+    apply_static_style_authority,
+    attach_independent_style_evidence_contract,
+)
+
+
+def test_textplus_size_contract_fills_heuristic_style_and_preserves_static_size():
+    heuristic = {"font_size_px": 88}
+    large = {"font_size_px": 295}
+    static = {"font_size_px": 78, "textplus_size": 0.10833333333333332}
+
+    _ensure_textplus_size(heuristic, 1080)
+    _ensure_textplus_size(large, 1080)
+    _ensure_textplus_size(static, 1080)
+
+    assert heuristic["textplus_size"] == 0.12222222222222223
+    assert large["textplus_size"] == 0.4097222222222222
+    assert static["textplus_size"] == 0.10833333333333332
+
+
+def test_static_style_authority_preserves_identity_and_serializes_geometry_font_stroke_and_z_order():
+    cue = {
+        "index": 1,
+        "visual_event_identity": "fragment_a",
+        "lane": 1,
+        "static_style": {
+            "visual_event_identity": "fragment_a",
+            "font_name": "Arial Black",
+            "font_authority": "BEST_AVAILABLE_FONT_MATCH",
+            "font_size_px": 110,
+            "bold": True,
+            "normalized_bbox": [0.25, 0.20, 0.50, 0.30],
+            "fill": "#f0c090",
+            "fill_opacity": 0.8,
+            "stroke_enabled": True,
+            "stroke_width_px": 5,
+            "stroke_color": "#101010",
+            "static_z_order": 4,
+            "static_rotation_degrees": -2.0,
+        },
+    }
+    style = {
+        "font_name": "Arial",
+        "font_size_px": 60,
+        "bold": False,
+        "fill": "#ffffff",
+        "outline": "#000000",
+        "outline_px": 1.0,
+        "placement": {"normalized_bbox": [0.0, 0.0, 0.1, 0.1]},
+    }
+
+    assert apply_static_style_authority([cue], {1: style}, 1080) == 1
+    assert cue["visual_event_identity"] == "fragment_a"
+    assert cue["lane"] == 6
+    assert style["font_name"] == "Arial Black"
+    assert style["font_size_px"] == 110
+    assert style["anchor"] == {"x": 0.375, "y": 0.25}
+    assert style["outline_px"] == 5.0
+    assert style["fill_fcpxml"].endswith(" 0.8")
+    assert style["static_rotation_degrees"] == -2.0
+
+
+def test_style_evidence_is_identity_owned_even_inside_a_composition_or_fragment_group():
+    cues = [
+        {"index": 1, "id": "a", "visual_event_identity": "a", "static_style": {"fragment_group": "buyers"}},
+        {"index": 2, "id": "b", "visual_event_identity": "b", "static_style": {"fragment_group": "buyers"}},
+        {"index": 3, "id": "c", "visual_event_identity": "c"},
+    ]
+    styles = {1: {}, 2: {}, 3: {}}
+
+    attach_independent_style_evidence_contract(cues, styles)
+
+    assert [styles[index]["style_evidence_owner"] for index in styles] == ["a", "b", "c"]
+    assert all(styles[index]["style_sharing_authority"] == "independent_by_default" for index in styles)
+    assert cues[0]["physical_word_group_id"] == cues[1]["physical_word_group_id"] == "buyers"
+    assert "physical_word_group_id" not in cues[2]
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_thickness_stroke.py b/tests/test_standalone_thickness_stroke.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..de01222b87c335ae2a3b56c9958a8b7e526f949b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_thickness_stroke.py
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_font_inference as fonts
+from scripts.standalone import video_cloner_thickness_stroke as inference
+
+
+FONTS = Path(r"C:\Windows\Fonts")
+
+
+def test_thickness_responds_to_controlled_width_and_real_bold_weight():
+    thin = np.zeros((40, 40), dtype=bool)
+    thick = np.zeros_like(thin)
+    thin[5:35, 18:21] = True
+    thick[5:35, 16:23] = True
+
+    assert inference.measure_glyph_thickness(thick)["median_px"] > inference.measure_glyph_thickness(thin)["median_px"]
+    regular = fonts.render_text_mask("sample", FONTS / "arial.ttf")
+    bold = fonts.render_text_mask("sample", FONTS / "arialbd.ttf")
+    assert inference.measure_glyph_thickness(bold)["median_px"] > inference.measure_glyph_thickness(regular)["median_px"]
+
+
+def test_controlled_outline_is_detected_and_uniform_background_is_not():
+    fill = np.zeros((90, 180), dtype=bool)
+    fill[25:65, 55:125] = True
+    background = np.full((90, 180, 3), (110, 120, 130), np.uint8)
+    no_stroke = background.copy()
+    no_stroke[fill] = (245, 245, 245)
+    ring = cv2.dilate(fill.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((7, 7), np.uint8)).astype(bool) & ~fill
+    stroked = background.copy()
+    stroked[ring] = (12, 20, 28)
+    stroked[fill] = (245, 245, 245)
+
+    detected = inference.detect_outline_observation(stroked, fill)
+    absent = inference.detect_outline_observation(no_stroke, fill)
+
+    assert detected["present"] is True
+    assert 2 <= detected["width_px"] <= 5
+    assert absent["present"] is False
+
+
+def test_single_pixel_antialias_ring_is_not_promoted_to_stroke():
+    fill = np.zeros((90, 180), dtype=bool)
+    fill[25:65, 55:125] = True
+    frame = np.full((90, 180, 3), (110, 120, 130), np.uint8)
+    antialias = cv2.dilate(fill.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)).astype(bool) & ~fill
+    frame[antialias] = (180, 185, 190)
+    frame[fill] = (245, 245, 245)
+
+    result = inference.detect_outline_observation(frame, fill)
+
+    assert result["width_px"] == 1
+    assert result["present"] is None
+    assert result["reason"] == "anti_aliasing_background_or_shadow_ambiguity"
+
+
+def test_unknown_pixels_never_create_positive_stroke_evidence():
+    fill = np.zeros((90, 180), dtype=bool)
+    fill[25:65, 55:125] = True
+    frame = np.full((90, 180, 3), (110, 120, 130), np.uint8)
+    ring = cv2.dilate(fill.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((7, 7), np.uint8)).astype(bool) & ~fill
+    frame[ring] = (12, 20, 28)
+    frame[fill] = (245, 245, 245)
+
+    result = inference.detect_outline_observation(frame, fill, unknown_mask=ring)
+
+    assert result["present"] is not True
+    assert result.get("unknown_edge_pixel_count", int(ring.sum())) > 0
+
+
+def test_foreign_identity_projection_removes_false_stroke_authority():
+    fill = np.zeros((90, 180), dtype=bool)
+    fill[25:65, 55:125] = True
+    frame = np.full((90, 180, 3), (110, 120, 130), np.uint8)
+    foreign = cv2.dilate(fill.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((7, 7), np.uint8)).astype(bool) & ~fill
+    frame[foreign] = (245, 245, 245)
+    frame[fill] = (20, 30, 40)
+    projected = inference.project_bbox_to_crop((100, 200, 280, 290), (150, 220, 230, 270), fill.shape)
+    ownership = inference.build_crop_ownership(fill, [foreign], [projected])
+
+    raw = inference.detect_outline_observation(frame, fill)
+    filtered = inference.detect_outline_observation(
+        frame, fill, ownership["FOREIGN_IDENTITY"] | ownership["UNKNOWN_OR_OCCLUDED"],
+    )
+
+    assert raw["present"] is True
+    assert filtered["present"] is not True
+    assert not np.any(ownership["FOREIGN_IDENTITY"] & ownership["TARGET_OWNED"])
+    assert not np.any(ownership["UNKNOWN_OR_OCCLUDED"] & ownership["TARGET_OWNED"])
+    assert np.all(
+        ownership["TARGET_OWNED"]
+        | ownership["FOREIGN_IDENTITY"]
+        | ownership["UNKNOWN_OR_OCCLUDED"]
+        | ownership["USABLE_BACKGROUND"]
+    )
+
+
+def test_missing_structure_fails_closed():
+    empty = np.zeros((20, 40), dtype=bool)
+
+    result = inference.infer_thickness(
+        empty, empty, "Regular", font_authority="NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FONT_RANKING",
+        evidence_classification="INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", mask_confidence=0.0,
+    )
+
+    assert result["status"] == "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_THICKNESS_INFERENCE"
+    assert result["observed_visual_weight_category"] is None
+    assert inference.aggregate_outline_observations([])["status"] == "NO_AUTHORITATIVE_STROKE_INFERENCE"
diff --git a/tests/test_step4b_resolve_caption_animation_adapter.py b/tests/test_step4b_resolve_caption_animation_adapter.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2d4841deb4ef51f84ba99ebbfe44ce97e7f17373
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_step4b_resolve_caption_animation_adapter.py
@@ -0,0 +1,183 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]
+MODULE_PATH = ROOT / "resolve_workspace" / "resolve_apply_caption_animation_step_3C.py"
+PREVIOUS_AUTORUN = os.environ.get("VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN")
+os.environ["VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN"] = "1"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("step4b_caption_animation", MODULE_PATH)
+assert SPEC is not None and SPEC.loader is not None
+MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+try:
+    SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)
+finally:
+    if PREVIOUS_AUTORUN is None:
+        os.environ.pop("VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN", None)
+    else:
+        os.environ["VC_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_AUTORUN"] = PREVIOUS_AUTORUN
+
+
+class FakeInput:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.connected = None
+        self.values = {}
+
+    def GetConnectedOutput(self):
+        return self.connected
+
+    def __setitem__(self, frame, value):
+        self.values[frame] = value
+
+    def __getitem__(self, frame):
+        return self.values.get(frame)
+
+
+class FakeTool:
+    def __init__(self, names=("Center", "Size")):
+        self.inputs = {name: FakeInput() for name in names}
+        self.modifier_calls = []
+
+    def FindInput(self, name):
+        return self.inputs.get(name)
+
+    def AddModifier(self, name, modifier):
+        self.modifier_calls.append((name, modifier))
+        self.inputs[name].connected = object()
+        return True
+
+    def GetInput(self, name, frame):
+        return self.inputs[name][frame]
+
+
+class FakeComp:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.locks = 0
+
+    def Lock(self):
+        self.locks += 1
+
+    def Unlock(self):
+        self.locks -= 1
+
+
+def payload(prop, source_type, keyframes):
+    return {
+        "authority": "visual_observed",
+        "source_evidence_id": "style_event",
+        "source_type": source_type,
+        "property": prop,
+        "keyframes": keyframes,
+    }
+
+
+def test_we_center_uses_path_and_temporal_modifier_readback():
+    tool = FakeTool()
+    result = MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(
+        FakeComp(), tool,
+        payload("Center", "slide", [
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": [-0.0106, 0.0565]},
+            {"frame": 2, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": [0.0, 0.0]},
+        ]),
+        3,
+    )
+    assert tool.modifier_calls == [("Center", "Path")]
+    assert [(row["local_frame"], row["actual"], row["modifier_connected"], row["matched"]) for row in result["readback"]] == [
+        (0, [-0.0106, 0.0565], True, True),
+        (2, [0.0, 0.0], True, True),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_selling_size_uses_bezier_spline_and_temporal_modifier_readback():
+    tool = FakeTool()
+    result = MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(
+        FakeComp(), tool,
+        payload("Size", "scale", [
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.30217657},
+            {"frame": 7, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 1.0},
+        ]),
+        8,
+    )
+    assert tool.modifier_calls == [("Size", "BezierSpline")]
+    assert [(row["local_frame"], row["actual"], row["modifier_connected"], row["matched"]) for row in result["readback"]] == [
+        (0, 1.30217657, True, True),
+        (7, 1.0, True, True),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_second_application_is_temporally_verified_without_mutation():
+    tool = FakeTool()
+    animation = payload("Size", "scale", [
+        {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.30217657},
+        {"frame": 7, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 1.0},
+    ])
+    MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(FakeComp(), tool, animation, 8)
+    second = MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(FakeComp(), tool, animation, 8)
+    assert second["already_correct"] is True
+    assert second["modified"] is False
+    assert second["keyframes_written"] == 0
+    assert tool.modifier_calls == [("Size", "BezierSpline")]
+
+
+def test_static_caption_is_a_zero_mutation_noop():
+    tool = FakeTool()
+    result = MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(FakeComp(), tool, None, 8)
+    assert result == {"ok": True, "selected": False, "modified": False, "keyframes_written": 0, "readback": []}
+    assert tool.modifier_calls == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("candidate", "duration", "message"),
+    [
+        (payload("Blend", "fade", [{"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 0.0}]), 2, "property_or_type"),
+        (payload("Size", "scale", []), 2, "keyframes"),
+        (payload("Size", "scale", [{"frame": 2, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 1.0}]), 2, "out_of_range"),
+        (payload("Size", "scale", [
+            {"frame": 1, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.2},
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 1.0},
+        ]), 2, "keyframe_order"),
+        (payload("Size", "scale", [
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.2},
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 1.0},
+        ]), 2, "duplicate_frame_conflict"),
+        (payload("Size", "scale", [{"frame": 0, "value": 1.0}]), 2, "keyframe_shape"),
+        ({**payload("Size", "scale", [{"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.0}]), "authority": "unresolved"}, 2, "authority"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_invalid_or_unresolved_payload_fails_before_mutation(candidate, duration, message):
+    tool = FakeTool()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):
+        MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(FakeComp(), tool, candidate, duration)
+    assert tool.modifier_calls == []
+
+
+def test_missing_textplus_input_fails_without_modifier_mutation():
+    tool = FakeTool(names=("Center",))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="input_not_found:Size"):
+        MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(
+            FakeComp(), tool,
+            payload("Size", "scale", [{"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.0}]),
+            2,
+        )
+    assert tool.modifier_calls == []
+
+
+def test_modifier_connection_failure_fails_without_keyframe_writes():
+    class NoConnectTool(FakeTool):
+        def AddModifier(self, name, modifier):
+            self.modifier_calls.append((name, modifier))
+            return False
+
+    tool = NoConnectTool()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="modifier_not_connected:Size"):
+        MODULE.apply_authorized_animation(
+            FakeComp(), tool,
+            payload("Size", "scale", [{"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 1.0}]),
+            2,
+        )
+    assert tool.inputs["Size"].values == {}

+from scripts.analysis.compile_step5a_v33_materialization import build_artifacts, digest
+from resolve_workspace.modules.video_cloner_step5a_v33_resolve_rebuild import _semantic_layer_hash
+
+
+def test_v33_materialization_preflight_is_complete_and_deterministic():
+    first, second = build_artifacts(), build_artifacts()
+    assert first == second
+    assert digest(first["manifest"]) == digest(second["manifest"])
+    assert first["manifest"]["object_count"] == 95
+    assert first["cleanup"]["pass"] is True
+    assert len(first["cleanup"]["timing_corrections"]) == 12
+    assert len(first["cleanup"]["text_corrections"]) == 1
+    assert first["cleanup"]["exact_duplicate_conflicts"] == []
+    assert first["cleanup"]["same_authored_object_conflicts"] == []
+    assert first["cleanup"]["style_corrections"] == []
+    assert first["cleanup"]["unknown"] == 0
+    assert first["reconciliation"]["current_v33_render_objects"] == 125
+    assert first["reconciliation"]["classification_counts"] == {
+        "KEEP": 30,
+        "MERGE_INTO_EXISTING": 83,
+        "SUPPRESS_AS_OBSERVATION": 12,
+        "REPLACE_OLD_OBJECT": 0,
+        "UNKNOWN": 0,
+    }
+    assert first["completeness"]["pass"] is True
+    assert first["collisions"]["same_track_illegal_overlaps"] == 0
+    assert first["regression"]["pass"] is True
+    assert first["protected_guard"]["pass"] is True
+    assert first["local_visual_sanity"]["pass"] is True
+
+
+def test_v33_reconciliation_removes_observation_level_regressions_without_word_branches():
+    result = build_artifacts()
+    decisions = {row["canonical_text"]: row["classification"] for row in result["reconciliation"]["decisions"]}
+    assert decisions["beforethe"] != "KEEP"
+    assert decisions["the hits yard"] != "KEEP"
+    assert decisions["partial hits transition fragment"] != "KEEP"
+    assert decisions["hits"] == "KEEP"
+    assert result["local_visual_sanity"]["checks"]["duplicate_semantic_stacks"] == 0
+
+
+def test_generated_only_equivalence_ignores_timeline_local_item_identity():
+    left = {"rows": [{"source_identity": "owner-a", "text": True, "lifecycle": True, "style": True}]}
+    right = {"rows": [{"source_identity": "owner-a", "text": True, "lifecycle": True, "style": True}]}
+    assert _semantic_layer_hash(left) == _semantic_layer_hash(right)
+
+
+def test_bounded_cleanup_resolves_regression_anchors_without_suppressing_source_objects():
+    result = build_artifacts()
+    objects = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in result["manifest"]["objects"]}
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0030"]["resolve_interval"] == [130, 154]
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0032"]["resolve_interval"] == [134, 137]
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0035"]["resolve_interval"] == [154, 155]
+    assert objects["caption_tracklet_0038"]["resolve_interval"] == [155, 158]
+    assert objects["canonical_source_object_78a21bf538c0a0ac"]["text"]["value"] == "in how"
+    assert result["cleanup"]["duplicates_suppressed"] == 0
+    assert result["cleanup"]["observation_objects_suppressed"] == 0
diff --git a/tests/test_style_profile_mvp_generic_comparison.py b/tests/test_style_profile_mvp_generic_comparison.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..534a57abbb71232c717a1331d10616c37b69c9bb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_style_profile_mvp_generic_comparison.py
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def _module(name):
+    path = ROOT / f"scripts/analysis/{name}.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+PROFILE = _module("build_style_profile_mvp_generic")
+COMPARE = _module("compare_style_profiles_mvp")
+
+
+def _hash(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _fresh_profile():
+    base = ROOT / "data/DZatr0EJt4B"
+    return PROFILE.build_profile(
+        base / "analysis/DZatr0EJt4B_analysis.json",
+        base / "planning/DZatr0EJt4B_edit_plan.json",
+        base / "analysis/DZatr0EJt4B_transitions.json",
+        base / "analysis/DZatr0EJt4B_camera_style_profile.json",
+        base / "analysis/DZatr0EJt4B_caption_style_grammar.json",
+        "DZatr0EJt4B",
+    )
+
+
+def test_generic_profile_is_deterministic_and_preserves_authority_boundaries():
+    accepted = ROOT / "data/DcJRJtUKScu/analysis/DcJRJtUKScu_style_profile_mvp.json"
+    accepted_hash = _hash(accepted)
+    profile = _fresh_profile()
+
+    assert json.loads(json.dumps(profile, sort_keys=True)) == profile
+    assert json.dumps(profile, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(_fresh_profile(), sort_keys=True)
+    assert set(profile) >= {"cuts_pacing", "transitions", "camera", "captions", "deferred", "source_artifacts"}
+    assert profile["cuts_pacing"]["observed"]["shot_count"] == 8
+    assert profile["cuts_pacing"]["observed"]["cut_count"] == 7
+    assert all(not row["family"].endswith("_candidate") for row in profile["transitions"]["recommended"]["merged_conservative_events"])
+    assert profile["captions"]["observed"]["opacity_rules"]["status"] == "UNKNOWN"
+    assert set(profile["deferred"]) == {"flash_execution", "generic_vfx", "occlusion_reconstruction", "sfx", "graphics"}
+    assert _hash(accepted) == accepted_hash
+    source = (ROOT / "scripts/analysis/build_style_profile_mvp_generic.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
+    assert not any(term in source for term in ("dcjrjtukscu", "dzatr0ejt4b", ".agent/gold", ".drt"))
+
+
+def test_comparator_separates_style_difference_unknown_and_limitation():
+    reference = json.loads((ROOT / "data/DcJRJtUKScu/analysis/DcJRJtUKScu_style_profile_mvp.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    candidate = _fresh_profile()
+    comparison = COMPARE.compare_profiles(reference, candidate)
+    repeat = COMPARE.compare_profiles(reference, candidate)
+    checks = {row["field"]: row["classification"] for row in comparison["dimensions"]["captions"]["checks"]}
+    transition_checks = {row["field"]: row["classification"] for row in comparison["dimensions"]["transitions"]["checks"]}
+
+    assert json.dumps(comparison, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(repeat, sort_keys=True)
+    assert comparison["verdict"] == "PASS_UNSEEN_REEL_MVP_GENERALIZATION"
+    assert comparison["dimensions"]["cuts_pacing"]["classification"] == "STYLE_DIFFERENCE"
+    assert checks["opacity_status"] == "UNKNOWN"
+    assert checks["enter_exit_availability"] == "PIPELINE_LIMITATION"
+    assert transition_checks["candidate_authority_separation"] == "MATCH"
+    assert comparison["pipeline_generalization"]["status"] == "PASS"
+    source = (ROOT / "scripts/analysis/compare_style_profiles_mvp.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
+    assert not any(term in source for term in ("dcjrjtukscu", "dzatr0ejt4b", ".agent/gold", ".drt"))

+++ b/tests/test_video_cloner_mvp_transition_filter.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from scripts.standalone.video_cloner_mvp_transition_filter import filter_mvp_transitions
+
+
+def test_unsupported_transition_is_demoted_without_losing_cut_evidence():
+    source = {
+        "success": True,
+        "schema": "video_cloner_transitions",
+        "transitions": [
+            {
+                "cut_frame": 461,
+                "transition_type": "whip_pan",
+                "editor_actionable": True,
+                "duration_frames": 8,
+                "duration_seconds": 0.3333,
+                "outgoing_frames": 4,
+                "incoming_frames": 4,
+                "scores": {"directional_context": {"outgoing": {}, "incoming": {}}},
+            },
+            {"cut_frame": 99, "transition_type": "flash_cut", "editor_actionable": True},
+        ],
+    }
+
+    filtered = filter_mvp_transitions(source)
+    candidate, supported = filtered["transitions"]
+
+    assert source["transitions"][0]["transition_type"] == "whip_pan"
+    assert candidate["cut_frame"] == 461
+    assert (candidate["transition_type"], candidate["editor_actionable"]) == ("whip_pan_candidate", False)
+    assert (candidate["duration_frames"], candidate["outgoing_frames"], candidate["incoming_frames"]) == (0, 0, 0)
+    assert supported["transition_type"] == "flash_cut" and supported["editor_actionable"] is True
+    assert filtered["summary"] == {"flash_cut": 1, "whip_pan_candidate": 1}
+    assert filtered["mvp_filter"]["demoted_count"] == 1
