diff --git a/tests/test_video_cloner_step4_fresh_animation_contract.py b/tests/test_video_cloner_step4_fresh_animation_contract.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..314a9c634b06c7daefeb477822a2ef4c88ca4c9b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_video_cloner_step4_fresh_animation_contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules.video_cloner_step4_fresh_reel2_textplus import (
+    _animation_result_matches_authority,
+    _artifact_identity_snapshot,
+    _inventory_delta,
+    _representative_overlap,
+    _select_owned_timeline,
+    _textplus_provision_matches_titles,
+    _timeline_identity_rows,
+)
+
+
+class _Timeline:
+    def __init__(self, name, unique_id):
+        self.name = name
+        self.unique_id = unique_id
+
+    def GetName(self):
+        return self.name
+
+    def GetUniqueId(self):
+        return self.unique_id
+
+
+def test_artifact_identity_snapshot_captures_runtime_observation(tmp_path):
+    artifact = tmp_path / "style.json"
+    artifact.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
+    rows = _artifact_identity_snapshot(
+        {"style_sha256": "expected"},
+        {"style": artifact},
+    )
+
+    assert rows == [{
+        "name": "style",
+        "expected_sha256": "expected",
+        "runtime_path": str(artifact.resolve()),
+        "is_file": True,
+        "observed_sha256": "44136fa355b3678a1146ad16f7e8649e94fb4fc21fe77e8310c060f61caaff8a",
+        "size": 2,
+        "mtime_ns": rows[0]["mtime_ns"],
+        "loaded_module_file": str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4_fresh_reel2_textplus.py"),
+        "loaded_module_sha256": rows[0]["loaded_module_sha256"],
+    }]
+
+
+def test_social_animation_uses_frozen_adapter_result_contract():
+    payload = {
+        "authority": "visual_observed",
+        "source_evidence_id": "style_event_sub_045",
+        "source_type": "scale",
+        "property": "Size",
+        "keyframes": [
+            {"frame": 0, "relative_time": 0.0, "value": 0.080528214},
+            {"frame": 23, "relative_time": 1.0, "value": 0.10833333333333332},
+        ],
+    }
+
+    assert 23 + 1 == 24
+    assert _animation_result_matches_authority(
+        {"ok": True, "selected": True, "modified": True, "keyframes_written": 2},
+        payload,
+    )
+    assert not _animation_result_matches_authority(
+        {"ok": True, "selected": False, "modified": False, "keyframes_written": 0},
+        payload,
+    )
+
+
+def test_overlap_pair_resolves_combined_simultaneous_composition():
+    lifecycle = {
+        "visual_overlap_pairs": [["caption_layer_sub_007", "caption_layer_sub_008"]],
+        "visual_compositions": [{
+            "composition_id": "visual_composition_sub_007__sub_008",
+            "relation": {"mode": "simultaneous"},
+            "window": [49, 62],
+            "tokens": [
+                {"token_id": "visual_token_sub_007", "semantic_ids": ["sub_007"], "window": [49, 53]},
+                {"token_id": "visual_token_sub_008", "semantic_ids": ["sub_008"], "window": [49, 62]},
+            ],
+        }],
+    }
+
+    assert _representative_overlap(lifecycle) == {
+        "composition_id": "visual_composition_sub_007__sub_008",
+        "mode": "simultaneous",
+        "window": [49, 62],
+        "tokens": [
+            {"token_id": "visual_token_sub_007", "semantic_ids": ["sub_007"], "window": [49, 53]},
+            {"token_id": "visual_token_sub_008", "semantic_ids": ["sub_008"], "window": [49, 62]},
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def test_import_ownership_uses_direct_return_then_single_inventory_delta():
+    existing = _Timeline("existing", "uid-existing")
+    imported = _Timeline("VC_R2_S5_20260919T120000Z", "uid-new")
+    before = _timeline_identity_rows([existing])
+    delta = _inventory_delta(before, _timeline_identity_rows([existing, imported]))
+
+    assert [(row["name"], row["unique_id"]) for row in delta] == [(imported.name, imported.unique_id)]
+    assert _select_owned_timeline(imported, delta) == (imported, "direct_return")
+    assert _select_owned_timeline(True, delta) == (imported, "inventory_delta")
+    assert _select_owned_timeline(None, delta + [_timeline_identity_rows([_Timeline("other", "uid-other")])[0]]) == (None, "ambiguous")
+
+
+def test_textplus_provision_requires_exact_requested_title_cardinality():
+    titles = [{"caption_id": f"sub_{index:03d}"} for index in range(92)]
+
+    def provision(created_count):
+        return {"ok": True, "created_count": created_count, "rows": [{}] * created_count, "failures": []}
+
+    assert not _textplus_provision_matches_titles(provision(91), titles)
+    assert _textplus_provision_matches_titles(provision(92), titles)
+    assert not _textplus_provision_matches_titles(provision(93), titles)
diff --git a/tests/test_video_cloner_step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight.py b/tests/test_video_cloner_step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..528d74c703d874e852c91cbb19a87384d5034435
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_video_cloner_step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight.py
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+import pytest
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step4_reel2_social_target_readonly_preflight as subject
+
+
+class Remote:
+    def __init__(self, **methods):
+        self.__dict__.update(methods)
+
+
+def item(uid="item-social", name="Text", track=2, start=365, end=376, text="social,", comps=None):
+    properties = {"Type": "Basic Title", "StyledText": text}
+    return track, Remote(
+        GetUniqueId=lambda: uid, GetName=lambda: name, GetStart=lambda: start,
+        GetEnd=lambda: end, GetDuration=lambda: end - start,
+        GetLeftOffset=lambda: None, GetMediaPoolItem=lambda: None,
+        GetProperty=lambda: properties, GetFusionCompCount=lambda: len(comps or []),
+        GetFusionCompByIndex=lambda index: (comps or [])[index - 1],
+    )
+
+
+def timeline(name=subject.TIMELINE_NAME, uid=subject.TIMELINE_UID, items=None):
+    rows = items if items is not None else [item()]
+    return Remote(
+        GetName=lambda: name, GetUniqueId=lambda: uid, GetStartFrame=lambda: 0,
+        GetEndFrame=lambda: 854, GetSetting=lambda key: 24,
+        GetTrackCount=lambda kind: max([row[0] for row in rows], default=0) if kind == "video" else 0,
+        GetItemListInTrack=lambda kind, track: [value for row_track, value in rows if kind == "video" and row_track == track],
+    )
+
+
+def resolve(project_name=subject.PROJECT_NAME, timelines=None):
+    values = timelines if timelines is not None else [timeline()]
+    project = Remote(
+        GetName=lambda: project_name, GetTimelineCount=lambda: len(values),
+        GetTimelineByIndex=lambda index: values[index - 1],
+    )
+    manager = Remote(GetCurrentProject=lambda: project)
+    return Remote(GetProjectManager=lambda: manager)
+
+
+def test_basic_title_requires_reconstruction():
+    result = subject.inspect(resolve())
+    assert result["classification"] == "TEXTPLUS_RECONSTRUCTION_REQUIRED"
+    assert result["target"]["timeline_item_uid"] == "item-social"
+    assert result["target"]["fusion_composition_count"] == 0
+    assert result["target"]["textplus_node_count"] == 0
+    assert result["compatibility"]["can_host_unchanged"] is False
+
+
+def test_wrong_project_fails_closed():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="project_identity"):
+        subject.inspect(resolve(project_name="Wrong"))
+
+
+def test_wrong_timeline_uid_fails_closed():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="timeline_uid"):
+        subject.inspect(resolve(timelines=[timeline(uid="wrong")]))
+
+
+def test_duplicate_timeline_or_structural_target_fails_closed():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="timeline_name_occurrence"):
+        subject.inspect(resolve(timelines=[timeline(), timeline()]))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="structural_target_occurrence"):
+        subject.inspect(resolve(timelines=[timeline(items=[item(), item(uid="duplicate")])]))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [[item(track=3)], [item(start=364)], []])
+def test_wrong_track_range_or_missing_target_fails_closed(rows):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="structural_target_occurrence"):
+        subject.inspect(resolve(timelines=[timeline(items=rows)]))
+
+
+def test_styled_text_mismatch_fails_closed():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="styled_text"):
+        subject.inspect(resolve(timelines=[timeline(items=[item(text="wrong")])]))
+
+
+def test_textplus_target_reports_modifier_state():
+    modifier = Remote(GetAttrs=lambda: {"TOOLS_RegID": "BezierSpline"}, GetKeyFrames=lambda: {0: 0.7, 23: 1.0})
+    output = Remote(GetTool=lambda: modifier)
+    input_object = Remote(GetConnectedOutput=lambda: output)
+    tool = Remote(
+        GetAttrs=lambda: {"TOOLS_Name": "Template", "TOOLS_RegID": "TextPlus"},
+        GetInput=lambda name, frame=0: "social," if name == "StyledText" else None,
+        FindInput=lambda name: input_object if name == "Size" else None,
+    )
+    comp = Remote(GetToolList=lambda *args: {"tool": tool})
+    result = subject.inspect(resolve(timelines=[timeline(items=[item(comps=[comp])])]))
+    assert result["classification"] == "TEXTPLUS_TARGET_EXISTS"
+    assert result["target"]["textplus_nodes"][0]["modifiers"]["Size"]["modifier_type"] == "BezierSpline"
+
+
+def test_mutation_command_is_rejected():
+    payload = {
+        "read_only": True, "expected_project": subject.PROJECT_NAME,
+        "target_timeline_name": subject.TIMELINE_NAME,
+        "expected_timeline_uid": subject.TIMELINE_UID,
+        "expected_item_name": subject.ITEM_NAME, "expected_track": subject.TRACK,
+        "expected_start": subject.START, "expected_end": subject.END,
+        "expected_text": subject.TEXT, "canonical_window": subject.CANONICAL_WINDOW,
+        "local_animation_range": subject.LOCAL_ANIMATION_RANGE,
+    }
+    for key in (
+        "mutation_permitted", "save_project", "create_permitted", "delete_permitted",
+        "title_write_permitted", "modifier_write_permitted", "keyframe_write_permitted",
+        "import_permitted", "relink_permitted", "replace_permitted", "timeline_selection_permitted",
+    ):
+        payload[key] = False
+    command = {"task_id": subject.TASK_ID, "mode": subject.MODE, "run_id": "run", "payload": payload}
+    subject.validate_command(command, "run")
+    mutated = deepcopy(command)
+    mutated["payload"]["save_project"] = True
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="read_only_command_authority"):
+        subject.validate_command(mutated, "run")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def load(path: Path, name: str):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader is not None
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+

+probe = load(ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py", "step4c_probe")
+publisher = load(ROOT / "scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step4c_animation_live_probe.py", "step4c_publisher")
+native = load(ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/step_3D_native_textplus_title_probe.py", "step4c_native")

+class Input:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.values = {}
+        self.connected = None
+
+    def __getitem__(self, frame): return self.values.get(frame)
+    def GetConnectedOutput(self): return self.connected
+
+
+class Modifier:
+    def __init__(self, kind, input_object):
+        self.kind = kind
+        self.input = input_object
+
+    def GetAttrs(self): return {"TOOLS_RegID": self.kind}
+    def GetKeyFrames(self): return dict(self.input.values)
+
+
+class Output:
+    def __init__(self, modifier): self.modifier = modifier
+    def GetTool(self): return self.modifier
+    def GetAttrs(self): return {"OUTS_Name": self.modifier.kind}
+
+
+class Tool:
+    def __init__(self, regid="TextPlus", name=None):
+        self.regid, self.Name = regid, name or regid
+        self.inputs = {"Center": Input(), "Size": Input(), "StyledText": Input(), "Input": Input()}
+    def FindInput(self, name): return self.inputs.get(name)
+    def GetAttrs(self): return {"TOOLS_RegID": self.regid, "TOOLS_Name": self.Name}
+    def SetInput(self, name, value): self.inputs[name].values[0] = value
+    def GetInput(self, name, frame=0): return self.inputs[name].values.get(frame)
+
+
+class Comp:
+    def __init__(self, textplus_count=1, connected=True):
+        self.text_tools = [Tool("TextPlus", f"Text{index + 1}") for index in range(textplus_count)]
+        self.tool = self.text_tools[0] if self.text_tools else None
+        self.media_out = Tool("MediaOut", "MediaOut1")
+        if connected and self.tool is not None:
+            self.media_out.FindInput("Input").connected = Output(self.tool)
+
+    def GetToolList(self, _selected=False, regid=None):
+        tools = {tool.Name: tool for tool in [*self.text_tools, self.media_out]}
+        return tools if regid is None else {name: tool for name, tool in tools.items() if tool.regid == regid}
+
+
+class Item:
+    count = 0
+
+    def __init__(self, name, start, end, track, textplus=False, textplus_count=1, connected=True, fusion_count=None):
+        Item.count += 1
+        self.name, self.start, self.end, self.track = name, start, end, track
+        self.uid = f"item-{Item.count}"
+        self.comp = Comp(textplus_count, connected) if textplus else None
+        self.fusion_count = fusion_count
+
+    def GetName(self): return self.name
+    def SetName(self, name): self.name = name; return True
+    def GetUniqueId(self): return self.uid
+    def GetStart(self): return self.start
+    def GetEnd(self): return self.end
+    def GetDuration(self): return self.end - self.start
+    def GetFusionCompCount(self): return self.fusion_count if self.fusion_count is not None else (1 if self.comp else 0)
+    def GetFusionCompByIndex(self, index): return self.comp if index == 1 else None
+    def GetMediaPoolItem(self): return None
+    def GetProperty(self): return {}
+
+
+class Timeline:
+    def __init__(self, name, tracks=None):
+        self.name, self.uid = name, f"timeline-{name}"
+        self.tracks = {int(key): list(value) for key, value in (tracks or {1: []}).items()}
+        self.project = None
+        self.locks = {}
+        self.current_frame = 0
+
+    def GetName(self): return self.name
+    def GetUniqueId(self): return self.uid
+    def GetTrackCount(self, kind): return max(self.tracks, default=0) if kind == "video" else 0
+    def GetItemListInTrack(self, kind, index): return list(self.tracks.get(index, [])) if kind == "video" else []
+    def GetStartFrame(self): return 0
+    def GetEndFrame(self): return max((item.end for items in self.tracks.values() for item in items), default=1000)
+    def GetStartTimecode(self): return "01:00:00:00"
+    def GetCurrentTimecode(self):
+        seconds, frame = divmod(self.current_frame, 24)
+        return f"01:00:{seconds:02d}:{frame:02d}"
+    def GetSetting(self, name): return "24" if name in ("timelineFrameRate", "timelinePlaybackFrameRate") else ""
+    def SetCurrentTimecode(self, value):
+        parts = value.replace(";", ":").split(":")
+        self.current_frame = int(parts[-2]) * 24 + int(parts[-1])
+        return True
+    def SetTrackLock(self, kind, index, locked): self.locks[(kind, index)] = locked; return True
+    def AddTrack(self, kind): self.tracks.setdefault(max(self.tracks, default=0) + 1, []); return kind == "video"
+    def DeleteClips(self, items, _ripple):
+        for track in self.tracks:
+            self.tracks[track] = [item for item in self.tracks[track] if item not in items]
+        return True
+    def DuplicateTimeline(self, name):
+        clone = Timeline(name, {
+            track: [Item(item.name, item.start, item.end, track, textplus=item.comp is not None) for item in items]
+            for track, items in self.tracks.items()
+        })
+        clone.project = self.project
+        self.project.timelines.append(clone)
+        return clone
+
+
+class MediaPool:
+    pass
+
+
+class Project:
+    def __init__(self, name="New Project 1", include_disposable=False):
+        reel1 = Timeline(probe.REEL1, {1: [Item("base1", 0, 900, 1)], 3: [Item("VC_TEXTPLUS_0001_sub_001", 10, 20, 3, True)]})
+        reel2 = Timeline(probe.REEL2, {1: [Item("base2", 0, 854, 1)]})
+        self.name, self.timelines, self.current, self.media_pool = name, [reel1, reel2], reel1, MediaPool()
+        if include_disposable:
+            self.timelines.append(Timeline("VC_STEP4C_ANIMATION_PROBE_test", {1: [], 2: [], 3: []}))
+        for timeline in self.timelines: timeline.project = self
+
+    def GetName(self): return self.name
+    def GetTimelineCount(self): return len(self.timelines)
+    def GetTimelineByIndex(self, index): return self.timelines[index - 1]
+    def GetCurrentTimeline(self): return self.current
+    def SetCurrentTimeline(self, timeline): self.current = timeline; return True
+    def GetMediaPool(self): return self.media_pool
+

+class Manager:
+    def __init__(self, project, mutate_on_save=False): self.project, self.save_calls, self.mutate_on_save = project, 0, mutate_on_save
+    def GetCurrentProject(self): return self.project
+    def SaveProject(self):
+        self.save_calls += 1
+        if self.mutate_on_save:
+            self.project.timelines[1].tracks[1][0].name = "changed"
+        return True
+
+
+class Resolve:
+    def __init__(self, project, mutate_on_save=False): self.manager, self.page = Manager(project, mutate_on_save), "edit"
+    def GetProjectManager(self): return self.manager
+    def GetCurrentPage(self): return self.page
+    def OpenPage(self, page): self.page = page; return True
+
+
+class Animation:
+    def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+    def find_input(self, tool, name): return tool.FindInput(name)
+    def connected_output(self, input_object): return input_object.GetConnectedOutput() if input_object else None
+    def read_input(self, tool, name, frame): return tool.FindInput(name).values.get(frame)
+    def normalize_value(self, _name, value): return value
+    def values_match(self, _name, actual, expected): return actual == expected
+    def apply_authorized_animation(self, _comp, tool, payload, duration):
+        self.calls.append(copy.deepcopy(payload))
+        if payload is None:
+            return {"ok": True, "selected": False, "modified": False, "keyframes_written": 0, "readback": []}
+        name = payload["property"]
+        input_object = tool.FindInput(name)
+        expected = {row["frame"]: row["value"] for row in payload["keyframes"]}
+        if input_object.connected is not None and input_object.values == expected:
+            return {"ok": True, "modified": False, "already_correct": True, "keyframes_written": 0, "readback": []}
+        kind = "Path" if name == "Center" else "BezierSpline"
+        input_object.connected = Output(Modifier(kind, input_object))
+        input_object.values = expected
+        return {"ok": True, "modified": True, "keyframes_written": len(expected), "readback": [{"matched": True} for _ in expected]}
+    def input_targets_are_correct(self, tool, name, targets):
+        item = tool.FindInput(name)
+        return item.connected is not None and all(item.values[row["local_frame"]] == row["expected"] for row in targets)
+
+
+class Carrier:
+    def __init__(self, delta_count=1, returned_mismatch=False, track=None, start_offset=0,
+                 duration_offset=0, textplus_count=1, connected=True, fusion_count=None):
+        self.delta_count = delta_count
+        self.returned_mismatch = returned_mismatch
+        self.track = track
+        self.start_offset = start_offset
+        self.duration_offset = duration_offset
+        self.textplus_count = textplus_count
+        self.connected = connected
+        self.fusion_count = fusion_count
+
+    def provision_textplus_media_carrier(self, project, timeline, video_items, start_frame,
+                                         end_frame, target_track, generated_name):
+        del project, video_items
+        track = self.track or target_track
+        start = start_frame + self.start_offset
+        end = start + (end_frame - start_frame) + self.duration_offset
+        created = []
+        for index in range(self.delta_count):
+            item = Item(generated_name if index == 0 else generated_name + "_extra", start, end, track,
+                        textplus=True, textplus_count=self.textplus_count,
+                        connected=self.connected, fusion_count=self.fusion_count)
+            timeline.tracks.setdefault(track, []).append(item)
+            created.append(item)
+        returned = Item("fallback", start, end, track, textplus=True) if self.returned_mismatch else (created[0] if created else Item("fallback", start, end, track, textplus=True))
+        return returned, {"ok": True, "backend": "media_pool_video_carrier_with_fusion_textplus"}
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def list_fusion_tools(comp): return list(comp.GetToolList(False).values())
+    @staticmethod
+    def fusion_tool_regid(tool): return tool.GetAttrs()["TOOLS_RegID"]
+    @staticmethod
+    def fusion_tool_name(tool): return tool.GetAttrs()["TOOLS_Name"]
+
+
+class Snapshots:
+    @staticmethod
+    def timeline_snapshot(timeline):
+        rows = [(track, item.name, item.uid, item.start, item.end) for track in sorted(timeline.tracks) for item in timeline.tracks[track]]
+        value = {"name": timeline.name, "uid": timeline.uid, "rows": rows}
+        value["signature"] = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)
+        return value
+
+
+def command(name="VC_STEP4C_ANIMATION_PROBE_test"):
+    return {"task_id": probe.TASK_ID, "mode": probe.MODE, "run_id": "run", "source_contract": {},
+            "payload": {"expected_project": probe.PROJECT_NAME, "protected_timelines": [probe.REEL1, probe.REEL2],
+                        "disposable_timeline_name": name, "mutation_permitted": True, "cleanup_permitted": False}}
+

+def run_fake(monkeypatch, project=None, mutate_on_save=False, command_value=None):
+    project = project or Project()
+    animation = Animation()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(probe, "queue_preflight", lambda _root, _run: {"running_count": 1, "pending_count": 0})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(probe, "repository_root", lambda: ROOT)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(native, "verify_source_contract", lambda _root, _command: {"verified_count": 5})
+    result = probe.execute(Resolve(project, mutate_on_save), {"command": command_value or command(), "run_id": "run"}, (native, animation, Snapshots, Carrier()))
+    return result, animation, project
+

+def existing_full_command(timeline, **overrides):
+    value = command(timeline.name)
+    value["payload"].update({
+        "reuse_existing_owned_disposable": True,
+        "ownership_required": "EXISTING_NEWLY_CREATED",
+        "expected_disposable_uid": timeline.uid,
+    })
+    value["payload"].update(overrides)
+    return value
+
+
+def insertion_context(carrier=None, project=None):
+    project = project or Project(include_disposable=True)
+    timeline = project.timelines[-1]
+    while timeline.GetTrackCount("video") < probe.TARGET_TRACK:
+        timeline.AddTrack("video")
+    animation = Animation()
+    return project, timeline, animation, carrier or Carrier()
+
+
+def insert(carrier=None, project=None):
+    project, timeline, animation, carrier = insertion_context(carrier, project)
+    result = probe._insert_title(native, animation, carrier, Resolve(project), project, timeline,
+                                 probe.STATIC_PROOF_FRAME, probe.STATIC_PROOF_NAME)
+    return result, project, timeline
+

+def test_full_probe_contract_dispatches_exact_payloads_and_proves_persistence_idempotency_static_and_protection(monkeypatch):

+        {"frame": 0, "expected": [-0.0106, 0.0565], "actual": [-0.0106, 0.0565], "matched": True},
+        {"frame": 2, "expected": [0.0, 0.0], "actual": [0.0, 0.0], "matched": True},
+    ]
+    assert [row["frame"] for row in result["persistent_readback"]["Size"]["readback"]] == [0, 7]
+    assert result["second_application"]["Center"]["keyframes_written"] == 0

+    assert result["static"]["before"] == result["static"]["after"]
+    assert result["protected_unchanged"] == {probe.REEL1: True, probe.REEL2: True}
+    assert result["mutation_counts"]["project_saves"] == 1

+def test_queue_preflight_requires_only_matching_running_command(tmp_path):
+    queue = tmp_path / ".agent/commands"
+    (queue / "pending").mkdir(parents=True)
+    (queue / "running").mkdir()
+    running = queue / "running/cmd.json"
+    running.write_text(json.dumps({"run_id": "run", "task_id": probe.TASK_ID}), encoding="utf-8")
+    assert probe.queue_preflight(tmp_path, "run")["running_count"] == 1
+    (queue / "pending/other.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
+    try:
+        probe.queue_preflight(tmp_path, "run")
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        assert "queue_state" in str(exc)
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("unsafe queue accepted")
+

+    assert result["mutation_counts"]["animation_keyframes_first"] == 0
+    assert result["mutation_counts"]["animation_keyframes_second"] == 0
+    assert animation.calls == []
+    assert result["protected_unchanged"] == {probe.REEL1: True, probe.REEL2: True}
+
+
+def test_zero_delta_cannot_use_helper_fallback_item():
+    try:
+        insert(Carrier(delta_count=0))
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        assert "title_ownership" in str(exc) and "delta=0" in str(exc)
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("helper fallback bypassed ownership")
+
+
+def test_multiple_delta_fails_closed():
+    try:
+        insert(Carrier(delta_count=2))
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        assert "title_ownership" in str(exc) and "delta=2" in str(exc)
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("multiple-item delta accepted")
+
+
+def test_returned_and_delta_uid_mismatch_fails_closed():
+    try:
+        insert(Carrier(returned_mismatch=True))
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        assert "title_ownership" in str(exc)
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("returned/delta mismatch accepted")
+
+
+def test_wrong_current_timeline_fails_before_provisioning():
+    project = Project(include_disposable=True)
+    project.SetCurrentTimeline = lambda _timeline: True
+    carrier = Carrier()
+    try:
+        insert(carrier, project)
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        assert "title_timeline_identity" in str(exc)
+        assert carrier.delta_count == 1
+        assert not project.timelines[-1].tracks.get(probe.TARGET_TRACK)
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("wrong current timeline accepted")
+
+
+def test_wrong_track_start_or_duration_fails_closed():
+    for carrier in (Carrier(track=2), Carrier(start_offset=1), Carrier(duration_offset=1)):
+        try:
+            insert(carrier)
+        except RuntimeError as exc:
+            assert "title_placement_or_timeline" in str(exc)
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError("wrong placement accepted")
+
+
+def test_ambiguous_fusion_or_textplus_identity_fails_closed():
+    for carrier in (Carrier(fusion_count=2), Carrier(textplus_count=2), Carrier(connected=False)):
+        try:
+            insert(carrier)
+        except RuntimeError as exc:
+            assert "title_" in str(exc)
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError("ambiguous Fusion identity accepted")

+++ b/tests/test_video_cloner_step5_f7_persisted_style_parity_diagnostic.py
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+RUNTIME = ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_persisted_style_parity_diagnostic.py"
+
+
+def load():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f7_persisted_parity_diagnostic", RUNTIME)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_scope_is_exact_and_runtime_has_no_resolve_mutation_calls() -> None:
+    module = load()
+    assert module.TARGET_TIMELINE == "VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5A_TEXTPLUS_VALIDATION_F7_66203b559cbd"
+    assert module.TARGET_IDS == (
+        "recovered_display_object_why_0001",
+        "recovered_display_object_local_we_0002",
+        "recovered_display_object_listing_0003",
+    )
+    tree = ast.parse(RUNTIME.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    called = {node.func.attr for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)}
+    assert not called & {
+        "SetInput", "SaveProject", "ImportTimelineFromFile", "DeleteTimelines",
+        "AddTrack", "SetName", "SetCurrentTimeline", "AddFusionComp",
+    }
+
+
+def test_evidence_is_written_before_comparator_or_classification() -> None:
+    tree = ast.parse(RUNTIME.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    run = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "run")
+    source = ast.get_source_segment(RUNTIME.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), run)
+    first_write = source.index("base.write(diagnostic_path, diagnostic)")
+    comparator = source.index("_base_projection(row, actual)")
+    classifier = source.index("_classify(projections)")
+    assert first_write < comparator < classifier
+
+
+def test_shadow_classification_preserves_sentinel_semantics() -> None:
+    module = load()
+    projections = {
+        "base": {
+            "fill": {"RESULT": True},
+            "shadow": {
+                "RESULT": False,
+                "OPERATIONAL_EXPECTATION": {"enabled": False},
+                "ACTUAL_NORMALIZED": {"enabled": False},
+            },
+        }
+    }
+    assert module._classify(projections) == {"shadow": "SEMANTICALLY_EQUAL_STRUCTURALLY_DIFFERENT"}
+
diff --git a/tests/test_video_cloner_step5_f7_placement.py b/tests/test_video_cloner_step5_f7_placement.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..272f09363d6136113345b8258158ba589ee275c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_video_cloner_step5_f7_placement.py
@@ -0,0 +1,249 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PREPARE = ROOT / "scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py"
+F6 = ROOT / ".agent/reports/VIDEO_CLONER_STEP5_F6_6000_LIFECYCLE_20261001_V1/20261001T083958505Z_1d261c7ba2c6/first/step5_f6_compile_contract.json"
+AUTHORITY = ROOT / "config/DcJRJtUKScu.accepted_f7_physical_track_placement.json"
+RUNTIME = ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f7_validation_rebuild.py"
+
+
+def load():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f7_placement_prepare", PREPARE)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_bounded_f7_placement_is_complete_and_deterministic() -> None:
+    module = load()
+    source = json.loads(F6.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    authority = json.loads(AUTHORITY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    corrected, validation = module.apply_placement_authority(source, authority)
+    rerun, rerun_validation = module.apply_placement_authority(source, authority)
+
+    assert module.fingerprint(corrected) == module.fingerprint(rerun)
+    assert validation["derived_objects_sha256"] == rerun_validation["derived_objects_sha256"]
+    assert validation["pass"] is True
+    assert validation["object_count"] == 65
+    assert validation["tracks_scanned"] == [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
+    assert validation["missing_lane_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["lane_track_mismatch_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["same_track_overlap_count"] == 0
+    assert validation["carrier_plan"]["result"] == "PASS"
+    assert validation["carrier_plan"]["title_count"] == 65
+    assert validation["unchanged_physical_placement_count"] == 62
+    assert validation["physical_placement_changes"] == {
+        "recovered_display_object_local_we_0002": {"before": [3, 2], "after": [4, 3]},
+        "caption_tracklet_0092": {"before": [2, 1], "after": [3, 2]},
+        "caption_tracklet_0093": {"before": [2, 1], "after": [3, 2]},
+    }
+    assert all(value["before"] == value["after"] for value in validation["invariant_hashes"].values())
+
+    by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in corrected["objects"]}
+    assert by_id["caption_tracklet_0089"]["resolve_interval"] == [542, 596]
+    assert len(by_id["caption_tracklet_0089"]["keyframes"]["scale"]) == 9
+    assert all(row["z_order_track"]["lane"] == row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"] - 1 for row in corrected["objects"])
+
+    normalized_source = copy.deepcopy(source)
+    for row in normalized_source["objects"]:
+        row["z_order_track"]["lane"] = row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"] - 1
+    expected_by_id = {row["source_identity"]: row for row in normalized_source["objects"]}
+    for identity, row in by_id.items():
+        if identity not in validation["physical_placement_changes"]:
+            assert row == expected_by_id[identity]
+
+
+def test_f7_style_path_handles_all_shadow_schemas_without_mutating_authority(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    runtime_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f7_runtime_shadow_test", RUNTIME)
+    runtime = importlib.util.module_from_spec(runtime_spec)
+    assert runtime_spec.loader
+    runtime_spec.loader.exec_module(runtime)
+    source = json.loads(F6.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    rows = source["objects"]
+    before = runtime.IMPLEMENTATION.carrier._fingerprint(rows)
+    schemas = Counter()
+    applied = {}
+
+    for row in rows:
+        effects = row.get("advanced_effects") or {}
+        shadow = effects.get("shadow")
+        kind = "mapping" if isinstance(shadow, Mapping) else "string" if isinstance(shadow, str) else "null_missing" if shadow is None else "other"
+        schemas[kind] += 1
+        runtime_row = runtime._runtime_style_row(row)
+        if kind == "mapping":
+            assert runtime_row is row
+            assert runtime_row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"] == shadow
+        else:
+            assert runtime_row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"] is None
+
+    def capture(_tool, cue, style, index, **_kwargs):
+        applied[index] = {"text": cue["text"], "style": copy.deepcopy(style)}
+        return {"applied": True}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.IMPLEMENTATION, "set_caption_textplus_style_inputs", capture)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.IMPLEMENTATION.visual, "set_static", lambda *_args, **_kwargs: {"ok": True})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.IMPLEMENTATION, "_set_gradient", lambda *_args, **_kwargs: {"ok": True})
+    for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
+        assert runtime.IMPLEMENTATION._style(row, object(), object(), index)["ok"] is True
+
+    assert schemas == Counter({"null_missing": 61, "string": 3, "mapping": 1})
+    assert len(applied) == 65
+    mapping_index = next(index for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1) if isinstance(row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"], Mapping))
+    assert applied[mapping_index]["style"]["shadow_enabled"] is True
+    assert applied[mapping_index]["style"]["shadow_opacity"] == 0.174431
+    for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
+        if not isinstance(row["advanced_effects"]["shadow"], Mapping):
+            assert applied[index]["style"]["shadow_enabled"] is False
+            assert applied[index]["style"]["shadow_opacity"] == 0.0
+    assert [applied[index]["text"] for index in range(1, 66)] == [row["text"]["value"] for row in rows]
+    assert runtime.IMPLEMENTATION.carrier._fingerprint(rows) == before
+
+
+def test_f7_gradient_serializer_and_proxy_normalizer() -> None:
+    runtime_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f7_runtime_gradient_test", RUNTIME)
+    runtime = importlib.util.module_from_spec(runtime_spec)
+    assert runtime_spec.loader
+    runtime_spec.loader.exec_module(runtime)
+    fill = {"stops": [
+        {"position": 0.0, "rgb": [190, 68, 78]},
+        {"position": 1.0, "rgb": [169, 50, 115]},
+    ]}
+    expected = {
+        0.0: {1: 190 / 255, 2: 68 / 255, 3: 78 / 255, 4: 1.0},
+        1.0: {1: 169 / 255, 2: 50 / 255, 3: 115 / 255, 4: 1.0},
+    }
+
+    class Proxy:
+        Value = expected
+
+        @property
+        def __class__(self):
+            raise AssertionError("raw proxy class metadata must not be inspected")
+
+    assert runtime._expected_gradient(fill) == expected
+    assert runtime._gradient_value(expected) is expected
+    assert runtime._gradient_rgba(Proxy()) == [list(stop.values()) for stop in expected.values()]
+    assert runtime._gradient_stops(Proxy()) == [
+        {"position": 0.0, "rgba": list(expected[0.0].values())},
+        {"position": 1.0, "rgba": list(expected[1.0].values())},
+    ]
+    assert runtime._gradient_rgba({0.0: {"R": 190 / 255, "G": 68 / 255, "B": 78 / 255, "A": 1.0}}) == [[190 / 255, 68 / 255, 78 / 255, 1.0]]
+    assert runtime._gradient_stops({"Value": {"Colors": expected}})[1]["position"] == 1.0
+    assert runtime._gradient_stops("<BlackmagicFusion.PyRemoteObject object>") == []
+    assert runtime._gradient_value(type("MalformedProxy", (), {"Value": []})()) is None
+    assert runtime._gradient_rgba({0.0: {1: 1.0, 2: 0.0, 3: 0.0}}) == []
+
+
+def _ideal_readback(row: dict) -> dict:
+    fill = row["fill"]
+    rgb = fill.get("resolve_rgb") or fill["stops"][0]["rgb"]
+    shadow = row["advanced_effects"].get("shadow")
+    if isinstance(shadow, Mapping):
+        shadow_readback = {
+            "enabled": 1.0,
+            "rgba": [value / 255.0 for value in shadow["color"]["effective_composite_rgb"]] + [shadow["strength"]["effective_darkening"]],
+            "offset": [shadow["offset"]["x_normalized"], shadow["offset"]["y_normalized"]],
+            "softness_x": shadow["softness"]["normalized_value"],
+            "softness_y": shadow["softness"]["normalized_value"],
+        }
+    else:
+        shadow_readback = {"enabled": 0.0, "rgba": [None] * 4, "offset": None, "softness_x": None, "softness_y": None}
+    gradient = [
+        {"position": float(stop["position"]), "rgba": [*(value / 255.0 for value in stop["rgb"]), float(stop.get("alpha", 1.0))]}
+        for stop in fill.get("stops", [])
+    ]
+    return {
+        "source_identity": row["source_identity"],
+        "text": row["text"]["value"],
+        "start": row["resolve_interval"][0],
+        "end": row["resolve_interval"][1],
+        "font": row["font"]["resolve_family"],
+        "font_style": row["font"]["resolve_style"],
+        "size": row["size"]["resolve_value"],
+        "center": row["position"]["resolve_center"],
+        "fill": [*(value / 255.0 for value in rgb), row["opacity"]["resolve_value"]],
+        "stroke": {"enabled": float(bool(row["stroke"]["resolve_enabled"])), "width": row["stroke"]["resolve_width"], "rgba": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]},
+        "opacity": {"alpha1": row["opacity"]["resolve_value"], "opacity1": 1.0},
+        "shadow": shadow_readback,
+        "static_rotation": row["static_rotation"]["resolve_degrees"] or 0.0,
+        "track": row["z_order_track"]["resolve_track"],
+        "keyframes": {
+            channel: [{"expected": key["value"], "actual": key["value"]} for key in row["keyframes"][channel]]
+            for channel in ("position", "scale", "rotation", "relative_visibility")
+        },
+        "style_extensions": {
+            "alpha": row["opacity"]["resolve_value"],
+            "type1": 2.0 if fill.get("type") == "linear_gradient" else 0.0,
+            "gradient": gradient,
+            "transform_shear": (row["font"].get("italic_treatment") or {}).get("value", 0.0),
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def test_corrected_f7_parity_projection_passes_all_65_without_mutating_authority() -> None:
+    runtime_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f7_runtime_parity_test", RUNTIME)
+    runtime = importlib.util.module_from_spec(runtime_spec)
+    assert runtime_spec.loader
+    runtime_spec.loader.exec_module(runtime)
+    contract = json.loads(F6.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    authority = json.loads(AUTHORITY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    contract, _validation = load().apply_placement_authority(contract, authority)
+    before = runtime.IMPLEMENTATION.carrier._fingerprint(contract)
+    rows = [_ideal_readback(row) for row in contract["objects"]]
+
+    result = runtime.IMPLEMENTATION._parity(contract, rows)
+
+    assert result["ok"] is True
+    assert result["object_count"] == 65
+    assert result["failures"] == []
+    assert runtime.IMPLEMENTATION.carrier._fingerprint(contract) == before
+    why = next(row for row in rows if row["source_identity"] == "recovered_display_object_why_0001")
+    assert why["fill"][3] == 0.75
+    assert why["style_extensions"]["alpha"] == 0.75
+    normal = next(row for row in rows if row["style_extensions"]["alpha"] == 1.0)
+    assert normal["fill"][3] == 1.0
+
+    missing = runtime.IMPLEMENTATION._parity(contract, rows[:-1])
+    assert missing["ok"] is False
+    assert any(value.startswith("missing:") for value in missing["failures"])
+    extra = copy.deepcopy(rows[0]); extra["source_identity"] = "unexpected_object"
+    unexpected = runtime.IMPLEMENTATION._parity(contract, [*rows, extra])
+    assert unexpected["ok"] is False
+    assert "unexpected:unexpected_object" in unexpected["failures"]
+
+
+def test_shadow_projection_is_schema_aware_and_mapping_checks_remain_detailed() -> None:
+    runtime_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f7_runtime_shadow_projection_test", RUNTIME)
+    runtime = importlib.util.module_from_spec(runtime_spec)
+    assert runtime_spec.loader
+    runtime_spec.loader.exec_module(runtime)
+    sentinel = "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_F5"
+    mapping = {"enabled": True}
+    assert runtime._shadow_for_parity(sentinel) is None
+    assert sentinel == "STYLE_UNRESOLVED_F5"
+    assert runtime._shadow_for_parity(None) is None
+    assert runtime._shadow_for_parity(mapping) is mapping
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="shadow_authority:list"):
+        runtime._shadow_for_parity([])
+
+    contract = json.loads(F6.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    authority = json.loads(AUTHORITY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    contract, _validation = load().apply_placement_authority(contract, authority)
+    rows = [_ideal_readback(row) for row in contract["objects"]]
+    mapping_identity = next(row["source_identity"] for row in contract["objects"] if isinstance(row["advanced_effects"].get("shadow"), Mapping))
+    actual = next(row for row in rows if row["source_identity"] == mapping_identity)
+    actual["shadow"]["enabled"] = 0.0
+    result = runtime.IMPLEMENTATION._parity(contract, rows)
+    assert result["ok"] is False
+    assert f"{mapping_identity}:shadow" in result["failures"]

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def _load(path: Path, name: str):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_preflight_preserves_accepted_f7_contract() -> None:
+    module = _load(ROOT / "scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review.py", "f8_review_prepare")
+    result = module.preflight(ROOT)
+    assert result["pass"] is True
+    assert result["renderables"] == 65
+    assert result["same_track_conflicts"] == 0
+    assert result["f2_f7_invariants_unchanged"] is True
+    assert result["f6_6000_interval"] == [542, 596]
+    assert result["f3_6000_scale_keys"] == 9
+    assert result["protected_timeline_mutation_planned"] is False
+    assert result["f7_timeline_mutation_planned"] is False
+
+
+def test_underlay_deletion_targets_only_non_fusion_and_non_video_items() -> None:
+    module = _load(ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8_generated_only_review.py", "f8_review_runtime")
+
+    class Item:
+        def __init__(self, fusion): self.fusion = fusion
+        def GetFusionCompCount(self): return self.fusion
+
+    captions = [Item(1), Item(1)]
+    source, audio = Item(0), Item(0)
+
+    class Timeline:
+        def GetTrackCount(self, kind): return {"video": 2, "audio": 1, "subtitle": 0}[kind]
+        def GetItemListInTrack(self, kind, track):
+            return source if False else ({("video", 1): [source], ("video", 2): captions, ("audio", 1): [audio]}.get((kind, track), []))
+        def DeleteClips(self, items, ripple):
+            assert items == [source, audio]
+            assert ripple is False
+            return True
+
+    assert module._delete_underlay(Timeline()) == {"ok": True, "video_items": 1, "audio_items": 1, "subtitle_items": 0, "total": 2}

@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+RUNTIME = ROOT / "resolve_workspace/modules/video_cloner_step5_f8a_attribution_size_diagnostic.py"
+
+
+def _load():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("f8a", RUNTIME)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_case_scope_and_timecode() -> None:
+    module = _load()
+    assert len(module.CASES) == 15
+    assert len(module.SOURCE_BBOXES) == 16
+    assert {identity for case in module.CASES for identity in case[3]} >= {
+        "continuous_visual_identity_0014", "caption_tracklet_0067", "caption_tracklet_0089",
+        "caption_tracklet_0094", "caption_tracklet_0096", "caption_tracklet_0045",
+        "caption_tracklet_0061", "recovered_display_object_listing_0003",
+    }
+    assert module._timecode("01:00:00:00", 55) == "01:00:02:07"
+
+
+def test_rect_normalization() -> None:
+    module = _load()
+    assert module._rect([10, 20, 110, 70]) == [10, 20, 110, 70]
+    assert module._rect({1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 110, 4: 70}) == [10, 20, 110, 70]
+    assert module._rect({"Left": 10, "Bottom": 20, "Right": 110, "Top": 70}) == [10, 20, 110, 70]
+    assert module._rect({}) is None
+
+
+def test_cleanup_requires_no_save_and_complete_rollback() -> None:
+    module = _load()
+    source = RUNTIME.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert 'cleanup["project_saved"] is False' in source
+    assert 'cleanup["target_unchanged"]' in source
+    assert 'cleanup["probe_absent"]' in source
+    assert "SaveProject" not in source
+
+
+def test_source_provenance_accepts_only_original_or_its_canonical_proxy(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    module = _load()
+    root = tmp_path / "project"
+    source = root / "input" / "Sample_Clip.mp4"
+    proxy = root / "media" / "Sample_Clip_proxy.mp4"
+    source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    proxy.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    source.write_bytes(b"source")
+    proxy.write_bytes(b"proxy")
+
+    original = module._source_provenance(source, {str(source)}, root)
+    assert original["provenance_relation"] == "ORIGINAL_SOURCE"
+    assert original["carrier_match"] is True
+    assert original["original_source_path"] == str(source.resolve())
+
+    derived = module._source_provenance(source, {str(proxy)}, root)
+    assert derived["canonical_proxy_path"] == str(proxy.resolve())
+    assert derived["provenance_relation"] == "CANONICAL_MEDIA_PREP_PROXY"
+    assert derived["identity_match"] is derived["carrier_match"] is True
+
+    other = root / "media" / "Other_proxy.mp4"
+    other.write_bytes(b"other")
+    assert module._source_provenance(source, {str(other)}, root)["carrier_match"] is False
+
+    outside = tmp_path / "outside" / proxy.name
+    outside.parent.mkdir()
+    outside.write_bytes(b"same name, wrong provenance")
+    outside_result = module._source_provenance(source, {str(outside)}, root)
+    assert outside_result["identity_match"] is True
+    assert outside_result["carrier_match"] is False
+
+    missing = root / "media" / "missing.mp4"
+    missing_result = module._source_provenance(source, {str(missing)}, root)
+    assert missing_result["provenance_relation"] == "OFFLINE_V1_CARRIER"
+    assert missing_result["carrier_match"] is False
+    assert module._source_provenance(source, {str(source), str(proxy)}, root)["carrier_match"] is False

+from __future__ import annotations

diff --git a/tests/test_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py b/tests/test_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a2fa3e15c6299ce7a8b1b9f8ba3dcd0b2c2bf916
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py
@@ -0,0 +1,453 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from resolve_workspace.modules import video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration as runtime
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def load_script(name: str, relative: str):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / relative)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader is not None
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+prepare = load_script("step6a_prepare_test", "scripts/davinci/prepare_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py")
+validator = load_script("step6a_validator_test", "scripts/davinci/validate_video_cloner_step6a_flash_integration.py")
+
+
+def authorities() -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    detector = json.loads((ROOT / runtime.DETECTOR_RELATIVE).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    planning = json.loads((ROOT / runtime.PLANNING_RELATIVE).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    return detector, planning
+
+
+class Timeline:
+    def __init__(self, name="gold", uid="u1"):
+        self.name, self.uid = name, uid
+
+    def GetName(self):
+        return self.name
+
+    def GetUniqueId(self):
+        return self.uid
+
+
+class Project:
+    def __init__(self, timelines, current=None):
+        self.timelines = timelines
+        self.current = current or timelines[0]
+
+    def GetTimelineCount(self):
+        return len(self.timelines)
+
+    def GetTimelineByIndex(self, index):
+        return self.timelines[index - 1]
+
+    def SetCurrentTimeline(self, timeline):
+        self.current = timeline
+        return True
+
+    def GetCurrentTimeline(self):
+        return self.current
+
+
+def geometry(monkeypatch, *, start=0, end=854, fps="24"):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.P4B, "timeline_snapshot", lambda _: {"settings": {"timelineFrameRate": fps, "timelinePlaybackFrameRate": fps}, "start_frame": start, "end_frame": end})
+
+
+def valid_report(mode: str) -> dict:
+    apply = mode == "apply"
+    return {"ok": True, "task_id": runtime.TASK_ID, "mode": runtime.MODE, "classification": "FIRST_APPLICATION" if apply else "ALREADY_VALID_REUSED", "authority_verification": {"ok": True}, "source_timeline_unchanged": True, "unrelated_timelines_unchanged": True, "target_after": {"ok": True, "persisted_fusion": {"ok": True}}, "visual_evidence": {"ok": apply}, "previous_timeline_restoration": {"ok": True}, "failures": [], "timeline_duplicate_count": 1 if apply else 0, "track_add_count": 1 if apply else 0, "flash_carrier_append_count": 1 if apply else 0, "media_import_count": 0, "save_project_count": 1 if apply else 0, "persistent_readback_ok": apply, "idempotent": not apply}
+
+
+def test_accepted_reel2_plan_has_exactly_one_flash():
+    plan = prepare.build_plan(*authorities())
+    assert len(plan["flashes"]) == 1
+    assert plan["flashes"][0]["transition_type"] == "flash_cut"
+    runtime.validate_plan(plan)
+
+
+def test_exact_half_open_594_598_mapping(monkeypatch):
+    geometry(monkeypatch)
+    mapping = runtime.frame_mapping(object())
+    assert mapping["mapped_span"] == [594, 598]
+    assert runtime.mapped_flash(mapping)[0]["start_frame"] == 594
+    assert runtime.mapped_flash(mapping)[0]["duration_frames"] == 4
+
+
+def test_nonzero_timeline_start_maps_by_offset(monkeypatch):
+    geometry(monkeypatch, start=86400, end=87254)
+    mapping = runtime.frame_mapping(object())
+    assert mapping["mapped_frames"] == {"594": 86994, "596": 86996, "598": 86998}
+
+
+def test_fps_mismatch_fails_closed(monkeypatch):
+    geometry(monkeypatch, fps="23.976")
+    with pytest.raises(runtime.FrameMappingError, match="STEP6A_GOLD_FRAME_MAPPING_MISMATCH:fps"):
+        runtime.frame_mapping(object())
+
+
+def test_gold_duration_mapping_mismatch_fails_closed(monkeypatch):
+    geometry(monkeypatch, end=597)
+    with pytest.raises(runtime.FrameMappingError, match="STEP6A_GOLD_FRAME_MAPPING_MISMATCH:range"):
+        runtime.frame_mapping(object())
+
+
+def test_many_existing_tracks_map_flash_to_top_plus_one(monkeypatch):
+    source = {"video_track_count": 11, "audio_track_count": 2, "captions": {"x": 1}, "non_caption": {"x": 2}, "geometry": {"x": 3}}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "caption_snapshot", lambda _: {"x": 1})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "non_caption_snapshot", lambda _: {"x": 2})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "frame_mapping", lambda _: {"x": 3})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V1, "track_count", lambda _, kind: 12 if kind == "video" else 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V4, "neutral_flash_snapshot", lambda *_: {"ok": True, "count": 1, "neutral_carrier_count": 1, "source_video_carrier_count": 0, "rows": [{"track_index": 12}]})
+    result = runtime.target_contract(source, object(), [{}])
+    assert result["ok"] and result["expected_flash_track"] == 12
+
+
+def test_wrong_overlay_track_fails_contract(monkeypatch):
+    source = {"video_track_count": 11, "audio_track_count": 2, "captions": {}, "non_caption": {}, "geometry": {}}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "caption_snapshot", lambda _: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "non_caption_snapshot", lambda _: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "frame_mapping", lambda _: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V1, "track_count", lambda _, kind: 12 if kind == "video" else 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V4, "neutral_flash_snapshot", lambda *_: {"ok": True, "count": 1, "neutral_carrier_count": 1, "source_video_carrier_count": 0, "rows": [{"track_index": 2}]})
+    assert not runtime.target_contract(source, object(), [{}])["ok"]
+
+
+def test_exact_current_timeline_selection_and_readback():
+    target = Timeline("target", "target-uid")
+    assert runtime.select_and_prove(Project([target]), target)["ok"]
+
+
+def test_current_timeline_readback_mismatch_fails():
+    target, other = Timeline("target", "target-uid"), Timeline("other", "other-uid")
+    project = Project([target, other], current=other)
+    project.SetCurrentTimeline = lambda _: True
+    assert not runtime.select_and_prove(project, target)["ok"]
+
+
+def test_runtime_restores_previous_timeline_in_finally():
+    text = Path(runtime.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "finally:" in text and "previous_timeline_restoration" in text and "select_and_prove(project, previous)" in text
+
+
+def test_caption_snapshot_is_dense_and_structural():
+    text = Path(runtime.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    for token in ("CAPTION_PROPERTIES", "_property_snapshot", "clip_enabled", "STABLE_INVENTORY_FIELDS"):
+        assert token in text
+
+
+def test_unrelated_inventory_comparison_is_multiset_safe():
+    left = [{"name": "a", "signature": "1"}, {"name": "a", "signature": "1"}]
+    assert runtime.same_inventory(left, list(reversed(left)))
+    assert not runtime.same_inventory(left, left[:1])
+
+
+def test_v4_media_ownership_helper_is_reused():
+    text = Path(runtime.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "V4.import_neutral_carrier" in text
+    assert "V4._delete_owned_media_pool_item" in text
+
+
+def test_ambiguous_and_incompatible_media_are_fail_closed():
+    text = Path(runtime.V4.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "PREEXISTING_INCOMPATIBLE" in text
+    assert "OWNERSHIP_AMBIGUOUS" in text
+
+
+def test_partial_mutation_rollback_deletes_only_owned_resources():
+    text = Path(runtime.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "not saved and media_pool is not None and (target_created or gold_imported)" in text
+    assert 'DeleteTimelines", owned_timelines' in text
+    assert '"owned_only": True' in text
+
+
+def test_successful_second_run_validator_requires_zero_mutations():
+    result = validator.validate(valid_report("idempotency"), "idempotency")
+    assert result["ok"]
+    bad = valid_report("idempotency")
+    bad["flash_carrier_append_count"] = 1
+    assert not validator.validate(bad, "idempotency")["ok"]
+
+
+def test_slide_whip_blur_and_crossfade_are_non_executable():
+    plan = prepare.build_plan(*authorities())
+    assert set(plan["non_executable_transition_types"]) == {"slide_transition_candidate", "whip_pan_candidate", "blur_transition", "crossfade_candidate"}
+    assert {row["transition_type"] for row in plan["flashes"]} == {"flash_cut"}
+
+
+def test_duplicate_step6a_target_fails_closed():
+    project = Project([Timeline(runtime.TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME, "1"), Timeline(runtime.TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME, "2")])
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="timeline_identity"):
+        runtime.find_exact(project, runtime.TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME)
+
+
+def test_first_application_validator_requires_one_bounded_delta():
+    assert validator.validate(valid_report("apply"), "apply")["ok"]
+    bad = valid_report("apply")
+    bad["track_add_count"] = 2
+    assert not validator.validate(bad, "apply")["ok"]
+
+
+def command_context(tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, project=runtime.PROJECT_NAME, payload_project=None):
+    plan = prepare.build_plan(*authorities())
+    plan_path = tmp_path / "plan.json"
+    plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan), encoding="utf-8")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "sha256", lambda _: "plan-hash")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "verify_input_hashes", lambda _: {"ok": True, "rows": []})
+    run_id = "20261005T000000000Z_" + "0" * 32
+    payload = {
+        "repository_root": str(tmp_path),
+        "report_dir": "report",
+        "run_mode": "apply",
+        "plan_path": str(plan_path),
+        "plan_sha256": "plan-hash",
+        "expected_project": project if payload_project is None else payload_project,
+    }
+    return {"run_id": run_id, "command": {"task": runtime.TASK_ID, "mode": runtime.MODE, "run_id": run_id, "payload": payload}}
+
+
+class GuardedMediaPool:
+    def __init__(self, events):
+        self.events = events
+
+    def ImportTimelineFromFile(self, *_):
+        self.events.append("gold_import")
+        return object()
+
+    def DeleteTimelines(self, timelines):
+        self.events.append("delete_owned_target")
+        return bool(timelines)
+
+    def DeleteClips(self, *_):
+        self.events.append("delete_shared_media")
+        return True
+
+
+class GuardedProject:
+    def __init__(self, name, events, source=None):
+        self.name, self.events, self.source = name, events, source or Timeline(runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "gold-uid")
+        self.current, self.target = self.source, None
+        self.media_pool = GuardedMediaPool(events)
+
+    def GetName(self):
+        return self.name
+
+    def GetMediaPool(self):
+        return self.media_pool
+
+    def GetCurrentTimeline(self):
+        return self.current
+
+    def SetCurrentTimeline(self, timeline):
+        self.current = timeline
+        self.events.append("select_timeline")
+        return True
+
+
+class GuardedManager:
+    def __init__(self, project, events):
+        self.project, self.events = project, events
+
+    def GetCurrentProject(self):
+        return self.project
+
+    def SaveProject(self):
+        self.events.append("save")
+        return True
+
+
+class GuardedResolve:
+    def __init__(self, project, events):
+        self.manager = GuardedManager(project, events)
+
+    def GetProjectManager(self):
+        return self.manager
+
+
+def test_plan_and_payload_contain_exact_expected_project(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    detector, planning = authorities()
+    plan = prepare.build_plan(detector, planning)
+    assert plan["project_name"] == runtime.PROJECT_NAME == "New Project 1"
+    for relative, value in ((runtime.DETECTOR_RELATIVE, detector), (runtime.PLANNING_RELATIVE, planning)):
+        path = tmp_path / relative
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(json.dumps(value), encoding="utf-8")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare.runtime, "verify_input_hashes", lambda _: {"ok": True})
+    receipt = prepare.publish(tmp_path, "apply", "20261005T000000000Z_" + "1" * 32)
+    command = json.loads((tmp_path / receipt["command_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    assert command["payload"]["expected_project"] == plan["project_name"]
+
+
+def test_altered_plan_project_fails_validation():
+    plan = prepare.build_plan(*authorities())
+    plan["project_name"] = "Other Project"
+    plan["plan_sha256"] = runtime.V1.canonical_sha256({key: value for key, value in plan.items() if key != "plan_sha256"})
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="plan_project"):
+        runtime.validate_plan(plan)
+
+
+def test_stale_payload_project_fails_before_resolve_access(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    context = command_context(tmp_path, monkeypatch, payload_project="Other Project")
+
+    class UntouchedResolve:
+        def GetProjectManager(self):
+            raise AssertionError("Resolve must not be accessed")
+
+    report = runtime.run(UntouchedResolve(), context)
+    assert report["failures"] == ["ValueError: payload_identity"]
+
+
+def test_wrong_project_fails_before_any_resolve_content_mutation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    events = []
+    project = GuardedProject("Other Project", events)
+    context = command_context(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    report = runtime.run(GuardedResolve(project, events), context)
+    assert report["failures"] == ["RuntimeError: project_identity"]
+    assert not set(events) & {"gold_import", "duplicate", "select_timeline", "track", "media_import", "append", "fusion", "save"}
+
+
+def test_correct_project_passes_identity_gate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    events = []
+    project = GuardedProject(runtime.PROJECT_NAME, events)
+    context = command_context(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+
+    def stop_after_gate(*_):
+        events.append("gold_resolution")
+        raise RuntimeError("stop_after_identity_gate")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "resolve_gold_source", stop_after_gate)
+    report = runtime.run(GuardedResolve(project, events), context)
+    assert events == ["gold_resolution", "select_timeline"]
+    assert report["project_name"] == runtime.PROJECT_NAME
+
+
+def run_first_application(tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, changed_inventory):
+    events = []
+    source = Timeline(runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "gold-uid")
+    project = GuardedProject(runtime.PROJECT_NAME, events, source)
+    context = command_context(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    source_state = {"timeline_name": runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "timeline_uid": "gold-uid", "video_track_count": 3, "audio_track_count": 2, "geometry": {"mapped_frames": {"594": 594, "596": 596, "598": 598}}, "captions": {"sha256": "captions"}, "non_caption": {"sha256": "base"}}
+    baseline = [{"name": runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "signature": "gold"}, {"name": "unrelated", "signature": "safe"}]
+    changed = [{"name": runtime.GOLD_TIMELINE_NAME, "signature": "gold"}, {"name": "unrelated", "signature": "changed"}]
+    inventory_calls = 0
+
+    def duplicate(name):
+        events.append("duplicate")
+        project.target = Timeline(name, "target-uid")
+        return project.target
+
+    source.DuplicateTimeline = duplicate
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "resolve_gold_source", lambda *_: (source, {"route": "EXACT_EXISTING_GOLD_TIMELINE", "imported": False}))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "source_state", lambda _: dict(source_state))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "target_contract", lambda *_: {"ok": True})
+
+    def find_exact(_, name, *, allow_missing=False):
+        if name == runtime.TARGET_TIMELINE_NAME:
+            return project.target
+        return source
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "find_exact", find_exact)
+
+    def inventory(_):
+        nonlocal inventory_calls
+        inventory_calls += 1
+        if inventory_calls == 2:
+            events.append("inventory_pre_save")
+            return changed if changed_inventory else baseline
+        return baseline
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "inventory_without_target", inventory)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V1, "ensure_extra_video_track", lambda *_: events.append("track") or {"ok": True, "target_track": 4})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V4, "validate_neutral_assets", lambda _: {"ok": True})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V4, "import_neutral_carrier", lambda *_: {"ok": True, "item": object(), "import_performed": False, "ownership_classification": "PREEXISTING_COMPATIBLE", "rollback_delete_permitted": False})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V1, "append_flash_carriers", lambda *args: events.append("append") or {"ok": True, "assigned": [(args[3][0], object())]})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "exact_flash_item", lambda *_: events.append("reacquire_flash") or object())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.V1, "configure_flash", lambda *_: events.append("fusion") or {"ok": True})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.C1, "capture_visual_evidence", lambda *_: events.append("visual_render") or {"ok": True, "total_frames": 4})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "persisted_target_contract", lambda *_: {"ok": True, "checks": {"flash_fusion_persisted": True}, "persisted_fusion": {"ok": True, "fusion_comp_count": 1}})
+    report = runtime.run(GuardedResolve(project, events), context)
+    return report, events
+
+
+def test_unchanged_non_target_inventory_allows_save_in_order(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    report, events = run_first_application(tmp_path, monkeypatch, changed_inventory=False)
+    assert report["ok"] and report["save_project_count"] == 1
+    assert events.index("reacquire_flash") < events.index("fusion") < events.index("inventory_pre_save") < events.index("visual_render") < events.index("save")
+
+
+def test_changed_non_target_inventory_fails_before_application_save_and_rolls_back_owned_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    report, events = run_first_application(tmp_path, monkeypatch, changed_inventory=True)
+    assert report["failures"] == ["RuntimeError: pre_save_non_target_regression"]
+    assert report["save_project_count"] == 0
+    assert events.index("inventory_pre_save") < events.index("delete_owned_target") < events.index("save")
+    assert "delete_shared_media" not in events
+    assert report["rollback"]["media_delete"]["attempted"] is False
+
+
+class FusionCarrier:
+    def __init__(self, count):
+        self.count = count
+
+    def GetFusionCompCount(self):
+        return self.count
+
+    def GetFusionCompByIndex(self, index):
+        return object() if self.count and index == 1 else None
+
+
+def persistence_contract(monkeypatch, count):
+    item = FusionCarrier(count)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "target_contract", lambda *_: {"ok": True, "checks": {"base": True}, "flash": {"ok": True}, "expected_flash_track": 9})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "exact_flash_item", lambda *_: item)
+    return runtime.persisted_target_contract({}, object(), [{}])
+
+
+def test_persisted_fusion_count_zero_fails_even_when_live_snapshot_passes(monkeypatch):
+    result = persistence_contract(monkeypatch, 0)
+    assert not result["ok"]
+    assert result["persisted_fusion"] == {"ok": False, "fusion_comp_count": 0, "reacquired_carrier": True}
+
+
+def test_persisted_fusion_reacquired_carrier_with_comp_passes(monkeypatch):
+    result = persistence_contract(monkeypatch, 1)
+    assert result["ok"]
+    assert result["persisted_fusion"]["fusion_comp_count"] == 1
+
+
+def test_partial_target_with_one_neutral_carrier_is_repairable_without_append(monkeypatch):
+    item = FusionCarrier(0)
+    contract = {
+        "ok": False,
+        "checks": {"caption_structural_snapshot_unchanged": True, "non_caption_inventory_unchanged": True, "timeline_geometry_unchanged": True, "audio_track_count_unchanged": True, "top_overlay_track_exact": True, "one_authorized_flash": False},
+        "expected_flash_track": 9,
+        "flash": {"count": 1, "source_video_carrier_count": 0, "rows": [{"name": "flash", "track_index": 9, "start": 594, "duration": 4, "carrier": {"neutral_carrier_ok": True}}]},
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "target_contract", lambda *_: contract)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "exact_flash_item", lambda *_: item)
+    result = runtime.repairable_partial_target({}, object(), [{"name": "flash", "start_frame": 594, "duration_frames": 4}])
+    assert result["ok"] and result["item"] is item and result["fusion_comp_count"] == 0
+
+
+def test_partial_target_repair_validator_requires_zero_new_carriers():
+    report = valid_report("apply")
+    report.update({"classification": "PARTIAL_TARGET_REPAIRED", "timeline_duplicate_count": 0, "track_add_count": 0, "flash_carrier_append_count": 0})
+    assert validator.validate(report, "apply")["ok"]
+    report["flash_carrier_append_count"] = 1
+    assert not validator.validate(report, "apply")["ok"]
+
+
+def test_validator_rejects_missing_persisted_fusion():
+    report = valid_report("apply")
+    report["target_after"]["persisted_fusion"] = {"ok": False, "fusion_comp_count": 0}
+    assert not validator.validate(report, "apply")["ok"]
